text.en:
Initially a patient at Rhodes Island, Popukar requested and passed the trial to become an Operator for Rhodes Island. She was assigned to Reserve Op Team A6.
She possesses tremendous destructive power, becoming the team's heavy.
text.zh:
作为患者被罗德岛接收，因能力出众，在征求本人意见后，接受并通过测试，成为罗德岛的一员，被分配到预备行动组A6。
拥有出色的破坏力，是小队的攻坚手。

text.en:
Imaging test for this Operator showed blurry outline of internal organs with visible unusual dark spots. Unusually high concentration of Originium particles were present in her circulation, indicating signs of infection and confirming her as infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 3% 
Crystallization visible on surface of body, with many symptoms of Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.2u/L 
Subject is currently stabilized, but regular observation and treatment are required.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】3%
包括体表的源石结晶在内，干员泡普卡拥有明显的感染者症状。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.2u/L
患者目前病程控制稳定。需要保持定期观察与控制。

text.en:
A member of Reserve Op Team A6. Although not capable of complex reasoning, her infection bestowed on her an ability that made her a suitable Operator. 
The source of a lot of problems for Team A6, most of these are unintentional. Because of her sincerity, she is also the easiest to forgive.
text.zh:
预备行动组A6的一员。虽然心智水平不足以承担复杂工作，但通过矿石病感染获得的怪力使得她破格成为了干员。
是A6的麻烦制造者，经常无意之间闯祸。但因为态度诚恳，也是最容易被原谅的一个。

text.en:
Unlike most other members, Popukar was taken in by Dr. Kal'tsit personally.
 Dr. Kal'tsit did not explain why she made this choice, only saying Popukar would stay on as a full-time member of Rhodes Island. 
However, Dr. Ansel said that was the first time she had ever seen Dr. Kal'tsit visibly upset.
text.zh:
和大部分干员有所不同，泡普卡是被凯尔希医生捡回来的。
凯尔希医生对于为何将她带回来一事并没有作过多说明，只是表示从今往后她将作为罗德岛的一员生活。
不过，据当时同行的安赛尔医生表示，那是他第一次看到凯尔希医生生气的样子。

text.en:
Although Popukar failed her Operator exam, she was allowed to work in logistics, rather than being cast out. 
And as it is so rare for an infection to make a patient stronger, even rarer to the extent of Popukar's infection, she is a very valuable case study.
text.zh:
当然，即使泡普卡没有通过干员测试，无家可归的她也能够获得后勤的工作。
另外，感染矿石病后在力量方面得到强化的病例本身就不多，像泡普卡这样得到极大强化的更是少见，从这个意义上，她的存在也很有价值。

text.en:
Popukar has gradually become one of the mascots of Rhodes Island. After all, no one could hate such an energetic little cutie -- even if she occasionally engages in 'minor' vandalism. 
Moreover, since joining A6, she has a much bigger family. Their shenanigans are just part of the Rhodes Island color nowadays.
text.zh:
泡普卡逐渐成为了罗德岛的吉祥物之一。毕竟，没有人会讨厌这样一个朝气蓬勃的小可爱——虽然这个小可爱偶尔还是会不小心搞点“小”破坏出来。
而且，在被编入A6后，她还多了许多家人，这一家子的鸡飞狗跳，如今也是罗德岛基地的风景之一。

value.en: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected.
value.zh: 体表有源石结晶分布，确认为感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected.
infectionStatus.zh: 体表有源石结晶分布，确认为感染者。

text.en: Originally a patient, she was accepted by Rhodes Island because she was found to be incredibly observant in examinations. Assigned to Reserve Op Team A6.
text.zh: 作为患者被罗德岛接收，因能力出众，在征求本人意见后，接受并通过测试，成为罗德岛的一员，被分配到预备行动组A6。

text.en:
Imaging test for this Operator showed blurry outline of internal organs with visible unusual dark spots. Unusually high concentration of Originium particles were present in her circulation, indicating signs of infection and confirming her as infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 2%
Crystallization is visible on body surface, with many symptoms of Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.30u/L
Mid-stage infection but in stable condition. Regular observation and treatment required.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】2%
包括体表的源石结晶在内，干员空爆拥有明显的感染者症状。

【血液内源石密度】0.30u/L. 
感染步入中期，患者目前病程控制稳定。需要保持定期观察与控制。

text.en:
She is a soldier in Reserve Op Team A6.
The problem child of A6, she loves to stick her nose where it doesn't belong and stir the pot. 
Catapult is a repeat offender who always gets into trouble and irritates Orchid in particular..
text.zh:
预备行动组A6的一员，士兵出身。
A6的问题儿童，平日吊儿郎当，看到热闹就会凑上去煽风点火，甚至自己也插一脚进去。
因为相比其他队友，属于明知故犯的类型，所以每次出事总是被梓兰批评得最狠的那一个。

text.en:
She didn't make a big mess in the last city she served. 
The mayor didn't step down, no one suspended the construction of the dam, and the vaults she blew up only accounted for a fraction of the city's revenue. 
Just a matter of time before the consequences finally kick in.
text.zh:
空爆过去服役的那座城市并没有因为她的行为产生巨大的改变。
城主并没有因此下台，也没有停止横征暴敛，甚至空爆炸掉的金库也只是城主众多财富中的九牛一毛。
不过，她的行为也并不是完全没有带来影响。只是，这份影响距离开花结果，尚有一段时日。

text.en:
Catapult actually enjoys hearing Orchid's critiques, and even deliberately makes her angry sometimes. 
Because she knows Orchid means well, she makes trouble for her.
text.zh:
空爆事实上相当享受梓兰的批评，有时候甚至是故意去惹她生气的。
因为她知道，愿意这么对待她的，才是真心对她好的。

text.en:
Catapult often avoids responsibility and work. It is hard to say if this is because she is simply rebellious, or something left over from her time in the military, or both.
But she is a good girl, otherwise she wouldn't have blown up the vaults. Although she wasn't happy with it, she did the best she could. In addition, since her time at Rhodes Island, she has never neglected her duty. 
If one day Rhodes Island disappoints her, she just might blow something up and leave. Hopefully, that day never comes.
text.zh:
空爆喜欢推卸责任，逃避工作，很难说，这是她性格中叛逆的成分作祟，还是她过去服役军队的风气使然，或许兼而有之。
但她的本性还是善良的，否则，也不会做下炸金库这样的事。虽然结果并不如人意，但那已经是她所能做到的极限。而且，来到罗德岛后，她虽然吊儿郎当，却也从没有玩忽职守。
若是有一天罗德岛令她失望，说不定她也会炸点什么然后一走了之吧，但愿，那一天永远不会到来。

value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Infection confirmed through clinical diagnosis.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

text.en: Initially a patient at Rhodes Island, volunteered to become an Operator. He was assigned to Reserve Op Team A6 after completing his examination battery.
text.zh: 作为患者进入罗德岛接受治疗，出于本人的意愿，在通过干员测试后，成为罗德岛的一员，被分配到预备行动组A6。

text.en:
Imaging test for this Operator showed blurry outline of internal organs with visible unusual dark spots. Unusually high concentration of Originium particles were present in his circulation, indicating signs of infection and confirming him as infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 8% 
Medical readings indicate subject has many symptoms of Oripathy. Oddly, subject has no visible crystallization on body. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.30u/L
Infection is spreading at a constant rate. Regular observation and treatment mandatory.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】8%
干员月见夜在医疗器械下，能发现明显的感染者症状。不过奇特的是，他的体表没有任何源石结晶。

【血液内源石密度】0.30u/L
感染步入中期，以这个势头发展下去，感染将匀速蔓延扩散。需要保持定期观察与控制。

text.en:
A former host now assigned to Reserve Op Team A6. 
Midnight was the most popular producer at a prominent host club in the Far East. He broke earnings record several years in a row, and was known as the Devil of the Eastern Night. 
He tends to speak boldly, even claiming he's here as God's gift to women. 
While he has never caused any real problems, he is still often a headache.
text.zh:
预备行动组A6的一员，男公关出身。
过去是东国某大型男公关俱乐部的头牌，曾连续数年打破上一年由自己创下的营业额记录，有着东夜魔王的别称。
言行举止颇为浮夸，自称正是以此来让众多女性为自己一掷千金。
虽然很少引发混乱，但经常会有令人头疼的行为。

text.en:
Midnight doesn't know how he got infected. According to his own words, he was very quick to retire after his diagnosis. 
After retiring, he found Rhodes Island through prior connections and came for treatment.
Then, after being in the program for a while, he made a peculiar request: He wanted work at Rhodes Island.
text.zh:
月见夜先生感染矿石病的经由不明，按照本人的说法，他十分果断地在发现症状并通过个人渠道确诊后，为自己举办了谢幕式，从业界隐退。
隐退后，他通过过去的人脉找到罗德岛，希望能够接受治疗。
不过，在罗德岛接受治疗了一段时间之后，他提出了一个古怪的要求：希望能够作为干员加入罗德岛。

text.en:
Midnight finally became a member of A6. 
At first, even in eccentric A6, Midnight was widely considered the most difficult person to get along with. But after a while, everyone realized he was actually kind and hardworking. 
Even then, there are still many people, such as Orchid, who can't handle his wild boasts.
text.zh:
月见夜先生最后成为了A6的一员。
原本，即使在怪人云集的A6中，月见夜先生也被认为会是最难以相处的一个。但实际相处后，所有人都发现，月见夜先生其实是个努力而温柔的人。
当然，即使如此，也依然还有许多人无法适应他的浮夸，比如梓兰。

text.en:
When Midnight cares about someone, he gives his whole heart, but that means only a few people can reciprocate on the same level. 
Since everyone is used to his hard work, they don't notice his exhaustion, which he wouldn't want them to notice, anyway. But it would be best for someone to check up on him once in a while.
text.zh:
应该相信，月见夜先生能够对谁都付出真心，但这也意味着，很少有人能回报他同等的爱。
当所有人都习惯了他的付出，他的疲惫就不会有人发觉——虽然他也不希望被发觉。但若真有那样的时刻，应该有那么一个人给他带去一些慰藉。

value.en: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected.
value.zh: 体表有源石结晶分布，确认为感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected.
infectionStatus.zh: 体表有源石结晶分布，确认为感染者。

text.en:
Originally a Sargonsoldier, Spot took the initiative and came to Rhodes Island seeking employment himself. After passing the examination battery, he was assigned to Reserve Op Team A6.
He has a lot of experience as a guard; and serves as the defensive specialist on the team.
text.zh:
原萨尔贡士兵，主动来到罗德岛求职。在通过干员测试后，成为罗德岛的一员，被分配到预备行动组A6。
于守护方面颇有心得，是小队的防御手。

text.en:
Imaging test for this Operator showed blurry outline of internal organs with visible unusual dark spots. Unusually high concentration of Originium particles were present in his circulation, indicating signs of infection and confirming him as infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 3% 
Crystallization visible on surface of body, with many symptoms of Oripathy difficult to spot due to skin and hair color. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.30u/L 
Infection is currently spreading at a constant rate. Regular observation and treatment required.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】3%
包括体表的源石结晶在内，干员斑点拥有明显的感染者症状。不过由于肤色和毛发的原因，反而很难发现。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.30u/L.
以这个势头发展下去，感染将匀速蔓延扩散。需要保持定期观察与控制。

text.en:
A member of Reserve Op Team A6 who used to be a Sargon soldier. 
He rarely speaks and has little reason to. On the rare occasion he does open his mouth, he tends to be brutally direct. Among the ostentatious members of Team A6, he is truly the odd man out.
text.zh:
预备行动组A6的一员，原萨尔贡士兵。
沉默寡言，缺乏干劲，即使偶尔开口也总是带刺，在吵闹的A6中，从另一个意义上显得十分特别。

text.en:
A fan of superheroes and pulp action, Spot loves to read comics and has an impressive collection. 
He has filled a whole shelf with his comic books, and other Operators often borrow them from him.
text.zh:
斑点第一喜欢看英雄题材，第二喜欢看冒险题材，当然，其他的题材他也有诸多收藏。
他在自己的房间里用一整个书架来摆放这些漫画，经常会有其他干员去向他借漫画。

text.en:
Although Sargon is a developed country with no shortage of modern entertainment in its cities, the Sargonians always seem a bit withdrawn.
Spot himself seemingly has no interest in anything other than comics and fashion. Every once in a while, he will ask Orchid to give him a Sargonian hairstyle.
text.zh:
虽然萨尔贡也是一个现代化的国家，他们的城市中也绝不缺少各种现代的娱乐设施，但萨尔贡人依然整体给人尚武的印象。
因此，像斑点这样，似乎对任何事情都没有兴趣，喜欢看漫画，总是喜欢而且喜欢追逐时尚，隔一段时间还会请梓兰小姐给他换一个毛型的萨尔贡人，确实是颇为少见。

text.en:
Spot's personality is largely the product of a stoic family. 
Sargonian military families have no patience for laziness. Unwilling to conform to his family's wishes, he became closed off, aggressive, and eventually ran away from home.
text.zh:
斑点性格的成因大部分来自家庭的冷遇。
一个萨尔贡的军人家族，是不允许其后代变得懒散的。不愿服从的他因此逐渐封闭了自己的内心，说话变得具有攻击性，并最终逃离了那个家。

value.en: Slight wear on outer casing, structure intact, normal durability. Generator and chassis in good condition. Medical system operational. Medical supplies replenished. ECU in good condition.
value.zh: 外壳有少量磨损，结构完整，强度正常。发动机与底盘状况良好。医疗设备运行正常，医疗消耗品已更替完毕。ECU状况良好。

inspectionReport.en: Slight wear on outer casing, structure intact, normal durability. Generator and chassis in good condition. Medical system operational. Medical supplies replenished. ECU in good condition.
inspectionReport.zh: 外壳有少量磨损，结构完整，强度正常。发动机与底盘状况良好。医疗设备运行正常，医疗消耗品已更替完毕。ECU状况良好。

text.en:
Lancet-2 is a custom Raythean-S62 Model six-wheeled operations platform. Its rounded design has led Lancet-2 to be perceived as cute, making her something of a mascot. Although she has a rather pessimistic dispensation, she is still well-liked. 
After being modified by Closure, Lancet-2 is able to perform more medical duties around Rhodes island, and her equipment is geared towards disinfecting and cleaning Originium contamination.
text.zh:
Lancet-2是可露希尔客制化后的雷神存在者™S Typer 62六轮作业平台，圆形的外观让人觉得很可爱所以成为了某种意义上的吉祥物。虽然她说话有时候很消极，但是大家都很喜欢她。
Lancet-2在经过可露希尔的改造后，得以满足更多罗德岛内的医疗需求，其器械设备也更注重于消毒和应对源石污染。

text.en: She is rather displeased with Closure's modifications. Her settings were changed to increase her personal opinion of Closure, and does not understand why that had to be the case. Closure thought her pessimism was funny, and thus increased the frequency and intensity of her self-deprecation.
text.zh: 对可露希尔改造自己比较在意，被设置成了最喜欢的东西是可露希尔，所以搞不懂为什么自己要喜欢可露希尔。可露希尔觉得她的性格偏向消极很有趣，便强化了她这些自嘲性格词条的使用频率。

value.en: Massive wear on outer casing, structure intact, normal durability. Generator and chassis in good condition. Weapon system operational. Slight damage on battery casing but operational. ECU in good condition.
value.zh: 外壳有大量磨损，结构完整，强度正常。发动机与底盘状况良好。攻击设备运行正常，电池外壳有轻微损坏，使用正常。ECU状况良好。

inspectionReport.en: Massive wear on outer casing, structure intact, normal durability. Generator and chassis in good condition. Weapon system operational. Slight damage on battery casing but operational. ECU in good condition.
inspectionReport.zh: 外壳有大量磨损，结构完整，强度正常。发动机与底盘状况良好。攻击设备运行正常，电池外壳有轻微损坏，使用正常。ECU状况良好。

text.en:
Castle-3 is a custom Raythean -Plus six-wheeled operations platform built by Closure. A likeable mascot for Rhodes Island, his mundane disposition means he is largely ignored. 
The solid blocky appearance of Castle-3 gives off a trustworthy, dependable impression. 
The marks on his casing may represent kills, but who made the marks if he has no hands?
text.zh:
Castle-3是可露希尔客制化后的雷神存在者™Plus六轮作业平台。受人喜爱，也是吉祥物一般的存在不过因为性格比较正常所以没有获得那么多关注。
Castle-3方方正正的形象给人以坚定可靠的感觉。
身上的标记可能代表着杀敌数，但是他自己没有手，所以是谁刻上去的呢？

text.en: He does not mind Closure's modifications, and is even quite pleased with the upgrade. His settings were changed to make Closure his favorite person, so he's satisfied with anything 'Master Closure' chooses to do.
text.zh: 对可露希尔改造自己毫不在意，并且对自己被强化了感到高兴。被设置成了最喜欢的东西是可露希尔，对此没有什么评价，觉得主人怎么做都可以。

value.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

text.en:
This nomadic warrior from Higashi joined Rhodes Island by sheer chance.
What she lacks in strategic acumen, she makes up with a mean giant sickle swing.
text.zh:
东国出身的流浪武者，机缘巧合之下加入罗德岛。
不善谋略，但凭借勇猛的气势与手中那把巨大的薙刀，在战场上如入无人之境。

text.en:
Imaging tests on this Operator show clear outlines of internal organs, with no abnormal dark spots or shadows. No unusual traces of Originium particles present in the circulatory system, no signs of infection, confirming this operator as uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0% 
Operator Matoimaru showed no symptoms of Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L 
Operator Matoimaru rarely comes into contact with Originium.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员缠丸没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.12u/L
干员缠丸甚少接触源石。

text.en:
Matoimaru is a magnificent warrior from Higashi.
She is simpleminded and prone to deception. She does catch on, but a new trick will fool her again.
Her hobbies, at which she excels, are sparring, soccer, and floral arrangement. She has been known to organize events around these subjects, though her idea of organization is typically dragging people kicking and screaming into it.
text.zh:
大大咧咧的东国武者。
心思单纯，容易被骗。虽然第一次上当后就会产生警惕，但只要换一个她没见过的手法，还是会上当。
爱好有比武、踢球、插花，在每一样上都颇有造诣，还经常会主动组织相应活动——当然，她的组织，一般就是硬拉。

text.en:
The Oni are still a mystery to most people. Aside from living in Higashi, there seems to be little in common among the race. 
However, Matoimaru is yet even more different from other Oni: Her bloodlust makes her performance on the battlefield strikingly unique, though it seems she's not aware of this fact.
text.zh:
迄今为止，鬼族对大部分人来说依然是个谜团，除了只生活于东国之外，还没有人发现他们之间有什么明显的共通之处。
不过，很显然，缠丸小姐也确实有一些异于常人的地方：她在战场上的嗜血，和她平日所表现的性格截然不同，而她似乎对此并没有自觉。

text.en:
Many Operators think Matoimaru is crude and unrefined, but they are mistaken.
They just need to check out her floral arrangements, on display every Saturday at 3pm. 
The beauty she can create is positively astonishing.
text.zh:
不少干员对缠丸小姐有一些误解，以为她只有平日那粗神经的一面，事实上这个认知是错误的。
有这种想法的人，都应该在每周六的下午三点，去参观一下缠丸小姐的插花教室。
在那里，他们一定会为缠丸小姐的美而惊叹的。

text.en:
Matoimaru is obviously self-conscious about her flaws: She is not good at controlling her strength or at critical thinking. 
She took up floral arrangement to refine herself and to show the others they don't need to fear her. 
Despite this, she's remains quite gullible. At least she has learned to question the idea that she must be a great thinker in order to survive. 
As far as she is concerned, her ideal companion would be someone who won't deceive or betray her, and will stay with her and guide her. How wonderful that would be...
text.zh:
很显然，缠丸小姐对于自己的弱点有明显的自觉：不擅控制力量；不擅思考。
为此，她选择用插花来锻炼技巧，用不去完全相信别人来保护自己。
——当然，即使如此，她也依然容易受骗，缠丸小姐就是这么单纯的一个人。但至少，她已经学会了去怀疑，为了生存，她必须让不擅长思考的自己学会这么做。
而正因为如此，对这样的她来说，如果有一个即使她什么都不用想，也绝对不会欺骗她、背叛她，还会陪伴她、引导她的人存在，那她……该会有多喜欢那个人呀。

value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Infection confirmed by medical report.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

text.en:
Vigna is a Sarkaz that was admitted into Rhodes Island following a battery of screenings, showing good potential in skirmishes, raids, and coordinated combat. 
Currently a Vanguard with an advance squad at Rhodes Island, with outstanding performance in both tactical raids and frontline combat.
text.zh:
红豆，萨卡兹人，经多项测试后许可加入罗德岛，在遭遇战、突击战、战术协同方面具有较高潜力。
现于罗德岛小队担任先锋人员，在战术突袭、开辟战场等方面取得突出表现。

text.en:
Imaging test for this Operator showed blurry outline of internal organs with visible unusual dark spots. Unusually high concentration of Originium particles were present in her circulation, indicating signs of infection and confirming her as infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 5% 
Infection will spread if unchecked at current progression, regular checkups and control needed. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.16u/L 
Since Sarkaz are susceptible to Oripathy, it is necessary for Operator Vigna to undergo regular tests and other assessments. 
—Silence
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】5% 
以这个势头发展下去，感染将匀速蔓延扩散。需要保持定期观察与控制。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.16u/L
鉴于萨卡兹人为矿石病易感人群，针对干员红豆理应需提供更多方面的检测，并及时查阅检测报告。
——赫默

text.en:
[Log 1]
'We Sarkaz can bear any burden! Weak words like 'compromise' do not, I repeat, do not exist in our vocabulary!' 
—Vigna 
The quote above was added to her file at her insistence. 
Operator Vigna was born in Kazdel, though she had lived in Columbia with her parents ever since she could remember. The constant moving, uneasy childhood and rough streets of Columbia gave rise to Vigna's unruly side. 
As a Sarkaz, Vigna saw a lot of discrimination against people like her, and often got into scuffles standing up against it. Of course, there were Sarkaz sympathizers, but they were few and far between. 
Vigna saw clearly the prejudice rooted in misunderstanding and closed-mindedness. It depressed her. But for the sake of her parents and others who still support her, she has not once lowered her little head.
text.zh:
【履历1】
“我们萨卡兹人，绝对不会向困境低头的！妥协这样软弱的词语，在我们的字典里——哼，才不存在呢！”
——红豆
根据干员红豆的个人强烈意愿，在资料中为她加入上述话语。
干员红豆出生在卡兹戴尔，但当她记事的时候就已经随同父母在哥伦比亚的城市中生活了。频繁变动的住址，不安稳的童年，冲突频繁的哥伦比亚城市街头，催生了红豆性格中最为不羁那一部分。
作为一名萨卡兹，红豆曾亲眼见证流浪的同族受到本地人的歧视，并为了保护同族，不止一次的与他人产生冲突。当然，也并非没有对萨卡兹怀有善意的人，但面对既已形成的大环境，少数的友善显得既脆弱又无力。
红豆清楚地看到了人与人之间，因误解和不愿相互理解而产生的种种歧见，并一度为此感到沮丧。但为了父亲母亲，为了仍在支持她，诚恳对待她的人们，她没有一次低下过自己的小小的头颅。

text.en:
'To be alive is to want your voice heard, right? Here, take this electric guitar, we'll use it to... uh, yeah, express ourselves! Use it to express how we feel!' 
—Vigna 
The quote above was, once again, added to the Operator's file at her insistence. 
Rock-and-roll was viewed as pure noise by traditional musicians at its inception. But then an iconic band from Columbia performed in loud, roaring concerts and officially ushered in the revolutionary new era of music. 
There is no bias in the world of rock, everyone has the right to express their thoughts and feeling in song. 
Operator Vigna saved up enough for a concert ticket. She was electrified all night by the wail of the guitars.
text.zh:
“只要是生存着的人，就都会有想要发出呐喊的时候，对吧！那么这把电吉他，给你！让我们一起用它……呃……对！绽放！用它，来让我们的生命壮丽地绽放吧！”
——红豆
根据干员再次表达出的强烈意愿，在资料中为她完整地加入上述话语。
摇滚的诞生最初是被传统乐理学家归入噪音行列。但当一个足以名垂青史的哥伦比亚摇滚乐团，用嘶吼的嗓音向所有听众发出的呐喊时，这种即将重新定义音乐的演奏形式正式登上时代的舞台。
在摇滚的世界里不存在歧视，任何人都有权唱出自己心中的所思所想。
干员红豆用省吃俭用的资金购买了一张演唱会的门票。在电吉他的激昂着她的鼓膜的这个夜晚，她的双手始终是在颤抖着。

text.en:
'I don't think there's ever an unusable weapon! People who say that just don't know the right way to use it. Anyway, since it's here, might as well use it!' 
The above quote explains why Vigna chose the lance as her weapon. 
This particular lance model never took off because of its unusual shape and esoteric features making it hard to master. Most of the lances were left to collect dust in the storehouse. Even though Vigna had enough cash for a better weapon, she saw the lance in the corner and right off the bat knew she had to have it. 
Wielding the lance requires great strength and skill, so Vigna doubled her daily training regimen. And to improve the power of the lance, she contacted the original manufacturer and custom-ordered a new model in pursuit of the perfect build. 
After her modifications, her lance is now a light, keen, durable, and powerful weapon. Vigna herself has also stepped up her own personal combat training in order to improve her mastery over the unique tool. 
Vigna has never felt she could or would ever quit. Every practice session, every battle all gave her an important sense of improvement, and she knew she wasn't even close to her limits.
text.zh:
“我觉得，没有不能使用的武器！如果觉得难以使用，那也一定也是使用者的技艺还不够吧。不管怎么样，既然已经被制造出来了，可没有理由让它这样孤独！”
上述话语，是红豆选择这把长枪的基本理由。
红豆的长枪被制造出来之后，由于结构新颖维护复杂而且难以操作，导致它的销路始终不畅，最终成为了仓库积压产品。而实际上购买武器的时候，红豆准备的资金本能购入更好的武器，但她一眼就看中了仓库角落的这杆长枪。
操纵这杆长枪需要十足的力量和扎实的技巧，于是红豆便将日常的锻炼量增加到了两倍；为了进一步提升长枪的威力，红豆还联系了原制造厂定制了新的枪刃，并不断地钻研长枪各种可行的组装方案。
经红豆改装过的长枪，已经在她的手中成为了一把轻便、锐利、延展性强、而且威力十足的优质武器。而红豆为了更好的操作使用它，也努力锻炼出了更加强健的身体，战斗的技巧也在不断提升着。
红豆从未觉得自己有停下脚步的可能。每一次的训练，每一次的战斗，都让她觉得自己仍在变得更好，而自己的边界——还远远没有触及到。

text.en:
Operator Vigna followed every step of Rhodes Island's recruitment protocol, from the submission of her resume, through the in-person interview, evaluation exams, all the way up to ultimately meeting the requirements and winning the approval of the top executives. 
As for why she chose Rhodes Island, her answer was simple: 
'Life here will be exciting. Very, very exciting, I can feel it!'
text.zh:
干员红豆加入罗德岛在流程上显得相当正式——简历投递、面试交流、测试检验，最终在她的各项指标均满足罗德岛的任职需求，并获得所有高层人员的许可后，红豆正式加入了罗德岛。
提及为何选择加入罗德岛时，红豆给出的答案非常简单：
“这里充满了精彩的生命，很多很多，我能感受得到哦。”

value.en: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected.
value.zh: 体表有源石结晶分布，确认为感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected.
infectionStatus.zh: 体表有源石结晶分布，确认为感染者。

text.en:
Real name Angelina Ajimu, she was a transporter responsible for delivering intelligence and special cargo around Siracusa. 
As an apprentice caster Operator, she now provides logistical support, battlefield assistance, and tactical coordination for Rhodes Island.
text.zh:
安洁莉娜，本名安心院安洁莉娜。于叙拉古从事情报递送、货物运输等公开活动，推测身份：信使。
现作为实习术师干员，为罗德岛提供后勤保障、战场辅助与战术协同等服务。

text.en:
Imaging test for this Operator showed blurry outline of internal organs with visible unusual dark spots. Unusually high concentration of Originium particles were present in her circulation, indicating signs of infection and confirming her as infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 5% 
The infection is consistently spreading. Regular observation and control are required. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.31u/L 
Subject has both visible crystallization and other symptoms of Oripathy. Although her condition is not serious, Angelina must keep to a course of treatment.
—Medic Operator Warfarin
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】5% 
以这个势头发展下去，感染将匀速蔓延扩散。需要保持定期观察与控制。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.31u/L
包括体表的源石结晶在内，干员安洁莉娜有着非常明显的感染者症状，虽然说不上有多严重，但安洁莉娜小姐可也千万不能轻视病况呀。
——医疗干员华法琳

text.en: She may not realize it, but Angelina has a special knack for Arts! She can change how much an object weighs. I think if she gets the proper training, she could be amazing one day!
text.zh: 虽然安洁莉娜她自己没意识到，不过她可是有着相当独特的法术天赋的哦！好像，是能让各种物品，变重或者是变轻的样子……如果能得到进一步的引导和开发的话，我觉得，总有一天她会变得很了不起的！

text.en:
Having only just recently become a transporter, Angelina is full of hope for the future, much like other high schoolers. She spends much of her time studying or dressing up. 
She likes dainty jewelry and young adult novels, and hides a secret love for older music. She could enjoy an ordinary, happy life. 

When Rhodes Island sought her out, she was gliding between skyscrapers in the middle of a dark night.
text.zh:
刚成为信使不久的少女。安洁莉娜就像其他的高中生一样，对未来充满希望，但也花了很多时间在学业与打扮上。
喜欢小饰品和流行小说，意外的喜欢稍显复古的音乐，安洁莉娜的人生本应平常而快乐。

而当罗德岛寻访她时，安洁莉娜却正穿梭在城市的黑夜中，于大楼间轻巧地滑翔而过。

text.en:
The world is unfair. 
After she suffering her infection, Angelina quietly faded from her old life. 
She didn't linger or say her goodbyes. She just silently left her family, friends, and beloved hometown behind. 
Yet she had not resigned herself to the typical fate of an Infected. 
Every night, she ran, jumped, glided between buildings, practiced her Arts, and smuggled goods from one place to another. 
As a courier, an Infected, or just a normal high-schooler, Angelina works hard, no matter what the future may look like.
text.zh:
这片大地是不公的。
意外成为感染者的安洁莉娜，悄悄地从自己的生活中消失了。
没有告别，没有徘徊，安洁莉娜离开了家庭，默默地告别了学校中的朋友和自己热爱的故乡。
然而，即便已经知晓了感染者的结局，安洁莉娜却并不甘心。
每个夜晚，她奔跑着，跳跃着，在建筑间穿梭着，操纵着还不那么熟练的法术，将货物从一个秘密的地方运送到另一个秘密的地方。
作为信使，作为感染者，也作为一个普通的高中生，安洁莉娜正在努力地生活下去，无论未来会变成什么模样。

text.en:
Before she came to Rhodes Island and met the Doctor, Angelina kept these secrets hidden away in her heart. 
It wasn't until Rhodes Island found her that she knew there was another life for the Infected. She is now a Rhodes Island Operator, and she may be able to go back to school. 
Probably. 
Where will the path Angelina has chosen take her? 
Even she can't imagine.
text.zh:
在遇见罗德岛与博士之前，安洁莉娜将这些秘密都藏在自己心里。
直到罗德岛发掘了安洁莉娜，她才看见了另一种属于感染者的生活。而她，也给罗德岛带来了不同的色彩。如今成为了罗德岛干员的她，兴许也能重新找回自己作为一个高中生应有的生活。
……大概。
安洁莉娜选择的道路，究竟会通向哪里？
可能连她自己都没法想象吧。

value.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

text.en:
Thorns, a front-line combatant for Rhodes Island, is proficient in swordsmanship and pharmacology. Born in the Iberian hinterland, Thorns left his hometown in the midst of local religious strife. After leaving the Iberian region, he was invited to join Rhodes Island. 
The above section describing the situation in Iberia was self-reported by Thorns and has not been fully verified.
text.zh:
精通剑术与药剂制作的罗德岛前线作战干员，棘刺。出身于伊比利亚腹地，于当地宗教局势动荡中离开家乡，在脱离伊比利亚地区后，受邀来到罗德岛。
以上关于伊比利亚境内局势的部分为棘刺自述，尚未完全经过考证。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Thorns has no signs of Originium infections. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.14u/L
Operator Thorns often comes into contact with Originium-based reagents, which puts him at some risk of infection. 

Don't worry, he is very vigilant about self-protection and his numbers have been stable. The risk of something happening is low. Properly taking care of oneself is a quality that everyone who enters and exits this laboratory should cultivate. 
—Ansel
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员棘刺没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.14u/L
干员棘刺时常会接触一些含有源石成分的试剂，这使得他有一定的感染风险。

别担心，他在自我防护这方面很有心得，这个数值相当稳定，没有那么容易出事。管理好自己的身体状况，我认为这是每一个经常出入实验室的人都应有的素养。 
——安赛尔

text.en:
When Thorns first joined Rhodes Island, his combat style on the battlefield gave others an impression of indifference, or even ruthlessness. After spending more time together, everyone gradually realized that though the Iberian swordsman may seem cold in demeanor and speak in a blunt manner, his actual nature was rather straightforward, free-spirited and suave, though not overblown. 
The swordsman seems to be aware of the issues some may have with his blunt and easily-misunderstood way of speaking, but he isn't particularly bothered by this. For Thorns, others' perceptions of him are ultimately inconsequential, and the way the outside world evaluates him has no effect upon him. 

Thorns often delves deeply into the extraction and preparation of medicinals and ends up ignoring other things in the process — such as his own outward appearance. Forgetting to wear a jacket, having one trouser leg rolled up, wearing clothes with holes in them, and even wearing things backwards or insides out — all of these are commonplace occurrences. If you encounter Thorns in the hallway displaying one of these features, don't read too much into it. 
For a swordsman who pursues precision and efficiency, it isn't worthwhile to spend too much time maintaining one's appearance. Even if Thorns' hair puffs up and curls over because of an awry experiment gone explosive, Thorns continues to conduct his own business, withstanding the curious eyes of all bystanders without a care.
text.zh:
干员棘刺刚加入罗德岛时，一度因其在战场上的作风，给许多人留下了冷漠古怪，甚至残忍无情的印象。而当相处时间长久之后，大家逐渐发觉，尽管这位伊比利亚剑士大多数时候的确看起来态度冷淡，说话也并不好听，但他的脾性却可以称得上率直，说是自由潇洒，也并不为过。 
对于自己过于直率，容易招来误解的言行，剑士并非无知无觉，只是他对此毫不在乎。对于棘刺来说，他人的看法，的确只是一件无关紧要的小事，来自外界的评价并不能影响到他。 

棘刺时常因太过于专注药剂的调配和萃取改良，而忽视其他方面的东西——比如说自己的外在形象。忘记穿外套、裤腿卷起一只却不自知、衣服破洞甚至直接穿反，这些都是家常便饭，如果在走廊上偶遇这样的干员棘刺，请不要感到意外。
对于追求精确与效率的剑士来说，花费太多力气来维持外表并不划算，就算偶尔因实验出岔子而被炸到每一根头发都膨胀卷曲，棘刺也能够做到放任自流，顶住所有好奇的目光，毫不在意地做自己的事。

text.en:
Thorns' swordsmanship is extremely potent. According to him, his particular style of swordsmanship requires every single motion to be precisely calculated. This swift and precise technique is widely known throughout Iberia as the 'Destreza.' 
The mainstay weapons of the Iberian region have always been swords and knives, with a wide variety of techniques spread across the land. However, the technique known as the 'Destreza' is not accessible to everyone. Needless to say, this technique requires excellent physical fitness, but it also has extremely demanding requirements for the user's mind. These strict requirements make the technique very difficult to learn, but if mastered, the rewards are great. 
At the same time, many traditional Iberian blademasters believe that 'Destreza' can only be used to describe swordsmanship using a standardized subset of weapons; and in their eyes, the styles used by non-Liberis, including Thorns, are nothing but clumsy and blasphemous imitations. However, according to Thorns, those people have absorbed more than enough of the technique's framework and apply them in a more realistic manner. On this basis, there are no issues with considering them as users of 'Destreza.' In other words, people who fight over semantics will quickly perish when they have to actually cross swords. After, they would not be exclusively facing swordsmen. 
However, even these renegade swordsmen will readily admit that Iberian swordsmanship is as vast and as dangerous as the ocean. No swordsman may ever exhaust that knowledge within his lifetime; not to mention, that lifetime is generally very short as well. 

In any case, by combining the precise swordsmanship he has mastered with the deadly poisons he concocted himself, Thorns will always complete his missions upon the battlefield with efficiency and ease, ensuring optimal results while keeping losses minimal. 
His method of operating is beyond reproach in terms of efficiency; however, in many situations, Thorns himself ends up garnering criticism. 
Thorns' swordsmanship and his pharmacological knowledge were learned from a local priest. He and several other children studied under the priest, following him through childhood and adolescence. Because this priest became involved in the religious turmoil that would later break out, several of his students have taken divergent paths. 
Thorns is exceptionally skilled at swordsmanship, and also exhibits extraordinary talents in pharmacology. He is particularly skilled at extracting and purifying drug compounds, especially toxins. The precise efficacy of some of the neurotoxins he's produced has been praised by the members of the Medical Department. In addition, Thorns always has bolder ideas when it comes to refining other reagents; and while his experiments do sometimes yield positive results, they end with an explosion more often than not. 
Even in the face of failure, Thorns always seems to enjoy himself.
text.zh:
干员棘刺拥有十分强烈的剑术风格，据其本人介绍，这种每一个动作都经过精密计算的剑术，被伊比利亚人称作“至高之术”，是在当地颇有声名的一种迅捷剑术。
伊比利亚地区历来以刀、剑作为主流武器，各类流派遍地，但被称为“至高之术”的技术却并非人人都能够学习。很明显，使用这样的剑术，不仅需要有良好的身体素质，同时还对于使用者的头脑有极高的要求，这样严格的条件使得这种剑术学习的难度很高，但如若能够掌握，回报也将是巨大的。
与此同时，传统的伊比利亚剑术大师们普遍认为“至高之术”只能被用来形容特定形制规范武器的剑术，所以在他们眼里，包括棘刺在内，许多非黎博利人所使用的剑术不过是拙劣的模仿和亵渎；但对于棘刺他们来说，他们从传统剑术中吸取了足够多的技巧，这让他们的剑术拥有了更加现实的意义，在这个基础上，自称“至高之术”的使用者并无问题。换句话说，纠结说辞的人在斗剑时大多会变成死人，何况他们并不仅仅是要面对剑士。
不过，就连这些离经叛道的剑士也都承认，伊比利亚的剑术如同大海一样广阔而危险，任何一个人在有生之年都不可能将其穷尽，更别说剑士的生命普遍都很短暂了。

不论如何，使用所掌握的精密剑术，配合自制的毒素，棘刺在战场上总能迅速完成被分配的任务，并确保在己方的损失能够被最小化的同时，获得最大的成果。
这种行动方针在效率上无可指摘，但很多时候，也难免会为棘刺本人惹来一些非议。
棘刺的剑术和药剂炼制及萃取的技艺，都由一位当地教士传授，他同另外几个孩子一起跟随教士学习，度过了童年及青少年时光，其后，因教士被卷入宗教动荡，他的几名学生至此也走上不同的道路。
干员棘刺在剑术上拥有很高的天赋，而在药剂制作这一领域，他也有着过人的才能，棘刺极为擅长药物的萃取与提纯，特别是毒素类，经由他手制作的神经类毒素的效果精确，得到了医疗部某些干员的极大好评。除此之外，棘刺在其他药剂的炼制方面则总有一些更大胆的想法——有时这样的确能得到更好的结果，但更多时候则是以爆炸收场。
即便如此，棘刺也依然乐此不疲。

text.en:
When putting together operator files, HR Department personnel will often conduct investigations from various directions, such as direct inquiries with the operator, field examinations of their hometown, observation of the operator's behavioral trends within the ship, and interviews with other operators. An operator's profile overview can only be completed by synthesizing all of the available information. 
Through these investigations, we've noticed that the personalities of the operators who come to Rhodes Island are almost always complex and multifaceted, almost impossible to reduce down to a list of simple traits, and never exactly the same between two operators. Of course, Thorns is no exception. 
Many people who've been in contact with Thorns will describe him as 'difficult to get along with.' While these evaluations seem to reflect poorly upon him, further investigation revealed that many of the operators who gave him these negative evaluations still maintain frequent and friendly interactions with him. Those who are able to see more and more of Thorns's flaws are, conversely, closer to him and have a deeper relationship. 
While people complain that Thorns is 'difficult to get along with,' they still make the effort to do so. In regards to the issue of Thorns' interpersonal relationship with other operators, we concluded that there is no need for further monitoring. 

[Addendum] 
I agree that long-term observation can enhance our understanding of an operator. 
But to be honest, I originally thought he was kind of cool, but within a few months, all I could think of was him and his.... uh... how should I put this... lively operators doing all kinds of weird exercises together. They'd talk about wacky topics all day long, and then try to actually build that stuff. Sometimes, their crafts will explode before even being finished! Who's going to be able to keep an eye on a guy like that? How come no one has come to hang these people on deck yet? 

[Recorder's Addendum] 
We already tried that, but it didn't do anything. 
The investigation period ends today. I have some comments I'd like to write on this file, but my boss said they were too subjective, so nevermind. What I will say is, the potion bang snaps they made today were a lot of fun.
text.zh:
在制作干员档案时，人事部的工作人员往往会从许多不同方向着手进行调查，对干员本人的询问，对其家乡的实地考证，对干员在舰船内活动轨迹的观察以及对其他干员的印象采访，只有综合所有这些能够取得的信息，才能完成对一位干员档案的编写。
在这些调查进行的过程中，我们会注意到，来到罗德岛的干员们的性格往往复杂而多面，很难用某种简约的特质来概括，干员棘刺显然也是如此。
许多同棘刺有过接触的人，都会对其给出“难以相处”这样的评价，这看似较为负面，然而进一步的调查却显示，许多给出负向评价的干员，仍然与干员棘刺维持着友好的互动与往来，那些能说出棘刺大堆缺点的人，反而与其往来较他人更加频繁，关系更加亲密。
令人一边抱怨“难以相处”，一边却仍愿意与之相处，在干员内部人际关系这个问题上，我们最终得出棘刺无需多加关注这一结论。

【记录人员补足】
长期的观察才更能全面了解干员，这点我同意。
但是说实话，我最开始以为这是个酷哥，几个月后我满脑子都是他和那几个…嗯…有点过于…呃…活泼的干员一起做怪模怪样的健身体操的画面，他们成天聊些又怪又傻的话题，会在聊嗨了之后真的动手去实践，做许多奇奇怪怪的东西，甚至还没做成就直接爆炸！这谁能顶得住？怎么还没人来把这几个人都挂到甲板上去？

【记录人员补足的补足】
已经被挂上甲板了，没什么用。
调查期到今天截止，我有一些评价想写在这份档案上，但是上司说太主观了不允许，所以算了。最后一句，他们今天做的药液摔炮挺好玩的。

text.en:
Iberians rarely talk about their hometown, and this isn't exactly a secret as long as you pay attention. Occasionally, when you mention their homeland, even Iberians who are generally impassive or stony-faced will show some complex expressions, and these subtle nuances can reveal a lot about their attitudes. 
Thorns is one of the few people among us who actually will give an unreserved impression of Iberia. Compared with the silence or vague remarks of the other operators, Thorns actually can give a calm response to our inquiries. He's provided us with a lot of referential information, and while a lot of it is fairly similar to more mainstream conceptions, some of it completely subverts these notions. 
In the past, this seaside country was often associated with passion, vitality, indulgence, where sunshine melts into the coast along the horizon. Once widely known for the resplendent beauty of its golden sunlight, this country was often discussed in conjunction with Laterano because of its religious connections. However, in recent years, this rich land has gradually become silent and faded from the public eye. 

[Classified Log] 
Very little is known about the current state of Iberia. According to Thorns, the treatment of the Ægir in Iberia has gone from bad to worse over the past few decades. He described a once prosperous city as gloomy and stagnant. 
The local administrators do not seem to prohibit locals from leaving, but they have enacted tight restrictions on re-entry. Rhodes Island's investigators have been staying near the area for a long time, but have not found a way to conduct an in-depth investigation. 
The Investigation Department has reached a similar assessment, discouraging any attempts to rashly enter the area until the need arises to prepare for an in-depth investigation.
text.zh:
我们之中来自伊比利亚的干员们很少谈论自己的家乡，这件事并不算是秘密，只要稍加留意就能够察觉。偶尔在提及故乡时，就算是再冷面不善表达的伊比利亚人，也或多或少会流露出一些复杂之意，人们能够从种种细微之处窥见他们的态度。
干员棘刺是我们之中少有的，会不遮不掩地对伊比利亚这片土地给出评价的干员之一。相较于其他干员的闭口不谈或含糊言辞，棘刺态度相当坦然，他向我们提供了许多可供参考的信息，其中的一部分与传统认知相似，而另一部分则全然是颠覆性的。
这个临海国度在过去时常被与热情、活力、奢豪，以及洒满海岸的阳光联系在一起，那里曾流传有黄金国度的美名，因与拉特兰在宗教上源远的历史联系而时常被一同讨论，然而近些年，这片富饶之地却逐渐沉寂，逐渐淡出人们的视野。

【权限记录】
对于目前伊比利亚的现状，我们所知甚少。据棘刺所说，在过去几十年中，阿戈尔人在伊比利亚境内的待遇每况愈下，他描述曾经繁荣的城市上空聚起阴云，气氛压抑而凝滞。
当地的管理者似乎并不阻止当地的居民离开，但在入境方面却有着严格的限制，罗德岛所属的调查人员在该地区停留多时，暂时还未找到办法进行深入调查。
调查部门给出了相关评估，在有必须深入的理由，并且做好相应的准备之前，并不建议贸然进入该地区。

text.en:
If every order is executed faithfully, will every result be flawlessly precise as well? 
Actually, the answer to this question depends on how well you know him. What you must know is that without sufficient mutual trust, Iberians tend to strictly calculate the conditions of the battlefield and only pursue the results, not necessarily solving problems in a way that others want.
text.zh:
如果每一条指令都被忠实地执行，所得到的结果，是否就精密无缺？
实际上，这个问题取决于你究竟有多了解他。要知道，如果没有足够的默契，战斗时总严格计算所有条件、只追求结果的伊比利亚人解决问题的方式，往往不如人所愿。

value.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

text.en:
Bodyguard to the Catastrophe Messenger Leonhardt, coming with him to Rhodes Island. He brings his experience in escorting, investigation, guerilla warfare, and infiltration under complex conditions. 
He enters the battlefield with an unconventional weapon purchased from Rim Billiton's black market and can provide a variety of short and medium-range attacks for his squad, exterminating enemies as his only means of protecting important targets.
text.zh:
天灾信使莱恩哈特的护卫，与其一同来到罗德岛就职，主要提供护卫、侦查以及复杂条件下进行渗透与游击的经验。
以雷姆必拓黑市购入的非制式武器切入战场，可在中近距离上为团队提供多种攻击方案，将驱逐敌人作为保护重要目标的唯一方式。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Only scars and abdominal markings are visible, with no signs of infection. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.07u/L
Remnants of Originium are visible on organs but at very low concentrations. 

'That golden-haired Cautus must have provided this guy with a bit of his own protective Arts. Otherwise, he would've turned into ash long ago given the kind of work environments mentioned in his file.' —A not very polite Medic
'Abdominal area feels pretty good on palpation.' —Medic's addendum
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
只有伤痕和腹肌，没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.07u/L
器官中发现源石残留成分，但占比极低。

“那个金毛卡特斯应该是把自己的防护技术原样提供给了这家伙，不然以他档案中提到的任务环境，化成灰都是有可能的。” ——不太客气的医师
“腹肌手感不错。” ——医师的追加评论

text.en:
Before joining Rhodes Island, Ayerscarpe was the bodyguard to Leonhardt, a Catastrophe Messenger. His main job was to protect Leonhardt from harm during his investigations and assessments of Catastrophes. Combined with Leonhardt's cleverness, the duo rarely run into sticky situations. Most of the time, Ayerscarpe only needs to accompany him on walks, help carry equipment, or listen to his friend's incessantly prattling about what he thinks is cool — at least until the moment when a crisis comes and he is required to perform his duties.
There are many ways for a bodyguard to protect his target. Some people prefer using defensive measures to mitigate the damage, others are good at arranging traps to deter an enemy's attack. However, Ayerscarpe's preferred method of defense is to eradicate the enemies. Though he is a man of few words, his ferocious attacks indeed confirm his status as an operator who believes that the best defense is a good offense.
text.zh:
在加入罗德岛以前，断崖是天灾信使莱恩哈特的护卫，其主要工作，即是保护莱恩哈特在进行调查与判断天灾情况时不受伤害。虽然以莱恩哈特的机敏，基本上不会遇到特别棘手的事，大部分时间，断崖也只是陪着他散步，帮忙搬运仪器，或是听朋友不断重复那些自认为很酷的琐事，直到危机来临，他开始履行职责的那一刻为止。
护卫们保护目标的方式有很多种，有些人喜欢以防御措施隔绝伤害、一些人则擅长布置陷阱，延缓敌人的攻击、而断崖的护卫手法，是以根除敌人来达到保护的目的——即使平时沉默寡言，但他的确是位习惯以猛烈进攻来达成防卫任务的干员。

text.en:
Ayerscarpe's chosen method of defense is extremely risky and does not conform to the logic of ordinary people. However, the operator himself is well-suited for carrying out his duties in this manner. In addition to having excellent combat skills and rapid reaction times, part of this operator's success is owed to the special weapon that he carries. 
There has been no official name given to this weapon as of yet, and the nicknames that the operator himself has chosen, such as 'my baby,' or 'nice guy,' have no reference value whatsoever. Due to the operating mode of the weapon itself, we've temporarily named it 'RT-01.' 
Since there is no weapon or even weapon class similar to RT-01 within our scope of knowledge, we believe that this is an experimental weapon. According to Ayerscape, this weapon was purchased from Rim Billiton's black market. Rim Billiton has developed many small-scale private mining companies due to its robust mining industry. The turnover and conglomeration rate among these companies are high, which indirectly promotes the black market. Many resources will circulate here before eventually reaching the hands of private individuals, organizations, or even foreign forces. Because Ayerscarpe overcame great difficulties to acquire this weapon, and the weapon itself boasts excellent performance, he is extremely fond of RT-01. When asked to describe any deficiencies, he'll only point out that it 'produces some slight noise from time to time.' 
The operator in charge of weapon inspections said he didn't hear anything, but Ayerscarpe insists that he hears it loud and clear.
text.zh:
断崖选择的防卫模式风险极高，也不合乎一般人的思维逻辑，然而干员本身的确适宜以这种方式开展护卫工作。这除了依托于干员本身优秀的身手和快速反应能力外，和其所携带的特殊武装也不无关系。
该特殊武装暂时没有正式名称，干员本人给出的，类似“宝贝”和“好家伙”之类的爱称也完全没有参考价值，出于武器本身的运行模式，我们暂为该武器命名为——RT-01。
由于在我们所了解的范围内，没有任何一件与RT-01类似，或是思路相近的武器，我们有理由认定，这是一件实验武器。根据干员本人的叙述，这件武器是他从雷姆必拓黑市上购入的。雷姆必拓由于开矿业发达，孕育了许多小规模的私人开矿组织，这些组织间倾轧与吞并时有发生，间接促生了雷姆必拓的黑市市场，许多资源会在此流通，最终进入个人、团体或国外势力手中。由于断崖在获取这件武器时克服了极大的困难，加上武器本身性能优秀，他对RT-01可以说是爱不释手，如果真要说有什么缺点的话，可能只有“会不定时产生轻微噪音”这一点了。
负责检查武器的干员什么都没听到，但他，听得一清二楚。

text.en:
Ayerscarpe and Leonhardt have been friends since childhood, and the two also divide labor amongst each other very cleanly. Leonhardt takes on jobs that require negotiation or involve minerals, and Ayerscarpe takes on tasks that require superior athleticism or uncovering things that can't be discovered by others. Don't be fooled by the fact that he often exchanges harsh words with his old friend — he will never make Leonhardt look bad in front of others, and if something ever happens to him, he is the first to rush over. When Leonhardt became a Catastrophe Messenger, Ayerscarpe volunteered to become Leonhardt's private bodyguard. Since Ayerscarpe acquired his unique set of weapons, it would be more profitable to take on jobs of his own rather than protecting the Catastrophe Messenger, but Ayerscarpe stubbornly insists on remaining his friend's bodyguard, while also making it clear that the other party needs to pay up. All in all, Leonhard, not wealthy in the first place, ended up allocating most of his salary to Ayerscarpe, ending up in an even tighter financial situation as a result. 
Although we didn't know how Ayerscarpe controlled these funds before, we were able to investigate the flow of funds between the two after he became an operator, and the results were mind-blowing. 
Leonhardt's concept of managing money is rather laissez-faire. While he is good at making money, he's also good at spending it. After joining Rhodes Island, his shopping list grew longer than ever due to stable living arrangements and a higher salary. Except for work-related tools such as dune buggies, which have questionable usability in general circumstances, Leonhardt's stash of new and interesting things has indeed been growing. Most of these items simply reflect his personal taste, but others are for gifting to young operators who he deems to 'not be cool enough,' and he often offers these gifts in a way that is hard to refuse. Sometimes, his consumption habits have caused been problematic, such as when he couldn't pay the bills one time. This time, he has had Ayerscarpe to cover for him.
Ayerscarpe's lifestyle has always been very frugal. Other than spending money on necessary living expenses and salted edamame, Ayerscarpe has been saving his money, and he basically returns the 'payment' he received from serving as Leonhardt's bodyguard to his friend at the right time. He knows that Leonhardt doesn't know how to save money, and he knows that sooner or later, he wouldn't be able to purchase something that he actually needed. At that time, he'll use that money to buy things for his friend and send it over to him. Even now when there is no direct financial connection between the two, he still often draws from his savings to fill in the gap for Leonhardt. Of course, he also knows that Leonhardt will repay him in due time. This is the mutual understanding formed after many years of cooperation, and demonstrates the trust between the two friends.
text.zh:
断崖和莱恩哈特从小就是好友，两人的分工也很明确，需要与人交涉或是涉及矿物的，莱恩哈特来干；需要巧劲的体力活和不能被人发现的事，则一般由断崖来完成。别看他表面上对老朋友恶言相向，在别人面前也一点不给莱恩哈特面子，一旦对方出了点事，第一个赶过去的，总是他。当莱恩哈特成为天灾信使后，断崖就自愿成为了莱恩哈特的护卫——自从获得了那套武器后，以断崖的实力，做什么都要比给天灾信使当护卫要赚得多，但他还是执拗地给朋友当保镖，并且，明确和对方说明了，要给钱。于是乎，莱恩哈特本就不富裕的薪资被划了一部分给断崖，手头更加拮据了。
虽然我们以前并不知道这笔钱断崖在如何支配，但在成为干员后，我们得以对两人的资金流向进行调查，结果，出乎我们的意料。
莱恩哈特的金钱管理观念比较开放，他擅于盈利，也乐于消费。在进入罗德岛之后，由于生活稳定和薪资上涨，他的购物清单比从前长了不少。尽管除了沙地车之类的工作用具外，普遍实用性堪忧，但不可否认其中不乏新潮而有趣的东西。大部分只是出于莱恩哈特个人的审美喜好，而另一些则被他用于以一种难以拒绝的强硬方式赠送给身边那些“不够酷”的年轻干员。有时，这种频繁消费会造成一些负面反应，比如说，一时间资金周转不过来。而在此时为他填上“窟窿”的，一直是断崖，
断崖的消费观很保守，除了必要的生活开支和盐水毛豆，断崖一直在进行储蓄，而之前为莱恩哈特做护卫时获得的“酬劳”，则基本上在适当的时间以实物的形式返还给了朋友——他知道莱恩哈特存不住钱，总会有一时拮据凑不出钱买东西的时候。到了那时，他就会取用这笔资金，给朋友买好东西，然后寄过去。即使是现在，两人已完全不存在金钱联系，他依旧会在自己的储蓄里划出一小笔来填充莱恩哈特的资金缺口。他知道，莱恩哈特会在适当的时候把这份钱返还回来。这是两人间长久合作后产生的默契，也包含着他对朋友的信赖。

text.en:
'We found a signal transmitter on Ayerscarpe's weapon, which has already been dismantled, that the operator had no knowledge of.' 
'The signal sent from the transmitter automatically searches for a valid port, performs a second transmission, before eliminating all traces until it reaches the target.' 
'Most countries' military-grade communications equipment does not have this level of technology.' 
'After cracking the transmission path of the launcher and simulating a transmission, we have reason to believe—'
'It's Rhine Lab. I can tell just from looking at it.' 
'The signal's final destination is a port located in Ursus.' 
'After being intercepted by a node halfway through, it modified the target port before immediately deleting the data. This is an old trick.' 
'Do you really think Ursus knows how to make a weapon like this?' 
'A reloading blade-gun, a self-calibrating gun, automatic hover blades.' 
'Only Rhine Labs has the capacity to deliberately integrate these technologies into a single system.' 
'I see.' 
'So——'
'How did a Columbian experimental weapon end up in Rim Billiton, in the hands of a young man who has nothing to do with them?' 
'......'
This whole situation has Rhine Lab's fingerprints all over it. Let me give you a hypothetical.' 
'Sure.' 
'On Terra, there will always be people with extraordinary talents.' 
'It is a joy to craft weapons for them.' 
'When these weapons are manufactured and their wielders seem to possess all the power in the world within their hands, buyers will arrive in droves to snag up these weapons.' 
'In the hands of ordinary people, these 'divine' weapons are not even as useful as a logging hatchet.' 
'As for what Rhine Labs did, I actually have an idea.' 
'They designed a 'divine weapon,' but realized that it is nothing but a hatchet.' 
'This thing?' 
'This is a failed design.' 
'While the design seems well-integrated as a whole, the Originium undergoes serious leakage problems during conversion, and the accuracy of the hovering blades is unsatisfactory.' 
'If not in the hands of someone who has a hobby of getting electrocuted, this weapon is not usable at all.' 
'How do we deal with this then?' 
'Deal with? There's no need for that. Saria couldn't see eye-to-eye about the way certain departments in Rhine Lab did things, but she wouldn't do anything about these weapon owners.' 
'Our biggest fear is that Rhine Lab will use the signal transmitter to take control of the device and do something unspeakable.' 
'Since we found out about it, it should be fine now that we've destroyed it.' 
'As for what Rhine Lab will do with the data they obtained, will they find another target to experiment upon, or will they create the hatchet that can slay a god?' 
'So, what does this have to do with Rhodes Island?' 
—Unknown time, Rhodes Island, unidentified surveillance recording
text.zh:
“我们发现了断崖武器上的信号发射器，已进行拆除工作，干员没有察觉。”
“该发射器发出的信号会自动寻找有效端口，进行二次传输，然后消除痕迹，直到传入目标端口。”
“大多数国家的军用发信设备都没有这种级别的科技。”
“在对发射器的传输路径进行破解和模拟发射后，我们有理由相信——”
“是莱茵生命，看武器样式就知道了。”
“信号最后的目标端口位于乌萨斯。”
“中途被节点截获以后进行目标端口修改然后直接删除数据，老伎俩了。”
“你真的觉得乌萨斯人会做这种武器？”
“填弹冲剑、定标铳、自动浮游刃。”
“特意花时间将这些技术整合到一个系统里这种事，也只有莱茵会做。”
“了解。”
“那么——”
“为什么哥伦比亚的实验武器会投放到雷姆必拓，而且在一个与他们毫无关系的青年手里？”
“……”
“其实这件事，很有莱茵人制作武器的风格，我给你们举个例子吧。”
“好。”
“在这片大地上，总会有天赋异禀的人。”
“为他们量身订制武器，是一种愉悦。”
“当武器制造完毕，在此人手中发挥绝大的力量时，人人都会渴望获得它们。”
“即使在普通人手中，这些神兵利器还不如砍柴斧好用。”
“而莱茵想做的，其实只是一件事。”
“设计出‘神兵利器’，然后将之实现为‘砍柴斧’。”
“这一件呢。”
“这一件是失败品。”
“一体化完成度很高，但是源石在转换时会发生严重的漏电问题，浮游刃精度也差强人意。”
“如果不是干员本人有触电嗜好，这件武器根本没法使用。”
“那我们怎么处理这件事。”
“处理？不用处理。塞雷娅只是看不惯莱茵一些部门的行事风格，不会针对武器持有人做什么事情的。”
“我们最大的担忧也只是莱茵会远端控制发信器来做些不可告人的事。”
“既然发现了，销毁就好。”
“至于莱茵用获得的数据去做什么，会不会找下一个目标进行试验，能不能造出弑神的砍柴斧。”
“和我们罗德岛有什么关系？”
——未知时间，罗德岛，未知监控录音

text.en:
Ayerscarpe is a very strange person. 
Even though I know that we shouldn't be quick to judge others, he really is a strange person. 
For example, take his habit of eating salted edamame. 
I know some people who think food from the East is new and exotic and have a desire to try it, and sometimes they'll even really like it. 
But I cannot understand his particular way of eating. 
He eats them, shell and everything. 
He just pops the entire pod into his mouth. 
I didn't know either at first, and originally thought that was how you were supposed to eat them. I gave it a try, and thought that these were inedible, and decided that whoever came up with the idea of eating these things must've been crazy. 
But then, someone told me to peel the pod. 
Ayerscarpe even made a little box to take with him that is specifically for edamame, which he probably eats as a snack. 
As for why, I can't don't why. 
Oh, right, there's one other thing. The guy thinks he runs on electricity. 
I'm serious. 
I have no idea if his weapon electrocutes people, but when I see his ears tremble, I'm pretty sure there's some electricity involved. 
What's more, he always goes around asking those electricity-based operators if he can bum some electricity from them. 
I'm talking Greyy, that guy who fixes the electrical outlets, and Leizi. 
He walked up to Leizi like a plank one day and asked, 'is there some way for me to quickly increase the charge my body can carry?' 
Is he stupid?! 
I feel even worse for that little Victorian hairstylist. They already have to deal with getting shocked by static electricity all the time due to their Oripathy, but now there's this guy who's always asking, 'Can you shock me real quick?' Absolute maniac! 
————A certain file manager's evaluation in the appendix
text.zh:
断崖是个很奇怪的人。
虽然我知道我们不应该随便评判别人，但他真的是个很奇怪的人。
比如说吃盐水毛豆这件事。
我知道有些人觉得东方的食物很新奇，会有尝试的欲望，然后就喜欢上了。
但他这种吃法我不能理解啊。
带壳吃。
还是一整条直接丢嘴里的。
一开始我不懂，看他这样吃了一回，我以为毛豆就是这么吃的，还在想了想这东西根本就不好吃，发明这种吃法的人是不是有毛病。
直到有人告诉我要剥壳。
他甚至搞了个小盒子随身带着专门放毛豆，估计是当零食吃的。
为什么啊，我不明白啊。
哦对了，还有件事。
这人欠电。
我是说真的。
他的武器会不会电人我不知道，反正看他耳朵一抖一抖的，估计真有电。
这还不够，还到处找那些用电的人问怎么能挨电。
格雷伊啊、修插座的叔叔啊、还有惊蛰。
他就像个木头一样横过去问惊蛰：“有没有快速增加身体携带电荷的方法。”
他是傻子吗！
那个维多利亚的小理发师就更惨了，本身因为矿石病的原因身上疯狂起静电，他还一天到晚去和别人说：“可以电我一下吗。”
神经病啊！
————某位档案管理员在档案附录里的评价

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Harmonie shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L
Operator Harmonie leads a life of minimal contact with Originium or the Infected.

造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%

【血液源石结晶密度】0.12u/L

text.en:
Due to safety concerns, we have carried out an inspection of the staff Harmonie wields, and can presently confirm it bears no extraneous videotaping nor messaging functionality. Additionally, we have seen the Originium Arts she casts with it, similar in nature to waves of water, and have experienced the induced illusory side-effect of making it difficult to breathe. I went in assuming a Caster of such excellence would be using a more refined staff as an Arts Unit, but found it to fall short of even regulation Victorian military standards. This, plus the fact our records show she almost never visits the training grounds, may be an indicator that she much prefers to grapple with others with her words, pulling strings and building bridges behind the scenes, and makes no habit of setting foot into true, live combat.
That said, touching on the several field missions Harmonie has undertaken, her teammates frequently describe her in their reports as 'unforgiving' along with 'swift and decisive,' while those she's helped out are often left feeling like they've made some kind of mistake—not that she actually tells them as such; she simply continues to carry out her orders, completing her mission in a rote manner.
It goes without saying, but just as Harmonie herself is typically lax, her own reports are every bit as sloppy.
text.zh:
出于安全考虑，我们对和弦所持的法杖进行了检查，现在可以确认，它没有额外的摄像或者发信功能。另外，我们在测试中都见过她通过那根法杖所施展的、类似水浪的源石技艺，也体验过它附带的那种使人呼吸不畅的错觉，原本我认为这样一位优秀的术师，所使用的法杖施术单元会更精致一些，结果居然连一般维多利亚军方的制式标准都够不上。再加上从记录来看，她几乎从不出现在训练场，也许作为一名情报人员，她确实更乐于以言辞为手段与人角力，在幕后牵线搭桥，而不习惯踏入真实的战场。
不过，和弦参加的数次外勤任务里，她的队友时常会在报告中形容她“严苛”“雷厉风行”，而被她帮助过的队友则说，总觉得自己好像做错了什么事，但对方也没有明说，只是继续按部就班地执行命令，完成任务。
当然，和弦本人的报告还是和她平时的态度一样散漫。

text.en:
Prior to entering Victoria, Rhodes Island was fully prepared for the complex situation it'd be involving itself in, and we understood our actions in Londinium would unavoidably draw scrutiny from certain powers. Despite that, the vast majority in the loop were set on edge by Operator Harmonie, envoy to the dukes, boarding the Rhodes Island landship.
As far as the lofty dukes go, the fact that they'd explicitly notify us that they were sending an envoy to observe Rhodes Island, rather than employing force to obstruct our continued operations, counts as goodwill in its own right. More crucially, Harmonie voluntarily informed HR of her years of history with intelligence work when submitting her registration data, and provided us with a few classified documents, even (intentionally or not) exposing how she'd been forced on the run until now. She clearly sought to win Rhodes Island's trust by being candid, but what exactly could motivate her to do it like this? And does it represent her own will, or the inclination of the powers that back her?
Soon after, we investigated Harmonie's background and any matters she'd been involved in. We ascertained that she had previously served as a Victorian Army intelligence officer for a long period, and then elected to serve as a double agent shortly following contact with Dublinn in its early formation, dancing the line between two mutually antagonistic sides. In recent operations, she had inadvertently exposed her identity, was made the target of a covert Victorian Army manhunt, and had no choice but to seek refuge.
Considering all the roles she's played in her personal history, as well as the political hazard her relationship with the dukes backing her poses, Rhodes Island put forward strict limitations on her actions during her time stationed here. For her part, she gladly accepted our proposals and reached an agreement with us that she would provide us aid in non-sensitive affairs.

I'm loathed to imagine the risk Rhodes Island is put in by accepting a duke's envoy aboard. Victoria's powers are a tangled web, and the more we investigate the more danger we find hidden in our operators' histories... It seems we've all grown accustomed to it, bit by bit.
—An HR Operator who declined to be named

It's true that Operator Harmonie has described being given the cold shoulder within Dublinn following her failures, but beware—this is a trick spies love to use when feigning defection. We will be continuing to monitor her attitude carefully.
Does she pose a thorn in our side? Maybe her mixing of fact and fiction is a little irritating. Still, we know her A-to-Z, and possess intelligence that could put her in peril. Someone as clever as her is going to work with us.
—■■■
text.zh:
在进入维多利亚之前，罗德岛就已经做好了卷入复杂局势的准备，也明白我们在伦蒂尼姆内的行动不可避免地会引起一些势力的关注。尽管如此，当干员和弦以公爵使者的身份来到罗德岛本舰时，绝大多数知情者都感到了紧张。
对于高傲的公爵们来说，他们愿意明确知会将派遣使者对罗德岛进行观察，而非直接使用暴力手段阻止罗德岛的进一步行动，已经是一种友好的表现。更重要的是，在人事部接收登记材料时，和弦主动告知了自己的多年情报工作经历，并向罗德岛提供了部分机密文件，甚至有意无意地透露出自己被迫逃亡至此的信息。她显然想要以坦诚的态度争取罗德岛的信任，但是，她这么做是出于何种动机？是代表她个人的意愿还是她背后势力的倾向？
随后，我们对和弦的背景和牵涉到的事件进行了调查。经确认，和弦曾长时间作为维多利亚军方情报人员活动，随后在接触深池早期组织的过程中选择成为双面间谍，在互相仇视的两方之间周旋。近期行动中，她不慎暴露身份，遭到维多利亚军方暗中追捕，不得不寻找避难处。
综合考虑她个人的身份经历，以及她背后与公爵相关的政治风险，罗德岛提出对她驻留期间的活动进行严格限制。和弦本人欣然接受了我们的安排，并与我们达成了在非敏感事务上协助罗德岛的协议。

一名公爵使者驻舰可能给罗德岛带来多大的危险，我已经不愿意预测了。维多利亚的势力错综复杂，我们不断在调查中发现各位干员身份背景里的潜在风险……似乎大家都逐渐适应这种事情了。
——不愿署名的人事干员

干员和弦的确讲述了一些自己失败后在深池内部遭受冷遇和排挤的经历，但需要注意，间谍假意投诚时惯用此种手段。我们会对她保持谨慎的态度。
棘手？也许她难辨真假的言辞是有一些棘手，但现在我们已经摸清了她的底细，握有能将她置于死地的情报，她这样的聪明人会配合我们的。
——■■■

text.en:
Since passing her file review and employment test, Harmonie has ceased to make mention of her identity, neither touting herself as a Victorian ducal emissary, nor displaying any ties to Dublinn or the Victorian Army. To the vast majority of operators, she's just a new Victorian Rhodes Island arrival with a brisk step and a rather cultured upbringing. They'll often find her on their rest days attending little dance parties and pressing a glass of bubbly into their hands, or run into her cradling a pile of books at the library to check out one after another, skimming everything from assorted national histories to collections of fashion magazines.
Despite effortlessly striking up conversations with others, Harmonie leaves most operators with neither a friendly nor kind impression—in fact, thoughts such as 'is she having fun with me?' or 'she was lying just now, right?' are the instinctive reaction. 'Y'see, there was this new model of control console in a brochure and she was telling me if I was interested, I should send in a purchase form lickety-split. And, well, just a few days later, the manufacturer's trade route got locked down. Listen, honest, I could've sworn she was messing with me the way she acted. But here I am now, one of the last lucky buyers,' said an operator from Engineering. Whether or not Operator Harmonie is intentionally distancing herself from others as a way of proving she has no intention of causing trouble here, we simply cannot say.
In observing this ducal envoy's movements, we were surprised to find that several children have shown a degree of trust in Harmonie. We note that she had little to do in her first days aboard Rhodes Island other than borrow publicly available books from the repository, and the young patients in question, permitted to leave Medical, just happened to have a fledgling interest in history, and would have gladly asked her to teach them about it.
Amusingly, after some time, the children have very naturally taken to addressing her as 'Miss' like one would a teacher, though Harmonie—who has always taken others' evaluations of her in stride—outright rejects this appellation, stating 'How would I ever be a good teacher?'
text.zh:
在通过档案审核和入职测试后，和弦就不再提起自己的身份，既不以维多利亚公爵的使臣自居，也不表现出与深池或是维多利亚军方的任何关联。对于绝大多数干员来说，她只是罗德岛新来的一名活泼且颇有教养的维多利亚人。干员们可能会在休息日的小型舞会上遇到她，收到她赠送的一杯气泡水，也有可能在图书室碰见她抱着一摞书籍一本一本地登记借阅，涉猎范围从各国历史到时尚杂志汇编。
尽管很容易跟其他人搭上话，但和弦留给大多数干员的印象却并不亲切也不友善，大家甚至本能地产生“她是不是在拿我取乐”“刚刚的话是她骗我的吧”之类的想法。“上次她劝我，对杂志上那个新款操作台感兴趣的话就赶快申请采购，过几天生产商那边的贸易线就要封锁了。拜托，当时她的语气真的很像在开玩笑。但从结果来说，我真的成了最后一批拿到货的幸运买家。”一名工程部干员如是说道。至于干员和弦是否是有意与其他人保持距离，以此证明自己并不想在罗德岛无事生非，我们不得而知。
在关注这位公爵使者动向的过程中，我们意外发现几名孩子对和弦表现出了一定程度的信任，这或许是因为和弦在刚来到罗德岛时，除了借阅图书室公开区域的书籍之外无事可做，而那几名被允许离开医疗部活动的小患者恰好对历史有入门的兴趣，很乐意向和弦请教。
有趣的是，在一段时间的相处后，孩子们在交谈中很自然地将和弦称作“老师”，而一向对他人的评价照单全收的和弦却以“自己怎么会是个好老师呢”为理由，拒绝了这个称呼。

text.en:
Rhodes Island's operator roster currently contains some persons who have a history with Harmonie. On account of Victoria's ongoing and highly divisive chaos, she has proactively suggested that her contact with said persons be avoided. Needless to say, she also expressed that if Rhodes Island was willing to work with her, she would be very eager to know of Operator Reed's present movements.
Despite her request for intel pertinent to Reed being principally of benefit to Dublinn, she also claimed, 'I admit I'm just quite curious, knowing how Loughshinny's come so far.' We learned that when Reed was serving in Dublinn as the Leader's body double, Harmonie may well have been the one to have the most contact with her, keeping her company in a role analogous to a tutor or mentor. Reed had minimal contact with her sister, and was unwilling to actively participate in Dublinn's schemes; when Dublinn first began reaching out to nobles with an interest in supporting her, her behavior during their talks was likewise left extremely wanting. In regard to this issue, Harmonie offered all the help she could.
'What do you think? Give her more reading time alone, give her less pressure, less responsibility? Is that all it would've taken to do good by her? I certainly wouldn't say so. It would always have been hell for her, you see, situated where she was. And it's a shame—her in that position is exactly what Dublinn wanted, so she could play the part of her sister like a good girl.'
RE: Reed's sister, the other Draco to guide Dublinn's flames, who has now taken center stage—Harmonie has not told us much on this subject, but during an idle chat she seemingly inadvertently mentioned that she is by no means loyal to Dublinn, only hoping to see how far the Leader's endeavors will take her.
'The batch of personal records I gave you was the truth. I haven't a tie to the Draco royal family nor the Tarans, and the Duke of Wellington? No one in my family's ever had the prestige to serve under, well, His Excellency. I do have some old Gaulish blood in me, though it's an awful pity I have absolutely no interest in the Gaulish irredentist or Draco restoration movements. Rotten old bygones, all of it, you know.
'I'm just curious to see powers I've never seen, ones that will smash convention into tiny little pieces.'
text.zh:
罗德岛现有干员名单上，有几位是和弦的旧识，基于眼下在维多利亚乱局中各自不同的立场，和弦主动提出自己将避免与这些人接触。当然，她也表示如果罗德岛愿意合作，她很乐意了解干员苇草现在的动向。
尽管和弦对苇草相关情报的打探主要是基于深池的利益，但她也自称“对走到现在这一步的拉芙希妮有一些好奇”。经了解，苇草仍在深池内担任领袖替身的时期，和弦或许也是与她交流相对最多的人。她以类似于辅导者的身份陪伴在苇草身边。苇草与她的姐姐交流甚少，并不愿意主动参与深池的谋划，深池刚开始与有意支持自己的贵族接触时，苇草在商谈中的表现也有欠缺。在这些问题上，和弦都提供了自己力所能及的协助。
“多给她一些独自看书的时间，让她少承受一些压力与谴责，这能算是为了她好吗？我可不敢这么自诩。只要她还在那个位置上，她就不会太好过的。可惜，深池当时需要的，也只是保持她待在那个位置上，好好地扮演她的姐姐。”
至于苇草的姐姐，如今已经走到台前、引导着深池火焰的另一条德拉克，和弦并没有给出太多信息，却在一次闲谈中状似不经意地提起，自己并非忠于深池，只是想看领袖的事业最终能走到哪一步。
“我提供的那一部分个人信息档案是真实的。我跟德拉克王室或是塔拉人都没有任何关系，至于那位威灵顿公爵呢，我的家族中也没人有那个荣幸，得以在他麾下效力。我反倒是有一些旧高卢人的血统，可惜，我对高卢复国和德拉克复辟都毫无兴趣，那都是些古旧腐朽的东西。
“我只好奇那些我不曾见过的、打破常规的力量。”

text.en:
I've asked her about it, and she said she was drunk.
An unlikely story, of course, even to herself. The lights weren't on in the AV room, save for the projector, and the table was strewn with drinks and snacks from the viewing party, but she didn't knock anything over, didn't so much as bump anything. She was just... there, dancing away gracefully on top of that tiny little coffee table.
No, you're right, it's not important. Maybe I just wanted to ask what was on the projector at the time. I know she borrowed some Rhodes Island combat records along with two Leithanian concert tapes, and I just don't think it was the latter she was watching.
Or maybe... it's how she turned to the security camera at the end and held out her hand... maybe that's what got me.
Say, someone just so happened to visit the control center last night, right? Three in the morning? Who could that be?
text.zh:
我问过她了，她说自己是喝醉了。
当然没有人会相信，她自己也不信。当时影音室的灯没打开，只有投影仪是亮的，桌子上乱七八糟堆着上一场放映会剩下的零食饮料，但是她什么都没打翻，甚至什么都没碰到。她就那么轻盈地在那张小方桌上跳舞。
你说得对，这其实根本不算什么事。也许我只是想问问当时投影仪在放什么。她借了一些罗德岛的作战录像带，还有两盘莱塔尼亚音乐会的录像带，但我总觉得她看的不是后者。
再或者……是因为她最后朝安保监控的方向伸出了手，我有点在意。
昨天夜间是不是恰好有人去了控制中枢？凌晨三点，那能是谁？

value.en: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected by medical examination.
value.zh: 体表有源石结晶分布，参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

infectionStatus.zh: 体表有源石结晶分布，参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

text.en:
Sussurro is a graduate of the Siracusa-Palermo Medical Academy. She has a sufficient level of knowledge in basic medical care.
She is now a medic at Rhodes Island and is a respected member of the headquarters' logistics system.
text.zh:
苏苏洛，正式入职前为叙拉古帕勒莫市立医科学院毕业生。具备基础医疗方面的充足学识。
现于罗德岛担任医疗干员，是总部后勤医疗体系内的坚实力量。

text.en:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 2%
Patient's oripathy is mild and currently shows no indications of spreading.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.3u/L
Patient's disease is under control.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】2%
患者轻度矿石病感染，目前无扩散倾向。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.3u/L
患者目前病程控制稳定。

text.en:
Sussurro was born to an ordinary family in a large city in Siracusa. Her parents were ordinary citizens who worked in local public institutions. They had two sons and two daughters. Sussurro was their third child.
Although Sussurro's parents wanted her to be a quiet, obedient child, she did not respond positively to these expectations. Sometimes this was to help her younger sister get back snacks her brothers had stolen, and sometimes this was to help her sister get a hold of a toy she couldn't have. Since her childhood, Sussurro has developed a personality that takes initiative.
Sussurro's two older brothers have already grown up and have gone into business. Her younger sister is studying in kindergarten. Sussurro herself chose to study medicine. She did not do so out of any grand ambition or dream, but because the medical industry in Siracusa holds promise and is a good field to work in.
text.zh:
干员苏苏洛出生于叙拉古某大型都市一个普通家庭中。其父母皆为普通市民，就职于当地的公职机构，并育有两子两女，苏苏洛是他们第三个孩子。
尽管父母希望苏苏洛成为一个安静，听话的孩子，但苏苏洛似乎并未积极响应他们的期望。有时候是为了帮幺妹讨回被哥哥们偷吃的零食，有的时候又要为得不到玩具而大哭大闹的幺妹操心。自童年起，苏苏洛就形成了如今这样敢说敢做的性格。
苏苏洛的两位兄长现已成人并进入公司工作，最小的妹妹尚在幼儿园就读。苏苏洛本人选择了就读医学专业，并不是为了远大的理想和美好愿望，只是因为医学行业在叙拉古当地的发展前景良好，是一份有前途的工作的缘故。

text.en:
Sussurro's life as a medical student was uneventful. She busied herself preparing for exams and participating in experiments. Her small figure was often bouncing between the different buildings on campus, and her short stature notwithstanding, all of her abilities steadily progressed.
Luckily for Sussurro, she got to make a solid group of friends between classes and maintained good relationships with some older students. These medical students all embraced the same dreams, confronted the same challenges, and worked towards the future together. With everyone's help and encouragement, Sussurro managed to press on through the long, dull days in her time as a medical student.
Though Sussurro originally had no aspirations of her own, through making friends with all kinds of people, she gradually came to understand the reasoning behind their choices. Whether it was to secure a job with a stable salary and life environment, out of a genuine desire to help others, or just out of pure interest in biology, Sussurro found their aspirations infectious. She liked everyone who had a dream and worked hard to fulfill it, and at the same time, her own thinking became clear:
Does becoming a doctor hold any special meaning for me?
text.zh:
作为医学学生的苏苏洛，生活无外乎背书，准备资格考试，参与实验等，她的小小身影忙碌于各个教学楼之间，除了身高之外的各项能力都在稳步地成长。
较为幸运的是，苏苏洛在校期间结识了一群关系不错的朋友，还与几位高一学年的学姐保持着良好的关系。同为医学生的大家怀抱着各自的梦想，共同面对难关，努力为未来拼搏着。正是在大家相互之间的帮助和鼓励下，苏苏洛才能一步步地踏过枯燥且漫长的医学生时光。
原本没有什么愿望的苏苏洛，在与各种各样的人相结识后，也渐渐在了解着大家对自己选择的思考。不论是为了就业后的稳定薪资与生活环境，还是真正怀着救助他人理想，或是单纯对生命本身的浓厚兴趣，每个人的愿望都在感染着苏苏洛。她喜欢每一个抱着美好愿望并为之努力的人，与此同时也在努力弄清自己的想法：
成为医生，对自己是否有着另外的意义？

text.en:
When the oripathy crisis gradually worsened throughout every major city, people were forced to confront an all-new and unknown illness. Now, both public and private hospitals were packed with patients, and medical resources became strained. Sussurro's clinical instructor as well as her seniors all participated in efforts to combat the disease.
Faced with a notice that all major hospitals were recruiting medical students to act as volunteers, Sussurro did not think twice about signing up. It was at this moment that she felt she was finally a medical student, and she found genuine purpose.
text.zh:
直到矿石病危机在各大城市不断加深，人们才开始正视这种全新的，尚且未知的疾病。此时，无论公私医院都面临着人满为患，医疗资源紧张的局面。苏苏洛的临床教师与正在实习的前辈们，都参与了收治感染者的行动。
面对各大医院招收医学生作为志愿者的通告，苏苏洛几乎没有想太多就报名。这一瞬间，她仿佛觉得自己作为医学生，在这一刻才获得了真正的意义。

text.en:
Sussurro did not think about the fact that she had become infected by volunteering to participate in the treatment of the infected. Even when three days had passed since she herself had been transformed from doctor to infected, she did not feel anything. Everything just seemed to happen so suddenly.
It wasn't until she witnessed a patient be declared untreatable and get sent to the intensive care unit with a blank stare that she made the connection between herself and the situation at hand.
text.zh:
因志愿参与救治感染者的行动而成为感染者这件事，苏苏洛没有仔细地想过。即使当她从医生成为病人经过了将近三天，她也尚未找到这件事带给自己的实感。一切都仿佛是突然发生的。
直到她在监护病房窗外看到被宣告不治的患者，被送往关怀病房时呆滞的眼神时，她试图将这一场景和自己连接起来。
