text.zh:
【干员德·托莱多资料归档记录】
档案资料一
当前流程状态：未入档
批注：请人事干员加快背调进度，确认干员德·托莱多所有资料的真实性。若情况特殊可以与干员本人或其相关人士面谈，依据口述确认资料。

档案资料一
当前流程状态：退回
批注：我知道整理三份各六小时的口述资料很困难，但纯音频文件实在不符合档案提交的格式。另外，请注意整理成文档时不能照搬“海洋的征服者、享有无上荣光的德·托莱多家族”此类浮夸表述。

档案资料一
当前流程状态：再次退回
批注：按规定，背调时间应当在三个月前已经结束——好吧，这位人事干员，我也很同情你，要从特菲口中听到她说一句关于自己身世的实话确实太难了。
回复：前辈……特菲是谁？
回复：德·托莱多干员的昵称啊。奇怪，这四个月里你没听她提起过吗？等等，你没听过她讲的《雷亚-伊比利亚与海中来客》？那《军官死前的最后一个雪夜》呢？
回复：哈……？

那是我有生以来第一次听到如此激昂、动人，又不着调的演说。干员德·托莱多站在活动室的下沉式休息区中央，向不了解伊比利亚的干员和在罗德岛治病的人们讲了三个故事。说实话，她听上去像个十足的骗子，恐怕只有第一排拿着帆船玩具和纸质徽章的孩子才会上当。对了，活动室的座位还是太少了，连站三个小时对腰背不好——好吧，我承认我也有点被这个张牙舞爪的黎博利打动了，甚至在她请求“黄金舰队筹备资金”的时候掏出了钱包。平心而论，这不算上当。包括我在内，很多听众大概都是被她讲的伊比利亚故事感染，而不是真认为她是个响当当的贵族。而且她看上去对手下的拥护者不错，连演讲时的音效都没让他们来弄，全都自己一手包办。
可惜的是，三个小时过去，我还是不清楚干员德·托莱多的故事里有哪几句是真的，我可能永远也完不成她的资料归档了。但我想，我确实搞明白了一件事——我不适合当一名记录以及核对事实的人事干员，我应当去追逐早已被我放下的创作梦。我将以文员的身份加入德·托莱多的队伍，替她写点故事，等到下一位人事干员来核实资料的时候，我说不定就能告诉他，德·托莱多到底是什么样的人。
——辞呈附件，来自曾经的人事干员

text.en: [Pending Translation]
text.zh:
当干员德·托莱多完成伊比利亚办事处的任务，带着她的拥护者们回罗德岛的时候，他们会自称“罗德岛下属海军”在基地内巡逻。
说是巡逻，更像是某种观光。德·托莱多将干员宿舍称为她的“寝宫”，将疗养庭院称为她的“花园”，将工程部称为她的“军备制造厂”，招来了不少非议。德·托莱多丝毫不在意周遭对她的评价，她命令在伊比利亚睡惯潮湿地板的孩子躺上她自己柔软的床垫；搀着病入膏肓的老人去疗养庭院闻一闻海边没有的花香；还有那些胆小却能造出结实玩意儿的年轻人，德·托莱多一把将他们推进工程部，三天之后，年轻人和工程部干员的眼睛里都放着光，比她还啰嗦地介绍新发明的设备。久而久之，抱怨德·托莱多蛮横举动的声音就跟投诉她占用活动室的信件一样消失了。只要和她接触过的人都会明白，德·托莱多是个做的跟说的一样多的人——鉴于她说的实在太多，她为自己拥护者做的足以让人暂时遗忘“拥护者”其实是上了她当的“受害者”——

受害者？我不明白……德·托莱多大人不是风暴，我们又怎么会因为她“受害”？我从鳞脊镇一路跟大人来到这里，身上什么都没有，大人就让我负责做饭，给大伙煮海藻汤。当然，不是什么时候都能捞到足够的海藻，我们会往里面掺点沙子。她说等她找到一个可靠的资助人，或者是有了自己的庄园，就把我们都接过去，喝只有海藻的海藻汤。我知道这里不是大人的家，但我在都是桌椅的地方领到了汤，德·托莱多大人没有欺骗我。什么？她的身份？有时候她确实不太像贵族，但我们也不知道伊比利亚的贵族到底是什么样子，不是吗？如果那些已经埋在土里的贵族老爷能跟大人一样，就很不错了。啊，我想起来了，之前也有拥护者质疑她，她向我们证明了她的贵族血统。海军军装？不，不是指那个。你们知道，她有十一根脚趾吗？
——德·托莱多的拥护者，一名普通的伊比利亚老人，拦住档案记录员说道

text.zh:
《德·托莱多家族血统遗传与十一根脚趾考》
埃斯特班·恩里克斯·德·托莱多，伊比利亚黄金时代王室海军将领，性格刚毅、自尊心极高，是出色的舵手和领航员，被当时的伊比利亚人称作“翻动波涛的德·托莱多”。八十三年的人生中，他有近七十年在海上度过，无论舰船面临多大的风暴，他都会伫立在甲板最前端，无数水手以他为榜样，极端的效仿行为让当时水手的死亡率以及晋升率都大幅提高。
然而大静谧后，雷亚-伊比利亚沉没，大量关于王室和贵族的资料遗失，口口相传的回忆以及为数不多的记载显露出这位贵族鲜为人知的另一面。埃斯特班·恩里克斯·德·托莱多患有家族遗传的多趾症，畸形、多余的脚趾令他在平地走路时一瘸一拐，而船只的颠簸恰能掩盖他的缺陷。航海上的造诣或许是他的天赋使然，亦或许是他为了自尊心掩盖残疾所作努力的成果。
同样的悲剧也发生在他的子嗣身上，他的继承者埃斯塔尼斯劳成了出色的海军将领，若无大静谧，他也将同他父亲一样终生在海上度过。据传言，大静谧来临时他跳下舰船，一瘸一拐逃出了雷亚-伊比利亚，从此销声匿迹。
如今，埃斯特菲尼娅·科隆·德·托莱多，自称埃斯特班·恩里克斯·德·托莱多的曾孙重新现身，海军军装和十一根脚趾无不在印证她的身份，我们应当追随她的脚步，重振伊比利亚王室海军的荣耀……

【一条夹在书页中的小记】
没想到我辞去人事部工作后，德·托莱多交予我的第一项任务是为她立传。也是，怀疑她贵族身份的拥护者一向不少。上述内容大部分是从她讲述的故事中摘录出来，再重新用逻辑串联的。我很确信德·托莱多并非那名伟大海军将领的后裔，但我确实也好奇她是否真的拥有十一根脚趾，如果不是，她又是怎么骗过寻求证明的拥护者的。疑问产生后的第四天，我从她讲的另一个故事里找到了答案，或许这又是一个她基于伊比利亚现实编撰出来的故事，但我姑且将它记下：
曾有一个贫穷的伊比利亚女人，她的丈夫被大海吞没，她独自等待临盆。分娩时因为胎位不正，胎儿的脚先出来。那个不幸的孩子同样患有多趾症，极度虔诚的女人以为自己诞下了一只恐鱼，晕死过去。后来孩子平安无事，但女人自戕了。孩子由村子里的人抚养，她增生的脚趾让她无法从事体力工作。她离开了村子，之后她的下落无人知晓。

text.zh:
【伊比利亚办事处一名外派干员的行动记录】
在与干员德·托莱多正式合作之前，我对她的行事风格颇有微词。先不说她到哪儿都带着浩浩荡荡的一批拥护者，有一小片空地就会清清嗓子开始演说，每次任务前，这个闲不住的黎博利都会彻底跑没影，在我无法确定按照伊比利亚的习俗这样行动是否合适时，这位名义上的“向导”基本不会在我们身边。
自雷亚-伊比利亚重回伊比利亚海岸线，审判庭决定解除伊比利亚的封锁之后，我们的工作比以往更加艰难。黄金时代的遗产逐渐回归人们的生活，伊比利亚人的信仰正在重组。部分民众不再对审判庭颁布的教义言听计从；而另一边，用信仰划定生活形状的人们声称自己遭受了“背叛”。一次，一名绝食的伊比利亚人主动拒绝了我们的帮助，他念诵旧版的经文驱赶我们，我们离开了。半小时之后，怒气冲冲的德·托莱多出现在我们面前。
这是我第一次见到德·托莱多生气。我曾经看到她在那个平民的木屋附近游荡，或许那是她的潜在拥护者之一。但她只是给了我一份名单，上面列着几十个名字，半数已经被划去。她告诉我，她手下的一名拥护者是这个镇子的配糖员，他每天下午会从甘蔗农场运出粗糖，给名单上的每个人送去一点。他向伟大的贵族德·托莱多许的愿望是，他希望自己不用再划去名单上的名字。
第二天，德·托莱多在那个伊比利亚人的家门口搭了一个小讲台。第三天，她连续讲了十个小时，太阳要从海面消失不见的时候，门内的伊比利亚人回了她一句。第四天，她用所谓的“家族训言”给粗糖“赐福”——不伦不类，但那人舔了一口碟子中的糖。至此，我们的扶助任务圆满结束，她收获了一名忠实的拥护者。
返回罗德岛的路上，我向她道歉，同时恭喜德·托莱多的队伍再添一员。她没像往常那样拍着我的胳膊嘻嘻哈哈。她看着簇拥在她身边的拥护者们，他们称她为伊比利亚最高尚之人，在此之前这个称号在他们口中属于审判庭的圣徒。
我似乎明白了她在担心什么。在依旧动荡的伊比利亚，她需要是“贵族德·托莱多”，她需要给“遭受背叛”的伊比利亚人一个选择。或许只有大部分伊比利亚人都能信仰自身时，她才会选择不再欺骗。

text.zh:
“咳咳……德·托莱多海军预备队与罗德岛合作第三次会议记录……”
“博士，这个小东西真能录下我们所有的对话？欸，不对，你不会在我偷偷跟你说真话的时候也开录音了吧？”
“对对对，现在录音也开着，我说的都是真话，都是！”
“说回正题，这次会议是为了汇报由我组建的海军预备队在罗德岛资助下的筹备概况。”
“人员招募、航海训练、武器制造都在稳步进行，前景十分乐观，建议增加投资——欸，不要调取行动记录啊！”
“……”
“别不说话啊，从人贩子手里救了两个孩子怎么不算人员招募？划船捞海藻怎么不算航海训练？还有武器制造——手炮和剑只有在审判庭的人手里才有用处，我们的武器应该是犁和铁锹！”
“我得先让拥护者们好好生活，才能再想点别的。相信我，我虽然骗人但从不食言的！”
“博士，你同意增加投资啦？有个条件？”
“……把我跟拥护者的经历也编进故事里宣讲？”
“小意思！我向你保证，你一定会是第一个听众！”

text.en: The Sargonian-Columbian Hadiya is a descendant of the Qarnsayf, a legendary warrior tribe of the desert. She joined Rhodes Island in Sargon as part of her ambition to improve her combat techniques. She currently receives training and participates in field missions at the Sargonian branch office of Rhodes Island.
text.zh: 哈蒂娅，萨尔贡裔哥伦比亚人，沙漠传奇战士部族剑角的后代。为学习战斗技巧于萨尔贡主动加入罗德岛，现作为罗德岛驻萨尔贡办事处干员，接受战斗训练的同时参与各类外勤任务。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be non-infected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Hadiya shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.19u/L
Before joining Rhodes Island, Operator Hadiya spent an extended time in the Sargonian wilderness without proper protection, resulting in BOCD numbers close to the infection threshold. As she is expected to spend significant time in the field, we have arranged additional tests in order to prepare proper protection for her. While Hadiya's awareness of the risks inherent in wilderness environments is lacking, she has proven cooperative with our work, which has greatly facilitated our efforts.

Based on her own account of her activities, she has been quite lucky to avoid contracting Oripathy so far. Unlike some tribal warriors, however, she is very receptive to scientific methods, and has already put in a request for other warriors from her tribe to receive similar checkups and training on Originium protection, pending approval by the Medical Department.
—Medical Department Note
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员哈蒂娅没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.19u/L
干员哈蒂娅加入罗德岛之前，在缺乏正确防护的情况下长时间活动于萨尔贡的荒野之中，她血液中的源石结晶密度测定结果几乎已经到达感染标准临界值。由于此后哈蒂娅小姐也将长期在野外执行任务，我们为她额外安排了多项检查，以便为她制定更好的防护方案。虽然哈蒂娅小姐本人似乎缺乏对荒野环境的完整认知，对外勤环境的风险评估能力尚有不足，但她十分配合我们的工作，这为医疗部的计划推进带来了极大的便利。

根据本人自述的活动经历来看，哈蒂娅小姐未感染矿石病纯属幸运。不过与部分传统的部族战士不同，哈蒂娅小姐对科学的治疗手段抱以很高的信任。她已经主动向医疗部提出申请，希望能够介绍同族的战士接受类似的检查与防护培训，此事已经提上医疗部的日程。
——医疗部干员

text.en:
Although Hadiya first encountered Rhodes Island in Sargon, and was assigned to the Sargonian branch after she was hired, it is obvious that she is not your average Sargonian.
Her style is very different from tribal warriors. She wields a staff with her right hand and a sword with her left, both containing complex mechanisms and axle-connected blades. The staff has foldable hooked blades on one end and a blunt hammer on the other, allowing her to employ both lethal and non-lethal means to neutralize enemies in close combat. Meanwhile, the short hilt of the sword makes it easy to perform thrusting motions when wielded on its own. An elaborate connector mechanism allows the two weapons to be combined into one, whereby the staff's hammer is retracted, the folding blades extended, and the shape of the sword's blade also changes, allowing her to respond to different situations and ranges. Hadiya had these weapons custom-made for her during her time in Columbia, and their design and construction clearly reflect Columbian technological thinking, making them very different from Sargonian weapons. The techniques she demonstrates in training are also different from traditional Sargonian techniques. She is an expert at utilizing cover and obstacles in close-quarters combat, relying on guile rather than strength, and creating an advantage through the versatility of her weapon. On the other hand, she is less comfortable fighting in wide-open spaces. She admits that she is still unfamiliar with the Sargonian wilderness, having developed her habits on the streets of Columbia and in training rooms. She recognizes that this is an area she needs to improve on as part of her new responsibilities, and she often approaches other Sargonian operators to pick their brains.

[Training Room Audio Log]
'Don't you find Hadiya's conversations with other Sargonian warriors really interesting?'
'What do you mean?'
'She always wants to learn the details of their weapons, how they're built, how they work, what environments they're good in.
'Most of the time, though, the only answer she gets is:
'Don't think. Just chop.'
text.zh:
虽然哈蒂娅本人是在萨尔贡第一次遇到了罗德岛的干员们，被雇佣后也一直分属于萨尔贡办事处，但每个人都看得出来她绝非人们普遍认知中的萨尔贡人。
最明显的是，她在战斗中就不同于一般部族战士。哈蒂娅手中常备有两把武器，无论是右手的战杖还是左手的单手剑，都带有相当复杂的机械结构和以轮轴相连的刃片。战杖配备的是可折叠倒钩状刃片，另一侧还装配着高强度的钝击锤，这让哈蒂娅能够在近身作战中对敌人进行缴械和致命打击。而单手剑则装配了较短的剑柄，在单独持握时能让哈蒂娅更加灵活地刺击。除此之外，它们还分别带有一套精密的铰接装置，能让两柄武器进行组合。组合时战杖的钝击锤会随铰接结构收起，折叠的刃片随即弹出，单手剑也会变更剑刃形状，以对应多变的战斗状况，适配不同的作战距离。这两柄武器都是哈蒂娅在哥伦比亚时为自己定做的，可以明显看出，它们的设计与制作都融入了哥伦比亚的科技化思想，与萨尔贡的风格相差甚远。另一方面，哈蒂娅在罗德岛的训练室中也展现出了不同于传统萨尔贡战士的战斗技巧，她更擅长障碍和掩体较多的近身作战环境，并且比起单纯依靠力量她更善于临机应变，利用手中武器的多面性来建立优势，反倒是在开阔环境作战中往往表现一般。聊到这一点，她痛快地承认对于萨尔贡的荒野来说自己还只是初来乍到，从小时候起她就只在哥伦比亚的城市街道和训练场中进行练习和模拟战斗，因此才有了现在的作战习惯。但她同时也表示，为了自己身上肩负的责任，她理应学会如何在荒野上作战。从她时常向罗德岛上的其他萨尔贡干员讨教这一点上，可以看出她并不只是嘴上说说而已。

【训练室语音记录】
“你不觉得哈蒂娅小姐和其他萨尔贡战士的对话很有意思吗？”
“怎么说？”
“她总是想弄明白武器的使用方式，它们的结构是什么样的，适用于什么作战环境，于是就一直在问类似的问题。
“但大部分时候对面只用一句话回答她。
“‘别管那些，砍就对了。’”

text.en:
The experience of growing up in Columbia will always be part of her. As she has often told other operators in the Sargon area, she knew that she was destined to come to this wilderness, but she also knows that it will hard to shake her Columbian habits, even once the glory of the Qarnsayf is restored.

'I grew up in a small community in a nomadic city,' said Hadiya while chatting with other operators during break time. 'It wasn't a very wealthy district, but it was always lively, with people coming from all kinds of places, and Sargon is just one of them.
'Every group has its own unique customs, character, and views. To me, though, it always felt so cohesive.
'Everyone's habits and pastimes had become Columbianized. Watching Wrankwood movies over soda and fried fowlbeast, making a fuss during district elections, and so on.
'The movies were great though! I should bring the latest pop music next time.'

While Hadiya is happy to talk about the culture and customs of Columbia, she has never shown an intention to import them to Sargon. When asked about the reason, she said she did not want to do so, because it would ruin the purity of Sargon in her mind.
In her veneration of the wilderness, she is, indeed, a proper Sargonian—a remark from many of her colleagues.
text.zh:
在哥伦比亚成长的经历对于哈蒂娅来说，是绝对无法从她生命中剥离的东西。正如她自己多次向萨尔贡驻地的干员们提起的那样，她知道自己命中注定要来到这片荒野上，但她也明白即便到了剑角部族重拾荣光的那一天，自己的哥伦比亚式的习惯也很难改变。

“我生在一个杂居社区。”哈蒂娅在某一天休息时，和干员们聊起自己的身世，“那是个移动城市里不太繁华的街区，但很热闹。来自各地的人都有，萨尔贡出身的人只是其中一小部分。
“每个族群都有独特的习俗，性格呀观念呀都不太一样，但要我说，那是个很有凝聚力的街区。
“因为大家的娱乐方式、日常生活习惯都已经是哥伦比亚式的了。喝着气泡水吃着油炸羽兽肉，一起看蓝卡坞的电影，等到区选举的时候还要去参加人声鼎沸的活动。
“那些电影真的很棒，对了，下次我应该带些最新的流行音乐给你们听。”

虽说如此，哈蒂娅一直以来都只是纯粹地分享，她从未表现出要把哥伦比亚的文化和习俗带到萨尔贡的意愿。当被问及这一点的时候，她明确表示不想那样做，因为那样会破坏她心中纯净的萨尔贡。
在坚守“敬畏荒野”的信念这一块她确实像个货真价实的萨尔贡人，这是很多与她共事过的干员对她的评价。

text.en:
Hadiya went through many hardships when rebuilding her tribe.
The name Qarnsayf exists only in historical records. Their territory no longer exists, nor have they left behind any extant relics, or first-hand witnesses to their exploits. This is why many lords ameer privately harbor doubts about the veracity of the legendary tribe's existence, even though The Book of Sargon contains detailed records of the Qarnsayf and their battles.
Hadiya's father's generation claimed to be the descendants of the Qarnsayf, and passed down their ancestors' teachings and the responsibility of rebuilding the tribe to hers. Although their appearance matches the depictions of the Qarnsayf in the records, and it is true that many Qarnsayf tribesmen left Sargon to become mercenaries, this is hardly enough to convince the Padishah to grant them new territory, much less make their name known throughout the tribes.
The local Padishah's challenge presented even more obstacles to her path. In order to earn the Padishah's trust and have him officially recognize the tribe and its territory, Hadiya must earn the recommendation of fifteen lords ameer and obtain their tokens—no mean feat when each one has a different demand. Defeating a lord ameer's guards in combat is merely the first step: some would not even give her the opportunity until she passed a test of history, which is hardly her strong suit. As such, at this time, Hadiya has only earned the approval of two lords ameer who allowed her to challenge their soldiers directly, and there is a long way to go until she completes the Padishah's task.
Hadiya has never complained about this. She is often seen in the break room watching Columbian movies, or chatting with colleagues about city life, showing no sign of worry about the progress of the challenge.
When others ask about it, her answer is this: If you fail, try again until you succeed.
She has never doubted that she will succeed.
text.zh:
哈蒂娅重建部族的进程并不顺利。
剑角部族是一个如今仅留于书面记载的部族，在如今的萨尔贡，既不存在其领地，也没有流传的遗物，甚至连亲身见证其传奇事迹的幸存者也早已消失。这也是为何虽然《萨尔贡史》之中有对剑角部族及其战斗功绩的明确记载，许多王酋私下里依然对这个传说中的部族是否真实存在过表示怀疑。
哈蒂娅的父辈自称是剑角部族的传人，并将先祖的教诲以及重建部族的使命传给了她这一代。虽然从外貌上，她与父辈都符合记载中对剑角部族战士形象的描绘，且剑角部族作为一个佣兵部族确实有不少族人离开了萨尔贡本土。但仅凭这些证据很难说服沙漠中的帕夏赐予剑角部族新领地，更遑论在部族之间传播剑角的威名了。
而让她的前路变得更加险阻重重的，就是当地帕夏提出的挑战。为了得到帕夏的信任，获得他亲自授予的部族领地和名号，哈蒂娅必须获得至少十五位王酋的认可，也就是从十五位王酋手上拿到证明的信物。但想要获得王酋们的信物并不容易，因为不同地区的王酋们提出的要求也不尽相同。作为战士战胜王酋亲兵只是最基本的挑战，在此之外有些王酋还会提出历史文书知识的比拼，只有通过了知识试炼他们才会同意哈蒂娅参加擂台赛挑战自己的亲兵。而书面知识从来都不是她的强项，因此哈蒂娅目前仅仅得到了两位愿意让她直接与亲兵作战的王酋的认可，距离达成帕夏的目标还非常遥远。
哈蒂娅对此没有过一句怨言。相反，在萨尔贡办事处，还能经常看到她在休息室悠闲地看着哥伦比亚电影，或是在训练之后开心地和同事们闲聊着自己的城市生活，似乎并不对挑战的进展感到担忧。
其他干员问起这件事情的时候，她只回答说，失败了的话做到成功为止不就好了。
她从不怀疑自己最终能够成功。

text.en:
[Columbian Department of Immigration Audio Log 044]
'Here are the reports on the ten Sargonians. Well, nine Sargonians now.'
'What happened?'
'One was deathly ill before crossing the border. Already dead by the time the troops found them.'
'Where are they? Still in custody?'
'Yes. It's a band of wandering mercenaries, not immigrants who entered through official channels. The military has concerns about their background and doesn't want to let them in.'
'Why don't they just deport them? Why hand them over to us?'
'Deport them where? Their employer, well, doesn't exist anymore, so that's out of the question. And the situation in Sargon is pretty chaotic right now. These ten seem to be from the same tribe, and most likely from somewhere our intel indicates a massacre occurred. The military is concerned that they might resort to desperate measures if not handled properly. I was there at the detention center, and I saw the kind of look in their eyes you only see in people who've seen hell. I'd only seen it in veterans of the Revolutionary War before.'
'So General Sfax doesn't want to be responsible for whatever happens if they're let loose. They want us to make the decision.'
'Do you want to review the report?'
'No need. Tell the general to let them in. Our mission is to absorb different types of immigrants from various places, and these Sargonians fit our needs.'
'Yes, sir, I'll let him know.'
'One more thing. Mark their papers and file them under 'Special Immigrants.' For reference when drafting future management policies.'
'Yes, sir.'
text.zh:
【哥伦比亚移民管理处录音记录转写文本第044号】
“这是有关那十个萨尔贡人的具体报告，应该说，现在是九个。”
“怎么回事？”
“其中有一个在穿越边境线之前就已经病得不轻了，等到被军队找到的时候早就咽气了。”
“现在他们人呢？还在临时羁押？”
“是的，这群人应该是流浪雇佣兵，不是正规渠道进来的移民，加上军方对他们的背景也不是很放心，不想放他们入境。”
“如果军方不愿意的话，直接遣返他们不就得了，干嘛要移交我们这边管？”
“问题就是，军方也不知道该遣返他们到哪里去。他们的上一任雇主，呃，已经不存在了，所以想把他们遣返回原雇主那边肯定行不通。萨尔贡那边的局势也极度混乱，从我们的调查来看，这十个人应该来自同一个部族，而且很有可能来自情报部门报告的那起大屠杀的区域。军队那边担心，如果不遣返，直接拒绝他们入境，很有可能会逼迫这群人铤而走险。毕竟，我也去羁押所见过这群人，确实看上去就不是普通移民，他们眼神里的那种只有在死地中摸爬滚打过的人才有的凶狠劲儿，我只在那些参与过独立战争的老兵身上看到过。”
“明白了，斯法克斯将军就是想着万一出了问题，他不想承担这个把人放了的责任，要我们去做这个拍板的人。”
“那报告您还需要过目吗？”
“不用，你去联系将军让他放这些人入境。我们接到的任务也是尽量多吸纳不同类型的各地移民，这些萨尔贡人很符合我们的需求。”
“明白了，我这就去联络。”
“稍等一下，在这群人的档案上做好标记，归档在‘特殊移民’里，以后制定移民管理策略的时候需要参考。”
“收到！”

text.en:
She could hardly feel her legs anymore.
Through the swaying light of the firepot, she looked at the lord ameer sitting behind the table, who was gazing at her with narrowed eyes. She knew she had to maintain control of her body and not waver, because the slightest sign of weakness would give him an excuse to deny her hard work.
First, the trial of recitement. She used the techniques that Anat taught her.
Second, the trial of stamina. Long years of training carried her through.
At last, the duel with the lord ameer's elite guard. There was no time for rest before this last trial. Thoroughly exhausted, she faced off against the hulking shieldguard. None of the faces illuminated by firelight were cheering for her. She could hear the crowd roar whenever the guard parried her attacks—
'Finish her off!'
When she hooked the edge of the shield with her staff and leapt into the air with the momentum of her opponent's charge, then flicked the sword to unfold the blades and cut the guard's necklace, none of the sounds around the stage mattered anymore.
'As per our agreement, victory is mine, lord ameer.' She could feel the words in her throat, but was not sure if she actually vocalized them or not.
The reaction of the lord ameer told her that she had. It was only her third victory, with twelve more to go, but she knew she was on the right path.
She took the token and turned around to walk towards the exit. Her legs had been numb, but now they were strong again, and her steps were no longer heavy.
She left behind the light of the firepots, and gazed out at the wilderness to see the sun rising upon the horizon.
text.zh:
她的双腿已经近乎失去知觉了。
在火盆摇曳的光芒之中，她看向眼前坐在桌后的王酋，对方眯着眼审视着她。她知道自己此刻只能用意志继续坚持着，绝不能放弃对自己身体的控制。因为哪怕露出一刻的软弱，眼前这个人都有可能否定掉自己的努力。
文书诵读，阿娜特小姐教授过的技巧，全部都派上了用场。
耐力试炼，常年的训练锻炼出的体质，让她坚持到了最后。
最后一场和亲兵的对决之前，没有休息的时间，她在几乎耗尽体能的状态下，面对手持巨盾的大力士。火光中没有人为她欢呼，反倒是盾卫兵一次次挡开她的攻击的时候，她听到观赛的群众的喊声。
“把她送走！”
而当她用战杖钩住巨盾的边缘，借着盾卫兵推进的蛮力让自己跃起，而后在对手身后弹出单手剑的剑刃，割断了他脖颈上的挂链时，擂台周围的一切声音对她而言都不再重要。
“大人，按照我们的约定，是我胜了。”她感到这句话从喉咙中冒了出来，但却无法确定自己究竟有没有将它说出口。
而桌子对面王酋的反应，让她知道自己是真的做到了。虽然这仅仅是她的第三次胜利，离十五次的目标还很远，但她知道，自己走在正确的路上。
她接过信物，转身走向了门口。已经麻木的双腿不知从何处又获取了力量，她感到脚步不再沉重。
火盆的光被她留在身后，她望向外面，荒野上的黎明似乎刚刚降临。

value.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

text.en:
Weedy, a bioengineering expert who was born into a family of Iberian scientists, is a researcher who has been with Rhodes Island since its establishment. 
After a long period of testing and adjustment, she has finally completed a customized weapon for herself. She has chosen to become an operator of her own free will, providing long-ranged support to other operators on the battlefield.
text.zh:
生物工程学专家，伊比利亚科研世家出身，罗德岛成立之初就加入的研究者。
经过本人长期调整与测试，最终完成了为自己量身定做的武器。并根据自身意愿成为干员，在战场上为同僚提供远程支援。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Weedy has no signs of Originium infections. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L
Operator Weedy utilizes comprehensive protection when coming in contact with Originium. 

If Weedy can still get infected despite all these protective measures, then life on Terra can no longer persist. 
—Gavial
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员温蒂没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.12u/L
干员温蒂在接触源石中做了十足的防护措施。

如果温蒂那样的防护措施都能被感染，那泰拉人不要活了。
——嘉维尔

text.en:
Weedy is a scientist and a bit of a neat-freak. 
Under normal circumstances, she is never seen in public. When interacting with others, if she notices anything untidy about her interlocutor's appearance, she will courteously but bluntly point it out with the expectation that it will be fixed immediately. Otherwise, the conversation will come to an abrupt end. 
For this reason, Miss Closure, Weedy's immediate supervisor and renowned slob, has difficulty lifting her head when talking to Weedy - a rare sight to behold indeed.
text.zh:
洁癖相当严重的科学家。
平时完全无法在公共场合见到她的身影。与人交流时，如果注意到对方身上有不整洁的地方，会有礼貌指出并率直地希望对方先整理自己的外表，否则对话就会就此终止。
因为这个原因，她的顶头上司，众所周知的不拘小节派，可露希尔小姐在面对她时，会罕见地抬不起头。

text.en:
Bioengineering is a discipline that has emerged only recently. Scientists have found that by combining biological theory with the experience of engineering, they are in a better position to solve various problems encountered in the fields of biology and medicine. This new discipline quickly became closely linked to the practice of medicine. 
Especially for a company like Rhodes Island that seeks to develop drugs to inhibit and treat Oripathy, a bioengineering laboratory can be said to be a necessity. 
However, even if Rhodes Island offers a favorable salary compared to the rest of the industry, it is well-known as a pharmaceutical company that specializes in Originium research and Oripathy treatment. Naturally, these are subjects that would discourage most people. 
But even setting this point aside, the fact that Rhodes Island needs to be mobile, and the existence of tech companies such as Rhine Lab that can provide a better baseline, has caused Rhodes Island to be at a disadvantage when competing for talent. 
Furthermore, Rhodes Island is not purely a pharmaceutical company, and many prospective employees decide to leave after learning about Rhodes Island's true purpose. 
All in all, despite the considerable successes of Closure's Engineering Department in attracting a vast amount of talent, Rhodes Island's recruiting efforts are far from enough to meet the scope of the challenges. Closure can often be heard complaining about these difficulties, but she knows that there is little that can be done to improve the situation. 
Despite these conditions, there is, according to Closure, one department that she never has to worry about, and that is the Bioengineering Department led by Weedy.
text.zh:
生物工程学是一个近代才出现的学科，科学家们发现如果将工程学的经验与生物理论相结合，能够帮助我们更好地去解决在生物学及医药学等领域等中遇到的各种问题，因此它迅速成为了一门与医学有着紧密联系的学科。
尤其是对于罗德岛这样一家试图研究出抑制和治疗矿石病的药物的公司来说，一个生物工程研究室应该说是必须要拥有的。
然而，即使罗德岛开出的薪资待遇在业内也属于优渥的水平，但罗德岛在对外宣传中是一家专攻源石研究和矿石病治疗的制药公司，很显然，源石和矿石病两个词会令大部分人望而却步。
而哪怕抛开这一点不谈，罗德岛本身需要到处移动的性质，以及存在莱茵生命这样显然拥有更好土壤的科技公司，都导致罗德岛在人才竞争方面是相当弱势的。
更何况罗德岛并不是一家纯粹的医药公司，其实在得知罗德岛真正在做的事后选择离开的人也不在少数。
总而言之，种种因素交织的结果是，虽然可露希尔的工程部中确实聚集起了许多人才，并且我们也确实有了相当的成果，但无论是规模还是涉及领域，其实都还远远不够。可露希尔也经常在会议中抱怨相关的问题，不过她自己也知道，这确实是没有办法的情况。
在这种情况下，以温蒂为首的生物工程研究室，是可露希尔口中，难得完全不用担心的部分。

text.en:
While people have joined Rhodes Island from the various corners of Terra, a bioengineer from Iberia is a strange sight indeed. 
First, as everyone knows, Iberia has been blocked off from the rest of the world. 
Second, though completely unsubstantiated, is the idea that Iberia is some backwards and xenophobic place. 
In fact, the inverse is true. Setting aside the complicated relationship between Laterano and Ægir, Iberia is a land full of flair and friendly to scientific research, although this friendship is conditional. 
A tacit understanding exists within the scientific community that one is free to conduct whatever research they choose within certain fields; and undeniably, Iberia has made substantial achievements in these fields. However, some fields of research are completely forbidden; or perhaps more accurately, in Iberia, those fields of research do not exist. 
To do justice to the modern history behind this situation would require an entire encyclopedia's worth of writing, so I will omit that here. However, bioengineering does exist in Iberia, or Weedy would not have been able to become an expert in the field at such a young age. Naturally, this was a result of her continuing her family's research. 
Admittedly, the above description makes it sound as if Weedy is seeking asylum in Rhodes Island to escape persecution, but this is actually a necessary background explanation based upon existing intelligence. 
Weedy joined Rhodes Island simply because she no longer wanted to stay in Iberia, and wished to see more of the world. According to her own account, there were virtually no barriers to her leaving, but she was also told that it would be significantly more difficult to return to Iberia - to which she had no particular sentiments. She received an offer from Rhodes Island shortly before receiving an offer from Rhine Lab. 
Weedy is not shy about mentioning her belief that Rhine Lab is better suited to her work than Rhodes Island is, but whenever this topic is brought up, she will tack on the phrase, 'but I think Rhodes Island is pretty good too.'
Of course it is. Otherwise, she wouldn't have chosen to set foot upon the battlefield either.
text.zh:
虽然罗德岛上聚集着来自泰拉各地的人，但一个来自伊比利亚的生物工程学专家任职于罗德岛依然是一件稍微有些令人惊讶的事。
一方面，众所周知，如今的伊比利亚已经对外封锁。
而另一方面，对伊比利亚不了解的人，往往会根据一些空穴来风的印象，认为那是一片落后且闭塞的土地。
实际上恰恰相反，如果抛开和拉特兰以及阿戈尔错综复杂的关系，伊比利亚是一片有十足风情，且对科学研究相当友好的土地——虽然这个友好是有条件的。
这在科学界是一个公开的秘密：在伊比利亚，你可以在大部分领域中进行完全自由的研究，在这些领域，伊比利亚也确实有着令人侧目的成就。但某些领域的研究是完全被禁止的，或者我们应该这么说，在伊比利亚，某些方向的研究是不存在的。
有关这一点，在这里展开恐怕足够写一本字典一样厚的近现代史，因此姑且按下不表。不过，生物工程学在伊比利亚是存在的，否则温蒂也无法在这个年纪就成为这个领域的专家，这当然是继承家学的结果。
我承认上面的描述有让人以为温蒂是因为被迫害而向罗德岛寻求庇护的嫌疑，不过这些其实只是必要的背景交代，根据现有的情报。
温蒂会加入罗德岛的理由，只是她不想留在伊比利亚而出来闯荡——根据温蒂本人的描述，离开的过程中并没有受到多少阻碍，只不过她也被告知，想要再次返回伊比利亚会困难百倍，对此她似乎并没有表达出特别的情绪——并且在接到莱茵生命的offer前，先接到了罗德岛的offer而已。
温蒂并不避讳提及比起罗德岛，莱茵生命更适合她的研究这一点，但每当提到这个话题时，她总会加上一句，“但我觉得罗德岛也挺好。”
是的，否则她也不会选择踏上战场。

text.en:
Scientists who devote themselves to the study of Originium, particularly those who specialize in treating Oripathy, often find themselves at odds with other researchers because they cannot understand how their colleagues can share the same scientific spirit and yet also harbor a deep rejection of infected peoples.
In the past, experimenting upon infected persons was not considered immoral. Even now, there are no shortage of scientists who specialize in studying the Infected, but with the intention of proving through various means that they are of inferior birth or even deserving of death. 
Even in Rhodes Island, there are a number of researchers who only recently overcame their fear of the Infected, and still have not reached a point where they can address those individuals with kindness. 
If this is true even among scientists who are supposed to represent the bleeding edge of knowledge, what are we to think about the beliefs of ordinary people? Sometimes, reality can be crushingly disappointing. 
However, there are also people like Weedy. 
Her abilities would have allowed her to find a better work environment, but she chose to stay with Rhodes Island. Her only demand towards people she is communicating with is that they remain tidy, and she does not care if they are infected or not. She is not particularly talkative, but she does attempt to use her technological expertise to help people within her means, such as making small gadgets or toys for them. 
Even her reason for joining the battlefield is as simple as it is moving:
'Is there anything I can do for them? '
text.zh:
投身源石研究的科学家们，尤其是专攻矿石病治疗的科学家们，最不理解部分同行们的一点就是，明明同样是拥有科学精神的人，他们却对感染者似乎有着更为深切的排斥。
在过去，用感染者做实验并不被认为是一件不道德的事，时至今日，专门研究感染者，并试图用各种手段证明感染者天生低人一等甚至该死的科学家也不在少数。
即使在罗德岛，也有相当一部分研究者仅仅只是克服了对感染者的恐惧，有的时候就连友善相处都谈不上。
连在观念上应当是最领先时代的科学家们都是如此，那就更不要提普通人了，有的时候，现实确实会令人感到泄气。
但也有温蒂这样的存在。
她的能力完全可以让她获得更好的环境，但她留在了罗德岛。她对交流对象的要求仅仅只有保持整洁，她从来不会在意对方是否被感染。她不太与人交流，但她经常用运用自己的技术为其他人做一些力所能及的事，例如一些小玩具，小物件等等。
甚至她会踏上战场的理由也很简单，却也令人感动：
“我可不可以为他们做些什么？”

text.en:
Weedy's physical qualities are somewhat at odds with our impressions of the Ægirians. In fact, after she successfully passed the other exams, she spent an entire three months before she was able to pass the physical component. 
Other than her physical strength and endurance, her condition is completely normal, her regimented routine with extra attention to hygiene bears mention. She is arguably even healthier than most of her fellow operators. 
Therefore, instead of worrying about her, you should perhaps strive to become more like her, from this day forward.
text.zh:
作为一名阿戈尔人，温蒂的身体素质确实有违我们对阿戈尔人的印象。事实上，顺利通过其他测试的她，最终为了通过体能测试，花了整整三个月的时间。
不过除了体力和耐力方面的问题，她的身体指标一切正常，甚至应该说，作息稳定又对卫生有高要求的她，是要比大部分干员都要健康的。
所以，与其为她担忧，不如向她学习吧，就从今天开始。

value.en: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected by medical examination.

text.en:
Elysium, a Rhodes Island Operator from Iberia, mastered a rather unique form of voice-related Originium Arts. Caught trying to fill in 'Once in a lifetime hottie' on his resume profile, he was detained on the spot by members of the HR Department. 
Now deputy leader of the 3rd Special Operations Squad, Elysium is responsible for maintaining clear channels of communication on the battlefield and assisting squad members in covert operations.
text.zh:
出身伊比利亚的罗德岛干员，掌握着与声讯相关较为特殊的源石技艺，试图偷偷在自己的客观履历里写“实乃百年难得一遇的大帅哥”，被人事部录入人员当场抓获。
现于特殊行动小队三队中担任队长副手，负责维持战场通讯畅通，辅助小队成员进行秘密行动。

text.en:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of his internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in his circulatory system, confirming him to be infected with Oripathy. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 7%
A small amount of Originium crystals are present on the surface of Elysium's body. He emphatically claims that they are there for decoration, but how could anyone choose to adorn themselves so tastelessly? 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.21u/L
The current condition is stable, and effective results have been obtained through focal treatment. Follow-up treatment should be adjusted appropriately depending on the patient's actual condition. 

Elysium's condition has always been stable. Perhaps this is related to his confident, over-the-top optimism? I don't necessarily hate guys like him, but he does get on my nerves every now and then. 
—Gavial
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。 

【体细胞与源石融合率】7% 
干员极境体表可见少量源石结晶，本人强行说是装饰，怎么会有这么没品味的装饰。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.21u/L 
病症较为稳定，对病灶的控制已见一定成效，后续治疗需根据患者实际状况进行适当调整。

干员极境的病情一向很稳定，或许这和他那种自信乐观到有点过头的心态有关？我倒是不讨厌他这样的家伙，就是偶尔会有点烦。
——嘉维尔

text.en:
Although Elysium has always proclaimed that there is no way he could have been born in Iberia, he shares the characteristics of unfettered boldness and unrestrained freedom that are so prominent in that area. 
Elysium has traveled the corners of the world alone, and has been to just about any place that you or I could name, including the kind of forlorn places that his codename suggests. According to his own account, he did consider becoming a messenger prior to joining Rhodes Island, a career plan that is now on hold. 
In fact, Elysium's sense of direction is so strong that he can remember any place he's ever been to, as well as being able to mentally map out a course of action with surprising accuracy. However, the maps that he comes up with often are not cost-efficient or practical, and he sometimes has to simplify these routes to facilitate better understanding and realizability — and yet, none of this meticulousness is carried over to his daily life.
text.zh:
尽管干员极境一直声称自己与出身地伊比利亚无法相合，但在他的身上，的确存在着那一地区表现显著的无拘无束、豪爽自由等特质。
极境曾独自游历过许多地域，脚步几乎踏遍大半你我能报出名字的城市，包括正如他代号所指代的那种极地与绝境。据其本人表示，在加入罗德岛之前，他确实考虑过信使这一职业，而加入罗德岛则令他暂时搁置了这一职业规划。
事实上，干员极境的方向感非常强，他能够记忆他所去过的任何地方，并且能够在脑中勾勒出正确的行动路线。只不过，他所构建出的地图往往都需要一定的理解成本，在战场上时极境会自行简化路线以方便理解，而日常生活中他往往并不会如此贴心。

text.en:
Due to Elysium's unique utility, he is often transferred between various teams due to what the task requires. 
Generally speaking, in addition to facilitating communication within the team, Elysium's most frequent job is to coordinate interpersonal relationships and arbitrate conflict. He values the relationships between team members far more than Operators who prefer to work alone; therefore, any conflict between members is the last thing he wants to see. 
Elysium's mere presence during a mission is enough to improve a team's morale and facilitate a more relaxed atmosphere. Though he often fails to recognize his own contribution in maintaining the harmony of a team, he always manages to elicit some very memorable reactions. When operators with clashing personalities have to be assigned to the same team due to special circumstances, the operation leader will often consider adding Elysium to keep the operation moving forward smoothly.
text.zh:
由于干员极境所担任的职能较为特殊，时常会因任务需要而被调动到各个小队。
一般来说，极境在队伍中除掌握通讯外，最常做的工作往往是协调人际关系与仲裁。他对同伴的重视远超许多更加喜欢单打独斗的干员，因此，小队成员之间起争执是他最不愿意见到的事情。
在执行任务的过程中，极境的存在会使队伍中的氛围更加轻松活跃。尽管许多时候，极境本人并没能意识到自己为团队的和谐作出了多大的贡献，但他的确总能引起一些独特的反应。每当因为遭遇一些特殊情况，而不得不将一些性格不是那样合拍的干员编入同一小队时，为确保任务的顺利推进，行动的负责人会考虑让极境也加入其中。

text.en:
'Elysium and I joined at roughly the same time, so I know a few things about him. 
There might be people out there who are inclined to believe that he doesn't work hard or take his responsibilities seriously because of his somewhat irreverent, joking tone. 
But we've all come to realize that this is but another form of humility. A Special Ops team's line of work can be very dangerous, and Elysium's role during these operations is sometimes even more important. The transmission device he carries with him needs to be paired with his Originium Arts in order to achieve the greatest effect, and the tacit synergy between Elysium and his direct superior can sometimes be the key to victory. 
To say that his job is to provide courage itself is, in my opinion, not an exaggeration. But this courage is not the flag-waving kind that gets people riled up before they charge off to war, but rather something more practical. 
When operators such as Elysium are present on the battlefield, the commander can better focus on understanding the overall situation, and individual operators can fight with the peace of mind that the operation plan is being executed. Some special operations even hinge on the state.' 
—Dobermann
text.zh:
“我和极境是差不多时间加入的，对他还算有所了解。
或许会有人因为他不正经的玩笑语气而相信他所说的话，类似说自己并不辛苦，或者他的职责并不怎么重要之类的。
但我们都应当认识到，这只不过是一类谦辞。特殊小队的工作有时会相当危险，而极境本人所承担的职能更是至关重要，他所携带的发信装置需要配合他所使用的源石技艺，才能发挥出最大的功效，极境本人与其队长之间的默契配合，有时甚至能够成为我们胜利的关键。
说他的工作是带来勇气，我个人认为也并不为过。但是这种勇气，不是指那种挥舞旗子给大家带来战意上的鼓舞，而是更加实际的东西。
只有如极境这样的干员在战场上活跃，我们的指挥官才能够更好地把控全局，干员们才能安心战斗，无后顾之忧，一些特殊的作战计划，才能得以实现。”
——杜宾

text.en:
Elysium has his own unique criteria for determining whether someone is trustworthy. 
In the entirety of Rhodes Island, the person who Elysium trusts most is the leader of the 3rd Squad to which he is also assigned, and these sentiments are reciprocated. It can be said that the duo's unbreakable trust is a product of their ability to fit together in all aspects, as well as years of cultivating their relationship. 
As the captain of one of Rhodes Island's special squads, the leader has a very special ability. This ability often provides unexpected and valuable effects in combat, but poses a hindrance in daily life. Only through Elysium's assistance is the leader able to normally communicate with others, and this responsibility may perhaps be the reason why Elysium chose to stay in Rhodes Island. 

'Even though it seems like he's always getting smacked around, they're actually on very good terms.' 
'Smacked around? Is the leader of the 3rd Squad such a vicious person?' 
'Hmm, I wouldn't say that. The leader's actually an introverted person, despite trying to maintain a cool and calm appearance... Whatever happens, it's usually because Elysium is such a pain in the ass!' 
—Conversation between a member of the 3rd Squad and a member of the HR Department

Once Elysium has recognized someone as reliable, he will display his trust in his own special way, which may manifest in the form of nonsensical dialogue, or through increasingly preposterous bets. In this regard, 'comrade' has a very special meaning for Elysium, and this is not a term that he uses lightly. 
Taking everything in consideration, none can deny that Elysium is an excellent teammate and a reliable partner on the battlefield, even if he can be a bit annoying.
text.zh:
在什么样的人值得信任这一问题上，干员极境有他自己独到的判断基准。
整个罗德岛内，他最信任的人毫无疑问是其所属的第三小队的队长，而对方显然也是如此。可以说，这份牢不可破的信赖关系与二人在各方面契合的能力、以及积年累月的相处磨合分不开关系。
作为罗德岛内部特殊小队的队长，第三小队领队人的自身能力本就极为特别，在作战时往往能够发挥意想不到的可贵功效，但这份能力在其日常生活中却成为了一种阻碍，只有通过极境的辅助，第三小队领队才能够与他人正常沟通，而极境或许也正是因为身上担负着这样的职责，才最终选择留在了罗德岛。

“虽然他似乎一直在挨打，但是能看出来他们关系的确很好。”
“挨打？第三小队队长这么凶的吗？”
“呃，倒也不是，虽然看上去很酷很冷静，但队长其实可内向了……会挨打，完全是极境那家伙自己太烦人的问题啦！”
——第三小队某队员与人事部干员之间的交谈

一旦被极境认定为可靠，他便会以自己的方式来展现自己对于对方的信赖，具体可能会表现为对话中的废话越说越多，或是打赌时的赌约越来越傻。在此基础上，“战友”这一称呼，对于极境来说则拥有更为特殊的意义，并不是能够轻易被使用的词语。
不论如何，从来没有人能够否认，除去有点烦人这一点外，极境在战场上是一个很好的队友，一个可靠的搭档。

text.en:
How high does he want to get promoted? 
If that position would put him above the squad's captain, Elysium would turn down that opportunity.
text.zh:
还要往哪里晋升？
如果要他越过队长，极境本人是不会同意的。

text.en: Former trading company employee, responsible for logistical technology R&D along with transport route planning. Unfortunately infected with Oripathy due to an incident in a sandstorm during the course of her work. Holds a post at the Rhodes Island Medical Department on introduction from her previous employer, simultaneously undergoing necessary treatment for Oripathy.
text.zh: 前贸易公司员工，负责后勤技术研发及运输路线规划。因为一场货运途中的沙暴事故，不幸感染矿石病。经原公司介绍，来到罗德岛医疗部门供职，同时进行必要的矿石病治疗。

text.en:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 7%
Some mild crystallization visible on the surface of the Operator's body, concentrated on the back and abdomen.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.29u/L
Operator was exposed to a high amount of constituent Originium within a short amount of time. Her situation itself is quite precarious; fortunately, discovery and treatment were both very prompt, and her present condition is stable. Her ensuing course of treatment will aim to further lower her internal blood Originium-crystal density levels.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】7%
该干员体表有少量源石结晶分布，多集中在背部与腹部。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.29u/L
该干员在短时间内接触到了大量源石成分，情况本身相当危险，所幸发现和治疗都很及时，目前病情稳定，下一阶段治疗目标是进一步将她体内的血液源石结晶密度压低。

text.en:
When Tuye had just come to Rhodes Island, and passed Human Resources' comprehensive interdepartmental assessments, she was an outstanding candidate for the Engineering Department.
However, on the day she was set to report to Engineering, we received an emergency mission. As the Medical Department was short-staffed that day, Tuye, possessing relevant aptitude, dove in impromptu to give critical and urgent care to operators returning aboard. Following, several senior operators from Medical gave high assessments of her emergency response capacity, and all agreed that though she wasn't proficient in healing Arts, her diverse fluency in the usage of tools—and her grasp on medical knowledge from years of work safeguarding transport logistics in the hostile wilds—qualified her to work as a Medic operator.
Upon notice of her transfer, Tuye had no complaints whatsoever, which was somewhat unexpected. Of course, we personally don't believe 'Closure furiously making for the Medical Department and starting a war of words with a section of its operators' needs to be recorded in detail for this file.
text.zh:
刚刚来到罗德岛的图耶小姐，在经过人事部门和各个部门的综合评估之后，曾经被视作前去工程部门的上佳人选。
然而，就在她将要前去工程部门报到的那天，我们接到了一个紧急任务。由于当天医疗部门的人手不够，具有相关资质的图耶小姐也临时参与到了对回舰干员的紧张救治当中。经此事件，医疗部门的一众资深干员对她的应急处理能力做出高度评价，大家一致认为，虽然图耶小姐并不精通治疗法术，但是凭她对各种器械原理的了解、以及多年最危险的野外运输后勤保障工作带来的对医疗知识的掌握，她足以胜任医疗干员的工作。
对此调任通知，图耶小姐并没有任何异议，这一点稍稍有些出乎意料。当然，之后可露希尔小姐气冲冲地赶来医疗部门、与部分医疗干员发生言语冲突的详细经过，个人认为并不需要在这份档案中记录。

text.en:
Tuye has little in common with typical Forte. Her body displays none of the sturdiness of her race, and Oripathy is not the sole reason. Taking into account her constant seclusion in her room, her aversion to exercise, her lack of a strict three meals and her accompanying intake of overly sugary or salty snacks, the fact that she still just about met physical exam standards is owed to some of her innate ability.
Meanwhile, her social relations are also close to none. She regularly refuses other operators' invitations and doesn't participate in any group activities; she only occasionally pays visits to certain operators' laboratories. Prior to her visiting, she pays absolutely no mind to giving any notice. It's fortunate that these laboratories' owners don't tend to pick bones with 'impolite' manners, focusing entirely on the work at hand. Compared to chatting civilities, they're much more about storming up the perfect bright idea.
The one thing Tuye doesn't lack in that respect is bright ideas—whether reflected in her invention-tinkering ingenuity, or her occasional whim for pranks.
text.zh:
图耶小姐并不是很像常见的丰蹄。她的身体并没有她的同族那般健壮，这不仅仅是由于矿石病的缘故。考虑到她常常躲在房间里，不爱运动，三餐也不规律，同时摄入了过度高糖或者高盐零食，她的体检结果还能在勉强合格的程度，这或许已经用上了一定的天赋。
与此同时，她的社交关系也趋近于无。她经常拒绝其他干员的邀约，不参与任何集体活动，只偶尔会光顾某些干员的实验室。而在到访之前，她也并没有自己需要打招呼的意识。好在这些实验室的主人往往也不计较这些看似“不礼貌”的举止，他们专注于手头的工作，比起客套的闲谈，更欢迎恰到好处的奇思妙想。
而图耶小姐最不缺的就是奇思妙想——无论是体现在鼓捣发明的巧思上，还是在偶尔进行的对她感兴趣的人的恶作剧上。

text.en:
She's not as unreasonable as others say.
I admit, when I first worked with her, I thought working with her was a nightmare too. Work often demanded that our department check in with her for transport routes; everyone pushed that off on everyone else, to the point we'd have to draw lots to decide who went to find her. The unlucky sap was always me. Every time I went off, I'd get keyed up like nothing else, scared I'd earn her contempt if I did a single thing wrong.
Afterwards... the incident. This sandstorm came especially rough. It wasn't her fault; desert weather's always changed faces on a whim. We were trapped in our transport car with the engine out, and I thought my own time was up. Stuck somewhere like that, to tell you the truth, nobody could make it out.
Then she came. She seriously pushed through the sandstorm, catching up with us from all the way back at the base. It was just her.
She brought water and nutritional fluid. We survived.
'Forcing me all this way to save your lives? I'm a logistics worker. You guys are beyond useless,' she was complaining, but she was so patient as she helped us fix our engine.
Afterwards, a very long time afterwards, work needed me to find her again, and I discovered she was long since gone.
I asked around as hard as I could. Only then did I learn she caught Oripathy. I know it, clear as day, it was because of that sandstorm, wasn't it? Nobody could stick their head into a storm like that and come out unscathed. The boss wasn't willing to tell me. Probably because she didn't want me to know.
I've heard she's posted at your company now, so I couldn't help writing this. You don't need to pass this letter on to her. I just wanted to tell you, having someone venerable as her on your staff, a colleague cute as her, you're all very lucky.

—Letter sent by Operator Tuye's former coworker.
text.zh:
她并没有别人说的那么不近人情。 
我承认，最早与她共事时候，我也以为她很难相处。因为工作需要，我们部门常常要找她确认运输路线，他们总是互相推诿，最后要靠抽签才能决定谁去找她。那个倒霉蛋总是我。每次去找她，我的心情都会变得很紧张，生怕自己出一点错，招来她的一通鄙夷。 
后来……那次事故。沙尘暴来得特别猛烈。这一点都不怪她，沙漠里的天气永远瞬息万变。我们被困在发动机失灵的运输车里，我以为自己一定是完蛋了。那样的环境，说真的，没人能挺过去。 
然后她来了。她竟然顶着风沙，从很远的基地里一路赶了过来。只有她一个人。 
她带来了水和营养液。我们活了下来。 
“必须让我这个做后勤的跑这么远来救命，你们真是太没用了。”她一边这么抱怨着，一边很耐心地陪我们修好了发动机。 
后来，到了很后来的时候，我再因为工作需要去找她，却发现她已经不在了。 
我很努力地打听，才知道她得了矿石病。我心里很清楚，就是因为那次风沙吧？没人能一头扎进那样的沙尘里还能好好的。老板不肯告诉我，大概是因为她不希望我们知道。 
我听说她现在在贵公司供职，所以忍不住写了这些话。这封信不需要转交给她，我只是想告诉你们，拥有这样一位可敬的员工、这样一位可爱的同事，你们是多么幸运。 

——某位图耶干员前同事寄来的信

text.en:
There is no rain in the desert.
Tuye always carries an umbrella with her. Even aboard the ship, that doesn't change. A lot of operators are curious about the umbrella, but don't dare ask Tuye about it.
Perhaps this photograph sent from her mother and father can offer some clues. The Tuye in the picture is considerably younger than the present; perhaps only three or four years old. As we can see, the scene in the photo should be of her home. She's tucked entirely under the umbrella, holding some components in her arms. They are clearly Columbian-produced parts she has in a pile, assembled to imitate all sorts of items—some like chairs, some like beds.
From a developmental psychology perspective, many children have this same tendency—treating the space under an umbrella as an independent space, a home of just their own. This can be because the parents are overly busy, caring insufficiently for these children, and so cause them to feel lonely. For this reason, they seek a smaller, more controllable space, where they only need to get along with themselves. My belief is that Tuye is one such case.
Nowadays, she still carries this umbrella. Perhaps, and I do mean perhaps, she considers the cover of the umbrella to be her home, just as before. Could a person entice her to come out from underneath? I don't know about anyone else. But in my belief, the person reading this file now, in whom all of Rhodes Island has placed their unwavering trust, certainly can.
text.zh:
沙漠里并没有雨。 
图耶小姐却始终随身带着一把雨伞，就连在船上也不例外。有许多干员对她的这把伞感兴趣，又不敢去问图耶小姐这把伞的故事。 
这张从图耶小姐父母那里寄来的照片或许能提供一些线索。照片上的图耶小姐比现在还要小许多，或许只有三四岁。就像我们能看到的那样，照片上的场景应该就是她的家，她整个人都躲在那柄伞下，手里抱着许多零件。那些一看就是哥伦比亚出品的零件被她堆得满满的，搭得有模有样，有的像椅子，有的像床铺。 
从发展心理学角度来说，许多小孩都会在童年时期有这个倾向——他们会把伞下的空间当成一个独立空间，一个只属于自己的家。这可能是因为父母过于忙碌，对这些孩子疏于照顾，导致他们感到了孤独，所以才想要一个更小、更能掌控的空间，只需要自己同自己相处。我想，图耶小姐应该也是这样。 
现在她依然带着这把伞。或许，我是说或许，对如今的她来说，她依然固执地认为伞下的空间才是家。有人能让她从伞下走出来吗？别人我不清楚。可是我想，那个正在阅读这份档案、被船上的各位毫无保留地信任着的人，一定可以。

text.en:
What, she pranked you? Congrats, that means you're in!
I mean, if you weren't, she'd treat you like air.
Well, duh, if I had to choose. Look. Either I get knocked out suddenly and tied to the testbed, getting a checkup while one of the big bosses lectures me, like I'm getting scanned inside and out by a computer with no heart. Or I get Tuye—uh, Dr. Tuye, who I think is obviously a way better option.
So, basically, you know the drill. Take care of your health, don't get injured, don't take a trip to Medical. That's the most important thing!

—Thoughts of a Guard Operator who ranks top in frequency of visits
text.zh:
什么，她对你恶作剧了？恭喜你，她显然把你当成了她的朋友！
如果不是朋友的话，她根本会把你当空气啊。
当然咯，非要我选的话，比起突然被打晕绑上试验台、一边看病一边被最大的BOSS之一训话、像被无情的电脑一样扫描自己的里里外外，我觉得图耶小姐——呃，图耶医生，真的是个很不错的选择了。
所以说，还是要注意身体，不要受伤，不要去医疗部才是最重要的啊！

——某出勤频率高居榜首的近卫干员的心声

value.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

text.en:
Operator Absinthe, one of the Ursus civilians rescued in the Chernobog incident, voluntarily applied to join Rhodes Island. 
After receiving a series of tests and undergoing training, she was approved to join an operational squad as a Caster Operator, while also providing services within the ship such as patrolling.
text.zh:
干员苦艾，切尔诺伯格事件中被救助的乌萨斯平民之一，自愿申请加入罗德岛。
在接受了一系列测试与培训后，被批准作为术师干员加入作战小队，同时也提供舰内巡逻等相关服务。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Absinthe has no signs of Originium infections. 
Being able to keep herself safe in situations like those means that her abilities must be solid enough, in addition to having the devil's luck. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.14u/L
Operator Absinthe had been exposed to an Originium-dense region for weeks prior to boarding, and extra attention must paid to potential virulence.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员苦艾没有被源石感染的迹象。
在那样的情况下能够保全自身安全，这说明她的确能力不弱，并且运气不差。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.14u/L
干员苦艾在登舰前的数周之内，一直身处十分危险的源石环境中，需时刻关注其是否出现感染倾向。

text.en:
A survivor of the Chernobog-Lungmen incident and daughter of a local policeman, Absinthe, following her onboarding, described in detail Chernobog's gradual descent into chaos under Reunion's occupation. According to her account, Reunion's attack came very suddenly. The local police force, as the basic unit of security in the city, could barely maintain order and evacuate the crowds even at the beginning. But as the situation worsened and the Catastrophe arrived, the line of defense was torn down, with violence and panic engulfing the entire city like a wildfire. 
The Ursursians who remained struggled amidst the despair to cling to their lives, working together with a small team of local police officers after the Catastrophe. In a short period of time, this group went from initially trying to maintain order and protect civilians, to a state of being unable to fend for themselves, even stealing food to survive. When Rhodes Island's rescue team found Absinthe, she was laying on her back amidst a heap of rubble, alone and dying from hunger. If the rescue team showed up any later, there is no saying what would have happened to her. Perhaps not even her body would have been left in place. 

Through the entire crisis, the survivors trapped in the city waited for the arrival of those tasked with protecting them, but help never arrived.
text.zh:
作为切尔诺伯格-龙门事件的幸存者，以及本地警察的女儿，在登上舰船后，苦艾向我们描述了在整合运动的占领下，切尔诺伯格逐步陷入混乱的过程。据她讲述，整合运动的袭击来得十分突然，作为城市内的基础安全保障系统，当地警力在最开始时，还能勉强维持秩序，疏散人群。但随着局势的发酵以及天灾的到来，这层防线最终被冲垮，暴力与恐慌开始在整座城中大规模蔓延。
置身此地的乌萨斯人无一不在绝望之中挣扎求生，苦艾本人在天灾后与一小队当地警察共同行动，在这段时间里，他们从最初的试图维持秩序、保护平民，到之后的无力自保，甚至要抢夺食物才能勉强生存，这个过程并没有耗费多少时间。当罗德岛的救援队伍找到苦艾时，她仰面躺在废墟中，只有她一个人，因饥饿而奄奄一息。如果救援再来迟一些，谁也不敢猜测这个女孩会有怎样的结局，或许连尸体都不会被留在原地。

被困在这座城市的幸存者们，从始至终，都没有等到本该保护他们的军队到来。

text.en:
During the time she was training and taking exams, Absinthe's performance satisfied all of Instructor Dobermann's standards. She may not have been gifted with great athleticism or combat acumen, but her tenacity coupled with the basic training she had received helped her quickly grow into a qualified operator. However, her lackadaisical attitude towards getting injured during training and exceedingly cavalier lifestyle habits are causes for concern. 
The medical department's assessment shows that Absinthe's mental health markers are troubling; she views many issues with significant pessimism, and also displays degrees of self-loathing and self-destructive tendencies. This Ursus girl rarely seeks to establish personal agency in her daily life, instead subconsciously trying to help others around her. However, at the same time, she belittles her own actions to the point of even negating whatever results she may have achieved, a behavior that, in the eyes of the medic operators, is very concerning. 
Another important issue to bring up is the strong concerns raised by the Ursus Student Self-government Group. Before joining Rhodes Island, Absinthe knew nothing about the members of the Self-Governing Group, and vice versa. It is unclear why Absinthe now pays so much attention to their activities, and she is unwilling to talk about the matter. These anomalous behaviors may have something to do with her past experiences in Peterheim Middle School. We can surmise that there must be some undiscovered facts regarding the time she spent there. 
Under the premise that this status will not cause damage to Rhodes Island, related background investigations have been temporarily suspended out of respect for Operator Absinthe.
text.zh:
在接受训练与测试期间，苦艾在各方面的表现都令作为教官的杜宾感到满意。她或许并不是天生身体素质与战斗意识都绝佳的那一类战士，但苦艾本身坚韧执着的性格，以及其曾经接受过的一些基础训练，都帮助她快速成长为一名合格的干员。但是这种在训练时就算受伤也从不叫苦，日常生活中对自身过于随意、不关心的态度，多少也令人对其状态感到担忧。
医疗部门的评测显示，苦艾的精神状态并不乐观，她在许多问题上表现得十分消极，并且展示出了一定程度的自我苛责与自毁倾向。这个乌萨斯女孩在日常中很少有明确的自我主张，她会下意识地保护身边的人，但同时又会贬低自己的行为，甚至会将自己取得的成果全盘否定，在医疗人员看来，这种表现无疑是非常糟糕的。
另一个值得在意的问题点是，苦艾对于乌萨斯学生自治团成员表现出了强烈的关注。在登上罗德岛之前，她与自治团成员互不相识，为何如此关注学生自治团的原因不明，苦艾本人也对此闭口不谈。种种反常表现或许与其过去经历有关，围绕彼得海姆中学，我们可以确定一定还有一些未曾被发掘的事实。
在判断其状态并不会为罗德岛带来损害的前提下，出于对干员苦艾本人的尊重，相关背景调查暂时被叫停。

text.en:
The attack on Chernobog was a key component of Reunion's plans. They plotted in secret, completely catching the city off guard when they struck. Before Chernobog's residents realized what was going on, much of the city had already been occupied. 
We can reconstruct an account of what happened in the incident's aftermath based upon oral narratives from survivors. Reunion's leaders partitioned the city and controlled different zones, with certain zones being controlled more strictly than others. In certain places, people could remain unharmed as long as they stayed behind closed doors. But many citizens in other areas were not so lucky... You already know what I mean by that. Certain Reunion leaders encouraged the Infected to 'claim their legitimate rights,' which is a euphemism for allowing gratuitous violence. When an excessively emotional catharsis morphs into hivemind behavior, one can imagine the kind of disaster that would ensue.
Police? Compared to the sheer number of Infected who had given in to fanaticism, the amount of peace officers and military police simply was too small. While they were better equipped and trained than the average Reunion rioter, that alone was not sufficient, and the following Catastrophe tore through what little defenses were left in the city. The Chernobog police continued to send backup requests to the garrison during this time, but judging from the results, such attempts were futile. 

How did that girl stay alive in those conditions until the time she was rescued? What kind of things did she have to go through? 
I won't ask her to answer those questions. I can see that she's doing well enough with us, and despite her doubts and anxieties, she's making an effort to understand what happened in the past and shake off the lingering effects of those events. I even saw her trying to make friends, to try to be more inviting and to not push others away. This is no easy feat, and it is also a good sign. There's no way we could heartlessly pry open those wounds. We all need to be more cautious and circumspect when dealing with people who have suffered through disasters. If she is willing to open up, then we shall listen. As for right now, she has already done enough. 

—Transcript of conversation with Archives Department's logistics operator
text.zh:
袭击切尔诺伯格是整合运动计划好的关键一步，他们在暗中谋划许久，打了这座城市一个措手不及，很多街区直到被占领，里面的人都还没有回过神。
我们可以从事后幸存者的口述中还原当时的情况，整合运动的干部分管不同的区域，一些地区受到严格管控，人们只要闭门不出，就可以免遭侵害。但另一些区域的市民，就没有那么幸运……你知道我在说什么，有一些整合运动的干部放纵甚至鼓励感染者们去“争取正当的权益”，说白了，在那时候，暴力是被允许的，当过激的情绪宣泄演变成集体行为，可以想象那是怎样一场灾难。
警察？和陷入狂热情绪的感染者比起来，警察和军警的人数还是太少了，他们的确比大多数整合暴徒都更加装备精良，更加训练有素，但仅仅是这样仍然不够，随后而来的天灾更是将城市内的防线撕得四分五裂。切尔诺伯格的警方在此期间一直持续向驻军发送讯号寻求支援，但从结果来看，这种努力是徒劳的。

那个女孩是怎么在这样的状况下活着等到救援的？她都经历了什么？
我不会去问她这种问题，我能看出她在我们这里过得不错，我看到她有疑问，有动摇，但至少有在努力尝试理解过去发生的事，努力去摆脱那些事情对她自己的影响。我甚至看到她在试着去交朋友，她开始没有那么排斥他人的接近了，这是好事，这很不容易。我们不能冷酷地去质问。对待这些蒙受灾难的人，我们都需要更加谨慎，更加小心。如果她愿意说，那就听。至少现在，这样就足够了。

——与档案部后勤干员的交谈记录

text.en:
The vast majority of rescued Chernobog refugees will, after a short resting period, stay with relatives or friends, or to go elsewhere to live alone. After that, Rhodes Island operators will escort them to their chosen destinations so that they may start a new life. At the same time, some of the refugees will end up staying with Rhodes Island for a variety of reasons. 
Absinthe's parents were confirmed to have passed away during the Chernobog incident. When the logistics operator confirmed other kinship ties with Absinthe, the latter rejected the offer to be sent to another city and voluntarily applied to join Rhodes Island. Without a doubt, what she had experienced during the last month had driven her to make this decision. 
The devastation wrought by Reunion's occupation, the destruction caused by the Catastrophe, and the ugly face of today's complex conflicts - all of these may have well played a role. As the turmoil continued, a shortage of food and drinking water turned these conflicts into something much simpler and more primal. Whether Infected or not, status mattered little when the only thing that remained was a cruel struggle for basic necessities. 

The Medical Department has been closely monitoring the mental health of all survivors of the Chernobog-Lungmen incident. Unlike the members of the Ursus Student Self-government Group who also escaped from Chernobog, Absinthe's depression and pain takes on a much more direct manner. She rarely shows a real smile, and very few people are able to approach her. More often then not, Absinthe chooses to stay far away from others and maintain a subdued silence. Nevertheless, Absinthe has already helped many people; she may be taciturn, but she is undoubtedly reliable. Perhaps Absinthe views her own actions as trivial and insignificant, but we believe that kindness begets kindness and eagerly look forward to Absinthe's future development. 
Just like the hair that she cut herself, perhaps only time can heal her scars.
text.zh:
绝大多数被救助的切尔诺伯格市民，会在短时间的停留之后选择投奔亲朋，或独自去别处谋生，届时他们将由罗德岛的各位干员分批护送前往各自选定的城市，在那里展开新的生活。与此同时，也会有一些被救助者出于种种不同的缘由，最终留在罗德岛。
干员苦艾的双亲已经确认于切尔诺伯格的动荡中离世，在后勤干员向其确认其他亲属关系时，苦艾拒绝了前往其他城市的建议，主动申请加入罗德岛。而驱使她做出这样选择的，毫无疑问是她在过去一个月中的那些见闻。
不仅仅是整合运动的侵占与破坏，天灾直接摧毁了建筑、街道，同时也摧毁了明面上的种种对立关系。在动乱后期，食品与饮用水的短缺使得对立转化为更加直白原始的模式，不分感染与否，不论敌方还是己方，那里仅剩的就是围绕生存资源展开的残酷争斗。

医疗部一直密切关注所有切尔诺伯格-龙门事件幸存者的精神状态，与同样自切尔诺伯格逃生的乌萨斯学生自治团成员不同，干员苦艾的忧郁与痛苦展现得更加直接，她很少真正展露笑容，很少有人能够让她放下戒备主动亲近，更多时候，干员苦艾选择保持带着压抑的沉默，远离他人。尽管如此，干员苦艾也已经帮助了许多人，她沉默寡言，但却坚实可靠。也许在苦艾本人看来，她所做的都是些不足一提的小事，但善意唤来善意，对于干员苦艾今后的发展，我们始终怀抱一份期望。
就同被她自己亲手割断的头发一样，或许只有时间，才能治愈这片伤痕。

text.en:
Even though her words were filled with confusion, as if everything she knew to be true was faltering, she never let go of the equipment she inherited from her father.
That pure idealism, a belief in the beauty of justice and protecting those in need, has never truly been sullied, even despite being dragged through veritable hell.
text.zh:
尽管言语中充斥茫然，曾经所相信的都摇摇欲坠，但继承自父亲的装备，她却从来没有真正松开手。
那个单纯美好，关于正义与保护的信念，就算亲眼见过最糟的现实，她也从来没有真正放下过。
