text.en:
Ch'en, former Lungmen superintendent and former head of the L.G.D.'s Special Inspection Unit, graduated from the Victorian Royal Guard Academy with superb marks and outstanding achievements. During her time with the Department, she cracked down on crime, fought violent offenders, tracked down armed fugitives, and brought down international criminals.
Having resigned from the L.G.D., she is now officially a member of Rhodes Island. In accordance with her wishes, she is mainly assigned to provide field operators adequate support and on-location guidance.
text.zh:
陈，前龙门高级警司，前龙门近卫局特别督察组组长，毕业于维多利亚皇家近卫学校，成绩优异，表现突出。在龙门近卫局供职期间，力主取缔龙门境内非法活动，对抗暴力犯罪和有组织犯罪，追缉武装逃犯与国际重犯等行动，并取得多项重大成果。
现辞去职务，正式成为罗德岛的一员。依本人意愿，任务多以外派为主，为各地外派干员提供有力支援以及现场指导。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 4%
Small amounts of Originium crystals have begun to appear on Operator Ch'en's body.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.18u/L
Although Ch'en contracted Oripathy relatively early and has not received adequate treatment, thanks to her newly-formed extremely methodical lifestyle habits, Oripathy does not seem to have a significant impact on her health.


I was wondering what's the big deal when they told me Lungmen confiscated Ch'en's physical report. Turns out it was no big deal at all. Lame.
—Medic Operator Warfarin
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】4%
干员陈体表已经出现较少源石结晶分布。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.18u/L
干员陈虽然感染矿石病时间较早，也没有接受过足够完善的应对处置，但由于其非常规律的生活作息和生活习惯，矿石病并没有对她的身体造成太大影响。


以前找不到陈的体检报告听说被龙门拿去的时候我还以为有多大的秘密，结果这么普通，没劲。
——医疗干员华法琳

text.en:
Ch'en really caught everyone by surprise when she came back from her holiday with that special gun of hers.
What's even more of a surprise is how, after that, she's been showing up at the sniper operators' training grounds. Goes to show how serious she is.
The reason she chose to do this isn't anything that complicated either. She is trying to improve in a different area.
In principle, Rhodes Island asks its operators to work on their existing talents first. However, we certainly are not against someone like Ch'en trying to explore her own potential when she has already mastered her first skillset.
That said, there was a little interlude to our weapon tuning process for Ch'en.
Per her personal account, the firearm that Tequila provided for her in Dossoles is geared for mid-range firing. In Laterano, it would be classified as an assault rifle. Her time with the firearm in Dossoles has convinced her that this attack style does not suit her. So, after a week of fiddling and watching our operators from Laterano use their firearms, she came up with this idea—She will use a shotgun for close quarters combat and explosives for mid- and long-range attacks.
I have to say, in a way, it's just like Ch'en to choose such a combat style. Compared to the swordsmanship that she is used to, this method of combat is even cruder. In addition, although Ch'en has a solid foundation, compared to other Sniper operators, her shooting can hardly be called exemplary. As a result, her Combat Skill evaluation on her exams has taken a slight hit. Ch'en doesn't mind, however. After all, she likely chose this weapon because she wanted a more effective way of fighting. Besides, in the words of one of the instructors who supervised her exam:
'It feels bad knowing she's actually much stronger without her gun.'
text.zh:
当陈带着她的特制铳从度假中归来时，所有人都被她吓了一跳。
而更令人吃惊的，则是在那之后，她居然出现在了狙击干员的训练场。这意味着，她是认真的。
而她选择这么做的理由也并不复杂，尝试在其他方向上提升自己。
罗德岛原则上希望干员们首先更加精进自己已有的技能，但是像陈这样已经在自己原本技能上拥有相当造诣的干员，我们自然不会反对她对于自身可能性的探索。
不过，为陈调试武器的过程也有一些插曲。
根据本人描述，在多索雷斯期间，龙舌兰为她提供的特制铳是偏向中距离攻击的，用拉特兰的分类来说，属于突击步枪，而在逗留多索雷斯期间的使用过程中，她认为这种进攻模式并不适合自己。于是，在经过长达一周的摸索与磨合，以及参考拉特兰干员们对铳的运用后，确定了现在的方案——近距离的霰弹枪模式，以及中远距离的轰炸攻击。
不得不说，某种意义上，是颇为符合陈行事风格的选择。当然，由于这种战斗方式本身相较于陈所学剑法要更为粗放，同时，在狙击干员中，陈的射击技术虽然扎实，却很难说出类拔萃，这也使得综合测试中，她的战斗技巧一栏评价稍逊过去。对此，陈并不在意，毕竟，她会选择这种武器，恐怕本就是为了追求一种更有效率的战斗方式，而且，用一位当时负责测试的教官的话来说的话，就是：
“要是我知道这个人放下铳之后反而更厉害，那我一定很难受。”

text.en:
Thanks to the events that transpired at Chernobog, Ch'en, then a Lungmen police officer, has managed to leave everyone at Rhodes Island a fairly strong impression. Not only was she a core participant in the incident, but she was also intimately connected to Talulah. This is why most operators had a hard time figuring out how to approach her when she formally joined.
Ch'en certainly seems to be well aware of this herself, though she did not attempt to rectify it in anyway, at least not when she first came on board. More accurately, she didn't think there was anything about her that needed changing. After all, she was always put in charge of the missions she was assigned naturally, and she always did a great job there, too. Besides, given that she requested to be mainly assigned to field operations—she joined Rhodes Island because she wanted to follow us and see the world, after all—this didn't pose much of a problem.
Nonetheless, most operators agree that Ch'en has changed since she came back from Dossoles. This change is hard to describe; it's not a change in personality or style. It's just that, on the whole, Ch'en seems to be a little easier to get along with now.
text.zh:
由于在切城事件前后，当时尚为龙门警官的陈给罗德岛上下带来了相当深刻的印象，并且她本人又是切城事件的核心参与者，还和塔露拉有十分密切的关系，以至于她正式作为干员加入罗德岛时，不少人对于如何与她相处始终抱有一些疑问。
陈对于这件事有所自觉，但至少在加入罗德岛最初的一段时间，她无意于去改变这一点，或者说，她并不认为这一点需要改变，因为她总是会自然而然地接过任务中的主导位置，并且做得很好。而且，由于她加入罗德岛的初衷之一是跟随罗德岛去四处看一看，并主动申请任务以外勤为主，因而这一点并没有引发什么问题。
不过，当她从多索雷斯回来后，不少干员都认为感觉陈有些改变，这种变化很难描述，因为这并不是说陈的性格或者行事风格发生了改变，只是从总体上来说，陈似乎变得好相处了一些。

text.en:
[Classified Log]
Doctor, I have a favor I would like to ask.
Because of my responsibilities, I can't visit Rhodes Island often, and you are a very dependable person, so you are the only one whom I can turn to.
It's actually very simple, but the reason behind it is a little complicated, so I am afraid this letter is going to be a long one.
I am certain that you already know about her trip to Dossoles. Thanks to Bolívar's unique circumstances and the political might of the city's mayor, Miss Candela Sanchez, Dossoles has become a truly unique city that stands out from its peers across the world.
I'm certain you've noticed this yourself, but after her holiday there, Ch'en has clearly changed
It's been over half a year since everything that went down in Chernobog, and her trip has lasted almost just as long. I'm guessing that, during her journey with Rhodes Island, she's probably come to truly understand that she can't realize the objective she once had all by herself. But what of it? My guess is that she knew this in her heart before that as well. The only difference is that she probably didn't think the world was so terrible.
It was her time in Dossoles that really opened her eyes.
Ch'en has of course seen some bad things, but things can only get so bad in Lungmen when Chief Wei runs the place. Dossoles showed her that things can get much worse than she ever imagined. She found out for herself that this isn't something she can do much about.
What can she do, then?
Doctor, here's a sentence that I once read in a book, and it's fairly interesting: 'When the environment we live in leaves much to be desired, how could we say that we ourselves are good?'
I'm not saying Ch'en had the wrong idea or was going about it the wrong way. She was right, but the world isn't nearly as beautiful a place as she thought.
I'm not saying I want her to be like me either. As a matter of fact, I don't want her to be like me, but at the very least, I want her to at least understand that tactfulness is not the same thing as maturity, and that the turmoils of this world do not mean that everything is so harsh. She's not afraid of the shadows, but if everything is really so clear cut that they are either out in the light or in the shadows, then most people wouldn't be so afraid. A swamp that you can't pluck yourself out of is far scarier than a cliff from which you can't see the bottom.
Ch'en will need to take that step, and, to her credit, she did try to take that step this time. She consulted me on quite a few things, and I told her a few things about how I handle and view this city.
I could tell she was pondering whether it was right to take that step, but she took it nonetheless.
By now, I'm sure you can already tell what it is that I'm asking of you.
When an idealist finds out the world may not be so black and white, when they decide to try to understand that dark side of humans in more detail, to face some kind of fundamental problem, can they really change their mindset right away? No, they might instead lose sight of themselves. The more resolute a person is, the harder they fall sometimes.
This could be the only time when Ch'en's bluntness works against her.
At the very least, it could keep her doubting herself and question the way she did things for a very long time. You might even have already heard her mention how there isn't an answer to anything. I am sure you are aware that this is her hesitancy speaking, not her resolve. The contradiction between procedural justice and actual justice will forever torment her. No one can help her find the answer to this question, but, at the very least, we can keep her from straying off the right path.
I ask you this sincerely. Please help her before that actually happens.
—Hoshiguma
This letter was placed on the Doctor's desk when Hoshiguma paid Rhodes Island a visit.
text.zh:
【权限记录】
博士，我想拜托您一件事。
我因职务在身，不好经常来罗德岛，而您是非常值得信赖的人，所以，这件事我只能拜托您。
事情很简单，不过理由有些复杂，所以我会写得多一些，您请见谅。
想必您已经知道了解她的多索雷斯之旅。多索雷斯这座城市，由于玻利瓦尔这个国家特殊的状况，以及市长坎黛拉·桑切斯女士高强的政治手腕，成为了一座即使放眼这片大地，也足够独特的城市。
而老陈在这趟度假之后，明显发生了一些变化，这一点，您也应该发现了。
切城事件到现在已经过了大半年了，她的旅行也已经持续了大半年了。我想，她在和你们的旅途上，一定更深刻地意识到了光靠她一个人可能是无法达成她过去的目标的，但是那又怎么样呢，她过去难道没有意识到吗？她只是觉得一切可能没有那么糟。
而多索雷斯这座城市给她来了一剂猛药。
老陈当然见过不好的东西，但在龙门，最不好的东西也不过如此，龙门这座城市，被魏长官治理得太好。而多索雷斯告诉她，比她想象的糟糕得多的东西也理所当然一样地存在着，而且她已经通过亲身体验了解到，自己可能无法撼动它。
那她该怎么做？
博士，我曾经在某本书上读到过一句话，这句话我觉得很有意思，“当我们所处的环境是坏的的时候，我们又怎么会是好的呢？”
我说这话的意思不是在说，老陈过去的想法和做法错了，她是对的，只是这片大地没有她想象的那么好。
我也并不是说我希望老陈变成我，事实上，我不希望她变成我，但至少我希望她能理解，圆滑不等于成熟，世故不意味着毫无棱角。她不怕黑，但实际上如果所有事都是非黑即白的，那许多人也不会害怕，比深不见底的悬崖更可怕的，是不可自拔的泥沼。
老陈最终需要迈出那一步，而老陈这一次，尝试着迈了出去。她向我请教了不少东西，我告诉了她了一些我所知道的对待这座城市的方法，以及看待这座城市的方式。
我看得出，她始终在犹豫自己迈出的这一步对不对，但她终究是迈了出去。
我写到这里，您大概也已经明白，我想要拜托您的是什么。
当一个理想主义者发现这片大地上可能没有非黑即白的地方，当他决定去更加细致地了解人性的阴暗面，去直面某种结构性的问题时，他能够立刻转变好心态吗？不，他更有可能会迷失自我。您知道的，越是坚定信念的人，有的时候越容易堕落。
唯有在这一点上，老陈的刚直反而有可能成为她的弱点。
她至少会有很长一段时间对于自己做事方法的迷茫，您可能已经听到了她说过一些类似“没有答案”之类的话，您应当明白这句话代表着她的迷茫，而不是坚定。程序正义与实体正义在种种情景下的矛盾将会成为永恒困扰她的问题，在回答这个问题上，谁都帮不了她，但是至少，我们可以让她不至于走偏。
在那之前，我诚恳地请求您，请帮助她。
——星熊 留
这封信在某次星熊造访罗德岛时，被放在博士的办公桌上。

text.en:
Given that Ch'en was on vacation, there was no need for her to report to anyone the events that transpired in Dossoles. Yet, as soon as she returned to Rhodes Island, she spent a week writing a long, detailed report.
Her report contained a detailed summary of her time in Dossoles, including her participation in the competition, her defusal of the crisis that emerged, as well as the assistance she provided the local police during her short stay and the lectures that she, Hoshiguma, and Swire held for the local officers to teach them how to better solve their cases. You will know everything you need to know about her trip to Dossoles as soon as you read this report.
But that's not all.
Ch'en also completed an excellent write-up on Bolívar and Dossoles, thanks to the many conversations she had with the locals about Bolívar, the three governments, and Dossoles as she worked her cases. This was no doubt helped by the fact she also kept herself well read on Bolívar's history, both during her time in Dossoles and after her return to Rhodes Island.
Testament to her education at the Victorian Royal Guard Academy, not only was this an excellent, comprehensive write-up, her observation of their core problems was insightful and eye-opening. However, through this write-up, we can also tell that, the detailed research Ch'en has done has only given her even greater doubts about all the phenomena that this country and city represent. It is also apparent that she arrived at some conclusions prematurely. This perhaps has to do with that change in her mindset.
Although her answer is definitely not entirely mature, that does not mean Ch'en herself is immature. Everyone has a path that they must walk. Some choose to give up before they reach the end, but Ch'en evidently is not one such person. This article is not a conclusion that she arrived at. Rather, it represents her musings, and she wishes to share her thoughts with Rhodes Island, whom she acknowledges, to work on this problem together. We at Rhodes Island are glad to see Ch'en place her trust in us, and we are glad to cooperate with her.
text.zh:
关于这一次多索雷斯之旅，由于原本只是陈的度假，她无需向任何人做汇报，但她返回罗德岛后，还是花了一周写了一份非常长的报告。
其中非常详细地记录了她在多索雷斯的经历，包括从参加比赛到解决危机，再到比赛结束后，继续逗留了一段时间在那里协助当地警察局解决各种案件，以及与星熊跟诗怀雅一起为让当地的警察们能够更好地解决案件而开课等等，只要读了这份报告，就能对她此次的多索雷斯之旅了解得一清二楚。
但这份报告并不只是如此。
在完成了对自己行动的回顾后，陈将她在四处办案期间，从各色各样的人们口中听到的种种有关玻利瓦尔这个国家，以及三个政府，还有多索雷斯这座城市的样貌综合了起来，并且在加上她本人在当地以及返回罗德岛后通过各种阅读了解的玻利瓦尔历史后，浓缩出了一篇非常精炼的有关玻利瓦尔这个国家，以及多索雷斯这座城市的文章。
陈无愧于其维多利亚皇家近卫学校毕业的高材生身份，这篇文章对于各种现象的归纳总结，以及对问题核心的洞察都令人惊叹，但是，在这篇文章中，我们也能够看出陈在经过了如此详尽的调查后，反而对这个国家以及这座城市所代表的的种种现象产生了更大的疑问，并且，在某些问题上，她的结论明显有些过于急切，这可能与她想法的转变有所联系。
我们必须承认，她的答案绝不能说成熟可行。但这绝不意味着陈的不成熟，每个人都有这样的必经之路，有的人选择半途而废，而陈显然是那个决不放弃思考的人。同时，这篇文章并不是她的结论，而是她的思考，并且她希望将这种思考与她所认同的罗德岛分享，与我们一起切磋琢磨，罗德岛非常乐于见到陈对罗德岛的信任，也非常乐于与她携手共进。

text.en: One day, I will pass judgment on her.
text.zh: 终有一天，我会审判她。

text.en:
Nearl, the Radiant Knight of Kazimierz. Embodies extreme combat skill and personal military accomplishment in protecting allies, flexible engagement, annihilation and open-zone battle.
After returning to Kazimierz and being crowned winner of the 24th Kazimierz Major, remained in Kazimierz to follow up on remaining affairs. Provides tactical support to the Rhodes Island Kawalerielki Branch Office as a collaborating operator, as well as assisting the landship with assorted operations in other regions in times of need.
text.zh:
临光，卡西米尔耀骑士。在掩护己方队员、机动作战、歼灭战与开阔地带作战中体现出极高的战斗技巧和个人军事素养。
在重返卡西米尔并夺得第二十四届骑士特别锦标赛决斗赛冠军之后，留在卡西米尔处理后续事务。作为合作干员为罗德岛驻卡瓦莱利亚基办事处提供战术支援，必要时也会去往其他地区协助本舰展开各项行动。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Nearl shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.14u/L
Operator Nearl was at one time frequently active in non-urban areas, but presently remains at lower risk of infection.

This is actually a past physical report of Nearl's... Hmm, and she can tell for herself at this point. But she found out the truth long ago, right? No matter when she learned, it never seemed to shake her one bit. Nearl really is some incredible person.
—Medic Operator Hibiscus
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员临光没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.14u/L
干员临光曾长时间在野外活动，但目前来看感染风险仍处于较低水平。

这其实是临光小姐以前的体检报告……嗯，她自己也能看到了。不过她早就知道真相了吧？无论她是什么时候知道的，她似乎从来没有一刻动摇。临光小姐，真是个了不起的人啊。
——医疗干员芙蓉

text.en:
[Originium Arts Overview]
The returnee Radiant Knight is still as valiant and dependable as she ever was, but her combat style has shown a certain shift. Aside from a change in weapon-of-choice, her application of Originium Arts is no longer constrained to treatment. There's no doubt her swordspear wrapped in gold remains the ultimate deterrent to enemies on the battlefield.
Just as her close friend Shining says, 'In the days she roamed with us, Margaret learned how to hold herself in, but upon her return to Kazimierz and reprisal of her charge, the Radiant Knight's learned how to blossom with all her heart.'
It's not just Shining and Nightingale; other operators who've worked with Nearl are shocked by her changes, but they all agree they suit her. Everyone understands clearly that in the application of justice to evil, so long as both reach the limit, the spotlight must shine. Immersed in the Radiant Knight's rays, evildoers are seared and burnt, while justice's allies continue supremely uplifted.

[Weapon Evaluation]
The swordspear Operator Nearl now uses, like the warhammer before it, was given by the Nearl family to a Kazimierzian craftsman to design and forge, and has been strengthened by Operator Blemishine. It was at one point broken in a bout between Nearl and the Blood Knight, only for Operator Blemishine to mend it again.
By Rhodes Island's Engineering Department's evaluation, Nearl's swordspear goes beyond the strength of Kazimierzian campaign knight standard arms, making an incomparable fit with Nearl's own Originium Arts. Under ideal circumstances, it gives the Arts she casts an almost 10% increase in effectivity. By request of the evaluating engineer, Nearl obtained the consent of the weapon's designer, and authorized Rhodes Island to create a 1:6 scale model of this swordspear, residing in the Engineering Department, provided for any engineering operators and students to research.
Supplement: Don't let Closure know how much a high-precision model of the Radiant Knight's swordspear could sell for in the Grand Knight Territory. Our agreement with the Radiant Knight says there'll only ever be one of these models.
text.zh:
【源石技艺概览】
再次归来的耀骑士，依旧与过去一样勇毅而可靠，但她的战斗方式还是发生了一定变化。除了常用武器的更换之外，她对源石技艺的应用也不再拘泥于治疗。那柄金芒缠绕的剑枪，在战场上无疑会给敌人带来极强的威慑。
就像她的好友闪灵说的那样，“与我们一同流浪的日子里，玛嘉烈学会了如何收敛锋芒，而回到卡西米尔再度发起冲锋的耀骑士，已学会了心无旁骛地盛放。”
不光闪灵小姐和夜莺小姐，其他与临光合作过的干员也都惊叹于临光的改变，但并没有人感到不适应。大家很清楚，无论正义是否决定要对邪恶强硬，只要正义与邪恶一样处在边际上，就都必然会有锋芒。同样沐浴在耀骑士的光芒之下，邪恶的人或许会感到灼痛难当，而正义的同伴则依然会受到无上的鼓舞。

【武器鉴定】
干员临光现在使用的剑枪与其从前使用的战锤一样，是由与临光一家交好的卡西米尔工匠设计打造，并经过干员瑕光强化。这柄剑枪曾在临光与血骑士一战时折断，随后再次由干员瑕光修复。
经罗德岛工程部门鉴定，临光的剑枪不仅有着堪比卡西米尔征战骑士制式武器的强度，还无比契合临光本人的源石技艺，于理想情况下，甚至能给她释放的法术带来将近百分之十的效果提升。在负责鉴定的工程师的请求下，临光征得其武器设计者的同意，授权罗德岛制作了一柄剑枪的六分之一模型，存放于工程部门，供各工程干员及学员研究学习。
补充：不要让可露希尔知道耀骑士的高精度剑枪模型在大骑士领能卖多少钱。我们和耀骑士说好了，这模型仅此一件。

text.en:
Though Nearl never complained about it, her work in Kazimierz was clearly tremendously heavy. Still, she never refused a single time the Rhodes Island Kazimierz Branch Office sought help. In her heart, whether she's aboard the landship or not, she remains a part of Rhodes Island.
Though admittedly, she has very limited time to stay aboard. For operators who admire Nearl, or perhaps miss their time fighting side by side with her, it really is a shame. At one point, many new operators full of hope sought out Instructors after finishing watching Nearl's Chernobog Incident battle records, mentioning wanting to learn a thing or two from this valiant operator, only to come back disappointed after learning Nearl was on long-term leave from the ship.
In contrast to Nearl, after Operator Blemishine confirmed her sister was on track with her undertakings in Kazimierz, she threw herself straight into the landship workshop, and spent a very long time without returning home. After several days in a row of Blemishine being unaccounted for, Nearl 'happened to' return to the landship, accurate in finding her in an experimental workshop working on the latest defensive materials, and seizing her while she was right into the middle of passionately hammering away with Eunectes. Nearl learned soon after that Blemishine had been hard at work on all-new form-fitted armor for her.
'It's softer, and lighter, so you can wear it when you'd normally wear leisure clothes, or underneath your formal gear, and it's gotten a massive boost to defending against physical impact! I asked Mechanist and Sona to take a look, and they both said, if I just worked at it a little more, this armor would be able to block it the next time a Lazurite arrow—'
Seeing Blemishine's brilliantly glowing face despite the circles under her eyes, Nearl didn't reprimand her for overtaxing herself, but instead hugged her close.
By Nearl's own request, this meeting was saved to this archive file. She hopes it'll serve to remind her that her every act in Kazimierz bears not just the weight of its manifold sufferers' hopes, but involves her most beloved family's future. The Radiant Knight now no longer launches lone charges against the great waves. She even extends her thanks to Rhodes Island, because she clearly saw the magnitude of the change that life aboard Rhodes Island brought to Maria and Zofia—'Just like when I had first joined Rhodes Island.'
'Of course, we have to give our own thanks to Nearl! Without her, we wouldn't have pulled in such outstanding operators as Blemishine and Whislash, right? Not to mention Flametail Knight, and the whole other crowd of operators who came from Kazimierz... The Radiant Knight's personal charm really is the best recruitment ad! If only a certain few of them didn't obsess every day about when she's going to come back so they can have a fight with her.' —Melancholies of a certain operator from HR
text.zh:
虽然临光从未诉苦，但她在卡西米尔的工作显然十分繁重。尽管如此，她对罗德岛驻卡西米尔办事处的求助还是有求必应。在她心中，无论她是否身在罗德岛本舰，她都依然是罗德岛的一份子。
只是相对而言，她在本舰停留的时间就很有限了。这对仰慕着临光，或者怀念着与她并肩作战的时光的干员们来说，实在是憾事一桩。曾有多名新干员在看完临光在切尔诺伯格事件中的作战记录后，满心期望地找到教官，提出想与这位英勇的干员切磋一二，又在得知临光长期离舰后失望而归。
而干员瑕光则与临光不同，在确定姐姐在卡西米尔的事业步上正轨之后，她就一头扎进了本舰的工坊内，而且很长一段时间没有回家。在瑕光一连失踪好几天之后，临光“恰好”回到了本舰，准确无误地在某个最新防护材料实验车间里，抓获了正与森蚺一起激情挥锤的妹妹。临光随后得知，瑕光其实正在努力地为她打造全新的贴身护甲。
“更柔软轻薄，可以穿在姐姐平时穿的休闲服或者正装礼服下面，而且对物理冲击的防御能力大大提升了！我拜托Mechanist和索娜看过，他们都说，我再努力一点点，这块护甲就能挡下一次青金的箭——”
看着瑕光顶着黑眼圈却闪耀着光彩的脸，临光没有责怪她透支身体，而是紧紧抱住了妹妹。
因临光本人要求，本次会面经过被保存在了这份档案里。她希望以此提醒自己，她在卡西米尔的一举一动，不仅承载着万千卡西米尔苦难的民众寄托的希冀，还牵扯着她最爱的家人们的未来。如今的耀骑士，不再是独自一人向巨浪发起冲锋。她还向罗德岛表达了感谢，因为她清晰地看到了罗德岛的生活给玛莉娅和佐菲娅带来了多大变化——“就如同我当初刚加入罗德岛时一样。”
“当然，我们也要感谢临光小姐，如果没有她，我们就不会吸引到如此出色的干员瑕光与干员鞭刃了，不是吗？更不用说焰尾骑士，还有另外一众从卡西米尔过来的干员……耀骑士的人格魅力，就是最好的招聘广告啊！要是他们之中的某些人来了之后不是每一天都惦记着耀骑士什么时候回来，好和耀骑士打一架就更好啦。”——来自某位人事部干员的感慨

text.en:
Rhodes Island bore witness to Nearl's entire journey to championship in the 24th Kazimierz Major. The plots veiled and open, both on and off the stage, the glinting of blades from the city's tip to tail, and the blood and sweat that Nearl herself shed in the field, all recorded in fine detail in the Special Operations Records. Anyone who's read through these records, or talked with Nearl before, will have no misconception of Nearl's attitude to this competition. After the span of six years, two champions, a long and treacherous path, and all manner of hardship, the Radiant Knight of today, same as the one of the past who attempted to shatter the rules that shackled, has never recognized the honor of knight competition championship as true glory.
However, in Nearl's eyes, there is another side to this farce.
'In that arena devoid of any splendor, every heroic moment bursting forth is splendorous; in those streets lit by neon that fall short of truth, the fellowship that comes together to survive is true; in those video recordings lacking any honor to speak of, those thirsts to clamber out without relenting, to break through oneself, are honorable.'
Late one night, Nearl wrote these words in her Rhodes Island cabin, imagining that once her friend in the City of Saplings and Artisans received this letter, they might ridicule how out of place her rare lament seemed, and let out a smile alone to herself.
The next day, she came across a young operator excitedly calling for 'the Radiant Knight,' to ask her her signature. The Radiant Knight's path to retaking the championship had been the focus of masses, and even Rhodes Island had its fair share of her fans. She'd keep running into similar situations each time she returned aboard, but these excited fans would be warned and kept in check by Dobermann and other Instructors most times, this being no exception. What Dobermann didn't expect, however, was that Nearl would accept that competition photograph, and wrote a line of text on the back.
And this is what she wrote: 'Keep up the training—Operator Nearl'.
If the encouragement of her signature could inspire a young operator for a good day, then, well, whether or not they truly understood the significance of her charge at the championship, at least for that day, it wouldn't matter.
text.zh:
罗德岛见证了临光在第二十四届骑士特别锦标赛夺冠的整个过程。那些台上台下的阴谋阳谋，街头巷尾的火花剑光，和临光本人在赛场上洒下的血汗一起，都被详细地记录在了特别行动档案里。凡是读过这份档案，或者曾与临光有过交谈的人，都不会误解临光对这场大赛的态度。六年跨度，两次冠军，一路险阻，万般辛苦，今日的耀骑士，和过去那个试图冲破规则桎梏的耀骑士一样，从未认可过骑士竞技的冠军荣誉是真正的荣耀。
不过，这场闹剧在临光眼里还有另外一面。
“在那不甚光彩的竞技场上，迸发出来的每一分豪情都是光彩的；在那些不够真实的霓虹灯照耀下的街道上，为了生存而相聚的友谊是真实的；在毫无荣耀可言的摄像机的记录下，那些不断攀登、突破自我的渴望，是荣耀的。”
某天深夜，临光在罗德岛本舰的舱室里写下这句话，想象着等身处林荫与匠人之都的友人收到信件，会不会调侃她偶尔的感慨不伦不类，独自一人露出了笑容。
第二天，她在走廊上遇到了一名激动地喊着“耀骑士”找她签名的年轻干员。耀骑士的再次夺冠之路万众瞩目，哪怕在罗德岛上也有不少拥趸，类似情况她在回舰时总会遇到，只是这些激动的粉丝多数都会被杜宾等教官提醒制止，这一次也不例外。出乎杜宾意料，临光接下了那张比赛时的照片，并在背后写下了一行字。
她写的是：“训练加油——干员临光”。
如果她的签名鼓励能让一名小干员振奋一整天，那么，对方是否真的理解了她冲击冠军的意义，至少在这一天之内，都无关紧要了。

text.en:
Nearl's path in Kazimierz was bound to be rough. Considering her experiences dealing with different people over the past few years, she had a clear recognition of the difficulties she did, and would soon face. In addition, her history fighting side by side with Shining, Nightingale and the other operators of Rhodes Island made her realize that the necessary amount of cooperation makes much easier work of things.
With the joint efforts of her and all of Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub, Rhodes Island's Kawalerielki branch office was successfully established. At the same time, she set out on new work to settle the Infected. To progress her plans, she no longer operated in total isolation outside of Kazimierz society's mechanisms; on the contrary, separately with the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi and General Chamber of Commerce, she made collaborative strides in different places. As one of the legendary Nearls, and two-time Major champion, she had a clear and marked value at every Kazimierz conference table, just like every matter she wanted to bring to fruition, and every life she wanted to save. 'All things have their price'—the sole principle that modern Kazimierz pursues. Nearl was naturally disgusted with being shunted about as a weight on the scales, but she never minded how the Radiant Knight seemed in others' eyes. As long as she was sure, that sufficed: What she held fast to, what she brought back heart and soul to Kazimierz, were all priceless. No deals existed between her and the Adeptus or the K.G.C.C.; every cause willing to lend her a hand, she would grasp in turn, and every hindrance to her forward path, she would turn to face with swordspear in hand and no sliver of hesitation.
'She's not like us. We'd have to look where we're going if we didn't want the wheels barreling our way. And her? She doesn't care about what turns at her. She'd opt to crash straight through it. No matter if we can't keep up, no matter if where she goes makes her presentable or not—once she smashes out of the cage, we all get to see the light coming in.' —Flametail Knight's stirred thoughts after several times cooperating
It's true. Without fear of danger, Nearl will forge on for the sake of a single, for a few Infected, but however many she's saved isn't her point of satisfaction. Countless idealists are ground to dust by the monolithic wheel of their times, forced to change themselves midway through changing others, but she is forever on the road, one time after another, launching her charge against the raging waves.
text.zh:
临光在卡西米尔的路注定不会走得太顺利。凭借着过去几年积累的与不同人打交道的经验，她对自己正在或者将要面临的困难有了清晰的认知。此外，与闪灵夜莺以及其他罗德岛干员并肩作战的经历，让她意识到一些必要的合作往往能事半功倍。
在她与红松骑士团诸位的共同努力之下，罗德岛驻卡瓦莱利亚基领办事处成功建立。与此同时，她着手展开新的感染者安置工作。为了推进计划，她也不再将自己彻底孤立于卡西米尔的社会运作机制之外，与之相反，她与监正会和商业联合会分别在不同的方面进行了一些合作。身为传奇的临光家的一员，以及两届特锦赛冠军，她在卡西米尔各处的谈判桌上有着明确的价码，正如她想做成的每一件事、想要拯救的每一条性命一样。“万物有价”，这就是今天的卡西米尔奉行的唯一准则。临光自然反感被当作砝码在天平上来回摆弄，可她从来不在意耀骑士在别人眼中是什么模样。只要她自己清楚就足够：她所坚守的，她一心想带回给卡西米尔的，都是无价的。她和监正会以及商业联合会之间并不存在交易，凡是愿意为她的事业伸出援手的，她都会反握住对方的手，而凡是阻碍着她前行的，她在朝对方挥动剑枪时也不会有一丝迟疑。
“她和我们不一样，为了躲避巨大的车轮，我们在跑起来的时候都不得不看着脚下的路。而她呢？她才不会管车轮什么的，她会选择一路撞过去。无论我们跟不跟得上，她走过的地方又是不是有了像样的路，她撞穿了樊笼之后，我们至少都能看到漏进来的光啊。”——几次合作之后焰尾骑士的感慨
是的，临光会为了一位或者几位感染者的安全而奋不顾身，但不会满足于自己已经救下了多少人。无数理想主义者被时代的巨轮碾得面目全非，在改变别人的半途被迫改变了自己，而她永远在路上，一遍又一遍地向惊涛骇浪发起冲锋。

text.en:
[Classified Log]
You may have already noticed, but in all the external publicity about the Nearl family, we often see only Margaret, Maria, Młynar, Zofia and Margaret's grandfather who passed away some years ago, and barely a mention seems to have been made of Margaret and Maria's parents.
According to reliable sources, during the Major, a gossip tabloid did once publish an article on Margaret's mother and father, but used the vague wording of 'suspected to have left the country years ago, never to return,' and this edition was retracted and destroyed overnight. This goes to show that as far as Kazimierz is concerned, the Nearl couple's whereabouts are classified to an untouchable degree.
Through discussion, we discovered Maria has near to no recollection of her parents, while Margaret's memories of them end at ten years old, give or take. From this, we understand that they went missing at least a decade ago. To Margaret's memory, outside of being cared for by her grandfather, she was often in the company of campaign knights. Clearly, following her parents' disappearance, the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi were considerably assistive of her family. This further shows with high likelihood, the Nearl couple went MIA in a major Adeptus-launched mission with close ties to Kazimierz.
Are they still alive to this day? If they did give their lives, then what dangerous affair lost Kazimierz a pair of such outstanding campaign knights? Doubtless we could find some answers in Kazimierz's top secret archives, but raising this matter would have an adverse effect on our relationship with the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi.
If you wish, we could still continue looking into this. Supposing there comes a day we find one of the Nearl family pursuing the issue, whether it's Margaret or not, we will be willing to offer our assistance.
text.zh:
【权限记录】
或许你已经注意到了，在外界流传的关于临光一家的资料里，我们往往只能看到玛嘉烈、玛莉娅、玛恩纳、佐菲娅和在几年前过世的玛嘉烈的祖父的身影，几乎没有见过与玛嘉烈和玛莉娅双亲相关的只言片语。
据可靠消息，在特锦赛期间，曾经有一份八卦小报写了一篇关于玛嘉烈父母的消息，只不过用到了“疑似远赴境外多年未归”这样模糊的字眼，这份报纸就在一夜之间遭到撤回和销毁。这足以说明，临光夫妇的下落对卡西米尔来说，属于不可触碰的机密。
通过交谈，我们发现，玛莉娅对父母几乎没有印象，而玛嘉烈对他们的回忆也停留在了十岁左右。由此可见，他们在十多年前就已经失踪。在玛嘉烈的记忆中，她的少年时期除了受年迈的祖父照料，还常常有征战骑士相伴，可见监正会在她父母消失之后，对他们一家颇多照拂。这进一步说明，临光夫妇高概率是在一次由监正会发起的、与卡西米尔息息相关的重大任务中失去踪迹。
时至今日，他们是否依然活着？如果他们已然牺牲，又是什么危险事件让卡西米尔损失了这样一对优秀的征战骑士？毫无疑问，我们能在卡西米尔的绝密档案库中找到部分答案，但提起此事对我们与监正会之间的关系并无好处。
如果你希望的话，我们还会对此继续保持关注，假如有朝一日，我们发现有临光家的人正在追查此事，无论那个人是不是玛嘉烈，我们都愿意提供帮助。

text.en: [Pending Translation]
text.zh: 安洁莉娜，服务于罗德岛的资深信使，足迹遍布迄今为止已知的大多数国家。同时，她也作为资深术师干员，利用其独特的源石技艺为罗德岛提供帮助。

text.en: [Pending Translation]
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】7%
与刚来到罗德岛不久时的情况相比，感染加重的程度较小，可以说控制得相当不错。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.24u/L
尽管安洁莉娜的防护工作已经做得足够细心，她的这项指标仍然无法彻底降低到让人完全放心的水平。

text.en: [Pending Translation]
text.zh:
罗德岛的外勤干员中不乏在源石技艺方面颇有建树的人才，其中有些堪称大师。但如果要问哪位干员在罗德岛任职期间的进步最令人瞩目，绝大多数以法术见长的外勤干员都会提起安洁莉娜的名字。
在安洁莉娜刚刚开始参加外勤工作时，罗德岛将她归为实习术师干员，不希望她在外勤任务中承担过重的压力。不过，安洁莉娜的主要身份并非术师，而是信使。她很少会长期留在罗德岛，就算在本舰也往往是忙着揽收和打包，几乎找不到参加实习术师转正测试的机会。因此，这个“实习术师干员”的名头她顶了好长时间，直到某次时间表终于安排得开，她才惴惴不安地参加了转正测试——结果给后面上场的实习干员制造了相当程度的精神压力。
尽管顺利通过了测试，安洁莉娜仍然觉得自己的法术能力有诸多需要提升之处，并一直在为此努力——这倒不能苛责她过分追求完美，对重力施加影响是极为罕见的天赋，罗德岛上并无能手把手指导她的人。不仅如此，这种源石技艺还极难操控，很难达到百分百的成功率，这也影响了安洁莉娜对自己能力的正确评估。
不过无论如何，此次雷姆必拓之行结束之后，安洁莉娜显然比先前自信了很多。对此最深有体会的不是别人，而是和安洁莉娜私交甚好的可颂。两人经常举办“法术vs蛮力”的举重比赛，一开始只比重量，后来安洁莉娜对法术的控制上了一个台阶，两人开始比谁能举得又重又稳。再后来，可颂只能靠“在一整摞行李箱上摆一个小球还不能让小球掉下来”这样的规则偶尔反败为胜，直到最近这次……

不管多重的东西，她都能在我举起来之后连重物带我一同举起来！这样以后没人再和她比举重了，呜呜呜……
——可颂

话虽如此，当安洁莉娜用法术把重物排成空中阶梯，请可颂上到最高处一览风景的时候，可颂仍然兴冲冲地接受了邀请。

text.en: [Pending Translation]
text.zh:
且不论源石技艺水平如何，安洁莉娜在罗德岛的首要身份仍然是罗德岛的信使。
我们在这方面能说的话其实并不算多，原因无他，一个称职的信使就是不会给人留下太多谈资。包裹送达，信件寄到，信使的身形就会理所当然地隐去。然而，在沉默的同时，信使又必定会知道许多事情——谁给谁寄了信，谁收了信一直不回，谁的地址一直在变……仅仅是这种零碎的信息，就能拼凑出一些未必特别模糊的真相。因而许多信使都视沉默——至少是在适当的时机沉默——为一种美德。
叙拉古出身的信使比其他人更明白这个道理，安洁莉娜也不例外。她当然是那个普普通通的女孩子，会与同龄人畅谈时尚、流行与打扮，但她也会在很多时候把情绪藏起来、吞下去，任由那些让心脏狂跳不止的东西慢慢干燥、风化，变成再不会说出口的秘密。
我们无意干涉信使的工作方式，但我们确实希望安洁莉娜能以她真心想要的方式度过这段人生中独一无二的时光，而我们能给予她的最好的支持，就是对她的善良和尽责报以无条件的信任。
她显然意识到了这一点。她现在是长期服务于罗德岛的信使之中最资深的一位，无论是寄出和送达的件数还是投递的完成情况都数一数二，还经常能对一些物流方面的事项提出自己的见解；与此同时，她也越来越把罗德岛当成一个真正可以信赖、可以依靠、可以做她自己的地方。她会把宿舍装饰成自己喜欢的样子，会在体检后给医生留下一个小礼物，也会在焦躁的时候一言不发地走进游戏室打上一整天的游戏，或者坐到食堂，以节制但不中断的节奏一盒又一盒地吃冰淇淋。

所以你真的没在称体重的时候施术吗？
——好奇的塔妮

谁会带着施术单元上体重秤啊！
——哭笑不得的安洁莉娜

text.en: [Pending Translation]
text.zh:
安洁莉娜的雷姆必拓之旅首先为我们带来的当然是三位性格各异的新干员，其次是雷姆必拓南境的活性源石相关数据，最后是一些与希尔达的所谓追随者相关的消息。
不过那些人在其追随者中所处的位置实在太过边缘。他们之中有一个人，在跟随乌露露离开红砂镇后辗转来到了某个罗德岛办事处，在那里度过了临终前最后一段时光。据其所说，他们之中最核心的那个人甚至都不敢宣称自己曾见过希尔达。
在之后途经雷姆必拓的旅途中，安洁莉娜不止一次追查那些人的来历，成功拼凑出了其中一些人的身世和遭蛊惑的经历，但绝大多数线索最终都中断了。

【权限记录】
“那位伟大的跋涉者从雷姆必拓出发，也终将在雷姆必拓建成她超然的国度。”
这是安洁莉娜在终极大铁屯某个贫民聚居的街区听见的传言。她没能追踪到说话者的踪迹，但这句话一直让她非常在意。

先把红砂镇的事件放在一边，安洁莉娜自己也是一位感染者。她刚刚来到罗德岛的时候情况很不好，时至今日，她自己的矿石病也并非毫无加重的迹象，而她这次交到的朋友之一，嘉辛塔，更是一名中晚期矿石病患者……我们的确担心这些因素加起来会对安洁莉娜的心理状况产生不利影响。
出乎意料的是，安洁莉娜是这样回答我们的：
“我不会说‘总会有办法的’这样的话。有些事情就是没有办法。我们只能看着它发生，尽量延缓、尽量补救，即便做到最好，很多时候还是得不到自己想要的结局。
“但我无论如何不会失去希望。博士一开始带给我的希望中……的确有不切实际的成分，但哪怕是虚假的希望，对我而言也弥足珍贵，甚至可以说，没有那点希望，我不可能直到今天还像这样站在大家面前。
“更何况，哪怕希望没能建立在完全坚实的地基上，其中蕴含的心意也毫无虚假。”

text.en: [Pending Translation]
text.zh:
……这样一来，纸星星就又折满了一罐。
其实后来我自己也分不清这些星星究竟是为何而折的了。这已经成了一种习惯，当我送出了信的时候，当我做到了什么的时候，当我没做到什么的时候，当我说了事后想起来会有些得意的话的时候，当我有什么没能说出口的时候……
但只是折纸的话，只是把心情藏在纸折的星星里的话……有些事情，就永远不会被其他人知道。星星不会说话。星星是沉默的眼睛。它们知晓，但从不诉说。没人知道星星在想什么。
而我……我知道自己不可能像繁星一样永远在天空中闪烁。玛蒂娜说藏在心中的感情终有一日会改变，可对我来说，也许在感情还没改变的某个时刻，我就已经化作了天边划过的那颗流星。所以，我应该去大胆地说出口，去把对爸爸妈妈的思念、把对罗德岛的眷恋、把对朋友们的关怀说出口，去把那些藏在心底最深处的话……说给重要的人听，别留下更多遗憾。
嗯，安洁莉娜的纸星星就只有这么多。如果还有一时间不好意思说出口的话……就用这个吧，妈妈最开始教会我的，纸折的沃尔珀兽亲，“小狐狸”。
它不是星星，它不必用余生等待一颗伴星。它会主动找到那个它希望陪伴的人，陪在那个人身边，依靠那个人，偶尔也被那个人依靠。
不仅是拥抱和起舞，更是危险时背靠着背的倚仗，力竭时托起肩膀的支撑。

text.en: [Pending Translation]
text.zh:
【语音记录】
没关系的。我刚训练完，时间上正好，一点都不早。
呃……不是。我找你没什么要紧事。这样是不是不太好？如果你有更重要的事要忙——
唔——嗯，好的！博士能为我特意空出时间，我很开心。
其实是这样的。之前我帮远山小姐送了一封对她而言很重要的信，于是她帮我占卜了一次……很认真的占卜，对她的消耗也很大。
她在水晶球里看见了我的身影，她说应该是未来的我……但这其实不太重要，重要的是，我身处一场战争之中，似乎正在扼守一道防线。
再怎么参加罗德岛的外勤任务，我仍然是一名信使。如果战争到了连信使都义不容辞的时候，罗德岛，甚至这片大地……究竟会变成什么样？
……说不怕当然是骗人的。我很怕那样的未来，哪怕远山小姐后来又看见了一些不同的景象，那片模糊不清的战场仍然会出现在我的梦中，所以我才会来找你。
水晶球中的我？唔……远山小姐说，水晶球中我的身影毫无畏惧……如果那时的我真的能做到，那就太好了。
但……假如我们真的要面对一场战争，我希望，我仍然能为一顿饱含心意的餐食雀跃，为一封报平安的信件感到宽慰，为精心调配的香气稍稍舒展眉头……为一朵刚刚绽放的花，留下至少一瞥的时间。
你不知道能否让我实现这个愿望，但你会为之努力？
我很开心，不过，我可能……还有一个稍微有点强人所难的请求。
这……能不能也成为你的愿望？
……谢谢你，博士。
和你一样，我也会为这个愿望……拼尽全力。

value.en: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected by medical examination.
value.zh: 体表有源石结晶分布，参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected by medical examination.
infectionStatus.zh: 体表有源石结晶分布，参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

text.en: Eyjafjalla, Volcanologist and Catastrophe Messenger. In recent years, she has participated in the production of multiple documentaries and written and published multiple books on volcanoes. She continues to receive treatment at Rhodes Island and undertakes a variety of activities, including Catastrophe research, as needed.
text.zh: 艾雅法拉，火山学家，天灾信使。近年参与拍摄多部火山纪录片，并参与撰写出版火山相关书籍。现于罗德岛继续接受治疗，并视需求参与包括天灾研究在内的多项活动。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 11%
Occurrences of deafness and blurred vision have become more frequent.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.59u/L
With Rhodes Island having brought her condition under control, Operator Eyjafjalla's Blood Originium-Crystal Density has not seen a significant increase.

'Dr. Keller... My numbers haven't gone up. I'm not lying! We can't delay this field survey... Please! Believe me!'
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】11%
失聪以及视物模糊的症状出现频率变高。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.59u/L
由于罗德岛对病情的控制，干员艾雅法拉的血液源石结晶密度没有大幅度上升。

“凯勒老师……我的各项数值没怎么上升，真的！我们不能推迟这次实地考察……哎呀，真的，相信我嘛！”

text.en:
After returning from her trip, Eyjafjalla slowly recounted to her fellow operators all her experiences during her time away. And when telling those stories, each and every piece of volcanic rock has an interesting factoid behind it: rocks with lots of holes can float in water, and sometimes even make noise; the distribution of obsidian is closely related to magma activity, and their hidden luster has other meanings to it; etc.
At the same time, our operators have also noticed that, while her hearing loss used to be a barrier to communication, it has since become much easier to talk to her. Whenever they tell her that her condition must have improved, she just keeps smiling as she always does and tells them with a bit of pride that, while her hearing has deteriorated to the point where she can now only hear with hearing aids in a quiet environment, they're finding it easier to talk to her because she learned to read lips.
'Hearing aids really don't help me understand that much anymore, so I usually rely on both them and lip reading to understand what everyone is saying. Is it that hard to tell if you're not watching for it?
'Sometimes, after I tell others about my condition, they start to look at me kind of differently. It's not that I want to be treated differently or earn anyone's sympathy. All I really need is for everyone to interact with me as usual.'
The worrying thing is that we occasionally have operators visit Medical and tell us that they saw her talking alone by herself, and that she sometimes even seemed a little angry. They were afraid to interrupt her, but were nonetheless worried that perhaps her condition has worsened in some strange way...
text.zh:
这次旅行回来，艾雅法拉给干员们慢慢地讲完了她此次的见闻。在她的口中，每一块与火山有关的石头都会有一个有趣的小知识：多孔的火山石能够浮在水面，有的还能发出声响；黑曜石的分布也和岩浆的每一次活动密切相关，那些暗藏的光泽有了别样的意义。
同时，干员们注意到，大家与艾雅法拉的交流似乎不再如之前那样，会因为她的听力问题而受到较大的阻碍，如今已经顺畅了许多。得知大家是以为她的病情有所好转，艾雅法拉只是一如既往地笑着，还有些小自豪地告诉大家，因为她的听力持续恶化，如今只有在安静稳定的环境下才能依靠助听器听清对方的话语，交流更顺畅是因为自己学会了如何读唇语。
“助听器能提供的帮助已经很少了，我现在大部分时间都是同时靠助听器和唇语分辨出大家都在说什么。是不是不注意的话，完全看不出来？
“有时在说出病情之后对方的目光会变得很奇怪。我其实并不希望自己得到一些特殊的照顾或者是心疼，我只需要像这样正常地被对待，正常地交流就好。”
但令人有些担心的是，偶尔会有干员来告诉医疗部，说自己看到了艾雅法拉小姐对着空气自言自语，有时还会有些生气。他们不敢贸然打扰，但还是会担心艾雅法拉小姐的病情是否出现了某些方面的恶化……

text.en:
Few are aware of the concept of a 'Sovereign of Beasts.' When interacting with humans, they are usually treated as either a human with distinctive traits or some kind of supernatural ruler. The natural characteristics demonstrated by these Sovereigns are also quite distinct from Terra's existing creatures. Recently, there has also been a string of strange occurrences aboard Rhodes Island, and we surmise that this is the work of a Sov■■■ (A long string of sheep hoofprints can be seen here; the letters are illegible)
—■■■(Another string of hoofprints}

'Skyfire told me they were scared to death when I got lost in the wilderness again, but they didn't expect me to suddenly appear out of nowhere in the crossroads they were in, alone. But I had a pink, fluffy critter lead me there. It even took a bite out of my book!'
'Pink, fluffy critters? They've been showing up whenever I play my guitar! Gotta say, they have great taste in music. Even when I'm jamming out in the wind, they stand out there with me, up against the gales and unleashing life! Wish they'd stop eating my strings, though.'
'Outta the way, outta the way~ Metal Crabs coming through~ These chubby little guys seem to be having a lot of fun with somebody lately; their body weight is back to normal now! I even found these pink furballs stuck to their claws. Any of you know whose pet they belong to?'
—Rhodes Island Cafeteria audio recording

Warning
Following the disappearance of instruction materials and food stockpiles in September, the instructors have found the following discipline violations during the October inspection:
Using Originium Arts to play with toys, suspending them midair and sending them flying around; the inexplicable disappearance of ice cream ingredients meant for classes; skateboarding on the deck outside of set hours and hiding as soon as the instructors arrive.
Offending operators should report to the instructors' office immediately to acknowledge and rectify their mistakes, as well as uphold all rules and regulations to prevent further offenses.
—Dur-nar

Give me my motherf■■in' limited edition vinyls back!
—■■ (Unknown penguin footprint on the wall)

A few days later, after a significant increase in incidents involving 'strange pink silhouettes,' Eyjafjalla had no choice but to leave her laboratory and spend what little time and energy she has dealing with the problems caused by the stealthy sheep, apologizing to everyone one-by-one, and helping everyone touch those invisible mischievous animals.
That said, it's apparent that she's also enjoying this.
text.zh:
“兽主”这一概念并不为大部分人所认知，在与人类的交流接触中，它们大多被当成长相奇特的人或是某种超然的支配者。兽主所表现出的自然特性也与泰拉现存的生物有着较大区别。针对罗德岛上近日出现的一些怪异现象，目前推测为是兽■■■（此处有一大串蹄印，字迹不清）
——■■■（此处又有一大串蹄印）

“天火学姐说，他们差点因为我又在荒野里迷路吓个半死，没想到明明什么都没有，但我就是出现在了他们所在的那个路口。可明明就是一个粉粉的、毛绒绒的小东西带我出来的，我的书还咬了它一口呢！”
“粉色的毛绒绒的小东西？我最近弹吉他的时候能看到它们！不得不说，它们对音乐很有品位，即使我是在狂风里演奏，它们也会和我一起不向狂风低头地……绽放生命！——要是不吃我的琴弦就更好了。”
“让一让让一让，磐蟹散步时间~这群超重的小家伙最近不知道和谁一起玩得很开心，体重全都恢复正常了！我还在它们的钳子上发现了这种粉色的毛球，你们知道是谁家的宠物吗？”
——罗德岛食堂录音

警告
继本年九月的教具和食品库存消失事件，教官团队在十月份的检查中，又发现了以下危害纪律性的问题：
使用源石技艺控制游戏室玩具并令其滞空和无规律飞舞，为教学准备的冰淇淋原料无故消失，于非规定时间在甲板上玩耍滑板，在教官到来之后迅速躲藏。
希望违纪干员马上前往教官室认错整改，并在日后严守纪律，避免类似问题再次出现。
——坚雷

把我的限量唱片还来！
——■■（墙上的不明企鹅脚印）

几天后，面对越来越多的“罗德岛诡异粉色身影”事件，艾雅法拉不得不从实验室中走出来，从本就不多的时间和精力里抽出一部分来处理这些时隐时现的小羊搞出来的问题，逐个道歉，并指引着众人触摸到那些看不到的捣乱生物。
但能看出来，她应该也是有些乐在其中的吧？

text.en:
Dr. Kahn:
You have my sincerest gratitude.
I know that if it weren't for your assistance in the beginning, I would likely not have received such quality healthcare. Over the past few years, I have persistently worked to complete the volcano expedition. I feel that as a volcanologist and a daughter taking over her parents' unfinished research, this is a life goal I must complete. In spite of your numerous letters, I have insisted on continuing down this path, and I apologize for making you worry.
I also know that you have been trying to uncover the truth of all those years ago, and that you've been protecting me time and again by trying to keep me from getting too involved. If it weren't for your persistence and care, I would never have learned what actually happened back then. Although the vacation itself may have helped alleviate my worries, it was you, the truth that you worked so hard to give me, and Dr. Keller's frankness in the end that truly gave me the relief I needed.
I will come visit you in Leithanien in the near future. My mother used to tell me that you would sometimes be upset when your experiments went wrong, and that you'd need my parents to bring a cake to your lab to comfort you... I really want to tell you that we can't completely prevent accidents. All we can do is hold on to every meaningful bit of time we have. I really hope you were able to finally calm down, and that you could tell me any old stories about my parents.
—Adele

Adele:
I have given this a lot of thought, but I finally decided to write you this letter. I want you to know that I am truly grateful to you.
I had decided many years ago that I would never again climb a volcano, and that this museum would be my final memento to Magna and Katia.
At first, I invited you to participate in the museum and Mt. Siesta's affairs because my work required it, and also because you are Magna and Katia's child. I had intended to retire from all research and work pertaining to volcanoes after bringing this matter to completion. I couldn't face you, nor could I face Kahn's question. I had been wondering: if I'd chosen to make them stay as well, would they not have been caught in that pyroclastic flow and lost their lives? However, I never expected you to have never questioned my involvement nor resented me.
I'm sorry, Adele. I was too harsh on you before, and it was partly because I was afraid I'd be reminded of the time I spent with your parents. My memories with them were once a heavy burden to me, but thanks to you, I can finally bring myself to put them into words again, and share them with you as simply fun anecdotes.
I await your next letter, and am preparing for our next expedition together.
—Keller
text.zh:
卡恩前辈：
我非常感谢您。
我明白没有您当初的帮助，我可能无法获得如此好的医疗条件。在这几年里我一直执着于完成火山考察，我觉得自己作为一名火山学家，作为继承爸爸妈妈未竟研究的女儿，这是我必须要完成的人生目标。您屡次写信劝我，而我却一意孤行，很抱歉，让您担心了。
我也知道是您一直在试图找出当年的真相，也是您一次次地保护我，不希望我受到太多牵扯。如果不是您的执着与在乎，我并不会知晓当初事情的真实情况。这趟度假本身或许有助于缓解我的焦虑，但真正让我释然的，卡恩前辈，是您的努力所带来的真相，和凯勒老师最后的坦诚。
前辈，等再过一段日子，我会去莱塔尼亚探望您。从前妈妈会和我讲起，说您其实偶尔还会因为实验出错而懊恼，最后还要爸爸妈妈带着蛋糕去实验室安慰您……我很想告诉您，意外并非我们所能阻止，我们能做的就是尽力抓住当下的每一段有意义的时间。我真心地希望那时您能够真正地放松下来，和我再聊起一些爸爸妈妈当年的趣事。
——阿黛尔

阿黛尔：
我考虑了很久，还是决定下笔写出这封信并寄送给你。我想让你知道，阿黛尔，我很感谢你的存在。
早在很多年前，我已经决定接下来的人生不会再登上火山，这座博物馆会是我对于玛格娜和卡提亚最后的纪念。
原本邀请你来参与博物馆与汐斯塔火山的事务只是出于工作需要，你也是玛格娜和卡提亚的孩子，在完成这些事情之后我已经打算退出火山相关的全部研究与工作。我无法面对你，也无法面对卡恩的质问。我一直在想，如果那天我选择让他们也留下，他们就不会遭遇火山碎屑流，也不会去世。但我没有想到你从未怀疑、埋怨过我。
抱歉，阿黛尔，我之前对你太过严厉，其实也是因为我怕自己会忍不住想起太多与你父母相处的往事。与你父母所有的记忆一度成为我的重担，但因为你的存在，我才能将它们再次说出口，将它们作为趣事与你分享。
我期待你的回信，并为下一次的火山实地考察准备着。
——凯勒

text.en: Upon her return to Rhodes Island, Eyjafjalla immediately began to gather all the data she had kept at Rhodes Island and send them to Siesta's Volcano Museum, as well as prepare for future joint research projects with Lady Keller. Naturally, we were a little worried. After all, she had been working with volcanoes both from closer distances and more often over the past few years, all to complete the project that her parents were unable to finish. This is no doubt detrimental to her health. Our Medical operators often tried to talk her out of participating in surveys, but she would always tell us a story she heard when she was still a child: of a sickly scientist bedridden with illness, but who didn't hesitate to spend what little strength she had left to continue her research. In the end, she reached a conclusion, and closed her eyes. She asked us a question: If you were that scientist, at the final days of your life, would you rather climb a summit or spend your remaining time in bed, peacefully with your family? We were unable to give Eyjafjalla an answer, but perhaps her answer would be to achieve both. Compared to others who've made significant breakthroughs in the field of volcanology, she is still very young. Some races can live past a hundred years, perhaps even longer, while others live a much more fleeting life. However, the length of one's life does not determine its worth. Judging from the data and research papers she's managed to put together in her dorm room, we can't help but be awestruck at how much she's already fit into her short life, and she is continually adding more. 'There are many secrets hidden across the lands under our feet. Each insignificant rock has endured far more time than even the oldest Savra. 'Underneath layers upon layers of strata, there is a chamber of magma that is ever flowing at unimaginable temperatures, while the strata themselves are slowly moving and constantly crushing one another. We once made the bold assumption that perhaps the seas were once tall mountains, and that the earth currently beneath our feet could perhaps have once reached even the clouds above. When, after traveling hundreds of thousands of miles, the earth that once saw the skies, or the bottom of the ocean, finally encounters its compatriot, they release a most radiant and blazing light. 'Throughout this process, my parents lifted their heads and pondered just what exactly it is that boils our lands' bloodstreams. And now, I am following their footsteps and walking the path they once did, to seek an answer from the land. The footsteps of future generations will likewise trample over ours as they continue down this path. 'This is the meaning of our lives.' —The opening monologue of the volcano documentary One Step After Another, as narrated by Eyjafjalla
text.zh:
这次返回罗德岛，艾雅法拉开始着手收拾她存放在罗德岛的各项资料，准备寄往汐斯塔的火山博物馆，为接下来与凯勒女士二人共同参与的科研项目做准备。
我们有些担心，毕竟艾雅法拉这几年来一次次更加频繁也更加近距离地接触火山，试图完成父母当年未竟的研究项目，而这无疑是有损她的健康的。针对这个问题，医疗部干员时常劝告艾雅法拉并不建议她参加考察活动，但艾雅法拉最终只是讲了自己幼时听过的一个故事：一位科学家在身患重病瘫痪在床时，仍旧不惜最后一丝力气继续研究，最终得到了一份结果，闭上了双眼。
她问了我们一个问题：如果你是这位科学家，在生命的最后，是要用最后的时间攀登高峰，还是要作为一个孱弱的病人，安静地度过他与家人相处的最后时光？
我们无法给出一个答案，但或许对于艾雅法拉来说，答案并不是二选一，而是可以兼得。和很多在火山研究上取得了重大突破的人相比，艾雅法拉很是年轻。一些种族的年长者能活过百年甚至更久的时间，一些人的生命转瞬即逝，但生命的长短并不是能够判定其价值的因素。看着从艾雅法拉宿舍整理出的各项资料与论文，我们不禁感叹，这就是生命的厚度，而艾雅法拉小姐还在不断地增加这份厚度。

“我们脚下的大地有着太多的秘密，每一块微不足道的石头都曾经历过比最年长的萨弗拉老人还要长久千百倍的岁月。
“在岩层与岩层之下，有一条永远在炽热流淌的熔岩带，岩层互相挤压，缓慢移动。我们曾大胆地推测，海洋或许曾经是高山，而此刻我们脚下的地面，或许能够直接触及云朵。当这些曾经看过天空或是水底的地面，终于遇见曾经千百里、百万里外的同伴时，它们会迸发出最耀眼也最灼热的光芒。
“在这个过程中，我的父母抬起了头，疑惑着究竟是什么让大地的血液沸腾。我跟在他们的后面，踩着他们曾留下的脚印，想向大地寻求一个答案，而后人的脚步最终会覆盖上如今我们的，他们将继续走下去。
“这就是我们生命的意义。”
——艾雅法拉为参与拍摄的火山纪录片《一步，又一步》所撰写的开场白

text.en:
Eyjafjalla's health isn't the best right now, but she still insists on climbing the Unna Volcano.
As her assistants, there was nothing we could do to talk her out of it...
Even before we reached the mountain, she was already starting to pass out from fatigue. She couldn't even hear us warning her. I know that Unna has seen a clear fluctuation across all indicators, and it's in prime observation condition, but pushing herself like that without regard for her own health is clearly against the most basic rules she taught us herself.
Worried about her, we've been following her.
The residents of the village all seem to know her very well. While still at the foot of the mountain, we rested a little and reorganized. Perhaps I should've tried to talk to her again...
......
We finally made it to the summit, but Eyjafjalla didn't start recording data right away.
Instead she dug a shallow hole and buried... a small rock.
Is something going to grow from this?
There are also the garlands of flowers she's been holding onto the whole time, and she kept hugging them tight even though she almost tripped a couple times. But suddenly, those two garlands just up and fluttered away. What a shame! Even though there wasn't any wind at all.
Still, I don't think I've ever seen her look so gratified...
text.zh:
艾雅法拉前辈的身体状况不是很好，但她还是坚持要登上乌纳火山。
我们几人作为她的助手，没能劝得动她……
原本在山腰时前辈已经因为体力不支差点晕倒，连我们的提醒她都没能听见。我明白乌纳火山最近有明显的数据波动，是非常值得观测的状态，但是像这样不顾身体前往，明显已经违背了前辈自己之前教我们的最基本的规定。
出于担心，我们一直跟到了现在。
村中的居民们似乎很熟悉艾雅法拉前辈，我们还在山下进行了一段小小的休整，或许在那个时候我就应该再劝一次的……
……
终于登上了山顶，前辈却没有第一时间记录数据。
前辈挖了一个浅浅的坑，埋下了一块……小石头。
这会长出什么来呢？
还有前辈一路上都护着的花环，她明明差点就摔倒了也还抱在怀里，但刚刚那两个花环突然飞起来，飘走了。好可惜！明明没有起风……
可前辈看起来很欣慰的样子……？

value.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

text.en: Originally registered at Rhodes Island as the leader of the Glasgow Gang, she later worked alongside us as the leader of the Exemplars during the Londinium War. Now, as the Speaker of Parliament, she maintains our cooperative relationship. Rhodes Island has been supporting Londinium's healthcare system, and Vina Victoria has pledged to broaden our partnership in other areas.
text.zh: 最初以格拉斯哥帮头领身份登记为罗德岛干员的推进之王，于伦蒂尼姆战争期间又以典范军领袖身份与罗德岛协同行动，现在则以伦蒂尼姆议会议长身份，和罗德岛保持合作关系。罗德岛为伦蒂尼姆的医疗建设提供了支持，维娜·维多利亚也承诺未来将在更多领域与罗德岛展开合作。

text.en: Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected. [Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0% Vina Victoria shows no signs of Originium infection. [Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.16u/L After the war, Vina Victoria completed another physical examination. The medical report was submitted by a local operator from the Londinium branch, and contains subjective assessments (see below) which I recommend removing from the file. 'I personally saw her battle at Silverrock Bluffs, a literal mountain of Originium. She charged to the frontlines with no protective gear, but somehow avoided infection. It's been days since then, and I can't help but wonder if that was a sign that Victoria can lead us through tough times.' What, should we check if she gets food stuck in her teeth during meals too? If not, maybe that means Victoria will sweep away the old refuse and lead us into a glorious future? Maybe we're placing way too many expectations on a single person. ——Morgan
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
维娜·维多利亚没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.16u/L
战后，维娜·维多利亚重新接受了体检。体检报告由办事处的一位伦蒂尼姆本地干员提交，其中存在部分有失客观的评价（如下所示），建议从档案中删去。
“我亲眼看到她在银石崖是怎么战斗的。那是涌动的源石构成的山峰啊，她没穿戴防护设备就冲在最前面……居然都没有感染。几天了，我还是忍不住想，这难道是某种预兆，是她能带领维多利亚挺过难关的预兆……”

下一步是什么，维娜吃饭有没有塞牙也要被解读一下吗，如果没塞牙就说明她清理旧时代糟粕能势如破竹？一个人真的能承受住这么多期望吗……
——摩根

text.en:
Initially, most of our operators had a limited understanding of Vina Victoria due to significant gaps in her records, which were based entirely on scant personal details leaked by the Glasgow Gang to HR.
However, when she returned to Rhodes Island as the Speaker of Londinium's Parliament, she quickly changed those perceptions.
Many noticed that, as Speaker, Vina acted with more caution, likely due to her new status.
According to the Glasgow Gang, Vina 'has a particular fondness for strange-flavored candies', but when the 'Odd-Food Enthusiasts' of Rhodes Island offered her a super-spicy star-anise-and-angelica root lollipop, Vina politely but firmly declined. There was also a rumor that she 'likes to doodle on her clothes'. However, the operators know that the intricate embroidery and patterns on her royal garments are definitely not doodles.
Many have remarked that Vina has become more laid-back and carefree after coming to Rhodes Island.
How about the claim that she is 'a picky eater who hates potatoes'? This was disproven after she was seen, on several occasions, chowing down on the nutritious meals provided by Hibiscus. The assertion that she is 'low energy and sluggish' was also quickly debunked. According to our operators, Vina actively takes part in many activities at Rhodes Island, including postpartum care for burdenbeasts and test-driving Engineering's new tractor.
What should we make of the changes in Vina Victoria's lifestyle? That's still being looked into. However, it is clear that many of the personal details leaked by the Glasgow Gang and recorded in Vina's file were simply pranks and should be removed.

Pranks?! If you remove anything, you're boneheads! You hear me, HR, official boneheads! I'll fight every single one of you!—Indra
Vina once said she liked sour lollipops because the intense sourness made her feel more alive. It's probably the same reason I enjoy the awful, nearly expired sauce from Old Hank's shop.
As for the claw marks she draws on her clothes, she said it's to let the ingrates see at a glance what kind of marks she can leave on them.
As for her hating potatoes, that part's true, but it also shows her determination and resolve. She even dragged Hannah into the boxing ring once, to get her to eat all her potatoes for her.
And the reason she can fall asleep anywhere is because she's always exhausted. I get that—if I had to be two people at once, I'd be tired too.
That's the Vina I know, and no one can tell me otherwise! These new 'records' you're adding are nothing but lies.

—Morgan
But whenever we see her, she's the same old Vina. She still shoves her potatoes onto Hannah's plate like always.
—Dagda

Hold on, Dagda, that isn't contradictory. While I no longer dislike potatoes, it's still funny to put them on Hannah's plate... But Mr. Recordkeeper sir, everything Morgan said is completely true as well! I've even fallen off the tram while dozing off...
Tch, never mind, why am I bothering to explain this? Anyway, those are all things I've done, so just leave them in my file!
—When the Glasgow Gang caused a ruckus at HR, Vina attempted to mediate.
text.zh:
先前，由于维娜·维多利亚履历的严重缺失，大部分干员对她极为有限的认知来源于格拉斯哥帮成员向人事部抖露的有关维娜个人生活习惯的信息。
然而，当已经成为伦蒂尼姆议会议长的维娜·维多利亚回到罗德岛时，她很大程度上颠覆了这些认知。
许多干员观察到，身为议长的维娜在行事时似乎多出了一些出于身份考量的顾虑。
据格拉斯哥帮成员所述，维娜“对怪味糖果情有独钟”，但在罗德岛的怪异食物爱好者团体端着特辣八角折耳根棒棒糖找到维娜时，维娜以委婉礼貌的方式表示了坚定的拒绝。关于维娜“喜爱在衣物上进行涂鸦”这一点，所有干员则非常肯定，维娜那身王室装束上华丽的刺绣与雕纹，绝对不是什么涂鸦。
但与此同时，也有许多干员表示，维娜在罗德岛上的行动只是变得更加自由随性了。
至于维娜“稍微有点挑食，尤其不爱吃土豆”，在她多次被目击抱着芙蓉提供的营养餐大快朵颐后，被证明并不属实。而维娜“缺乏精力，较为嗜睡”的说法很快也被证伪，许多干员表示，维娜在罗德岛停留期间精神抖擞地参加了诸多活动，包括但不限于驮兽的产后护理教学、工程部新型拖拉机试驾等。
维娜·维多利亚生活习惯的改变该如何理解，还有待进一步观察。但首先，曾经由格拉斯哥帮成员提供，并记录在维娜个人档案中的诸多生活习惯，大概率只是出自格拉斯哥帮成员的恶作剧，有必要从档案中移除。

恶作剧？从档案中移除？！这是人事部哪个天才想出来的，我要去和他单挑！
——因陀罗
维娜说过，她喜欢酸味的棒棒糖，是因为那种浓郁的酸味让她觉得自己活得真实，那大概和我喜欢吃老汉克店里那种尝起来像快过期了的劣质酱料是一回事，我能懂。
至于她在自己衣服上画的那些爪痕，她说过是为了让那些不知好歹的家伙看到她的第一眼，就明白她能给他们留下什么样的爪痕。
还有不吃土豆，维娜喜欢什么讨厌什么的时候比谁都坚决，她为了让汉娜帮她吃掉土豆，可是拖着汉娜上过拳台的。
以及，维娜随时随地都能睡着也是有原因的。她说是因为自己总觉得疲惫，这我也明白，如果我同时要当两个人，我也累。
这些都是我认识的维娜，怎么就不属实了？我看新增的档案才不属实！
——摩根
可是维娜每次来见我们的时候，都没什么变化……她甚至还会若无其事地把土豆塞进汉娜盘子里？
——达格达

等等，达格达，这根本不冲突，虽然我现在不讨厌土豆，但给汉娜塞土豆还是很有趣……记录员先生，摩根说的那些也完全属实！我还因为打瞌睡从电车上栽下去过……
啧，算了，我解释个什么劲啊。总之所有这些都是我干过的事，麻烦都给我留在档案上！
——格拉斯哥帮大闹人事部时，维娜试图调解

text.en:
[Classified Log]
I don't know precisely what trick Kal'tsit used, but she did manage to get Siege, who was living in fear in a foreign land, to let down her guard and treat Rhodes Island as a second home. During that time, she would even drag Kal'tsit to their Glasgow Gang dormitory to watch movies.
So, when Kal'tsit finally called her by her full name, 'Alexandrina Vina Victoria,' all her hair stood up. I remember it clearly: she smacked Mon3tr with a hammer so hard it started buzzing; you could hear it from the hallway.
But she only hit it once. This time, she didn't run away.
—■■■

[Voice Log]
Doctor, I've actually never been sure whether the path I'm on is one I've chosen for myself. From my biological father, to the dukes who sent him to the gallows, to the 'Unicorn' pulling strings behind the scenes... they've all tried to control my life, pushing me into different roles for all sorts of purposes. But I can't see what lies ahead. I really don't know what path they've put me on. To be honest, I hate it.
When I first came back to Londinium, I thought I was heading home to deal with some minor family issues. I never imagined I would end up where I am now, doing what I'm doing. But Dr. Kal'tsit did, didn't she? Right from the beginning. Even when she first brought me to Rhodes Island, she was already looking toward Londinium, wasn't she?
Ha, you won't deny it. I only just realized that Dr. Kal'tsit—and even you, Doctor—have already thought more about my life's trajectory than I had. All while leaving me completely in the dark.
What, you think I'm angry? Not at all. I think of it as you competing against those who've tried to manipulate me, and helping me defeat them. I don't regret my choices in the slightest, and neither should you.
text.zh:
【权限记录】
虽然不知道凯尔希最初到底用了什么小伎俩……但她确实成功地让那个在异地他乡活得战战兢兢的推进之王放下了层层戒备，把罗德岛当成了她的第二个家。那段时间她还经常拖着凯尔希去她们格拉斯哥帮的宿舍看电影呢。
所以呢，当凯尔希终于对她叫出“亚历山德莉娜·维娜·维多利亚”这个名字的时候，她全身上下都炸了毛。我记得可清楚了，她一锤子把Mon3tr敲得嗡嗡叫唤，在走廊里都能听见哦。
但她也只是敲了那一锤子而已。这一次，她没有选择逃离。
——■■■

【语音记录】
博士，我其实很久以来都不清楚，我的路到底是不是由我自己走出来的。从我的亲生父亲到把他送上绞架的公爵，再到藏在幕后的“独角兽”……都在试图操纵我的人生，为了各种各样的目的，把我塞到各种各样的位置。可我看不了太远，每时每刻都不知道自己被他们安排在了什么样的轨迹上。说实话，我很讨厌这样。
当初启程来伦蒂尼姆的时候，我只觉得自己是要回一趟家，解决家里冒出的一点小问题……我根本没想过自己会坐到现在的位置上，做起眼下这些事。但凯尔希医生早就想到了，对吗？从一开始把我带上罗德岛的时候，她的目光就已经放在伦蒂尼姆了，对吗？
哈，你没否认。我也是才意识到，凯尔希医生，甚至博士你，都比我更早地考虑过我的人生轨迹——而我毫不知情。
什么，你以为我要生气？怎么会。我觉得，就当成你们是在和那些想要操纵我的人同台竞技，然后帮我打赢了他们吧。我一点也不后悔自己的选择，你可一定也别后悔啊。

text.en:
The Holy Orb of Order, a symbol of the Victorian parliamentary system, is usually held by the Speaker (the King themself). It is made of a special alloy crafted by royal alchemists; its deep blue hue emits a mysterious, shifting glow when placed in the light. It is adorned with a golden band in the center, set with various dark gemstones. There are two different Holy Orbs of Order: one engraved with a red dragon, and the other with a lion. The former belongs to the Draco royal family, and the latter belongs to the Aslan royal family. Eventually, the orb with the red dragon disappeared along with the Draco royal bloodline, while the orb with the lion has been passed down through the Aslan royal family for generations.

Professor Briggs, 65 years old, and a faculty member at Victorian National University, tearfully recounted his experience. According to him, the current Speaker of Parliament, Vina Victoria, unexpectedly approached him one sunny afternoon, seeking information on the Holy Orb of Order. After Professor Briggs carefully explained the orb's history and political significance, as well as the process used to make it, the Speaker revealed her true purpose: she wanted to repurpose it into a voting bell to remind members to attend votes punctually! She even planned to make replicas and distribute them to every MP!
Professor Briggs deeply regretted not asking for clarification in the beginning. He tried to 'hypnotize' the Speaker with his words, hoping she would forget this absurd idea as well as what he had told her, but unsurprisingly, he failed. In his despair, he cried that a royal heirloom, the sacred symbol of Parliament, should never be desecrated like this—and if it were, it certainly would not be in relation to him.
The Speaker, however, had a different perspective. She boldly asserted that since both the Holy Orb and the voting bell are used to maintain parliamentary order, they are clearly the same thing.
—'Londinium Bi-Monthly,' Headline News, 'Parliamentary Relic or Gold-Plated Alarm Clock?'

Your Grace, we are losing Victoria.
The Duke of Wellington's stance is clear, and his will is firm. We have no way to respond by force, lest we provoke another war. While Tara's economy is imbalanced, its foundation remains strong. You would need to collaborate even more closely than you currently do with the other dukes if you want to put economic pressure on the Duke of Wellington.
On the other side, only Alexandrina and Parliament remain. As you said, there is no need to rush in and get involved; rather than seizing authority, Alexandrina seems to be building her own power base in a land where previous sources of authority have already been shattered. The power she is accumulating... we could have harvested it.
However, as I've mentioned several times in my reports, her methods are unconventional. She appears adept at dismantling established symbols of power. Though she is currently powerless against the crown, the Holy Orb of Order has already been reduced to what common folk jokingly call a 'gold-plated alarm clock.'
I don't know how she plans to establish her authority after so eagerly dismantling the existing symbols of power. I believe her approach will lead to one of two outcomes: either she will quickly be hanged by her own people, or she will create a kind of power we've never seen before and can't ever hope to harness.
—Report submitted to the Duke of Caster, intercepted by Operator Harmonie and secretly forwarded to Rhodes Island

Ha, it's happening all over again. I pass some bills in Parliament, and they remain indifferent... but when that little orb is placed on the lathe, everyone gets so worked up.
When all else fails, shake things up! That still works in politics, from time to time.
—After reading the above report, Vina laughed.
text.zh:
秩序圣球，系维多利亚议会秩序的象征，通常由议长（即国王本人）持有。圣球球身由皇家炼金术师所炼制的特殊合金制成，呈正蓝色，在光照下会显现出变幻莫测的奇异光泽。球中央饰有金带，上面镶嵌着多种深色宝石。秩序圣球共有两枚，一枚上雕着意象化的红龙，一枚上雕着意象化的狮子，分别由德拉克王室与阿斯兰王室持有。后来，雕红龙的那枚与德拉克王室的血脉一同失踪，而雕狮子的那枚则由阿斯兰王室传承至今。

现年65岁，在维多利亚国立大学任教的布里格斯教授，眼角噙着泪向我们叙述了他的遭遇。据称，现任伦蒂尼姆议会议长维娜·维多利亚在某个风和日丽的午后毫无征兆地找上他，咨询了秩序圣球的相关信息。待布里格斯教授细致入微地讲解了圣球的历史渊源、政治意义、制造工艺后，议长才表明，自己的真实目的竟然是要将圣球改造成用来提醒议员及时到场表决的表决钟！她甚至还计划仿造一批，分发给每一位议员！
布里格斯教授无比悔恨自己没能提前问清缘由，他试图以语言进行催眠，想让议长忘记这荒唐的想法，也忘记他讲解的内容，但他毫无悬念地失败了。事后，他绝望地表示，王室代代相传的珍宝，议会秩序的神圣象征，绝对不可以被如此亵渎，就算被亵渎，也不该与他有关。
对此，议长则有不同的看法。据说她大胆断言，圣球是用来维系议会秩序的，表决钟也是用来维系议会秩序的，那它们显然就是同一个东西……
——《伦蒂尼姆双月报》头条新闻，《议会圣物还是镶金闹钟？》

公爵大人，我们正在失去维多利亚。
威灵顿公爵的态度很明确，也很坚决。在不挑起另一场战争的前提下，我们暂时还无法做出太强硬的回应。塔拉的经济结构虽然有失平衡，但其基础并不薄弱。要在经济上钳住威灵顿的命脉，需要您与其他几位公爵紧密合作，更甚于现今可能达到的程度。
另一边，就只剩亚历山德莉娜和她的伦蒂尼姆议会。如您所言，我们没有必要急于干涉，比起攫取权力，她更像是在一片权力已经被打碎的土地上重新建立权力，而她所建立的权力，本可以由我们来摘取。
但如我多次在报告中提及的，亚历山德莉娜的手段并不寻常，她似乎十分擅长消解既有的权力符号。虽然她暂且对那顶王冠无能为力，但议会的秩序圣球，据我所知，已经被她消解成哪怕普通人也会打趣称作是“镶金闹钟”的东西了。
我不知道她如此急切地消解权力符号，还如何能建立起自己的权威。我认为她这样做的结果只有两种，要么，她很快就会被她自己的人民挂上绞架，要么，她创造出某种我们从未见过，也无法利用的权力……
——一份呈给开斯特公爵的报告，由干员和弦截获，并秘密抄送至罗德岛

哈，又是这样。我在议会厅里通过了什么法案，他们无动于衷……反倒是把那颗小球放上车床，就叫这么多人紧张成这样。
在桌子上能做的事做完以后，就得及时把桌子掀了——哈，这招在政坛上也还是这么管用。
——读完上述报告，维娜笑道

text.en:
This one? This is a photo that the Count of Schutzbury gave me. Don't worry about who he is for now... Can you guess what it's of?
Right, it's just a blurry mess, I can't make it out either. The day he gave it to me, he didn't prattle on about his usual theories of justice. Instead, he looked at this blurry photo and went on and on about what he saw in it: a bakery with a red sign, selling the worst bread on the block. Yet, homeless people would gather in front of it every night, eating the leftover bread the owner had left out. There was a sunken area on the road in front of the shop, where water would collect every time it rained. The neighborhood children would pick up the bread wrappers thrown away by the adults and fold them into paper boats to float in the water, etc...
I later found out that his unusual behavior was something Vina had orchestrated.
Strange, isn't it? Morgan and the others told me that Vina used to be like all the other street thugs—she despised nobles to her core. Two months ago, I would have had a hard time imagining her speaking with any noble for ten minutes without throwing a punch. In the past two months, she's made more new noble friends than I've made new intelligence contacts. Of course, she still hates salons, fancy dinners, and balls, but at least she's willing to let a viscount talk about his family's ancestral beliefs before raising her fist, or let a scholar explain some new, emerging political theories, or let an army officer recount the social ills he's witnessed firsthand. Just like how she used to listen to me talk all night about Lynncardine. It seems like she is trying to understand the Victoria she's determined to shatter.
Victoria is dirty, but it's also proud. Over a thousand years ago, when the Draco people were still nomadic tribal leaders, they pieced together the earliest form of Victoria using a framework borrowed from Sargon. But the fundamental source of their power was still their ability to protect their people—something they took pride in. That pride has been passed down, stumbling along the way, to the present day. Every noble child still blindly recites 'Honor her glory, shield and protector,' just as their ancestors did, though they no longer can see the people they need to protect.
I think Vina must have seen that pride, which is why she's holding back her fist for now. She wants these people to open their eyes and see Victoria the way she does. So, while riding in Count Schutzbury's hot air balloon, Vina pressed his head down, making him look at the streets below, showing him that the people he treated like trash also had lives of their own. What he couldn't see, Vina described to him, street by street, until the sky began to lighten again, until the hot air balloon was frosted over.
After they came down, Count Schutzbury immediately called back those poor souls he had thrown into the boiler room without any protective gear. He started telling everyone about the sights he saw, the things he had learned for the very first time. Of course... we all know this was probably just momentary self-reflection. Vina opened his eyes, but in the end, he will most likely close them again.
But even so, for Victoria, this is a big deal.
—A conversation between Delphine and the Doctor
text.zh:
这张？这张是舒茨伯雷伯爵送给我的照片。先不用管他是谁……能猜出这拍的是什么吗？
对吧，一团模糊，我也看不出。那天，伯爵一反常态地没有唠叨他那套有关公义的理论，而是对着那张糊成一团的照片，滔滔不绝地讲他在里面看到了什么：一家红色招牌的面包店，卖的是全街区最难吃的面包，但流浪汉们每晚都会聚在他家门口，吃着老板放在那的剩面包；店门前道路上那块凹陷，每到下雨天就会积水，街上的孩子们会捡了大人们扔掉的面包纸，折成纸船放在里面……
我后来才知道，他那副反常的模样，是维娜弄出来的。
很奇怪吧？摩根她们和我说过，维娜以前就和其他任何一个街头混混一样，和所有贵族不共戴天的。放在两个月以前，我都很难想象她能跟任何一个贵族说上十分钟的话还没伸出拳头。但这两个月来，她新结交的贵族朋友比我新联络的情报人员还要多。当然，她还是很讨厌那些沙龙、聚餐和舞会，但至少她在抬起拳头之前，愿意先听一位子爵谈论其父辈传承下来的家族信念，听一位学士解释学界不断完善的政治理论，或是听一位长官讲述自己亲眼所见的社会污点，就像她当初彻夜听我讲丽茵卡登的事情那样。维娜似乎在试图理解她决心要砸碎的那个维多利亚。
维多利亚是肮脏的，但她也是骄傲的。上千年前，还是游牧部族领袖的德拉克，用他们从萨尔贡借来的体制框架拼凑起了最初的维多利亚，但他们权力的根本来源，仍是他们保护人民的能力——他们为此感到骄傲。这种骄傲磕磕绊绊地传承到今天，每个贵族子弟还是会懵懂地跟着父辈念诵“恩敬她的荣光，坚盾与守护者”，他们只是不再看得见需要守护的对象。
我觉得维娜大概是看见了这种骄傲，所以她暂且收住了自己的拳头。她想让这些人睁开眼睛，也看见她眼中的维多利亚。所以，在舒茨伯雷伯爵的观光热气球上，维娜摁着他的脑袋，让他看着身下的街道，看看那些被他当垃圾处理掉的人，是不是也有自己的生活。他看不见的，维娜就给他讲，一条街道一条街道地看，一条街道一条街道地讲，直到天边第二次泛白，直到热气球上都挂了霜。
从那上面下来之后，舒茨伯雷伯爵立刻把那些没拿到任何防护设施就被他扔进动力层锅炉间的可怜人送了回来，还到处去跟人讲述他这么多年来第一次看到的那些景象。当然……我们都知道，他大概只是一时的自我感动，维娜让他睁开的眼睛，他最后还是会眯上。
可哪怕是这样，对于维多利亚来说，也很不容易了。
——戴菲恩与博士的谈话

text.en:
[Voice Log]
Thank you for your skepticism, Feist.
...No, of course I don't want the military-industrial complex to dominate Victoria's future—that would only turn Victoria's future into Ursus's past.
My hope is only that any new technology retains the potential for military application.
My teacher told me that Rhodes Island will guide us down a path that confronts the destiny of the land. He wasn't speaking metaphorically. It was never Rhodes Island that pulled Victoria into the Core countries' political struggles: Victoria was inevitably being drawn into a much larger vortex.
When Rhodes Island reaches the end of its mission, I hope that we, and Victoria, will stand in the right position. By that time, I don't want her to be held back by an unwieldy industrial system or outdated military technology.
And until then... I assure you, nothing born from your hands will become an extension of anyone's ambitions.
text.zh:
【语音记录】
谢谢你的质疑，费斯特。
……不，我当然不希望军事工业在维多利亚日后的工业体系当中占据主导位置，那只会让维多利亚的未来变成乌萨斯的过去。
我只是希望，任何新技术都能保留其作为武器呈现的那种可能性。
老师和我说过，罗德岛会引我们走向一条直面大地宿命的道路……他这么说的时候，不是在打比方。从来都不是维多利亚把罗德岛卷入了核心圈政治博弈的漩涡之中，而是维多利亚无可避免地被卷入了某种更大的漩涡之中。
待罗德岛行驶到它使命的终点时，我希望我们、维多利亚，能站在必要的位置。到那个时候，我不希望她会被臃肿的工业体系和过时的军事技术拖住脚步。
而在那之前……我向你保证，从你们手中诞生的一切事物，都不会成为任何人野心的延伸。
