text.en: Reed previously applied to withdraw while stationed at a Rhodes Island branch office in southern Victoria, and has only recently reestablished contact with us. Presently actively leading a small force within Victorian borders under Dublinn's name, with her primary objective being to aid those Tarans forcefully displaced.
text.zh: 苇草，驻留罗德岛的维多利亚南部办事处期间，曾提出撤离申请，近期再次成功与罗德岛建立联络。目前正以深池名义带领小股部队在维多利亚境内活动，以救助被暴力胁迫的塔拉人为主要行动目标。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 10%
No apparent proliferation in Reed's surface Originium crystals compared to before she disembarked.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.22u/L
The emergency treatment of Operator Reed left a deep impression on all attending Medical Department Operators. While huge challenges were posed during the procedure, her condition was nevertheless successfully stabilized.
'Upon regaining consciousness, the first thing the patient asked me was 'Why save me?', which I had no idea how to respond to... *sigh* I wonder if she's found her answer now?'
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】10%
和离舰之前的检查结果相比，苇草体表的源石结晶没有明显增加的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.22u/L
参与过那场急救的医疗部干员都对干员苇草的身体状况印象很深。虽然过程很艰难，但病情的确被成功控制住了。
“患者清醒后问我们的第一个问题就是‘为什么要救我’，这可叫我怎么回答呀……唉，她现在找到答案了吗？”

text.en:
In order to keep her identity concealed, Reed applied to Engineering for a new weapon when she left. Left unable to discuss it with the applicant, Engineering had to estimate her Arts characteristics and combat tics based solely on her old lance. Even so, judging by post-reboarding tests, this new weapon is an unexpectedly superior fit for Reed; or perhaps, as Reed herself says, her previous weapon simply didn't fit her at all. She seems to feel a sense of freedom now that she can lay down her old weapon, but nevertheless asked that Rhodes Island keep it appropriately stored in the warehouse.
[Originium Arts Overview]
Reed now has precise control over her Arts, and testing them no longer requires the grounds to be cleared of personnel, nor does Reed herself express strong opposition.
I recall an operator once permitted to observe her in combat, who was practically stunned, even frightened by the energy innate to her casting. Now, however, her Arts manifest in a completely different form. Several theoretical Casters have confirmed that her Arts, as ever, accelerate activity within organic tissue, but said acceleration has clearly become more controlled. Rejuvenation of flesh spurs rapid healing of wounds, while neuronal replacement inhibits the transmission of pain. No longer does life rapidly wither to her Arts; now it shines with fresh vitality.
To so significantly alter how one's Arts are cast without any long-term training is, for the caster, potently dangerous. After our repeated inquiries, Reed conceded that she endures a level of burning pain in limiting her Arts' energy and constraining their use purely to therapy, but stated that as no practical harm comes to her body, no concern is needed.
It goes without saying that that destructive power still lies within her blood, and in testing that, or sending her directly into combat missions, we continue to observe how the instantaneous rush of her flames can burn anything and everything to ashes. She has simply chosen to reveal the therapeutic side of her Arts to us, for that is the peace embodied by her dreams.
text.zh:
为了隐藏身份，苇草在离开时向工程部申请了一柄新的武器。在没能成功与申请人展开交流的情况下，工程部干员唯有依照她的旧枪推测她的源石技艺特性和战斗习惯，不过，从本次返舰后的测试情况来看，这柄新武器却出人意料地更加适合苇草，或者，如苇草本人所说，只是过去的武器太不适合她。她似乎为自己能放下那柄旧枪而感到解脱，但同时也请求罗德岛将其妥善保存在仓库中。
【源石技艺概览】
苇草已经能精准地控制她的源石技艺了，现在对她的源石技艺进行测试时不再需要事先清理场地内人员，她本人也不再表现出强烈抗拒。
我记得，此前罗德岛上被准许观看她战斗的干员几乎都曾为她法术中蕴含的能量感到震撼，甚至恐惧，但现在她的源石技艺表现形式已经截然不同。多位理论术师确认，她的法术依旧在加快生物组织的活性化，但这种加速现象明显得到了控制。新生的血肉促使伤口迅速痊愈，神经细胞的更替使得疼痛的表达同时被抑制。生命不再因为她的法术而迅速凋谢，反而焕发了新生。
未经长期训练就如此大幅度地改变自己法术能量的释放方式，对施术者本人而言是极具风险的。在我们的反复询问下，苇草承认，当抑制自己源石技艺的能量，使其仅用于治疗时，自己会承受一定的烧灼感，但躯体并不会受到实际伤害，所以不必担心。
毋庸置疑，那毁灭性的力量依然存在于她的血液里，去测试她的破坏性，或者直接将她派遣到作战任务中，我们依然会看到她瞬间迸发的烈焰是如何将一切都烧成灰烬。只是，她选择向我们展示自己法术的这一面，因为这样的平静，才是她的梦想。

text.en:
Reed was highly positive during her reexamination at Medical. This stems partly from her preexisting trust established with Rhodes Island, but also from having accepted her identity as a Draco, and the responsibilities that follow. These days, she does not worry about allowing Rhodes Island to get a hold of information on the Draco, nor whether her simple touch would inadvertently burn another to ashes.
Most of the time, Reed is as calm as ever. The minority of operators who came into direct contact with her in the past all recall how often she'd wake from a stupor with a shudder, eyes filled with fear, yet not say a word to indicate what weighed on her mind. This extreme resistance to contact with others was alleviated somewhat after repeated attempts by Rhodes Island's operators and the Doctor to communicate, but the comfortable, assured way she now talks from time to time is truly gratifying to all who care for her. If raising the topics of Victoria's present theater of chaos or her own duties, she'll be extremely earnest and prudent in offering her own thoughts; meanwhile, when you touch on local lays of the land, on poetry and hopes for the future, she'll bare her own sincere bereavement and affection, without even realizing.
At the end of her stay at Medical, Reed was actively asking about issues relating to Oripathy treatment and protection.
By no means is it the first time Reed has asked a Medic Operator something of her own accord. In fact, before she last left Rhodes Island to set out, she spent several days and a huge amount of effort packing medical articles, and her luggage practically transformed into a medkit. For every way to die she could imagine, she thought of a way to resist it, which might have been a mechanical way of affirming life's value to herself at the time. Happily, her medical preparations may well have saved the day in practice, and now Reed asks for the sake of far more than her own.
Based on her accounts, Oripathy infection rates among Tarans are relatively high owing to the majority working under conditions of inadequate protection; conversely, the relentless pace of Dublinn's battles sees casualties emerge infected one after another. She feels she has to address this somehow, perhaps because she is the Leader, or perhaps simply because she is their companion.
Besides that, at some point prior to Operator Saileach disembarking, she and Reed had had a lengthy conversation in the library. Reed's latest return to the landship coincidentally saw her meet Saileach again, who was reboarding to report in from County Hillock. Over these past several months roaming Victorian soil, a change has been evident in the both of them. Seeing Saileach leave the reception room alone with much weighing on her, we had our reservations that, similar to her fellow former Victorian serviceman Bagpipe, Saileach would be at irreconcilable odds with Reed, who presently fights for Dublinn's cause.
But the next day, an operator saw the two of them together in a corner of the library. Absorbed in a novel, Saileach never so much as lifted her face to greet the operator passing by, while Reed was taking a small break—head resting in her arms in a picture of tranquility—with a half-filled sheet of letter paper laid by her side. Until Reed left the library in the afternoon to visit Medical, not a word seemed to come from that corner, only the calm rustle of pages flipping and the soft scratching of a pen.
Not long after, we noted that a great deal of Saileach's report highlighting the full course of events at County Hillock and how the Tarans were surviving, was referenced from Reed.
text.zh:
再次接受医疗部检查时，苇草表现得很积极，这一方面是出于她与罗德岛已经建立起的信任关系，另一方面，则是因为她已经接纳了自己德拉克的身份，以及与之相伴的责任。如今，她并不担心让罗德岛掌握一条德拉克的情报，也不再担心自己只是触及他人就会不慎将人烧作灰烬。
大多数时候，苇草依然很安静。过去少数几位直接接触到她的干员，都记得她是如何多次颤抖着从昏迷中惊醒，眼神里充满惊惧，却又对自己的所见所想不发一言。这样极度抗拒与他人交流的状况，在罗德岛干员及博士本人反复的沟通尝试后有所缓解，但此次返舰期间她偶尔表现出的、自在地侃侃而谈的模样，才真正让关心她的各位感到欣慰。如果与她说起维多利亚眼下的乱局，或者她自己的责任，她会极其认真而审慎地给出自己的想法；而谈及风土人情、诗歌和对未来的期望时，她会不自觉地流露出属于她自己的，真诚的哀伤与喜爱。
在医疗部停留的末尾，苇草主动问起了矿石病治疗与防护相关的问题。
这并不是苇草第一次主动向医疗干员提问。实际上，在上一次离开罗德岛踏上旅途之前，她曾经连续数天花费极大精力去整理医疗用品，几乎将自己的手提行李箱变成一只医疗箱。一一历数死亡的手段，一一思考与之抗争的方法，这对于当时的她来说，或许是一种对生命价值的机械性确认。值得高兴的是，那些预备的医疗物资或许确实派上了用场，而现在苇草也不仅仅是为自己而发问。
据她所述，由于大部分塔拉人在缺少防护的环境里工作，塔拉人的矿石病感染率相对较高；另一方面，深池不断战斗的过程中，感染的伤员也会陆陆续续出现。她感到自己必须为此做些什么，也许是因为她是领袖，或者只是因为，她是他们的同行者。
另外，干员琴柳离舰前，二人曾在图书室的一角久久交谈。这次苇草回到罗德岛本舰，恰好再次遇到了从小丘郡回舰报告的琴柳。在如今的维多利亚土地上漫游过数月之后，她们显然各自有了转变。看到琴柳心事重重地独自从会客室离开时，我们曾一度担心，同为前维多利亚军人的琴柳会像干员风笛一样，与如今为深池而战斗的苇草产生不可调和的矛盾。
但次日，有干员在图书室的角落里见到了二人。沉浸在小说中的琴柳并没有抬头与路过的干员打招呼，苇草则正在小憩，枕着手臂，十分安静，手边放着写了一半的纸笺。直到下午苇草离开图书室前往医疗部之前，那个角落似乎都没有传来谈话声，只有安然地翻动纸页的声音与沙沙的书写声。
随后，我们在琴柳的报告里看到了许多引自苇草的，关于小丘郡事件前因后果和塔拉人生存状况的介绍。

text.en:
We've already had a run in with Dublinn forces in Londinium; each participating operator may well have their own understanding of what Dublinn is. Reed did not come back to Rhodes Island in her Dublinn capacity, but she does not refrain from recounting to us the Dublinn she knows—as well as the Dublinn she considers herself to lead.
The name of Dublinn finds its origin in the two sisters' family name, one that was hidden by wandering for years and symbolizes their Draco bloodline. That said, the vast majority of Victorians would think little upon hearing it; the leader of Dublinn may well have chosen the name to stir up that forgotten history that comprises the Kingdom of Tara.
The Kingdom of Tara was founded by a Draco nomad in what is currently the Taran region. Thereafter, according to Victorian historical accounts, Victoria and Tara opted to merge so as to fend off the Nightzmora's Khagan, with Victoria conferring the title of King Gaeil upon Tara's ruler. However, with the amassing of relics, data, and oral tradition from the folk sphere in recent years, more and more scholars of Taran historical texts and culture are inclined to believe that the Kingdom of Victoria subjugated the Kingdom of Tara by force, the latter coerced into having its territory annexed. Some even hold that though the ruler of the Taran region held the title of King Gaeil, it was in fact the Victorian nobles dispatched to the Taran court that held greater authority. Another view largely accepted by modern historians is that in the centuries following their violent conquest, any culture unique to the Taran region had been suppressed and even destroyed by Victoria, with the Tarans' own dignity crushed underfoot as a consequence.
Regardless of what history may lay behind it, the present region of Tara is inarguably lagging in development, and the people subjected to extremely arduous lives. The conflict between speakers and non-speakers of Taran becomes more pronounced by the day; it is in this context that Dublinn arose. Records would indicate that Dublinn's forces have only been active across Victoria's southern regions in the last two years, but in truth, it came into conception approximately seven years ago. And from then until now, its heart has remained the same: the Draco of Tara out to rescue her people from the clutches of suffering.
We have observed signs of conflict between different factions within Dublinn. Some are more concerned with the Taran name, while others seek to see the Draco dynasty restored; yet another side with no ties to the first two sets its sights on Dublinn's most powerful backer, the Duke of Wellington. Reed herself recognizes that though she only wishes for the Tarans who suffer to receive fair treatment, she simply cannot avoid the issues implicated by the Draco aspect.
[Classified Log]
Whether Reed's statements or our own independently gathered intel, everything indicates that Dublinn has no intention of vying for the Victorian crown—at least, at present. Reed's twin sister, the Draco Caster that presently commands Dublinn's main forces, is the one and only royal successor to a considerable portion of the population; what obstacles compel her—or what, if any, considerations lead her to take her current approach? Given that all intel paints Dublinn's Leader as a political conniver at ease with contending amidst numerous powers, if she is taking a back seat then it must be in exchange for something.
Perhaps we'll be shown the answer sooner than we think.
text.zh:
我们已经在伦蒂尼姆遇到过深池的部队了，参与过行动的每位干员，或许对深池都有各自不同的认知。苇草并不是带着深池的身份返回罗德岛的，但她也并不避讳向我们讲述她所见的深池，以及，她认为自己所领导的深池。
深池的名字源自姐妹二人的姓氏，这一在漂泊中隐藏多年的姓氏代表了她们的德拉克血统，不过，绝大多数维多利亚人听到时并不会加以注意，而深池的领导者选择这一命名，或许也是想翻动那段被遗忘的塔拉王国的历史。
塔拉王国由一支德拉克游牧民族在今天的塔拉地区建立，随后，依据维多利亚史料记载，为了抵挡梦魇可汗，维多利亚与塔拉选择了合并，维多利亚也将盖尔王的头衔授予了塔拉的统治者。不过近年来，通过搜集民间文物资料和口述故事，越来越多致力于考据塔拉历史文化的学者倾向于认为，维多利亚王国是通过暴力征服了塔拉王国，将后者强行并入自己的疆域。部分观点甚至声称，塔拉地区的统治者虽有盖尔王之名，但宫廷内部实际多由维多利亚派遣的贵族执掌大权。另一个被许多现代历史学者接受的观点是，被暴力征服后的数百年里，塔拉地区独有的文明始终受到维多利亚的压制乃至破坏，与之相伴的，还有塔拉人自身尊严受到的践踏。
无论背后有着怎样的历史因素，眼下的塔拉地区确实存在发展缓慢、人们生活极度艰苦、塔拉语使用者与非使用者之间矛盾日趋尖锐的问题，深池则为此而生。根据记录，深池部队近两年才在维多利亚南部各地有所活动，但实际上，它在约七年前就已经萌生。从那一刻起到现在，它的核心从未改变：塔拉的德拉克将拯救她的子民于苦难之中。
我们能在深池身上看到多方博弈的痕迹。一部分人更在乎塔拉人这一属性，另一部分人则渴望看到德拉克的王朝复辟；还有一些与二者都无关的势力，正将目光投向深池最有力的支持者，威灵顿公爵。苇草本人也认同，即使自己只是希望苦难中的塔拉人能够得到公正待遇，自己也无法逃避德拉克这一身份所牵连的议题。
【权限记录】
无论是苇草的陈述还是我们收集到的其他情报，都确实证明，深池无意、至少眼下无意争夺维多利亚的王冠。作为大众眼中唯一的王位继承人，苇草的双胞胎姐姐，如今率领着深池大部队的那名德拉克术师，是碍于怎样的胁迫，或是出于怎样的考量，才暂时摆出如此态度？既然所有的情报都将深池的领导者形容为在众多势力间周旋自如的权术家，她一定以自己的退让换取了什么。
或许我们很快就会看到答案。

text.en:
Knowing that the Dublinn leader we recently encountered in Londinium was Eblana herself, we can understand to a certain degree why Reed fears her twin sister so much, even having warned Rhodes Island to avoid contact with her. Fortunately, she did not react with the same intense stress as before when we raised the topic of her sister again, after receiving our intel from Londinium. Instead she recounted, quite calmly, her past experiences as her sister's 'shadow,' and filled in some information which had been hazy in our records. Through Reed, we gained an explicit understanding of how the Dublinn leader's Arts manifest, and confirmed the combat MO of a portion of Dublinn's spec ops personnel.
Later, she informed us that she still didn't quite grasp what goal Dublinn had in entering Londinium, and so couldn't approve of said action for the time being, but would be sure to meet with Eblana directly at an appropriate time in the future.
We were concerned that whether out of a desire for vengeance, or to prove her sister's wrongdoings and vie for leadership of Dublinn, the now-uncurbed Reed seemed on the verge of a clash with her sister, perhaps even to the death. However, she reassured us that this was not the case. By her account, the primary Dublinn force commanded by Eblana seems to have come to an unspoken understanding about Reed, ceasing their pursuit of her, while also regarding her and her companions as comrades, one and all. At present, each side is committed to their own plan of action, existing in some kind of pseudo-harmony.
'She knows—that I'll return to her side, even if she doesn't pursue me, that's all. What I think, what I want—none of it matters to her. She's always believed... that I'll never avoid her, or escape from her grasp.'
'Me? ...It doesn't matter to me either. If she fights for the life the Tarans deserve, then she and I are fundamentally doing the same thing. Is it that important that I matter?'
text.zh:
既然近期罗德岛在伦蒂尼姆遭遇的深池领导者就是爱布拉娜本人，那么我们一定程度上可以理解，为何苇草对自己的双胞胎姐姐如此恐惧，甚至曾警告罗德岛不要与之接触。所幸，当我们带着在伦蒂尼姆获得的情报，再一次向苇草提起她的姐姐时，她没有像此前那样出现强烈的应激反应，而是较为平静地讲述了她过去作为对方“影子”的经历，并为我们补充了记录中一些模糊的信息。通过苇草，我们得以确切理解深池领导者的源石技艺表现形式，并确认了深池部分特种作战人员的作战方式。
随后，她告知我们，她尚未完全了解眼下深池进入伦蒂尼姆有什么目的，因此暂时不能认同这一行动，但之后她一定会在合适的时间，直接去见对方。
我们曾经担心，无论是出于复仇之心，还是为了证明对方的错误、与对方争夺深池的主导权，已经挣脱控制的苇草似乎都要与姐姐发生剧烈的冲突，甚至不死不休。不过，苇草本人并没有这样的想法。而根据她的叙述，爱布拉娜所率领的深池主力部队似乎也与她形成了某种默契，停止了对她的追捕，并且将她和她身边的人一概视作同僚。眼下，双方各自执行着自己的行动计划，几乎相安无事。
“她知道，我一定会回到她身边，所以不用追，仅此而已。我在想什么，我想要的是什么，她都不在乎。她相信到了最后，我躲不开她，也逃不出她的掌控。”
“我？……我也不在乎。如果她在争取塔拉人应有的生活，我和她做的，本来就是一样的事情。我自己，很重要吗？”

text.en:
Before leaving Rhodes Island, I had left those knots I could not untie, could not face, in a letter to you. I remember I could not muster more than a word or two, but once I set my pen down, I felt I finally had the courage to trust in my own conscience... to trust that 'life has its value,' as Rhodes Island taught me.
Yet... if life had value, it must have been a dearly, gravely heavy one, so heavy I didn't know how I could bear it. I could not answer why Outcast saved me, the taker of countless lives, as I was dying. If I was not simply fuel for the flames, then what should I be?
I had to emerge from this refuge, so I could answer her, answer all of you.
And now, I pen a letter again, to tell you of what I found, and of my answer.
...
And so, my identity is one I cannot flee. Am I a Taran? I am; am I Dublinn? I am; am I the Draco? I am.
Am I Dublinn's Leader? I can be.
I want them too to see how life should be, and should that duty choose me, I will flee no longer.
Doctor, I am aware. Choosing to return to Dublinn signifies that no longer do I seek first and foremost to protect and save the Oripathy-blighted, and that I cannot anymore avoid the hostility of some by your side. I have thought, and thought, and before I return to the Rhodes Island landship, I will have written and sent you this letter.
I will not become an enemy to Rhodes Island. But should you not approve, I will not return to Rhodes Island unpermitted, posing as an operator. That is all for you to decide.
text.zh:
离开罗德岛前，我曾将我无法直面的心结，留在给你的信中。我记得，自己能写下的不过是只言片语，只是落笔之后，我终于感到自己有勇气去相信我心中的良知，相信罗德岛教我的“生命有其价值”。
可是，生命若有价值，那一定会非常非常贵重，重得我不知如何承担。我无法回答，Outcast为何要救下将死的我，曾夺去无数生命的我。我若不止是燃料，又该是什么？
为了给她回答，给你们回答，我必须从避难所中走出去。
而现在，我再次提笔写信，想要告诉你我所见到的，以及我的答案。
……
所以，我的身份，我无法逃避。塔拉人，我是；深池，我是；德拉克，我是。
深池的领袖，我可以是。
我想让他们也看到生命所应有的样子，而如果那份责任选择了我，我不会再逃跑。
博士，我知道，选择回到深池，意味着我最先要保护和拯救的不再是矿石病人，也意味着，你身边一些人对我的仇恨，我再不能逃避。思来想去，在回到罗德岛的舰船之前，我写成这封信送给你。
我不会成为罗德岛的敌人，不过，你不认可的话，我是不会擅自回到罗德岛、以干员自诩的。一切由你决定。

value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Confirmed Infected by medical examination.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

text.en: Following extensive training and practical experience, Kroos has been smoothly promoted to formal Operator status, principally tasked with field missions. Under the guidance of Rhodes Island's Instructors and from tempering in the field, she has greatly matured, gaining her own insight into and views on firing techniques and concealing movements.
text.zh: 经过长久的训练与磨砺后，克洛丝顺利晋升为正式干员，主要负责外勤任务。在罗德岛教官的指导和外勤任务的磨炼下，她已经成长许多，在射击技巧与隐匿行动上有了自己的心得与看法。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 10%
Very fortunately, she continues to present no obvious external symptoms of Oripathy.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.25u/L
Oripathy shows signs of spread, owing to her undertaking of long-term field assignments. Close attention needs to be paid.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】10%
体表仍未出现明显的矿石病病征，可喜可贺。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.25u/L
因长期承接外勤任务，矿石病有扩散的迹象，需要密切注意。

text.en:
After years of maturing, everyone can clearly see how Kroos has transformed. Is she taller? For a fact. Is her hair longer? Sure is. Have her tastes shifted? Seeing how she dresses now, you'd be right. Apart from those changes though, she still seems to be the same Kroos we know and love. She loves to play, laugh, and goof off. However, if you ever see her curled up in some corner, napping, pay careful attention to whether she really is off-guard. The old her would lazily greet you as you approach, still half-asleep. Now? Get just a little closer, and next second you'll find yourself caught her trap. Then she'll shoot to her feet, free you from it, and tell you in that same old tone that it was just a little prank. But after seeing her proficiency at disassembling her traps, and that her crossbow was specially refitted with a bayonet, we're sure you'll realize at least one thing.
No longer is she Reserve Operator Kroos.
text.zh:
经过了这么多年的成长后，所有人都能明显看到克洛丝的改变。长高？的确高了。留长发了？是这样的。品味变了？看看她现在的着装，的确如此。除去这些变化外，她好像还是我们所熟悉的那个克洛丝，爱玩、爱笑、爱偷懒。只是，当你看到她缩在哪个角落里打瞌睡时，请仔细观察一下，她是不是真的毫无防备。如果是从前的她，当然会在被惊醒后懒洋洋地和你打个招呼。至于现在？只要多走近一步，下一秒，你就会落入她的陷阱，而她会站起身子，把你从陷阱中解救出来，用着和从前一样的语气，告诉你这只是一个小小的恶作剧。但看着她熟练收拾陷阱的动作，还有那把特殊改造后加装刺刀的弩，你也确实应该意识到这么一件事。
她已经不是预备干员克洛丝了。

text.en:
Excerpts from Kroos' trapping notes: On 'Magic Tricks'

'Marathon Alarms'
This is that prank Fang and the rest pulled to get me out of bed, but now I finally get to use it on others! Wish I could see the looks on their faces when they wake up from their nap to find a few extra alarm clocks~
Notes: Not to be used bedside or on people in deep sleeps, they'll wake up grumpy.
......
People stuck in combat situations get very sensitive to sounds. That's how they become part of the trap themselves, one after another. Can completely numb the enemy's senses, or alert teammates that they're coming. But not all that practical, on account of all the alarm clocks you'd need. Switch out for appropriate substitute based on the battlefield.

'Invisible Warning Tape'
There's a lot of fun to be had with a roll of clear sticky tape. Most classic's when you stick strips all across a doorframe and lead a good friend into it. Watching them get stuck or even trip really brings a smile to your face!
Notes: Target must however be chosen with care, and watch the mood they're in. If it doesn't turn out funny, apologize straight away.
......
At first I used tactical rope, but nowadays this purpose-developed tripwire has the edge in concealment, weight and price. Based on real combat testing, this see-through thread gets exactly the effect you want, and even marries well with other traps. Gives you a level of lethality from the materials alone, and can be wound in a pinch to work as tactical rope. Considering how all-purpose it is, I should apply for a reel with Logistics next time I'm out on the field. Majorly useful.

'Hollow Cake'
Preparing this one's a pain in the rear, but especially funny. Hollow out a hole in a cake, fill it with other stuff and then re-cover. Wait for everyone's looks when they come to eat the cake and find 'something nice' inside.
Notes: Some people don't have very good teeth, so make sure not to stuff anything too hard in.
......
You're not just limited to food when you pull this one in practical combat. Kettles, cupboards, supplies. Just use your thinker, and the world's full of stuff to use against your enemies.

'Me'
My mates have always loved showing up next to me from out of nowhere to scare me, which got me thinking: if I use myself to draw their attention, won't it be even harder for them to notice all the little shadows where I've tucked my pranks?
Notes: People have all their focus on you when they scare you, so you'd best not make any moves and give it away.
......
What does the enemy most want to see? Me, of course. Me, hurt. Me, dead. The instructors said: 'No hunter hunts forever.' There'll always come a day when a Sniper Operator becomes someone else's prey. So why not... treat myself as bait, and give the other guy a 'nice surprise?' Right, no hunter hunts forever, but there are some hunters who'll disguise themselves as the prey.
text.zh:
克洛丝的布陷笔记节选：关于“小戏法”

“闹铃阵”
从前芬她们拿来喊我起床的恶作剧，现在终于有机会用在别人身上啦！不知道在打瞌睡的人突然发现周围多出好几个闹铃后会是怎么样的表情呢~
备注：不应当在床边或对陷入熟睡的人使用，他们会有起床气的。
……
陷入战斗状态的人对声音都很敏感，既然如此，它自然可以成为陷阱的一部分，一个接着一个，将敌人这一方面的感官完全麻痹或者提醒队友敌人的到来。但考虑到对闹铃的消耗，实用度并不高，依据战场环境会替换相关材料。

“透明警戒线”
一卷透明胶能玩出很多花样，最经典的当然就是在门上拉好多胶带然后把好朋友引过来啦，看着他们被粘住或者绊倒还是很开心的！
备注：但是要谨慎选择目标，而且要注意对方的情绪，如果闹不愉快的话要马上道歉。
……
最初使用的是战术绳索，但最近研发的专用绊索在隐蔽度、重量和价格上都更有优势，根据实战检验，这种透明细线完全可以达到预期效果，甚至与其他陷阱搭配，本身就可以凭借材质起到一定杀伤能力，应急时还可以扭在一起当做战术绳索使用。考虑到泛用性，下次出外勤时应该向后勤部门多申请一卷，很好用。

“空心蛋糕”
这个做起来还挺麻烦的，但特别有意思。把一个蛋糕切开挖空，填进其他东西以后复原，然后期待大家在吃蛋糕时发现里面有个“好东西”时的表情。
备注：有些人牙不是太好，所以填进蛋糕的东西不要太硬。
……
实际战场上使用这一技巧时不会局限于食物，水壶、橱柜、补给物资，只要开动脑筋，很多东西都会提供一个与敌人抗争的机会。

“我”
以前大家都喜欢突然出现在我身边吓唬我呢，所以我就想，如果我用自己把他们的注意力吸引过来的话，是不是他们就更不容易发现那些潜藏在暗处的小恶作剧了呢？
备注：因为大家在吓唬你的时候注意力在你身上，所以人最好不要有动作哦。
……
敌人最想要看到什么？当然是我。一个受伤的我，一个死去的我。教官说过：“没有永恒的猎手。”总有一天，狙击干员会变成别人眼中的猎物。那为什么，不把自己当做诱饵，给别人一个“惊喜”呢？是呀，没有永恒的猎手，但有会把自己伪装成猎物的猎手呢。

text.en:
After passing the examination and becoming a formal Operator, Kroos is now qualified to accept solo missions. Her treatment of assignments is painstakingly conscientious. She can delicately sort out all manner of conflicting views, and she's more than fluent in communicating with her employers. She's never had a contract broken or an assignment failed. When on field missions with other operators, she rigorously abides by schedules and even raises her own views, all to ensure the mission succeeds perfectly. When on break from field work, she remains aboard Rhodes Island, where she'll assist the instructors by sharing her combat experiences with the reserve operators. Or perhaps she'll take part in some recon and solo operation training, either way keeping her itinerary full. The Kroos of today is a cheerful, good-humored, and self-disciplining woman; she's discarded her bad habits, and strived to excel at what she does. You've long since known that Kroos was worth trusting, but now you can rest easy while she's on almost any assignment, because you know she'll never betray your confidence.
The facts have proven as much.
text.zh:
在通过考核成为正式干员后，克洛丝拥有了独自承接委托的资格。她对待任务认真且细致，能够很好地处理各种矛盾，与雇主们的沟通也十分流畅，基本没有出现过违约或任务失败的情况。在与其他外勤干员一同执行外勤任务时，能严格遵守时间安排，甚至提出自己的见解，保证任务圆满完成。当没有外出事项时，她会留在罗德岛上，担任教官团的助教，与预备干员分享她的作战经验；抑或是参加些侦察、单独行动方向的训练，把自己的日程安排得满满当当。现在的克洛丝，是一个开朗、幽默、自律的克洛丝，她摒弃了身上的坏习惯，努力让自己变得更优秀，更强大。你很久以前就知道，克洛丝值得信赖，但到现在，你能够安心地将绝大多数任务派给她，因为你知道，她绝不会辜负你的信任。
事实也的确如此。

text.en:
At this point, how long has Kroos gone without rest?
It all depends on how you define 'rest.' If it means closing her eyes and sleeping, she isn't much different from back then. But if rest means unloading her burdens and falling deep in dreamland without a care in the world?
In that case, it's been a very long time now.
Because of her mistake.
Or put another way— what she's fixated on as her mistake.
In Rim Billiton, when Reserve Op Team A1 still operated together, a bolt skewered the body of a squadmate, and it left its eternal scar on Kroos' spirit too.
If only she hadn't been nervous, if only her shot hadn't strayed, if only she'd kept tighter aim, none of it would've happened.
This is what she tells herself.
Again and again.
On the battlefield, everything changes in the blink of an eye, and she'd already done the best she could. Everyone told her that.
But, after seeing that scar in front of her, she still can't forgive herself.
She should've done better.
She has to do better.
......
Ever since then, her sleep's become unusually light.
She confirms the rustle of every blade of grass, every sound on the pavement, one by one.
She's scared.
Scared of her own negligence, of allowing another crisis to befall a comrade.
She's long since been unable to sleep soundly, even aboard Rhodes Island.
And the reward she most hopes for at the end of a hard day's work has changed too, from a neverending dream, to a simple breather on a bench.
This, for her and her alone,
is the price of maturity.
text.zh:
克洛丝已经多久没有休息了？
这全看你如何定义“休息”这个词。如果它的含义是闭上双眼睡眠，那克洛丝和以前并没有什么区别。但如果说，它的含义是卸下重担，毫无负担地沉入梦乡？
那么，她已经很久没有休息了。
因为她的失误。
或是说，她所认定的，自己的失误。
在雷姆必拓，在曾经的行动预备组A1还共同行动时，一支弩箭刺穿了队友的躯体，也在克洛丝的心灵上永远留下了一道伤痕。
如果没有紧张，如果没有射偏，如果自己能盯得更紧些，这一切本不会发生。
她这么对自己说。
一遍又一遍。
战场是瞬息万变的，她已经尽力了。大家都这样告诉克洛丝。
但是，当看到那道伤痕时，克洛丝还是没法原谅自己。
她本应做得更好。
她必须做得更好。
……
从那以后，她的睡眠变得非常浅。
风吹草动，走道杂音，她都要一一确认。
她在害怕。
害怕自己的过失，再次让同伴陷入危机。
即使是在罗德岛上，她也早已无法安眠。
而她最期待的奖励，从一场永不醒来的睡梦，变成了长椅上的闭目小憩。
这便是独属于她的，
成长的代价。

text.zh:

value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Confirmed Infected by medical examination.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

text.en: The Doctor and the Medical Department have approved 'Perfumer' Lena's request for temporary assignment to the Minos region, where she will direct the newly established Athenius office in establishing a local system for Oripathy treatment. Operator Podenco will supervise the Convalescent Garden while Lena is away.
text.zh: 调香师莱娜，在与博士和罗德岛医疗部沟通后，将疗养庭院暂时交予干员波登可负责，并主动申请外派至米诺斯地区，担任新建立的雅赛努斯办事处的负责人，为当地建立感染者医疗体系。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 3%
Minor infection. Crystal formations have not been observed on the surface of the body.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.2u/L
Operator possesses significant medical knowledge and cooperates with treatment. Her condition is under control.

Certain herbal remedies have been demonstrated to be effective in containing the progression of Oripathy. While the medical benefit of fragrances in Oripathy treatment has not been established, it can certainly have a relaxing effect, or allow the subject to temporarily set aside deeply-rooted biases. As an Infected from Minos, she has a more personal understanding of the interaction between psychology and Oripathy than you and I.
—Warfarin
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】3%
轻微感染，体表未生成源石。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.2u/L
该干员具有较为丰富的医学常识，积极配合治疗，病情已得到控制。

一些草药粉剂对源石感染的抑制效果已经得到充分证实，无论香气是否对治疗有助益，它至少能舒缓精神或是让人暂时抛开某种根深蒂固的观念。心理与矿石病的关联，作为米诺斯的感染者，她比你我更有体会。
——华法琳

text.en:
A caladium plant on one of the Convalescent Garden's shelves was the first to notice that something was off with Lena. Highly sensitive to changes in moisture, the plant had heretofore received the most tender care possible in the greenhouse, but now the edges of the leaves had begun to grow yellow, only returning to their previous color when Podenco discovered the issue and recalibrated the humidifier. Numerous minor incidents like this continued to occur throughout the week—pruning shears not being returned to their proper place, pesticide cans being filled with water, plant names spelled wrong on fragrance tags... When Podenco witnessed the normally steady and dependable Lena mix up pepper and cardamom, resulting in a sneezing fit, she was convinced of one thing: her performance evaluation had begun.
Lena had always been meticulous about the Convalescent Garden, after all. She hardly ever made errors, and would certainly not break the rules that she herself had set. She had built the garden from a few seeds and design books that she brought from her homeland, carefully picking the right flowers to grow, and developing it into a space for fragrance therapy. It was a labor of love, her pride, and one of the most popular hangouts for Rhodes Island operators.
It thus came as a shock when Podenco anxiously completed her seventeenth 'evaluation item', and learned that Lena was leaving to become the supervisor of the Athenius office. Perhaps this trip home had special meaning to Lena, or perhaps she received a letter from an old acquaintance inviting her to reveal some hidden past... Podenco realized that Lena was testing whether she was ready to take over management of the Convalescent Garden, which implied that Lena was likely not coming back. The empathetic Perro sniffled as she expressed her worries to an HR operator while preparing a parting gift for Lena.

Why am I going back to Minos? Heh, tell Podenco not to overthink it. I knew Rhodes Island was going to establish a new office in Athenius, and it just made perfect sense that I should be involved. I was a little concerned about what would happen to the garden, but she has been particularly passionate about her work lately. It would have been a much harder decision if not for her. Huh? A performance evaluation? Oh dear, I didn't even realize I've been causing so much trouble for her... I suppose the prospect of returning home has made me nervous.
—Lena's explanation when submitting her disembarkment application
text.zh:
最先发现莱娜有点不对劲的，是疗养庭院一区植物架上的彩叶芋。这种对湿度要求十分严苛的植物总是在温室里受到最精细的养护，而现在它们的叶片却出现了发黄焦边的情况。幸亏波登可换班时重新校准了加湿设备，这才让小家伙们重焕绿意。类似的小意外在之后的一周里时有发生——使用完毕的园艺剪没有归位，本该存放除虫药剂的喷罐中装的是清水，熏香标签上记录的植物名有拼写错误……当波登可亲眼看到自己稳重可靠的莱娜姐姐把胡椒和小豆蔻搞错，一连打了十几个喷嚏之后，她确信了一点——自己的绩效考评开始了。
毕竟，作为疗养庭院的管理人，调香师莱娜一向严谨、细心，不会打破自己定下的规矩，极少出现差错。她仅靠自己从故乡带来的花种和几本庭院设计指南，开始规划整片庭院的布局，精心挑选适宜种植的花卉，打造芬芳疗法所需的特殊空间。毫无疑问，这座庭院是莱娜引以为傲的作品，后来也成了舰上最受罗德岛干员欢迎的地方之一。
因此，当波登可战战兢兢地完成了第十七个“考评项目”，得知莱娜小姐即将离开本舰，担任雅赛努斯办事处的负责人时，她着实吃了一惊。或许这次归乡的时间点对莱娜小姐来说有特殊的意义，又或许她收到了来自故人的信件，邀请她一同揭开尘封的往事……波登可恍然大悟，原来所有的“考评项目”只是莱娜小姐在用不露声色的方式测试自己是否能全权接手疗养庭院繁忙的工作，而这很有可能意味着她本人不会再回来了。善解人意的佩洛一边向人事干员表达自己的担忧，一边吸了吸鼻子，为自己的前辈，体贴的莱娜姐姐，准备起最后一份礼物。

为什么回米诺斯？噗，你让波登可别多想，我早就知道罗德岛想在雅赛努斯设立新的办事处，我去帮忙理所应当。本来还有些担心庭院的花草，但那个孩子不知道为什么最近表现得异常热心可靠。要不是她，我其实还没办法那么快做出决定。“考评项目”？啊，原来这段时间我给她添了那么多麻烦……或许这就是近乡情怯吧。
——莱娜递交离舰申请时的补充说明

text.en:
Many came to see the scion of the famous Athopoulou family when the Rhodes Island office was first established. From her botanical fragrance, to her gentle words, to the meticulous craftsmanship of her dress... everything about her was the very image of a well-bred young lady. She took young patients into the hills to pick herbs on sunny days, teaching them about the leaves and roots of medicinal plants, and the process that turned them into medicine to relieve pain. She told children who feared that their illness would prevent them from becoming heroes that they themselves would be the first person they saved, and it would be their first step on the path to becoming a hero.
Surprisingly, Dr. Lena has received mixed reviews in the office's recent patient surveys. One patient complained that she had banned her from drinking, catching her in under thirty minutes no matter which establishment she went to and preventing her from emulating Bacchus the Drunken Hero. Another lamented that he could not do the work he loved anymore, as he was no longer allowed to swing a hammer with his Originium-covered arm to make weapons in the traditional manner.
Most patients did not believe that the gentle doctor would use forceful measures, until one day a hulking and ferocious patient came rushing out of the consultation room to complain about her at the front desk. The man, a well-known ruffian, claimed that she had insulted his veneration of Heraces, and was trying to record his name in a book so that everyone would know he was a weak Infected. But he quickly lowered his raised fist at the sight of her coming out of the consultation room with her staff in hand, calmly explaining that registration was necessary for the establishment of an emergency medical system, and that the man's actions had demonstrated that he does not truly venerate the heroes, only the muscles that allowed him to bully the weak. She prescribed medicine for the troublemaker, and a bottle of pheromones labeled 'Your Heroic Spirit'.
The concept of 'hero' is a vague one, and everyone's understanding of 'heroic spirit' is different. The idea that Oripathy saps the heroic spirit, an ancient saying of unknown origin, has become a widespread belief in Minos. Even without discrimination from others, those suffering from Oripathy will leave the temples of their own accord, abandon their dreams, and even turn to a life of crime. Fortunately, operators at the office know that all they need to do with patients who have given in to despair is drag them into Lena's consultation room, and their dependable supervisor will use the fragrances of plants to calm her countrymen down.
text.zh:
罗德岛办事处建立之初，许多人都想来看看过去在雅赛努斯赫赫有名的阿苏普欧洛家族的后人，现在是什么样子。芬芳的植物香气，温柔的耳畔低语，做工考究的精致衣裙，一切都符合众人对一位大家闺秀的想象。莱娜会在晴朗的日子，带着感染矿石病的孩子们去山上采摘草药，耐心地同他们讲解叶子和根茎中的成分，告诉他们只要经过哪些工序，手上的花草就可以变成缓解病痛的药物。她告诉那些担心自己因得病无法成为英雄的孩子：“你会是你拯救的第一个人，你的英雄之路从此开始。”
令人意外的是，如此深受孩子们喜爱的莱娜医生，在办事处最近发起的几次就医体验调查问卷中，受到的评价却褒贬不一。有的病人抱怨莱娜医生对她下了禁酒令，无论自己出现在哪间酒馆都会在半小时之内被她逮住，严重影响了自己效仿“沉醉的英雄”巴赫斯；有的病人则沮丧地表示自己再也无法从事心爱的工匠工作，因为莱娜医生不允许他用布满结晶的手臂再次抡动铁锤，以纯粹的古法打造武器。
大部分病人并不相信温柔的莱娜医生会使用如此强硬的手段。直到某一次，一个身材健硕、满脸凶相的病人冲出诊室，直奔前台对莱娜医生发起投诉——当地人都知道，这位闹事的病人是臭名昭著的恶霸。他声称莱娜医生不仅侮辱了他对大力神海格斯的崇拜之心，还想将他的名字登记在册，让所有人知道他是名无能的感染者。话音未落，他扬起的拳头就软了下去。莱娜医生拿着自己的施术法杖走出诊室，语气平静地解释，登记是快速建立应急医疗体系的必要措施之一，另外他的一举一动已然证明他所崇拜的并非英雄，而是他可以用来恃强凌弱的身体资本。随后，她给这名闹事者开了足量的药物，又给他开了一瓶费洛蒙，标签上写着“你所谓的英雄气概”。
“英雄”是个极其模糊的概念，每个人对“英雄气概”的理解也不尽相同，而“矿石病会隔绝英雄气概”这句现已无从考证的古语，在米诺斯却成了大多数人信奉的真理。哪怕没有遭受周围人的歧视，感染者也会自发远离神殿，放弃自身，甚至走上恶途。好在办事处的医疗干员们都知道，一旦遇到自暴自弃的病人，可以将他们请进莱娜的诊室——这位可靠的负责人永远懂得如何用花朵和草木的气息让她的同胞冷静下来。

text.en:
The HR operator lost his way when he came to the 'Mountain-Rimmed Garden' for the first time. When he asked two Athenians where to find the supervisor of the local office, one said that the 'Flora of Athopoulou' was the only Oripathy doctor he knew, before being interrupted by his companion, who said, 'Do not compare an Infected to a hero, even if Dr. Lena has indeed done a lot for us.'
Flora is one of the heroes worshipped by Minoans, the legendary gardener of the 'Mountain-Rimmed Garden'. It is said that she had a superhuman affinity for plants, being instinctively in tune with the breath of nature, even bringing back dead flowers to life. She is the patron hero of Minoans who worked with plants, herbs, and perfumes, and Operator Perfumer's family was no exception. The Athopoulous were once one of the most famous families of Athenius, one that both gardeners and fashion-seeking merchants depended on. The family has long since fallen from its high perch, and most of its members have left Athenius, but there are many who still remember the former head of the family, Steros Athopoulou, and his daughter who left for distant lands at a young age.
Having learned of this past, the HR operator now sat in Perfumer's consultation room, listening to grateful patients call her the 'Flora of Athopoulou'. Seeing no reaction from Lena, the curious operator asked if she felt uncomfortable with the title. She looked surprised for a moment, then answered in the negative.
Returning to the office months later, the operator found that patients were no longer calling Lena by that lengthy title. A short distance away, a smartly dressed, gray-haired Vulpo with a cold expression on her face was writing up a citizen who had committed an offense. She stopped the operator when she saw the Rhodes Island's logo on his clothes, and their conversation was recorded as follows:
'How much do you know about Lena—or rather, 'Operator Perfumer'? How much do you know about the Athopoulou family?
'You've heard what the patients called her... you asked her how she felt? Hah, did you expect her to tell you the truth?
'Of course she was used to it. For the better part of two decades, she sat at the breakfast table every morning hearing her father sing her praises, calling her the brightest the family had ever seen and the 'Flora of Athopoulou', as if those words would do more to help her grow than the cystymilk on the table.
'Of course she could always let go of her past. Most of the family have left Athenius at my 'behest', but why remind her of those days when she was kept chained by training and rules? ...Even if she might not think of it the same way.
'Anyway, I've dealt with the matter. No one will bring it up ever again.
'Why? Because as a former member of the family, I hated the name Athopoulou as much as she did, that's all.'
text.zh:
人事干员第一次来到这座“四面环山的花园”时迷了路。他向两位雅赛努斯人打听办事处的负责人身在何处。其中一位表示，治疗矿石病的医生，他只认识“阿苏普欧洛家的芙罗拉”。然而话未说完，他就被同伴急忙打断——“感染者不应与英雄相提并论，哪怕莱娜小姐确实对我们照顾有加。”
芙罗拉是米诺斯人崇拜的英雄之一，传说她正是这座“四面环山的花园”的园丁。芙罗拉对植物有着超越常人的认知和亲近感，她仿佛天生懂得自然的呼吸，甚至能令花朵起死回生。从事植物品种培育、草药制作、香精调配等工作的米诺斯人将芙罗拉作为信仰的对象，干员调香师的家族也不例外。阿苏普欧洛家族曾是雅赛努斯的名门，无论是需要种子的花匠，还是追求时尚的富商，都与之打过交道。如今，阿苏普欧洛家族已然没落，家族成员大多也已离开雅赛努斯，而曾经受过关照的人仍记得施特罗斯·阿苏普欧洛——上一任家主，有一位很早就已远走他乡的女儿。
对前尘往事有所了解的人事干员坐在调香师的诊疗室里，再次听到接受芬芳疗法的病人感激地将莱娜称作“阿苏普欧洛家的芙罗拉”，而莱娜对此没有任何反应。好奇的人事干员试探着询问莱娜是否因这个称呼感到不适，她愣了一下，随后给出了否定答案。
几个月后，这位人事干员再次来到办事处，他发现病人们似乎不再对莱娜使用原先那串复杂的称呼。不远处的街道上，一位灰发的沃尔珀穿着干练、神色冷淡，似乎正在处理一名犯了错的公民。她看到罗德岛的标识之后叫住了这名人事干员，于是我们便有了这段记录——
“莱娜小姐，你们的干员调香师，你们对她的了解有多少？对于阿苏普欧洛家族又知道多少？
“你听过那些病人是怎样称呼她的……你直接问了莱娜的感受？哈，她怎么可能对你说实话？
“她当然习惯了被那样称呼，在雅赛努斯成长的十几年里，她每天一醒来就会听到施特罗斯先生说，自己的女儿是家族最好的继承者，是‘阿苏普欧洛家的芙罗拉’，好像这句话比餐桌上的瘤奶更能让莱娜长高似的。
“她当然可以放下过去，家族的成员也大多被我‘请’出了雅赛努斯，但何必再用那句荒唐的期盼反复地让她回忆起在庄园里被雕琢与规训的日子……尽管她本人或许不那么认为。
“我已经派人处理这件事了，以后不会再有人提及。
“我为什么要做这些事？作为曾经的‘阿苏普欧洛’，我同她一样厌恶这个姓氏，仅此而已。”

text.en:
A medic found a special notebook in the flowerbeds at the branch office, recording the common and scientific names of plants, as well as short comments written in Minoan—a little dictionary of plants, so to speak. She initially thought it was written by a child who idolized Lena, but it was Lena herself who showed up at the lost-and-found. Lena told the curious operator that she had indeed written those notes herself; however, their purpose was not so much to remember, but to forget.
Lena left Athenius years ago under unspoken pressure from her family, attempting to restart her perfuming career and botany studies elsewhere, but ran into difficulties with communication. The language and naming conventions of the Minoans were shaped by their love of poetry and stories, so without an actual physical object, it was impossible to explain to a Victorian merchant what a 'Reflection of Narcissus' was, and she had a hard time progressing her perfuming work until she memorized the names of plants in the common tongue.
'This was the most basic thing, and what I would tell any Minoan child who wanted to follow in my footsteps. But the truth is, I never spoke the names of plants in Minoan after I left my homeland... I hated them.' The operator's impression of Lena had always been one of polite gentleness. She rarely if ever recalled Lena directly expressing her like or dislike of something. Yet it seems her return to Minos—this 'home' that once rejected her—had caused her to abandon her restraint. 'The scientific naming of plants is structured and objective, reflecting a precise truth, such as their family, genus and species, their discoverer, and their characteristics. Minoan names for plants are vague and ambiguous, full of meticulous poetry. I understand its beauty as well as anyone, but I also understand how it causes people to place expectations upon those names.'
Having grown up shouldering the expectations of her family, it was fortuitous that Lena had a natural affinity for plants and nature. She gladly accepted coursework far beyond what was reasonable for a child, the massive amount of plant names and etymology she was expected to memorize, and her father's pop quizzes, all in the name of her love and passion. At the time, she did not understand the compromise that her harmonious relationship with her family was built upon. Not until she left Athenius and saw flowers from her homeland again did she realize the burden that all the names and stories of plants she memorized had become. She could no longer find it in herself to call them by the names she once knew them by.
On this return to her homeland, and in her communications with patients, Lena once again hears the stories and names of plants that she spent more than a decade memorizing. But she understands that her patients are calling to her in the same way she might instinctively say the name of a familiar plant in Minoan as she gathers herbs in the forests of Athenius alone. The burdens of the past are lifted, and she once again flips through the 'dictionary', communicating with Minoans in the words they are most familiar with. She is now able and willing to extend a helping hand.
text.zh:
一名医疗干员在办事处的花坛中捡到了一本特殊的笔记，上面记录着植物的常用名、学名和似乎是用米诺斯语写成的短语，如同一本“植物词典”。起初她以为这是某位崇拜莱娜的孩子为了学习植物名称留下的笔记，意料之外的是，几个小时后她在失物招领处见到的不是预想中的害羞的孩子，而是莱娜本人。莱娜告诉好奇的干员，这确实是自己过去的笔记，但是比起记忆，它的存在更多是为了忘却。
多年前，在家族不言自明的压力下，莱娜离开了雅赛努斯，试图在其他地方重新开始调香的事业以及对植物的栽培和研究，却在沟通上遇到了困难。米诺斯人热爱诗歌与故事的天性，让他们的语言和命名方法同样呈现出独特的文学气质。她无法在没有实物的情况下向一位维多利亚的货商解释“那赫索斯的倒影”是哪种植物，在记住通用语中对应植物的名称之前，她的调香事业很难顺利进行。
“这是最基础的前提，要是有米诺斯的孩子想成为我的‘后辈’，我一定会这样告诉他们。不过，真实的情况是，从离开故乡起，我就不再用米诺斯语念出任何一种草木的名字……我讨厌它们。”在医疗干员的印象中，莱娜总是温柔得体，极少直接表达对某些事物的喜恶，然而回到米诺斯之后，在这个曾经将她拒之门外的“家”中，她反倒放下了以往的克制谨慎。“植物的学术命名具有一套客观的规范，它反映准确的事实，比如植物的科、属、种，由谁发现或是具有何种特征。而米诺斯语中的植物名称是含混的，它们充满了精心编排的诗意，我比谁都认同它们是美的，但我也知道这意味着人们在这个名称上倾注了期望。”
背负着家族期望成长的莱娜，非常幸运地对植物和自然拥有天然的兴趣。那些超出孩子承受范围的课程、大量的需要背诵的植物名称和典故、父亲随时随地的考验和测试，都被莱娜以“爱好”的名义尽数接受。当时的她并未察觉，自己与家人幸福和谐的关系建立在何种妥协之上。直到她离开雅赛努斯，再次见到产自家乡的花朵，她才意识到自己曾经记忆的每一条植物名称和典故，已经累积成为何种重压——莱娜再也无法轻易用过去的语言称呼它。
这次返回家乡，在与病人的沟通中，莱娜重新听到那些耗费十多年记忆的典故和植物名称，重新听到人们叫出她熟悉的称呼。但莱娜清楚，病人们呼唤她，正如她一个人在雅赛努斯的树林采集时，不自觉地用米诺斯语称呼一株熟知的小草。过去的重压已然消失，她重新翻阅那些“词典”，以米诺斯人熟悉的方式与他们沟通。现在的莱娜有能力，也十分愿意向他们伸出援手。

text.en:
Lena wrinkled her nose. The corridor smelled strange. She had returned briefly from the Athenius branch office, and her ride back to Minos was leaving in twenty minutes, but she smelled something burning as she passed near the Convalescent Garden. The smell was acrid and aggressive, not like ordinary fire, more like some kind of Originium Arts. An enemy attack? But there was also a familiar scent, some kind of bright and sunny flower. The names of a dozen flowers flashed across Lena's mind, but none of them seemed to be the answer. Then she heard scattered sounds coming from behind the garden's door, and the smell grew even more chaotic, without rhyme or reason. For the first time, Lena found herself at a loss as to what was happening behind the door. The unfamiliar sound and smell made her uneasy, but this was the Convalescent Garden, the garden she had built with her own two hands. Lena clutched her staff and pulled the door open sharply—
'So... it was your handiwork I smelled, Podenco?'
'Yes! It's a brand-new essence I developed while you were away!'
'Was it part of the plan to have Beanstalk's metal crab run around with various fragrances?'
'Yes! It helped hide the scent of the small cake from you. Peacake had a lot of fun too!'
'Was Flamebringer in on the surprise as well?'
'He made a charred smell as part of the disguise. Said it was repayment for the flower seeds you gave him!'
Lena shook her head, but her ears betrayed her joy at how a group of operators who had only met because of Rhodes Island and the Convalescent Garden went through all this trouble just to fool her sense of smell and give her a surprise. She blew out the candles, and found herself in no particular hurry to go back to her other home. Why not spend a little more time with her friends here in the garden?
text.zh:
今天走廊的味道不太对劲，莱娜皱皱鼻子。她难得从雅赛努斯办事处回罗德岛本舰，二十分钟后又要搭上返回米诺斯的载具，这个时候却在临近疗养庭院的地方闻到了什么东西烧着的气味——焦糊发苦充满攻击性，不是来自寻常的火焰，更像是来自某种源石技艺。是敌人？不，这里面还有一种熟悉的香气，像某种明媚的花朵，莱娜脑子里出现了十几种花卉的名字，没有找到答案。正在此时，细碎的声音从疗养庭院的门后传出，气味越发混乱，毫无规律可循。莱娜第一次对门后正在发生的事情无从判断，未知的声响和气味让她有些不安。可那是她久违的疗养庭院，她一手打造起来的花园，莱娜握紧手中的法杖，猛地拉开门——
“所以……我闻到的那种气味，是波登可你的杰作？”
“嘿嘿，是的莱娜姐姐，那是全新调配的香精，是你不在的时候我独立完成的作品！”
“豆苗小姐的磐蟹举着不同种类的香精瓶满地乱跑，也是你们计划的一环？”
“是呀，这样莱娜姐姐就不会提前闻到这个小蛋糕的甜味了，豆豆也玩得很开心哦。”
“就连炎客先生都加入了你们的计划？”
“他帮忙制造了焦味作为掩饰，这是莱娜姐姐给他花种的回礼！”
莱娜无奈地摇摇头，耳朵却轻快地抖动，显露出了她的好心情。一群因罗德岛、因疗养庭院相识的干员，做了这么复杂的布置，只是为了瞒过她灵敏的嗅觉，给她一个惊喜。莱娜一口气吹灭了蜡烛，她想在庭院里跟她的朋友们多待会儿，她还不着急从一个家回到另一个家里去。

value.en:
No Originium crystals are visible on the surface of body, but confirmed Infected by medical examination.
Operator Specter's infection symptoms are rather unique, and are undergoing clinical research.
value.zh:

text.en:
Specter, real name Laurentina, is a member of the 'Abyssal Hunters,' an Ægir military squad. She has demonstrated extreme proficiency in operations such as taking down large-scale organisms and destroying hard targets. 
After the 'Stultifera Navis' incident, her mental state and mood began to stabilize, and her memories returned.
text.zh:
幽灵鲨，本名劳伦缇娜，阿戈尔军事团体“深海猎人”成员，在对抗大型生物与破坏硬目标等行动中展现出极强的技巧。
“愚人号”事件后，其精神状态趋于稳定，记忆恢复，情绪趋于稳定。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 14.5% 
It has been determined that the source of her nerve infection is due to excessive amounts of Originium concentrate that was forcibly injected into her spinal cord. Current medical technology is unable to deal with this condition, so this operator can only be administered minimal conservative treatment.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.34 u/L
The Originium infection progress is extremely slow, and even if this does not conform to our common sense, it is still a welcome thing. We speculate that the reason for this phenomenon may be related to the transformation that Abyssal Hunters undergo.

Operator Specter's medical files have been moved to an extremely high-clearance database. We ask that relevant medic operators maintain strict confidentiality.
––Medic Department Internal Notice
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】14.5%
已确认神经感染源头为被强行打入脊髓的过量源石浓液，以现阶段的医疗技术无法处理这种病情，因此只能为该干员进行最低限度的保守治疗。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.34u/L
源石感染进度十分缓慢，即使不符合我们的常识，这仍是件可喜的事，推测其原因与深海猎人接受的改造有关。

干员幽灵鲨的医疗档案已移入高权限资料库，请相关医疗干员做好保密工作。
——医疗部内部通告

text.en:
After the tides of her hometown called her memories and personality back to her, Specter quickly came to accept what had happened to her during her amnesiac period. For a free and easy person like her, having another 'self' was not a bitter pill to swallow. Rather, her mad 'self' merely provided Specter with another angle from which to understand things, greatly broadening her horizons. In this regard, Specter is quite satisfied, although she occasionally regrets that her 'self' was unable to use the inspiration of madness on the right path. As for now, she has ample time to process and digest the impact her 'self' has on her surroundings, Rhodes Island, and other operators. The suspicion and bewilderment on the faces of the operators who had contact with her before brought her no shortage of novelty and amusement. 

Operator Specter's mental state has continued to stabilize as of now, and in theory, the probability of her main persona being replaced again is extremely low. However, during fierce combat, or certain situations that cause her to have intense outbursts of emotion, certain sudden changes to her behaviors have been observed. We cannot say for sure whether this is a relapse of her condition, or if Specter is deliberately imitating her past self in search of 'inspiration.' We recommend continuing closely monitoring the operator's mental state as much as possible. 
––Anonymous Operator, Medical Department
text.zh:
在记忆与性格被故乡的海潮唤回身体后，幽灵鲨很快就接受了自己失忆期间的种种遭遇。对于她这样洒脱的人来说，拥有另一个“自我”并不是件难以启齿的事。不如说，那个疯狂的“自己”为幽灵鲨提供了另一种认识事物的角度，极大拓宽了她的视野。在这一点上，幽灵鲨是十分满意的。只是，她偶尔会对“自己”没能把疯狂的灵感用在正途上感到遗憾。至于现在，现在她有足够的时间去感悟与消化“自己”对周边环境、对罗德岛、对其他干员产生的影响。而那些从前与她有过接触的干员们表现出来的疑惑和不知所措，让她感到新奇与快乐。

干员幽灵鲨如今的精神状态已趋于稳定，理论上主人格被再次替代的可能性极低，然而，在激烈战斗，抑或是某些让她情绪极为激烈的场合下，仍观测到幽灵鲨突然改变其行为方式的现象出现。是疾病复发，还是幽灵鲨在刻意模仿过去的自己以寻求“灵感”，我们尚不得知。建议持续关注，以尽可能维护该干员的精神状态。
——医疗部匿名干员

text.en:
Unlike the elusive Gladiia or the reclusive Skadi, Specter is not only the most approachable Abyssal Hunter, but also the only one who will offer brief descriptions of Ægir for others. After chatting with her, many operators got their first glimpse into this mysterious deep-sea country. 
In Specter's own words, in the ocean far from land's shores lies a utopian country: there is no Originium, the people do not have to worry about survival, and citizens are assigned to work where they are best suited according to their personal abilities. Light covers the bottom of the sea, and each transparent dome carves out a small piece of paradise. Everyday life is filled with various automatic equipment, and almost all mechanized manual labor is completed by high-end technological products. As a whole, the society is even more ideal than the images conceived in Terra's most cutting-edge science fiction novels. 
Specter's descriptions undoubtedly satisfied most operators' conception of an exotic, far-flung country, and they naturally ignored the things she mentioned far less often: the immense pressure that the Seaborn posed to the survival of the Ægir people, and the destruction wrought upon Ægir by the Seaborn's followers. 
The Abyssal Hunters invariably face the same problems on land that they did beneath the waves. 
But due to their lack of manpower, the Abyssal Hunters are unable to change anything. In the face of the scourge of the seas that cannot be completely driven out even with the Ægir's science and technology, what can the land-dwellers' puny technology accomplish? 
This is the Abyssal Hunters' status quo. Gladiia has long been concerned about this, and Specter is well aware of it. 
Having that said, she has no reservations about cooperating with her friends on land. This is not due to some calculus based on ability or practicality, but rather because on an emotional level, she feels that fighting with these soft, vulnerable companions might make miracles. 
That is the reason she leads the charge into enemy lines, her chainsaw's battle-dance opening up the slimmest of chances for her friends. 
After all, she already created a chance for Skadi's team to kill a so-called 'Him.' 
Why can't she do it again?
text.zh:
和神出鬼没的歌蕾蒂娅或是离群索居的斯卡蒂不同，幽灵鲨不仅是深海猎人中最容易接触的那位，同时也是唯一一位会为其他人简单描述阿戈尔的深海猎人。在与她闲聊过后，许多干员第一次对这个神秘的深海国家有了些许了解。
在幽灵鲨口中，远离大陆的海洋下存在着一个理想中的国家：没有源石侵扰，没有生存忧虑，人们按照个人能力被分配至自己最擅长的领域工作。灯光铺满海底，巨大透明穹顶隔绝出一片片乐土，日常生活中充满各种自动器械，几乎所有机械体力劳动都由高科技产物完成。整个社会的样貌，似乎比泰拉大陆上最前沿的科幻小说所描写的场景还要令人向往。
幽灵鲨的描述无疑满足了大多数干员对于遥远国度的臆想，他们也就十分自然地忽视了她较少提及的内容：海嗣对阿戈尔人生存环境的压迫，以及海嗣信徒对阿戈尔造成的破坏。
深海猎人在海面上遇到的问题，在海面下也别无二致。
然而以现在的人力，深海猎人无法改变任何事情，而面对以阿戈尔的科学技术尚无法完全驱逐的海嗣祸患，陆上人那些粗浅的科技又能做到什么呢？
这就是深海猎人们的现状，歌蕾蒂娅一直对此抱有忧虑，这一点幽灵鲨很清楚。
但她倒是对与陆上的朋友合作这件事颇有信心。这并不是出于能力或者实际情况的考量，而是她觉得，从情感上而言，与这些脆弱的同伴们共同战斗，或许能够创造奇迹。
所以她总是带头切入敌人阵线，肆意挥舞着锯子，为朋友们创造些微不足道的机会。
毕竟，她已经为斯卡蒂的队伍杀死那个所谓的“祂”创造过一次机会了。
为什么不能再做一次呢？

text.en:
The operators who take care of Specter on Rhodes Island have found that she tends to stare at sculptures or paintings for a period of time in complete silence. And once Specter returns to herself and expresses her thoughts on these things, the operators finally come to understand that it was her inherent love of art that soothed the scars on her psyche. 
For Specter, art was the expectation bestowed upon her by Ægir society, as well as her own life's pursuit. Thanks to the nature of her parents' work, she had access to Ægir's bountiful art collection since a young age. Among the various art mediums, sculpture left an indelible imprint within Specter. She still remembers that snow-white sculpture. The moment she laid eyes on it, time seemed to stand still the clock's hand refused to turn. She indulged in the eternal giant displayed before her, coming to realize what true art and beauty is. To this day, she does not understand the idea behind the creation's sculptor, nor has she seen that statute again. However, all the emotional expressivity carried in that piece of stone have long found a home in her heart, and she hopes that one day she can become a sculptor acknowledged by Ægir. One day, she, Laurentina, will be able to create her own sculptures. 
If she had not become an Abyssal Hunter.
text.zh:
在罗德岛上照料幽灵鲨的干员曾经发现，她总会盯着雕塑或绘画作品沉默良久，好似在观赏这些作品时，她在精神上能够获得片刻安宁。而当幽灵鲨重获自我，开口抒发对这些物件的看法时，干员们也终于明白，是她天性中对艺术的热爱安抚了精神上的伤痕。
对于幽灵鲨来说，艺术曾是阿戈尔社会赋予她的期望，也是她自身对于生活的追求。得益于双亲的工作性质，她从小就能接触到阿戈尔丰富的艺术藏品，在各种艺术载体中，雕塑带给了幽灵鲨无与伦比的震撼。她仍记得那座雪白雕像，就在看到它的一瞬间，时间不愿流逝，指针拒绝转动，眼前的永恒巨物纵情展现，让她体会到了何为艺术，何为美。时至今日，她仍不了解那位雕塑家创作的理念，她甚至再也没见过那尊雕像，然而这块巨石中承载的所有感性表达，早已留在了她心中，她希望自己能够成为一名雕塑家，而阿戈尔也认可了她的才华。总有一天，她，劳伦缇娜能够创作出属于自己的雕塑作品。
如果她没有成为深海猎人的话。

text.en:
Specter's metamorphosis from a sculpture apprentice into an Abyssal Hunter may appear to be an accident to some; however, what they do not know is that Ægir's technology and institutions can ensure that their chosen personnel will never deviate from the basic needs of their post. Because of this, citizens generally do not refuse when summoned by state institutions such as the Abyssal Hunters. Specter completed her metamorphosis with ease, quickly mastered what she was trained for, and officially became an Abyssal Hunter, hunting Seaborn along with Gladiia. Thus, her obsession with beauty turned into a deep hatred of the Seaborn. It may be the case that Seaborn evolve into striking forms that leave people awestruck, but this cannot be considered beauty - rather, it is more of a byproduct of evolutionary needs. The Ægirians' most ingenious creations are useless pieces of artifice in these creatures' eyes, a perspective that Specter could not tolerate. The 2nd Abyssal Hunter team to which she belonged was once responsible for clearing out a large Seaborn lair: an entire city that had fallen into the sea, its various buildings turned into breeding nests. When she saw the colors bleeding from torn oil paintings and the desecrated stone statues covered with nests, she no longer had any reservations in her heart about slaying the Seaborn. 
Now that civilization has encountered vermin, Specter is more than happy to play the role of exterminator. 
Through their deaths, Ægir's survival is forged.
text.zh:
幽灵鲨从一位雕塑学徒成为深海猎人在他人看来像是一场意外，然而，他们所不知道的是，阿戈尔的技术与制度能够保证选拔出来的人员绝不会偏离其职务的基本需求。正因如此，当受到类似深海猎人这样由国家发起的征召时，国民一般不会选择拒绝。她十分顺利地通过了改造，也迅速掌握了训练内容，正式成为一名深海猎人，跟随着歌蕾蒂娅一起狩猎海嗣。而她对于美的执着，则转化成了对于海嗣的深切仇恨。或许，海嗣自身会进化出令人印象深刻的形态，但那绝不是因为美，而更像是一种进化需求的副产品，阿戈尔人最精妙的文明创造在这些生物眼中只是毫无用途的人工造物，而这一点，幽灵鲨决不容忍。她所属的深海猎人二队曾经负责清剿一处大型海嗣巢穴，整个城市陷落于海中，城里的各处建筑被海嗣用作巢穴。看着颜料散开的油画，以及被损毁后铺满巢穴的石像，她心中再也没有一丝对于杀死海嗣的顾虑。
既然文明遇上了害兽，那么，幽灵鲨很乐意成为一位屠夫。
以它们的死亡，铸就阿戈尔的生存。

text.en:
'You want to know more about the folks who experimented on me?'
'I pretty much exterminated them all, Gladiia.'
'I need to review the information and combine it with the intel provided by Iberia.'
'Alright, let me try to think back.'
'Quintus, the one you ran circles around, is probably the least worth talking about among the bunch.'
'He couldn't see anything outside of the experiments, living inside a dreamscape he wove for himself, single-mindedly power-hungry and conceited.'
'So, it wasn't hard to deal with him, right?'
'Mm, next one.'
'Amaia, that damn Liberi. You probably saw her on that Iberian ship.'
'Elegant, and far more dangerous.'
'That's right. She was in charge of recording down my mental state and providing feedback after the experiment. Given how knowledgeable and accomplished she was, it's a pity she was so well-suited for this job.'
'She might've treated me the nicest among the experimenters, but you know what, Gladiia? She never actually liked me. In fact, she had a lot of things to say about the way we refused to follow nature's ordained trajectory.'
'Hmph.'
'In the end, becoming food for the Seaborn perhaps was what suited her heart best. Alas, for someone like her, Terra's future only has enough room for the Seaborn.'
'It's not hard to find crazed cultists like her along the coast.'
'As for the last guy, he... he wasn't a bishop.'
'Hmm?'
'All I remember is, he was the one who carried out the experiment's procedure... Nngh...'
'Are you alright, Laurentina?'
'I'm fine, I'm fine... Just getting some phantom pains...'
'He rarely showed himself except to conduct the operations... The cultists seemed to call him... 'Sire'...'
''Sire,' huh? I'll remember that.'
'Quintus and Amaia are both dead. That guy will probably be watching his back a lot more carefully from now on.'
'You don't need to worry, Laurentina.'
'I will deal with this scourge.'
text.zh:
“你想了解对我做实验的那几个家伙？”
“他们可基本上都被我们消灭了，歌蕾蒂娅。”
“我需要复核情报，再综合下伊比利亚方面提供的信息。”
“行，让我回忆一下。”
“昆图斯，被你耍得团团转的那个，应该是他们中最不值得谈论的。”
“他见不到实验以外的东西，生活在自己编织的梦境中，一味贪图力量，自傲且自负。”
“所以对付他并不费力，对不对？”
“嗯，下一位。”
“阿玛雅，那个该死的黎博利，我想你应该在伊比利亚那艘船上见过她。”
“优雅，也更危险。”
“是呢，她负责在实验后记录我的精神状态并给出反馈。以她的学识和素养，确实适合做这样的活，可惜了。”
“虽然她是对我最友善的实验人员，但你知道吗，歌蕾蒂娅，她其实并不喜欢我。不如说，她对于我们不顺从天性这点颇有微词。”
“哼。”
“最后成为海嗣食粮，可能也很合乎她心意吧。唉，可能对她这样的人来说，泰拉的未来只容得下海嗣。”
“这样的狂热信徒在海岸边也不少见。”
“至于最后一个家伙……他……他不是主教。”
“哦？”
“我只记得他是实验手术的操刀手……呃……”
“你还好吗，劳伦缇娜？”
“没事……没事……只是有些幻痛……”
“除了进行手术的时候，他很少露面……邪教徒们称呼他为……‘先生’……”
“‘先生’，好，我记住了。”
“昆图斯和阿玛雅都死了，那家伙一定会变得更加谨慎的……”
“你不必担心，劳伦缇娜。”
“我会处理这个祸害。”

value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Confirmed Infected by medical examination.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

text.en: Following both systematic training in medical theory and long-term training in clinical practice, Hibiscus has graduated from intern doctor to formal Medic Operator, as well as one of the Medical Department's attending physicians. Hibiscus possesses not only ample experience in medical field work, but has made considerable contributions to health management and aftercare as a theoretical researcher.
text.zh: 经过系统的医疗理论培训以及长时间的临床实践训练后，芙蓉已经由实习医生转为正式医疗干员，并且成为了医疗部的主治医师之一。芙蓉不仅在医疗外勤任务上有相当丰富的经验，在健康管理以及病后护理的理论研究方面也颇有建树。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 14%
Large abnormal shadows located about operator's thoracic cavity.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.30u/L
Condition provisionally shows no signs of degradation.
'Hibiscus is highly specialized in health management, and she's just as strict on herself as you'd expect. But even so, that battle left a grave impact on her, and the extent of her infection is no cause for optimism. Regular examinations will be needed.' —Ansel
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】14%
干员胸腔部位有大面积异常阴影。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.30u/L
病情暂时没有继续恶化的现象。
“芙蓉小姐在健康管理方面很专业，对自己也很严格。但即便如此，那次战斗遗留下的影响还是十分严重，她的感染程度不容乐观，需要定时接受检查。”——安赛尔

text.en:
We've all borne witness to the growth of the children emerging from Reserve Op Team A1, as a youthful influence and the next generation of Rhodes Island. But among them, the way Hibiscus has changed draws particular attention.
While the maturation of her technique goes without saying, the old Hibiscus who made unyielding demands of everyone around her has 'vanished,' one could say, at some point. How long has it been since anyone's seen her making a grand scene of confiscating a patient's snacks and fiercely requiring them to follow her health schedule to the letter? These days, she need only gently advise them what would be best for their health, and they'll readily comply. We have reason to believe that in her heart lies a kind of innate power to have others warm up to her. She's simply picked up on a better way showing this side of herself to others.
The young pupil nipping at Operator Pith's heels, asking about this and that, day after day, is now a mentor herself, instructing even younger new interns. Without even realizing it, her work within the Medical Department has taken on a degree of professionalism, and you can often find her by hospital beds, patiently soothing patients who are panicked or afraid. It's something no one but her could accomplish... Time pushes us all onwards, never allowing us much of a look back on what we've lose to the past. But now and again, on seeing what's come of this baptism by time, the wisdom gained, how can we not be relieved?
If only everyone were still here for it.
text.zh:
作为罗德岛新一代的年轻力量，从A1预备组走出来的这些孩子的成长，大家都是看在眼里的。其中芙蓉的变化，尤为引人注目。
能力上的成长自不必说，那个总是以最强硬的态度要求身边所有人的芙蓉却也不知道在何时“消失”了。上一次见到芙蓉大吵大闹着没收病人的零食，风风火火地要求病人严格执行她的健康作息表是什么时候的事了？现在的芙蓉，只要温和地告诉病人们怎样做对身体有好处，病人们就都乖乖照做了。我们有理由相信，芙蓉的内心里，天生就有一种可以温暖人心的力量。她现在只是学会了以恰当的方式，将自己真实的一面展示给大家。
之前那个整天跟在干员Pith身后问这问那的小跟班，如今也担起了给更年轻的实习医生解疑答惑的前辈角色。就在不知不觉中，芙蓉已经承担起了医疗部相当一部分专业工作，也能时常见到她守在病床边，耐心安抚着那些惊慌害怕的病人，这的确是只有她才能做到的事……时间总是在推着我们向前走，不允许我们对遗失在过去的东西多加回顾。只是偶尔看到这些经过时光洗礼积淀下来的成果，我们又怎能不欣慰呢？
要是所有人都还在就好了。

text.en:
How long does it take to go from an intern lacking any fundamentals to an attending physician in charge of her own interns? Five years? Ten? To the majority who give up on it partway through, it's a goal that's out of reach for one's entire life.
Certainly, many medical personnel aboard Rhodes Island are astounding in terms of professional ability and reserves of knowledge. But for them, finding the time to systematically teach students the vast swathes of modern medical theory is near-impossible. Under those circumstances, Hibiscus simply had to treat every practical as an opportunity to learn. She meticulously summed up her medical experience, earnestly took note of every bit of wisdom her seniors offered, seized nearly every free moment to pour through reference materials, and gradually digested it all until she finally attained a comprehensive mastery.
Hibiscus has an exceptional amount of experience in her chosen vocation of patient care, and her gentle personality and delicate mood allows her treatments to proceed without a hitch. Having acquired enough medical knowledge over the years, Hibiscus has been attempting to synthesize a systematic theory of healthcare based on her initial field of expertise, nutrition. The value of her current research results has been recognized even by Dr. Kal'tsit. Guided by her theories, Hibiscus has directed a gradual upgrade of the Medical Department's ward facilities. And judging by the recovery of the patients afterwards, these measures have shown clear results.
'The idea of medical treatment isn't just to bring patients out of life-threatening situations. It's just as important that we provide ample care to the sick, keeping their bodies and minds healthy so they can fend off encroaching illness. It's long-term work, and requires plenty of patience, attention, and concern for your patients from the bottom of your heart.' An additional paragraph authored by Hibiscus, from a revision of the Rhodes Island Medical Department handbook.
text.zh:
从毫无基础的实习医生到一名可以独当一面的主治医生需要多久？五年？十年？对于在这条道路上半途而废的大多数人来说，这是一生也无法达到的目标。
罗德岛上的确有许多专业能力和知识储备都极为杰出的医疗人员。但是对于他们来说，也很难专门抽出时间来系统性地将庞大的现代医疗理论教授给学生。在这种情况下，芙蓉所能做的，就是将每一次实践都当作学习机会。她一丝不苟地总结医疗经验，认真记下前辈提到的每一个知识点，然后利用几乎全部的空余时间去查阅资料、慢慢消化，最终融会贯通。
芙蓉在照顾病人的本职工作上有着非常丰富的经验，温柔的性格与细腻的心思让她在医疗护理上得心应手。在积累了足够的医疗知识后，芙蓉正在尝试以自己原本就擅长的营养学为基础，总结一套系统性的医疗护理理论。目前已有的研究成果得到了凯尔希医生的高度认可。以这套理论为指导，芙蓉主导了一次医疗部病房设备的升级换代。从之后病人的恢复情况来看，这些措施的确取得了明显的成果。
“医疗的概念，绝不仅仅是在危急时刻将病人带离生命危险。给予患者充分的关怀，让他们的身体、心理都维持在一个健康的状态，以抵御疾病的侵害，这也是医疗重要的一环。这是一项长期的工作，需要充分的细心与耐心，还有对病人发自内心的关怀。”在罗德岛医疗部修订版手册中，芙蓉加上了这样一段话。

text.en:
When Rhodes Island's Medic Operators are carrying out field missions, they typically have at least one Field Operator accompanying, so as to ensure the safety of medical personnel. We noted a fair degree of disconcerting information in reports from Field Operators who've worked alongside Hibiscus.
'Mission got off to a rocky start. Local Infected was clearly cautious of, even hostile towards us...'
'I was a hair from beating the hell out of him. What reined me in in the end wasn't Rhodes employee regulations, it was Dr. Hibiscus... I know he was Infected. I am too, so is Dr. Hibiscus. He was clearly aware she had saved his life. So how could he say those things to her... No conflict ultimately arose between us.'
The above is an extract from one such Field Operator's mission report. However, similar notes appear in the reports of many other operators that work with Hibiscus. More concerning still is that all incidents of this nature go completely unmentioned in her own mission reports.
Hibiscus's consistent silence regarding this has worried more than us: Lava has also repeatedly asked that we pay closer mind to Hibiscus's physical and mental state.
'She's not gonna say anything about it herself. But that doesn't mean it doesn't bother her... I want you to keep an eye on her for me. After all, she's just a dummy who acts like she can take care of herself. That's it. She just acts like it.'
Renouncing prejudice and hatred has always been the stance of Rhodes Island, but we cannot deny that such animosity for Infected and the Sarkaz objectively exists, all across the land. While shouldered with such a complex identity, and doing everything she can to fulfill her duties as a doctor, the source of hostility is more often than not the very one she's trying to help. Others can only imagine the pressure she must be bearing, truly empathizing is something else altogether. We very much hope that Hibiscus can open her heart to others. But until she herself seeks help, all we can do is continue to watch over her and give her a degree of choice when assigning missions.
So far, Hibiscus still has never refused a single field mission.
text.zh:
罗德岛的医疗干员在执行外勤任务时，往往会有至少一名外勤干员陪同，以确保医护人员的安全。在与芙蓉同行的外勤干员的任务报告中，我们看到了不少令人不安的信息。
“任务一开始并不顺利，本地的感染者对我们怀有明显的戒备甚至是敌意……”
“我当时差点没有忍住想狠狠揍他一拳。最终把我拦下来的不是罗德岛员工守则，而是芙蓉医生……我知道他是感染者，我也是，芙蓉医生也是。那个人明明知道芙蓉是救了他一命的人，他怎么敢对芙蓉说那样的话……我们最终没有产生冲突。”
以上片段摘自某位外勤干员的任务报告。然而相似的记录，还出现在了许多其他与芙蓉合作的外勤干员的任务报告中。更令人在意的是，所有相关事件在芙蓉的任务报告中只字未提。
对芙蓉始终保持沉默的态度有所担忧的不只是我们，炎熔也多次找到过我们，请我们多加留意芙蓉的身心状况。
“那个家伙自己是什么都不会说的。但这不代表她真的不在意……我还是想请你们盯着她一点，毕竟她只是个看上去能把自己照顾得很好的笨蛋。只是看上去而已。”
摒弃偏见与仇恨是罗德岛的一贯主张，但不可否认的是，在大地各处，对感染者，对萨卡兹的仇恨客观存在。背负着复杂的身份，还要尽力履行一名医生的责任，而很多时候敌意的来源，偏偏是自己想要帮助的对象……芙蓉所承担的压力，他人只能想象，却很难真正地感同身受。我们非常希望芙蓉可以打开心扉与他人交流，而在她本人寻求帮助之前，我们所能做的只有继续留意观察，并且在为芙蓉安排任务时有所选择。
芙蓉至今从未推辞过任何外勤任务。

text.en:
Hibiscus often mentions the block of buildings where she used to live.
Based on her descriptions, it was akin to a slum hidden in a corner of bustling Londinium. Many who lived there were of different races and nationalities. There were Feline workers local to Londinium, as well as traders from Sargon and Vouivre. Everyone came from different backgrounds, but their shared experience of 'we have to do all we can before we can put down roots here' was enough to bring them together.
As Hibiscus paints a picture of the peace and harmony there, colored in nostalgia, we can't help but wonder—could such a neighborhood truly exist? Especially now, years on, with the chaos Londinium has been through, we fear that even if that block was once reality, it's long since been reduced to ruins.
Perhaps she's seeing these things through rose-tinted glasses. Perhaps she was simply lucky, and this Sarkaz girl with no concept of prejudice found friendly faces in her first contact outside her household. Regardless, these earliest memories have become the simplest, yet staunchest grounds Hibiscus has for believing in goodwill. Upon these lands exist hatred and prejudice, but so too do love and kindness. As for which outnumbers which, it hardly seems a question at all to her. A lamp in the cold night may not be enough for warmth, but it can be what supports the conviction to keep going. By her own actions, the Hibiscus of today is passing down that lamp.
She may be far more resilient than we can imagine.
text.zh:
芙蓉常常提起自己儿时曾经居住的那片街区。
根据她的描述，那里像隐于伦蒂尼姆这座繁华城市角落的贫民区。那里住着许多不同国籍、不同种族的人。有伦蒂尼姆本地的菲林工人，也有来自萨尔贡的瓦伊凡行商。大家出身各异，但“需要拼尽全力才能在这里扎根生存”这一共性，足以让所有人团结在一起。
当芙蓉带着无比怀念的情绪描述那里融洽祥和的生活图景时，我们不禁怀疑，这片大地上是否真的存在这样的角落？时隔多年，尤其是伦蒂尼姆还经历过那样的动乱，那片老城区哪怕真实存在过，恐怕也早已化为废墟。
也许是回忆带有自我美化的特性，也许只是芙蓉有些幸运，当初那个还不知偏见为何物的萨卡兹女孩第一次接触家庭之外的环境时，遇到的就是一些友善的人。这些最初的记忆成为了芙蓉相信善意最简单又坚定的理由。这片大地上存在仇恨与偏见，也存在爱与善意。至于二者究竟孰多孰少，对于芙蓉来说似乎根本不能算是一个问题。 寒夜中一点灯火或许不足以取暖，却可以支撑起一个人继续前行的信念。现在的芙蓉，正在以自己的行动将这一点光亮传递下去。
她或许远比我们想象的要坚强。

text.en:
'...On this mission, Operator Hibiscus displayed exceptional professionalism. She looked after Infected with every ounce of her heart, acted decisively at critical moments, and from an objective lens removed the danger of a large-scale infection in the Afterglow... In summary, based on Hibiscus's outstanding performance, I suggest that she be awarded a corresponding promotion.'
'But it's worth mentioning that during the mission, she often acted rashly without regard for her own safety. Though her intent was to better fulfil her duties as a doctor, we cannot condone such risky methods. Nobody requires that Rhodes Island's medical personnel place the safety of their patients ahead of their own; this cannot be considered a proper philosophy. We'd like Operator Hibiscus to make a habit of protecting herself from dangerous situations in the future.'
—Extract from Rhodes Island Afterglow Branch Officer-in-Charge Andante's mission report on the Vyseheim incident

'Vyseheim's Afterglow is a very interesting place. The coffee and specialty snacks are absolutely scrumptious, and the people love to sing and dance, not to mention how welcoming they are. During my mission as a Medic, I received plenty of assistance from the locals... I miss it there very much.'
—Extract from Hibiscus's mission report on the Vyseheim incident
text.zh:
“……在这次任务中，干员芙蓉展现出了非常专业的能力。尽心尽责地照顾感染者，在危急时刻果决地行动，客观上解除了夕照区大规模的感染危机……综合评估，根据芙蓉在此次任务中的杰出表现，建议给予相应的晋升奖励。”
“但是值得一提的是，干员芙蓉在任务中时常会有不顾自身安危的激进行为。虽然她的本意还是为了更好地完成医疗救援任务，但是我们并不提倡这种冒险的做法。没有人要求罗德岛的医疗人员将自己的生命安危置于患者之后，这不能称为正确的观念……希望干员芙蓉今后在其他危险的场合，能学着保护自己。”
——摘自罗德岛夕照区办事处负责人行板关于维谢海姆事件的任务报告

“维谢海姆的夕照区是一个很有趣的地方，咖啡与特色小吃十分美味，人们能歌善舞，也十分热情好客。在医疗任务中，我得到了许多来自当地人们的帮助……我十分怀念那里。”
——摘自芙蓉关于维谢海姆事件的任务报告

value.en: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected by medical examination.
value.zh: 体表有源石结晶分布，参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected by medical examination.
infectionStatus.zh: 体表有源石结晶分布，参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

text.en: Gavial remains a member of the Rhodes Island Medical Department, but whenever Rhodes Island needs her combat prowess instead of her medical knowledge, she won't hesitate to pick up her battleaxe and charge toward her enemies.
text.zh: 嘉维尔现在仍是罗德岛医疗部的一员，但在罗德岛需要她发挥自己的战斗力而非医学素养的时候，她也会拿起战斧，冲锋陷阵。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 15.3%
This hasn't changed much since I joined Rhodes Island. Nothing to worry about.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.27u/L
I know my own body better than anyone, but it's thanks to all the other operators at Medical that I've been able to keep my Oripathy under control so well. Maybe I should invite everyone to Acahualla for a vacation one of these days.
—Gavial
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】15.3%
和刚来罗德岛时没差多少，没什么好担心的。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.27u/L
虽然我自己的身体我自己最清楚，但病情能控制得这么好，医疗部的其他干员也帮了我很大的忙。要不我找个时间请大家一起去阿卡胡拉度假吧。
——嘉维尔

text.en:
Most Operators have remarked that Gavial made a very strong impression with her outfit when she returned from Acahualla. At first, there were rumors that it was the equipment she inherited from her tribe before her decision to study medicine. Soon, though, the rumors got out of hand. In the end, people were gossiping that 'Gavial once used the axe to cut open a waterfall at the highest cliff in Acahualla, creating a new landmark there.' Although the origins of such absurd rumors cannot be ascertained, Operator Tomimi seemed to really take a liking to them, and added her own fuel to the fire as the story mutated.
Tomimi's personal interests aside, the fact is that it was Operator Eunectes who forged Gavial's new equipment. When the two of them received Tomimi's message that Acahualla could be facing a disaster, Gavial made the request for new gear. Eunectes then quickly fabricated the entire set, from the weapons and armor to even the accessories, out of the finest materials, yet it is the imposing yet easy-to-wield battleaxe that Gavial instantly took a liking to.
text.zh:
大多数干员都对嘉维尔从阿卡胡拉回来时的那一身装备印象深刻，有传言说那是嘉维尔学医以前从部族继承下来的装备。传言越来越离谱，最后甚至出现了“嘉维尔曾经用那把大斧在阿卡胡拉的最高峰一击劈出一道瀑布，那道瀑布成了阿卡胡拉的地标”之类的变体。传言的来源已不可考，不过干员特米米显然很喜欢这些离谱的故事，还在故事传播和演化的过程中起到了推波助澜的作用。
特米米的个人兴趣先放在一边，事实情况是，嘉维尔的这身装备完全出自干员森蚺之手。在接到特米米关于阿卡胡拉可能发生灾难的来信之后，嘉维尔提出了更换新装备的申请，于是森蚺用最好的材料赶制了一整套装备，从武器到盔甲再到配饰应有尽有。但嘉维尔一眼相中的，还是这把看起来颇有气势，挥舞起来也相当顺手的大斧。

text.en:
Although the disaster that Tomimi said in her letter would affect all of Acahualla was more or less fabricated by Stitch Canvas (now Rhodes Island Operator Minimalist), the Durin city beneath Acahualla, Zeruertza, was indeed facing a calamity. Fortunately, thanks to the combined efforts of the local residents and the Rhodes Island Operators present, the Zeruertza citizens were all able to evacuate to the surface before it was too late, and no lives were lost during the incident.
It's worth mentioning that Gavial played a pivotal leadership role during the handling of the crisis. She was the first to propose having the Durins evacuate to the surface, persuaded the plan's opponents, was one of the last to evacuate, and even maintained order when the Durins built their settlement on the surface, ensuring that the construction would be completed on time. Operators not involved with the incident have all expressed disbelief upon hearing that it was Gavial who talked her opponents over, but to those who experienced the events personally, her identity as both a warrior and a doctor had come together, and it all seemed to happen perfectly naturally, with nothing feeling strange about it whatsoever.
'What were we supposed to do? She's Gavial.'
text.zh:
特米米信中提到的波及整个阿卡胡拉的大灾难，基本上是斯第奇·画布（现为罗德岛干员至简）杜撰出来的，但位于阿卡胡拉地下的杜林城市，际崖城，确实遭遇了一场毁灭性的灾难。幸运的是，在当地居民和罗德岛干员的共同努力之下，际崖城的全部居民都在灾难发生之前来到了地上。事件中没有任何人员伤亡。
值得一提的是，嘉维尔在这次事件中发挥了极为重要的作用。她第一个提出让杜林人前往地面避难的想法，说服了计划的反对者，最后一批撤出际崖城，还在杜林地面聚落的建设过程中维持了秩序，保证聚落在预计时间之内完工——没能参与此次事件的干员很难想象嘉维尔舌战群儒的景象，但对那些事件的亲历者来说，就像医生与战士两种身份以一种奇妙但不失和谐的方式在嘉维尔身上融合一样，这些事情仅仅是自然而然地发生了而已，完全没什么好奇怪的。
“没办法，谁叫她是嘉维尔啊。”

text.en:
That said, our Medical Department personnel nonetheless noticed a subtle change in Gavial. Not that she's become more melancholic or moody or anything like that, but she's now more confident and talkative than ever, and enjoys talking about her homeland more.
To be clear, she's never had anything against talking about her hometown, even back when she first joined Rhodes Island. However, she simply viewed it as the place she was from, and nothing more. She had no reason to avoid the topic, but also no reason to bring it up, so if Rhodes Island wasn't going to dig any deeper, she would naturally have no reason to ever discuss Acahualla.
Yet ever since her bizarre rainforest vacation, Rhodes Island has started to see more and more Acahuallan Operators join its ranks, and Gavial has started to open up about her home more as well, which has led to us learning more about the region by the day. This was a forest that was once considered no man's land, but is home to all sorts of tribes, big and small—such as the battle-obsessed Tiacauh. However, it has also been slowly and irreversibly industrializing... and has now seen several hundred thousand Durins pouring in from underground. With all these factors coming together, even the planner with the greatest foresight in the world would find themselves struck with a headache when trying to imagine Acahualla's future.
But Gavial doesn't think so at all.
In her eyes, she, Tomimi, Zumama, Inam, and all the valiant Tiacauh will be able to overcome any challenges that Acahualla might face. She has her friends' complete, unreserved trust, and she too wholeheartedly trusts her friends. No matter how difficult the path forward is, even if she must really break open a waterfall at the tallest cliff in Acahualla, that wouldn't be entirely unrealistic with her friends' full support. And so, why not take pride in her homeland?
Of course, there's little she can do about the fact that her friends trusts her fists far more than her medical acumen. Perhaps that's a good worry to have, though.
text.zh:
话虽如此，医疗部的同事们仍然看得出，嘉维尔发生了一些微妙的变化。这绝不是说她在朝着更多愁善感或者类似的方向变化，她只是更加自信、更加健谈，而且更喜欢谈及自己的家乡了。
必须澄清的是，就算是刚刚加入罗德岛时，她也并未对自己的家乡有什么避讳。对那时的她而言，家乡就是家乡而已，不必着重强调，也无需避而不谈。只是罗德岛既然无意对她的过去刨根问底，她自然也没必要时时刻刻把阿卡胡拉挂在嘴边。
然而，以那次奇妙的雨林假期为开端，罗德岛上陆陆续续多了不少来自阿卡胡拉的干员，嘉维尔关于家乡的话匣子也逐渐打开。于是，我们对这片区域的认识也与日俱增：一片过去被认为是无人区的丛林，大大小小的部族，尚武好战的提亚卡乌，还有缓慢而不可逆的工业化进程……现在又加上了数十万从地下涌上来的杜林人。这么多要素放在一起，哪怕是大地上最富有远见的规划家，在想到阿卡胡拉的未来时，恐怕也要觉得头痛。
但嘉维尔完全不觉得。
在她看来，有她，有特米米，有祖玛玛，有依娜姆，还有那么多能征善战的提亚卡乌，阿卡胡拉面临的一切困难都有解决办法。伙伴们毫无保留地信任她，而她也全心全意依赖着伙伴们。无论前路有多少艰险，就算她真的不得不在阿卡胡拉地势最高处劈凿出一道瀑布，在伙伴们的全力支持之下，也不是什么不可企及的事。所以，她怎么可能不以自己的家乡为荣呢？
当然，对于伙伴们更相信她的拳头而不是医术这一点，她自己也没什么好办法。这大概就是所谓幸福的烦恼吧。

text.en:
[Classified Log]
In the short term, the Durins' move to the surface does not seem to have had much of an apparent effect on Acahualla. Thanks to their ingenious camouflage, they have thus far been able to hide Acahualla's industrialization from the agents of Sargon's rulers, even causing them to return to the court prior to the arrival of the first wave of Durins.
