text.en: Lappland, unemployed. The only daughter of Alberto Saluzzo, patriarch of the Siracusan Famiglia Saluzzo. She is currently separated from her family. Lappland excels in solo combat, and often assists Rhodes Island in tactical Arts assaults and elimination operations.
text.zh: 拉普兰德，无业，叙拉古萨卢佐家族现任家主阿尔贝托的独女，目前已从家族脱离。拉普兰德擅长单兵作战，经常在战术攻坚与肃清作战中为罗德岛提供协助。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 14%
The Originium crystals on Operator Lappland's body are still spreading.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.33u/L
Density has significantly increased compared to previous results.

'She's crazy! Patients like her are the most annoying to deal with. She's always so polite and cooperative when we're conducting tests, and even smiled while saying she'd take good care of herself as Medical suggested... And look what happened. Can we just beat the daylights out of her, so we can treat her here uninterrupted for a month?'
'You want to try?'
'...'
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】14%
干员拉普兰德体表的源石结晶仍在扩散。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.33u/L
血液源石结晶密度较之前上升明显。

“疯子！最烦这样的病人了，接受检查的时候全程都很有礼貌地配合，还笑着说一定会好好按照医疗部的建议做好防护……结果就是这么个结果，能不能直接把她打晕，按在医疗部接受一个月的治疗？”
“你去。”
“……”

text.en: Lappland did not notify anyone before returning to the Rhodes Island landship. She suddenly showed up in HR's office, taking up half the sofa while her weapon occupied the other half. She looked as if she had just came back from traversing the wastes, covered in sand and dust... had it not been her gorgeous and somewhat extravagant Siracusan attire suggesting more to her story. Before she showed up, we learned from mission logs sent by the Nuova Volsinii branch about what happened at the Carnevale, including the fact the city government had revoked all of her licenses and banned her from returning to the city. We tried to ask how she was related to the city's unrest that nearly turned into civil strife, and she did not shy away, giving us a rundown of what she did over the next two minutes. She spoke in a breezy tone, but the operator in charge of recording stopped writing, frozen with fear. According to her, what she did at the Carnevale included but was not limited to: Helping strangers put Alberto—her own father and head of Famiglia Saluzzo—in prison, driving a cargo landship loaded with weapons into a massive parade crowd, and helping a Vulpo mother exact vengeance... All of this, to 'spice up' the Carnevale. 'Honestly, shouldn't they have given me a medal?' Lappland added, after a brief pause, 'How else would they be able to boast about how Nuova Volsiii has gotten off to a good start in reforming Siracusa!' 'Though...' she suddenly stopped talking, looked at the operator recording her words, and asked, 'What do you think? If the Carnevale started like this, won't future Carnevales only get more and more boring?' With her signature smile on her face, it was hard to tell if she spoke with regret or schadenfreude. The operator was stunned and didn't know how to respond, so the conversation abruptly ended there.
text.zh:
拉普兰德返回罗德岛本舰之前并未通知任何人，她就那么突然地出现在了人事部的办公室，霸占了半张沙发，她的武器则霸占了另外半张。拉普兰德看起来像是个一路徒步穿越荒野风尘仆仆的旅人……如果她没有穿着那一身华丽到有些浮夸的叙拉古礼服的话。
在此之前，我们已经通过新沃尔西尼办事处传回的任务日志知晓了狂欢节上发生的事情，包括新沃尔西尼市政厅已经吊销了拉普兰德的所有合法证照，颁布了针对她的禁入令。我们尝试询问那场差点演变成城邦内乱的动乱和她到底有何关系，拉普兰德并未遮掩，她用两分钟简单给我们讲了讲自己的所作所为。她的语气很轻快，但负责记录的人事干员胆战心惊地停下了笔。按照拉普兰德的说法，她在狂欢节上做的事情包括但不限于：帮着外人把自己的父亲，萨卢佐家族的家主阿尔贝托送进监狱，将一艘满载着武器的货运陆行舰开到了几十万人的巡游队伍的必经之路上，顺便帮助一位沃尔珀母亲报了仇……而这一切，都是为了“让狂欢节办得更加有声有色”。
“他们不该给我颁个奖吗？”稍稍停顿后，拉普兰德补充道，“不然他们哪能自诩新沃尔西尼给叙拉古的变革开了个好头呢！
“不过啊……”拉普兰德讲着讲着突然停了下来，她看着负责记录的人事干员，问，“你说，第一年都办成这样了，以后的狂欢节是不是只会越来越无聊？”
拉普兰德的嘴角挂着标志性的微笑，语气听不出来到底是真的遗憾还是幸灾乐祸，人事干员不知道该作何回答，愣在当场，这场谈话也就草草收了尾。

text.en:
Lappland and Texas bumped into each other in the Rhodes Island lounge.
We have a rough understanding of the subtle relationship between the two operators—everyone can still remember why Lappland joined Rhodes Island in the first place, after all. After the collaboration between the Lungmen branch and Penguin Logistics ended, she suddenly cornered one of our operators, handing over her resume with a smile and—while resting her two strangely shaped blades on the operator's neck—asked: 'Is Texas your employee?' Afterwards, be it a deliberate provocation, inexplicable adulation, or vague investigation, it is no secret that she has always set her sights on Texas, and thus we have prevented them from meeting directly. However, one time Texas unexpectedly returned to the landship, and by the time we were aware and trying to prevent them from meeting, she had already run into Lappland who was drinking alcohol by herself in the break room.
The operator who had rushed to 'get the situation under control' came back silently, and described what he saw with a confused look on his face: Lappland casually took a glass from the alcohol rack and poured a glass of amaretto whiskey, and Texas sat down, took the glass and drank it like it was just a normal day. Lappland nonchalantly asked Texas about her recent work as a special logistics consultant for Nuova Volsinii, and made a few casual jokes about city hall's attempt to promote the 'New Urban Management Act' to other Siracusan cities, to which Texas replied with a few words. After finishing her drink, Texas leisurely stood up and left, and they even wished each other well before going their separate ways! They seemed like nothing more than a pair of old friends who understood each other perfectly and had met up at an agreed time whilst going their respective ways.
To be honest, we have no clue what exactly happened. We only know that they had met a few times during the Carnevale, so how did their relationship suddenly turn out like this? Have they resolved their differences and reconciled, or is this another tug-of-war, with a hidden turbulent undercurrent? Who knows? One day they might cross swords and stain the deck with blood. For a while after this, we continued to observe the two, who met up a few more times, but the general atmosphere was similar to that day in the break room.

'I'm tired. Tired of guessing what's going on between them.
'I don't care if those two have let go of their grievances or not, but at least they're no longer as tense as before, which saves us a lot of trouble.'
—An HR Operator in charge of observation
text.zh:
拉普兰德和德克萨斯在罗德岛的休息室碰面了。
我们大概知道这两位干员之间的微妙关系，毕竟大家都还记得拉普兰德当初为什么会加入罗德岛——在某次龙门办事处与企鹅物流的合作结束后，她突然拦住我们的干员，笑着递上了自己的简历——同时将那两柄造型奇特的剑架在了干员的脖子上，问：“德克萨斯是你们的员工？”那之后，在我们所知的行动中，无论刻意的挑衅、令人费解的讨好、若即若离的试探，拉普兰德对德克萨斯的针对都很明显，因此，我们一直在尽量避免让她们直接碰面。但这一次，由于德克萨斯回到本舰同样突然，等我们反应过来的时候，她已经撞见了正在休息室独自喝酒的拉普兰德……
赶去“控制场面”的干员默默回来了，他满脸困惑地向我们描述了自己看到的画面：拉普兰德很自然地从酒架上取下一个杯子，倒上了一杯苦杏仁味的威士忌，德克萨斯很自然地坐下，很自然地接过那杯酒喝了起来，拉普兰德很自然地问起她最近在新沃尔西尼的物流特别顾问的工作开展得如何了，顺便很自然地调侃了几句市政厅试图将《新都市管理法案》推广到叙拉古其他城市的做法，德克萨斯很自然地回呛了几句。一杯酒喝完之后，德克萨斯很自然地起身离开，分别前她们甚至还互道了祝福！这两个人像是一对无比默契的老朋友，刚刚履行了一场约定好的在各自旅途中的短暂会面。
说实话，我们并不清楚到底发生了什么，据我们所知，这两个家伙在狂欢节期间也就见了几面，怎么就突然转变成了这样一种状态，究竟是已经冰释前嫌达成了和解，还是这其实是另一场暗流汹涌的拉锯，说不定哪天就会刀剑相向血染甲板……在之后的一段时间，我们进行了持续的观察，两人又碰见过几次，但都跟那天在休息室喝酒的氛围差不多。

“累了，懒得猜了。
“不管这俩人有没有完全放下那些恩恩怨怨，现阶段起码没那么紧绷了，也算给我们省了不少事。”
——负责观察的人事干员

text.en:
Famiglia Saluzzo traces its origins to the Siracusan Autonomous Region three centuries ago. Siracusans see the family as extremely robust, even turning a mistake made at an important point in history into a story of survival.
In the late 1030s, when Signora Sicilia established the 'Guns and Order', there were many dissidents, Alberto's grandfather among them. During the most important revolution of modern Siracusan history, the head of Famiglia Saluzzo stood against Signora Sicilia, and this decision nearly spelled the end of the family. Several major opposition famiglie were practically liquidated overnight, and Famiglia Saluzzo too suffered the Signora's retaliation. To spare the rest of his famiglia from suffering, Alberto's grandfather ultimately ended his life in his own study, and the ancient family established during Lethanian rule that rose to prominence by selling bootleg liquor to Gaul almost collapsed entirely.
Fortunately, Alberto's father painstakingly brought his family into the Grey Hall and they became one of the Dodici Famiglie, though the family's prestige and power had yet to recover from the prior shock. Alberto was born into and grew up in those circumstances, and took over the famiglia's future from his father's hands.
—Excerpt from a special study on Siracusa conducted by a certain Columbian university

We once asked Lappland about Famiglia Saluzzo's situation, but she was uninterested and kept yawning in response, so we eventually abandoned our questions.
Based on information later provided by HR, we managed to make a rough analysis of what happened. Alberto did not at all trust the emotions and legacy between the generations of his family: his grandfather's mistake during Signora Sicillia's reforms had, after all, brought upon disastrous consequences, but he was also disgusted by his father's harsh denouncements of his grandfather, and this distrust was passed down and reflected in his attitude towards his daughter—He had an almost perverted desire to control her, equipping her with an elite education, but also throwing her into the barrens as a child for training, and even expelling her from the family because of her various transgressions. Of course, this analysis is meaningless, for it is difficult for us to attribute Lappland's current behavior solely to a 'failed education'. This would not explain her simultaneous 'politeness', 'aggressiveness', 'hunger for battle', and 'penchant for theatrics'. After observing her for a long time, she seems to have been 'born' mad, while her father and family's influence merely fanned the flames.
'Let's just settle Lappland's files as-is. There's no point analyzing a lunatic's personality.'
text.zh:
萨卢佐家族诞生于三百年前的叙拉古自治领时期，在叙拉古人的印象中，这个家族的生命力极其顽强，哪怕在历史的重要时刻做出了错误的选择，也能转危为安。
1030年代末，西西里夫人着手在叙拉古建设“铳与秩序”时，持异见者众多，阿尔贝托的祖父便是其中的代表——在叙拉古近代最重要的变革之中，萨卢佐的家主站在了西西里夫人的对立面，这个决定几乎给家族带来了灭顶之灾，数个主要的反对家族几乎是在一夜之间被清算，萨卢佐家族也遭到了西西里夫人的严厉报复。为了不让整个家族蒙难，阿尔贝托的祖父最终在书房结束了自己的生命，这个建立于莱塔尼亚统治时代、因向高卢出售大量私酒而崛起的古老家族几乎就要一蹶不振。
所幸，萨卢佐家族在阿尔贝托父亲的苦心经营之下跻身灰厅，成为十二家族之一，但此时，家族的威信和力量都尚未从此前的剧烈震荡中恢复过来。阿尔贝托少爷便是在这样的背景下出生、长大，从父亲手中接过了未来……
——摘自哥伦比亚某大学针对叙拉古问题的专题研究

我们曾向拉普兰德询问过萨卢佐家族的相关情况，但她兴致缺缺哈欠连天，我们也就没再多问。
根据人事部后续补充的资料，其实我们能分析出个大概。阿尔贝托对家族代际之间的情感和承继极端不信任——祖父在西西里夫人变革时期的错误选择酿成了恶果，但父亲对祖父近乎诅咒的痛斥同样让他感觉厌恶，这种不信任延续下去，表现在了他对女儿的态度上——一种近乎变态的控制欲，从小给女儿全套的精英教育、将年幼的她扔进荒野中历练，并因她的种种越轨行为将她驱逐出家族……当然了，这种分析本身并没有意义，我们很难说拉普兰德如今的行事风格可以完全归因于“失败的教育”，这解释不了她身上同时存在的“礼仪”“侵略性”“战斗欲”和“表演欲”。和拉普兰德相处了这么久，就我们的观察来说，她的疯狂更像是“生来如此”，父亲和家族的影响只是添了一把火。
“拉普兰德的资料就这么归档吧，去给一个狂人做人格分析没有意义。”

text.en: Lappland's return to Rhodes Island has provoked strong reactions in some of our Operators. In particular, Operator Lunacub who had just recently recovered from rather serious injuries suddenly began running down the landship corridors, excitedly shouting 'I finally saw Agnese again!' Or Operator Projekt Red who would on occasion suddenly tense up, muttering words like 'Grandma'. Meanwhile, Lappland would always just happen to be passing by, as if the one they were talking about were by her side. [Classified Log] Take good care of Red. The Signori dei Lupi's game is over, but this child has grown up in such unusual circumstances, and suffered so much deception and betrayal that will take a long time to deal with. I came up with many ways of stopping her from ending up like this, but still I failed in the end. Fighting with each other is natural for the Signori dei Lupi, and not every human who interacts with them can be as lucky as Lunacub, or Lappland... to naturally integrate into a wolf pack, even becoming their sovereign in the latter case. I hear she has made a deal with Emperor and Duck Lord while representing the wolf pack. Be it Emperor, Duck Lord, or the Signori dei Lupi, I have dealt with many beings like them. They are immortal, and most find a way to get along with humans and live on this land with their unique character. I've also met humans with unusual life experiences. Be it due to their ancestors' adventures or major Catastrophes, they possess powers or insights beyond human limits and are closer to the former. Lappland seems to have been born this way. She is obviously still young and her experiences aren't that out of the ordinary, but the boundaries on her are already blurred. She is embracing a certain kind of madness ordinary people will find difficult to comprehend, which is not a good thing... Continue watching over her, Doctor. Going back to our original topic, the Beast Aristocrats may phrase it differently, but it all comes down to the same thing: they felt uneasy. If even they feel threatened to the point of ignoring their respective traits so they might contact each other and figure out a countermeasure, then we must focus on what is causing their nervousness.
text.zh:
拉普兰德回到罗德岛，激起了部分干员的强烈反应。准确来说，重伤初愈的子月干员突然开始在罗德岛的走廊里跑动，兴奋地喊着“终于见到了失散的阿涅塞”，红干员的精神状态偶尔也会突然紧绷起来，嘴里念叨着“外婆”之类的，而彼时拉普兰德都正好经过，好像她们口中的人就跟在拉普兰德身边一样……

【权限记录】
照顾好红，狼之主的游戏已经结束，但这孩子的成长经历太过特殊，遭受了那样的欺骗和背叛，也不是短时间就能被安抚的，我想过很多办法，避免她走到如今的境地，但还是失败了。厮杀是狼之主们的天性，不是每个与之产生交集的人类都能像子月那么幸运，或者像拉普兰德那样……自然地融入狼群，甚至反客为主，听说她已经在代表狼群与大帝、鸭爵他们打交道了。
大帝、鸭爵也好，狼之主也好，我与不少类似的存在打过交道，他们不死不灭，多数会在漫长的岁月里找到与人类相处的方式，以独特的姿态存在于这片大地，我也遇见过一些经历特殊的人类，由于种族的奇遇或者巨大的灾变，他们拥有了不属于人类的力量或者洞见，向着前者靠拢。而拉普兰德仿佛生来如此，她明明很年轻，经历也说不上离奇，但身上的界限却已经非常模糊。她正在拥抱某种常人难以理解的疯狂，这不是件好事……继续关注她吧，博士。
言归正传，兽主们的说法虽然各不相同，但归根到底都是——他们感受到了不安。如果连他们这样的存在都会受到威胁，因而不得不忽略彼此迥异的习性，尝试互相接触寻求对策，那不安的来源究竟是什么，我们必须重视。

text.en:
Luchino recognized this special client: she once opened the doors of Tailor de Montano and ordered two Carnevale outfits of the highest quality in one breath, and even personally drew the famiglia patterns she wanted on the costumes by hand. This time, she was still wearing one of the outfits, but the Carnevale mask that used to be sitting at her waist was now missing. Unlike a traditional Siracusan suit, the mask is the most important part of a Carnevale outfit, and the most unique visualization of the event. Luchino could not ignore the missing mask, and boldly asked why.
'I gave it away.'—That is how the client responded.
It was not De Montano's professionalism that led him to ask the question, but Luchino still expressed his willingness to make her a new mask and complete her outfit. After all, he knew who his client was, and it would be best if she had a mask ready for any future Carnevales. Nonno had passed a long time ago, and his current skills were already 'up to par', so as the current manager of De Montano, he was obliged to maintain any relationships with old clients, no matter who they were.
'No need, little tailor. Is there a difference between wearing one mask and wearing two?
'The outfit is clearly already complete!'
text.zh:
卢奇诺认出了这个特别的客人——她曾经推开德蒙塔诺的门，一口气下单了两套最高规格的狂欢节礼服，并亲手在纸上画下了需要在服饰细节上有所体现的家族纹样。此刻，对方依然穿着那套礼服，但腰间原本系着狂欢节假面的地方却空着，与传统的叙拉古套装不同，假面是狂欢节礼服最为重要的组成部分，是整个狂欢节上最独特的风景。卢奇诺无法忽略这种缺憾，所以他壮着胆子上前搭讪。
“送出去了。”——客人是这么回答的。
虽然并不是德蒙塔诺的手艺遭到了质疑，但卢奇诺依然表示愿意为这位客人重新制作一副面具，将这套礼服补全。毕竟他知晓对方的身份，如果她还要参加接下来的狂欢节，少了面具总是不方便的。爷爷去世了这么久，他的手艺已经“上得了台面”，作为德蒙塔诺如今的主理人，他也有必要维系和老主顾的关系，不管对方是什么身份。
“不用了，小裁缝。戴一副面具，和戴两副面具，有什么区别呢？
“这礼服明明完整得很！”

value.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

text.en: Former Rhodes Island frontline combatant Thorns, now a captain aboard an independent exploration-ship/scientific-vessel/finning-boat/cargo-hauler/pirate-ship. As the captain of the Cuna de Nene, he maintains a cooperative partnership with Rhodes Island. We provide medical and supply services, while he in turn offers us many ocean-related conveniences, as well as the means to contact remote Iberian settlements outside the jurisdiction of the Inquisition.
text.zh: 曾是罗德岛前线作战干员的棘刺，如今以独立探险船兼科考船兼捕鳞船兼货运船兼海盗船——宝宝摇篮号船长的身份，与罗德岛保持合作关系。罗德岛定期为宝宝摇篮号提供医疗与物资支持，棘刺则为罗德岛提供诸多与海洋相关的便利，以及接触伊比利亚土地上许多不受审判庭管辖的偏远聚落的渠道。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Thorns shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.17u/L
The moment we stepped aboard the Cuna de Nene, Operator Thorns handed us a piece of wrinkled cloth. It was only later that I noticed the numbers painted on it. To my surprise, it was data on his vital signs, but more surprising was how closely the numbers matched our official examinations. It was like magic.
I asked him about it, and he said it was something he came up with while darning the sails. He used the alchemical substance coating his arm he calls the 'Corazonix' to give himself an examination, ran the numbers himself, then jotted them down on a nearby scrap of sail canvas.
It's fine, I suppose. Maybe a bit haphazard, but it's never a bad thing to be thinking about your own health.
—Medical Operator's report after the Doctor visited the Cuna de Nene
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员棘刺没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.17u/L
我们刚登上宝宝摇篮号，干员棘刺就递上来一张皱巴巴的布片。我后来才发现，那上面随手涂画着的数字，居然是棘刺几项身体指标的数据，而且这些数据还神奇地和我们正式体检得出的数据相差无几。
我问了棘刺，他说那是他在缝补船帆的时候临时起意，用他手臂上那种被称作“心相原质”的炼金产物给自己做了体检，自己算出了数据，又随手写在了从船帆上裁下来的边角料上……
好吧，虽然太随意了点，但自己有健康管理的意识，总归是件好事。
——随博士造访宝宝摇篮号后，一位医疗干员提交的报告

text.en:
[Crewmate's Petition #1]
Captain! Next time we're repairing the ship, d'you mind not using your Corawhatsit?! Sure, it fixes things up great, but whenever you've got something on your mind that silver goop starts flying everywhere and dragging along all the stuff you fixed with it! The crapper door keeps smacking into the crapper, and it's a real pain in the ass, so to speak...
[Captain's Response]
Agreed.
Logically, the simplest solution would be to train myself to keep a cool head, while the most thorough would be to cut off the Corazonix I use as an adhesive to prevent it from reacting to my thoughts.
But my personal decision is to start developing a new quick-drying, waterproof, and high-strength multi-purpose adhesive. I think it would be a fascinating research project.

[Crewmate's Petition #2]
Captain! That knucklehead Fabian dropped the mooring rope and half a mast cracked off! Nearly squished little Nene in the process! So why's he still swaggering about like nothing happened?! He deserves to get flogged or something!
[Captain's Response]
Agreed.
I've ordered Fabian to do strength exercises ten times a day, so the next time he's fastening the rope, he won't get tired and let it slip.
To ensure he follows those orders, I'll do them with him.

[Crewmate's Petition #3]
Captain!!! This ship used to be the La Conquista, so why the hell is it the Cuna de Nene now?! Before asking if it's dapper or not (it's not), we're a ship sailing the seas by our lonesome. Without a fearsome name to shout, how're we supposed to scare off any slimy curs up to no good?
For the crew's safety, I beg you to reconsider the new name! We're looking at a mutiny here!
[Captain's Response]
Denied.
Cuna de Nene was decided by drawing lots, as usual. As a saltfin, I highly doubt Nene used any underhanded tricks to rig the results. Besides, the Seaborn seem unlikely to respond differently to different ship names.
But if you do wish to mutiny, be sure to inform me ahead of time.

[Audio Log]
'You've been out to sea before, Señora Juana. Tell me, was being the captain always like this? Did Captain Cruz have to handle this sort of thing? I always feel like I'm doing something wrong.'
'Why ask? Are you unhappy with it? Would you rather be tied up and dragged behind the ship whenever there's a complaint?'
text.zh:
【船员请愿#1】
船长！下次能不能不要再用你手臂上的那个心什么质修船了！虽然修得很好，但每次你心烦意乱的时候，那些心什么质就到处乱飞，原本修好的部件也跟着乱飞！厕所门在厕所里胡乱地扇，还是太要命了……
【船长答复】
批准。
客观上来说，最直接的办法是我通过练习保持情绪稳定，最彻底的办法则是把当粘合剂用的那些心相原质分离出去，让它们不再实时受我控制。
但我主观上决定立刻着手研发一种快干、防水、高强度的万用粘合剂，想想就觉得是有趣的课题。

【船员请愿#2】
船长！！法比安那个家伙，上次甩脱了缆绳，害我们损失了半根桅杆，还差点把宝宝砸在底下……他怎么还能大摇大摆地在外面溜达？通常这种情况不是应该有点什么惩罚吗？
【船长答复】
批准。
我已经命令法比安这个月内每天做十次加强版健身体操，确保他以后再系缆绳的时候，绝不会再脱力失手。
为了确保命令执行，我会和他一起做。

【船员请愿#3】
船长！！！这艘船原来可是叫征服宣告号的，现在怎么就变成了宝宝摇篮号？且不提帅不帅的问题（真的很矬），我们这一艘孤船在外航行，名号不响亮的话，怎么唬得住心怀不轨的家伙？
为了全体船员的安全，请您考虑更名！否则的话，我们就要考虑发起哗变了！
【船长答复】
驳回。
“宝宝摇篮”号是按照正规抽签流程选出的名字，我相信宝宝作为一只盐鳞，不会在抽签时舞弊。况且，我相信海嗣不会根据船的名字改变它们的行为。
以及，如果要哗变的话，记得提前告诉我。

【语音记录】
“胡安娜女士，您过去也出过海，您告诉我，船长真的都是这样的吗？科鲁兹船长当年，也是这样管事的吗？我总觉得哪里不太对……”
“问这个干什么，你现在过得不开心？难道你想在有怨言的时候，被五花大绑拖在船后面泡着？”

text.en:
You the new guy the first mate recruited? She tell you about the situation aboard the ship?
Fine, I guess I'll do it. No secrets on this ship—our captain knows all.
Hah, take it from me. One time he was charting our course with the first mate. One moment, he's talking about the ocean currents, next, he's calling my name, saying my tattoo's starting to swell and to put some ointment on it... I swear to Nene, I never told anyone I got a tattoo in the first place! Since it's of, uh, Nene's beautiful fin-spinning dance... Then there was another time he was adjusting the helm when all of a sudden, he pokes his head out from behind the wheel and hands me a bottle, told me to rub it on if I wanted Nene to play nice with me... How'd he know Nene nipped me?
Oh, but don't you worry! He don't really care about dark grudges or lurid affairs, and he's not one for teasing or blackmail either. It's just crazy how much he knows, and that lets him spot a whole lotta problems... Not that any of us can say when he'll decide to do something about 'em.
—An old sailor's warning to a new crewmember in a tavern in an unnamed town

In the early morning, if it's a clear blue sky, you can see the Cuna de Nene entwined in shimmering silver threads. This is the only time of day you'll have the chance to actually see them in all their near-imperceptible glory. They are the handiwork of Operator Thorns, woven out of the alchemical substance called 'Corazonix' he bears on his arm. According to him, he can release this Corazonix to have it enter any sort of natural fluid (ie: air, seawater, or even flowing blood), inserting itself into the circulation and sending innumerable data points back to his arm.
When I say 'innumerable', I mean 'innumerable'. If I understood Thorns correctly, it feels like your ear is subjected to a foreign language, classical music, and a burdenbeast braying all at once, while your mouth is being stuffed with candy, chilies, and mud at the same time, not to mention the documentary, children's cartoon, and dance lesson being beamed into your eyes... How does he process all that information?
—A Caster's report after the Doctor visited the Cuna de Nene

My dear colleagues, it has become clearer than ever that the Corazonix is itself a paradox.
The 'compass'—the most direct apparatus we can use to decipher it—is the product of many years of research, yet even with its aid we cannot know which of the Corazonix's tremblings tells the temperature of the air, which of its undulations mirrors the ocean's flow, or if its churning conveys of the average blood temperature of a school of fins or the direction of the next geyser to erupt. The way I see it, there is nobody who can interpret the irregular behavior of the compass's Corazonix... unless that interpreter already has a clear image in mind of what data they'll need.
For you see, a tool that can gather endless data has finally manifested itself, but it can only ever show us what the heart of man yearns for... Ah. Perhaps the rumors of a so-called 'guiding desire', as well as the name 'Corazonix' itself—thought up by the court poets to show off their skills—are rather fitting after all.
—A letter from Golden Age alchemist Aulus to his colleagues, kept in the archives of the Inquisition
text.zh:
你就是大副新招的家伙？船上的情况她都说了？
好，那我补一条。这艘船上没有秘密，我们的船长什么都知道。
哈。拿我自己说吧。有一次，船长在和大副规划航线，上一秒还聊着那些洋流数据，下一秒就突然叫住我，说我的纹身有发炎迹象，叫我上点药……我对宝宝发誓，我没让任何人知道我搞了纹身！毕竟我纹的是，呃，是宝宝扭动鳍肢的美丽模样……还有一次，船长在调整舵轮，拧到一半突然从舵轮后面探出头来，递给我一个小瓶，说抹在身上就可以让宝宝温柔地接近我……他又是怎么知道我被宝宝咬了的？
哎，但别担心！他其实不在乎这些秘密背后有什么深仇大恨或是苦情虐恋，也不会借此调侃或者要挟你。他就是莫名其妙地知道很多，所以也能发现很多问题……只是谁也说不准，他啥时候突然就想顺手解决哪个问题了。
——无名小镇的酒馆里，一位老船员郑重其事地告诫新船员

清晨，如果天气晴朗，就能看到整艘宝宝摇篮号都被闪闪发亮的银色丝线缠绕着——这也是一天中仅有的，能直接看到那些细到肉眼几乎不可见的丝线的机会。所有丝线，都是干员棘刺用手臂上那种被称作“心相原质”的炼金产物织成的。据他描述，当他释放这种炼金产物，它便会进入外界的各类流体物质——不论是空气、海水，还是生物的血液——加入它们的自然循环，再带着不计其数的信息回到他的手臂。
我说“不计其数”，可没夸张。如果我没理解错棘刺的描述，那种感觉可能相当于有人在你耳边同时放外语听力古典音乐和驮兽叫声，还往你嘴里同时塞进糖果辣椒和泥巴，并且在你眼前同时播放纪实影像儿童动画和舞蹈教学……他是怎么同时处理这些信息的？
——随博士造访宝宝摇篮号后，一位术师干员提交的报告

亲爱的同僚，我越发清晰地意识到，心相原质本身就是一个悖论。
“罗盘”已经是我们这些年研发出的最直观的解读器械了，可我们依然无法客观地分辨心相原质在罗盘上的哪一次震颤是在反映空气的湿度，哪一次波动是在反映海水的流速，以及哪一次翻涌是在反映鳞群血液的温度，或是热泉喷发的方位。依我所见，没有人能解读出心相原质在罗盘上的那些毫无规律可言的表现……除非解读的人在拿起罗盘之前，心里已经清楚自己需要什么信息。
您看，一件能获取无数信息的工具，最终能呈现出来的，却只有人心中本就在索求的信息……呵。或许外面那些玄之又玄的所谓“指引心之所向”的传言，以及“心相原质”这个宫廷诗人卖弄文采起的名字，反倒异常贴切。
——由审判庭看管的文件，黄金时代炼金术师奥卢斯给同僚的去信

text.en: 'Hey, Elysium, what happened to the captain after that?!' 'Ah, right, where was I... Our Captain Valourchin defeated the scoundrels, and finally managed to take his trusty crew out to sea. With a wave of his silver arm, he could see the positions of every sea monster, letting him slip through their territory before they even noticed. He also recovered basketfuls of fins snatched away by the monsters, meaning nobody had to go hungry. And just so you know, he was only able to learn any of these skills because I was there to support him, as his constant companion and closest friend—' 'But if the Captain Valourchin's always out at sea, doesn't that mean the two of you have split up?' 'Err... It's true that I didn't follow him to sea...' 'Then why do you look so happy? Didn't you say you were the best of friends?' 'I may not be out there among the briny waves with him, but we're still partners! Before he set sail, I thought about everything he might encounter during his adventure! Everything he needed out there was prepared by yours truly! I'm willing to bet that even as we speak, he's eating one of the vitamin pills I gave him!' —A tale Elysium recounted about himself and the Captain at a signing for the 'Saga of the Captain Valourchin: Volume 3' 'You sure you're looking for Rhodes Island?' That's what the sailor, beard festooned with clattering bone ornaments, asked me. My heart was leaping out my chest, but since I had already stepped aboard, all I could do was tell the truth. 'I-I was told there were people here who took applications for R-Rhodes Island supplies.' He squinted his eyes, then led me into the depths of the ship's hold. It was like a ramshackle maze in there. Sometimes we'd have to crawl under Golden Age era steel frames, some still partially gilded. Other times, we'd have to climb up and down ladders fashioned from bone and finleather. I was led to a dark room, where a pair of golden eyes stared at me from the other side. The sailor pushed me in, telling me I was on my own. 'Could you turn on the light for me? The switch is 23 degrees to your right, and 40 centimeters ahead.' With the lights on, I could see who was talking to me. He had messy hair and unkempt clothes, yet gave off a vigorous, youthful aura. He examined me carefully in silence as he fiddled with some strange device in his hand. To tell the truth, this was not what I had in mind when I pictured a Rhodes Island office. All sorts of symbols were scrawled across the wall, while bottles hung down from the ceiling. As strangely-colored lights shone from them, I could faintly see fine threads running through the air. It reminded me more of a sorcerer's lair than anything else. 'I, err, think I might have gotten the wrong place. Seeing how this isn't a Rhodes Island office and all. I don't suppose you could just let me go in peace? I've got no money on me, a-and there's no one who can pay a ransom either...' I clutched my autographed copies of the 'Saga of the Captain Valourchin' trilogy in my bag, trying my best to think of a way out of there. If I had really fallen into the hands of pirates, I thought, then the righteous Captain would surely come to my rescue, but until then, I'd have to rely on my own wits... 'Oh, what am I saying, this must be Rhodes Island... O-Oh! Terribly sorry.' Upon hearing the name 'Rhodes Island', the young man's eyes lit up. He stood up all of a sudden, painstakingly dragging a plank covered in draft paper over from behind him. On the back of the plank was an impressively-carved rendition of the Rhodes Island logo. 'Sorry, there's not much space aboard, so rooms have to pull double-duty. This is Rhodes Island. Specifically, its high seas office. Trust me, we're the real deal. Now hand me your application form, and I'll see what we have available...' —The recollections of a villager who, after introductions from Rhodes Island's Iberia office, came aboard the Cuna de Nene to receive supplies
text.zh:
“所以，极境哥哥，船长后来怎么样了！”
“好，接着上次的讲，我们的豪胆船长棘刺击败了坏家伙，就带着勇敢的同伴们到了海上！他挥挥银色的手臂，就能看见海里所有的怪物，在被怪物发现之前悄无声息地穿过它们的领地，带回一筐又一筐被怪物抢走的鳞，让大家都不再饿肚子。嘿，要知道，他能练成这套本领，中间可少不了我作为挚友和助手的支持……”
“欸——可是，如果豪胆船长一直在海上，那岂不是说，你们已经分开了？”
“呃。我确实没跟他出海。”
“那极境哥哥为什么还这么开心？你不是说你们是很好的朋友吗？”
“虽然我没出海，但我们还是搭档！早在豪胆船长出发之前，我就在心里把他的冒险完完整整预演过一遍了，他用到的一切必需品，都是我安排的！我敢打赌，就在此时此刻，豪胆船长一定在吃我给他的维生素片！”
——《豪胆船长传奇·第三卷》的签售会上，极境又一次讲起自己与豪胆船长的故事

“你确定要找罗德岛？”
那位胡子上挂满叮当作响的骨质饰品的船员压低声音问我。我心里怕得不行，但既然已经身在这艘船上，也只能如实交代。
“我、我被告知这里有人受理罗、罗德岛的救助物资申请。”
他挤了挤眼睛，领我往船舱深处走去。船舱内像是一座胡乱拼凑的迷宫，有时候要从还遗留着黄金时代镀金痕迹的钢架下爬过，有时候又要抓着骨棒和鳞皮做成的梯子上下攀行。
我被领进一间昏暗的舱室。一双金色的眼睛在舱室尽头端详着我。身后的船员推了推我，叫我独自进去。
“顺手帮忙打开灯吧，开关在你右前方23度角，40厘米处。”
灯亮后，我看清了说话的人。一个发型凌乱、衣衫不整，但精神焕发的青年，沉默地端详着我的同时，手里还摆弄着某种奇特的装置。说实话，这里根本不像什么罗德岛的办事处。墙上地上都用杂乱的笔迹画满了各种符号，天花板上吊着各式各样的瓶瓶罐罐，在颜色奇异的灯光映照下，空气中还有纤细的丝线若隐若现，说它是什么邪术师的窝点，还更可信些。
“那、那个，要是我找错地方了，这里不是罗德岛的办事处，我只希望你们能让我安全离开，我身上没钱，也没人能来赎我，我……”
我捏紧了包里的《豪胆船长传奇》三部曲签名版，拼命想着脱身的计策。如果真的落入海盗之手，我想，正义的豪胆船长一定会出手相救，但前提是我得先凭自己的才智，拖延足够的时间……
“怎么，这里当然是罗德岛……哦，哦！不好意思。”
听到罗德岛，青年忽然眼睛一亮，猛地站起身来，费力地将身后挂满草稿纸的木板转了过来。木板背面赫然刻着罗德岛的标志。
“不好意思，船上空间不够，只能一室两用了。但这就是罗德岛驻泰拉海洋办事处，货真价实。现在，申请单给我，我看看我们有没有对应的储备……”
——一位经罗德岛驻伊比利亚办事处介绍，来到宝宝摇篮号领取救助物资的村民的回忆

text.en:
'You met with that youth, the so-called 'Captain Valourchin' again, Lord Carmen.'
'I did.'
'You need not attend the meetings personally. He is of far less importance than our dealings with Ægir.'
'It has been a very long time since tales of any 'sea captain' have made their way around Iberia.'
'...A 'captain' who has looted towns and conspired to murder our civil servants. His tale should be brought to an end by the Penal Battalion's poleaxes.'
'His crimes will not be forgotten, but do not be so eager to bring him to trial. His current conduct is still of use to us.'
'A few barrels of fins to some remote villages we do not have the leisure to look after, and opening up trade routes to such regions... Hardly anything groundbreaking. The past few decades have seen the remnants of the Defensa voluntarily look after dozens of hamlets near our land border.'
'Yet they have not seen anyone from the Defensa sung of as a folk hero. I saw the eyes of those villagers as they praised the 'Captain Valourchin'. I've seen that look before.'
'What sort of look?'
'Sixty-odd years ago, whether aboard the Church's seaborne basilica or Alfonso's Stultifera, every time I returned, I could see their shining lights—Cerro del Faro, Ciudad de las Olas Doradas, sometimes Puerto Orgullo. Even in the middle of the night, the people would look out to sea with expectant gazes, eager to see what curiosities we had brought back from distant waters. I see that same eagerness, the same expectation in the eyes of those praising the 'Captain Valourchin'... I am afraid the people no longer fear the sea.'
'You mean to say he has led these innocents to cast aside the sanctuary of fear and embrace desire instead. Desire that will only invite disaster. All the more reason to punish him as soon as possible.'
'Or maybe what we actually need is someone to light a fire amidst the ashes. We will not find the answers we seek on land. No matter how much we fear it, Iberia's lifeline lies out at sea. If he were to submit to Inquisition supervision and act in our name... he would no longer pose a threat to us. Quite the opposite, in fact.'
'And how did he respond?'
'Ah. He refused.'
—A conversation between Saint Carmen and a senior Inquisitor
text.zh:
“您还是去见那位年轻的所谓‘豪胆船长’了，卡门阁下。”
“是。”
“您本不必亲自去的。比起阿戈尔方面的事务来说，他远没有那么重要。”
“伊比利亚已经很久没有流传过‘船长’的故事了。”
“……一位劫掠城镇、谋害公职人员的‘船长’。他的故事本该由惩戒军的斧枪来终结。”
“他的罪行不会被遗忘，但对他的审判不急于在此刻作结。他如今的所作所为，并非毫无价值。”
“他只不过是将打来的鳞分给了几个我们无暇照管的偏远聚落，在那些地方打通了几条贸易线路……这都不是什么新事。几十年来，国防军的残部也一直在自行管理着靠近陆上边境的几十座村镇。”
“几十年来，国防军不曾成为过民间传奇故事的主角。我看到那些村民在传颂‘豪胆船长’的时候，流露出了怎样的眼神。我曾经见过那种眼神。”
“什么眼神？”
“六十多年前，不论我是在国教会的那艘海上大教堂上，还是在阿方索的斯图提斐拉上，每次归航，我都能看见通明的灯火……灯塔山、金浪城，或是骄傲的港都。哪怕是在半夜，人们也要急切地远望大海，企盼着见证我们从海里带回的新事物。在那些传颂‘豪胆船长’的村民眼里，我看到了同样的急切，同样的企盼……我恐怕，这些人已经不再惧怕大海了。”
“您是说，他教唆这些无辜的人抛弃了庇护他们的恐惧，拾起了滋生灾祸的欲望……那他就更应该及早受到处置。”
“又或者，我们其实需要有人在死灰之中点一把火。问题的答案终归不在陆上，不论我们多么恐惧，伊比利亚的生路仍在海中。只要他能在审判庭的监督下，以审判庭的名义行动……他就不会对我们构成威胁，甚至，可以成为我们的助力。”
“那么，他作何回应？”
“呵，他拒绝了。”
——圣徒卡门与一位年长审判官的谈话

text.en: No need to rush. This question, I leave to you. There will come a day you can answer in your own words... Or rather, when the time comes, your answer will be your own. —The final words Aulus left for Thorns as they parted [Captain's Log] The sea's much calmer than I imagined. The day I set out to sea, the voices that once called my name from the depths no longer echoed in my ears. I observed every school of Seaborns along our course, yet they all seemed compelled by instinct—relentless expanding and devouring. I couldn't hear their murmurs or calls. Now, all I hear is my own voice. Every time I call the Corazonix back to me, I can hear the rushing of my blood spreading further and further into the distance. At last, it is not the sea calling to me, but me calling to it. I am trying to extend my searches further. At its distant limits, it takes an incredibly long time to recall the Corazonix, and I fear the accuracy of its information will be diminished somewhat. The further I go, the more the sea warps and mutates. Some of these oddities can be explained by large-scale Seaborn activity. Others, I believe may be due to Ægirian technology controlling things behind the scenes. But even further in the distance, there are phenomena I have no explanation for. There is some sort of abnormal 'tide' (for lack of a better word), completely unlike the one near the coast. As if the water of this distant stretch of sea is being pulled away by some unknown force. I want to know what it is. I will discover the truth of the matter.
text.zh:
不必心急，我将问题留在了你的身上。
总有一天，你会用自己的意志回应我……或者说，到那时候，你回应的是你自己。
——分别时，奥卢斯留给棘刺最后的话语

【船长日志】
海比我想象中要安静得多。从我出航的那天起，曾经那些从海中呼唤我的声音，就都不再作响。我测算过航线上每一支海嗣群落的动向，但它们只是循规蹈矩地进行着本性使然的扩张与吞噬，它们没有在呢喃，也没有在呼唤。
现在，我能听见的，就只有我自己的声音。每次收回心相原质，我都能听见自己血液流淌的声音向更远处延伸。终于不是我被海呼唤，而是由我来呼唤它。
我在尝试探得更远。在极限距离下，心相原质的回收周期变得很长，信息准确度恐怕也有所降低。越往远处，海就越是异变频发。这其中有些是由大规模的海嗣活动引发，另一些，我认为是阿戈尔人的技术产物在控制。但在更远处，还有一些我全然无法解释的现象，一种与近海全然不同的、异常的“潮汐”（我暂且只能如此称呼），仿佛远海的海水在持续经受着未知力量的牵引。
我想知道那是什么。
我会知道那是什么。

text.en: Gu Zhuhuang, code name Blaze, is an elite operator who wields powerful, destructive Arts over a wide area. Able to handle both Guard and Caster roles, she plays a key tactical role in various combat operations, from assault to defense to raids.
text.zh: 本名顾烛煌，代号煌，罗德岛精英干员，其施放的法术在破坏力与攻击范围上均达较高标准。兼任近卫干员与术师干员，在攻坚、防守、突袭等多种类型的作战任务中，作为战术核心之一发挥作用。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 17%
Blaze's Originium crystals remained largely confined to her torso. No further spread has been noted.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.25u/L
Blaze continues to be active on the frontlines; if anything, she has gotten even more active since her return from Yan, frequently participating in Catastrophe rescue missions and operating fearlessly in high active Originium environments.
Fortunately, she is taking better protection measures than before, and her condition remains stable.

Blaze is finally taking protective gear seriously. It's a good thing. All about finding the right person to nag her about it, I guess.
—Medic Operator Y.P.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】17%
干员煌的源石结晶仍然主要分布在躯干位置，没有进一步扩散。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.25u/L
煌依旧冲在最前线，从炎国回来后，甚至有比之前更拼了的趋势。光是天灾救援任务她就参与了好几次，在充满活性源石的环境中无所畏惧地行动。
所幸，她的防护措施比之前做得更到位，目前病况相对稳定。

煌终于开始注意戴护具了，好事。看来还是得找对的人来念叨她。
——医疗干员Y.P

text.en:
[Hairdresser's Log]
Client: Blaze
Service: Hair straightening
There's no way to straighten hair that was curled by fire! Please be careful when practicing Arts.
—Goldenglow

[Tailor's Log]
Client: Blaze
Service: Repairing hole on clothing
This is the third time Blaze has come to have her clothes patched. Always the same request too: 'Don't let the one who gave me this find out.' Good thing it's just a hole this time, not an entire sleeve that got burned. She's making progress in controlling her flames.
—Bibeak

[Weapon Workshop Log]
When Blaze first started studying the Arts unit she brought back from Yan, I thought she would go back to her chainsaw after blowing a few holes in the training room walls. She's BLAZE, after all, someone who can saw through a two meter thick blast-proof door in a matter of seconds. Turning to something so restrictive would be like a Vouivre warrior fighting with a sewing needle.
Little did I expect her to come back and ask me to fit a precision adjustment valve for the Arts unit.
She said she wanted to discover new possibilities for her Originium Arts, transforming heat to fire. 'True strength is being able to control one's power,' as she put it. Anyway, I fitted the valve for her, but I'll be sure to laugh in her face when she comes back, begging for me to remove it.
They were trying times. We could hear the explosions, things breaking, screaming, and fire alarms from the training room about once every five minutes. But she never came looking for me.
Until one day it all stopped, and all was quiet in the training room. I peeked inside apprehensively, and saw not flying sparks, but Blaze standing there with a flame in her palm, bright and stable.
Blaze's innate Originium Arts Assimilation does not stand out among the elite operators. She had gotten to this point through hard work and raw willpower—as she always does.
Every asset is important to Rhodes Island, and Blaze has always been one of our most valuable.
—Mechanist
text.zh:
【理发室服务记录】
服务对象：煌
服务内容：将卷发拉直
煌的头发，是被明火燎焦了才变卷的，再拉也不会变直的！下次练习法术的时候，请小心一点……
——澄闪

【缝纫室服务记录】
服务对象：煌
服务内容：修补衣服上的小洞
煌第三次来修补衣服，要求仍然是“尽量别让送我衣服的那家伙看出来”。上一次，衣服的半截袖子被烧坏，还好这次只是个小洞。她有在像她说的那样，尽量控制自己的火焰。
——柏喙

【武器升级改造服务记录】
煌刚开始研究那个从炎国带回来的施术单元时，我本来以为她会在炸穿几次训练场地的墙壁后，老老实实地换回自己的链锯。毕竟她可是煌，在所有人认知中那个能一锯子拆掉敌人两米厚防爆门的家伙，现在要改用这么束手束脚的东西……见过瓦伊凡战士拿绣花针扎人吗？
可我没有想到，煌居然要我给她的施术单元安装精准调节阀。
按她自己的说法，是想要在自己原本的源石技艺上探索新的可能，将热流化为火焰。“能准确地控制力量，是强大的一种体现”——对，这是她的原话。不管怎么说，精准调节阀还是给她装上了，等她来求我拆掉那玩意儿的时候，我一定会借机嘲笑她。
那一阵子所有人的心都悬着。训练室以每五分钟一次的频率传出爆炸声、碎裂声、“好烫好烫”的叫声，还有消防警报声，但她就是没来找我。
直到有一天，训练室里安静得令人担心，我忍不住去看了一眼——没有乱飞的火焰，煌正将一团火苗稳稳地托在掌心，明亮得灼眼。
煌的源石技艺适应性在罗德岛的精英干员中其实不算那么出众，她竟然靠着拼劲和意志力将源石技艺掌握到这种程度，可是仔细想想，她向来如此。
在当下的情况，罗德岛尤其珍惜每一份力量，而煌一直是我们中的关键一员。
——Mechanist

text.en:
Blaze, who hails from Victoria, was visiting Yan for the first time. She had a bunch of old letters in her hand, and everything in Baizao was fresh and exciting to her bright eyes. She cheered the sugar painter showing off his work—when he asked if she wanted one, she said no, because it would melt in her hand, but she wanted to see him paint one more.
Blaze said her father was a man of culture. As she looked for her father's name on the poetry board in front of the Virtue Bookstore, she also looked at the poems others had left on it. 'What's this... er... scent of... osmanthus... oh! This is about autumn!' She managed to read some of the cursive writing in vertical Yanese script.
After visiting the academy, we had xiaolongbao at a nearby restaurant. I had hardly picked up my chopsticks before her plate was empty. She had nothing but effusive praise for the dish, and the hot soup inside the buns did not seem to bother her in the slightest. I recommended that she take a little more time to take in the flavor, with the traditional method of 'bite, sip and savor.' It took her some effort to slow down, but her eyes went wide once she did. 'Wow, there's so much in there I didn't taste until now!'
I started telling her about the origins of Baizao cuisine and how some of its most famous dishes were made. I have rarely had a listener so attentive, who not only gave me her undivided attention, but was also unafraid to ask questions like 'Why not add three portions of sugar at once, instead of adding one portion three times?'
I enjoyed our conversation very much, and was already making plans about where to take her next, but sadly it was not to be.
—Excerpt from 'Baizao Cuisine & Food Culture', Volume 3
text.zh:
来自维多利亚的友人煌小姐是头一回来炎国，一来就拿着一叠旧信，兴致勃勃地去探访自己眼里的“百灶”。她看什么都新鲜，看到糖画铺老板一展身手便给他喝彩叫好，老板喜滋滋地问她要哪一款，她却说：“我不买，我拿在手上糖就化了。但能不能让我看你再画一个？”
煌小姐说自己的父亲是个文化人，站在明德书局门口的题诗板前找父亲的名字，抓耳挠腮地念别人用草书题的诗：“闻什么——桂什么——香什么——啊，写的是秋天！”竖着写的诗，她横着念竟也歪打正着读懂了一些。
我们逛完学宫，去吃门口的小笼包。几乎是我刚动筷，她的那盘已经空了。她也不嫌烫，抹抹嘴直夸好吃。我请她试试用“一咬，二吮，三尝味”的方法细细尝这小笼包，她努力放慢速度品尝后，惊讶地说：“吃到了刚才没尝出来的味！”
或许是难得有人听得那么认真，我滔滔不绝地给她说起了百灶饮食的来历和经典菜肴的做法。她不仅听得极认真，还会提出诸如“用糖收三遍汁，那为什么不能放三份糖一次搞定？”这样的问题。我身边往来之人，鲜少有人似她这般坦率爽利，不懂就问，因而我十分欢喜与她交谈。
我那时已开始盘算，之后带她去玩些什么，看些什么。可惜，后来发生了种种，那时的愿望也无疾而终。
——节选自《百灶食珍录》卷三

text.en:
Blaze talks about her childhood from time to time.
She has always had a fiery temper and straightforward nature, never afraid to make a stand, whether at school or among the kids in town. She protected the weak kids, and raised her not-so-strong fists against bullies. Her actions, of course, earned her plenty of scolding from her father.
Her father was very different from her, and Blaze never once saw him argue with someone else. He always preached the principles of conflict avoidance and treating others with magnanimity, as written in the classical Yanese texts.
'One time, I said to him: 'You always tell me to be patient, to endure, but what if the bad guys don't stop? What if there's no way for the victims to get justice?'
'Dad thought about it for a long time before putting his hand on my head. He said that if the time comes when there is no choice, when backing down is truly no longer an option, and when I'm sure I must stand up for justice... then I should make a stand.'
The young Blaze did not really understand what her father said, but listened and tried to keep her temper in check.
There was no particular drama to the story of how Blaze contracted Oripathy.
When her father left Victoria, she, already a young adult, began working at a local factory in order to ease the burden on her mother. Such factories in remote regions, with lax oversight and inadequate Originium safety measures, always have their share of Infected workers, but Blaze befriended everyone, treating them all as equals.
Blaze found out that the owner of the factory, who had promised to supply medicine to Infected workers, was refusing to provide even basic painkillers. At first, he claimed that his request was still being reviewed by the governing noble, but Blaze soon realized that the medicine was being held in a warehouse outside the quarantine zone. In fact, medicine was being brought into the warehouse on a weekly basis, before being smuggled out in small batches and sold to the highest bidder. The factory owner had never intended to make good on his promise.
When the workers protested, the owner had soldiers brought in to 'keep the peace' and round up all the protesters. Watching her friends go down one by one because of illness, Blaze went to the door of the factory and begged them to bring medicine, only to be met with the soldiers' cold, indifferent looks. That was when Blaze realized that the time when backing down was no longer an option had come.
Blaze smashed a hole in the wall of factory and led the workers' charge into the medicine warehouse. That was the incident where she contracted Oripathy.
Blaze's life was turned upside down, heralding the events that would eventually lead to her joining Rhodes Island.
'I still think of Dad's teachings sometimes. He wasn't wrong, but I don't regret what I did one bit.'
Only much later did Blaze learn about her father's past. It made her eyes go wide first, then brought tears to them. She never imagined that her gentle, timid father had long since made his own stand for justice. They had been separated by thousands of miles, but were walking on the same path, in a way. Once again, she seemed to feel the warmth of that hand on her head.
text.zh:
煌偶尔会谈起她小时候的事。
在她的讲述里，自己火爆的脾气和耿直的性格从出生起就没有变过。不论是在学校或是小镇上的孩子群体之间，煌总是会打抱不平的那一个。她会毫不犹豫地挡在弱小的孩子身前，她彼时还不算有力的拳头也会落在每一个不怀好意的欺凌者身上。但每当此类事情传入父亲耳中，总少不了一番严厉的批评。
父亲与煌性格迥异。煌从来没有见过父亲与人置气，只是听他一遍又一遍地重复着炎国典籍中“宽厚待人”“夫唯不争故无尤”之类的道理。
“有一回我觉得委屈，我问他，你总是告诉我忍让，可要是那些坏人永远不会停手呢？要是那些被欺负的人永远没处说理呢？
“老爸好像想了很久，他摸着我的头说，真到逼不得已、退无可退的时候，如果确定那是自己必须追求的正义，就……站出来。”
彼时还年幼的煌虽然对父亲的规劝感到不解，但还是尝试听劝，压抑了自己火爆的性子。
至于后来，煌成为感染者的经历，其实算不上多么有故事性。
父亲离开维多利亚后，已经是青年的煌，为了缓解母亲负担生计的压力，去小镇上的工厂打工。小镇地处偏远，监管松弛，矿石病的防护措施难以到位，工厂中自然少不了一些感染者。煌对工友们只是一视同仁，将大家都当作朋友。
然而煌发现，老板承诺给予感染的工人们药物，实际上却连廉价的止痛剂都不肯提供。一开始，老板说自己正在向领主申请药物。可她很快就发现，药就在隔离区外的仓库里。每周都有人送药进仓库，又偷偷分批运走卖给愿意出更高价格的人。老板从未打算走完那个“申请流程”。
工人们得知此事后向工厂发起抗议，老板却反咬一口，请了士兵来“维护秩序”，将所有抗议的工人关在一处。眼看着被关的工友一个接一个因发病倒下，煌冲到工厂门口，声嘶力竭地求他们把药拿过来。看着看守士兵脸上冷漠的表情，煌在愤怒中感受到，或许这就是“退无可退”的时候。
于是，她砸开了工厂的墙壁，带着工人们冲向了药物仓库。就是在那一次事件中，煌变成了感染者。
之后，煌的生活因此发生了翻天覆地的变化，几经辗转，最终加入了罗德岛。
“我偶尔还是会想起老爸教训过的话，他的确是有道理的，可我一点也不后悔。”
直到，煌了解了父亲过往的全貌。起初是惊讶，细想不禁泪湿了眼眶。她从未想过那个温良怯懦的父亲其实也早已为自己的正义站了出来。虽然远隔万里，但他们也算在相同的道路上并肩前行。儿时搭在头上的那只手，她似乎又感受到了它的温度。

text.en:
'What is this, Lin Qingyan? Did you want me to investigate something for you?'
'This list of names is for you. The ones in bold are the ones still alive... your true relatives. It wasn't easy putting it together, but as far as I know there should be nothing missing.
'My true... are they doing okay?'
'The exile was just relocating them to cities away from Baizao. The government is providing support now that the ban has been lifted. It's not much, but at least they're being compensated for the suffering they went through.'
'Good... that's good enough.'
'You have regained your Yanese identity. If you want, you can go back to Yan to seek your family, even live there, and no one will stand in your way.'
'......'
'You're not going to seek them out?'
'No. Or rather, I don't know. Let's say I do find them. What do I say to them? What do I do? We never knew each other our entire lives. What happens if I just showed up? Do we embrace each other in tears and pour our hearts out to a stranger, just because we share the same bloodline? Maybe it's not the right thing to say, but it's not me they need, and it's not me who should be offering apologies and compensation.
'Besides, I never had an identity in Yan to begin with. Whether it was being framed as the descendant of a traitorous official forty years ago, or this abrupt pardon, everything was just to make up for a lie. None of it has anything to do with me.
'Let's turn the page. That snow was both the ending, and the answer.
'We'll hang out together once your practices are over. But I'll come visit. As Blaze, elite operator of Rhodes Island.'
text.zh:
“这是什么意思，麟青砚？要我帮你查什么吗？”
“这是给你的。这张名单，加粗的是现在还活着的人……是你真正的亲属。凑齐这些信息不容易，应该没有遗漏了。”
“我真正的……他们，都还好吗？”
“当时说流放，其实是将他们安置在远离百灶的城市。现在禁忌解除，上面也安排了人对他们进行生活上的援助。不能说过得多好，只能说，至少有人在为他们受的苦做弥补。”
“好……那就行。”
“你在炎国的身份也已经解禁。从此以后，无论你想回炎国寻亲还是生活，都不会有人妨碍你。”
“……”
“你不打算回去找他们？”
“不打算。我是说，我不知道，麟青砚。你说，找到了他们，我该说什么，做什么呢？我们明明前半辈子互不相识，就因为我与他们有着相同的血脉，就该突然出现在他们面前，与他们相拥而泣，互相理解吗？这么说或许很不对，但，他们需要的不是我。该给他们道歉和补偿的人也不是我。
“更何况，我在炎国没有什么身份。不管是四十年前沦为罪臣后人，还是现在突然被‘大度’地免罪，都只是为了弥补一个谎言，和我本人从来都没有关系。
“所以，就让这个事翻篇吧。那场雪……既是结局，也是答案。
“等你闭关出来，我会去找你玩的，不过，是作为访客——罗德岛精英干员，煌。”

text.en:
You were curious about the bowl of viscous liquid Blaze was eating, her hands covered in flour.
'This? No, it's not black sesame soup, it's tangyuan. The last few broke from the heat of my palm, and I cooked them so they wouldn't go to waste. The ones I made earlier are alright, so I'll cook them for everyone once my sister gets here.
'In Yan, tangyuan is the symbol of a reunion. Plopping down this bowl of glutinous rice balls in front of someone is all you need for them get the message. And if it's coming from someone like me, who always speaks first and thinks later, would it send an even clearer message? No idea, but that's why I wanted to find out, while everyone is here.
'The reunion could be for me and my sister, linked not by blood but by fate. It could be for me coming back from a long journey, and seeing everybody else for the first time in a while. You get a bowl, Amiya gets a bowl, Mechanist gets a bowl, and...
'...And there are so many others I wish could be sharing tangyuan with us.'
Blaze's tone drops a bit, but she soon picks herself up.
'I know. Nothing's ever perfect, and life always has its share of sorrowful goodbyes. What does it matter, though? Many of us have left, but no one will ever be forgotten.
'Our dreams have never changed. All of us here at Rhodes Island will always be together.'
text.zh:
看见煌满手沾着面粉，吃着一碗不可名状的糊状物，你有些好奇。
“这个啊，不是芝麻糊，是汤圆，哈哈……最后几个被我手上的温度烫干裂了，不想浪费就煮了吃了。幸亏起先包的没裂，等我妹到了，我就煮给大家吃。
“我听说，汤圆在炎国的意义是‘团圆’，当你把这么一碗糯米团子端到对方面前的时候，你想说的话就已经说出来了。像我这样习惯了有啥说啥的，把一碗热腾腾的汤圆‘啪！’地放在对方面前，会不会比嘴上说得更多、更清楚？不知道，所以就想趁大家都在的时候试试看。
“像我和我妹这样没有血缘关系却命运相连的姐妹，相遇也算一种团圆吧？还有，我远行回来，和大家也算得上团圆吧？我算过了，你一碗，阿米娅一碗，Mechanist一碗，还有……
“……还有很多人，要是还能请他们吃上一碗该多好。”
煌的声音低落下去，短暂的消沉后，她又给自己鼓足干劲，恢复了精神。
“我知道，圆满难求嘛，悲欢离合都是没办法的事，但那又怎么样呢，许多人离开了，但没有人会被遗忘。
“我们的理想没有变，罗德岛的大家，永远都是在一起的。”

text.en:

text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。
