text.en:
Lessing became a frequent visitor of the training grounds while Rhodes Island was docked at Leithanien.
He does not object to observers, whether he is practicing on his own or sparring with others, claiming that there is 'nothing out of the ordinary' about his fighting style, after all. Looking at the way he swings his tape-wrapped claymore though, one cannot help but wonder if he is truly Leithanian. After all, all things Leithanian are supposed to be elegant and beautiful, from music to art to Arts to swordplay. But Lessing's fighting style is plain and unembellished, the ultimate expression of efficiency. The one-swing, one-kill approach not only requires heightened concentration, perception, and reaction speed, it also requires a motion that holds nothing back, putting great strain on the body. In other words, Lessing's swordplay places unbelievable stress on both mind and body, but he seems entirely unconcerned. When I advised him to be more careful, he looked as though he'd been told to stop eating his food so quickly.
I know many are curious about the tape he wraps around his sword... There are rumors that he studied with an ill-tempered Arts master, and that the tape is the key to unlocking terrifying Arts. The latest version of the rumors even claim that the sword transforms into a massive monster—larger than Rhodes Island itself—if the tape is removed, devouring any living thing that it touches without a single trace.
The truth was finally revealed when some of the bolder operators invited him to spar 'holding nothing back.' While Lessing does have considerable skill in Arts, he uses them sparingly, and is a far cry from the legendary caster the rumors speak of. As for the tape, it does not seem to serve any special purpose other than wrapping around the sword's blade.
'Someone like him really only has two reasons to wrap up his sword.
'One, to make it less conspicuous.
'Two, to avoid hurting others.'
text.zh:
在罗德岛本舰停靠莱塔尼亚期间，止颂成了训练场里的常客。
无论是自行练习，还是与人对战，止颂都并不排斥旁人的围观。毕竟如他所说，他的战斗方式确实“没什么特别的”。但每每看他挥舞那柄缠绕着绷带的巨剑，大家都难免疑惑——他真的是个莱塔尼亚人吗？莱塔尼亚的音乐，莱塔尼亚的剑技，莱塔尼亚的艺术，莱塔尼亚的法术，不都应该是优雅曼妙的吗？可止颂这样极致追求高效的战斗方式，实在称不上赏心悦目。要一击即中，除了身临战场时高度集中的注意力，敏锐的洞察力与反应力，往往还意味着给身体带来巨大负荷的、不留余力的动作。换言之，止颂的战斗方式给身体和精神带来的压力都是难以想象的，而他自己并不觉得这有什么不应该，我叮嘱他以后要注意的时候，他的表情就好像我在讲“吃饭不要太快”一样。
我知道有很多人更在意他剑上缠着的那些带子……不是老有人传他跟随一位脾气超臭但法术超高的超级魔头学过本事嘛，他一定掌握了某种可怕的法术，而那些绷带正是法术的开关。最新的版本是，一旦解开绷带，那柄剑就会在一片喷薄的黑雾中化作比罗德岛还大的庞然大物，所及之处，生物被敲骨吸髓，吞噬殆尽，一点儿渣都不剩下……
当然，随着某些胆大的干员主动提出与止颂“毫无保留地比试”，真相也终于显露——止颂确实会一些法术，确实也称得上厉害，但他用得不多，更没到传说的那种地步。至于那些绷带，除了能将剑身裹起来外，貌似真的没什么特别的作用。
“其实他这样的人，之所以往剑上缠带子，不外乎两个原因。
“第一，觉得自己的大剑太招摇了，缠上带子就不那么显眼了。‘聪明人’有时候是这样的。
“第二，只是怕伤害到别人。”

text.en:
'Can you practice drums for an hour straight?'
'Piece of cake.'
'Can you stay focused and solve one of Hypatia's questions in an hour?'
'Probably.'
'But can you answer that problem after practicing drums for an hour in a small room without noise-cancelling headphones?'
'What are you talking about? I only asked you to go see what Lessing is doing in that room he booked.'
'And that's what I saw!'
'......'
'You're confused too, aren't you? He shows up at the training grounds at the same time every day, completes a full training program and then some, pushing himself to the limit. He lets the pain push him forward, day after day, for half a month. Then today, he suddenly books an empty room with Logistics... No surprise there, everyone needs to let some steam off, after all, no matter how disciplined. So I cracked open the door, and almost went deaf. He was just banging away at the drums. No headphones, his hair soaked with sweat, but his expression the same as always. Which is to say, no expression at all.'
'And? So what if he needed to let off some steam?'
'I didn't dare go in, so I waited for him to come out, which took quite a while. I asked him how he was feeling, and told him he could come talk to us if he ever feels stressed at Rhodes Island, because we're all friends here. And you know what he said? He said that was how he thinks, relaxes, gets rid of extraneous thoughts... Basically, he's meditating in the midst of deafening drums.
'Wow.'
'......'
'Well, never mind that. At least we learned two comforting facts.'
'Yeah?'
'One, Lessing's psychological state is perfectly fine. Two, it's true that every Leithanian can play an instrument.'
—Conversation between Hibiscus and an anonymous Logistics Department operator
text.zh:
“我问你啊，你能持续练习架子鼓一小时吗？”
“这有什么难的。”
“如果海帕提娅老师布置了一道思考题，你能在一小时内全神贯注去解出它吗？”
“应该能吧。”
“那如果将你关在一个不大的空房间，不佩戴降噪耳机，持续练习架子鼓一小时，出门时你能给出那道思考题的答案吗？”
“你在说什么？不就是止颂突然申请了一间空房间，我让你悄悄去看看他在干什么吗？你回来问我这些干什么？”
“因为这就是我看到的啊！”
“……”
“你也不理解对不对？你也满脑袋问号对不对？他每天都准时出现在训练场，然后超额完成所有的训练任务，把自己逼到极限，让自己痛苦，让痛苦鞭策自己。半个月如一日，天天如此。终于，他今天向后勤部申请了一间空房间……再自律的人也需要发泄，这样才是正常人嘛。我将那扇门推开了一条缝，里面传出来的声音差点没给我震聋——止颂在卖力敲架子鼓，咚咚咚嚓，咚嚓咚咚咚咚咚……他没戴降噪耳机，头发都湿透了，全是汗，但还是那副表情，就是没表情……”
“然后呢？这不正说明了他需要发泄吗？”
“我没敢进去，好不容易才等到他出来。我问他感觉还好吗，要是在罗德岛上压力太大就别硬撑着，可以随时跟我们说，别觉得自己没朋友，大家都是他的朋友。你知道止颂跟我说什么吗？他说那是他思考的方式、放松的方式、排除杂念的方式……你可以理解为，他在足以把人震聋的架子鼓声中冥想。”
“哇哦……”
“……”
“算了算了，起码有两点能让人放下心来。”
“什么？”
“一、我们的止颂干员确实没什么心理问题。二、莱塔尼亚人确实人人都会乐器。”
——后勤部，芙蓉与某干员的聊天记录

text.en:
[Urtica Investigation Report Excerpts]
Lessing's upbringing was much simpler than expected. He was born to serve the Graf Urtica, as every child in his family has for generations. This tradition was abolished by the Witch King when he ascended to the position of Graf Urtica, but the Maeyer family took up the responsibility of protecting the Grafschaft of their own accord, working tirelessly to maintain the territory's order and prosperity.
The aftermath of the Witch King's fall hit the family especially hard. Though no member of the family was officially denounced as an associate of the Witch King, they were put under surveillance for years, and the family went into decline. A few years later, the spire of Urtica welcomed a new Graf. Perhaps as part of the surveillance, or perhaps to curry favor with the new lord, a noble came to the Maeyer farm and requested they send their youngest child into the spire.
That child did indeed come to the spire, his fate once again aligned with that of his family's, but a contradictory edict came the day he was expecting to meet the Graf who would be his master. 

[Scattered Records From Ludwigs-Universität]
Oh, pay no heed to the child, Lessing Maeyer. He's no threat.
So what if he grew up by the seat of my teacher? I know him. We're of the same kind. A trapped beast extending his tongue, trying to taste the sweetness of fate outside the cage, but his vision is so narrow that he can only see the dust-filled corners, not the spectacular scene above his head.
What I shame... I thought he would be a comrade. When he fought back against the Gendarmerie who were dispersing the crowd and was beaten within an inch of his life, I didn't think he'd get back up, scratching and clawing, snatching the Gendarmerie's badge, biting until his mouth was bloodied. He yelled at the Gendarmerie, 'What difference is there between you and the people you're beating?' Even the professor glanced at him that day...
I was the one who brought him back, gave him a chance to live. But he didn't learn a thing from the professor. Still just as useless, but with more shackles.
...Maybe I was wrong, maybe the professor never looked at him at all.

[Conversation Log]
'If not for the professor's insistence, the Liches would have left Leithanien following the death of Herkunftshorn. The Twin Spires of the empresses are imposing, but hardly reassuring. Just because the sunset no longer tasted of blood didn't mean it was perfect. There are cracks in even the most beautiful of clouds. A new change was brewing... it's a story we've seen many times. The Liches that remained in Zwillingstürme took more care to hide their tracks, bringing their research projects to a close and were ready to fly at a moment's notice. But then one day, the professor brought a Caprinae back to Ludwigs-Universität. He said he picked him up from the Gendarmerie. We were confused and alarmed. You understand, right? Who would take in a new pet while preparing to move? Well, that's what I complained to the professor about, at any rate.'
'The Liches eventually got used to this outsider in their lives. You know how he is. He's like a piece of wood. You can't get a reaction out of him. Weird, yeah, but that weirdness comes in handy sometimes. When the professor is angry, the students dare not go into his office, and even the other Liches keep their threads stowed, lest he drag them inside and gives them a verbal smackdown. Lessing's the only one with the nerve to push through the crowd, open the door, head into the office, and pick up the books and equipment scattered on the ground, all without the slightest sliver of an expression on his face. It's like he's completely deaf, as the professor put it. Anyway, we learned to tell when it was safe to go in by the change in volume after Lessing went in. He doesn't talk much, but he's pretty reliable. Anything that's inconvenient for the Liches to do or buy on their own, they ask him to do, so he goes into town every month with a long shopping list, and comes back hanging a bunch of bags on his sword...
'Say, do you think you can give him the occasional vacation, you know, to visit Kazdel from time to time? I-I'm not saying we need him around to deal with the professor. Just tell him that, er, his sister and the rest of his family, er, miss him. Right, miss him.'
text.zh:
【乌提卡领相关调查记录节选】
止颂的出身比我们预想的要简单许多。他出身于乌提卡领的一个扈从家族，他们家族的孩子从诞生之日起，就注定了会成为乌提卡伯爵的扈从。直到巫王担任乌提卡伯爵之时，这项约束家族的传统才被废除。不再担任扈从的梅耶尔家族，却自愿承担起了守护乌提卡领的责任，不遗余力地为领内事务奔忙。
而伴随着巫王的倒台，曾与乌提卡高塔紧密相关的梅耶尔家族也受到了不小的牵连。虽然该家族内并未有人被正式宣判为巫王残党，但在经历了数年的审查、监视之后，梅耶尔家族几近没落。数年之后，乌提卡领的高塔迎来了一位新的伯爵。或许是出于试探，又或许只是想讨好新伯爵，一位贵族来到梅耶尔家的农田里，要求他们将最小的孩子送入高塔。
回到家族命运中，再度成为伯爵扈从的孩子来到了高塔之下。未料就在他本该面见他的领主的当天，他收到了一条相反的谕令。

【在路德维格大学散落的记录】
不，不必在意那个孩子，莱辛·梅耶尔，他构不成威胁。
他是在我老师座旁长大的，那又怎样？我了解他，我和他是同一类人。困兽伸长了舌头，妄图舔舐笼外命运的甘甜。可他的眼光太狭隘！总是投向积满灰尘的角落，不知头顶之上有多么壮美的图景。
真是遗憾……我本以为他能与我们同路。当年他反抗驱赶平民的宪兵，在街边被打得只剩一口气。我没想到他还能跳起来，用指甲抓，用牙齿咬，夺去宪兵的徽章，把嘴咬得鲜血淋漓。他对宪兵大吼：“你和你打的人有什么区别？”那时候连老师都瞥了他一眼……
是我将他拖到老师面前，给了他活下去的机会。可他没从老师的学识中学到什么，还和那时一样愚莽、一样不成器，又给自己套上了一层枷锁。
……也许那时是我看错了，老师根本就没看他。

【一份谈话记录】
“其实，要不是老师坚持，赫尔昏佐伦死后，巫妖们就应该离开莱塔尼亚。拔地而起的女皇双塔是很震撼，但并不能真的让人安心。晚霞里少了血的铁锈味，不代表它真的完美无瑕了。再美的云霞也有裂纹，新的变化早已在酝酿……这样的事情，我们看得多了。所以，待在崔林特尔梅的巫妖更加注意敛藏自己的行迹，抓紧收尾种种研究项目，随时准备开溜。突然有一天，老师带着一个卡普里尼回到了路德维格大学。据说是从宪兵队手里捞回来的。他的做法难免让我们疑惑，也让我们警惕。您大概能懂吧？谁会在准备搬家的当口收养一只小宠物呢？……呃，我当时确实是跟老师这么抱怨的。
“但不知道从什么时候开始，巫妖们都习惯了生活里有这么一个异类存在。您也知道他的性格，跟个木头似的，常常油盐不进，很奇怪对不对？但这种奇怪，有些时候意外地有用欸。老师发起脾气来，大学里的学生们都只敢守在门口，就连其他巫妖都恨不得小心地把线头收好，生怕被拽进去挨一顿教训。这种时候，只有莱辛，面无表情地越过众人，面无表情地推门进去，面无表情地顶着骂声收拾满地凌乱的书籍和法器。用老师的话说，就跟——聋了一样。总之，大家后来学会了根据莱辛进房间后里面音量的变化来判断进去向老师汇报的时机。而且啊，他话是不多，但很靠谱。巫妖们不方便去做的事情，不方便购置的物件，都会拜托他，他每个月都带着一张长长的单子进一趟城，回来时用那把大剑挑着大包小包……
“博士，您说您能不能给他放个假，让他偶尔也来下卡兹戴尔？不不，才不是想让他继续帮我们应付老师呢，您就不能当作……他的姐姐，还有其他家人，都想他了吗？”

text.en:
[Letter Excerpt 1]
...I visited more than a dozen spires in Heidenschwiel. I failed to even get an audience with some of their masters, while others politely saw me out after learning of my purpose. Fortunately, the rest were willing to stay in contact with us.
I am not surprised that you did not leave Leithanien with Professor Fremont. You have seen Grimmacht and conveyed his messages to her. I remember you saying that you would support her, even without her relationship with the Liches. You believe in the path she took... Perhaps the day will come when the people of Leithanien get used to a single empress representing eternal grace, but Grimmacht's vision should not be neglected...
I am visiting my hometown of Lupukarn next month.
Maybe you don't need my advice, but I would ask you to be careful nonetheless, for Urtica is too close to the sunset.
......

[Letter Excerpt 2]
......
Road repairs in the territory: Complete
Procurement of Originium equipment in Zwillingstürme: In progress
Helping with Jif's harvest: Pending return to Urtica
......
Accompanying the Graf on his survey to remap Urtica: Complete
Notifying the nobles to visit the spire: Complete
Repair of Graf Urtica's spire: In progress
......
There is nothing to fear about fate.
text.zh:
【书信摘录·其一】
……我已经拜访过海登施威尔大区的十几座高塔。它们的主人，有些我连面都没有见到，有些在我表明来意后便委婉地下了逐客令。但好在，剩下的那些人愿意和我们保持联系，起码没有拒绝。如果时机成熟，他们可能会在将来的某些时刻，为我们提供某些帮助，无论是重新开启那道不属于现实的门扉，还是……
莱辛，你没有跟随弗莱蒙特阁下离开莱塔尼亚，这并不令我惊讶。你见过赫琳玛特，你曾经代弗莱蒙特阁下向她传递过一些信息。我记得你有一回跟我说，哪怕赫琳玛特没有和巫妖的这层关系，你也会选择支持她。她在走的，是一条你认为对的道路……或许很快，莱塔尼亚的人们会习惯这个国家只有一位代表着“永恒恩典”的女皇，但赫琳玛特的愿景不应该被搁置……
我下个月会回一趟鲁珀坎大区，我的故乡。
另，虽然你并不需要我叮嘱什么，但还是要小心些，乌提卡领离晚霞太近了。
……

【书信摘录·其二】
……
筹备领内道路修缮工作：完成
在崔林特尔梅购置源石设备：进行中
帮助吉菲大叔刈收小麦：返回乌提卡领后安排
……
随伯爵勘察乌提卡领，以备重绘地图：完成
告谕领内诸贵族前往高塔谒见：完成
修缮乌提卡伯爵高塔：筹备中
……
命运不值畏惧。

text.en:
The spruce that had barely grown to the height of his shoulders was nearly fallen, its trunk partially broken.
It rained yesterday, and the earth and rocks were loose. There were tire tracks nearby. A farmer must have accidentally hit it while driving by.
Lessing carefully straightened the spruce. He had no shovel on him, so he used his sword to dig at the soil, pile it around the tree's roots, and hardened it by stomping his foot.
Then he sat down and gazed at the forest before him, not caring about the dirt. Spruces grew all over the wilderness of Leithanien, with no pattern or order. It was an utterly unremarkable sight. Therefore, when back at the Graf's tower Ebenholz asked him where he went, he said it was just out for a walk. In fact, he liked this place, visiting it almost daily before he left for Zwillingstürme, sometimes training, sometimes daydreaming. Rain and storms were frequent, often toppling trees. Other times, craftsmen and farmers took wood from the forest for materials and firewood, but the forest nonetheless grew year after year. Now, it was twice as big as he remembered, so big he could not see where it ended, its canopies blocking out the sun's rays like a mountain range. The spruce, a tree that grew all over the wilderness of Leithanien, so unremarkable that no one thinks to plant them near the spires. But they grow straight and tall, sometimes even taller than the spires. And they will still be here, after all the spires of Leithanien are gone.
text.zh:
那棵才刚刚长到自己肩膀高的云杉歪歪斜斜的，已经能看到部分断裂的根系，只是勉强立着。
昨天才下过一场雨，土石松落，周围有车轮的痕迹，应该是哪个农人驱车经过不小心刮到了它吧。
莱辛小心地将云杉扶正，他临时起意来的，自然不可能随身带着铲子，只能用剑挖来泥土，培在小树的根系附近，再用脚踩实。
忙完这一切，卡普里尼就地坐下来，盯着前面出神，也不管地上脏不脏。前面只是一大片林子。云杉树，莱塔尼亚郊野随处可见的树种，就这么毫无规律地恣意长着。并不是什么特别了不得的风景，所以当回到伯爵塔放下行李，黑键问他要去哪里时，莱辛只是说去随便走走。其实他很喜欢这里，在去崔林特尔梅之前，他几乎每天都过来，锻炼，发呆。那几年气候很差，时常有大雨和雷暴，他经常看到有些树就那么倒在泥地里。为乐器寻找木料的匠人，为生活寻找柴薪的农夫，也时常会打它们的主意。可这片林子，还是每过一年，都会比去年大上一些。此时此刻，它比他印象中大了足足一倍，一眼看不到尽头，连绵的树梢如山脉般拦截了阳光。云杉树，莱塔尼亚郊野随处可见的树，太过普通，从未作为景观树出现在高塔的附近，可它们长得又直又高，有些甚至高过高塔。或许，莱塔尼亚的高塔都倾颓后，这些云杉也依然在。

text.en:
Head maid to Kjerag Saintess Enya Silverash (also known as Operator Pramanix), joining Rhodes Island as delegate of the Saintess.
Responsible for a great deal of connective matters in Pramanix's secret visits to Rhodes Island. Extremely keen on the operator life, presently active as a Caster Operator in all manner of missions.
text.zh:
谢拉格圣女，恩雅·希瓦艾什，也就是干员初雪的侍女长，作为圣女的代表加入罗德岛。
负责初雪秘密访问罗德岛的诸多对接事宜，除此之外，本人也十分享受干员生活，现作为术师干员活跃于各种任务中。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0u/L

What do I say? She doesn't really hide it, and she went so far beforehand as to tell me that her body probably isn't like the layman's, so I'm not overly surprised by this?
Although if I could just have a little discussion with her, get her to undergo regular inspections in my office, let me draw a little blood, that's all. It wouldn't impact her in any real way.
—Warfarin
Ask her yourself.
—Kal'tsit

怎么说呢，因为她本人也不怎么掩饰，甚至她在事前都告诉我说她的身体可能和普通人不一样，所以对于这个结果我也不是很惊讶。
就是能不能和她商量一下，让她定期来我这里做个检查，让我抽点血就行，不会对她有什么影响的。
——华法琳
自己去问。
——凯尔希

text.en:
Though her appearance seems rather youthful, Kjera often strikes a sense of seniority into people. Primarily, this is because she has a rather subconsciously old-fashioned way of looking at certain things, and not in a way that would turn off people of modern thought, but in a 'there are people who still think like this?' way. Moreover, she is exceptionally naturally caring of those around her, and operators who've been on missions with her line up to attest they've felt it was like being on a mission with a family elder, very strange, but not too bad either. Combined with what the Doctor's picked up in Kjerag, Kjera's true identity my be far more complex than the Saintess's head maid.
Just as Dr. Kal'tsit says, 'Of all those of her kind still alive, she may well be the easiest one to get along with.'
text.zh:
虽然外表颇为年轻，但耶拉时常会给人一种长辈的感觉。这主要是因为，她对于一些事物下意识的看法颇为陈旧，这种陈旧还不是会让接受现代思想的人反感的陈旧，而是“现在还有人会这么想？”的陈旧。而且她会非常自然地照顾身边的人，与她出过任务的干员都纷纷表示，感觉就好像在和家里的长辈一起出任务一样，感觉很怪，但是又挺好的。结合博士在谢拉格的见闻，耶拉的真实身份，恐怕远不止圣女的侍女长那么简单。
正如凯尔希医生所说，“在她所有还活着的同类中，她恐怕是最好相处的之一”。

text.en:
Compared to Pramanix, who has to go out of her way to make her own free time to leave Kjerag and come to Rhodes Island on 'vacation,' Kjera as her head maid clearly has much more liberty over allotting her own time. Pramanix may not stop over at Rhodes Island for long throughout the course of a year, but Kjera seems to stay aboard so long as she wishes it, likely because she simultaneously has a duty as a contact bridge between Rhodes Island and Saintess Enya—though as far as Rhodes Island is concerned, at least initially, we had no expectations of such contact.
Before Pramanix first visited Rhodes Island, Kjera didn't actually shy from meeting any others from Kjerag, not even avoiding showing up in the same place as SilverAsh when he visited—of course, both SilverAsh and her are obviously people who know the limits.
Essentially, Kjera has never given anyone a very clear sense of being 'the surrogate of the Saintess,' but more pertinently, she seems to take a lot more joy in the Operator lifestyle than many others.
Moreover, she has a full understanding of Kjerag; even the travel handbooks issued by Karlan Trade don't know as much as she does, and in her vivid explanations, plenty of operators have gained a more profound comprehension of what kind of place Kjerag is.
text.zh:
相比需要专门为自己腾出时间离开谢拉格前来罗德岛“休假”的初雪，身为其侍女长的耶拉，对于自身时间的分配显然要自由许多，初雪一年中在罗德岛逗留的时间可能不会太久，而耶拉似乎只要她想，她可以一直留在罗德岛上，这可能是因为她同时肩负罗德岛与圣女恩雅之间联络桥梁的责任——虽然对于罗德岛来说，至少在一开始我们并没有期望这样的联系。
在初雪没有造访罗德岛的时候，耶拉其实并不避讳与其他来自谢拉格的人产生交集，甚至当银灰造访罗德岛时，她也并不避讳与银灰出现在同一个场合——当然，无论是银灰还是她，明显都是知道分寸的人。
总而言之，耶拉并没有给人一种很明显的“圣女的代理”这样的感觉，倒不如说，她似乎比许多人都要对身为干员的生活更加乐在其中。
而且她对于谢拉格十分了解，即使是喀兰贸易发布的旅行手册上的内容也没有她知道的多，在她生动的讲解下，不少干员也对谢拉格是一个怎样的地方产生了更加深刻的理解。

text.en:
When Kjera applied for Saintess Enya's interim collaborative operator status on her behalf, Rhodes Island was thoroughly hesitant.
Firstly, Saintess Enya was already nominally Kjerag's leader, and Rhodes Island policy has always refrained from having direct ties to any political entity. Secondly—before that, her elder brother, Enciodes, had already become a Rhodes Island interim collaborative operator—SilverAsh.
If Enya and Enciodes' relations weren't apparent by the end of the Doctor's journey to Kjerag, then they were crystal clear by the time Kjera handed her application in. The siblings' reconciliation had already turned out as a false start. They chose their own respective positions, and hence simply acted on them, nothing more.
And Enya still decided to join Rhodes Island even after knowing the basis of our and Enciodes' relationship; we're hard-pressed to believe her objective really was as simple as Kjera claims, that she wanted to give herself a moment of reprieve from the bustle of government affairs, and reunite with her sister. Or, perhaps, this truly is her mind, but given her identity, just the slightest carelessness and Rhodes Island would become another battleground for her and Enciodes' game, even if that's not what she wants.
But in the end, Rhodes Island still approved her application. After all, taking a step back, Kjera joining Rhodes Island as Enya's surrogate already gave rise to ties between us and Enya, and refusing at this time would be like sticking our heads in the sand. In another regard, Rhodes Island has always been capable of maintaining its own position, and as Enya and Enciodes are both willing to accept Rhodes Island's terms, acting as operators under certain restrictions, they would have to honor Rhodes Island's policy in that case. At Rhodes Island, she is Operator Pramanix, and Enciodes is Operator SilverAsh, with nothing on top.
'...Speaking as a bystander, I'm very happy Enya and Enciodes have separately made their choices. The answers they've submitted are both brilliant, and I have high hopes for the future. But I'm no more than an observer, in the end. I'm Enya's head maid; I've seen her anger, bewilderment and tears. During the Snowcap Incident, I could say I couldn't interfere in the process of their giving their answers, so I'm not willing to directly act—in reality, if I really can't avoid it in the end, I will act to save Enya—but what about the future? Will I just fold my arms and watch then, too? Doctor, to tell the truth, I don't think I can do that.'
'That's one big reason I came here, Doctor. These siblings make their own choices, and the barrier crossed between them will grow larger and larger, but given you could conclude the Snowcap Incident so, I trust that you also have the ability to find them another way in future. Doctor, you're going to help me, aren't you?'
text.zh:
当耶拉代替圣女恩雅向罗德岛提出成为临时合作干员的申请时，罗德岛是十分犹豫的。
一是因为圣女恩雅已经是谢拉格名义上的领袖，罗德岛的方针始终是不与任何政治实体产生直接联系，二是——在那之前，她的兄长，恩希欧迪斯已经成为了罗德岛的临时合作干员——银灰。
恩雅与恩希欧迪斯的关系，如果说在博士结束谢拉格之旅时尚不明朗，那么在耶拉递出申请的时间点也已经十分清晰了。兄妹和解在此时已经成了一个伪命题，他们各自选择了自己的立场，接下来要做的，只是贯彻自己的立场而已。
而恩雅在知道恩希欧迪斯与罗德岛关系的基础上依然提出加入罗德岛，我们很难认为她的目的真的只是单纯地如耶拉所说，想要给自己在繁忙的政务中找到一些喘息时间，以及与妹妹团聚。又或者说，即使她真的这么想，但是以她的身份，只要稍不注意，哪怕她不希望，罗德岛也会成为她与恩希欧迪斯博弈的另一战场。
但最终，罗德岛还是同意了她的申请。毕竟，退一步说，耶拉作为恩雅的代理加入罗德岛，本就已经让罗德岛与恩雅之间产生了联系，在这时拒绝，也不过是掩耳盗铃。另一方面，罗德岛向来能够坚持自己的立场，既然恩雅与恩希欧迪斯都愿意接受罗德岛的条件，在某种束缚下成为干员，那么，他们也必须遵守罗德岛的规则。在罗德岛，她就是干员初雪，恩希欧迪斯就是干员银灰，没有在那之上的东西。
“……站在旁观者的立场，我对于恩雅和恩希欧迪斯分别做出了选择是很高兴的，他们给出的答案都很好，让我很期待。但我毕竟不只是一个旁观者。我是恩雅的侍女长，我见过她的愤怒、迷茫还有眼泪。在雪山事变中，我可以说我不能干涉他们交出答卷的过程，所以我不愿意直接出手——实际上，最后如果真的无法挽回，我是一定会出手救下恩雅的——但是，未来呢？未来我也要袖手旁观吗？博士，说真的，我觉得我做不到。”
“这也是我来到这里的一大理由，博士。这对兄妹各自做出了选择，横亘在他们之间的隔阂将会越来越大，但你既然能让雪山事变以那样的方式收场，我相信你也有能力在未来为他们找出另一种可能性。博士，你会帮我的，对吗？”

text.en:
Doctor, you should be able to guess who I am. Am I Kjeragandr? Or perhaps an existence very intimate to Her?
You'd find it slightly boring if I personally told you, so I'll let you imagine. After all, it's not important in the end, is it?
At least, I personally feel it isn't.
When She was born, She thought there was only the snowcapped mountain between heaven and earth, and the people living on the snowfields, and She automatically felt close to those people. She had never left Kjerag before, and She only knew a land by that name, and was only acquainted with the people who lived upon it. The Kjerag people believed they were relying on Her, but in actuality, wasn't She relying on them too?
Did thinking of having to bear the people's hopes terrify Her in turn? Had confronting the way in which things developed left Her at a loss? Did realizing the people held to faith and ceased to walk on cause Her regret?
Who was She?
In all honesty, what this question should be asking is, what was She, and what did She represent.
My answers are, She was born of Kjerag's people, and She stands for what once happened, but She doesn't know what *is* happening, nor what *will* happen.
Kjerag's future has never been in Her hands, and should not be in Her hands.
But if so—what course should She now follow?
Why would She be born unto this great land? If protecting Kjerag is not Her calling, then what meaning is there in Her life?
This answer, She wishes to find.
text.zh:
博士，你应该能猜到我是谁，我就是耶拉冈德？或者是与祂十分亲近的存在？
这个问题要是由我亲自来告诉你会有些无聊，所以，还是任由你想象吧，毕竟这其实不重要，不是吗？
至少我自己觉得，这不重要。
祂在诞生时，以为天地间只有这片雪山，和生活在这片雪原上的人，祂自然而然地对他们产生了亲近之感。祂从未离开过谢拉格，祂知道的，只有谢拉格这片土地，认识的，也只有生活在这片土地上的人。谢拉格人以为自己在依靠祂，实际上，是不是祂也在依靠谢拉格人呢？
是否当祂想到要承担人们的期望时也会觉得惶恐，是否当祂面对发展的方向时也曾迷茫，是否当祂发现人们因为信仰而停下脚步时也曾后悔？
祂是谁。
实际上这个问题应该问的是，祂是什么，祂代表什么。
我的回答是，祂是诞生于谢拉格的生灵，祂代表过去发生过什么，而祂不知道正在发生什么，以及即将发生什么。
谢拉格的未来从来不掌握在祂的手上，也不该掌握在祂的手上。
但如果是这样的话——祂该何去何从？
祂为什么会降生在这片大地上？如果守护谢拉格不是祂的使命，那祂的生命有何意义？
祂想要找到这个答案。

text.en:
The Doctor has determined, though Kjera hasn't explicitly stated it, she clearly possesses some form of high-speed, even instantaneous motion ability. Otherwise, her elusive and fleeting movements become impossible to explain.
Kjera doesn't hide this, and has given a definitive reply.
'I can indeed appear wherever I want within Kjerag's borders, but I can't do that outside of them.'
Aside from that, she's also shown herself to have some ability of mental suggestion, able to make others not consider her conspicuous, and she's relied on this ability to lead her long life in Kjerag without being suspected.
Her openness actually deepens Rhodes Island's confusion—in the end, this clearly doesn't fall under any Originium Arts.
However, she and Nian should be of the same sort. After all, the first time she saw Nian, her stunned look left a deep impression on us. Nian seems to take a fair liking to her as well, frequently showing up solicited by her chef's table.
Further, compared to Nian's reason-rejecting abilities, her own could be called so much as immature, which inevitably piques greater curiosity in their true identities, as well as their race's mode of life.
text.zh:
根据博士的判断，耶拉虽然没有明说，但她明显拥有某种类似高速移动，甚至瞬间移动的能力，否则，无法解释她神出鬼没的行动。
对此，耶拉没有遮掩，给出了肯定的答复。
“我确实可以做到出现在谢拉格境内的任何地方，不过在外面是做不到的。”
此外，她还表示，自己拥有某种精神暗示能力，能够让他人不认为自己可疑，她就是依靠这种能力在谢拉格生活许久而不被怀疑的。
她的直白反而加深了罗德岛的困惑——毕竟，这明显不属于源石技艺中的任何一种。
不过，她和年应当是同类，毕竟，她第一次见到年时，那副惊愕的样子实在令人印象深刻。年似乎也相当中意她，经常会不请自来地出现在她主厨的饭桌旁。
而和年那种不可理喻的能力相比，她的能力甚至可以说是稚嫩，这不得不让人对她们的真实身份，以及族群的生态产生进一步的好奇。

text.en: Lunacub, a wandering hunter from the Siracusan wilderness, joined Rhodes Island after an introduction by Penguin Logistics. Serves as a guide for Rhodes Island's field operations in Siracusa and as a part-time Sniper Operator.
text.zh: 子月，游荡在叙拉古荒野上的猎人，经由企鹅物流的介绍加入罗德岛，担任罗德岛在叙拉古野外行动的向导，兼职狙击干员。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 8%
Operator Lunacub exhibits Originium crystal distribution on her left ankle.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.22u/L
Operator Lunacub was not familiar with Oripathy prevention methods and her vitals were not as steady as her outward appearance would suggest. With the intervention of the Medical Department, Lunacub's condition has gradually stabilized. She is willing to listen to doctors, as long as they can find her.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】8%
干员子月在左脚踝处可见明显源石结晶分布。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.22u/L
干员子月并没有良好的矿石病防范意识，她的身体状况并没有她表现出来的那么好。在医疗部的介入下，子月的病情逐渐稳定。她还算听医生们的话，前提是你能找得到她。

text.en:
Lunacub was introduced to Rhodes Island by the owner of Penguin Logistics. The rap star himself somehow showed up at HR and handed over Lunacub's file, along with his autograph. As he put it: 'This kid did a little something for my girls, so you guys take care of her.'
Lunacub herself didn't hesitate to take Rhodes Island's offer, to the point that I'm not quite sure she knows what a 'job' really is. But when we got to talking about company benefits, she immediately showed some enthusiasm. And she had somehow already figured out where the cafeteria was on the landship, which we can say was a good demonstration of her intelligence gathering abilities.
We didn't have high hopes for her operator exams since, as far as we knew, she'd never received any formal training. But she completed the entire battery with impressive skill, and proudly told the instructors, 'Out there, I learned to use my brain to help the pack solve problems! Agnese always says I'm really smart!'
I don't know who Agnese is, but when it comes to sneaking into the warehouse, Lunacub is plenty smart. And thank goodness she hasn't figured out how our security system works. —Logistics Operator
text.zh:
子月是由企鹅物流的那位老板介绍到罗德岛的，那个说唱界的大明星不知怎么就出现在了罗德岛的人事办公室，一边给我们签名一边把子月的档案交到了我们手上。按他的说法，“这小姑娘也算是帮了点我家员工的忙，你们照看着点吧”。
子月本人对于罗德岛的工作邀约并没有表现出任何犹豫，甚至我们怀疑她可能并不十分明白“一份工作”到底意味着什么，当人事部的干员向子月介绍她的职责时，她看起来完全没有在听，但当话题进展到公司福利时，子月立马展现出了极高的热情，并且天知道为什么她已经摸清了罗德岛本舰内的食堂在哪里，我们只能说，这或许也从侧面印证了她的情报搜集能力。
我们本以为干员测试不会进行得很顺利，毕竟据我们所知，子月从没接受过任何系统性的训练。但她凭借让人惊叹的技巧利落地完成了所有项目，她自豪地向教官们表示：“在外面，开动脑筋，帮兽群解决问题可是我的强项！阿涅塞都经常夸我聪明！”
我不知道阿涅塞是谁，但就想尽办法溜进仓库这件事而言，子月确实很聪明，谢天谢地她至今没搞清楚我们的安保系统是怎么运作的。——后勤部干员

text.en:
Operator Lunacub grew up in the wilderness. Or to be more precise, she was raised by the wilderness.
She reports living in the wilds with the beasts for as long as she can remember, with her friend Agnese teaching her how to feed herself, how to use a bow and arrow, and how to work with the beasts to lay traps and catch prey. Our investigations reveal that Lunacub did lead a pack that included several types of beast, which is indeed puzzling, as it is rare enough for different beasts to coexist peacefully in a pack, let alone submit to the authority of a human.
Some Rhodes Island researchers suspect her of using some kind of Arts to manipulate them, but she herself denies this. 'If you spend a lot of time with them, you start to understand what they want. They're not complicated.' But observation records suggest that 'getting along' is definitely not as simple as she makes it out to be.
Lunacub often mentions a friend 'Agnese,' who played a very important role in her relationship with the pack. Discussions with her make it clear that Agnese is more of a parental figure than a friend. She consistently claims that Agnese is with her, and there are indeed indications that some kind of presence surrounds Lunacub. But whatever the case may be, we have yet to determine who or what this 'Agnese' is.
[Classified Log]
I spoke to Agnese and we agreed.
It may still be risky to have Projekt Red and Lunacub in the same space, but we have to try. I will do what I can to make sure that Red is stable and that Lunacub is restrained by Agnese's request.
I know that Red went to Siracusa, I know what she did, and this pointless conflict has gone on long enough.
text.zh:
干员子月在荒野上长大。更确切的说法是，荒野养育了她。
根据子月自己的陈述，从记事起，她就已经在外面和兽群生活在一起了，她的朋友阿涅塞教会了她如何炮制食物填饱肚子，如何使用弓箭，如何与兽群协作布下包围网，然后把猎物逼入绝境。根据我们的调查，子月确实领导了一个由数种牙兽构成的，客观意义上的“兽群”，这确实十分令人费解，数种牙兽能够在一个群落中和平共处已经足够罕见，更何况，它们居然接受了一名人类的统辖。
部分罗德岛的研究人员曾一度怀疑她使用了某种能够操纵野兽的源石技艺，但是子月本人否定了这一点。按照她的说法，“只要相处久了，自然就能明白它们想要什么了，它们可没什么弯弯绕。”但从人类已有的对于野生动物的观察记录来看，这种“相处”绝对没有子月嘴上说的这么简单。
我们注意到，子月经常提到她的那位朋友“阿涅塞”，这位阿涅塞毫无疑问在她与兽群的关系中扮演了十分重要的角色。从子月的言谈中不难判断，阿涅塞与其说是她的朋友，更像是她的养育者。子月一直声称阿涅塞就在她的身边，也确有种种迹象表明，某种存在时常陪伴在子月的周围，但无论借助何种手段，我们暂时都还没有弄清楚，这位“阿涅塞”究竟是什么人，或者，是什么。
【权限记录】
我与阿涅塞谈过了，我们达成了一致。
让红与子月出现在同一空间中或许仍有风险，但必须做出尝试。倘若这种情况发生，我会尽量确保红的状态稳定，子月也会在阿涅塞的要求下保持克制。
我知道红去了叙拉古，我知道她做了什么，这种毫无意义的冲突已经持续得够久了。

text.en:
A note that appeared on the Doctor's desk, the provenance of which is still under investigation:
I saw you talking to the ones who returned from Volsinii, 'Doctor.' I hope that's the right way to address you; it's what everyone else calls you, anyway. You're a clever one, and you're different from most of the others I've met. Your nature is fundamentally different, and I think maybe you can answer my question.
Creatures are often trapped by their nature, both yours and ours. This impulse is sometimes articulated as desire, but in my opinion, this is much more primitive than desire. Desire should at least come from the heart, not from raw, subconscious tendencies. What's even sillier is how some think themselves unblinded by it, claiming that the cravings in their flesh and bones are their own. They take pride and pleasure in it. Yes, I'm talking about Zaaro, the pitiful man.
But I grew bored, and tired. My friends laughed at Emperor, saying he should be belly-sliding across the tundra, as that was his purpose. Just as our purpose is to produce the packmaster of all wolves, and then produce another after a long enough time, and then another after that.
I found Lunacub and raised her. By all rights, she should be my Fang, one who breaks the other Fangs. But the Fangs of a beast don't smile or stare at you with two big eyes and ask you adorably stupid questions. It feels good to be a friend, much nicer than being a master.
I tried to get Lunacub to break free of the path laid for her, but you have to understand that inertia is much more powerful than we ever know. It's like the one you call 'Projekt Red.' You tried hard to influence her, but she struggled to break free. It was the only way she knew how to live. She went back to Siracusa, and your doctor tells me she will return, hopefully.
My desire to find a new life for Lunacub also means that I have to resist the impulses of my nature. But if Emperor can do it, there's no reason I should be less than him.
Maybe you can help us, maybe you know the way. Show me, show me how to shed your instincts, and how to throw off your destiny, 'Doctor.'
text.zh:
一张出现在博士办公桌上的字条，其来源还在调查中：
我注意到你与那几位从沃尔西尼回来的人谈过了，“博士”，希望我这么称呼你是正确的，反正别人都这么喊你。你是个聪明的家伙，你与我所见过的很多人……有着本质上的不同，或许你能回答我的疑问。
生物常常被本性所困，无论是你们，还是我们。这种冲动有时被阐述为欲望，但在我看来，欲望可比它高级得多。欲望起码应该出自自己的本心，而不是那些不受控的，下意识的倾向性举动。更可笑的是，有些家伙自以为从未被它蒙蔽，他们声称骨血中的渴求就是他们自己的渴求，他们以此为乐，以此为荣。没错，我说的就是扎罗，那可怜的家伙。
但我腻烦了，我累了，我的那些伙伴们耻笑大帝，他们觉得大帝就应该去冻原上用肚皮滑行，这就是他存在的意义，就像我们存在的意义就是角逐出一个头狼，然后在漫长的时间后再角逐出下一个，还有再下一个。
我捡到了子月，抚养了她，按照规则，她应该成为我的獠牙，负责折断其他的獠牙，但是野兽的獠牙可不会笑，也不会瞪着双眼睛瞧着你，问你些可爱的蠢问题。成为一位朋友的感觉不错，比成为一个主人要强得多。
我尝试让子月挣脱她既定的道路，但你要知道，惯性的力量比我们所预想的要大得多。就好比你们称之为“红”的那个家伙，你们很努力地尝试影响她，可她很难挣脱，这是她唯一所知的生活方式。她回到了叙拉古，你们的那位医生告诉我她一定会回来，但愿如此。
我希望给子月找到一种新的生活，这也意味着我必须要抵抗那种源自本性的冲动。既然大帝做得到，我没有理由不如他。
或许你能帮助我们，或许你知道方法。展示给我看吧，让我看看你如何摆脱本能，摆脱命运，“博士”。

text.en:
[Classified Log]
You've already become aware of them, Doctor.
They are mysterious, powerful, barely bound by the laws of nature as we know them, and they are the polar opposite of Originium. Research on them is limited because researchers struggle to find the profound differences between them and us.
No matter how they appear to you, remember that Emperor and the High Priest are not some 'strange-looking Liberi,' Zaaro and Agnese are not some 'ghostly Lupos,' and the one who follows Vina is not some Aslan risen out of history.
They are not beasts, of course, nor are they like unto Kjeragandr, or the shattered fragments from Yan.
I wouldn't say they are more 'base,' as it is not our place to define what is basic, but if we had the ability to glimpse the other side of our lands, we may find them everywhere.
They sometimes call themselves the aristocrats of beasts, though they rule over nothing, that much I can guarantee.
Treat them with caution, and perhaps one day they will reveal to us the deepest secrets of these vast lands.
text.zh:
【权限记录】
你已经注意到他们的存在了，博士。
他们很神秘，很强大，他们几乎不受我们所熟知的规则束缚，他们与源石截然相反。关于他们的研究很有限，因为往往研究者们并不能真正发现他们与我们最为深刻的区别。
不管他们在你眼中呈现出什么样子，请记住，大帝与大祭司并不是什么“长得奇怪的黎博利”，扎罗与阿涅塞也不是什么“神出鬼没的鲁珀”，跟在维娜身边的也不是任何一位从历史中走出的阿斯兰。
他们当然不是野兽，也不似耶拉冈德或来自炎国的那些碎片。
我不会说他们更为“本质”，没有人有资格下这个定义，但如果我们有能力窥得这片大地的另一面，他们或许无处不在。
他们有时会自称“兽主”。但他们不会是任何东西的主宰，唯有这点，我可以保证。
谨慎地接近他们吧，或许有一天，他们会为我们揭露这片大地最深处的秘密。

text.en:
We must be on high alert. A terror cell is forming within Rhodes Island. I'm unable to give a complete account of its members, but there is no doubt that Lunacub and Ceobe are among them. They seize every opportunity to bypass the doors we guard. They use any means available to satisfy their basic instincts... Do not underestimate them! Have you realized it? They are learning, they are improving! They've learned to bide their time and plan, and if we leave them to their own devices... Good, I see the look on your faces. Remember this fear and remember our duty.
Upgrade our security systems, keep a close eye on every monitor, leave no critical location unguarded, and be on the lookout for every potential accomplice!
Now, who would like to join me in approaching Closure about raising the cafeteria security budget? —From the morning meeting minutes of the cafeteria logistics supervisor
It has come to our attention that Lunacub and Ceobe probably obtained the minutes of the meeting through certain channels and are already adapting their plans. The two of them have inexplicably been together for three days, which is not a good sign.
text.zh:
我们必须警惕一种倾向，在罗德岛内部，有一个恐怖的同盟正在形成。我还无法指出其中的每一位成员，但毫无疑问，子月和刻俄柏一定在其中。她们抓住一切机会，试图绕过我们所把守的大门；她们想尽种种办法，只为了满足她们的欲望……别小瞧她们！你们注意到了吗？她们在学习，在成长！她们已经学会了掩护和配合，倘若再假以时日……很好，我看到你们的表情了，牢牢记住你们现在的这份恐惧，牢牢记住我们的职责。
升级我们的安保系统，紧紧盯住每一台监视器，不放过任何一个可疑的地点，警惕每一名潜在的同谋！
那么，有谁愿意和我一起，去和可露希尔小姐谈谈提高食堂安保预算的事？——摘自食堂后勤主管的晨会记录
我们注意到，子月和刻俄柏很可能通过某种渠道取得了这份会议记录，并且已经在着手应对。她们俩已经神神秘秘地凑在一起三天了，这可不是什么好兆头。

value.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

text.en:
A native of Laterano, real name Serpilia. Spuria was dispatched to Rhodes Island alongside Executor Richele by the Sixth Tribunal of the Lateran Curia following the Ambrosii Incident.
She is an expert in firearms technology, and proficient in communications and mechanical engineering. She is currently a visiting associate of the Engineering Department.
text.zh:
空构，本名斯普莉雅，拉特兰公民，就职于教皇厅第六厅，于安布罗修事件后跟随执行者里凯莱以拉特兰外派人员的身份加入罗德岛。
精通铳械辅助技术，在通讯、机械工程等领域亦有造诣，现作为访学人员为工程部提供协助。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Spuria shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.11u/L
Operator Spuria has a strong sense of safety awareness. Her blood Originium-Crystal density is so low one suspects she does not leave home at all.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员空构没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.11u/L
干员空构的安全防护意识非常强。不过这个浓度有点过于低了，不由得让人怀疑，她是不是压根就不出门？

text.en:
Based on her training data, Operator Spuria demonstrates well-above average shooting accuracy, adaptability, and proficiency at firing on the move against other moving targets. However, she seems to consciously avoid overreliance on firearms, unlike most Sankta operators from Laterano. Instead, she actively employs drones and information warfare in combat.
Although she has declined to explain why she prefers not to rely entirely on guns, she is happy to demonstrate her proficiency in engineering and firearms technology. She often spends her free time in her room, working on drones and other gadgets. At Closure's recommendation, she began to visit Rhodes Island's workshop, sharing her knowledge with other engineers. Today, she is considered a trusted partner by both our Sankta operators and the Engineering Department, and their go-to if the engineers of Repair Workshop 3 are absent—which they often are. In case Spuria declines—perhaps claiming to be too tired to visit the workshop or that she has not washed her hair—operators are advised to promise to sign-in for her at the next regular meeting, and to bring the equipment in need of repairs directly to her room. Operators should also note, however, that her modifications have been known to cause other 'issues' from time to time.
It took considerable time for Spuria to build up her good relationships with others by repairing their equipment. She began by accepting online or phone commissions, and drones could often be spotted delivering broken equipment to her room, or repaired equipment back to their owners. As no one had seen her in person at the time, rumors began to spread that she was too overweight to leave her room.
text.zh:
根据例行战斗测验的数据，干员空构在训练场上所表现出的射击精准度、临场反应能力，以及在运动状态下对移动目标的跟随打击能力都远超干员平均水平。然而，我们注意到，她似乎在有意避免完全依赖铳械战斗。与我们对来自拉特兰的萨科塔干员的普遍印象不同，比起完全信任铳械的战斗方式，干员空构更愿意利用无人机及相关通信定位技术来协助自己进行铳械作战。
虽然干员空构不愿意过多解释她避免完全依赖铳械战斗的原因，但是她依然乐于向我们展现她对于机械维修、铳械辅助技术的精通程度。入职以后，空构常常把自己关在房间里，钻研她的无人机小发明，随后经过可露希尔的强力引荐，她开始频频出入罗德岛工坊，与工匠们交流切磋精密技术工艺。如今，空构已然成为萨科塔干员与工程部干员信赖的伙伴。每当有干员的精密机械需要维护保养，而第三维修工坊的工匠们因为各种原因不见踪影时，空构总会成为他们第一时间想到的救星——虽然空构常常会以“腿快断了不想走去工坊”“没洗头不想见人”等类似的理由拒绝，但是只要答应在下一次例行会议时替她签到，并把需要维修的设备带去她的宿舍，她大概率也会很乐意帮你解决一些小问题。不过，她的改装，或许会给你带来些新的“问题”。
当然，空构与其他干员通过维修机械而建立起的良好关系，也花了她不少时间。起初，空构只通过电话与网络接受修理委托，在那段时间里，你经常可以在走廊中看见无人机运送着故障机械去往空构的房间，或是正要将修好的机械送去委托人那里，从未有人一睹她的真面目，以致大家都以为空构应该是个心广体胖、行动不便的热心肠大叔——如果不是这样，又怎么会和弃械师傅玩“谁先理谁谁就输”的无聊游戏呢？

text.en:
[Audio Log]
'Hey, did you hear about how a bunch of operators in Medical called in sick?'
'A pathogen leak? Or just overwork from having too many patients?'
'No, I heard there was something involving some rarely used medical equipment in the old storage room...'
'Old storage room? You don't mean the one that used to...'
'Exactly, which is why no one's been in there for ages. Anyway, it was bad enough to have to go into that dark, scary place, but then they started hearing strange voices.'
'What?'
'Not only that, the white cloth covering the equipment started swaying eerily. One of them even saw a semi-transparent figure in a corner!'

[Announcement from the Medical Department]
The Medical Department has completed its preliminary investigation into the rumors surrounding the so-called 'Mystery of the Storage Room.' To protect the privacy of those involved, no public report will be issued. However, in order to prevent similar incidents in the future, the Medical Department hereby announces the following regulations:
1. Without express permission, no drones or other appliances with voice or holographic projection functions are permitted into restricted areas, including surgery rooms, intensive care units, and equipment storage rooms.
2. Non-Medical personnel who wish to study the medical equipment may submit a request to Dr. Kal'tsit in writing. Or just come to the surgery room. Don't use hacking and drones for this sort of thing!
3. Don't use 'studying medical equipment' as an excuse to scare people with drones!
4. Don't deliver your written request via drone! Come in person!
text.zh:
【语音记录】
“喂喂，你们听说了吗，最近医疗部的几个年轻干员，都扎堆请病假了。”
“啊？难道是有致病菌泄露了？还是最近送来的病人太多，都累倒了啊……？”
“都不是！据说是前天晚上有台比较复杂的手术，要用到几个不太常用的医疗设备，它们之前一直堆放在那个旧储藏间里……”
“旧储藏间？是不是那个之前放过……”
“没错，就是因为之前有过那种用途，所以那个地方一直锁着门，很久都没有人进去过了。但是没办法，她们还是得摸着黑进去找设备，本来已经很害怕了，结果竟然真的听到了奇怪的人声！”
“啊？”
“不仅如此，有人看到遮盖器材的白布都诡异地晃动着。那个病得最重的妹妹还说，她在角落里看到了个半透明的鬼影！”

【医疗部公告】
鉴于近期有关“储藏间事件”的流言愈演愈烈，医疗部协同其他部门进行了详实的调查，对这一事件的发生经过与事故成因已得出了初步结论。为了保护相关人员的隐私，我们决定不对此事进行公开处理，只在有限范围内进行说明，并力求妥善解决“储藏间事件”所造成的不良影响。为了避免类似的事件再次发生，经医疗部内部全体会议决定，新增如下管理章程：
一、未经申报，不允许无人机（尤其是装载语音模块和全息投影模块的）随意进入手术室、护理病房、医用设备储藏间等医疗部专用的房间。
二、如有非医疗部干员对医疗用精密仪器与设备感兴趣，可以以书面的形式向凯尔希医生提出参观学习申请。如果觉得手续繁琐，也可以大大方方来手术室观摩，不要把通信入侵技术与无人机潜入技术用在这种容易让人产生误会的事情上。
三、不要以观摩仪器为借口，使用无人机来吓唬人！
四、不要通过无人机来提交书面申请，请本人亲自到场！！！

text.en:
Operator Spuria previously worked as a communications engineer at the Laterano Municipal Office. She currently works for the Sixth Tribunal, which is responsible for civic matters, education, and health. Although she is known to be eccentric even by the standards of our other Lateran operators, she is quite willing to use her tech skills to help people solve small issues in exchange for repayment, such as rescuing trapped pets, manipulating traffic signals and school bells, or other 'interesting' problems.
While she was a student, she was repeatedly disciplined for hacking the school bells. In one case, a sociology teacher showed signs of dehydration after lecturing for five hours straight, without a bell to signal the end of the period. Investigations revealed that Spuria had disabled the school's timekeeping system. When questioned, she answered, 'I just wanted him to take up the classroom a little while longer so I wouldn't have to go to tech ethics class. How was I supposed to know he could talk that long?'
Despite numerous incidents, Spuria was never expelled. While she rarely attended class, she helped the school develop a highly efficient system for teaching and administration, greatly reducing administrative workload. This is also why she was able to remove any disciplinary action from her record. The headmaster even waived her attendance requirements after she secured him the best seats at a popular singer's concert. While the school may have turned a blind eye to her eccentricities, she did receive 'discipline' from other sources, such as Lemuen, the head prefect of the student council. While no record remains of their interactions as students, the two of them are known to be close, even now.
Interestingly, Spuria was recommended to the Curia not long after Lemuen recovered from her injuries and joined the Seventh Tribunal, responsible for intelligence, foreign affairs, and national defense. Spuria was first offered a post at the Seventh Tribunal as well, but surprisingly she declined, preferring to work at the civic-focused Sixth Tribunal.
'Technology exists to be used. It's only fitting that my drone goes to class in my place!'
'You want to skip class, and I want you to attend.
'So how about this: Either you get up in the next 10 minutes, or I give your teacher and classmates a call, and let you explain to them the little drone you invented.'
text.zh:
干员空构经由拉特兰城区办事处的推荐，凭借其对通讯和定位技术的专业性协助民政事务，目前就职于司民政、教育、医疗的第六厅。虽然她看上去总是不太着调（与其他拉特兰干员相比更有过之而无不及），但是如果有人诚恳请求她，只要愿意提供一点小小的“报答”，她也乐意利用自己擅长的技术为人解决一点点小麻烦，比如帮忙解救受困屋顶的宠物，甚至应急操纵交通信号灯，延迟或提前学校铃声这样“有趣的事”。
还在学校时，干员空构就曾多次因为擅自改变响铃时间，领受校方的通报批评。曾有一门社会学课程的老师连讲了五个小时，口干舌燥甚至出现了中暑脱水的症状，也没等来下课铃声，事后经调查，果然是空构瘫痪了学校的时间显示系统。“我只是想让他多占用一会儿那个教室，这样我就不用去上那个什么所谓的技术伦理课了，谁知道那个秃顶的社会学老师真能讲那么久啊？！”空构如此解释道。
好几个学期空构受到的处分数量都居高不下，校方却对她的随性完全没有办法。这是因为空构虽然不怎么上课，但是她也确实通过她所专精的通信技术帮助学校建立了高效的教务教学系统（正因如此，她能够轻而易举地消除对自己的处分），为学校减少了很多繁杂冗余的事务性工作。在空构帮助校长抢到了偶像在拉特兰竞演的黄金座位票之后，她便获得了“旷课豁免权”——当然，即使校方对她的行为睁一只眼闭一只眼，也还会有人“修理”她，比如时任学生会纪律委员的蕾缪安。虽然二人学生时期的往来无法通过档案考据，但直到现在，空构对蕾缪安的亲近都是众所周知的事情。
有趣的是，空构被推荐进入教皇厅的时间，在蕾缪安从重伤中恢复并受邀加入司掌情报、外交、国防的第七厅后不久，而她最初得到的机会也来自第七厅。出乎意料的是，她拒绝了这份入职邀请，而选择了更偏向改善民生服务的第六厅就职。
“技术应该为人所用，所以由小无人机代我去上课就好啦~”
“欸？这就是小莉雅为自己偷懒想出的借口吗？可是你不去上课的话，也让我很难办啊。
“这样吧，如果十分钟内你再不从床上起来，我就把老师和同学们一起叫过来，到时候就麻烦你耐心给他们讲一讲你的无人机小发明啦。”

text.en:
Inquiries with Operators Spuria, Insider, and Executor have helped us piece together a picture of what happened at the Sanctilaminium Ambrosii. After expressing our condolences for what the inhabitants had been through, we determined that the tragedy could not have been averted by the efforts of a few, and that Spuria and the others present would benefit from moving on. While we do not believe that she is responsible for Fortuna's fall, it was apparent that she continues to feel guilt over it.
We were concerned that, after witnessing the fall of a Sankta from up close, Spuria would associate what happened with the 'unusual choice' she made. However, from what we've observed, she is not trying to shoulder responsibility for the entire incident herself. Indeed, her feelings of guilt have actually had a positive influence on her.
Since her student days, Operator Spuria has devoted her full attention to the study of precision technology, but only out of curiosity and laziness. Lemuen helped her realize that the technology she knew had little practical application, which led her to join the civic-focused Sixth Tribunal. Then, the fall of Fortuna made her rethink her responsibility towards guns as a Sankta, and she realized that her expertise in firearms technology could help more Sankta fulfill their own responsibilities and prevent future tragedies. This was the practical value of technology she had sought.
Operator Spuria takes regular shore leaves, revealing little about the purpose of these trips other than that she is helping out the Sixth Tribunal. We have strong reason to believe, however, that she is visiting Fortuna and carrying out her 'duty of oversight.'
text.zh:
经过对干员空构、隐现与送葬人的问询，我们基本了解了发生在安布罗修修道院的一切。在表达了对修道院居民们不幸遭遇的遗憾与惋惜之后，我们意识到空构等人作为事件的共同亲历者，如何面对这场以个人或小队的能力无法避免的悲剧，如何从中走出来，是一项重要的课题。在详细评估过后，我们认为干员空构并不应该对福尔图娜小姐的“堕天”一事负有责任，但是空构本人似乎对此仍心存愧疚。
我们担心，空构在近距离见证了一个萨科塔的“堕天”之后，会认为之所以事件会以这样的轨迹发展，正是因为她这一次的“不寻常选择”。不过好在通过密切观察，我们并未发现空构有将责任全然揽在自己身上的倾向。而由于这起事件存在的“愧疚心理”，反倒对空构产生了一定程度的积极影响。
从学生时代起，干员空构便将全部的热情投入钻研精密技术之中，不过这些所谓的精密技术，也只是满足了她个人对于简便生活、趣味生活的需要。在蕾缪安的帮助下，空构逐渐意识到，目前她所掌握的这些精密技术，无非是一些空中楼阁。“这些技术，有什么实用价值呢？”抱持着这样的疑问，空构加入了服务于民生的第六厅。在福尔图娜小姐“堕天”一事发生后，干员空构开始思考，作为萨科塔，对于铳应该承担怎样的责任。与此同时，她意识到自己所擅长的铳械辅助技术，或许可以帮助到更多萨科塔，确保他们更好地履行这份责任，避免更多悲剧发生——而这正是她所追求的“技术的实用价值”。
现如今，干员空构定期会以协助处理第六厅政务为由申请离舰，虽然她对自己的工作内容闪烁其词，但我们也通过多方渠道了解到，她是去探望福尔图娜小姐，履行她的“监视义务”。

text.en:
Former Higashi shinobi. Referred to Rhodes Island for work through household connections and coordination with the head, following the previous head's passing and a clash between her own views and the new head's business goals.
Presently stationed in Victoria as Rhodes Island intelligence personnel.
text.zh:

目前为罗德岛驻维多利亚情报人员。

text.en:
After more than half a year working for the new head's business firm, Kazemaru couldn't stand it anymore.
Maybe some people are just born for danger and the shadows. Though the steady side of their heart may try to take root when they spend long enough in a safe environment, the remaining facets will only cry out even louder, driving them to the brink of madness.
Kazemaru is exactly that sort of person. A placid life will only dull her claws, murder the gleam in her eyes, and choke the ingenuity out of the origami in her hands.
Wearing the same exact uniform each day, handing her card to business partners, sitting in meetings for hours on end, the only excitement Kazemaru ever got was the occasional chance to nose out intel on rival companies. Though she'd entertained the idea that coping with hopeless days like these wouldn't kill her per se, there came a day when the wind blew over a flowerpot on her way home from work, and she completely failed to detect or dodge it in time. Standing in the middle of the street, her head covered in soil and clay chips, she felt she could bear this no longer. After a whole night discussing her objections with the household, she proposed her own idea to the head, and the young lord gladly gave his consent. He relieved her of her contracts, and handed her over to Rhodes Island.
Free from the firm, Kazemaru has returned to her scene once again: a battlefield brimming with danger.
text.zh:
在新任家主开办的商业公司中做了半年多员工后，风丸受不了了。
也许有些人生来就适合接近危险和阴影，若他们长时间待在安稳的环境中，即便内心平稳的一面试图在环境中扎根，但剩下的部分只会大声喊叫着自己快要被逼疯。
风丸就是这样的人。波澜不惊的生活只会让她的利爪变钝，让眼神变死，让手中的折纸失去灵气。
每天重复地穿着一成不变的制服，向合作方递出名片，在会议室里几个小时几个小时地坐着，风丸唯一兴奋的就是偶尔能去打探竞争公司的消息。虽然也想过这样没有盼头的日子忍一忍似乎也不是不能过下去，但有天当她走在下班路上，风吹下了一个花盆，而风丸完全没有察觉到也没能躲开时，顶着一头泥土和花盆碎片站在路中间的风丸觉得自己再也无法忍受了。和家中人彻夜长谈过自己的意见后，风丸向家主讲出了自己的想法，而后这位年轻的主君欣然应允，他解除了合同，并为风丸牵上了来罗德岛的线。
离开了公司，风丸再次回到了这片属于她的，充满了危险的疆场。

text.en:
Kazemaru once revealed to Rhodes Island a few shinobi training methods.
In Higashi, clans of all sizes tend to keep a suite of shinobi on their dime. Some people's whole families will be shinobi of Higashi's great households, their fealty sworn for generations. She herself undertook training from the age of five, and the merciless and peculiar-sounding exercises helped her to fulfill mission after mission with flying colors. Moreover, her Originium Arts grant her the ability to control an origami substitute indistinguishable from the real person. Whether to confuse the enemy, aid in combat, or make time to catch one's breath when retreating, Kazemaru can control her doppelganger to her complete satisfaction.
As for what her future holds, Kazemaru hasn't thought that far ahead.
After all, she originally reckoned she'd be sworn to the head all her life, and that once she could no longer serve as her lord's blade, she might train newcomers, or go far away and leave it all behind. Maybe even work out a thing or two in the fashion field. But never among these was the option of leaving Higashi to be situated in a Victorian government office, taking down meeting notes.
The young lord's abrupt reforms made her realize that so much of the future was beyond her planning. All she needs to do is make every step in the present count.
text.zh:
风丸曾向罗德岛透露过一些忍者的训练方式。
东国的大小家族通常会豢养一批自己的忍者，有些人有可能一整个家族都是东国大家族的忍者，世代为其效忠。她本人则从五岁起就开始接受训练，那些听起来残酷又奇特的方式帮助她出色地完成了一件又一件的任务。而她的源石技艺能让她操控一个由纸折出的与本人相差无二的替身。不论是迷惑敌人、辅助作战，还是在撤退时争取更多的喘息时间，替身在风丸的操控下都能达到令人满意的效果。
未来是什么样的，风丸如今还没有想那么远。
毕竟原先自己以为这一辈子都会效忠于家主，等到了自己再也不能成为家主的刀的那一天，她也许会去训练新人，也许会什么都不管远远地离开这一切，甚至有可能会往时尚方面发展发展，但这些选项里从来都没有离开东国，坐在维多利亚政府的办公室里记录会议文件这一条。
小家主的突然改革让她意识到，未来很多事情都很有可能不在自己的规划范围之内，她要做的就是走好眼前的每一步。

text.en:
There aren't many days Kazemaru returns to the landship. When she's back, the first thing she does is enter the conference room, where any passing operator will see the lights remain on from early to late.
But whenever they think something HAS to have happened to the people in there, that they should take a look just to be safe, they end up putting their ear to the door and hearing a muffled, unbroken discussion coming from within, and these duly worried operators are forced to let go of their resolve to knock. Of course, not a word of the discussion can be clearly made out.
Conversely, Rhodes Island's children eagerly anticipate such days, for the nice Feline who can make paper things run and fly is about to bring them origami toys more novel than ever.
The truth is that Kazemaru isn't playing along with these children of her own initiative; her identity and training up till now wouldn't permit her to do so. But by chance, after the children found out her origami could move, they hounded her, pleading her to teach them how.
Though she was initially flustered by this, she was quick to brandish her mastery, rapidly taking on the role of a close, big-sister-type friend to the children, a dedicated origami expert, sweets-lover, and enthusiast of play. However, while Kazemaru may have been subconsciously disguising her identity at first, you can imagine from the hints her face lets slip now and then that she really is enjoying herself.
The children are delighted on the occasions they meet her, but at the same time worry whether this Feline seemingly not much bigger than them—so short, with fingers so soft—might have gotten hurt outside.
On more than one occasion, HR operators have seen this and sighed to themselves: 'they all think Kazemaru can't be more than a few years older than them. Oh, you sweet summer children...'
text.zh:
风丸回本舰的日子不多，每次回来的第一件事就是走进会议室，而后路过的干员就能看到会议室的灯光从早开到晚。
但每到他们觉得再不进去看看，里面的人绝对要出什么大事的时候，只要把耳朵凑近门板，就能听到里面低沉的交谈声持续不断，这些充满担忧的干员只好放下自己准备敲门的手。当然，其中的交流内容他们一个字也听不清楚。
但是罗德岛的孩子们就会很期待这一天，因为那个会让折纸跑动或者飞起来的菲林姐姐会给他们带来更新奇的折纸小玩意。
风丸其实并没有主动接触这些孩子的想法，她的身份以及一直以来受到的训练并不允许她做出这样的举动。但孩子们在偶然间发现她的折纸会动以后就缠上了她，央求风丸教他们方法。
虽然风丸一开始对此有些慌张，但她很快就拿出了自己的专业素养，迅速接受并成为了一个孩子们专属的擅长折纸、喜欢糖果、爱和他们玩的贴心姐姐。不过，虽然风丸一开始是下意识地伪装了身份，但是看到她脸上偶尔流露出的一丝表情，这些时候她应该也确实是开心的吧。
孩子们在很开心能偶尔见到风丸的同时，也很担心这个看起来不会比他们大上几岁的小菲林姐姐，这么小小的身子，这么温柔的手指，她在外面有没有受伤。
人事部干员在见到这个场景时不止一次地私下感叹：“他们一直以为风丸没有比自己大上几岁，可爱又天真的孩子们呀……”

text.en:
Kazemaru has been 'employed' by Caladon's government for a while now.
Under a new identity, she's assimilated perfectly with the city council, and has even smoothly set Rhodes Island up with passage permits and business certification for several duchies. She also makes use of her post to obtain each count's list of industrial property addresses with little effort, as well as detailed blueprints for all manner of buildings and thoroughfares, helping enormously advance every mission Rhodes Island has.
At the same time, as a Caladon City Council recorder, she has direct, firsthand access to the councilors' viewpoints. The council nobles think nothing of the employee forever taking down notes in the corner, and as they wage their war of interests, her pen rarely ever pauses. But they don't know just what lies in her writing.
Kazemaru's seen her fair share in Victoria; while it's not quite the same as in Higashi, they have their similarities. She didn't originally have too much of an opinion on it—after all, as a shinobi, the first thing she was trained to do was loyally carry out her lord's orders. However, through completing missions for Rhodes Island, she's gotten to know several Infected friends and noble daughters constantly busy helping the Infected. She's gradually started to shift from her former, rigid, shinobi way of thinking. She's begun to change her goals, no longer desiring solely to fulfill assignments, but to regard the land with a new outlook, make sense of Rhodes Island's ideals, and help deal with the problems the Infected come across, along with the other Rhodes Islanders.
Nowadays (though the Doctor has not requested fealty from her as per her shinobi status), Kazemaru considers what she does here to be much more far-reaching than her time as a shinobi, and she's glad she could take this path. She no longer considers herself just an agent of a family, but an agent of impetus, hoping she can do something with Rhodes Island to change the land, and she has long been willing to offer her loyalty to this work.
'People are scared of the Infected, but they don't know that the corrupt who duck behind the issue, out to achieve nothing but their own goals, are the ones they should fear most.'
These are the words she spoke to the operator receiving her, following full handover of her tasks, when she returned aboard one time to report her work.
She's all but clear about what it is she needs to do now.
text.zh:
风丸在卡拉顿政府“任职”有一段时间了。
她用新身份很好地融入了政府，甚至顺利地为罗德岛在几个公爵领地办下了通行许可和业务证明，她也利用职务顺利地接触到各位伯爵的产业地址清单，以及各类建筑和通道的详细图纸，为罗德岛的各项任务推进提供了极大的帮助。
同时，作为卡拉顿城议会的记录员，风丸能直接接触第一手的议员意见。议会中的贵族们并没有重视这个永远坐在角落低头记录的工作人员，在他们为利益争斗之时，风丸的笔很少停下。但他们并不知道风丸正在写的究竟是什么内容。
风丸在维多利亚见证了不少事情，它们与东国的情况不尽相同，却又有相似之处。原本风丸对这些事情并没有太多的看法，毕竟作为忍者，她一开始接受的训练就只是忠诚地执行家主的命令。但在完成罗德岛的任务的过程中，她认识了许多感染者朋友和为了感染者而奔波的贵族大小姐。风丸渐渐开始从以前的忍者思维定式中跳出来，开始改变目标，不再只是想单纯地完成任务，而换用一种新的眼光看待这片大地，去理解罗德岛的理想，然后和罗德岛的其他人一起去帮助解决感染者们遇到的问题。
如今，虽然罗德岛的博士并没有要她以忍者的身份对自己效忠，但风丸已经认为她在这里要做的事远比之前她身为忍者时做的事情要更为远大，她很庆幸自己走上了这条道路。她已经不再认为自己只是一个忍者，而是一个推动者，希望能和罗德岛一起做点什么来改变这片大地，她早已愿意为现在的这份工作献上她的忠诚。
“人们都害怕感染者，但不知道最应该被畏惧的是那些躲在感染者问题后面不择手段，只为达到自己目的的人。”
在一次回岛述职时，风丸交接完所有的工作后，向对接的干员说出了这句话。
她很清楚如今自己要做的究竟是什么。

text.en:
'You had all these shiny straps one time when you came back, swinging about on this little handbag, and this huge smile. That was the moment I went, like, oh, damn, you're pretty cute!'

'The figures in your room are all really gorgeous, Miss~'

'I've had it really under control lately! I'm not going to spark everywhere anymore. Don't get mad at me again, okay? I'll give you a new hairdo, how about that?'

'Second issue of L'Officiel Victoria came in. You weren't around at the stand that day, so I saved you a copy. No rush!'

'Um, you were wearing really pretty clothes the last time I saw you... I-I want to be pretty too! Can you teach me next time you come back? Please? Thank you!'

'Do you think some blue highlights would look nice on me? Hmm, what if I try some bigger curls?'

'Can your paper person thing hold water? How long can it last away from you? Do I get to learn how you control it? Can I have my own paper me? Can I trade this sword my family passed down for one?'
This last letter has been singled out and stuck onto the letterbox, written over in heavy letters: 'NO!'

—The personal letterbox at Kazemaru's door
text.zh:
“你有一次回来的时候手里拿着一堆亮闪闪的小挂件，在一个小包上比来比去，笑得可开心了。我那个时候就觉得，哦，你好可爱哦！”

“姐姐屋子里那些玩偶真的很漂亮~”

“我最近已经控制得很好了，已经不会再乱放电了，不要再生我气了嘛，我给你剪个新发型好不好？”

“《维多利亚时装公报》第二期到了，开摊那天你不在，我给你留了一本，不急！”

“那个，上次见到你穿的衣服好漂亮……我、我也想要变漂亮……！你回来的那天可以教教我吗？拜托了！谢谢！”

“你说我挑染个蓝色会不会很漂亮？嗯，再烫个大一点的卷？”

“你的纸人会倒水吗？它能脱离你待多久？你操控它的那个方法我能学吗？我可以有一个自己的纸人吗？我拿我祖上传来的宝剑和你换好吗？”
这张纸条被专门拿出来贴在信箱上，上面重重写着：“不能！”

——风丸房间门口的小信箱

value.en: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected by medical examination.
value.zh: 体表有源石结晶分布，参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected by medical examination.
infectionStatus.zh: 体表有源石结晶分布，参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

text.en: Puzzle, a Victorian military intelligence officer, came to Rhodes Island with a letter from the Duke of Caster, seeking treatment as an Infected. He has reached a cooperation agreement with Rhodes Island, and is active in various operations and preliminary intelligence gathering while receiving treatment.
text.zh: 谜图，维多利亚军方情报人员，持开斯特公爵的署名信函，以寻求治疗的感染者身份前来罗德岛。现与罗德岛达成合作协议，在接受治疗的同时活跃于各项行动和前期情报搜集工作中。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 11%
Larger distributions of Originium crystals visible on the left arm and side of the body.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.26u/L
Operator Puzzle was acutely infected during an explosion; fortunately, it had not been long before he arrived at Rhodes Island and it was quickly brought under control.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】11%
左手臂及体侧可见较多源石结晶分布。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.26u/L
干员谜图在一场爆炸中遭到急性感染，还好感染时间不长，来到罗德岛之后病情很快得到了控制。

text.en:
Operator Puzzle has already passed his onboarding examination with flying colors, but we will not allow him to participate in combat missions for the time being.
This is not a matter of trust—he has shown us his good intentions, and has no motive to sabotage Rhodes Island.
Naturally, neither is it due to any lack of ability on his part. Though due to Oripathy his physical condition is slightly below average for a Vouivre, it is not enough to compromise his combat abilities. Furthermore, his smog-type Originium Arts complement his stealth-based fighting style well.
However, he requires finer control of his Arts or perhaps even a drastic change to his fighting style, as we have observed him overexerting himself with his Arts on the battlefield. First of all, such a tendency makes it much harder to control the disease's progression while he is still undergoing Oripathy suppression treatment. Second, we cannot rule out the possibility that as his Infection deepens, his Arts might go out of control as well.
For people who were already proficient in Arts prior to being infected, asking them to change their fighting style or even their lifestyle is a tall order indeed, especially for someone as stubborn as Puzzle. He formulates detailed plans based on his own logical reasoning and prepares contingencies for worst-case scenarios, all of which take into account everything at his disposal. Naturally, his Arts are a key part of this. We've tried communicating that we want him to leave himself more room for error in these back-up plans. The human body does not operate like precision clockwork, and it is impossible to quantify the factors that affect the progression of Oripathy. These are simply facts.
But we have to suspend him from field missions. He knows why, of course, just can't accept it.
text.zh:
干员谜图已经通过了入职测试，表现良好，但我们暂时不会让他参与作战任务。
这并不是因为信任问题。他已经向我们表现了诚意，也没有什么从内部破坏罗德岛的动机。
当然也不是因为他的能力还有所欠缺。受矿石病影响，他现在的身体状况和瓦伊凡的平均水平相比是稍微差了一点，但并不影响他发挥自己的战斗技巧。同时，他具有的烟雾类源石技艺也为他以隐蔽行动为主的战斗提供了不少便利。
只是，他必须控制自己对源石技艺的使用，甚至也许要大幅度改变自己的战斗方式。我们观察到他近乎透支自我地在战斗中施展源石技艺，一方面，他仍然处在矿石病抑制疗程中，这种习惯极不利于控制他的病情；另一方面，我们也不能保证感染程度加深是否会导致他的源石技艺失控。
对于感染前就已经擅长源石技艺的人来说，要改变自己的战斗方式乃至生活方式，并没有那么容易，更不要说是性格极其固执的谜图。他会按照自己的逻辑详细制定计划，针对最坏情况做应急预案，在此过程中调动他拥有的一切力量；而自身的源石技艺是他可用手段中极为重要的一部分。我们试图与他沟通，希望他像在行动中准备备用方案那样，为自己留出更多的容错空间来。人体不是像钟表零件那样精确运转的，影响矿石病发展的因素也不可能量化计算，这些都是最简单直白的道理。
但最终我们不得不直接暂停他的外勤任务。他当然知道这些道理，只是无法接受。

text.en:
The source of Puzzle's infection was an otherwise ordinary investigation. He had noticed a bomber's abnormal behavior beforehand and had time to escape to a safe area; but realized that if the target of his investigation was killed in an explosion, then all of his work would come to naught. Moreover, he was undercover as a city hall clerk and rushing forward to persuade them to leave would only alert his target.
Therefore, in less than half a minute, he made the spur-of-the-moment decision to not avoid the explosion, seeming to subconsciously want to protect his target. Afterwards, both were injured and sent to the hospital, and Puzzle was able to make contact with his target while their guard was completely down.
When this topic came up in casual conversation, Puzzle offered a simple explanation for his actions: he was ordered to investigate potential military activity from the local nobles, which led him to track down a factory in the city based on a batch of chemical raw material orders. When we sincerely responded with 'that must've been a very important job,' Puzzle shook his head and replied that the information he obtained was of no particular value.
'I can see where he's coming from. For Rhodes Island, our greatest enemy is Oripathy, so of course we would never talk about 'what circumstances would make it worth it to get Infected.' Likewise, he will not allow others to judge whether the sacrifices he made for his mission were worthwhile or not. That is the respect owed to one's convictions.'
––A Medical Department staff member who talked with Puzzle during the course of treatment
text.zh:
导致谜图感染矿石病的是一次普通的调查行动。当时，他提前察觉到了实施爆破者的异常行径，原本有足够的时间逃至安全区域，但同时他也意识到，如果自己试图接近的关键人物在这场爆炸中遇害身亡，那么他持续至今的调查将在这里全部断掉，而且，他是以市政厅办事员的身份前来调查，如果贸然直接接触对方，将其劝离，难免会打草惊蛇。
因此，在半分钟时间里，他迅速做出决定，没有躲避爆炸，但看似下意识地保护了那位关键人物。随后，二人受伤送医，谜图得以在对方完全放下防备的情况下与之接触。
由于是在闲谈中提及此事，谜图只是简单解释了自己当时的行动目的。他受命探查当地贵族可能的军事筹备，继而根据一批化工原料订单追踪到了城内的某家工厂。当我们出于好意表示“那一定是很重要的任务”的时候，谜图却摇了摇头，表示自己在那里得到的信息并不具有多少价值。
“我能理解他。对于罗德岛来说，矿石病就是我们最大的敌人，所以，我不会讨论‘什么情况下感染矿石病也是值得的’。同样地，他不会接受别人来衡量，他为自己的任务而做出的牺牲是否值得。这是对信念的尊重。”
——在治疗过程中与谜图展开谈话的医疗部干员

text.en:
Puzzle got his opportunity to come to Rhodes Island through an anonymous letter.
He was carrying out an investigation on Operator Reed and ran into Bagpipe and Ch'en, who were traveling with her at the time, resulting in a conflict between the two sides. He collected extra intel regarding the three of them as part of his due diligence, but the more he pieced together their backgrounds, the less he understood why people with such different motivations, affiliations, and positions would come together like friends in the first place.
While searching for clues, Puzzle's infection also forced him to make a choice: either end his career, living the good life on a short leash while waiting for Oripathy to do him in, or take the next step as an intelligence officer. He did not clearly explain what he meant by 'taking the next step,' but considering that he arrived at Rhodes Island with a signed letter from the Duke of Caster himself, one can infer that he worked his way up to a position under the direct command of the Duke.
That was when he received a letter containing only Rhodes Island's business card, but that was enough to resolve all his quandaries—as well as open up new possibilities.
'Of course I knew who the sender was, as well as why she sent it. Communicate goodwill, seek cooperation, weave a network of relationships—these are the hallmarks of an intelligence officer's instincts. But rest assured, my prior work has come to an end, and I will no longer be investigating your operator, Reed. Furthermore, I have no interest in the woman codenamed 'Harmonie.''
After that, Puzzle talked about his views on intelligence work.
text.zh:
谜图来到罗德岛的契机是一封匿名信。
当时的谜图正在执行一项针对干员苇草的调查，并偶遇了与苇草同行的风笛和陈，双方发生了一些冲突。职业性的警惕令他搜集了大量与三人相关的情报，但三人各自的背景信息越完整，谜图就越不明白，为何这三个目的、身份与立场都截然不同的人会如朋友一般共处。
在寻找关键线索的同时，由于已经感染矿石病，谜图也面临着选择：结束自己的情报人员生涯，过上受监视的优渥生活，等待着矿石病夺去自己的生命；或是在情报人员的身份上再进一步。谜图并未明确解释他所说的“再进一步”是指什么，但考虑到他来到罗德岛时持有的是开斯特公爵本人的署名信，可以推测，他或许曾有机会成为直接为公爵效力的一类人员。
接着，他收到了一封信，信封里只装了一张罗德岛的名片，却恰巧同时回答了他所有的困惑，也给了他一种新的可能。
“我当然知道寄信人是谁，也知道她为什么要这么做。释放善意信号，寻求合作，编织关系网，这是一部分情报人员本能的行为方式。但请放心，过去的任务都已经告一段落了，现在的我不会继续调查你们的干员苇草，对于那位代号‘和弦’的女士也没有兴趣。”
谜图随后谈论起自己对情报工作的看法。

text.en:
During the Londinium incident, Puzzle strictly abided by his cooperation agreement with Rhodes Island and did not intervene in any form. However, when we chatted with him about his views on the incident, he did not hesitate to chime in with his professional opinion as an intelligence officer.
Before getting involved in intelligence work, he was just an ordinary college student with little talent in Arts, shunned by his classmates due to his harsh and exacting personality. Obviously, it never crossed his mind at the time that one day he would have the chance to deal with aristocrats, cooperate with the military, and work inside the intelligence department. But when his future boss, the leader of an intelligence organization, approached him and asked if he would consider entering training, he agreed almost immediately.
Intelligence work, a field requiring extreme caution and precise attention to detail, is indeed well-suited for his talents, but more importantly, he saw eye-to-eye with the leader's philosophy—that in order to maintain a peaceful and orderly society, those who provoke conflict must be regarded as enemies.
For him, the idea that 'everything has its own order' is not a goal, but a paranoid way of thinking. Naturally, this mindset is directly contradicted by our conflict-stricken reality, and this is especially true in Victoria, where dukes are constantly at each others' throats and turmoil is always at one's doorstep. As a result, he is always displeased with all the unprovoked violent conflicts, as well as the chaos caused by continually shifting 'orders,' and even more afraid of the possibility of war breaking out.
'War has no rhyme or reason. Nobody should tolerate such a senseless waste of life. Over the past few years, I've come to think the ultimate goal of our work is to prevent human lives from falling into that miserable situation.'
'But in terms of results, I'm disappointed. The war came regardless, and we gave it our tacit approval. Time and time again, we were so careful to avoid implicating the lives of hundreds or thousands with our small mistakes, but by the time war began to rear its ugly head, I realized it was already too late to stop it.'
'...Your poking and prodding is a waste of time. My allegiances won't change. It's just that no matter what I think of it, I can't compromise on that one fact. Which is why I'm here.'
text.zh:
在伦蒂尼姆事件期间，谜图严格遵守着与罗德岛达成的合作协议，没有以任何形式参与其中。不过，我们与他聊起对此事件的看法时，他突兀地提起了自己成为情报人员的经历。
在接触情报工作前，谜图只是一名普通的在校大学生，在源石技艺方面小有天赋，并因为自己苛刻、追求完美的性格而被大部分同学敬而远之，至于接触贵族阶层，与军方合作，为情报部门效力，这些可能性显然是当时的他完全没有想过的。但在他后来的上司、某情报组织的牵头人找到他，问他是否考虑接受培养时，他几乎是毫不犹豫地答应了下来。
需要小心谨慎、在细节上也绝不犯错的情报工作，的确很适合他发挥自己的才能，不过更重要的是，他认同了对方的理念：为了维持社会生活和平有序，将意图挑起战争的对象视作敌人。
于他而言，“事物各有其秩序”并不是追求，而是他偏执的认知。这种认知当然与充满偶然的现实生活处处矛盾，尤其是在各大公爵争执不休、动乱将至的维多利亚，他时时为无端的暴力冲突和朝令夕改导致的混乱感到不快，更对可能爆发的战争感到恐惧。
“战争里没有道理可言。人们不应该忍受那样毫无道理的生活。过去几年里，我认为我们工作的最大目标，就是避免人们的生活落入那样悲惨的境地。
“但从结果来说，我失望了。战争最终发生了，而且，是在我们的默许下发生的。绝大多数时间里，我们小心翼翼，以免自己行动上的小小失误牵连成百上千人的生命，但战争真正显露出它将要到来的征兆时，我意识到自己所能做的一切都无法撼动它。
“……您这样的试探只是浪费时间，我的忠诚不会改变。只是，无论我如何思考，我也不可能向这一事实妥协。所以现在我在这里。”

text.en:
Uhh, we were the ones who did it. We dragged him to be the referee of the timed jigsaw puzzle competition. We figured it'd be fine since he enjoys them, making purchase requests to Logistics every two weeks, and spending all day glued to his desk whenever he has time off.
––Of course I know who he is. You can tell at a glance he's not used to his role as a 'Rhodes Island Collaborating Operator.' In the past, he might've worked as a clerk at city hall, an antique appraiser, or a nobleman's personal secretary. In any of those positions, he'd always have a way to win over people's trust. But at Rhodes Island, an affable manner and a silver tongue won't get you very far.
Alright, so maybe inviting him wasn't a great idea. He hates being rushed, hates watching other people mess things up, and maybe he was telling the truth when he said he only uses puzzles to stay focused. But you know what? For the first time, I felt less nervous around him when he was crouching helplessly under the table with us, picking up the pieces a short-tempered operator had swept to the floor.
text.zh:
呃，是我们几个干的，我们拉他去当拼图限时赛的裁判了。反正他喜欢玩拼图嘛，每两周雷打不动地向后勤部提交采购申请单，一到休息日就在桌前坐一整天。
——我当然知道他是谁，也看得出来，他还不太适应“罗德岛合作干员”这个身份。以前他可能当过市政厅办事员，当过古董鉴定商，当过贵族的贴身秘书，在那些位置上，他都有一套取信于人的手段；但在罗德岛，那些礼仪也好话术也好，恐怕都不太用得上。
好吧，邀请他其实不是个好主意，他不喜欢限时，也不喜欢看人把事情弄得一团糟，可能他说自己只是把玩拼图当成一种集中注意力的手段，也是实话。但至少，他无奈地跟我们一起蹲在桌子底下，捡某位失去耐心的干员扫到地上的拼图碎片时，我头一次觉得他没那么神经紧绷了。
