text.en:
Nine-Colored Deer, claims to come from a mountain forest in Yan, specific location as yet unascertained.
Possesses ample knowledge related to gathering and processing of herbals, and holds a degree of combat ability. Through introduction from other operators, came to Rhodes Island on exchange study, traveling with Rhodes Island for the near future.
text.zh:
九色鹿，自称来自大炎的某一片山林，具体位置并未告知。 
自身具有丰富的药草采集和制作的相关知识，并具备一定作战能力。经其他干员介绍，来到罗德岛交流学习，近期将与罗德岛同行。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Nine-Colored Deer shows no signs of Infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.13u/L
Operator Nine-Colored Deer fulfils fundamental protective measures in aiding Oripathy sufferers, and we have detected no risk of Oripathy infection.

Nine-Colored Deer is in very good health. We hear she's very familiar with the herbals of Yan; we can consider having her teach other operators the way to distinguish them. And while we're at it, we can have her talk with Myrrh a little more, too. Maybe we'll have some way to rid the herbs of that bitterness...
—Medic Operator Breeze
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员九色鹿没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.13u/L
干员九色鹿在救助矿石病患者时做了基础防护，并未检测出有感染矿石病风险。

九色鹿小姐身体很健康，听说她很熟悉大炎的草药，可以考虑让她教其他干员怎样区分。顺便，可以让她和末药也多交流下，也许有办法消除草药的苦味……
——医疗干员微风

text.en:
Though she's never had standard training, Nine-Colored Deer bears a fairly distinct awareness of the battlefield. We have no way to know of her former experiences, but based on her emergency treatment of wounds and skill in transporting casualties, she must have been through many desperate situations. Each person takes away different things from a disaster, some choosing to flee, some choosing to actively confront it. Nine-Colored Deer is the latter, and has continuously conferred with and studied from the Medical Department's operators since arriving at Rhodes Island, her mind for constant learning catching on with others, other departments' operators beginning to learn first-aid knowledge with her.
'Nothing wrong with learning a little more first aid! If we ever end up in danger, I can even help out!'
—An operator from HR
text.zh:
虽然没有接受过正规的训练，但九色鹿对战场却有一个较为清晰的认知。她之前经历过什么我们没法知道，但从她对伤口的应急处理方式以及伤员的搬运技巧上来看，她一定经历过很多惨烈的场面。每个人从灾难中得到的东西都不同，有的人会选择逃避，有的人会选择积极面对。九色鹿是后者，她来到罗德岛后便一直积极地与医疗部的干员交流学习，她不断学习的精神感染了其他人，其他部门的干员跟着一起开始学习急救知识。
“多学点急救知识没坏处的，真的遇到危机情况，我还可以搭把手呢！”
——人事部门某干员

text.en:
'Um, right, I randomly met Nine-Colored Deer while out in Yan collecting herbal samples. It gave me a shock when she suddenly appeared next to me. No... I heard her footsteps, but... when some fowlbeasts perched on her shoulders, that really startled me. Who brings fowlbeasts with them hiking? ...Oh, yeah, she said she'd moved up to the mountains long ago. I was really curious how she managed to live in the mountains for such a long time. Don't you get restless being all alone up there...?'
'Her room was filled with unfinished herbal pills. Uh-huh, she said she usually went into the mountains to collect fresh herbs, and she'd worked out a special way to make herbal pills. She blended Yanese tea leaves and local ground herbs and made a pill from it, and it had a faint tea flavor when you ate it, and it wasn't too strongly bitter. No, don't worry, it was just a pill to help with health. Hey, don't look at me like that! I don't just eat anything I see, I swear!'
'There was a clinic in the village at the mountain's base, where she'd take the pills she'd made to the patients. The clinic seemed to have worked with her for a long time, and she'd provide them with herbal medicine free of charge... really, it really was free! Why would I be lying to you? When she first gave them medicine, the doctor had doubts about the quality. When does something just land in your lap for free, after all? So at first, they went without using any of it. It took until a doctor came across Nine-Colored Deer treating a villager who tripped and crashed onto a rock, and they saw her medical skills, before they realized they were that close to letting someone so able slip away. Yeah, the doctor there told me! Afterwards, they even went to compliment her for her medicinal knowledge and knack for treatment. And, you know, there's never enough medical resources in remote areas like that, and the fact the patients there could get her treatment really did feel heaven-sent. Oh, yeah, she barely ever gave treatment directly at the clinic, she just gave them herbal pills. She'd only lend a hand when the clinic needed the help. Makes you wonder too, right? I thought she was a little frightened of human contact, but it seemed like she'd gone through something before, and I didn't want to dredge it up.'
'After that, I thought it wouldn't do much harm if I stayed a few more days, so I chatted for a while longer with her. She wanted to improve her own medical skills, and go save more people. So I gave her an invitation, hoped she'd come to Rhodes Island for a kind of skill exchange. Whoa, the clinic doctor and the patients there really wanted to hit me when I suggested the invitation. They didn't want her to leave at all. I completely understood the feeling, so I stopped running my mouth there...'
'After that, she spent a long time talking it over with the patients, and in the end proposed she'd come to Rhodes Island for a week or two at a time to communicate and study... I just need to go and fetch her.  Can we get her set up in my dorm when the time comes? ...Alright, I guess that'll do it. Huh? I have to submit my reason for overstaying there on paper? G—Gimme a sec and I'll go write it.'

—A certain Operator's field voice recording
text.zh:
“啊，是的，我是在大炎采集药草样本时偶然遇到了九色鹿小姐。当时她突然出现在我身边把我吓了一跳。不……我听到了她的脚步声，但……当时她肩膀上落着几只羽兽，确实把我吓到了。哪有人会带着羽兽一起爬山啊？……哦对，她说自己搬到山上居住很久了。我真的很好奇她是怎么做到能在山里生活那么长时间的，在山里一个人待着不闷吗……”
“她的屋子里有很多还没做好的草药丸，嗯哼，她说自己经常会上山采集新鲜的药草，她自己还研究出了一套特殊的草药丸制作方法。把大炎的茶叶和当地的草药捣碎调和后制作出的药丸，吃起来会有淡淡的茶香，没有很重的苦味。哎呀不用担心，只是调理身体的草药丸而已，哎，不要这样看我呀！我真的不是贪吃！”
“山下村庄里有一个诊所，她会把做好的药丸送给那里的患者。诊所似乎和她有长期合作，她会无偿提供草药给他们……真的，真的是无偿！我骗你干什么。一开始送药过去的时候，医生还很怀疑药的质量，毕竟哪有这样白捡的便宜，所以在一开始的时候，她的药医生一直没有用。直到有一次医生偶然遇到了九色鹿小姐在治疗被滚石砸伤的村民，看到她的医疗技术后才发现自己差点错过一位高人。是呀，是那里的医生和我说的呀，后来医生还一直在夸奖九色鹿小姐的药理知识和医疗技术呢。你也知道，这种偏远地区的医疗资源一向都不充足，这里的患者能遇到九色鹿小姐为他们治病真的是天大的好事了。哦对，她很少直接去诊所治病，只是提供草药丸，只有在诊所需要帮忙的时候才会搭把手。你也很奇怪是吧？我以为她是有点恐惧与人社交，但似乎是之前的她经历过什么，我也不好去问嘛。”
“然后我想着在那里多待几天也没什么，所以和九色鹿小姐多聊了一段时间。她还想要提高自己的医疗技术，想要去拯救更多的人。所以我向她发出邀请，希望她来罗德岛进行技术交流。哇，我在邀请她的时候，诊所的医生和病人都要动手打我了，他们一点都不希望九色鹿小姐离开。这个心情我完全能理解，所以当时我也不好再说什么嘛……”
“九色鹿小姐后来和患者们商量了很久，最后商议下来是会每隔一段时间来罗德岛交流学习一两周……我去接她就行，到时候可以把她安排在我的宿舍吗？……哦好的，这些就够了是吗。啊？在那滞留的原因还要提交纸质报告吗？等、等下就去写。”

——某位干员的外勤语音记录

text.en:
In her early years, Nine-Colored Deer traveled Yan, treating and saving people as she roamed. Rescuing the dying and wounded, asking for nothing in return, those were her principles. When passing through a village just recently struck by Catastrophe, she stopped in her tracks and stayed to aid the casualties. She treated people with the greatest kindness, but sadly never received their goodwill in turn. Communications in the village had been cut off at the time, and stockpiled medical supplies and drugs were critically insufficient, more and more patients being bedridden due to lack of medicated treatment. She and the one doctor left in the village were forced to search for herbals in the nearby mountains, in order to make up for the deficiency. She firmly believed she could pull this village with nothing left away from the brink. But contrary to her hopes, rumors began spreading among the already feeble populace, and within them, Nine-Colored Deer transformed from a physician to an evil, a herald of calamity.
'This woman only stays here so she can promote her cures, and gain our trust!' 'Look at her Originium Arts! She's the one who brought the Catastrophe!' She had to face not just the bitter cries of the sick, but the unguessable human heart. Though she never took notice of the villagers' slander,  these rumors rotted some of the people inside. Finally, a few brute villagers assembled in front of her, forcibly demanding the 'Elafia who brought us disaster' leave the place.
In the end, she entrusted her books filled with methods to treat illnesses, her methods for making herbal pills to that doctor, and walked far to the closest town, to inform the outside world this village still needed aid. Following that, she left that place, headed for the mountain forests to find somewhere secluded.
However, the mountains were by no means always so peaceful, and the clinic at their foot always had patients in need of help. After hesitating again and again, she delivered her herbals to the doctor after all. Fortunately, this time saw no reprisal of the last.
She still maintains her principles, and she firmly believes, treating the heart of the people is more important than treating the body.
text.zh:
早年间，九色鹿曾游历大炎，在各地行医救人。 救死扶伤，不求回报，这是她的准则。在途经一座刚刚遭受天灾的村庄时，她停下脚步并留在此地救助伤者。她以最大的善意面对人们，可惜却并未获得他们的好意。当时村庄里通讯已经中断，库存的医疗物资和药品严重不足，越来越多的患者因没有足够的药物治疗而倒下。她和村里仅剩的一名医生为填补药品不足的空缺，不得不前往附近的山林里寻找草药。她坚信可以带这个已经一无所有的村子脱离险境。但事与愿违，谣言开始在本就脆弱的人群中蔓延，流言蜚语中九色鹿从医者变为了带来灾祸的恶人。
“这个女人就是为了宣传自己的药，博取大家的信任才留在这的！”“你看她的源石技艺！是她带来的天灾！”她要面对的不仅是痛苦呻吟的病患，还有无法揣测的人心。虽然她从不理会村民的闲言碎语，但这些流言腐蚀了一些人的内心。最后一些粗鲁的村民聚集到她面前，强行要求“带来灾祸的埃拉菲亚”离开此地。
最后，她将记载各类病症的治疗方式的书籍和草药丸的制作方式托付给那位医生，自己徒步很远前往最近的城镇，向外界告知这座村庄仍需要救助。然后她便离开那，前往山林以寻求一片幽静之地。
然而山里也并非一直那样平静，山脚下的诊所总有病患需要帮助。犹豫再三后，她还是将草药送到医生手里。所幸，这里并没有出现和之前一样的情况。
她依然坚持着她的准则，她坚信，治疗人心比治疗身体更加重要。

text.en:
'You're finally back~ How was field work this time? Er... are you alright there?'
'I'm dead on my feet here... hold on, how long's it been since we saw each other?'
'About seven days? What's up...?'
'What have you been eating to fill yourself out like that? Look, you've got meat on your chin now!'
'Food's been really good at the canteen lately. Just been having more, that's all.'
'You sure you didn't beg Hung to make a whole week's food for you?'
'Gimme a break... I'm not even like that. It was a Yan operator, codename's Nine-Colored Deer. I've told you, the Yan cuisine she makes is suuuuper good.'
'Any left? Lemme try some!'
'Still plenty. She's kept a whole bunch of food ready in the fridge, especially for operators who get back late. What are you hankering for? Spicy or not? Something sweet? I'll heat it up and bring it over to you.'
'You can choose what you want?? Gimme something spicy, then, uh... no, scratch that, non-spicy. Belly's not been feeling good lately.'
'What's wrong with it? There's stomach pills here too. Here, have one.'
'What, pills? Nah, nah, nah, leave it, they're too bitter for me. I'll have some porridge when I get back.'
'These pills aren't bitter at all. They've got a little tea flavor, even. Try 'em. I had a bad gut when I got back a few days ago, and it was taking the pills for a few days that cured it.'
'You sure? Shoot me one, then... they're *not* bitter!'
'Right? I told you.'
'First time I've had a pill that's not bitter. Who made it? Can I buy a few?'
'Same person from Yan. She made the one you just had. Hold on, I found the congee. Lemme heat it one sec, and then you take your time eating.'
'Don't tell me she made that too?'
'Still her. Everything on the top shelves in here, she made. All the food with stickers on it. If you want more, you can pull some out and warm it. Oh, right, she left all the pills in this box here too. Stomach medicine is the blue sticker. Don't get mixed up.'
'She made all this medicine herself?'
'She collects herbs all the time in Yan, and she makes the pills and brings them in.'
'What can't she do... I feel like I know why you got meat on your bones so quick now.'
'I mean, you know? Meals have just been amazing lately. If my mom could make stuff so delicious, I'd be a ball by now.'
'Nothing wrong with that. Here, hey-hey-hey, you have some too. Too sad eating by myself.'
'Sure. I'll go get another bowl.'
'You've been eating this for days on end and you haven't gotten any present to thank her or anything?'
'I sent her some flowers earlier, but it's just all flowers outside her dorm door. All of them from everyone else.'
'I've got something good here. Bought it on the way back from the field. Let's go together tomorrow and give to her.'

——Cafeteria recording monitor, unknown timestamp
text.zh:
“你终于回来啦~这次外勤怎么样？呃……你人还好吗？”
“人快累死了……等下，我们多长时间没见面了？”
“大概七天？怎么了……”
“你都吃什么了，胖这么多？下巴都有肉了好吗！”
“最近食堂伙食特别好，多吃了一点而已。”
“你不会是求着吽让他给你做了一周的饭吧？”
“怎么可能……我可不是那样的人。是一个大炎的干员，代号是九色鹿。我和你讲哦，九色鹿小姐做的炎国菜超——级好吃。”
“还有吗？让我吃一口！”
“还有好多呢，她在冰箱里存了好多做好的菜，专门留给晚归的干员。你想吃什么味道的？辣的还是不辣的？要不要吃甜的？我把菜热一下再拿给你。”
“口味还能自选吗？？那要一份辣的，哎……算了还是不辣的吧，最近胃不太好。”
“胃怎么了？这还有养胃的药丸，给你点。”
“药丸？不不不，还是算了，药丸太苦了，我回去再喝点粥好了。”
“这个药丸一点都不苦，还有茶香味道，你尝尝嘛。我前几天回来的时候胃也不舒服，吃了几天药丸之后才养好的。”
“真的吗，那给我一个……真的不苦哎！”
“对吧，我可没骗你。”
“第一次吃到不苦的药丸，是谁做的啊？我能买点吗？”
“还是大炎的那位，你现在吃的这个菜就是她做的。等下，我找到粥了，稍等我加热下，你慢点吃菜啊。”
“这粥不会也是她做的吧？”
“还是她，这冰箱里上面冷藏层的全是她做的。这些有贴纸的菜都是，你要是还想吃，晚上还可以拿去热一热。哦对，这个盒子里的药丸也是她特意留下的。养胃的药丸是蓝色贴纸的，可别拿错了。”
“这些药是她自己做的？”
“她在大炎经常会采集草药呢，药丸也是她自己做好带过来的。”
“太全能了吧……我似乎知道为什么你会胖得那么快了。”
“没办法，最近吃得太好了，我妈要是做菜能这么好吃，我能胖成球。”
“胖成球还行。来来来，你也吃点，我一个人吃太尴尬了。”
“行吧，我再去拿个碗。”
“你都吃了这么多天了，没给她准备点答谢礼物吗？”
“之前送了点花，但她宿舍门口的花太多了，都是其他人送的。”
“我这里有个好东西，是这次外勤回来的路上买的，明天我们一起拿给她吧。”

————未知时间食堂录音监控

text.en:
Nine-Colored Deer likes the fresh scent of vegetation, admiring the ink of scrolls while it's still not dry, and trying delicate new teas.
She likes all of these, and it's because of it that she so carefully cherishes them.
text.zh:
九色鹿喜欢闻植物的清新香气，喜欢欣赏墨迹未干的书画，还喜欢品尝鲜嫩的新茶。
这里的一切她都喜欢，正因如此她才会如此用心地呵护这一切。

text.en: Formerly a warrior of a Szubat-Arsalan tribe in Sargon, Kestrel and her siblings were enslaved by the local lord ameer's army. Encountering Rhodes Island personnel during her escape, she was able to return to the mines and rescue the other workers. She later joined Rhodes Island and is currently employed at the Sargonian branch, receiving treatment while participating in field missions.
text.zh: 红隼，萨尔贡人，舒巴特-阿尔萨兰地区前部落战士，曾与她的兄弟姐妹们一起被当地王酋军强制奴役。在一次逃离后与罗德岛相遇，重返矿场解救了与自己一同受难的工友，后主动申请加入罗德岛。现作为罗德岛萨尔贡办事处干员，接受治疗的同时参与各类外勤任务。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 3.7%
Operator Kestrel shows signs of mild Oripathy infection, but leads a life that is little different from the uninfected.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.26u/L
Working in dangerous Originium mines without proper protection has had a significant impact on Operator Kestrel's health. Her BOCD is well above normal levels and requires regular monitoring. While we have instructed her to take it easy in her everyday life, it seems unlikely that she would be willing to sit around all day. The best we can do is recommend that she avoids high-risk field missions.

The people of her tribe had a custom of painting 'bite marks' with mineral paint. It remains to be seen whether this has a negative effect on her condition.
- Warfarin, Medical Department
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】3.7%
干员红隼体内有轻微的矿石病感染迹象，但她在生活中和未感染者看起来没有什么区别。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.26u/L
干员红隼过去那段极为危险的源石矿开采经历给她的健康带来了不可忽视的影响。缺乏防护让她的血液源石结晶密度明显高于正常水平，我们将会对她的病况进行跟踪观察。为避免进一步恶化，我们应当要求她保持相对舒缓的生活方式，但考虑到红隼小姐本人强烈的作战意愿，我们未必能让她安静地待着——只好建议她尽可能避免高风险的外勤活动。

在其曾经所属的萨尔贡部落中，疑似有以矿石颜料涂抹在“齿痕”上的古老传统，关于这是否会加速病情恶化还有待进一步考察。
——医疗干员华法琳

text.en:
Kestrel is a Sargonian warrior who is as straightforward as they come.
She began frequenting the training room shortly after arriving at headquarters, confidently walking in like she had always been a regular. Her relationship with the combat experts of Rhodes Island began with a clash of weapons, putting on a show of Sargonian tribal swordplay that the operators in the training room had never seen before. They eagerly invited her to come back for more.
Her favorite hangout is the bar; although she has been warned against excessive drinking, she can often be spotted doing so from dusk to dawn at the bar for weeks on end. Ultimately, the Medical Department decided to bring her in by force, but Kestrel refused the 'treatment'; being under the influence only seemed to make her sword strike faster and harder. Treatment finally began when her training room friends arrived and successfully restrained her with great effort, only for everyone to realize that treatment was unnecessary after all: unlike most drunks who deny being drunk, Kestrel was, in fact, unimpaired. If anything, the alcohol had only served to hone her swordsmanship.

[Medical Department Audio Log]
'That Kestrel, from Sargon. Can you believe what her tests show?'
'What do you mean?'
'Do you know how much she drinks? Yet it doesn't seem to have any effect on her vitals.'
'Wish I were like that.'
text.zh:
红隼是一位直来直往的萨尔贡战士。
刚来罗德岛本舰的那几天，红隼最常去的地方是训练室。在最开始，她一言不发地走进去，假装自己是这里的“熟客”。她和罗德岛的战斗好手们的结识也从彼此武器的第一次撞击开始，在训练室的干员们则第一次领教到他们从未见识过的萨尔贡部落刀法，并且主动邀请她下次有空再来。
她最爱光顾的地方是罗德岛酒吧，虽然反复被提醒不要过量饮酒，但干员们还是发现她常常在酒吧里开怀畅饮，从晚上喝到第二天早上。如此循环往复几个星期以后，干员们十分担忧她的健康状态。某天，医疗部的干员们终于决定将她“扭送”到医疗部醒酒，然而正在兴头上的红隼拒绝“治疗”，她的部落刀法反而变得更加凌厉，直到一些她在训练室结交的朋友赶到现场，这场“治疗”才得以展开。但是很快，大家就发现这场“治疗”并没有那么必要，因为和一般的醉酒者不一样，她说的“我没醉”居然是一句实话，而且她喝了酒以后部落刀法也变得更加高超了。

【医疗部语音记录】
“那位从萨尔贡来的红隼小姐，身体指标真是令人感到惊讶。”
“怎么说？”
“你能想到她每天喝那么多酒，所有的身体指标都没什么波动吗？”
“我也好想有这样的体质啊。”

text.en:
Many Rhodes Island operators have their fair share of scars, which serves as a way to introduce themselves.
'I got this during the Sarkaz Civil War...'
'I got this during Columbia's Great Expansion...'
'I got this when I hit my head on a table when I was three!'
'That doesn't count!'
Kestrel was rather reticent about this topic at first, as the trials of her past left no visible marks on her skin. This bothered her, as she saw scars from battle as something to be proud of.
As she began to blend in, she realized that her 'bite marks' serve equally well as a conversation starter. When asked about the meaning of a 'guardian bite mark', she ended up giving a lecture about the meanings of various marks.
'What would Rhodes Island's bite mark embody?'
'That depends on what Rhodes Island is about.'
'Let's say... 'future'.'
'My tribe didn't have that kind of mark, but we can invent one.'
Kestrel began inventing her first 'bite mark' after receiving such a request. Shutting herself in her room, she spent two days drawing up the pattern, and hung it up in the cafeteria to the sound of cheering.
As the crowd came forward to embrace her, she felt, for the first time, that she had truly been accepted.
She still thinks back to the people and events of her past, but no longer finds her lack of scars to be a handicap. Rather, she is happy to share the origins of her 'bite marks,' and to carry on the tradition of her people in her new home.

Medical checks revealed nothing of particular note. We suspect that painting these 'bite marks' with mineral paints may have something to do with how external trauma leaves no mark on her skin, but no firm conclusions have been reached for now.
- Warfarin, Medical Department
text.zh:
罗德岛上的干员们大多都历经种种变故，往往会留下各种各样的伤疤，这也常常成为他们彼此间自我介绍的一种方式。
“我这块伤疤是萨卡兹内战的时候留下的，那会儿我……”
“我这块是哥伦比亚大拓荒时期留下的，那会儿我……”
“我这块伤疤是我三岁的时候在自家桌子上磕出来的！”
“什么，你这也算？”
在刚来罗德岛的时候，红隼面对这些话题会十分沉默，因为她所经历的各种伤痛似乎都无法在她的皮肤上留下任何痕迹，这对于曾经视伤疤为战斗的纪念的她来说本来便是一种缺憾。
逐渐与大家熟悉以后，红隼发现其实自己的“齿痕”也一样具有话题性。常常被人问起“守护齿痕”的含义，一时兴起的她决定给大家讲解各种样式“齿痕”的不同含义。
“如果罗德岛也有‘齿痕’，它应当有什么含义呢？”
“那要看罗德岛的宗旨是什么。”
“未来吧。”
“这样的‘齿痕’在我以前的部族里是没有的，不过……可以新做一个。”
为了完成干员们的请求，红隼第一次开始创作“齿痕”，这是她在之前从未做过的事，她将自己关在房间里，用两天时间绘制了纹路，然后在众人的欢呼中将其挂在了食堂的墙壁上。
在被众人拥簇的那一刻，她感受到了自己真正地被接纳。
如今，她还是会偶尔想起过去的那些人和事，但她不再会因为缺少伤疤而若有所失，相反地，如今的她更乐于分享自己“齿痕”的渊源，将自己部族留下的美好“发扬光大”，让自己所守护的新家园拥有一抹属于红隼的色彩。

我们确实邀请红隼干员接受了额外的医学检查，从结果来看，她并没有什么独特的、可被明确定义的身体特质。我们也怀疑过她本人在“齿痕”上涂抹矿石颜料的行为与她的皮肤经受外部创伤不会留痕的状况有相关性，不过目前看起来，答案并不明确。
——医疗干员华法琳

text.en:
Kestrels holds great respect for the tribal chief who brought her up.
By tradition, women of the tribe undergo trials to become defenders of hearth and home. The chief was the one who took the homeless Kestrel in and raised her to become a brave warrior. She was a beautiful and kind leader who taught her tribe to turn abandoned ruins into settlements with plenty of water and rich soil.
The threat of the Lord Ameer was constantly looming over their heads, though. In order to oppose the Lord Ameer, the chief traveled to numerous other tribes to build alliances, taking Kestrel along with her. In her free time, she discussed with the young Kestrel what kinds of body paint looked best, and gave Kestrel 'bite marks' symbolizing 'Protection.'
Kestrel learned that the chief preferred white for 'bite marks'.
In subsequent years, she used the 'bite mark' that her mentor gave her, in her favorite color, while fighting a hopeless war against the Lord Ameer's soldiers with the few comrades she had left, until she was the only one left.
text.zh:
干员红隼心中有一位非常尊重的前辈，是曾经养育她的部落首领。
部族里有一个古老的传统，每一位成年的女性都需要通过挑战加入卫队捍卫家园。首领在路上救下了四处流浪的红隼，之后又教导她如何成为一位勇敢、强壮的战士。这位首领美丽且温柔，带领着全部族的人一点一点地将曾经的废墟改造成了水源丰沛、土地肥沃的定居点。
但王酋军这一阴霾始终挥之不去，如此弱小的部族怎样才能抵挡四处侵扰的王酋军是一个不得不面对的问题。这位首领带着红隼到处寻求部族联合，在奔波的路上，她依然会忙里偷闲和年轻的红隼交流使用什么颜色的矿石颜料在身体上涂抹最美观，并亲手给红隼刻上了象征“守护”的“齿痕”。
在那时红隼便知道，首领最喜欢在“齿痕”上涂抹的颜色是白色。
在接下来的岁月里，她涂抹着首领最喜爱的颜色，使用着首领为她挑选的“守护齿痕”，即便知道夺回自己的家园无望，她还是带着几个仅有的战友不断向王酋军发动复仇，直到只剩她一人。

text.en:
A psychological assessment was performed on Operator Kestrel to mitigate potential risks in field missions.
We learned through interviews that revenge became her purpose after the destruction of her tribe, but that it came to a stop at some point.
According to her, during her stint in the mines, she took in some children who had also been enslaved in the mines. At their request, she agreed to teach them to use a blade in order to take revenge for their families.
However, she had underestimated the price of revenge. Witnessing the deaths of those children led her to look back on the purpose she had pursued for so many years, and the results that came of it. No longer obsessed with vengeance, she turned her sights back to the original connotations of 'Protection,' and began to see inciting revenge as an evil.
She came to the conclusion that her current life matters more, and that Rhodes Island is her new home that she must protect. As such, she has requested a reassignment to the Sargonian branch to participate in field missions.
We must inform the Sargonian office ahead of time to keep an eye on Kestrel's condition in the field, investigate any faction that has a history with her, and require her to regularly return to HQ for psychological evaluation and Oripathy monitoring.

Kestrel still has many mysteries, as there are details in her personal history that can no longer be verified, and her own account is sometimes confused or fragmented. It must be emphasized, however, that this is no reason not to put our trust in her.
- HR Department Note
text.zh:
我们近期对干员红隼进行了初步的心理状态评估，以避免一些未来外勤任务中可能会出现的潜在问题。
在翻阅了她本人对于过去的表述资料之后，我们得知，部落被毁灭后，复仇成了红隼人生的主题，但在一场变故后，这一切戛然而止。
根据红隼本人提供的信息，被奴役于采矿场期间，她曾经收留过同样沦为矿工的孩子，这些孩子请求向她学习她的部落刀法为自己逝去的亲人复仇。她接受了这一请求——
但她低估了复仇会付出的代价，这些孩子全部死在了行动里。她目睹了这一惨剧，开始回顾自己过去多年来的“坚持”和“结果”。她决定不再执拗于复仇本身，而是回到“守护”本来的含义上。并且，她认为随意鼓动他人复仇是一种作恶的行为。
在经过深思熟虑之后，她现在更在乎自己已经拥有的生活，认为罗德岛是自己需要守护的新的“家园”。因此，她也主动要求离开本舰，返回萨尔贡办事处执行外勤任务。
我们需要提前将该信息发送给萨尔贡办事处，要求他们在派遣红隼执行外勤任务的时候有所把控，对那些过去与红隼有过节的势力进行调查，同时要求红隼定期返回本舰接受心理状态评估和矿石病病情监测。

她身上依然有许多谜团，许多她过往经历中的细节我们已无从考证，本人的自述也有一些混乱和破碎，但需要强调的是这些部分不会成为我们对她产生信任问题的理由。
——人事部成员留

text.en:
The sun is setting.
Kestrel stands up from the roof of the office building she had been lying on, pulls out her horn, and blows it towards the setting sun.
She had explained to curious operators that the horn symbolized the celebration of victory, or the passing of a peaceful and quiet day.
Today's horn is particularly long, because this is her first day at the office as an official operator of Rhodes Island.
Kestrel blows it a little longer for the important events in her life.
The first time was her very first victory in battle. Their armies charged downhill and routed the Lord Ameer's soldiers. She had volunteered to be the vanguard, and saved the life of her friend with the sword her chief had taught her to wield. That day, she learned what it meant to be a comrade, and she blew her horn longer.
The second was when she led the slave revolt through the mine shafts, filled with fog and enemies. She took the rear guard, fighting off pursuers all night, until she saw with her own eyes that the miners had reached safety. That day, she learned that the purpose of the sword was to protect, and she blew her horn longer.
This is the third time.
text.zh:
太阳要落山了。
躺在办事处屋顶上的红隼站起身来，掏出自己的号角，对着太阳落下的地方吹响。
她曾经对好奇的干员们解释过吹响号角在部落的含义：代表胜利的庆祝，亦或是昭示家园平静度过了一天。
今天的号角声格外长，因为今天是她以罗德岛正式干员的身份在办事处就职的第一天。
在红隼过去的人生中，每经历一个重要的节点，她都会让号角声长一些，再长一些。
第一次，是红隼初次获得战斗的胜利。那是一场从山坡上冲向王酋军的战斗，年轻的她主动请战，用首领教会她的刀法救下了奄奄一息的朋友。这时，她第一次理解了战友的含义，决定要让号角声响得更久。
第二次，是她带着矿工们冲出巷道，在重重包围中冲破迷雾的时候，断后的她用刀与穷追不舍的监工们缠斗了大半个夜晚，直到亲眼看到矿工们平安到达目的地，她才吹起了号角，再长一些，那时她明白了守护才是战斗的最终目的。
而现在，是她的第三次。

value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Confirmed Infected by medical examination.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

text.en:
Operator Shalem, Rhodes Island Landship employee, principally responsible for field/logistics preparatory work, several items of background still as of yet unverified.
Presently dispatched on relevant missions as a Defender Operator, possessing comparatively strong combat ability.
text.zh:
干员暮落，罗德岛本舰雇员，主要负责外勤与后勤筹备工作，背景履历中仍有数个条目尚未核实。
现作为重装干员被派遣至相关任务，具有较强作战能力。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 7%
Operator Shalem is infected, but displays no visible surface crystallization yet.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.21u/L
The operator is fully cooperative with plans proposed by Rhodes Island's Medical Department. Under active treatment, we have presently not found any likelihood of Oripathy metastasis.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】7%
干员暮落已感染，但体表尚未发现明显结晶。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.21u/L
该干员十分配合罗德岛医疗部提出的方案，在积极治疗下，暂未发现矿石病扩散的可能性。

text.en: Was someone like him ever there in your circles? When you return to your senses some day, only then will you realize he's appeared in your life. You've never held much conversation. You can't even remember what it was like the first time you met him. Yet in some domain, he's your most reliable adviser; you ask him a question, and he'll give you an answer. But when you design to pull him into your social rings, he'll slip quietly out from your hands, hidden in the shadows on interaction's periphery. Not so long ago, Shalem was such a 'friend,' conscientious in his work, humble and gentle in his treatment of others, a proclivity for using his Arts mastery to wipe others' doubts, but at the same time, he tactfully declines all kindnesses, maintaining a distance from every person. Considering Rhodes Island's operators come from all corners, races, temperaments, histories and myriad diversities of the land, there are indeed plenty who are weak with communication yet possess a kind heart, and thus HR's operators haven't had serious concern, vis-a-vis the state of Shalem's life. Actually, Shalem himself hopes he'll lead this sort of life to his biological end, unable to stand recalling his past, his intermittent dreams reminding him his nightmares are still in this world. Thus, he painstakingly avoids any relation with others, hoping that he won't embroil others in it when misfortune descends. He's been waiting forever, waiting for his chapter's end, but he doesn't anticipate that in ten or so months, when Rhodes Island life has long since become routine, that a shadow of the past will sorrowfully arrive.
text.zh: 在你的社交圈中，可曾有那么一个人？当你某天回过神来时，才发现他已出现在了你的生活中，你们并没有多少交流，你甚至想不起来第一次与他见面时的场景。但在某些领域中，他是你最可靠的顾问，你提出问题，他便会为你解答，可当你想把他拉入自己的社交圈时，他又从你手中悄然滑开，躲到了交际边缘的阴影里。曾几何时，暮落正是这样一个“朋友”，工作上兢兢业业，待人上谦逊柔和，乐于用自己的艺术造诣为他人解惑，但与此同时，他婉言谢绝所有善意，与所有人都保持距离。考虑到罗德岛干员们来自大地的各个角落，种族、性格、经历也千差万别，的确有许多人不擅长交际却有着一颗善良的心，因此对于暮落的生活状态，人事部门的干员并没有放在心上。其实，暮落本人也期望以这种状态生活到自己生命的终点，他的过去实在不堪回忆，而时断时续的幻梦也警醒着他噩梦尚在人间，因此他刻意回避与他人的关系，希望厄运降临时不要给他人添麻烦。他一直在等待，等待自己这一篇章的终结，但他没有料到，在十几个月后，当自己早已熟悉在罗德岛的生活时，过往的黑影悄然而至。

text.en:
After a field mission ended, Shalem noticed a phantasm behind him. He was the most brilliant of those young stars in the troupe, its leader's favorite, a crimson blood diamond, and he stared at him, naturally not seeking to reminisce. To evade that phantasm, Shalem left the squad, fled alone into the barrens, but the black mirage kept behind him close as his shadow. Shalem hid in the city, disguised, changed clothes, and took a circuitous route from a branch office back to Rhodes Island. He thought he'd fooled it, but on returning to his dormitory, he found it had followed aboard, and begun to roam this steel behemoth.
An acquainted operator informed him someone called Phantom had joined as an Operator in the past few days. Who was Phantom? Shalem knew in his heart as clear as night.
Ever since, he began making every effort to shrink his range of activity; if there was no need, he wouldn't set half a pace beyond his dormitory. The ghost of the troupe was still wandering aboard Rhodes Island, and should they meet, he would have no way out. Just like this, Shalem disappeared from Rhodes Island for an age...
When he received a mission on his terminal to seek the missing Operator Phantom, Shalem believed someone to be pranking him, but after verifying high and low, he realized Phantom truly had departed Rhodes Island, and no one was more familiar with the mission objective's search area than Shalem.
It was his and Phantom's home, and the beginning of their nightmares.
The past had already found Shalem, and he could not choose to stay uninvolved again.
He accepted the mission to search for Phantom.
text.zh:
在一次外勤任务结束后，暮落发现了身后的幻影。他是剧团那一批孩子中最闪亮的新星，剧团长的爱徒，猩红的血钻，他盯上自己，自然不是为了叙旧。为了躲过那抹幻影，暮落离开队伍，独自一人在荒野中逃亡，而黑影在他背后穷追不舍。暮落躲入城市，易容，换装，从当地的罗德岛办事处曲折返回罗德岛。他自以为骗过了幻影，然而在回到宿舍后，却发现它追上了罗德岛，开始在这座钢铁巨物里游荡。
相识的干员告诉他，有位叫作傀影的干员在几日前加入了罗德岛。傀影是谁？暮落心中自然一清二楚。
从此，他开始尽力收缩自己的活动范围，如若没有必要，他决不踏出宿舍半步。剧团的幽魂还在罗德岛上游荡，一旦遇上，他便没有活路，就这样，暮落在罗德岛上消失了许久……
当在终端上接到搜寻失踪干员傀影的任务时，暮落还以为有人给自己开了个玩笑，但在多方核实后，他发现，傀影的确离开了罗德岛，而任务目标上的搜索地域，没有人比暮落更熟悉。
那是他和傀影的家乡，也是他们噩梦的开端。
过往已经找上了暮落，而他已经无法再次选择置身事外了。
暮落接下了搜索傀影的任务。

text.en:
In Shalem's memories, aside from the great flood that submerged the village, clinging miserably to the rooftops to survive, all recollection of his home has long gone.
There is only the troupe, and only the troupe remains.
After the flood receded, some sumptuously graceful guests entered the village. Yes, they handed people money to seek local aid; yes, they carefully selected, adopted many children who were without claim, now their parents had vanished or been lost. Numbering one of them was the young Shalem.
When Shalem and the great huddle of children first saw the troupe's tent, and were taken to their quarters in familiar manner by the butler, given bread from the old man's hands, listened to his cordial questions, their hearts were filled with a hope for the future.
'You are children of the arts. Now, you may rest well.'
So the old butler promised, and so Shalem believed.
Soon after, his life became a play.
Modest and gentle was the label the troupe gave to Shalem, and ever since then, it has become his 'true personality.'
We shan't dwell on the daily physical training and rehearsal of lines. Understudies as excellent as Phantom would be led upon stage, given verbal motivation and material reward in front of them all. And of course, those children not fit for the troupe's demands would be correspondingly denounced.
Everyone wanted to be the lead on stage with the support of all, and not the failures rebuked before them. And so, on all of their shoulders sat an incorporeal burden.
Not every child could bear this burden, and though no worries of nourishment nor sleep were had, some still had not the physical power to last upon the stage. Or, perhaps, they were encaged in a role, unable to recover themselves.
The children who entered the troupe together one by one disappeared, and those left were completely changed in temperament, not a speck of the innocence of their years left visible.
As they grew in years, Shalem had convinced himself to accept one fact:
We were only brought into this troupe to offer our lives to the arts. If we are unable to perform...
Then we have no right to live within the troupe.
Whether voluntary or not, so long as you joined the troupe, the script you were given would be written long in advance.
To run until your life's end.
......
In his dreams, Shalem watches the traveling troupe's performances with his parents, and their performance is of a one-of-a-kind vast flood, submerging everything. Only a few survivors remain, pulling through atop the mountains. Survival drives all to the brink, and they who ought to have worked together past these difficulties began to slaughter each other. In the end, no one escapes. Only a few uneaten slices of meat remain, scooped away by fowlbeasts, flapping their wings across the endless waters.
text.zh:
在暮落的记忆里，除了那场淹没村庄的大洪水，和人们缩在屋顶上挣扎求生的丑态外，早已没了半点对故乡的回忆。
唯有剧团，只余剧团。
当洪水退去，一些雍容华贵的来客进入村子，一边拨款请人在当地救灾，一边则仔细甄选，收养了许多父母双亡或失散而无人认领的孩童，年幼的暮落也是其中之一。
当暮落和一大帮孩子第一次看到剧团的帐篷，被管家亲切地带入宿舍，接过这位老者手中的面包，听闻他亲切的问询时，心里满是对未来的期望。
“你们是艺术的孩子，现在请好好休息吧。”
老管家如此许诺，暮落如此想象着。
随后，他的生活便成了一出戏。
谦逊温和是剧团赋予暮落的标签，从此之后，这便是他的“真实性格”。
日常的体能训练与台词演练自不必说，像傀影那样优秀的预备演员，将会被拥上舞台，在众人眼前获得言语激励和物质奖赏。当然，不符合剧团要求的孩子，也会遭受相应的贬斥。
每个人都想成为舞台上被众人拥戴的主演，而非被当众训斥的失败者，就这样，所有人肩上都多了一副无形的重担。
这种重负并非每个孩子都能承受的，即使没有营养和睡眠上的忧虑，还是有些人体力不支倒在舞台上，抑或是被角色所困，再也没恢复过来。
当初一起进入剧团的孩子们一个个消失，而留下来的人，性情也完全改变，看不到半点当年的纯真。
随着年龄增长，暮落也说服自己接受了一个真相：
我们是为了将生命奉献给艺术才被带入剧团的，如果无法表演……
就没有在剧团里生活的资格。
无论自愿与否，只要进入剧团，便会被安排上早已写就的剧本。
直至生命的终点。
……
在自己的幻梦中，暮落同父母一起观赏了流浪剧团的演出，演出内容是一场绝无仅有的大洪水，洪水淹没了一切，只余几位生者在高山上苟延残喘。生存将所有人逼上绝境，本应合作渡过难关的他们开始互相残杀，最终，无人幸免，只余下几块无人吃下的肉片被羽兽叼走，向着无垠的洪水振翅飞去。

text.en:
Does the boy of the abyss sense beauty?
He does; he still does.
He is a child of the arts, and beautiful yearnings infiltrate his soul deep.
He should have let the greed he held well his spirit full, cast all to the wind to chase the objects of beauty.
If he could not have them, then he should have cast all to the wind to destroy them!
In that interval resplendence dies out, see all things of rare marvel in the world fade to naught.
In that instant only—in sorrow, pain, torment!—witness their fleeting destruction.
He should have delivered that dagger to their heart, felt the spasm of their limbs, watched the light in their eyes little by little melt away.
But the boy of the abyss did not do so.
The weapon meant to murder instead cut the rope, and was handed to another to become a tool protective of life.
And so did a meticulous production end.
A play rendered a complete shambles by this boy of the abyss.
A stage offered to him to prove his talent, so wasted and defiled by a conscience.
Sinner, sinner!
This coward, this lamentable coward.
A hunter letting go its prey, presuming to still return to the castle, to report to its king.
And yet he! He follows the prey's steps, disappears with it into the barrens' ends?!
Let him be far from civilization, far from art, to go to that wild brink.
He is fit only to be exiled.
text.zh:
沉渊感受得到美吗？
他会，他仍会。
他是艺术的孩子，对美好的眷恋深入灵魂。
他本应让占有的欲望充盈心灵，不顾一切去追逐美的事物。
若是得不到，便应不顾一切将之毁灭。
在璀璨消亡间，目睹世间稀少的美妙事物彻底消失。
只那一瞬，在悲伤、痛苦、折磨中见证即逝的毁灭。
他本应将匕首送入那人的心脏，感受肢体的抽搐，看着对方眼中的光亮缓缓消散。
但沉渊没有那样做。
伤人的凶器割断了绳索，还交到他人手中成了守护生命的器具。
精心准备的戏剧，就此结束。
沉渊让这场戏变得一团糟。
一个提供给他证明才华的舞台，就这样被良知给白白糟蹋了。
罪恶，罪恶！
这个懦夫，可悲的懦夫。
猎人放走猎物，还知道返回城堡，向国王复命。
可他居然，居然循着猎物的脚步，一同消失在了荒野尽头？！
就让他远离文明，远离艺术，去那荒蛮的边缘吧。
他只配得到放逐。

text.en:
When a person begins learning to perform, or takes up the profession of an actor, they bear for the rest of their life a curse:
Are you doing what you would, or carrying out an endless performance?
You're very good at surmising the personalities of roles, able to vary your expression and body language as you like.
But do you still remember your own personality?
People can change. Perhaps you've already matured, and maturity has brought the personality you show far, far away from your juvenile years.
In which case, which personality is true, and which is the false?
Do you enact your true personality? Or is your false personality itself the true you?
Oh, I imagine you likely can't make heads or tails anymore.
Let me show you a way forth.
Whether you're the bottomless boy of the abyss taking the stage, or the nobody Shalem aboard Rhodes Island.
Listen to this suggestion from your old butler.
Everything is a sham.
You are not your own self.
You were born a performance.
Don't be led astray by your self.
You are a role, and the role is all that you are.
The role's choices are your choices.
Now take the stage, performer.
The time to offer yourself to art has come.
text.zh:
当一个人开始学习表演，或是从事演员这一职业时，终其一生，都要背负一个诅咒：
你是在做你自己，还是在进行一场永无尽头的表演？
你很擅长揣测角色性格，能够随意变换表情与肢体语言。
可你还记得自己的性格吗？
人是会改变的，或许你已经成长了，而成长导致你显露出的性格已与幼时大相径庭。
那么，哪一个性格是真实的，哪一个性格是虚假的呢？
你在演绎真实的性格？还是说，虚假的性格才是真正的你？
哦，我想你可能已经考虑不过来了。
让我给你指条明路吧。
无论你是登台亮相的无底沉渊，还是罗德岛上默默无闻的暮落。
听听老管家留给你的建议。
一切都是虚伪的。
你并非自我。
你生来便是要演绎的。
不要被自我所迷惑。
你是角色，角色则是你的一切。
角色的选择，就是你的选择。
请登台吧，演员。
为艺术献身的时刻到了。

value.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

text.en: Ingrid, mother of Operator Suzuran, and former core member of Famiglia Venezia—one of the Dodici Famiglie of Siracusa. A veteran assassin who excels in elimination and raid missions, she has separated herself from her famiglia for various reasons. Now works on the Rhodes Island landship as an operator under the codename Vulpisfoglia.
text.zh: 英格丽，铃兰干员的母亲，曾为叙拉古灰厅十二家族之一——威尼斯家族的核心成员，多执行暗杀任务，擅长歼灭战与突袭战，后因故从家族脱离。现以罗德岛驻舰干员身份活动，代号忍冬。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Vulpisfoglia shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.13u/L
Operator Vulpisfoglia rarely comes into contact with Originium, but is quite familiar with Oripathy prevention and treatment methods, and has some experience with taking care of Oripathy patients.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员忍冬没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.13u/L
干员忍冬甚少接触源石，但对矿石病的防护和应急治疗手段却颇为熟悉，在矿石病患者的日常护理方面也有一些经验。

text.en:
Over the last few years while Operator Suzuran has been receiving treatment on Rhodes Island, Ingrid and a Higashinese priest have visited the landship a few times to see her. The priest is always the one asking us how his daughter is doing, in terms of both health and studies, while Ingrid stands at the side, occasionally asking abrupt questions about the landship's defenses and how dangerous the field missions are. This has left HR with a profound, albeit limited, understanding of her, but also given them an easy job when deciding what to write on her record—'Siracusan, famiglia assassin, doesn't seem friendly.'
This time she has come to Rhodes Island on her own, and after she applied to stay on the landship, we began to supplement her files with more information. This went smoothly, and we discovered that 'Ingrid' is an infamous name in Siracusa: As a core member of Famiglia Venezia, she left no less than 27 separate homicide case files in the courts of every region she visited while the famiglia was expanding their territory. At least ten famiglie have offered a bounty for her head, and half of them have yet to expire even today. 'A Vulpo even more ruthless than a wolf', is how she's fearfully described among Siracusan famiglie.
Of course, considering Siracusa's political situation and the identities of those who have died at her hands, her past is not at all incomprehensible, and will not meaningfully affect Rhodes Island. After consulting Dr. Kal'tsit, we approved her application to stay aboard the landship. The final confirmation step also went smoothly, and the operators who went looking for her came back to HR shortly after. According to them, they had brought a large file of sorted information for her, but the other party just nodded to confirm her application, and only mentioned a small request: to erase the 'Venezia' surname from her file. She even gave each HR Operator an exquisite present before she left, and said with a smile: 'As thanks for taking care of Lisa, and also for your hard work collecting those documents.'

'Ingrid doesn't seem that unfriendly.'
'Hey now. Didn't you hear the implied threat underlining her second sentence?'
'Don't jump to conclusions. Don't you remember her smile?
'Exactly, remember that smile...'
text.zh:
铃兰干员在罗德岛接受治疗的这几年，英格丽女士和那位东国的宫司来本舰探望过她几次。每次都是那位宫司絮絮叨叨地询问我们他女儿的学业和生活，而英格丽女士则站在一旁，偶尔冷不丁地插入几个问题，关于罗德岛本舰的防务、外勤任务的风险之类，因此人事部虽然对她印象很深但了解甚少，留存的记录也很简单——“叙拉古人，家族杀手，看起来不太好相处。”
当这次英格丽女士独自来到罗德岛，并提出留舰申请后，我们开始对她的资料进行补充。相关工作进行得很顺利，这时我们才发现“英格丽”这个名字在叙拉古不可谓不出名：作为威尼斯家族的核心成员，在该家族向各个城市扩张地盘的那些年，她也在各地的法院留下了足足二十七份命案卷宗，起码有十个家族发布过针对她的悬赏，其中有半数至今仍未失效。“比狼更狠的沃尔珀”，叙拉古家族之间口口相传着她的凶名。
当然，考虑到叙拉古的政治现状，以及死在她手里的那些人的身份，英格丽女士的这些过往并非不能理解，加上并不会对罗德岛产生实际影响，在请示过凯尔希医生后，我们通过了英格丽女士的留舰申请。最后的确认工作也很顺利，去找英格丽女士的干员很快回到了人事部。据他们所说，当他们带着整理好的一大摞资料找到英格丽女士时，对方很坦然地点头确认，只是提了一个很小的要求——在姓名栏删去“威尼斯”这个姓氏。临走时她甚至送了人事干员一人一份精美的小礼物，笑着说：“一来是感谢你们照顾丽萨，二来……你们收集这些资料辛苦了。”

“看来英格丽女士也没有那么不好相处嘛。”
“喂喂，你不觉得最后那句话更像是威胁吗？”
“别乱猜，你想想她的笑容。”
“对啊，你想想她的笑容……”

text.en: As Ingrid spent more and more time on the landship, we got to know each other better. A few interest groups invited her to their gatherings, but were surprised when she gladly accepted, only to miss almost every single one—because she was always late. She missed a few consecutive wine tasting sessions, only languidly arriving at the venue when the event was almost over, and embarrassingly pleading the organizer to extend it by one more hour. We find it truly hard to imagine how she has no sense of time while also somewhat lacking in patience. She once again surpassed our understanding of her when she began participating in Rhodes Island's combat drills and field missions under the code name 'Vulpisfoglia'. Operators who were with her would nearly always mention feeling a great pressure, not because she was once a Siracusan famiglia assassin, has an unsociable personality, or uses cruel methods, but because her... impressive ability to execute every task with utmost precision left everyone somewhat dumbfounded. She always completes every objective in a mission exactly as stated, and even a placeholder objective accidentally left unrevised as 'I hope the target can be knocked over by an object thrown from up high, right as the new day comes in, for a most satisfactory result' was realized perfectly. Unlike how she acts on the landship, she seemed to have suddenly gained an almost obsessive-compulsive or perfectionist obsession with the finest of details. The sharp contrast stunned everyone, but someone finally plucked the courage to ask her about this gap in behavior. She simply frowned and said: 'Did you want me to slack off while working?' [Supplementary Note] I was sorting through the operator's files when I flipped to a Siracusan court case with records of what Ingrid said when she was answering the judge as a defendant. Perhaps it can explain her 'extreme separation of work and life' and her 'OCD' tendencies in battle: Some die as a warning to others, while some die in a way that cannot be remembered. How should someone undeserving of death die, or someone who should die, go? Your Honor, technical work must always be executed with utmost care.'
text.zh:
随着英格丽女士在本舰待的时间越来越长，她和我们也变得熟络了起来。几个兴趣团体尝试向她发去了邀请函，但出乎所有人意料的是，英格丽女士都欣然接受了，然后几乎没有参加过……原因在于——她总是迟到。她连续错过了好几次品酒会，在几乎散场的时候才慢悠悠地赶来，不好意思地央求主办者将品酒的时间延长一个小时……我们实在很难想象英格丽女士居然是个没什么时间观念、耐心也有些“欠佳”的人。
英格丽女士再次打破我们的认知，是在她开始以“忍冬”为代号参加罗德岛的作战训练及外勤任务后。几乎每次都有同行的干员表示压力非常大，这倒不是因为曾是叙拉古家族杀手的英格丽女士有多么不合群或者手段有多么残忍，而是她……夸张的执行力让人有些无所适从。她几乎总能兑现计划书上的每一个字，时间一秒不差，细节一丝不苟，甚至连“希望目标在新一天到来的前一刻在最志得意满的时候被高空抛物砸翻”这种意外写上没来得及删掉的草稿也得以完美实现。英格丽女士像是一下子变成了一个执着于细节的强迫症患者或者完美主义者。
强烈的反差让所有人都摸不着头脑，终于在某次任务结束后，有人壮着胆子去问了问英格丽女士。她皱着眉头甩下了一句：“难道你们希望我工作的时候偷懒吗？”

【补充说明】
最近在例行整理干员资料时，偶然翻到了一份叙拉古某法院的庭审文书，上面记录了英格丽女士作为被告面对法官提问时的一些回答，或许能在“工作和生活分得很开”这个说法之外，解释她在战斗中的“强迫症”：
“有些人的死是为了给人警告，有些人的死不能被人记住，有些不该死的人该怎么死，有些该死的人该怎么死……法官大人，技术活总该有些讲究。”

text.en:
I imposed a strict ban on curious operators discussing Operator Suzuran's family composition, until I bumped into Suzuran and Ingrid myself, chatting on the landship bridge, and they stopped to greet me at the same time. They were just so alike in appearance and stature, as if they were carved from the same mold, but their temperaments were like night and day. I confess this was somewhat rude of me, but I honestly couldn't help wondering how a Siracusan assassin and a Higashinese kannushi met and formed ties.
Many stories quickly flashed through my mind, like a tale of a cold killer who, under orders to kill the shrine's master, traveled from Siracusa to Higashi, but her long blade shatters a bugaku mask to reveal the kannushi's clear eyes, stopping them both in their tracks as if entranced. Or another tale, of a gentle kannushi visiting the foot of a mountain for an event, but finding a Siracusan assassin leaning against a maple tree on a corner of his path, who—having fled a bloody battle and made it all the way to a foreign land—was now bleeding out, and the kannushi tenderly crouching down to check on her. By the time I came back to my senses, I realized I had already involuntarily opened my mouth to ask: 'Excuse me...'
Be it as a colleague or an HR operator, my actions were extremely inappropriate, but surprisingly they were not angry at me. On the contrary, Suzuran generously answered my question in a simple manner. She described her father meeting her mother as purely coincidence:
An armed force had infiltrated the area around the shrine where Suzuran's father works, and frequently caused trouble. Her father resolved to confront them alone at their stronghold to protect the innocent masses, and was on his way to the final negotiation. At the foot of the mountain, he passed by a foreign lady with a scar on her right cheek wearing a large coat. When he arrived at their stronghold, the boss was already dead in the snow, and everyone else left had already fled. A week later, the priest had gone into the city in civilian clothes to buy some chikuwa for a certain 'god' he serves, and went to the stall he usually frequented, only to see the same woman from before buying the last two sticks. He politely asked her to sell him one, and the cruel-seeming woman turned around, and gave him a stick with a smile. He bowed and thanked her for the chikuwa stick, as well as for their second meeting... and then everything else happened as it should.

Indeed, a truly normal tale. In fact, the meeting of two people from different countries, backgrounds, and personalities is precious in itself, but the choices and efforts they made afterwards—challenging the shrine taboos, ignoring the famiglia rules, and raising a child both parties have invested unfathomable emotions and expectations in—are far more worthy of respect, and have nothing to do with how strange their initial encounter may have been. I bid the two goodbye, and then Ingrid, who had been silent the whole conversation, smiled and stopped me in my tracks with this:
'As I recall, you'll be joining us in our special resistance training drill later this afternoon, yes?'
text.zh:
我严肃地制止了一些好奇心爆棚的家伙对铃兰干员家庭构成的讨论，直到我自己撞见铃兰干员和英格丽女士聊着天并肩走过廊桥，并且同时停下来和我打招呼——她们实在是过于相像，相近的身高，几乎是一个模子里刻出来的五官，但气质却截然不同——我承认这有些无礼，但我当时确实忍不住在想一位叙拉古杀手和一位东国神职是怎么相识结缘的。
我的脑子里一瞬间闪过了许多故事，比如冷酷的杀手从叙拉古远赴东国，奉命诛杀神社的主人，却在长刀击碎舞乐面具的下一刻对上了神职清澈的眸子，然后两人都像是被下了咒术一般停了下来……又比如温柔的宫司偶然去山下参加活动，却在一个转角发现了靠在枫树旁的叙拉古杀手，从血战中脱身的杀手一路逃到异乡，已经奄奄一息，宫司怜爱地蹲下身查看她的情况……等到我反应过来的时候，我发现自己已经不由自主地开了口：“请问……”
无论是作为同事，还是作为人事部干员，我的举动都是非常不得体的，但出乎意料的是，她们没有生气，相反，铃兰干员大方而简单地回答了我的疑问。在她的描述里，英格丽女士与铃兰父亲的相识其实只是一次偶然：
一股武装势力流窜进了铃兰父亲任职的神社所在的地区，频频滋事，为了保护无辜的民众，他毅然决定孤身前往对方的驻地，进行最后的交涉。在山脚下，他和一位披着大衣右脸有疤的异国女士擦肩而过，等到达那伙人的驻地时，对方的首领已经死在了雪地上，剩下的人也已经逃散。一周后，为了给自己侍奉的某位“神明”买祂爱吃的竹轮，宫司换上常服进城。在常去的小摊，排在宫司前面的女性买走了最后两份特色竹轮，他礼貌地请对方转卖一份，那位一看就不好惹的叙拉古女性转过身，笑着递了一份给他，他鞠躬道谢，既为竹轮，也为第二次相逢……那之后的事情就顺理成章了。

确实不是什么离奇的故事。其实两个不同国家、不同身份、不同性格的人相逢本身便是一种可贵的缘分，之后的选择，以及因此所需要作出的努力——挑战神社的禁忌、无视家族的规矩，以及养育一个双方都投入了无限情感和期待的孩子——更加值得尊敬，这和双方的相逢够不够离奇没有关系。我向她们二人告别，这时一直没说话的英格丽女士笑着叫住了我：
“我记得下午的特别对抗训练你也会参加，对吧？”

text.en:
[Special Letter Correspondence 03]
Sender: Fabrizio Venezia (verified as the current don of Siracusa's Famiglia Venezia)
Recipient: Rhodes Island Procurement Department
Content: My granddaughter Lisa has always been undergoing Oripathy treatment with your company, and recently her mother Ingrid has also gone to your company as well, so I hope to sponsor your research on Oripathy diagnosis and treatment in the name of Venezia Trucking Co..
Response: We specifically asked Ingrid about this, and based on her attitude have made the following reply:
'Thank you for your interest in Rhodes Island, but we cannot consider your offer due to inaccurate information provided.'

[Special Letter Correspondence 07]
Sender: Nuova Volsinii branch office, Penance
Recipient: Rhodes Island Landship
Content: Operator Penance has routinely synchronized with us on mission reports and official correspondence, which included an arrest warrant issued by the Police Department of Nuova Volsnii for Ingrid on the grounds of committing premeditated injury.
Response: We informed Ingrid about this, and surprisingly, unlike the usual famiglia member attitude towards the law, she acknowledged the warrant was real.

[Classified Log]
I'm not running or looking for a sanctuary, Doctor. Of course, I'm not going back either. There are too many 'laws' on this land, so why care about them all?
...Yes, Siracusan famiglie do not need a valid reason to end someone's life. Or rather, the usual reasons not to, like 'decency' or 'hoping everyone gets a good ending'... often hold no water there, which is why I chose to leave. But I won't take off this suit, because it's comfortable to wear; I won't abandon this blade, because it's easy to wield. It's just that Lisa doesn't need me to worry over her anymore, and her papa can solve his own problems and won't need my help for the time being. So I can indeed afford a short vacation. You're right, an assassin taking a vacation isn't a bad thing. For her, or for everyone else.
text.zh:
【特殊函件报告03】
发件人：法布里齐奥·威尼斯（经查证为叙拉古威尼斯家族现任家主）
收件人：罗德岛采购部
具体内容：我的外孙女小丽萨一直在贵司接受矿石病治疗，近日她的母亲英格丽也去到了贵司，我希望能以威尼斯载具公司的名义资助贵司在矿石病诊疗方面的研究。
处理意见：我们特意询问了英格丽女士，参考她的态度，作出如下回复——
“感谢您对罗德岛的关注，但因部分情况不属实，故不予考虑。”

【特殊函件报告07】
发件人：新沃尔西尼办事处，斥罪
收件人：罗德岛本舰
具体内容：斥罪干员例行同步了一些任务报告与公函，其中一份为新沃尔西尼警察局与法院签发的通缉令，对象为英格丽，事由为蓄意伤害罪。
处理意见：我们知会了英格丽女士，出乎意料的是，和我们常见的叙拉古家族成员对法院的态度不同，英格丽女士承认了这份通缉令的效力。

【权限记录】
我没有逃，也没有在找避风港，博士。当然了，我更不会回去。这片大地上的“法律”太多，怎么在意得过来？
……是的。在叙拉古，家族了结一个人不需要什么理由。或者说，多数时候的理由，什么“体面”“希望每一个成员都有个好结局”……其实根本不成立，所以我已经离开了那里。但我不会脱下这身衣服，因为它好穿；我也不会扔了这把刀，因为它好用。只不过，丽萨这孩子已经用不着我操心了，她的爸爸有能力解决自己的麻烦，暂时也用不着我帮忙。我确实可以闲一阵子。你说得没错，一个杀手休个假，对她自己和其他人都不是件坏事。

text.en:
'Orchid, was that Ingrid just now?'
'Yes. She wanted to borrow and needle and some thread to repair something on her own.'
'What was it?'
'The omamori hanging on her waist. She said it was accidentally punctured in Nuova Volsinii... I suppose it's important to her.'
'What's inside it? Hehe, I'm just curious...'
'It's empty.'
'Empty?'
'Maybe it had something inside before, and it got lost when it was struck open. Why so surprised? Someone like her surely knows what's important or not. Her hands were clumsy, but she mended it in one go, tied off the thread and got up to leave, stylish as ever.'
text.zh:
“梓兰小姐，刚刚那是英格丽女士？”
“是啊。她过来借针线，自己在这儿缝补好了一个破损的东西。”
“什么啊？”
“她腰上的那个御守。说是在新沃尔西尼的时候不小心被人刺破了……估计是挺重要的东西吧。”
“里面装的是？嘿嘿，我就好奇问问……”
“空的。”
“空的？”
“可能之前放了东西吧，说不定就是被刺破才丢了。那么惊讶干什么？她那样的人，还能不知道自己该在意什么？我看她手笨笨的，但是一口气缝好，绳线系好，起身走人，姿势可潇洒了。”

text.en:
A former Maylander Foundation agent, she joined Rhodes Island on the recommendations of Dr. Kal'tsit and the Doctor.
Her proficiency in fighting solo and adapting to all kinds of extreme environments has proven invaluable to our myriad covert operations.
text.zh:
前梅兰德基金会所属特工，在凯尔希医生与博士的引荐下加入罗德岛。
擅长单兵作战，并且能够应对各种极端环境，在各类隐秘行动中发挥了重大价值。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Ho'olheyak shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.11u/L
Operator Ho'olheyak has a great understanding of Originium's properties as well as how to protect herself from them, and we recommend that other operators follow her example.

In short, she's very healthy. But as for her lifespan, the Medical Department will produce a special report elaborating on the topic later.
——Warfarin
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员霍尔海雅没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.11u/L
干员霍尔海雅对源石的特性以及相关防护手段十分了解，推荐其他干员在这方面向她学习。

从结论上来说，她的身体十分健康。至于她的寿命，医疗部会专门出一篇报告阐述这个问题。
——华法琳

text.en:
My colleagues and I have been left quite perplexed by Ho'olheyak's arrival on Rhodes Island.
At this point, we're just lying to ourselves when we talk up Rhodes Island's apolitical stance. We have many contacts with close ties to government bodies from multiple countries, and some even visit the landship from time to time. She even used to be one of the Maylander Foundation's top agents, too, manipulating Columbia's gigantic shadow from within...
Even though she has technically left the organization and we've somewhat restricted her access, her background alone lets her know of their existence, and she may have already obtained some intel. This is evident from her rather contemplative expression as she flips through a list of our operators.
Furthermore, she usually applies to operate solo on most of her missions. Perhaps this is a habit from her secret agent days, but it is quite worrisome that she does not seem willing to mingle with the others, or even to adjust to life on Rhodes Island.
Of course, this could also be how she expresses her goodwill. She understands what sort of apprehensions her identity brings us, and has decided to flaunt it rather than downplay it, letting us decide how to treat her.
To be honest, she has already demonstrated her expertise in espionage despite having only joined us recently. Our intel work will definitely increase in efficiency and quality if we are to trust her. In fact, she has already shared with us a little on how the Maylander Foundation operates, which has definitely helped us somewhat, but has also left us even more confused.
Operators over at HR have formed some divisive opinions on her, and it seems like this will remain the trend for some time.
——Weekly report by HR operator D.E

Kal'tsit and I have both put much thought into the matter. Her position is much more complicated than you can imagine, but she will do fine in terms of work.
As for her relationship with Rhodes Island... we'll leave that to the Doctor.
-——A note by ■■■
text.zh:
霍尔海雅的到来给我和我身边的同事带来了不小的困惑。
事到如今，强调罗德岛在政治上的独立性多少有些掩耳盗铃，有诸多与各国政治局势密切相关的人和我们有联系，有的甚至会时不时造访本舰。而一个来自梅兰德基金会，那个在阴影中影响着哥伦比亚这个庞然大物的影子的顶级特工……
即使她在程序上已经脱离了那个组织，即使我们在情报方面对她做出了一些相应的封锁，但她的出身，已经决定了光是让她知道那些人的存在，或许有些情报已经来到了她的手上。这一点，她在翻阅干员名单时脸上露出的那种玩味表情已经足以证明。
而且，几乎所有任务她都会申请独立行动，这也许是特工生涯的习惯所致，但她完全没有表现出融入，甚至哪怕只是适应罗德岛生活的意愿，这也是令人担忧的一个方面。
当然，这或许也可以解释为她展现善意的方式。她了解自己的身份会给我们带来怎样的顾虑，与其加以掩饰，不如全盘展现，由我们去决定该如何对待她。
诚实地说，虽然才加入没多久，但她已经展现了她在特工领域的专业性，如果我们愿意信任她，那么我们的情报工作效率将得到质的提升。事实上，她甚至向我们分享了一些梅兰德基金会的工作模式，这确实给我们提供了一些帮助，但也增加了我们的困惑。
现在，人事部干员之间关于她的评价相当地两极分化，这样的情况可能还要持续一段时间。
——人事部干员D.E.周报

这件事我和凯尔希都有数。她的立场比你们所有人设想的都要复杂，在工作层面公事公办即可。
至于她和罗德岛的关系……就交给博士处理吧。
——■■■批注

text.en:
Oh? I had been wondering how to handle my interviewer while in the locker room earlier, but I didn't expect that it would be you, Doctor.
So it worries you to have someone else interview me?
Are you worried about them, or about me? Hmm?
...Hehe, forget it. Our current relationship should be enough to let us skip the more trivial questions, no?
Hm? You're asking why someone as smart as me would be seeking information on the mythical K'uk'ulkan?
Did you also try this line on our cute Elf, Doctor?
Hehe... In terms of social status in today's society, surely the resources and position I held at the Maylander Foundation were far more powerful than the 'K'uk'ulkans' who exist today only in name, yes?
Let's say we disregard authority and just focus on raw strength instead. Could a 'K'uk'ulkan' in its prime handle a few Columbian army divisions? How many seconds could we last against a laser from S.H.A.F.T.?
Me, my parents, and each and every one of my ancestors residing in my memories. How can we pretend that the very same civilization we have all lived in doesn't exist?
The fact that I can talk about this subject is proof enough that there is no actual 'curse' forcing me to act this way.
In other words, I could abandon this whenever I want, and so could my ancestors.
Then why, why oh why, did we not do so? Why did we continue the chase?
——That would be a perfectly normal response, from a bystander's point of view.
But for me? I have had this obsession lingering in my mind ever since I was born. My first word was neither Mama nor Papa, but 'K'uk'ulkan.'
So naturally, all of my childhood education was ultimately directed towards pursuing the 'K'uk'ulkan.'
This mission is always on my mind, and the most I can do is ignore it for a short while.
Do you accept it, or ignore it?
And if you do choose to accept... Can you understand how it feels to spend your oh-so-short life chasing after something, only to end up with nothing, Doctor?
Would you be willing to let it all be forgotten? Or would you pass on your mission to the next generation, and have them inherit your pain, your anger, your pursuit?
Honestly, it's more like a curse that we've put upon ourselves.
...Well, it seems like you managed to wrap your head around my words. Well, aren't you clever?
Yes, even then we should be able to ignore our mission, if we really didn't want to continue the chase.
Indeed, the main reason why 'become a K'uk'ulkan' has remained a desire until now is because of my choice to do so. Our choice.
History, to us, is a mandatory class. We have always been looking for our answer within it, and when we see through the dense fog and realize that we have been performing to no one on an imaginary stage, that modern history is surrounded by towering walls, we lose all interest in the present.
The more glorious a civilization becomes as it advances with its technology, the more enthralling our legends become to us. To soar in the skies in our majestic forms with the wind and thunder.
To us, the word 'K'uk'ulkan' means both the force of our might, and the truth of our history.
Call it superstition, habit, or just plain ignorance. I'll allow you the thought, Doctor, because I sometimes think the same.
As we continue our pursuit of 'K'uk'ulkan,' we also look for an alternative to free ourselves from our fate, but we always end up where we began.
Until Kristen said those words to me.
Let's call it a day here, Doctor. The rest... is a secret that you'll have to work hard for.
——Recording of a conversation between the Doctor and Ho'olheyak (1)
text.zh:
嗯？我在更衣室的时候还在想，要怎么应付面试官，没想到是你亲自面试我，博士。
让别的人面试不放心？
是对别的人不放心呢，还是对我不放心，嗯哼？
……呵呵，算了。以我们之间的关系，一些没有必要的问答应该也可以略过吧？
嗯？像我这样聪明的人，为什么会追求存在于传说之中的羽蛇？
你也是这样去和我们可爱的精灵搭讪的吗，博士？
……呵呵。是啊，现代社会已经发展到了如此的地步，单以社会地位而言，我在梅兰德基金会中的地位所能动用的资源，难道不比一个只是名为“羽蛇”的存在强？
即使不谈权力，单论武力，一个全盛时期的“羽蛇”，能对付哥伦比亚几个师团？在那座能量井的光芒中，“羽蛇”能坚持几秒？
我、我的父母、存在于我记忆中的一个个祖先，我们同样生活在这个文明之下，怎么可能对这些熟视无睹？
而且，我能像这样和你聊这个话题，足以证明并没有一种真的“诅咒”让我不得不去做这件事。
换言之，我是可以放弃它的，我的祖先们也是可以放弃它的。
那么，为什么、为什么我们没有这么做，为什么我们还要追求它？
——从旁观者的角度而言，这样去想理所当然。
但是，对我而言，那是从我有意识开始就在我脑海中盘桓的执念，我在出生后喊出的第一个词，不是“爸爸”或者“妈妈”，而是“羽蛇”。
而后，我在幼年时接受的所有教育，最后都指向了对于“羽蛇”的追求。
我是不可能忘记这个使命的，我最多能做到的也只是短暂地背过身去。
接受它，或者无视它。
而一旦接受它……博士，你能明白吗？你在明显比他人短暂的寿命里为了追求一个东西耗费了一生，而最终你一无所获。
你会愿意就此让一切付诸东流吗？还是将它交给你的后代，让他继承你的苦痛，你的愤怒，你的追求？
说白了，这是一种我们自己给自己施加的诅咒。
……嗯，看起来，你没有被我绕进去，真聪明。
对，即使如此，如果我们发自内心地不愿意履行这项使命，那我们应当可以无视它。
是的，“成为羽蛇”这个愿望会延续至今的根本原因，是因为这是我，是我们自己的选择。
对于我们来说，历史是必修课，我们总是在历史中寻找答案。当我们在重重迷雾中发现，现代的历史被高耸的墙壁所包围，我们只是在虚构的舞台上进行一场或许无人观赏的演出时，我们所处的当下就失去了所有的吸引力。
现代文明越是瑰丽，现代科技越是先进，那些只存在于传说中的风与雷，那些翱翔的荣耀，那些壮丽的身姿，对我们而言，只会愈发迷人。
“羽蛇”对我们而言，在意味着绝对强大的同时，意味着历史的真实。
你可以说这是迷信、惯性、愚昧的想法，博士，我允许你这么说，因为我时而也会这么想。
在追求“羽蛇”的同时，我们同样在寻找着其他能代替“羽蛇”，能让我们解放自己的道路，然而，最后我们总是会回到原点。
直到克丽斯腾对我说了那句话。
今天，就到此为止吧，博士，之后的话……可是秘密。想要知道一个人的秘密，可是要付出努力的。
——博士与霍尔海雅对话的录音①

text.en:
The K'uk'ulkans used to be one of the most powerful Elder races in Sargon. They could soar in the skies and harness the power of wind and thunder, and to this day still exist in the myths of some Sargonian tribes.
And as someone who bears such a myth on her back, her current physical condition and Originium Arts assimilation are simply stronger than most, but that's about it.
For someone like me who grew up in an environment full of lineages and glory and all that jazz, I can't say I don't understand her at all.
But those kinds of Arts are simply too much for me.
Manipulating such delicate things as memory, emotion, perception, and whatnot is no easy feat. As far as I know, only some of the oldest Sarkaz Royal Court records mention similar Arts, and they're all difficult to work with and come with some kind of absurd price to pay.
The Arts of the K'uk'ulkan are completely unrelated to those of the Sarkaz Royal Court, but rather a twisted product of some clue they found somewhere in the annals of their history.
In fact, their Elder lifespans are still longer than most people, even halved. But their lives will be forever incomplete. Did Ho'olheyak have a childhood? Will she be able to enjoy retirement?
In conclusion, it's neither a curse nor the damage to her physical body that cut half her lifespan away, but the structure of her brain has been permanently altered.
Imagine this: you're a newborn baby with a still-developing body, and someone takes the opportunity to pour a load of information into your brain so it can be passed down to the next generation, unforgotten.
To put it bluntly, it's less about the Arts themselves than the extremely inhumane brain surgery carried out with said Arts.
The one who invented this procedure was undoubtedly talented.
Ethics aside, one can probably only cast that kind of thing on an infant. There's no way to simulate it to test my theory, but I think once an infant becomes self-aware, this crude method of importing information might not only shatter their mind, but also their very being.
Such a procedure is practically unheard of, based on what I know of modern science and Originium technology.
And according to Ho'olheyak, her inherited history began more than four centuries ago. So achieving such a fantastical feat was something you could only dream of in an era when medical science wasn't a thing yet.
You'd also have to be a damned lunatic to even try it though.
The chances of a procedure like that succeeding aren't very high, and I dare not even ask how many other siblings she had. Even if there were other successes, the damage done to the infant's brain is irreversible. That's the main cause of their shortened lifespan, when as Elders should rightfully be living longer than ordinary races.
Their so-called 'legacy,' 'past glory,' and 'absolute power,' have turned their Arts into a curse on their own bloodline.
——Warfarin
text.zh:
羽蛇曾经是萨尔贡一支非常强大的神民血脉，他们能够翱翔于天空，并且使用风雷之力，在一些萨尔贡本土部族里，至今还流传着有关他们的传说。
而她作为背负着这种传说的人，现在的身体机能也好，源石技艺适应性也好，都只是比普通人强了不少而已。
作为一个在血脉啊，荣耀啊之类的废话环境中长大的人来说，我倒也不是完全不理解她。
但是，就算是这样，这法术也太超过了。
记忆、情绪、感知等等，法术如果要对这些细腻的东西造成影响是十分困难的。据我所知，只有一些最古老的王庭传承中记载了类似的法术，而且无论哪一种使用起来都非常困难，需要付出的代价也一个比一个见鬼。
他们使用的法术并不是萨卡兹王庭流传的任何一种，是不知道从什么传承里找到的线索，然后自己开发出的扭曲产物。
他们的悲惨事实上并不在于寿命本身，作为神民，他们的寿命就算打了对折，也比大部分人长得多。但是，他们的一生是不完整的。霍尔海雅有过童年吗，她能享受自己的晚年吗？
从结论上来说，导致她寿命缩短的主要原因，并不是诅咒，也不是身体机能受损，而是永久性的脑部结构变化。
想象一下，你是一个刚出生的婴儿，你的所有身体机能都还十分稚嫩，然而有人趁着这个时期将大量的信息灌入你的大脑中，为的就是让这些信息能够切实且长久地留存在你的脑海里。
说白了，这与其说是一项法术，不如说是一项借由法术进行的，极端粗暴的脑手术。
发明这项手术的人毫无疑问是一个天才。
抛开伦理因素不谈，这恐怕确实是一项只能在婴儿时期施行的法术，虽然无法模拟，但我完全可以想象，一旦婴儿建立了自我意识，那么这种粗暴的信息输入恐怕不仅会对其大脑，更会对他的人格产生粉碎性的破坏。
以我对现代科学以及源石技艺的了解来说，这种手段根本就是闻所未闻。
而据霍尔海雅自己说，她传承的历史自四百多年前开始，在那个医学根本还没有体系化的时代里，能够实现这样一项手术完全是天方夜谭。
然而在同时，他也是一个该死的疯子。
这种手术成功率并不高，我甚至不想去问她，她曾经有多少个兄弟姐妹。而即使成功，这项手术对婴儿大脑的改变是不可逆的，它是让这个本应比普通种族活得长一些的神民种族寿命打对折的罪魁祸首。
为了所谓的传承，所谓的往昔荣耀，所谓绝对的力量，这种法术成为了流转在他们血脉之中的诅咒。
——华法琳

text.en:
Ah, good evening, Doctor. Lovingly attached to your work as usual, I see.
...Hm? No, it's nothing, I only— you shared with me how it feels to have amnesia, yes?
I thought it was time we continued our previous conversation.
...Eh? Have you forgotten? If you have, I won't mind wrapping my tail around your neck to jog your memory.
Oh, yes. We stopped at 'Until Kristen.'
We believe the past holds the truth, and that truth would reveal our true future. She scoffed at our belief, stubbornly asserting that the past is worthless, but the present will lead to the future.
She pulled me into her plan, and as it was nearing completion she brought it up so casually... A life pod, I believe was its name? Anyway, she basically gave me all the data from the sarcophagi and told me, now, you can choose to lie in this sarcophagus and turn back into a 'K'uk'ulkan.' But she also asked me:
'Will it really be worth it, to sacrifice all of your people's lives just to return to the past?'
This question has come up in our history too many times to count, but it has never caused a sense of... self-doubt as it did then.
And Kristen... she only came to this conclusion after learning everything. So I had to acknowledge it.
I'm sure you know the rest, Doctor.
I escaped from the Tin Man and rushed into that underground space, witnessed the fall of 'God,' and brought whatever remained to you people.
I obtained nothing from that death that had nothing to do with me. Questions, answers, the past, the future, nothing at all.
Doctor, I've been on Rhodes Island for a while now, and I now believe that you and Kal'tsit know just as much as Kristen does.
What did you see down there underground? What did you hear, feel?
...Don't get the wrong idea now. I didn't look for you and Rhodes Island to find an answer.
The answers from the past became meaningless when I stopped pursuing the 'K'uk'ulkan.' Kristen cruelly opened the doors of truth, leaving everyone behind, and my sole stroke of luck was to find the two of you standing in front of it.
Right now I find myself inexplicably smug, but on a lone boat in the middle of a vast ocean. And you, as the only lighthouse that can guide my way.
So now, I'll give you a piece of good news and bad news.
The good news is that my lifespan will have me dying before you do.
As for the bad news, your existence will be passed down through my bloodline, and you won't be able to escape.
——Recording of a conversation between the Doctor and Ho'olheyak (2)
text.zh:
啊，博士，晚上好，你还是这样地热爱工作。
……嗯？不，没什么，只是——你向我分享了失忆的感受，不是吗？
我想，也是时候继续之前的话题了。
……咦？你不会忘了吧？如果你忘了，我不介意用尾巴缠住你的脖子，让你好好回忆一下。
嗯，对，“直到克丽斯腾”。
我们相信过去蕴含着真相，真相将揭示真正的未来，而她对此嗤之以鼻，她强硬地宣称，过去不值一提，现在同样通往未来。
她将我引入她的计划，而在计划接近完成时，她随意地将那具……维生舱？是这么叫的吗？总而言之，她将那具石棺的数据丢给了我，告诉我，现在，你可以躺进石棺，变回“羽蛇”了。同时，她问我：
“不惜牺牲全族人的寿命，只是为了回到过去……这一切真的有价值吗？”
这个问题在我们的历史中出现了无数次，但没有一次像那时一样让人……自我怀疑。
克丽斯腾……她在了解这一切的基础上，依然如此下结论。我无法对此置之不理。
后面的事情你都知道了，博士。
我挣脱了锡人的束缚并冲入那个地下空间，目睹了“神”的陨落，将残骸带给了你们。
我在那场与我无关的消亡之中没有获得任何东西，问题，答案，过去，未来，什么都没有。
博士，我来到罗德岛后已经过了一段时间，我现在相信，你和凯尔希知道的不比克丽斯腾少。
你们在那个地下空间看到了什么，听到了什么，又感受到了什么？
……别误会，我找到你们，找到你，并不是想要得到一个回答。
当我放下对“羽蛇”的追求以后，过去的答案已经失去了意义。克丽斯腾残忍地在推开了真理之门后抛弃了所有人，而我唯一的幸运，是在门前发现了你们的存在。
我现在如同冲出江河而正沾沾自喜，却发现自己置身汪洋的一叶孤舟。而你，是唯一能指引方向的灯塔。
所以，你现在有一个好消息，和一个坏消息，博士。
好消息是，我的寿命会让我早早地在你之前死去。
坏消息是，你的存在会流传在我之后的血脉之中，你逃不了的。
——博士与霍尔海雅对话的录音②

text.en:
Ho'olheyak's experience is the complete opposite of mine.
I won't say I understand her. I'm probably the least able to.
I just... if I had my kin whispering in my ears every single day, and could easily see just when my life would end, I think I wouldn't fare any better than her.
All I can say is, she has what I don't, and vice versa.
But that's not the point I'm trying to make here, Doctor.
Let's take you out of the equation, and say that she's dealing with Kal'tsit. She still acts all cold and callous as if she cares for nothing, doesn't she?
On one hand, it's true she doesn't care for most things, but on the other, she has very carefully hidden away parts of herself.
It can't go on like this, companions should be honest with each other, right?
So, I'll let you in on an exclusive scoop.
You might have heard that she can usually be found in the intel processing room when not on missions, and she really does like to hang out there. So much so that a corner of the room has practically turned into her exclusive spot.
Try sneaking in there in the middle of the night sometimes. If you're careful, you might even catch a view of her sleeping face.
——A note that randomly appeared on your desk with handwriting you recognize as Muelsyse's
text.zh:
霍尔海雅的经历和我完全相反。
我不会说我理解她，我大概是最无法理解她的人。
只是……要是我每天也被自己的同族在耳边神神道道，而且寿命又一眼能看到尽头，我觉得我的状态不会比她好到哪里去。
她拥有我没有的东西，而我也拥有她没有的东西，我只能这么说。
不过，我不是来说这个的，博士。
这个女人，别说面对你，就算是面对那个凯尔希，她也总是表现得很刻薄，好像什么都不在乎一样，不是吗？
一方面，她在乎的东西确实不多，另一方面，她也很小心地将自己的其他部分藏了起来。
这样怎么行呢，同伴之间就应该坦诚相待对吧？
那么，我就给你分享一些独家情报吧。
她平时最喜欢待在情报处理室里，你可能也听说过，执行任务之外，任何时间你都有可能在那里找到她，角落的那个位置，几乎已经变成她的专座。
你应该找个夜深人静的时候偷偷去一趟情报处理室，如果你足够小心，说不定就能看到她的睡脸。
——突然出现在你桌上的纸条，你认出是缪尔赛思的笔迹
