text.en: Ripresa, manager of a well-known orchestra in Nuova Volsinii who contacted us after observing that many with positions of power in the city have ties to Rhodes Island, in the hope of increasing exposure for her orchestra. She participates in certain field missions at her own request.
text.zh: 复奏，新沃尔西尼知名乐团的经理人，在观察到新沃尔西尼的诸多权力人物都与罗德岛有千丝万缕的关系后，主动联系罗德岛寻求商业合作，以期扩大乐团的知名度。基于本人的意愿，也会参与一部分外勤任务。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 6%
A small distribution of Originium crystals is present on Operator Ripresa's thigh.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.25u/L
Operator Ripresa contracted Originium at a young age. Her condition is currently under control.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】6%
干员复奏的大腿处可见少量源石结晶分布。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.25u/L
干员复奏幼时感染矿石病，目前病情稳定。

text.en:
Czerny had had enough. For the fourth time, Ripresa had given him a new tape after her piano lesson.
The first, a piano etude, could be justified as homework, but the next was a trombone solo, followed by an oboe and bassoon duet. This one was apparently the percussion section from a symphony movement. Ripresa was a motivated student, a quick study, and diligent with her practice. Other students in the studio said she must be a huge fan of Professor Czerny, and at one point Czerny would have agreed.
'Did you need something from me, Frau Liesel?'
'Oh, um... I've always been very interested in your compositional style...'
'That's not what I'm talking about. You've taken enough of my lessons to be familiar with my style, and I've heard enough of your tapes to get a feel for them. I must certainly compliment you on your choice of repertoire. Now, what do you want from me?'
Ripresa blinked for a few seconds before taking out a few video tapes from her bag.
'Well, Maestro Czerny, these are recordings of the Schwarzervorhang Orchestra's performances, a small chamber orchestra of around twenty members that I currently direct...'
Ripresa's description gave Czerny food for thought. He recalled his most recent schedule to check whether he had time to make a trip to Nuova Volsinii. A Leithanian orchestra? What sort of chemistry could he form with them as a pianist? Czerny cleared his throat, interrupting Ripresa's monologue.
'I would be happy to work with your orchestra—'
'Really?! Thank you! About the composition's style—our members agreed that we would prefer a hopeful work to a melancholic one. With Maestro Czerny writing it, I'm sure our performance will deliver hope to our listeners' hearts!'
'...Composition?'
Czerny swallowed the words 'performing as a pianist' as Ripresa continued to describe her request. Her ideas for the new composition were very specific, and the recordings were sufficiently vivid that a melody gradually took form in his mind as she spoke.

Czerny's new work was unsurprisingly a massive hit in Nuova Volsinii at its premiere by the Schwarzervorhang Orchestra. We deliberated on whether to tell Ripresa that she could simply come forward with any requests she has, without resorting to her old negotiation tactics from Nuova Volsinii. But she seems to enjoy the process very much. Perhaps it is not such a bad thing after all, to let her do things her way.
text.zh:
这是复奏第四次在钢琴课之后将新的录音带交到自己手上，车尔尼终于忍不住了。
第一次的录音带还算是课后作业，是一段钢琴练习曲，但之后录音带的内容却是长号的独奏、双簧管和低音管的配合，这次据说是整个打击乐组在某个乐章中的组合演奏。复奏在课堂上表现非常积极，对待提问总是能举一反三，练习也很刻苦，钢琴班上的其他同学提到她时，总是说，她一定是车尔尼老师的头号粉丝。车尔尼本人也一度这样以为。
“莉泽尔同学，你是不是有事？”
“呃，我……我是一直都对老师您的创作方法很感兴趣……”
“我不是说这些。上了我这么多节课，想必我的风格你已经很清楚了。你带来给我听的录音带的演奏特色我现在也了解了，呵，不得不说，你选的曲目也非常有趣。说吧，你到底想要我做什么？”
复奏愣了几秒，然后从随身的包里拿出几盘录像带。
“车尔尼老师，这些都是黑绒幕乐团的演出实录，我们是一个不到二十人的小型交响乐团，目前由我担任指挥……”
听着复奏的介绍，车尔尼若有所思，他想到近期的日程安排，想着自己是否有时间去新沃尔西尼一趟。莱塔尼亚人的乐团吗？不知道自己作为钢琴演奏家，与对方能够碰出怎样的火花。复奏仍在长篇大论，车尔尼却清了清嗓子。
“我可以和你们乐团合作——”
“欸！真的吗？！谢谢车尔尼老师！对了，关于新曲的风格，我们乐团一致认为，比起忧郁的乐曲，还是充满希望的曲子更合适！有车尔尼老师为我们作曲，这种希望一定能经由我们的演奏传递到听众的心里的！”
“……新曲？”
车尔尼一时语塞，将自己还没说出口的“以嘉宾的身份负责你们乐团的钢琴演奏”生生咽了回去。复奏继续说着她的请求和畅想。她想要的新曲子非常具体，那些录音带的特色又足够鲜明，渐渐地，车尔尼脑中开始有新的旋律产生。

后来，车尔尼给了黑绒幕乐团一首量身定制的乐曲，毫不意外地，新曲的演出在新沃尔西尼大获成功。事后我们也考虑过，是否需要告诉干员复奏，在罗德岛，彼此都是同事，有什么请求可以直接提出，不必再用她在新沃尔西尼谈合作的老方法。但干员复奏在做类似的事情时总是表现得很有活力，甚至乐在其中。也许，就按她的老方法来，也没什么不好。

text.en:
Certain strange rumors came to our attention as HR performed its background check on Operator Ripresa. When we inquired with Operator Bellone on this, he simply smiled and said, 'She's good to her famiglia.'
The theater that the Schwarzervorhang Orchestra had partnered with was closed for investigation following the murder of the musician Paola Memminger, forcing the orchestra to seek out other venues in Nuova Volsinii.
Their agreement with the new theater was initially only a temporary lease, but extra costs were incurred as rehearsals intensified, which were borne by the venue under the rental agreement. Meanwhile, the orchestra would have difficulty finding a new venue on short notice if the agreement were terminated, locking the two parties in a stalemate.
Rather than avoid the issue, Ripresa set about reviewing rehearsal records and expenses incurred, putting together a list of the extra costs and incorporating them into their budget in her capacity as the orchestra's representative. It was not an easy decision for an orchestra in transition, and Ripresa had to redistribute a budget that was already tight to begin with, incurring additional risks in the process, but she decided to take on the expense knowing that the orchestra risked more than monetary loss if the partnership were terminated.
In interviews, HR learned that the venue was surprised by her decision.
It kept the partnership intact, and the two sides began negotiations on future billing and usage. While a stable long-term partnership is as yet uncertain, the pressing issues have been resolved without escalation, as Ripresa has consistently done in any matter involving the orchestra's interests.
At the end of the investigation, we were still unable to clearly define her actions. She did not seem to be trying to expand her influence, but rather appeared to take on responsibility for any issue as a matter of habit, acting less like a representative and more like a...
'That petite Caprinae resolved the conflict between the vicious foreigners and our famiglia like the Godmother!'
While inputting the data, the investigator could not help but recall certain rumors from the early stages of the investigation.
text.zh:
当人事部干员在对干员复奏进行背调时，有些略显奇怪的传闻甚嚣尘上。我们就此事向干员贝洛内询问，他只是微微一笑，留下一句“她对她的家人很好”，便离开了。
音乐家葆拉·梅明格遇害后，黑绒幕乐团原本长期合作的剧场被封锁调查。为确保排练与演出进度，乐团不得不临时租用新沃尔西尼城内的其他场所，尝试建立新的合作关系。
与新剧场的合作最初仅限于临时租用，然而随着排练强度提升，过程中产生了各种额外的成本。继续按临时租用处理，意味着损耗只能由场地方自行承担；而一旦中止合作，乐团在短时间内也难以找到条件相当的替代场地。双方因此陷入僵持。
复奏没有回避这些已有的问题。她逐一核对排练记录与费用清单，将所有额外成本明确列出，并以乐团负责人的身份主动将其纳入乐团的结算范围。这一决定并不轻松。对于正处于动荡期的乐团而言，额外支出意味着复奏需要重新分配本就紧张的预算，也意味着她必须为此承担风险。但复奏仍然选择将代价从场地方手中收回——一旦合作在此时破裂，乐团所要承受的将远不止账面上的损失。
人事部干员在事后走访中得知，场地方对复奏的这一决定也颇感意外。
这一处理方式让合作得以维系，双方开始重新商讨费用与使用安排。即便最终是否会形成稳定的长期合作尚不可知，但至少，眼下的问题被妥善解决，没有进一步演变为冲突——正如其他所有涉及复奏及其乐团利益的问题一样。
调查的最后，我们依旧无法为复奏的行为下一个明确的定义，她似乎并非在扩张影响力，而是习惯站在所有人前面，把现有的麻烦挡下来。这不像是单纯的负责人，更像是……
“那个小小的卡普里尼就像教母一样，调停了凶恶的外国人和我们家族之间的争斗！”
负责背调的人事部干员在录入这些信息后，不禁想到在调查初期就听到的这句传闻。

text.en:
One consistent theme from our interviews with members of the Schwarzervorhang Orchestra was that many of them had begun to identify themselves as Nuova Volsinians, or more specifically as 'members of the Schwarzervorhang Orchestra of Nuova Volsinii'.
Most of them came to Siracusa as exiles from Leithanien, harboring both bitterness towards Leithanien and wariness towards Siracusa. They struggled in Siracusa's cities despite their talents in music and Arts, and many even gave up on music. After all, music that was rejected by Leithanien would not necessarily fare much better in Siracusa. It was only when Paola Memminger brought them together that they finally found their home.
After her death, the members faced uncertainty about more than just personnel or venue, but also about their own futures. They mentioned that, for the first time, they were faced with the reality that without a steady anchor holding it all together, they could dissolve and scatter at any moment. Leaving was always a realistic option.
Things changed when Ripresa took over.
She did not attempt to define the orchestra's identity, nor did she emphasize to its members what they ought to represent. She simply performed the duties that seemed mundane, but were very important: ensuring that rehearsals continued on schedule, checking the details of their rental agreements with venues, and making contingency plans to avoid potential conflict. As things began to settle down, something changed subtly in the mentality of the members, nudging them towards putting down roots in the city. The members offered various answers when we asked the reason, but they all pointed to the same thing: Liesel was here, and she would conduct them tomorrow.
Notably, this shift in identity did not come from any clear gesture of acceptance by the city, but from the orchestra itself. For its members, 'Schwarzervorhang' was no longer just a collection of musicians, but a community they lived in, one in which they did not have to explain where they came from, nor constantly prepare for where to go next.
For what was perhaps the first time since they left Leithanien, the people who came together because of Paola had a home, one that they did not need to check on constantly, and one that was not easily lost. All thanks to the leadership of Paola's foster daughter.
text.zh:
在我们对黑绒幕乐团的走访中，乐团成员们多次表达了一种类似的感受：很多人都有了自己是“新沃尔西尼人”的实感，或者说，是“新沃尔西尼的黑绒幕成员”的实感。
他们中的大多数都是早年从莱塔尼亚流亡至叙拉古的，提到莱塔尼亚其回忆多是苦涩的，对叙拉古也始终保持着一种谨慎的态度，即使有音乐或源石技艺上的特长，他们在叙拉古各个城市中的生活也并不如意，其中有很多人甚至曾经放弃过音乐，毕竟，不被莱塔尼亚所接受的乐章，并不意味着就能在叙拉古顺利生长。直到因葆拉·梅明格而聚到一起，他们似乎才有了能够短暂落脚的容身之处。
然而在葆拉去世后，乐团面临的不只是人员与场地的动荡，也包括对自身去向的重新审视。据成员们回忆，那段时间，他们第一次清晰地意识到，失去了稳定的依托，他们随时可能各自散去。对他们而言，“离开”始终是一个现实选项。
变化出现在复奏接手全部事务之后。
她并未试图为乐团定义某种身份，也没有向成员们强调他们应当代表什么，她只是持续推进一些看似琐碎却关键的工作：确保排练不被临时取消，与场地方反复确认使用细节，提前做好预案规避潜在的冲突。随着这些安排逐渐落实，成员们的心理发生了细微变化——一种更趋向于扎根的变化。当我们询问产生这种变化的原因时，成员们的回答并不统一，却都指向同一点：莉泽尔在这里，莉泽尔会指挥他们明天的演奏。
值得注意的是，这种“新沃尔西尼人”的实感，并非来自城市的明确接纳，而是因为乐团本身。对成员们而言，“黑绒幕”不再只是一个聚集演奏者的组织，而是一个可以容纳生活的集体。在这个集体之中，他们不必反复说明来处，也不必随时为未来的去向做准备。
因葆拉而聚到一起的人们，如今在她养女的带领下——这或许是第一次——在离开莱塔尼亚之后，真正拥有了一个无需反复确认，也不会轻易失去的“家”。

text.en:
'I was sitting in the gallery when the Caprinae who killed Mama Paola was sentenced by Judge Lavinia. He stood there with an impassive expression and freely admitted his crime. To him, she was a stranger—no more than a symbol, one that was incompatible with the narrative he believed in. For a long time after the trial, I had a hard time accepting the whole thing.
'She never preached sedition the way the killer said she did. She didn't gather us to oppose anything. From the beginning, all she told me and the other members was that we should tell the truth, not be afraid, and enjoy the music we love... I just don't understand how it turned out this way. I don't understand, so I need to do something.
'Revenge? Oh, not at all! The case is closed, and the culprit has received his punishment. The other members are all of the same mind on this. What I feel I must do is... well, maybe it's an impulsive act, but I feel like Mama Paola did nothing wrong, nor did anybody in the orchestra. I don't want anyone to have to change their way of life just because someone else doesn't like it. We'll continue to live this way. In fact, we'll live even freer and let the Leithanians suffer on their own. We'll play the music we want to play, and only the music we want to play.
If you ask me whether I have a grudge against the killer... he took my mother from me and hurt my family. Of course I have a grudge. But I won't let him or people like him ruin my life. I think that's what she would have wanted.'

[Classified Log]
Grimmacht's voice is silent. The shadow of Gaul appears in the clouds. Ewigegnade is cleansing Leithanien of all disharmony, and her iron fists reach beyond the borders of Leithanien. Rhodes Island must be vigilant, and consider its next move carefully.
text.zh:
“那个杀害了葆拉妈妈的卡普里尼最后被拉维妮娅大法官判了刑。当时我坐在旁听席，看到那个男人只是面无表情地站着，对所有罪行供认不讳。即便对他而言，葆拉妈妈只是一个陌生人，甚至只是一个符号，一个不容于他所信仰的叙事的符号，审判结束之后的很长一段时间里，我仍觉得整件事都非常荒谬，我难以接受。
“葆拉妈妈并不像犯人说的那样，在宣扬什么大逆不道的想法——她从没将我们集结起来去反对过什么。葆拉妈妈从始至终告诉我、告诉其他乐团成员的，都是大家要说真话，不要害怕，然后享受音乐，享受自己喜欢的音乐。我不明白……为什么事情会变成这样。我不明白，所以我必须去做些什么。
“报仇？啊，不是的！案子已经结了，凶手也得到了应有的惩罚，在这一点上，乐团成员们的想法和我是一致的。我想的‘必须去做些什么’，其实……可能也只是一种赌气啦。我觉得葆拉妈妈没有做错什么，乐团里的大家也没有错，我才不会因为有人看不惯就让大家改掉现在的生活方式，我们偏要这样过，还要过得更自在。让莱塔尼亚的那些人难受去吧，我们偏要演奏我们自己喜欢的乐曲，只演奏我们喜欢的乐曲！
“如果你问的是我恨不恨那个凶手……他夺走了我最爱的妈妈，伤害了我的家人们的感情，我当然恨他，但是……我不会让他，或是和他类似的人，毁掉我的生活。我想，葆拉妈妈应该也是这样希望的吧。”

【权限记录】
赫琳玛特不再发出声音，高卢的幻影出现在云层之中，伊维格娜德独掌大权，着手清除莱塔尼亚的不和谐之音，她的高压甚至已经蔓延到了莱塔尼亚境外，在这种局势下，罗德岛必须谨慎思考相应的下一步动作。

text.en:
Maestro Czerny,
I hope this letter finds you well.
I apologize for not being able to visit you personally, as I have been busy with the Schwarzervorhang Orchestra's performances lately. I am writing today to share with you some changes that have happened recently, and ask something of you.
Yesterday, I ran into a Caprinae at the end of her wits holding an instrument case, saying that she came from Leithanien to Nuova Volsinii, just like the other members that Mama Paola recruited. I didn't understand a lot of what she said, but I feel there must be many people like Mama Paola who couldn't play the music they wanted to back home. This woman really loved the piece you wrote for us, and so I asked her to stay as second violist.
You may have already guessed what I want to ask... We already have a violist, but I wanted her to stay, and to give her a place in that piece that belongs to her.
I know you wrote it for our particular orchestra, which is why I didn't want her to just play in unison with the other violist—it would make her feel redundant, not to mention that the performance would deviate from your original concept. I want the composition to truly respond to her, just as it did for the others, but I'm not Mama Paola, and I'm still learning the art of composition.
So I would like to ask if you could make some arrangements to the piece, so that the second violist has a distinct and unique significance. Whether it be the voicing, the structure, or anything else you see fit, I am willing to put my full faith in whatever you decide.
Actually, she doesn't yet know that we're inviting her to stay... I was shadowing her before writing this letter, and I saw her go to a music store to ask about selling her instrument. Please, I don't want her to give up music! I'll try to get her to perform with us until you write back.
I look forward to your reply!
Liesel
text.zh:
亲爱的车尔尼老师：
希望您一切都好。
原谅我忙于黑绒幕乐团近期演出无法当面向您问候。这次写信给您，是想和您分享最近发生在乐团里的小变化，并向您提出一个请求。
像葆拉妈妈之前遇到乐团里的叔叔阿姨们一样，昨天，我也遇到了一个拎着乐器箱走投无路的卡普里尼。她说她也是从莱塔尼亚来到新沃尔西尼的，她说的很多事我都不太懂，我想，也许还有很多人和葆拉妈妈一样，在自己的家乡无法演奏自己喜欢的乐曲吧。老师您先前为我们乐团写的那首曲子，她听完我们的排练之后，表示非常喜欢！所以我决定让她留下来，作为第二位中提琴手加入黑绒幕乐团。
写到这里，您应该已经察觉到我的请求了吧……是的，中提琴声部原本并不缺人，但我还是希望她能留下来，我想为她在那首作品中留出一个真正属于她的位置。
那首曲子是您为我们乐团写的，这一点我始终记得，也正因如此，我不太愿意只是让她和另一位中提琴手简单地合奏——那样的话，她的存在会显得有些勉强，整体表现也不符合您原先的创作理念。我更希望她能像乐团里的其他人一样，被这首作品真切地回应一次。但您也知道，我没有葆拉妈妈那么厉害，作曲方面的知识我还在学习……
所以，我冒昧地请求您，能否帮我们改一改这首曲子，让第二位中提琴手在乐曲中拥有清楚而独特的意义。无论是修改声部分配、曲式结构，还是在任何您认为合适的其他方面进行调整，我都完全信任您的判断，并安心地将这件事托付于您。
其实她还不知道我和乐团成员决定留住她这件事。写信之前，我偷偷跟着她，看到她去了乐器行，咨询出售二手琴的事情……车尔尼老师，拜托了！我好怕她放弃音乐！在您回信之前我会先想办法让她和我们一起演出的！
期待您的回信！
莉泽尔

text.en:
Proviso left a deep impression on our HR operators the day she reported in. After all, not many new hires take the time to review each and every word in their contract, and then go on to lament with an extremely disappointed and slightly complimentary tone, 'I couldn't find any mistakes...'
Even before her arrival, the HR Department was already hesitant about hiring Ms. Deszcz, now known as Operator Proviso, after reviewing her resume and conducting a routine background check.
Proviso previously worked as a lawyer at the Longrein Law Firm, Kazimierz's top firm, in both litigation and non-litigation. She's had an impressive track record over the years, with a considerable number of cases under her belt and an unbroken streak of victories in the courtroom. When we reviewed the relevant case records, we found that Operator Proviso was never concerned with whether the results were just or not. She focused solely on earning victory for her clients, and there were many questionable aspects in the way she handled her cases.
Even though we can find no flaw in her abilities, we were concerned whether a lawyer with her values would fulfill our requirements.
Operator Proviso provided detailed answers to all of our questions. She assured us that her previous affairs had been wrapped up and would not create a conflict of interest. In addition, she mentioned she was very interested in our actions during the Major. That is also the reason she chose to join Rhodes Island: it seemed to be a company that was actually trying to do good. And she chose to give up her old job because, as she put it, she 'saw the stars.'
text.zh:
在报到那一天，但书干员给几位人事部干员留下了很深的印象，毕竟很少有干员在入职第一天就坐在桌前，用充满批判性的目光细细审视需要签字的合同，并在阅读过后以一种带有很多可惜和一丝丝赞赏的语气表示：“没找到什么错呢……”
而在此前，我们收到但书干员的简历，例行背景调查时，人事部干员对于是否接受黛丝特小姐，也就是现在的但书干员十分犹豫。
但书干员此前就职于卡西米尔顶尖的精英律所——长缰律所，有过非诉讼律师和诉讼律师的工作经验，在工作这几年内经手案子数量相当可观，拥有辩护不败的惊人战绩。我们在查阅相关案情报告时，发现但书干员对待交到她手上的案件，往往不会在意结果正义与否，完全只是为了辩护人能获得最终胜利而行动，具体的办案手段也多有暧昧不明之处。
对于罗德岛来说，她的能力自然无可指摘，但我们在意的是这样一位律师，她的本性是否符合我们的要求。
但书干员对我们的提问回答得十分详细，她说自己已经处理好了之前的所有事务，不会对罗德岛造成影响，并且她提出，她对罗德岛在特锦赛期间做的事十分感兴趣，这也是她最终选择罗德岛的理由：一家似乎真的在做点什么好事的稀有公司。而她放弃原有工作的原因，则是“看了一次星星”。

text.en: Many young people find it difficult to adjust during the transition from student to employee, and Proviso was no exception. When she worked her first case as a fresh lawyer, her mentor asked if she wanted to win. When she answered affirmatively, she was told that they would hide a key piece of evidence until the hearing was halfway through. She was then to claim that 'the inspection agency has just finished analyzing the data,' at which point her mentor would enter the courtroom and deliver the new piece of evidence: a repaired recording of a conversation. With it, Proviso was able to discredit the witness's testimony and place responsibility on the secretary, who had been blinded by the huge amount of money involved. He was found guilty and sentenced to prison. 'A beautiful first win.' That's what everyone at the law firm said about her performance. Later, while in prison, the secretary was apparently able to suddenly prove his innocence. Supposedly, it was done with a note written in his own blood. His mother is said to have committed suicide not long after. Proviso had heard many of these alleged events. At the time, she was responsible for helping a high-ranking executive clear himself of bribery charges, and among his many transactions, one of the most frequent recipients was the secretary's superior. She realized at that point that there may have been more to her first case, so she suggested to her mentor that they should get the case retried. But her mentor simply sat behind his desk and looked at her coldly without saying a word. She remembered that when she was still a student filled with admiration, she would head to the courtroom to watch him work. Even though he was the executive defendant's defense attorney, he argued for the staff member plaintiff, and in the end bowed deeply to everyone in the stands. 'Whatever is necessary to uphold justice,' he said at the time. Proviso said nothing more. She did absolutely everything she could to get the executive's charges thrown out, and earned a huge sum of money. Later, she anonymously sent the full amount to the prisoner's wife and never again brought it up again.
text.zh:
从“学生”到“职场人”的身份转变，对于大多数年轻人来说都不是一件容易的事，但书也并不例外。
新手律师的第一案，带但书的前辈问她想不想赢，在得到肯定的回答后，前辈告诉但书，隐瞒一件关键证物，直到庭审进行到一半时，但书再声称“检测机构刚分析出数据”，前辈则会从场外为她递上这份证据——一份被修复好的对话录音。她依此成功地推翻了对方证人提出的证词，并把主要责任锁定在了看到巨额钱款的秘书身上，秘书当庭被宣判罪名并认罪入狱。
“一场华丽的首战大捷”，律所的所有人都这样评价。
后来，据说那位秘书在狱中突然推翻了自己之前承认的所有罪名，据说他用血书证明自己的清白，据说他的母亲没多久就自杀了。但书在很久以后听到了这些“据说”，那时她正在负责帮一位高层董事推翻关于他受贿的指控，董事的资金往来中多条付款记录的收款人，正是那位秘书的上司。她敏锐地察觉到，她的第一案必定还有她没有发现的事情，她向前辈提出重审当年的案件。
但前辈只是坐在桌后，冷冷地看着她，一言不发。
她想起自己还是学生时，充满憧憬地去旁观前辈的庭审现场。那时前辈明明是被告董事的辩护律师，却处处为原告职员说话，在最后他深深地向旁观席鞠躬，“护卫公正”，前辈那时说。
但书没有再多说什么，她拼尽全力帮董事推翻了所有指控，得到了大笔报酬。她匿名把这些钱偷偷寄给了犯人的妻子，然后再也没有提过这件事。

text.en:
'The ice-cold Mr. Młynar.' That's what Proviso always calls Operator Młynar. However, she often tells us that he isn't actually as cold and indifferent as he seems, and in fact they had a short conversation when they first met.
They had run into each other by chance on their way to Twierdza, and while crossing a simple wooden bridge on the way to the village they came across an old man carrying heavy firewood on his back. As the old man slowly made his way to the other side of the bridge, Proviso stretched her ankles and looked around for a place to rest. She quietly said to herself, 'I wonder how much he'll make from that bundle of firewood?'
Proviso said she kept zoning out afterwards. A few days prior, she had just won a case for a certain executive and received a huge sum of money for her services. She knew she had seen plenty of things she shouldn't have while collecting evidence, and her payment was greater than previously agreed on. In other words, she was being paid to keep her mouth shut, and she had assured her discretion. However, after celebrating at a pub, and despite the security features installed in her home, she returned to find a torn business suit hung from the ceiling. She panicked, but also felt a bit relieved, as it meant that was as far as the executive's threat went. At the very least, it was her clothes hanging from the ceiling, not her. She had already experienced similar incidents more than a dozen times, and so when she looked over the rural landscape on the way to Twierdza, all she had on her mind was whether she should purchase a home there to lay low, and how she would have to change the wording in her contracts to keep anyone from finding it.
Proviso paused for a moment, then continued to talk about her journey.
As she was zoning out, she paid little attention to the question she had posed on a whim, but after a brief silence, Młynar suddenly gave her a number. Proviso said she was flabbergasted. She could only see his fed up, sorrowful expression after he spoke, and did not understand why he would suddenly answer her question. But after the day's work, she spotted a man in the fields. It was the same old man, having finally traversed the endless rural paths and made it back to his village before dark. He had a small amount of change in his hands, worth roughly the same as the number Młynar gave her.
She was holding her terminal in her hand at the time, and just about to answer a phone call from her employer, yet for whatever reason, she did not press the button to pick up the call until the old man had slowly gone back inside his home. According to Proviso, she shuddered when she heard the voice on the other end of the line.
text.zh:
“那位冷冰冰的玛恩纳先生”，但书小姐总是这样称呼玛恩纳干员，但她也时常和我们讲，玛恩纳先生其实并不如他表面上那般冷漠，他们两人在接触之初，曾有过一次小小的对话。
那时他们偶然相遇，随后在一同前往垒石村的路上，唯一能让他们继续前进的简陋木桥上正走着一位背着沉重柴火的老人，老人一步一步缓慢挪向另一边时，但书为了休息正在活动脚腕四处张望，她自言自语地说，不知道老人所背的这一捆柴火能赚到多少赫勒。
但书说随后她就继续走神，她前几日刚为某位董事打赢了官司，因此也收到了一笔丰厚的酬金。她知道自己在搜集证据时看到了不少原本不该看的，这笔钱的金额超出了原定数目，意义就在于要她闭嘴，但书表示了自己会守口如瓶。但在从酒吧庆祝完回家后，她在自己安保齐备的住所里，看到了一件被撕裂并吊起来的律师服。她有些惊慌，但又有些庆幸，这说明董事们的威胁到此为止，起码自己并不是那件被悬挂起来的律师服。而这样的事，她已经经历过十数回，以至于刚刚看到田野风光，她想的都是自己要不要在这里买一套房子作为最后的藏身之地，以及在合同上如何让做文章才能让人查不到这里。
但书顿了顿，然后继续描述着她前往垒石村时的事。
她由于走神并没有在意自己随口提出的问题，但在一阵沉默后，玛恩纳突然开口报出了一个数字。但书说她当时很诧异，她只看到了玛恩纳回答完后变得厌烦和悲哀的表情，也并不理解为何玛恩纳会突然回答这个问题。但在做完白天的工作后，她在农田里看到了一个身影：那位老人终于走完了漫长的田间小路，在天黑透时回到了村庄，他的手里捏着一点点零碎的钱，数目与玛恩纳当时报出的数字不差分毫。
那时她拿着终端正准备接听从公司打来的电话，却不知道为什么直到看着老人慢慢地走回了他的家，自己才终于按下那个通话键。但书说，在听到对接人的声音从终端那头传来时，她打了一个冷战。

text.en: A 'letter of intent' instead of a 'services agreement,' incomplete bidding documents, and no thorough assessment of the workload... You have all these mistakes laid out in front of me, but won't let me seek damages. That just makes me sad, you know? Yes, I understand. A few other lawyers have already told me about Rhodes Island's standards. But it is a serious error for a commercial corporation not to closely review the contracts it signs. As Rhodes Island's lawyer, I'm on your side, of course. But what if I worked for a company we were fighting in court? Naturally, it'd be to my benefit to sniff out every mistake Rhodes Island has ever made—who's to say what would happen if I actually filed a lawsuit? Yes, I'm a lawyer. But I'm just a lawyer. If both sides present strong evidence in their favor, the side whose evidence is lacking will lose. The law is just that straightforward. My beliefs? What about my beliefs? Hey! Take a closer look at these lawsuits. These companies aren't the good guys you're making them out to be. This one had news break out a couple years ago about them abusing their Infected employees, while this one once fired a huge number of company veterans. And this one. I have proof that they've covered up their workers' deaths. Now that I'm working for Rhodes Island, of course I know what it is you guys are trying to do— Besides, the new Infected laws they introduced these past few years are riddled with holes. Compared to all the commercial laws everyone's poured over for ages, and come up with countless interpretations for every single word, this couldn't be any easier! That's why you have to trust me, and I'll do my best to help you within the bounds of what you'll allow. How about it? Can you let me give it a try? I'll hit 'em right where it hurts: the bank account!
text.zh:
意向书而并非承诺合同、招标文件不完备、未对工程量做精准核算，如果这么多漏洞摆在我面前，却不让我提出索赔，我可是会很伤心的哦。
我知道你说的意思，其他几位律师也和我讲了罗德岛的标准，但是，身为商业公司却没有仔细审查自己签署的合同，原本就是一种很严重的失误。我身为罗德岛的律师，自然是站在罗德岛这边。
您问要是我是对方公司的律师？
那自然是为了对方的利益而揪出罗德岛的失误了——如果我真的要提起诉讼的话，结果可说不定哦？
嗯，我是律师啊。
但我也不过是个律师啦，两边各自拿出对自己有力的证据，哪方不足，哪方就会输，法律就是这么直截了当。
我信的是什么？
……喂！
仔细看看呀，我现在提交的这几份诉讼，里面的公司可不是您说的那些好家伙：这家早几年就爆出了虐待感染者员工的新闻，这家曾经清理辞退过大量老员工，还有这家，我收集到了他们压下的工人死亡的证据。
我现在既然就在罗德岛工作，自然知道你们想做的是什么——更何况，与感染者相关的法律只有近几年才新出台的几部，里面有太多不完善的地方，比起那些已经被人们研究到每个字眼都有无数种解释的商法来说，不知道简单到哪里去了！
所以，请相信我，我会尽我所能，在你们允许的范围内帮助你们的。
怎么样，要不要让我试试看？
我可是能狠狠地问他们要一笔哦！

text.en:
After a round of mediation, the self-satisfied client leans back into the sofa, swirls the wine in his glass, and asks the lawyer in front of him, 'Miss Deszcz, with someone like you on our side, it's like the law is our own personal protective talisman.'
He waits for a compliment.
'Maybe you should off that director and take over the company, then?
'You aren't going to tell me you don't have the heart to, are you? You just swallowed an entire business, and I'm sure we'll be seeing the shriveled faces of plenty of bankrupt executives on the news tomorrow morning.'
The client is flabbergasted.
'What I'm saying is the law ensures that this is the best you can manage.' Deszcz swirls the wine in her glass as well. 'Perhaps this might offend you, but at the very least, you have to take into consideration that the law exists, no?'
'This way, at least their lawyers can earn them some damages for them to survive on. The law helps you win, it keeps them alive, and the worst case scenario doesn't come to pass.
'What's more, I make loads of money every step of the way.'
text.zh:
在一次调解结束后，志得意满的委托人把自己的背靠向柔软的沙发靠垫，摇晃着杯中的红酒，问眼前的律师：“黛丝特小姐，有您这样的人在，法律不就是我们的护身符吗？”
委托人等着一些恭维之辞。
“那您为什么不干脆杀了那位大董事，直接把公司抢过来？
“总不是因为不忍心吧。您可是刚刚吞下了整个产业，估计明早的新闻，会登满董事们破产后干瘪憔悴的脸。”
委托人很是诧异。
“法律意味着您只能做到现在这样。”黛丝特晃了晃红酒杯，“或许有些冒犯哦，但，您起码会顾及法律的存在，不是吗？”
“这样，至少，至少，他们的律师也能为他们争取到一笔能活下去的赔偿款。法律能帮您获利，也能为他们保命，所有事都不至于走向最坏的那一步。
“而且，我也能赚到一大笔钱哦。”

value.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

text.en: Enforcer, citizen of Laterano, entitled to the privileges listed in Clauses 1 through 13 of the Laterano Constitution, is an executor of the Notarial Hall who just passed his training term. During the Summit of Nations, he was involved in riots caused by heretics. Following the incident's conclusion, he was recommended by Operator Executor. In accordance to an agreement between Rhodes Island and the Notarial Hall, he now assists Rhodes Island as a specialist operator.
text.zh: 见行者，拉特兰公民，适用于拉特兰一至十三项公民权益，刚通过实训期的公证所执行者。于万国峰会期间被卷入异端团体引发的骚乱之中，事件结束后，经由干员送葬人引荐，依据罗德岛与公证所相关协议，现作为特种干员为罗德岛提供协助。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, the operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Enforcer shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L
Operator Enforcer rarely comes into contact with Originium, but consumes coffee in excess. Moderation is encouraged.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员见行者没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.12u/L
干员见行者甚少接触源石，不过咖啡有点接触得太多了，应注意适量饮用。

text.en:
Operator Enforcer, real name Ezell Pastore, quickly won over everyone's hearts shortly after arriving at Rhodes Island thanks to his gentle, friendly demeanor and helpful attitude. It is hard to imagine that Executor and Enforcer, both executors from the same Laterano Notarial Hall, have such dramatically different ways of handling people and situations. From this, we can infer that Laterano may have various ways of protecting their citizens' civil rights. Enforcer prefers a more diplomatic approach of listening and mediation, rather than resolving disputes through physical means. He tries to fully understand the intentions and arguments of all parties, before finally resolving the conflict by finding a solution everyone can accept.
However, this does not mean that Enforcer is incapable of fighting—far from it. During his operator exam, Enforcer displayed stunning combat prowess, particularly in close-quarters. Though he may lack experience in emergency situations, as far as his skills are concerned, he is very likely more than capable of dragging everyone to the negotiation table, one way or another.
Great, the Notarial Hall even has enforcers like him! The kid even offered to help me whip up a cup of coffee!
—Closure
text.zh:
干员见行者，本名艾泽尔·帕斯托莱，在成为罗德岛合作干员后，很快就凭借他温和友善的态度和乐于助人的作风赢得了大家的喜爱。很难想象，同为拉特兰公证所的执行者，见行者和送葬人的性格反差会如此之大，待人接物的方式会如此迥然。由此可以推断，拉特兰维护自己公民权益的方式恐怕也是多种多样的。相比于直接通过物理手段解决纷争，见行者更擅长倾听和调解。他会充分了解各方的诉求和意图，寻找出一个大家都能接受的方案，最终将矛盾消弭于无形。
但是，这并不意味着见行者不擅长战斗。在干员测试中，见行者发挥出了让人惊讶的战斗能力，特别是近身格斗能力。虽说尚且缺乏临机应变的经验，就技术而言，恐怕他完全可以用关节技说服谈判桌上的所有人。
太好了，公证所的执行者里也有人类！这小子甚至会主动帮我泡咖啡！
——可露希尔

text.en:
As we understand it, Enforcer recently completed his training period as an executor of the Notarial Hall, certainly no small feat for someone so young. Under normal circumstances, when a citizen of Laterano receives their patron firearm at the age of twelve, they still need an extensive period of study to truly master using it. After passing a number of examinations and obtaining the corresponding qualification certificates, including the Laterano Firearm Carry and Usage Permit, they formally earn the authorization to use their gun in self-defense, escort duty, ceremonies, and other purposes. Additionally, every few years, gun-owning citizens of Laterano need to bring their patron firearms to the relevant branches of the Notarial Hall and complete gun inspections before they can continue to legally use their 'partners'.
However, the education and training required of a Notarial Hall executor goes far beyond that.
Working in the Notarial Hall is a difficult task, and each official requires a deep understanding of several layers of laws, regulations, and rules. In other words, it can be said that many in the Notarial Hall are profound legal scholars. On top of all this, an executor must also have excellent gun-handling skills, and most difficult of all, must deal with situations where they might be forced to point the muzzle at their own kind. This is not something that can be learned from a textbook.
Due to both the Sankta's laws and their own empathy, it is inherently difficult for one to harbor hostilities towards another, or even to hide their hostilities. Even if it would not violate the law, one still needs to overcome massive psychological pressure, as well as a sense of moral condemnation, to lift one's hand against a fellow Sankta. Perhaps Operator Executor represents the ideal state that skilled, experienced executors should aspire towards. However, Operator Enforcer still managed to pass his Notarial Hall training, all while maintaining his gentle demeanor.
With a smile on his face, he told the HR operator that he had no special secrets to accomplish this. Simply a bit more patience.
text.zh:
根据我们的了解，见行者在不久之前刚刚完成了公证所执行者的实训期训练，这对于他这样的年轻人而言并不是一件容易的事。一位拉特兰公民，在通常情况下，自从十二岁获得自己的守护铳之后，仍需漫长的学习才能真正掌握铳械的使用技巧。在通过包括拉特兰铳型武装运用许可协议在内的若干考核并领取资格证后，方得到戒律允许将铳械运用于防身、自卫、庆祝等多个领域。并且，每到规定的年限，持铳的拉特兰公民需要携守护铳前往公证所相关机构完成铳检，才能继续合法使用自己的这位伙伴。
然而，公证所执行者需接受的教育和训练远远不止于此。
在公证所任职本就是一件困难的事，其中的每一位成员都必须把不同层级的律法、戒律、规则烂熟于心，并且对它们拥有深入的理解。可以说，许多公证所成员都堪称渊博的法学学者。在此之上，一名执行者还需要具备杰出的铳械操作技艺，以及最困难的——应对可能与同族敌对的情况。这绝非从教科书上能够习得的本领。
由于萨科塔的律法与共感，一名萨科塔要对另一名萨科塔产生敌意或隐藏敌意本就是一件困难的事情，即使不以违背律法为代价持铳相向，对同族出手仍需克服巨大的心理压力和道德谴责感。或许干员送葬人那样的状态才是一个娴熟于任务的执行者应有的面貌。然而干员见行者，在保持自己那份温和态度的前提下，以他的方式通过了所有的公证所训练。
他笑着对人事干员表示，自己没什么特殊的秘诀，只是比较有耐心而已。

text.en:
When Enforcer arrived at Rhodes Island to handle the necessary onboarding procedures, he had with him a young Sankta girl named Cecelia. What a mature and adorable child. Even though she won't be here for long, she has already become good friends with almost all the other children here, and they all look forward to seeing her again. This came as a surprise to us. From what we knew, Cecelia grew up in a very unique environment. Isolated at home for a long time because of her identity, she never had any contact with her peers, and was not given a chance to get along with them or develop bonds. However, Cecelia did not exhibit any social impairments, personality flaws, or psychological problems usually present in children growing up under similar circumstances. Her deceased guardian must've painstakingly nurtured her emotional growth. Undoubtedly, she has been given more than enough love and companionship.
According to Operator Enforcer's explanations, Cecelia's health is not in stable condition, and, following Dr. Kal'tsit's judgment, Rhodes Island will provide her with as much medical assistance as possible. Unfortunately though, there really is not much we can do for this lovely young lady. Dr. Kal'tsit can only provide a few bits of basic medical advice on diet and rest. Given that Cecelia will travel to areas near Kazdel, it will be difficult for Medical to conduct follow-up health monitoring. However, Cecelia assures us that she can take care of herself, and we have little choice but to trust in this precocious girl. After all, Enforcer will be accompanying her along the way. An executor should have the skills to handle whatever challenges may arise on the way.
It's worth noting that in the period before leaving for Kazdel, Enforcer often spoke with the operators in charge of educating the minors at Rhodes Island, consulting them in great detail on all the recommended textbooks and supplementary materials from primary education through secondary education, and downloading everything onto his terminal.
text.zh:
见行者来到罗德岛办理相关手续的时候，与他一起登舰的还有一位名叫塞茜莉亚的萨科塔女孩。那真是个懂事又可爱的孩子，虽然这次她只会在罗德岛上做短暂停留，但是我们这里几乎所有的孩子都已经和她成了朋友，并盼着彼此的下次相会了。这真是让人惊讶，以我们的了解，塞茜莉亚的成长环境非常特殊，她因身份问题长期幽居在家，从未接触过任何同龄人，更别提与他们相处，建立联结了。然而，塞茜莉亚并没有表现出任何社交障碍、人格缺陷或其他类似情况下容易出现的心理问题，她的那位已经故去的监护人一定花费了大量的心血来确保她精神层面上的健康成长。当然，无疑还有足够的爱和陪伴。
依据干员见行者的说明，塞茜莉亚的身体状况并不稳定，经由凯尔希医生判断，罗德岛会在尽可能的范围内为她提供医学援助。遗憾的是，我们并不能真的帮上这个可爱的女孩什么忙，凯尔希医生只能给出一份包含膳食与作息建议的简单医嘱。鉴于塞茜莉亚之后将前往卡兹戴尔周边区域，后续的健康监测罗德岛医疗部门也难以跟进。不过，塞茜莉亚表示她完全能够照顾好自己，我们不妨相信这位早慧的女孩。更何况，见行者也会一路随行。一名执行者所掌握的技能足够处理绝大部分突发情况。
值得注意的是，在启程前往卡兹戴尔之前，见行者经常与罗德岛上负责未成年人教育的干员共处，向他们详细咨询了从初等教育到中等教育阶段所有的推荐教材和配套的备课教案，并将其全部下载到了自己的终端中。

text.en:
[Classified Log]
Cecelia's condition is very unique. Unexpectedly, Operator Enforcer seems to have a deeper understanding of this than we do, perhaps due to what they experienced during Laterano's Summit of Nations.
That's right. The girl named Cecelia has a mix of Sankta and Sarkaz blood. Despite the deep hatred between these two races, there are always those who can overcome the barriers built over thousands of years. To be honest, this girl is not alone. Emotions have a lot more power than one would expect.
The truly remarkable thing is that even as a mixed-blood, Cecelia's halo still shines bright above her head, though somewhat unstably. Children between Sankta and foreigners can never be Sankta, and this should have been ironclad law. Their haloes and wings of light are proof of their acceptance by the law, which shuns all else.
What, then, does Cecelia's existence mean?
We have too little information to work with.
Neither Cecelia nor Ezell seemed insistent on asking this question, which is likely the wisest course of action. For us, what truly matters isn't the meaning given to one's existence, but what meaning that existence can go on to create. The journey ahead of them is destined to be rough, and there will be no shortage of trials and tribulations. They may well tread a thorny path, and even come home empty-handed.
But their journey will never be in vain, and we wish all the luck in the world to these two youths.
text.zh:
【权限记录】
塞茜莉亚的身体状况非常特殊，出乎意料的是，干员见行者对这一点的认知比我们想象得还要深刻。相信这与他们在拉特兰万国峰会期间的经历有关。
没错。这个叫塞茜莉亚的女孩是萨科塔与萨卡兹的混血，就算是两个世代仇恨的种族，也总有人能跨越千年来构建的壁垒。说实话，这个女孩并不是孤例，情感拥有比我们想象中大得多的力量。
真正值得注意的是，作为一名混血儿，虽然并不稳定，塞茜莉亚的头顶依然闪耀着光环。萨科塔与外族的孩子永远不可能是萨科塔，这本该是铁律。光环与光翼是被律法接纳的证明，律法拒斥他者。
那么，塞茜莉亚的存在到底意味着什么？
我们掌握的信息或许还太少。
塞茜莉亚和艾泽尔似乎并不执着于追问这个问题，这是个明智的选择。对于我们每个个体而言，重要的不是存在被赋予的意义，而是存在所造就的意义。他们未来的旅程注定不会那么顺遂，会有磨难，会有荆棘，甚至可能一无所获，空手而归。
但绝不会是徒劳无功，祝这两位年轻人好运。

text.en:
Operator Enforcer always carries a coffee mug with him when he works, which always contains the same kind of black coffee—made from a very bitter bean, with not a single granule of sugar added. However, like most Laterans, he is also extremely fond of sweets such as cakes and cookies. In his own words, his choice of black coffee is only to help him focus on his work.
Yet when he finishes his work, Enforcer will pull out a separate coffee brewing set. He often spends hours at a time comparing the differences in flavor caused by varying degrees of roasting, configuring the perfect blend of coffee bean varieties, optimizing the proper ratio of cream and sugar, and even subscribing to the Bolívar Agricultural Magazine just to read the coffee planting columns—even though the magazine is often delivered months late. If Enforcer ever invites you to try the new blend of coffee he whipped up after work, be sure to accept his offer: you won't be disappointed.
However, if you ever accept a cup of coffee from him during work hours, be sure to determine whose cup it is.
text.zh:
干员见行者在工作时总是端着他的咖啡杯，里面永远装着一成不变的黑咖啡，并且选用的是一种风味极苦的咖啡豆，不放一份糖。但是实际上，见行者和绝大部分拉特兰人一样，热衷于蛋糕和曲奇之类的甜点。按照他自己的说法，选择黑咖啡只是为了在工作时方便集中精神。
然而，在工作结束之后，见行者会取出另一套咖啡萃取壶。他经常花费几个小时去对比烘焙程度造成的风味区别，配置不同咖啡豆品种的比例，寻找奶与糖的绝妙配比，乃至于订阅往往要迟上几个月才能送到的玻利瓦尔农业杂志，只为了阅读上面的咖啡种植专栏。若是见行者在下班后约你一起品鉴他刚收到的新口味咖啡，请一定要答应下来，你不会失望的。
但在工作时间，从见行者手中接过咖啡杯时，也一定要看清楚到底是谁的杯子。

Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Bellone shows no trace of Originium infection. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.14u/L
Operator Bellone rarely comes into contact with Originium.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

text.en:
A young Lupo who always has a smile on his face, yet is nevertheless somehow quietly intimidating.
Operator Bellone's first visit to Rhodes Island caused a small uproar within HR, as we had previously written in Operator Vigil's file that Vigil was the 'last leader of Siracusa's Bellone Family'.
This misunderstanding was quickly cleared up: according to Operator Bellone's statement, the Bellones almost dissolved when Don Bernando died, and his heir Vigil left the old city to build Nuova Volsinii. The Family's power structure had fallen apart, and the remaining former Bellones were barely scraping by under pressure from other Families, unable to either return to a normal life or join another family and thus betray Bellone. That was when Demetri Certaldo decided to take up the mantle of the Don of the Bellone Family, taking those who had lost the family's protection under his wing.
Based on our current understanding of Siracusa, we are aware that his statement is missing quite a few details. Someone who was not the designated heir could hardly have inherited a family—even a declining one—without facing opposition both within and without. When asked about this, however, he deflected our questions with a smile.
'I grew up in the famiglia. The people there are like blood family to me, and I could never abandon them no matter what,' he said, and declined to elaborate further.
It is perhaps worth mentioning that Bellone ran into Chiave's gang at lunch that day. The always-jolly Chiave welcomed Bellone's arrival with his gang—to Bellone's apparent surprise, though he eventually assented to Chiave's eager (and rather physical) show of friendship with a smile. The scene seemed familiar, but also quite different from when Vigil first arrived.
An operator who was present recalled, 'It makes you realize how easy-going Vigil is by comparison. The smile never left Bellone's face, but for some reason I was really worried for Chiave the entire time.'
text.zh:
常常面带微笑，却不知为何会给人以压迫感的鲁珀青年。
干员贝洛内第一次造访罗德岛时，人事部内部产生了一些小小的尴尬与混乱，这是因为我们曾在干员伺夜的档案里写过，伺夜是“叙拉古贝洛内家族最后一任领袖”。
所幸我们很快就厘清了状况，据干员贝洛内所说，当时伺夜的父亲、贝洛内家上一任家主贝纳尔多去世，作为继承人的伺夜本人则离开旧城，投身于新沃尔西尼的建设，贝洛内家族确实一度沦落到了溃散的境地，家族内部的权力架构也彻底解体。在其他家族的倾轧下，仅剩的一些原贝洛内家族的成员只能挣扎度日，他们无法回归到普通人的生活中去，也无法背叛贝洛内家而投身于其他家族。在看到这样的状况后，这名原本叫作德米特里·切塔尔多的青年决定挺身而出，继承贝洛内的名号，并将这些所有失去了家族庇护的人归拢在自己的照拂之下，从此以后，他就成了贝洛内家的新任家主。
按照我们目前对叙拉古的了解，贝洛内的这套说辞显然省略了许多细节，原本并非继承人的他要继承家族——即使它已经走向衰败——无论是在家族内部还是外部，都必然会有阻力，他的继承也绝不可能如他所说这么自然顺利。但当我们问及这些部分时，贝洛内只是微微一笑。
“我是在家族里长大的，家族的成员于我来说就是家人，无论发生了什么，我都不可能放着我的家人不管。就这么简单。”最后，他只说了这么一句。
另外，或许值得一提的是，在当天的午餐时间，贝洛内也遇到了贾维团伙。贾维凭借他一贯的开朗，又带领他的团伙成员欢迎了贝洛内的到来。贝洛内对此似乎有些惊讶，但最终以微笑默许了贾维的勾肩搭背。这个场景似曾相识，却又好像与伺夜那次完全不同。
“有了对比才又意识到，伺夜确实平易近人。贝洛内虽然脸上挂着微笑，但不知为何，当时我真的很替贾维担心。”某位在场干员回忆道。

text.en:
The Bellone Family staked a foothold in Nuova Volsinii through the Saluzzo Vino winery. Soon after Demetri Bellone and Alberto's deal, Alberto was arrested, and control of Saluzzo Vino fell into Bellone's hands. He has since made Saluzzo Vino stronger, establishing a dominant position in the local wine market following the Kazimierz-sponsored Red Wine Championship, and demonstrating the ability to compete with international brands from outside Siracusa.
In addition to wine, the Bellone Family has also invested in various industries in Nuova Volsinii, which are also growing at a breakneck pace. Although public data is not available, it is estimated that they are bringing the Bellone Family roughly the same revenue as Saluzzo Vino, perhaps even more. Yet there are also issues: most of these investments are in traditional mafia industries such as restaurants, bars, hotels, and moneylending—rarely involving the production of physical goods—inevitably leading to speculation that the Bellone Family is going back to the old ways in Nuova Volsinii. Furthermore, while Bellone's new investments are heavily staffed with Bellone members, Saluzzo Vino maintains a strong Saluzzo presence. Even setting aside potential problems caused by mafia members in corporate leadership, one cannot help but feel concerned as to whether the Saluzzo members truly accept Bellone leadership, and whether this arrangement will impact Rhodes Island's partnership with the Bellone Family.
An HR operator made a secret visit to Saluzzo Vino with these concerns in mind.
'Signor Bellone? He's a good man!
'We're still called Saluzzo Vino, aren't we? He said Saluzzo's only working with Bellone on a temporary basis. We're still Saluzzo, of course, and he even praised us for our loyalty, saying he was honored to be working with a famiglia like ours that respects tradition!
'Of course, we're in Nuova Volsinii now, and Signor Bellone told us to respect City Hall's policies, work hard, and follow the rules of the New Urban Management Act. I can tell you it took some getting used to. Back in the day, whenever I heard my terminal ring, the first thing I did wasn't pick up the call, but check my knife and gun. But I'm not even doing any brawling these days. I work fixed hours and go home for dinner with my wife and kids. I've got to admit, it's not such a bad feeling after all.
'Oh, of course I'm still part of the famiglia. We're all waiting for Don Saluzzo to get out of prison! I even asked Signor Bellone if there was a way to get him out. He said it would be hard to get his sentence reduced under the New Urban Management Act, but he would pull a few strings and make things more comfortable for him. Sure enough, when I visited the Don a couple of days ago, he had a cell to himself and seemed to have gotten a little plumper. I'm so grateful to Signor Bellone!
'I wasn't able to talk to the Don too much in the allotted time, so I just told him about how things had been going with us. He didn't say anything, but ended the visit with a smile. I'm sure he's very grateful to Signor Bellone too!'
The HR operator could not help but feel that something was not quite right. Seeing the Perro's bright smile, however, he could only follow Alberto Saluzzo's lead and smile back.
text.zh:
贝洛内家是以萨卢佐酒业为基点进入新沃尔西尼的。在德米特里·贝洛内与阿尔贝托交易后不久，阿尔贝托入狱，贝洛内则取得了萨卢佐酒业的经营权。在他手中，萨卢佐酒业逐渐发展壮大，在卡西米尔商人主办的红酒锦标赛结束之后，更是占据了本地酒类市场的半壁江山，甚至有了与叙拉古之外的跨国连锁品牌一争高下的实力。
除酒业之外，贝洛内家在新沃尔西尼还投资了不少其他产业。它们的发展势头也很迅猛，虽然没有公开的数据可以证实，但据估算，它们为贝洛内家带来的年收入应该已与萨卢佐酒业相当，也可能更胜一筹。不过，这也产生了一些问题，比如说，它们集中在餐厅、酒吧、高档酒店、金融借贷等传统意义上家族发展会投资的领域，很少涉及实业，这就不免让人怀疑贝洛内家是否会在新沃尔西尼重走过去的老路。另一方面，这些产业中有大量贝洛内家族成员，而萨卢佐酒业内，萨卢佐家族的成员也都还在任职。家族成员占据企业内重要岗位的现状暂且不提，萨卢佐家族的成员能否真心实意地接受贝洛内的领导，贝洛内家族集团内部是否会因此而埋下隐患，上述情况是否会进一步影响罗德岛与贝洛内家的合作，这一系列的问题更让人担忧。
带着这样的疑问与忧虑，一位人事干员私下里探访了萨卢佐酒业。
“德米特里老爷？他是个好人啊！
“你看我们现在还叫‘萨卢佐酒业’，德米特里老爷说萨卢佐家只是暂时地与贝洛内家合作，我们当然还是萨卢佐家的人！他还夸了我们的忠诚心，说很高兴能与我们这样恪守传统的家族合作！
“哦，不过现在我们是在新沃尔西尼，德米特里老爷说，我们还是得对市政厅的决策保持尊敬，要好好干活，认真上班，遵守《新都市管理法案》里的规定。嘿，我开始还挺不习惯的，要知道，以前我听到终端响起来的第一反应不是接听，而是检查我身上的铳和匕首，但现在，连叫我去打架的事都没了。我每天能按时上下班，回家跟老婆和孩子吃个饭，其实感觉还挺踏实安心。
“不不，我当然还是家族成员啊，我们都还在等阿尔贝托老爷从监狱里出来的！对了，有一次我还去请德米特里老爷想想办法，看能不能把阿尔贝托老爷捞出来。他说《新都市管理法案》在这方面有明确规定，要给老爷减刑比较困难，但他可以想办法疏通关系，让老爷在监狱里住得舒服些。前两天的会见日，我去见了阿尔贝托老爷，他一个人住一间，气色确实不错，好像还长胖了，感谢德米特里老爷！
“会见有时间限制，所以我也没能跟阿尔贝托老爷聊太多，就说了说我们的近况。老爷没有说什么，但他最后笑了，我想，阿尔贝托老爷一定也很感激德米特里老爷吧！”
听到这里，我们的人事干员觉得好像有哪里不太对劲，但看着面前这位笑容灿烂的佩洛，最终也只能学习阿尔贝托，微笑着什么也没有说。

text.en:
We are well aware that Demetri Certaldo was not groomed to become the next Don of the Bellone Family. His father had held an advisor position in the Bellones, and when he was killed in a mafia struggle, young Demetri was taken in by the Family and raised alongside Operator Vigil. This sort of arrangement is in line with what we know about Siracusan mafia tradition: having core members live together helps instill loyalty in those pegged for important Family positions in the future.
Demetri quickly accepted his role as Leontuzzo's advisor, taking care of his daily needs and teaching him everything he knew about the mafia, business, and fighting—essentially grooming the boy four years his junior to become the perfect leader, one who could take care of every member of the Family and protect their interests.
This should have ensured a smooth transition of power to Leontuzzo, until Bernardo's views on the Family began to change and he brought Lavinia—Operator Penance—into the Bellone Family. Under Lavinia's influence, Leontuzzo began to deviate from the path that Demetri had set for him. This was seen as a regrettable development, but an understandable one: for Leontuzzo, the scope of the 'family' had grown from a single Family to what is today all of Nuova Volsinii, and perhaps eventually all of Siracusa. The rules of the Family that he used to value had became the law and justice that Lavinia upheld.
Again, Operator Bellone's statement here seemed to omit many details, which we do not feel the need to delve deeper into, but there was a question we could not help but ask regarding Siracusan mafia tradition: is the Family's advisor normally expected to take care of the Don's daily needs?
Bellone did not answer.
We did, however, receive a valuable reference from another 'party concerned':
'Most advisors don't, but Demetri and I grew up together. He was a few years older, and he was used to taking care of me, while I was used to being taken care of. Or maybe... he was already showing his potential to become the Don, by seeing me as his famiglia and finding it perfectly natural that he should take care of me. He used to tell me that a Don should take care of his famiglia. I think he's doing a fine job of it.'
text.zh:
德米特里·切塔尔多原本不是作为贝洛内家族的家主被培养的，这一点我们很早就知道。他的父亲是贝洛内家曾经的军师，在一次家族间的斗争中不幸去世，此后年幼的德米特里被贝洛内家收养，与干员伺夜一起长大。这样的安排很符合我们对叙拉古家族传统的认知：让家族的核心成员一同生活，显然更有助于培养重要岗位未来继承者的忠诚心。
被收养之后，德米特里迅速地接受了自己作为莱昂图索军师的定位，他会照顾莱昂图索的生活起居，将自己掌握的家族活动、经营和战斗的规则、知识与技巧传授给小自己四岁的莱昂图索，竭尽全力地将其培养成自己心目中最完美的领袖——要能照顾好家族里的每一个家人，保证每一个家人的利益不受侵犯。
这样的安排本可以保证莱昂图索顺利地接掌贝洛内家，但后来，老贝纳尔多将拉维妮娅——干员斥罪——带入了贝洛内家，他对“家族”这一概念本身有了别的想法，而莱昂图索也在拉维妮娅的影响下，渐渐偏离了德米特里预想的道路。这当然是一件很让人遗憾的事，但也并不是不能理解：对莱昂图索而言，“家人”的概念从家族成员的范畴扩展到了现在的新沃尔西尼人，未来或许会扩展到所有的叙拉古人；而他本应该最看重的家族的规则，也转变成了拉维妮娅坚守的法律与公平，如此而已。
以上，来自干员贝洛内的陈述，似乎同样省略了许多细节，但我们不打算细究。只是，有关于叙拉古的所谓家族传统，仍有一点让我们禁不住想问——家族里的军师，在为家族活动提出建议之外，都会负责照顾家主的日常生活吗？
贝洛内没有回答。
不过，另一位当事人为我们提供了一份可供参考的答案——
“一般的军师应该是不会的。但德米特和我一起长大，他比我大几岁，早就习惯了照顾我的生活，我也习惯了接受他的照顾。当然，也可能……那家伙从那时候起就有了做家主的潜质，他把我当家人，觉得自己照顾我是应该的，‘家主理应照顾好每一个家人’嘛，他以前总跟我这么说，我看他现在就做得挺好。”

text.en:
The announcement of the amendment to the New Urban Management Act sent shock waves throughout Nuova Volsinii. Most heavily impacted were the foreign corporations in the involved industries, whose stakeholders and investors expressed their dissatisfaction to City Hall. City Hall stood firm, however, and as a result some corporations have begun to adjust their business strategies based on the amendment's provisions. It was met with a generally positive response from local enterprises, who were long clamoring for its policies, as well as the general populace of Nuova Volsinii. Although some have noted that the amendment represents a form of protectionism, which could cause Siracusa's mafia traditions to once again rear their heads in the guise of local enterprises.
The full impact of the amendment on Nuova Volsinii remains to be seen, and we are keeping a close eye on further developments.
—Central Journal, International Edition

When Bellone finally stood before Signora Sicilia, he felt nothing but fear.
It was not her power that he feared. On the contrary, when he stood before her and saw her face clearly for the first time, he saw her sagging cheeks and sunken eye sockets, and the spots on her skin that not even heavy powdering could disguise. That was when he realized that the legends of Signora Sicilia he was so familiar with took place sixty years ago, and that the legendary matriarch had already entered her twilight years.
Her gaze was still strong, her movements elegant and confident, and her words soft yet impossible to refute or defy. The authority of Siracusa was still concentrated in her, but this only served to amplify his fear: all this power was centered on her, yet she was merely mortal. The order that she represented, the influence she wielded over the many Siracusan famiglie, and the deterrence her presence represented to other countries would all inevitably vanish upon her death. When the time came, would the famiglie still sit together and negotiate in the Grey Hall to resolve their conflicts? Or would Siracusa fall into chaos and desolation again?
'I don't give a damn what happens to Siracusa after I die,'
Signora Sicilia said as she ascended the steps of her manor. Her steps were slow, and seemingly steady, but she grabbed Bellone's arm with such strength that all he could say in response was, 'Please do not mention that word, Signora. You still have many years ahead of you.'
'The only people who love to bring up that word are the young who've never known death and the old for whom death is near. I know my own body best,' she smiled. 'The future does not belong to me. Whether it belongs to you—all of you—depends on you. Your idea is interesting, and you have shown respect by coming to see me before you act. Go. Go and try it out in Nuova Volsinii.'
His fear prevented Bellone from answering, but in that instant the faint notions in his mind became concrete and firm. He had wanted someone to show him a path he could simply follow. Now, he had to become the one leading the way, the one who saw it through to the end. He must build a new order.
There is little time left. For him, for them, and for Siracusa.
text.zh:
《新都市管理法修正案》颁布以来，新沃尔西尼各界都因此而震动。受影响最深的是修正案所涉相关行业的外国公司，这些企业的投资人与企业主纷纷向市政厅表示不满，但市政厅态度坚决，因此已有部分企业主根据一些条款调整了自家公司的经营策略；本地企业纷纷叫好，同时表示修正案来得太晚；新沃尔西尼的广大市民则总体持肯定态度，但亦有一些有识之士不无担忧地指出，修正案实际上体现的是一种地方保护主义，而叙拉古长期以来有着家族的传统，恐怕家族势力会借地方企业的外壳死灰复燃。
该修正案后续将为新沃尔西尼带来怎样的变化仍有待观察，本报将持续带来相关报道。
——《中央新闻报海外版》

当贝洛内终于站到西西里夫人面前时，他的内心感受到的只有恐惧。
这种恐惧并非源于西西里夫人的权势，不如说正相反，当时他站在西西里夫人面前，终于看清了这张他过去只在公众场合远观过的脸，看到她下垂的脸颊和深深的泪沟，还有她皮肤上用化妆品也无法彻底遮住的斑点，他突然意识到，自己从小耳熟能详的西西里夫人的传说，发生在六十多年前，此刻站在他面前的这位夫人，早已步入垂暮之年。
当然，她的双眼依然坚定清澈，她的动作依然从容有力，她说话依然像从前那样轻声细语，带着让人无法驳斥与忤逆的强势，在她身上，依然集中着叙拉古的全部权力。但正是因此，贝洛内的恐惧才更强烈——权力集中在她身上，而她却不是永恒的存在，她所代表的秩序、她对叙拉古各个家族的威慑，乃至其他国家因她的存在而对叙拉古产生的忌惮，在她彻底衰老直至死亡之后，必将悉数消散，终归于无。而到了那时候，各个家族还会愿意像现在这样在灰厅坐下来谈判、解决纷争吗？叙拉古是否会重新陷入混沌与荒芜？
“我死了之后叙拉古会变成什么样，我根本不在意。”
西西里夫人这么说着，走上她宅邸的台阶。她的步伐很慢，似乎依然沉稳，但她的手攥住了贝洛内的手臂，过于用力。于是贝洛内只能回答：“夫人，别提那个字眼，您还能活很久。”
“只有从没有经历过死亡的孩子和即将步入死亡的老人才会把‘死’挂在嘴上——我的身体，我最清楚不过。”她微笑道，“未来不属于我，但能不能属于你——或者你们——得看你自己。你的想法很有意思，你在做之前先来找我，也展露了你对我的尊敬，那就去吧，去新沃尔西尼试一试。”
恐惧让贝洛内无法回答，在见面之前他心里的所有那些模糊的念头却在此时变得明晰而坚定。他曾经希望有人能给他指明道路，而他只要绝对服从就好，但现在，他必须成为那个指出方向并始终践行的人，他要建立新的秩序。
留给他、他们、叙拉古的时间，都不多了。

text.en: You wish to mediate between me and Leon, Doctor? I appreciate it, but that will not be necessary. I understand that it concerns you that he is avoiding me at Rhodes Island, but I assure you it is simply because he does not know how to treat me in an informal setting. We were family, after all, brothers who grew up together, the future Don and his advisor. Now, we are partners, friends who speak to each other as equals. It will take some time for him to get used to it, as well as hearing the name 'Bellone' in his ears, but he will get used to it. He must. We must all accept certain things that we cannot change, must we not? Leon has, after all, chosen a different path. No, I do not oppose Lavinia's ideas. They are very fine ideals, light and justice and all that. I fully believe that they will guide Nuova Volsinii and Siracusa toward a better future. You must understand that I was in charge of his education long before Lavinia came to the Bellones. The famiglia and Signor Bernardo groomed me to be its advisor, and I taught Leon everything I knew, raising him to be the leader I wanted the famiglia to have. Yes, we've had our disagreements, but what he believes in is essentially no different from what I believe in. I have simply walked too long in the rain, which is the reason for our differences. I could never abandon my famiglia, so long as they consider themselves that. On this, both Signor Bernardo and Leon have a leg up on me, possessing the resolve and determination that I lack. Still, I firmly believe that the Bellones and I have the right to exist, that we are needed. Where there is light, there is shadow. If you wish to breathe the fresh air after a rain, you must first accept the rain. It is true that I am a long way from the ideal leader I dream of. This doesn't matter. It was never what I aspired to be, and I will not change who I am now. I once placed all my hopes on Leontuzzo Bellone, but he will not become Don, and I will not be his advisor. This, I have accepted. In the distant future, I may become an advisor again—if someone proves that they will make a better Don than I am.
text.zh:
你可以出面帮忙调和我与莱昂之间的关系？谢谢你的好心，博士，不过现在已经没有这个必要了。
我知道他在罗德岛时会选择避开我，这让你有些担心，但那只是因为他不知该如何在非正式的场合与我相处，因为我们曾经是家人，是互相扶持一同长大的兄弟，是未来的家主与辅佐他的军师，而现在，我们成了合作伙伴，平起平坐的朋友。这样的转变让他有些茫然和不适应，“贝洛内”这个名号又让他觉得有些刺耳。你需要做的只是给他一些时间，他会习惯的，他总得习惯。我们总得无可奈何地接受一些我们无法改变的事，不是吗？毕竟，莱昂在那时候选择了与我不同的道路。
不，我其实并不反对拉维妮娅坚持的信念，它们都是很好的，代表着光明和正义，我完全相信它们能将新沃尔西尼、将叙拉古带往更美好的未来。你要知道，从拉维妮娅还没有来到贝洛内家的很早以前，我就接管了莱昂的教育，家族和贝纳尔多老爷养育了将成为军师的我，而我将我的所知所想都教给了莱昂。我按照我心中理想家主的形象培养了他，没错，我们之间是有一些微小的分歧，但他所坚信的，与我本质上没有什么不同。
我已在雨中行走太久，而这就是我们之间产生分歧的原因。我永远不可能放弃我的家人——只要他们还承认自己是家族的成员。在这一点上，我确实不及贝纳尔多老爷和莱昂，他们的坚定与果决是我所不具备的。但即使如此，我始终相信，我与贝洛内家依然有着存在的权利和必要，有光就会有影子，若是喜欢雨过天晴的清新空气，就得先经历漫长的雨季。
现在的我确实……离我心目中理想的家主还很遥远。但没有关系，过去的我从未以此为目标，如今的我也不会为此而改变自己的行为方式。莱昂图索·贝洛内曾经寄托着我的理想，但他不会成为家主，我也不会成为他的军师，我已经接受了这一点。而在遥远的未来，我依然可以退为军师，只要有人能够向我证明，自己可以成为比我更好的家主。

text.en: Horn, graduate of the Royal Guard Academy of Victoria, presently commander of Victoria's 2nd Tempest Platoon. Fought in coordination with Rhodes Island during the Londinium incident. Ratified a cooperative strategic contract with Rhodes Island following referral by Elite Operator Misery.
text.zh: 号角，毕业于维多利亚皇家近卫学校，现为维多利亚风暴突击队第二分队指挥官。于伦蒂尼姆事件中与罗德岛协同作战，经精英干员Misery介绍，与罗德岛签订战略合作条款。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Horn shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.13u/L
Operator Horn rarely comes into contact with Originium.

You know, it was fairly dangerous having to sneak about Sudean back in Londinium... Good thing we brought a batch of protective meds. Let us hand out a share to all the other Victorian soldiers as well as Miss Horn.
—Londinium Spec-Ops Medic Operator
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员号角没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.13u/L
干员号角甚少接触源石。

其实，在伦蒂尼姆萨迪恩区东躲西藏的那段经历还是挺危险的……好在我们带了一批防护用的药品，除了号角小姐以外，也会给其他维多利亚的战士们都发一份。
——伦蒂尼姆特别行动队医疗干员

text.en:
As a professional officer, there is no question that Horn possesses excellent combat skill and tactical accomplishment. Her customary weapon is a specialized shield, with an arming mechanism able to burst up to ten rounds in an extremely short time.
Just as with Bagpipe's piledriver spear, Horn's shield displays the terrifying might of Victoria's standard ordnance. Londinium is currently in a unique phase, and being in cooperation, we've performed repairs on the weapons borne by Horn and the Victorian soldiers she leads. In the initial stages of work, even the mechanical structure of her shield eluded us.
'Jeez, no wonder Victoria's got the most advanced mechanical engineering on all of Terra. I can't even picture how I'd develop these weapons any further,' were Closure's words, demonstrating even her awe.
Fortunately, Horn assisted us in disassembling the most difficult parts. Her past military exercises had given her a considerably professional grasp on mechanical technology. With her knowledge, she and the city defense force soldiers fashioned their crossbows and grenades by themselves during a period when supplies were extremely scarce. It's no exaggeration to say that Horn has once again made us find how outstanding the professionalism of Victorian soldiers is.
'Are you SURE the Royal Guard Academy teaches mechanical engineering? Then what about all the control terminals Bagpipe's wrecked on the ship?!' Addition of this remark has been strongly requested by Closure following perusal of the above paragraph.
Also, while this should probably go in the armament evaluation logs, I'll add these battlefield observation records below too, considering we have a shortage of hands on deck for Londinium operations.
Horn's performance on the battlefield is extremely professional. On top of an all-round, comprehensive combat capacity, she has rich experience in squad command. This completely matches our first impressions, and is a strong fit to Bagpipe's descriptions.
But in a few, extremely challenging battles, I and a few other operators witnessed a shift. I might not have been exact under such tense circumstances, so it could be that any change in eye and hair color was my misconception. But it was difficult to ignore her sudden rise in speed, and how vastly different her destructive fighting techniques were to her former restrained and controlled combat style.
Out of curiosity, I asked the other Victorian soldiers if they knew anything, and heard a few rumors about the White Wolf who was active in the Victorian Army. A white Lupo went mad in Sargon on a moonlit night and tore an entire army to death for an Aslan pasha however many thousand years ago, the White Wolf Count ripped a Vampire prince to shreds with his bare hands however many hundred years ago, and so on... I mean, they just sound like stories that get spread through the streets.
But a Medical Department colleague got back to me, and in their view, that kind of combat style would still put a heavy strain on the body, regardless of if she used some unique Originium Arts or activated some hereditary ability in the moment. We're fully aware of how far Horn can go to protect her soldiers and Victoria's civilians, but we hope she won't go that far so lightly.
text.zh:
作为一名职业军官，号角无疑有着优秀的战斗技巧与战术素养。她惯用的武器为一面特殊形制的盾，带有击发结构，能够在极短时间内射出多达十枚弹药。
就像风笛的破城矛一样，号角的盾同样展现了维多利亚制式军械的恐怖实力。目前伦蒂尼姆处在特殊时期，作为合作方，我们对号角及她所带领的维多利亚士兵的武器进行了整修。在工作初期，我们甚至无法理解她所持盾牌的机械结构。
“维多利亚不愧掌握着整个泰拉最先进的机械工程技术，我甚至想象不出来这些武器之后还能往什么方向继续发展啊。”就连可露希尔都这么感慨。
好在号角帮我们拆解了最难的部分。她受过的军事训练令她掌握了相当专业的机械技术知识。据了解，在物资极度匮乏的时期，她与其他城防军士兵所使用的弓弩与榴弹都是自制的。毫不夸张地说，号角再一次让我们认识到了维多利亚军人的职业素质有多出色。
“你确定皇家近卫学校会教授机械工程吗？那船上被风笛弄坏的那些控制终端是怎么回事？！”在看到上面那句话后，可露希尔强烈要求补上这句疑问。
还有，虽说这本该是武器鉴定记录，但是考虑到在伦蒂尼姆行动的人手不足，下面这些战场观察记录也由我来补充。
号角在战场上的表现非常专业。她不仅有着全面的综合战斗能力，并且在指挥小队作战方面有着丰富的经验。这完全符合我们对她的第一印象，也与风笛的描述高度吻合。
但在少数几次极其困难的作战中，我与其他几位干员都目睹了一些变化。也许在那样紧张的场合下，我看到的画面未必准确，所以那些瞳色与发色的变化都可能是错觉。可她突然提升的速度，以及与往日克制严谨的作战风格差异巨大的，极具破坏力的战斗手法实在很难被忽视。
出于好奇，我找其他维多利亚的士兵打听了一下，然后听说了一些关于活跃在维多利亚军队中的白狼的传言。什么千年前白色的鲁珀狂奔在萨尔贡的月夜下为阿斯兰帕夏咬死了一整支敌军，什么百年前的白狼伯爵曾经徒手撕碎了一位血魔亲王之类的……这怎么听都像是坊间流传的虚构故事啊。
不过，从医疗部同事的反馈来看，无论号角在那些时刻是使用了某种特殊的源石技艺，还是激发了特殊的血脉能力，这样的作战方式对她的身体来说都是不轻的负担。我们深知号角为了保护她的士兵和维多利亚的平民能做到哪一步，然而，我们都希望她不要轻易迈出那一步。

text.en:
The Tempest Platoon of Victoria is a special forces unit established by the Victorian Parliament. Formerly known as the Exemplars of Victoria, its main duty is to carry out special missions assigned directly by Parliament, with traces of its activity covering all of Victoria, including her enclaves everywhere.
Structurally, the current Tempest Platoon is still attached to the Victorian Army, and is deployed to the frontline for assault duties in times of war, but is in reality relatively independent. The Platoon is divided into six sections, each section incorporating two operational groups, each operational group typically consisting of five members. The Platoon's members are typically selected for excellence from either other special forces units or the Royal Police, and undergo extremely harsh training. By and large, they possess all-encompassing combat abilities and exceptional intelligence analysis capacity, and are outfitted with the technological cutting edge of Victoria's equipment.
Due to the Members who first founded the Exemplars themselves being Royal Guard Academy alumni, the Tempest Platoon has always had inextricable ties with this prestigious military school, from the day of its founding to present times. Every so often, some of the most outstanding graduates will receive recommendation letters from their instructors, which serve as the door to training and evaluation. Nobody on the outside is able to find out anything regarding the ratio of people who pass. Given the standards of the two Tempest Platoon soldiers we've already come into contact with, we imagine that even should one have graduated from the RGA, becoming a formal member of the Tempest Platoon must be considerably challenging.
As for Horn herself, anyone who's met her will know that she represents the Tempest Platoon of Victoria's ideal essence. Bravery, loyalty, tenacity, wiping out all that blocks the way as a tempest does. She will fight with her life on the line, for Victoria, for every innocent life of Her people, until the last blood is shed. You know, it's obvious she's of noble birth, isn't it? The child of a prestigious family must've had her pick of options, even if she didn't happen to be the favorite child. She could've served as the trusted aide of a Londinium VIP, or had a cushier time as a commander high up in the Army. Wouldn't anything have been better than joining the Tempest Platoon, doing nothing but the most wearisome and dangerous work?
The White Wolf Count... If she's the 'White Wolf,' so to speak, then maybe I can guess. Since the upheaval two decades or so ago, nobility loyal to the Royal Family, especially those in the military, went through harder times. Count Skamandros had been nestling in the border city of Caladon for years by that point. The 'White Wolf's' prowess in the military still remained, and many a Duke feared crossing him, but any of the slightest indication from him could wipe out his whole family then and there. I hear Horn hasn't been back to see her father in years, too. If her choice to join the Tempest Platoon right after graduating is any indication, she likely doesn't approve of her father receding away in self-protection.
Victoria's future certainly isn't held in the hands of the old nobility entering their elder years, unable to uphold even their past splendor. Whether Victoria becomes the next Gaul will ultimately be seen in the choices made by the young, those like Horn and Bagpipe.

—Personal log of Rhodes Island intelligence personnel stationed in Victoria
text.zh:
维多利亚风暴突击队，是由维多利亚议会建立的一支特种部队，其前身为维多利亚典范军，主要职责是执行直接由议会下达的特殊任务，活动踪迹遍布维多利亚，包括各处维多利亚飞地。
目前风暴突击队在编制上依然隶属于维多利亚军队，在战争时期也会被部署至前线执行奇袭任务，但事实上相对独立。突击队分为六支行动分队，每支分队包括两个行动小组，每个行动小组通常有五名队员。突击队队员通常从其余特种部队或皇家警察中选拔而出，经过极其严苛的训练，他们往往拥有全面的作战能力与优异的情报分析能力，并配备维多利亚最尖端的科技装备。
由于最初组建典范军的议员正是毕业于维多利亚皇家近卫学校，风暴突击队从成立之初到现在，都与这所著名的军校有着千丝万缕的联系。每隔一段时间，都可能会有一些最优秀的毕业生拿到学校老师的推荐信，以此来作为参与训练考核的敲门砖。至于通过比例，外面的人就不得而知了。以我们已经接触到的两位风暴突击队战士的标准来看，想必即便毕业于皇家近卫学校，想要成为一名正式的风暴突击队队员，也是相当困难的。
至于号角本人，只要接触过她的人都会知道，她本身就代表着维多利亚风暴突击队的理想精神。勇敢、忠诚、顽强，就如风暴般能够摧毁一切阻碍。为了维多利亚，也为了每一个无辜的维多利亚人的生命，她会拼命战斗下去，直至流尽最后一滴血。其实，她明明是贵族出身吧？显贵家庭的孩子，哪怕不是最受宠的那一个，她也有很多条路可以选。去给某个伦蒂尼姆的要员当亲信，或者去集团军里当个轻松一点的高级指挥官，不都比加入风暴突击队，一路干着最累最危险的活来得强些？
白狼伯爵……如果是那个“白狼”的话，我倒是能猜到一些。从二十多年前那场剧变开始，这些忠于王室的贵族，尤其是军事贵族们过得都不太容易。那位斯卡曼德罗斯伯爵已经在卡拉顿那种边缘城市窝了很多年。“白狼”在军队里的威名犹在，许多公爵都会忌惮他，但凡他稍微出一下头，都可能会给全家人带来灭顶之灾。我听说号角有很多年没有回家见过父亲了。从她一毕业就加入了风暴突击队这个选择来看，她大概不赞同父亲为了自保而做出的退让吧。
维多利亚的未来，的确不会握在这些即将步入暮年，就连守住往日辉煌都做不到的老贵族手里。维多利亚会不会成为下一个高卢，终究是要看号角与风笛这样的年轻人会做何选择啊。

——某罗德岛驻维多利亚情报人员个人记录

text.en:
Londinium's in a hell of a mess. Yeah, the situation's more grim than we were assuming.
Theresis is taking measures on every front. The Nachzehrer's leading the Royal Court's army out of Londinium right now. Between him and the dukes' forces, they're keeping each other gagged.
As for the power which killed Outcast, Dublinn, you guessed right. They were cozy with a couple of nobles after all.
Seems now they're trying to get a message to Theresis. Maybe they want to wrangle a partnership.
Going by the intel we picked up, odds are rock-bottom that Theresis allies with Dublinn at this stage. He's not going to trust any promises from a mysterious organization who wasn't there yesterday, and he's not going to be arrogant enough to set sights on any city beyond Londinium.
But we have to consider worst-case.
Victoria might just be torn to pieces. The dukes could be provoked into action by Theresis, Dublinn, maybe some other schemer from out of nowhere, and the whole nation would fall into civil strife.
Obviously, Theresis had everything planned, from the moment he got the one Duke's invitation to enter Londinium and put down the rebellion. He had under ten thousand Sarkaz with him when he left Kazdel, but now? Londinium's military factories are producing arms for Theresis day and night. The Nachzehrer's got whatever secret channels he's found, and they're funneling Sarkaz soldiers in from every surrounding nation, straight to Theresis.
We still don't know what exactly Theresis is planning, but if this enters all-out warfare, what percent of those soldiers convened there do you figure are leaving Londinium alive?
And after the war's over, even if Victoria can't help itself, it's not like the Sarkaz'll get anything good out of it either. You've seen the way Theresis retaliated against Victoria. Will Kazdel once again become the target of every nation in the centrum? Will we bring a new disaster?
I don't know, Kal'tsit. You and Blaze always tell me I think too much, but there's only so much I can do. So it's always been.
As for Theresis and the Military Commission's plans. I believe Logos and Ascalon are more impatient than I am. All I can do for now is keep going with this Dublinn unit, figure out just what they intend on. If any intel of worth shows up, I'll send it back immediately. I know you've brought up the Draco before, Outcast's rescuee from County Hillock. Once she's ready, she'll give us more info, even help us figure out the truth of Dublinn. In which case, I hope the intel I get will help her make the decision to, ASAP.
Right. One more thing—I discovered a young Victorian officer in the Dublinn unit's camp. Dead ringer for Bagpipe's 'Leader.' Her commander she described.
I've been keeping visuals on her for a time, out of caution. You know and I know that there's no looking at how Theresis went uncontested into Londinium without seeing the support from the Londinium army's top echelons. I trust how Bagpipe feels strongly about her leader, but just the same, I firmly believe a cruel war can reshape anyone's sense of wisdom.
She wasn't looked after kindly by Dublinn. County Hillock—Mandragora and her subordinates—they insulted her, mocked her, constantly. They didn't put her through excessive physical torture. Maybe they still saw worth in her as a bargaining chip. Actually, no. Let me state this right. For an officer in the prime of her youth, there is no punishment more cruel than having to watch on helplessly while your comrades-in-arms are slaughtered, while you fall into enemy hands with no way to resist.
I've seen a lot of POWs before. Most lose the will to fight. Life with an interminably long sentence does that to you. Maybe they let hate swallow all their reason.
I didn't expect her to still be sane. But she was.
Multiple times, I saw her fall asleep reading out her deceased comrades' names, then bolt awake shouting those same names, but I never saw tears in her eyes. There was still fire in them. The longing to survive and change it all. It was a fire that burned away her sorrow, led her to triumph over despair.
I even doubt myself, owing to that. Am I too pessimistic? Maybe enough to forget I can lift my head, and behind Londinium's dark clouds, there are still a million morning stars waiting.
I'm convinced, tomorrow, or this evening, she'll attempt to make her break.
Kal'tsit. It's my belief I should help her. 

—Misery
text.zh:
伦蒂尼姆的情况很糟糕。是的，局势比我们设想的还要严峻。
特雷西斯采取了全面行动。食腐者率领的王庭军队正在伦蒂尼姆城外，与公爵们的军队相互钳制。
至于那支杀死了Outcast的势力，深池，你的猜测是对的，他们果然与某几位贵族有联系。
看样子，他们正在找办法传信给特雷西斯，或许是想争取合作。
从我们之前获得的情报来看，特雷西斯在这个阶段与深池结盟的几率很低，他不会相信这个突然崛起的神秘组织的承诺，也不会自大到属意于除伦蒂尼姆之外的城市。
但我们不得不把最坏的可能性考虑在内。
维多利亚可能会被彻底撕成碎片。公爵们会被特雷西斯与深池，或者其他蹦出来的阴谋家挑动，整个国家陷入内乱。
显而易见，从特雷西斯接受那位大公爵的邀请进入伦蒂尼姆平叛开始，他就已经在盘算这一切。当时跟着他离开卡兹戴尔的萨卡兹只有一万人不到，而现在呢？伦蒂尼姆的军工厂正在没日没夜地为特雷西斯生产武器，食腐者挖掘的密道每天都在为特雷西斯输送从周边各国赶来的萨卡兹战士。
我们仍不知道特雷西斯具体的打算是什么，可一旦进入全面战争，这些被召集的战士里，活着离开伦蒂尼姆的能有几成？
而在战争结束后，即使维多利亚自顾不暇，萨卡兹也很难有什么好结果。目睹了特雷西斯对维多利亚的报复，卡兹戴尔会不会再度成为所有核心圈国家的靶子，迎来新的劫难？
我不知道，凯尔希，你和煌总说我想得太多，而我能做的事情从来都很有限。
关于特雷西斯和军事委员会的图谋，我相信Logos和阿斯卡纶比我更心急。目前我能做的只有继续跟着这支深池部队，弄清楚他们究竟想干什么。任何有价值的情报我都会立刻送回。你说过，等那位由Outcast从小丘郡救回来的德拉克准备好，她会给我们更多信息，甚至帮我们找到深池的真相。那么，我希望我取得的这些情报能让她尽快地下定决心。
对了，还有另一件事——我在那支深池部队的营地里发现了一位年轻的维多利亚军官，她的模样与风笛描述的“队长”十分接近。
出于谨慎，我观察了她一段时间。你也知道，特雷西斯之所以能长驱直入伦蒂尼姆，与伦蒂尼姆军队高层的支持密不可分。我相信风笛对她的队长很有感情，但我同样坚信，残酷的战争有可能将任何人的心智重新塑形。
她被深池严密地看管着，小丘郡的蔓德拉和她的手下经常辱骂和嘲笑她。也许是看在她作为谈判筹码仍有价值的份上，她并未经受过分的生理上的折磨。不，这样的说法并不合适。对一位年轻气盛的军官来说，没有什么刑罚比眼睁睁看着战友被屠戮殆尽，自己却落入敌手无法反抗更残酷。
过去我曾见过许多战俘，他们多数会在漫长且看不到尽头的监禁生活中丧失斗志，又或者任由仇恨吞没理智。
出乎我的意料，她至今仍然清醒。
我数次看到她念着死去战友的名字睡去，又呼喊着相同的名字惊醒，可我从未在她眼里见过泪水。她的眼睛里仍然有火，那是活下去改变一切的渴求。正是这把火焚干了悲痛，也令她战胜了绝望。
我甚至开始怀疑自己，我是不是太过悲观，以至于忘了抬头看一看，伦蒂尼姆的阴云背后，仍有万千晨星。
我确信，明天又或者是今天晚上，她会尝试着越狱。
凯尔希，我认为我该去帮她。

——Misery

text.en:
'Tactics sharpen the mind,
Discipline strengthens the will.
Bravery shall overcome evil,
Benevolence shall save lives.'
We've found out, from Horn personally, that these are the Tempest Platoon of Victoria's maxims.
Any Operators who've fought side by side with Bagpipe are sure to be intimately familiar with those phrases. After having learned of Bagpipe's experiences over the past several months, Horn fell into a prolonged silence.
'I knew she'd follow orders and press on the whole way, but I didn't... think it'd force her to retire from duty.'
Horn said little more regarding Bagpipe's choice, or Victoria's situation, or the emergence of traitors in the Army.
She still throws herself into battle after battle, but in the intervals between combat, we often see her laughing as she chats with her fellow soldiers. Horn has a unique sense of humor, always able to find something to say that makes others crack a smile, no matter how grave the situation. This has quickly closed the distance between her and everyone else.
All soldiers, regardless of their birthplace, whether city defense or ordinary workers, or even Rhodes Island operators from other nations' lands, find it easy as could be to relax around Horn.
This isn't solely due to her combat and command ability that inspire confidence, nor her admirable uprightness and strength, but moreso her uncanny ability to see through her soldiers' worries and fears at a blink, and use appropriate methods to help adjust everyone's moods.
However, we've gradually begun to worry for her. Who'll be there to ease her mind?
She's transformed herself into the shield she bears, firm, steady, and seemingly forever to be the last one standing.
But there's only so much time any armament has.
When a human's forced herself to the extreme, and been stressed for too long, what will happen to her the instant the pressure on her disappears?
If possible, we'd like it for Horn not just to bring joy to everyone, but to be able to share any pain with us too, as her fellow operators do.
Perhaps, after reading this file, it'll be in you to reach out to her. To not just bring her to stand side by side with you on the battlefield, but to invite her with you, to truly enjoy even the briefest moments of respite.
text.zh:
“战术使人思维明晰，
纪律使人意志坚定。
勇敢能够击溃邪恶，
仁慈能够拯救生命。”
从号角口中，我们得知，这是维多利亚风暴突击队的格言。
与风笛一起并肩战斗过的干员们，一定都对这几句话很熟悉。在得知风笛这大半年的经历之后，号角陷入了长时间的沉默。
“我知道她会遵守命令一路坚持下去，但我没有想到……这反而逼得她不得不退役。”
关于风笛的选择，关于维多利亚的局势，关于军队里出现的叛徒，号角没有再多说什么。
她依然将自己投身于一场又一场的战斗中，而战斗的间隙，我们也常常看到她和其他战友们说笑。号角身上有一种特别的幽默感，总是能在一些看似严肃的场合说出令人忍俊不禁的话。这迅速地拉进了她和所有人的距离。
战士们，不管他们之前是什么出身，城防军，普通工人，又或者来自其他国家地区的罗德岛干员，都很容易在号角面前放松下来。
这不仅是因为她的作战能力与指挥能力值得信任，也不仅是因为她的正直与坚强令人敬佩，更是因为她总能一眼看穿战士们的焦虑与恐惧，并用恰当的方式调动大家的情绪。
可是，我们渐渐开始担心，又有谁能安抚她呢？
她把自己变成了手中的盾，坚硬、稳定，看起来永远不会先于其他人倒下。
然而所有武器都有使用期限。
当一个人把自己逼到了极致，又绷了太久，在外部的压力消失的那一刻，她会怎么样？
如果有可能的话，我们希望号角能像其他干员一样，不仅将欢乐带给大家，也能将痛苦与我们分享。
或许，看到这份档案的你能向她伸出手，除了拉着她并肩上战场，也能邀请她一起，真正地享受哪怕很短暂的休憩时光。

text.en:
A letter's just arrived at Rhodes Island, with a photo the only thing inside.
In it, there's an elegant and lively noble girl, wearing a light dress skirt, red shoes, lying about on a deep green lawn.
Towering maples shelter her from the sunlight, and a sword is left by her side, along with two books strewn about—a copy of Military History of the Empire, and a fashion catalog for the season. The catalog appears clearly brand new, used to rest her feet on, while Military History of the Empire has been read to the point its spine is half-cracked.
Though quite a ways from her current dress style, I can still tell at a glance that this girl with her eyes half-shut is our very Horn.
Just who was it that sent this letter?
'To my darling Rita'—a single line written on the reverse, in resplendent but unfamiliar handwriting.
Who learned of Horn's partnership with Rhodes Island so quickly? Our Messengers were just dispatched, and Bagpipe might not even know her leader's still alive, let alone that we've been active in Londinium.
Whoever it is, I anticipate them to have known Horn well, and kept a watch on her all this time, as well as Rhodes Island.
I'll take this letter as means to launch an investigation. I can only hope its sender has no overbearing ill will or more troubling motive.
But no matter the case... when I saw this photograph, I couldn't help but think, deep down, about how such a lovable aspect existed to the ever-stern, proper Horn.
text.zh:
罗德岛刚刚收到了一封信，信封里只有一张照片。
照片里是一位活泼秀美的贵族少女，穿着轻薄的长裙，赤着双足，躺在碧绿的草地上。
高大的槭树为她遮挡着阳光，她的手边放着一柄剑，还散落着两本书——一本《帝国军事史》和一本当季流行服饰的购物图册。图册明显是崭新的，用来垫着鞋，《帝国军事史》却已翻得书脊半裂。
虽然与现在的着装风格有着不小的差异，但我依然一眼认出，那位半眯着眼的少女，就是号角。
寄出这封信的人究竟是谁呢？
“给亲爱的丽塔”——照片背面写着这样一行字，字迹华丽而陌生。
到底是谁这么快就得知了号角与罗德岛合作？我们的信使才刚上路，恐怕就连风笛都不知道自己的队长还活着，更不会了解我们在伦蒂尼姆做了什么。
这个人，恐怕过去就与号角熟识，并且一直在关注着她，同时关注着罗德岛。
我会就这封匿名信展开调查，但愿寄信人没有什么太强的恶意和更可怕的图谋。
但不管怎么说……在看到这张照片的时候，我还是忍不住心想，原来严肃正经的号角小姐也有这么可爱的一面啊。

value.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。
