text.en:
Qiubai, swordswoman, born in a river fort near the Yanese city of Jiangqi, later left her hometown due to changes in her family and travels the country year-round without a fixed residence or job.
On investigation, Qiubai had already been in contact with several Operators in separate incidents, and later accepted Rhodes Island's invitation to cooperate and provide support to our various affairs in Yan.
text.zh:
仇白，剑客，出生于炎国姜齐城附近的水寨，后因家庭变故离开故乡，常年行走于炎国各地，并无固定居所与工作。
经调查，仇白曾在不同事件中与多位干员有过接触，后接受罗德岛的合作邀请，为罗德岛在炎国境内的各项事务提供支持。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, the operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Qiubai shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.13u/L
Operator Qiubai rarely comes into contact with Originium.

I hear that she's often out in the wilderness... maybe her aura of chivalry is so strong that Oripathy has no effect on her. Or maybe I'm just spouting nonsense. She definitely has plenty of experience from running around her old stomping grounds, and is pretty good at protecting herself.
—A certain Medical Operator
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员仇白没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.13u/L
干员仇白甚少接触源石。

听说仇白干员经常在荒野上奔行……可能行侠仗义的人，矿石病会绕着她走吧。我瞎说的，她常年跑江湖，有经验了，自我防护工作做得挺好的。
——某医疗干员

text.en:
We came into contact with Qiubai during an incident in the Yanese city of Kou-wu, and subsequently extended an invitation for her to collaborate with us. Afterwards, we were surprised to discover that she had been involved in another incident six months ago in a village in the northwestern part of Yan with Operators Saga, Wind Chimes, and Mulberry, and even had interactions with Operators Chongyue and Lin... We must have fate to thank for her to not refusing our invitation.
As for the Kou-wu city incident, the operators involved have said that... it was pretty impressive.
At the time, some office operators were about to purchase a batch of special medicinal herbs, but after getting in touch with the farmers a certain major herb dealer in Kou-wu city stopped our transaction. The merchant brought out a contract with the farmers signed years ago, that stipulated any sales or transfers of goods as well as other matters had to be agreed upon by both parties beforehand. In short, there was no way for us to get around his terms, and the price he offered was nearly three times greater than what the farmers would have taken. We also learned that he seemed to have engaged in even more nefarious business practices in the area under the table... Whether in regards to profit or ideals, we could not accept such a person as our partner.
The procurement came to an impasse, but a solution came out of nowhere. A swordswoman had applied to be a senior bodyguard for the merchant, and when she demonstrated her skills, she accidentally drove the scabbard of her longsword through the merchant's hair and nailed him straight onto the wall. Then they spoke for a full minute while in that position. We have no way of knowing what they talked about, except that the merchant informed the farmer the very next day that he had unilaterally rescinded the contract. He then fired the swordswoman and did not hold her responsible for what seemed to be simply the innocuous accident of a poorly-educated individual.
Although we'd actually already been collecting relevant evidence... In any case, it was a boon for Rhodes Island as we urgently needed the batch of herbs, so we located the swordswoman to thank her.
Everything else fell into place after that.
text.zh:
我们在炎国勾吴城的某起事件中接触到了仇白，随后向她发出了合作邀请。然后我们才惊喜地发现，早在半年之前，仇白便与干员嵯峨、干员铎铃、干员桑葚等人共同卷入过发生在西北山村的另外一起事件，也与干员重岳、干员林在玉门有过往来……感谢缘分，她没有拒绝我们的邀请。
至于勾吴城的那件事，当时参与的干员纷纷表示……印象蛮深刻的。
当时，办事处的干员正要采购一批特殊药材，在与药农取得联系后，勾吴城的某位药材大商人叫停了我们的合作。商人手中握有一份早年签订的协议，在条款中对转销转产等诸多事项进行了连带规定……简而言之，罗德岛的采购没办法绕过他，而他开出的收购价与药农所得之间，有着近乎三倍的价差。我们进一步了解到，他在当地似乎有着更多不能放在台面上的恶劣行径……无论从利润，还是情理的角度考虑，我们都无法接受这样的人成为我们的合作对象。
采购之事陷入了僵局，但解决得也很突然……一位剑客应聘了商人的高级保镖，剑客在展示业务能力的时候，不小心将长剑的剑鞘贯穿了商人的发髻，直钉入墙，商人保持着“头悬剑柄”的姿势和剑客进行了长达一分钟的交谈。我们无从得知交谈的内容，只知道商人次日便通知药农，单方面解除了那份协议。随后，他开除了剑客，也并未追究她的责任，毕竟那看起来确实只是一个学艺不精的人闹出的不痛不痒的意外。
其实我们当时已经在搜集相关证据……总之事情能早点解决，对急需那批药材的罗德岛来说自然是件好事，所以我们找到了剑客，向她表达了谢意。
后来的事情就顺理成章了。

text.en:
Operator Qiubai is not proficient in Originium Arts, and has not displayed any related abilities in combat tests or on missions. At first we thought she was just holding back, and it was understandable that someone so accustomed to being alone would be wary of showing her full power while working with others. But afterwards, we found out that in combat she really relies solely on the longsword in her hands. All the operators who have worked with her say that she is 'good with the sword' but how good exactly was not easy to describe, or rather, there was not much else that could be said.
We have seen Qiubai surrounded by operators several times, being asked if she had cool yet unintelligible names for her moves like 'flying snow sword technique' or 'cut the flow of a thousand rivers,' all while she appeared rather exasperated. Their behavior may have stemmed from an unintentional stereotype—that the beautiful yet lethal kung fu styles of Yan were granted by the heavens and have been passed down from generation to generation. The culprits are a certain 'Xia' genre of Yanese fiction, the names of Operator Chen's sword techniques, and Operator Mr. Nothing's usual way of explaining things.
Regarding the characteristics of Qiubai's sword style, we can only summarize it as 'to strike at the most opportune time.' This was most evident in a recent combat test: she barely maintained a defensive posture while flanked by two Defender operators, and once she spotted an opening, pounced on it to disarm their shields with her sword. In a subsequent match with a Caster with suppression abilities, Qiubai wielded only a sword. The Caster had no time to cast their Arts before the blade was already at their throat. From the way she holds her sword, to the way she strikes with it, to the amount of strength she uses or the angle she strikes from... by any standard, Qiubai is wholly unconcerned with any long-established 'swordplay' techniques. Her moves are not aesthetically pleasing, but rather extremely simple, concise, agile, and efficient—concerned with seizing any chance of victory from the edge of death. Considering her history, it is not difficult to surmise that her style was developed from years of 'experience' accumulated from her brushes with life and death. I can't imagine more than a few people would willingly experience such a life.

'My teacher? You mean my enemies? They're all dead... Well, except for one.'
text.zh:
干员仇白并不擅长源石技艺，起码在战斗测试及截至目前的任务中，她并未展现与之相关的能力。起初我们以为她只是有所保留，像她这样习惯了独来独往的人，对合作对象怀有戒心，倒也能够理解。但随后我们发现，仇白在战斗中，确实只依靠手中的长剑。和她一起出过任务的干员无一例外地评价她“剑法高强”，但怎么个高强法，其实不太好说，或者说，没什么好说的。
我们多次见到仇白被一堆干员围在中间的场面，当被追问自己的剑术是不是有个不知所云但是很酷的名字，比如“飞雪剑法”“千江断流剑法”时，她露出了非常无奈的表情。干员们的行为可能是缘于某种无意间形成的刻板印象——兼具美感与杀伤力的炎国武功都是脱胎于天地胜迹，代代相传。罪魁祸首是一种不知怎么就在罗德岛上流行开来的，名为“侠”的炎国小说门类和影视作品、干员陈的剑术名称，以及干员乌有平时不遗余力的科普……
干员仇白的剑术特征，我们似乎只能简单概括为……“在最合适的时机出剑”。这在最近的一次战斗测试中体现得最为明显：她在两位重装干员的合围下勉强维持着守势，看准机会制造出空当，趁机用剑卸下了对方的盾；在随后对抗作战能力具有压制效果的术师干员时，仇白只出了一剑。术师干员压根没来得及发动源石技艺，剑已经横在了自己的要害上。用剑姿势、发力方式、力道、角度……无论以什么标准来判断，仇白都不讲究形成所谓“剑法”的系统性技巧，她出招不求美感，异常简洁、洗练，且高效，在死亡的边缘寻找并攥紧制胜的机会。结合她此前的履历，不难判断，这样的剑术，显然来自她多年来与生死打交道的“经验”积累，我想没几个正常人愿意体验那样的生活。

“老师？你是问我的那些敌人？他们都死了……哦，有一个除外。”

text.en:
Operator Qiubai's main responsibility is to assist with Rhodes Island's affairs in Yan, so opportunities to spot her on the landship are few. And so, on one occasion when she returned to the landship to submit her reports and hand over her duties, the Logistics Department spotted a couple of people sneaking around her dormitory quarters—
'We just wanted to see if she would actually sleep on the rafters.'
'Nonsense, obviously she just needs a rope as thick as your thumb. She can attach both ends to a wall and lie down to sleep on the taut rope!'
'We really had no ill intentions!'
—Here again is an example of an inexplicably deep-rooted stereotype, but we have seriously educated the individuals involved.
Qiubai does not have any such a bizarre sleeping habits, other than always keeping her sword within arm's reach. That said, it should be noted that her standards for a living environment are very low, and she has barely modified the temporary dormitory arranged for her on Rhodes Island. When she does return to the landship, she also does not take the opportunity to socialize, instead volunteering to keep a lookout. Her lifestyle is as simple as her swordplay.
According to the operator that was on duty with Qiubai, she would sit down on the bridge and fish out a whetstone from her sleeves like it was the most natural thing, and the sound of her sharpening her sword echoed across the bridge. The operator was trembling and sat down opposite her, but ended up falling asleep to the sound. He tried to explain to everyone that Qiubai was not as aloof as she seems, for the two of them had talked for quite a bit before he fell asleep. Although he had forgotten what exactly they talked about, Qiubai had showed off the differences of each Yanese dialect: Shangshu is soft, while Yumen is rough, Lungmen is rich in their tones, while Jiangqi and Dusk City also have their own unique characteristics. This is consistent with Qiubai's statement during her personnel audit that she has traveled all over Yan, and though she has not stayed anywhere for long and has no plans to, she has still been a positive force in the lives of many people, for no particular reason. 'After this, I will head to my next destination. All I need is this sword, and there will always be somewhere it's needed. I'm used to this.'
'In Yan, this is what they call 'to walk the jianghu is to walk the path of chivalry,' right? Oh, I know, Qiubai is the chivalrous warrior that Mr. Nothing always talks about!'
'Qiubai, how many chivalrous people like you are there in Yan?'
'......Best to have none at all.'
text.zh:
干员仇白主要负责协助处理罗德岛在炎国境内的事务，在本舰上见到她的机会很少。于是，在某次仇白回本舰汇报并交接任务时，后勤部在她的宿舍门口发现了几个鬼鬼祟祟张望的家伙——
“我们只是想看看仇白小姐会不会真的在房梁上睡觉。”
“胡说，明明是将一根拇指粗细的绳子的两端插入墙壁，然后躺在绷直的绳子上睡觉！”
“我们真的没有恶意！”
——同样来自一些已经根深蒂固的刻板印象，已经很难解释清楚，但我们对相关人员进行了严肃的教育。
仇白在睡眠方面并没有那么奇怪的癖好，除了那把从不离身的长剑必须放在自己触手可及的位置……应该说，仇白对于起居环境的要求很低，罗德岛为她安排的临时宿舍，她几乎没有做任何布置。回到本舰时，她也没有趁机多参加一些社交活动，甚至主动承担了守夜的任务，她的生活状态和她的剑术一样简单。
据和仇白共同值班的干员描述，仇白在舰桥上坐下，很自然地从怀里掏出了一块磨刀石，舰桥上回荡着她洗磨自己那把长剑的声音。该干员战战兢兢地在她对面坐下……最后就在那规律的背景音中睡着了。该干员努力地向大家说明，仇白其实不像表面上那么冷漠，在他没有睡着的上半夜，两个人聊了不少话题。虽然已经忘了怎么聊到的，但仇白甚至向他认真展示了炎国好几种方言之间的区别：尚蜀话温软，玉门话粗粝，龙门话音节丰富，姜齐话、夕城话各有特色……这与仇白接受人事审核时的说法一致，她几乎走遍了整个大炎，尽管以前没有在哪个地方长久停留，以后想必也不会，但她依然融入了许多人的生活，为他们提供过帮助。没什么特别的原因，“此间事了，再去下一个地方，我只有这把剑，可总是有需要这把剑的地方。习惯了。”
“炎国话叫‘行走江湖，行侠仗义’吧——我懂了，仇白小姐正是乌有常说的那种侠客！”
“仇白小姐，炎国有多少你这样的侠客？”
“……最好一个也没有。”

text.en:
We invited Qiubai to a movie screening, originally intending to consult her about some details since the movie is based on wandering Yanese vigilantes, with a theme that went something like 'disperse all grievances to live a life of normalcy.' After the screening, Qiubai did not comment on how the film was shot, the architecture or the costume props, or even the cultural nuances, but merely expressed her disdain for the story itself. She could not accept that the characters would simply get into fights, have drinks, say some words and then bury the hatchet, with all grudges and gratitude as well as good and evil 'lost in the wine'.
'If it were that simple, all it means is that their resentment wasn't worth a thing... Oh, don't mind me, the movie was pretty good, I just didn't like it.'
—Records from a Rhodes Island movie enthusiast club

In order to ensure that the files were as thorough and accurate as possible when they were archived, HR did a background check on some of the more obscure parts of Qiubai's history. More than a decade ago, pirates occupied an area of Jiangqi city in Yan, building river forts and colluding with each other to control nearly half the waterways, robbing all the merchants that traveled to and from the city. The Yanese government mobilized a force from all over the country, including Chongyue who happened to be passing by at that time while on duty, and launched a purge on the Jiangqi pirates, covering hundreds of li. All those who resisted were disposed of, with the rest arrested, and Yanese state officials varied their sentences accordingly, letting off the people who had merely been coerced to return to farming after their investigation was done. The families of the pirates were taken care of, and their young ones properly raised and educated. But when the list was checked, one of the pirate leader's daughters had disappeared in the confusion, though we know what happened after, for she had went to Yumen.
As a teenage girl, she traveled from Jiangqi to Yumen, a distance of thousands of li over a period of five years. By the time she reached Yumen, her amazing swordplay was already beginning to take shape. What happened on that journey, Qiubai has not told us in detail, but it was presumably not your average road trip. She also stayed in Yumen City for a full five years, not to exact her 'revenge,' but to participate in several emergency defense operations in Yumen. As far as we know, Chongyue had sent relevant documents to various agencies, explaining her situation before his resignation. Any further details were not told to us by either party, but it was unlikely to be the sort of movie scene where they met and laughed off their past grudges.
Of course, this is a personal matter between the two of them, and after confirming their respective attitudes and making sure they would not come to a blows in Rhodes Island over their old grudges, HR did not pry any further. But we still remember her final words at the time: 'Hatred has long been unworthy of my sword.'
text.zh:
我们邀请仇白小姐参加观影会，本意是想在涉及一些细节的讨论时，能够向她求证，毕竟那部电影取材于炎国游侠，主题是“恩怨散尽江湖归隐”什么的。放映结束后，仇白小姐没有对电影的拍摄手法、建筑与服装原型、风土人情细节等作出评价，但直截了当地表达了对故事本身的厌恶。她无法接受角色们在电影的最后仅仅是打了场架、喝了顿酒、说了些话就冰释前嫌，此前浓墨重彩刻画的恩与怨、善与恶就“都在酒里了”。
“要真有那么简单，只能说明那些所谓的恩怨善恶本身就不值一提……哦，你们别介意，电影拍得挺好的，只是我不喜欢。”
——罗德岛某观影兴趣小组的记录

为了尽可能保证档案在归档时的详尽和准确，人事部在整理仇白的干员资料时，就她经历中一些比较模糊的部分进行了查证。十多年前，炎国姜齐城一带，水匪占据汀州地形，建起水寨，彼此之间勾连呼应，实际上控制了近半数的水道，劫掠往来的客商。炎国政府从各地调取了足够的人手，包括了当时正好因述职经过当地的重岳先生，对姜齐水匪开展了一起覆盖数百里的清剿行动。负隅顽抗的匪首尽数伏诛，对于归案的匪众，炎国官方分级量刑，其中那些受到胁迫无辜牵连进来的成员，在审核无误之后，全部返农返工。对于匪首的家属，当地也予以妥善安置，对年幼者进行抚养教育。但最后核验名单时，有一位匪首的女儿在混乱中失踪了……后来的事情我们也都知道了，她去到了玉门。
一个十多岁的少女，从姜齐到玉门，中间数千里的距离，她走了足足五年的时间。到达玉门的时候，如今那样惊人的剑术已经初具形貌。这中间经历了什么，仇白并没有向我们细说，但想必不会是什么走走停停的愉快旅行。她在玉门城同样待了足足五年，非但没有“报仇”，反而在好几次突发事件中为保卫玉门出过力。据我们了解，卸任之前，重岳先生已经向有关机构寄送了相关材料，说明了仇白的情况。这中间更多的细节，重岳先生与仇白并没有向我们细说，但想必不会是什么相逢一笑泯恩仇的电影桥段。
当然，这毕竟是两位干员的私事，在确认了各自的态度，确保他们不会在罗德岛因旧事而冲突后，人事部也就不再过多干涉。但我们记下了仇白最后的那句话：“仇恨早已不值得我出剑。”

text.en:
By chance, we were given some dated information, but possibly related to the pirates in Jiangqi—
More than thirty years ago, a merchant had reported to his local government that his young adult daughter had disappeared while passing through the waterways on a cargo ship to visit family, and was never found.

'Enmity rises from the struggle between good and evil, but where does such a cycle end, or begin? 'Good and evil are both hard to judge' is merely a useless lament, and thus the reason why I wield my sword.'
text.zh:
一个偶然的机会，我们得到了一份年代久远，但可能与姜齐匪患相关的资料——
大概三十多年前，一位商人向当地政府报案，自己成年不久的女儿随货船远行探亲，在经过姜齐附近的水道时失踪，从此下落不明。

“善恶之争生出恩怨，这样的循环，到何处终，自何处始？‘善恶难断’只是一句无用的感喟，这是我现在执剑的理由。”

value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Confirmed Infected by medical examination.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

text.en: Wind Chimes, a Messenger who travels around northwestern Yan, allowing remote villages to communicate with each other. She came to Rhodes Island for Oripathy treatment and now works part-time as a Messenger for Rhodes Island.
text.zh: 铎铃，奔波在炎国西北部的乡村信使，曾使数个闭塞的村庄获得了相对通畅的信息交流。因矿石病来罗德岛求医，现兼职为罗德岛提供信使服务。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 7%
Crystal distribution clearly visible on the abdomen.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.19u/L
Considering the location of the Oripathy lesions, the patient should refrain from heavy lifting or work that requires the use of her core muscles.
—Sussurro
Yeah, no way that's happening.
—Wind Chimes
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】7%
干员铎铃腹部可见明显源石结晶分布。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.19u/L
考虑到病灶的位置，患者应尽量避免需要调动核心肌群的负重工作。
——苏苏洛
呃，这个真做不到。
——铎铃

text.en:
A Messenger from a mountain village in the northwestern region of Yan. Travel-worn, but still friendly to everyone she meets.
The northwestern region is full of mountains with villages big and small sparsely scattered all over, unable to communicate effectively with each other unlike the villages in Jiangnan with their waterways. Even land transportation is extremely inconvenient, and Wind Chimes was born in one of those villages.
With her good grades, the steadfast Wind Chimes was admitted to a school in a nomadic city. However, after studying for a few years she gave up her chance of further education and returned to her hometown to work as the village's Messenger.
Young and strong, she trekked the mountain paths to figure out a way to make travelling between the nearby villages easier. On top of that, she also tried to open an agricultural trade route between the villages and nomadic cities, but it did not work out.
She had been recounting her experience in her usual frank manner up till this point where she fell silent. We assumed that high logistics costs were the main reason she had failed to achieve her goal, but that was just the most direct, yet least important reason for her plans going awry.
'I promised the official in charge of commerce and trade that a village representative would come to the city for discussion. Then I excitedly returned to the village, but was greeted with the sight of several factory recruitment notices and a whole stack of signed recruitment contracts at the village headman's place. I looked at the signatures and they were all dated within a few days of my departure.'
text.zh:
出身于炎国西北山村的炎国信使。总是风尘仆仆，待人接物却很亲切。
炎国西北多山，大大小小的村庄散落其间，无法像江南一样依托水道相互交流，甚至连陆路交通也极为不便，铎铃出生的村落也是其中之一。
性格踏实的铎铃以不错的成绩考入移动城市的学校。不过，读了几年书之后，她放弃了继续深造的机会，而是回到家乡，担负起了村庄信使的工作。
年轻力壮的她付出了相当的努力，探索出了数条方便邻近村庄通行的山道。在此基础上，她还试图打开村庄与城市之间的农产品商贸通道，但最终未能如愿。
一向直来直去的她在述说到此时陷入了沉默。我们以为她未能达成目标的原因是运输成本过高，但这只是计划受挫最直接，也最不重要的原因。
“我答应主管商贸的官员，让村里管事的人来城里和他谈。我兴冲冲地回到村里，可迎接我的是好几个工厂招工的看板，还有村长家一整摞签好的招工合同。我仔细看了看签字的日期，都是我出发后没几天签好的。”

text.en:
As a child, Wind Chimes was fond of the Messengers coming to and from the village, and even learned to read from the words on the envelopes. To her, it was the letters, or more precisely, the greetings, news, and emotions in them that connected those who had traveled far from their villages to their homes.
With such experiences and a steadfast and kindhearted personality, her setback only set her sights on a much broader and rugged place—she tried to become the regional Messenger of the entire mountainous region around her hometown.
After a testing period, she quickly attained the position in an official capacity, and held a year-long record of zero missed deliveries until it was broken by a pack of hungry tuskbeasts.
After returning to the city, Wind Chimes asked her colleagues for advice on how to avoid the beasts. However, before she could break her own record again, another incident happened.
She ran into a group of bandits.
'I was blindfolded, and yelling at them till my voice was hoarse to leave the letters alone. The goods could be replaced, but if the letters were destroyed, the words within could never be replaced.
'No, the bandit chief didn't laugh like the ones you see on television. He even told me somewhat sincerely that it was not possible. He didn't kill the official, but didn't leave the officers even a scrap of information, because in his line of work, he could easily lose his head from a little carelessness.'
'I heard the sound of paper going up in flames, and I knew right then that it was time for me to buy a sword.'
Since then, her colleagues would occasionally see fresh wounds on her, but the goods and letters she carried were never lost again.
text.zh:
铎铃幼时就对来往村庄的信使颇有好感，连认字都是从信封上的字开始的。在她看来，正是一封封信，更确切地说，是信中的问候、消息和情感，将那些离乡远行的人与他们的家连在一起。
这样的经历与踏实善良的性格，让她在遭遇挫折之后，将目光投向了更广阔，也更崎岖的地方——她试图承担起故乡周围整片山区的信使工作。
经过一段时间的测试，她很快获得了正式编制，并在整整一年的时间里保持着无一件漏送错送的记录，直到这个记录因一群饥肠辘辘的牙兽被打破。
回城之后，铎铃向同僚们请教了各种避开野兽的技巧。然而，在马上就要打破自己创造的记录之前，她又出事了。
她遇上了一群盗匪。
“我被蒙着眼睛，声嘶力竭地问他们能不能把信留下。货物也许还能补上。可信丢了，信里写着的东西就再也回不来了。”
“不，那个头领没像剧集的反派那样哈哈大笑什么的。他甚至有些诚恳地跟我说，不行。他不杀官差，但同样也不会给官差留一丁点把柄，因为他干的是把脑袋别在裤腰带上的生意。”
“听着纸张燃烧的声音，我知道，是时候给自己买把刀了。”
在那之后，同僚们时而能看到她身上的新伤，但她运送的货物与信件再也没丢过。

text.en:
In order to ensure the safety and communication between the nomadic cities in Yan, maintenance and construction work on Chidao both old and new is a never ending project, from which countless business opportunities and life-changing chances emerge. For those especially who do not live in a nomadic city, the compensation for helping out with the Chidao is often enough to make a considerable leap in their standard of living. Though after such a change, there comes the question on how to maintain the new status quo.
Most settled communities often want long-term contracts with the Chidao maintenance agency, but such opportunities are rare.
For the more proactive people, getting a glimpse of the Chidao and the fragments of the nomadic cities they bring renders them unable to hold back their aspirations. Many young people and even those older follow the Chidao on their journey to the nomadic cities. An entire village moving to a city like in Wind Chime's case is certainly a bit extreme, but it is by no means unheard of.
Wind Chimes gets dejected at the sight of one deserted village after another, but she also understands that those people have the right to pursue a better life.
What she could do, then, was to send back wanders's money and letters together to their parents, and then deliver their words as well as letters from others with huge bags of dried meat back to the city.
An old man was calculating his money under the light of an oil lamp, pondering over what farming equipment to purchase, what crops to grow, if he should use an entire barrel of soy sauce to pickle meat, and eventually decided to use a majority of the funds to rear some livestock; a young person was lying in bed exhausted, watching a beautiful life depicted on the television screen, subconsciously going through an entire packet of dried meat while talking to themselves with a few hints of their rusty native tongue.
At that moment, Wind Chimes was out in the wilderness travelling between cities. The twin moons shone overhead, the mountains stretched in all directions, and the night breeze blew through the thin clothing she had chosen to keep her journey lighter.
text.zh:
在炎国，为了保障移动城市的安全与顺畅的交流，旧驰道的维护与新驰道的修建是一项永不停息的浩大工程，无数商机与改变命运的机会从中涌现。尤其是对那些不生活在移动城市中的人们来说，帮助修建驰道所获得的报酬常常足以让他们的生活水平完成一次质的飞跃。而在这样的飞跃完成之后，如何维持现状，就成了不得不面对的问题。
更加安土重迁的群体通常希望与负责驰道维护的机构签订长期维护合同，但这样的机会不会太多。
而那些心思更活络的人，在见识过驰道和驰道带来的移动城市的一鳞半爪之后，大多无法按捺心中的憧憬。许多年轻人，乃至不那么年轻的人，都循着驰道踏上了前往移动城市的旅途。像铎铃故乡那样全村进城的情况固然有些极端，但也绝非孤例。
铎铃会为一个又一个凋零的村庄黯然神伤，但她也明白，人都有追求幸福生活的权利。
她能做的，是将游子的钱款和信一起送到父母手中，再将父母口述、他人代笔的书信与大包大包的肉干送回城市。
老人在油灯下盘算着用这些钱换哪些农具、种什么庄稼，想到为了腌肉用光的一整桶酱油，决定用大头来添置牧兽；年轻人带着一身疲惫躺在床上，看着电视里美好的生活，不知不觉吃光了一整包肉干，自言自语中夹带了几丝渐渐生疏的乡音。
而此时的铎铃正踽踽跋涉在城市与荒地之间。头顶双月当空，眼前山脉横亘，夜风穿过她为了负重特意穿少的衣衫。

text.en:
There is a Moushan Village in the area that Wind Chimes works. When she was there to deliver a huge sum of money, the village was in chaos. However, the uproar did not concern her much and she quickly moved on after dropping off the money, for there were many more deliveries to make.
Only later did she learn that there was a cruel connection between the teenager she had parted on bad terms with and the baffling commotion in the village.
She spent an entire day watching the footage in the young man's camera: the scenery, the monologue, the interview, the little stunt of pretending the camera was off while leaving the microphone on, and the 'apology letter.'
After that, Wind Chimes started bringing the camera everywhere.
At first, her experience was limited to filming deliveries. She is not a film enthusiast, so it was not surprising for her to assume the camera was broken because the lens cap was not on. But still, she persevered with the same tenacity she traversed the mountains with, and went from filming goods, to people, and then the roads she traveled, and the memory card soon ran out of space.
The more videos she shot, the more she regretted her actions back then. Naivety is not arrogance, but willful ignorance is.
However, when she was asked if she wanted to sell the rights of her footage to companies, she merely laughed at the thought.
She knew that her work was shining a spotlight on the daily isolation and poverty of the villages, as well as the foundations of her nostalgia. She would not cut herself any slack, but did not want to publicize it either. These images were ruthless, but also extremely valuable to her.
As for that disturbance, none of the Rhodes Island operators involved in the incident have spoken much about it. We only found out her opinion on the matter when Wind Chimes talked about it in a conversation with others.
'I remember it all, I'll never forget it. But that person's death... was purely an accident.'
'If I didn't deliver the money, what else could they have done?'
'I can't think of anything else.'
text.zh:
在铎铃负责联络的区域内，有一个名为谋善村的小小村落。她把一大笔补贴送到谋善村时，那里正乱作一团。不过，村里的喧哗与混乱与她并无太大关系，她把钱送到后也未作停留，还有更多东西等着她送到该送的地方。
后来她才知道，那位与她不欢而散的少年和那场让她莫名其妙的骚动中间，还存在着残酷的联系。
她花了一整天看完了少年摄像机里面存着的所有东西，风景，独白，采访，说好关掉摄像机却还开着麦克风的小小的狡黠，还有那段“道歉信”。
在那之后，铎铃开始把摄像机带在身上。
一开始，她对摄影的了解仅限于给送到别人手上的快件拍照片。她不是电影爱好者，关着镜头盖以为摄像机坏了的事也不是没干过。但她还是凭着当年为村子走通山路的那一股韧劲坚持了下来，从拍货到拍人，再到拍自己走过的路，存储卡很快就不够用了。
随着拍过的东西越来越多，她也越来越为自己当时的举动后悔。一无所知不是傲慢，闭目塞听才是。
然而，当有人问她要不要把拍下来的东西投给资方的时候，她只是笑了笑。
她知道，自己的工作正在日复一日地撬动闭塞，撬动贫困，撬动她怀恋的生活的地基。她不会放弃用影像记录地基的松动，但她也不太想将其公之于众。这些影像对她而言带着些残忍，同时也弥足珍贵。
至于那场骚动，罗德岛上与之相关的干员们都不大提起。有一次，铎铃碰巧和其他人聊到此事，我们才知道她对那件事的看法。
“我都记着，我不会忘。但那个人的死……毕竟是一场偶然。
“如果我没送到那笔钱，他们除了那么做，还能有什么法子？
“我想不出来。”

text.en:
When Wind Chimes first started working the camera, the file names were way too long. For the sake of brevity, we have helped to rename her files stored on Rhodes Island in a numerical fashion with her original file names in the videos' metadata.

0007: The 'tractor' put together by two mischievous people in Moushan Village. I'm a little afraid they'll actually try to drive that thing on the mountain roads, it's too dangerous.
0008: There was a small flower on the side of the mountain path. I wanted to film the flower blooming just like I'd seen in another video, but it took too long. I held the camera up till my arms ached and it didn't even change a bit.
0009: A fowlbeast suddenly leapt over my head. I didn't get it on video, but managed to record its cry. It's a nice sound.
0010: I went to have a second look, and the flower had already withered... so fast?
0011: Someone walking on the mountain road. Had a few words with him. He said he was heading to town to procure some farming equipment for his village, like a planter or weeder or something else he didn't know the name of. We debated over the name for half a day and still didn't manage to figure it out.
0012: Road

[Classified Log]
'I'm sorry, Wind Chimes, you're not here right now, but the name of this video is really different than the usual, so I really can't help but be curious... Besides, back then when I asked you about it, you just said 'it's all scenery, but you can look if you really want to', right?'
...
'What the... it's just a barren forest? But why does she keep her camera's focus on the traces of that campsite?'
text.zh:
铎铃刚开始用摄影机时给视频起的文件名太长。为了简洁，我们帮她给存储在罗德岛的视频编了号，把她原来起的文件名放在了视频的简介信息中。

0007：谋善村的两个淘气包拼凑的“拖拉机”。我有点怕他们两个真把那东西开上山道，太危险了。
0008：山道边有朵小花。我想学着之前看到过的视频那样拍下花的开放过程，可花开得太慢，我举到手酸也没看出什么变化。
0009：一只羽兽突然从我头顶蹿了过去。我没拍到羽兽，但录到了羽兽的叫声。好听。
0010：再去看的时候，花居然谢了……有这么快的吗？
0011：有人在山路上走。我和他攀谈了几句。他说要去镇上给村里置办一些农机，有播种机、除草机什么的，还有一种农机他不知道名字，我们相互比划了半天，最后也没搞清楚。
0012：路

【权限记录】
“抱歉啊铎铃，虽然你不在，但你这个视频的名字起得实在太与众不同，我真的按捺不住好奇心……而且我问你的时候你也说了，‘都是些风景，真想看也不是不行’，对吧。”
……
“什么呀，不就是一片荒林嘛。不过，她为什么要一直死盯着那点营地的痕迹拍啊？”

value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Confirmed Infected by medical examination.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

text.en: Former Sarkaz mercenary, Ines. She briefly participated in Kazdel's chaotic civil war, until faking her death and disappearing during the Chernobog Incident. She proceeded to conceal her tracks, but ultimately reestablished contact with Rhodes Island during the Londinium Incident. The details of her experiences in the meantime remain unverifiable, but with Ascalon's guarantee, she ultimately signed strategic cooperation terms with Rhodes Island.
text.zh: 前萨卡兹佣兵头目，伊内丝。曾短暂参与卡兹戴尔的混乱内战，直到切尔诺伯格事件时，她借助假死彻底消失在所有人的视野中。此后，伊内丝隐藏了自己的踪迹，但通过最近的伦蒂尼姆事件，她正式与罗德岛恢复了联系。期间她经历了什么无从查验，最后在阿斯卡纶的担保下与罗德岛签订了战略合作条款。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 11%
Ines's infection shows on her body, but she refuses to do any cosmetic concealment.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.21u/L
Due to her prolonged activities in the Kazdel region and extended exposure to the wilderness, Ines's infection status was predictable. However, much like W, her being Infected did not cause her much trouble.

Our medical operators attempted multiple times to assist her with comprehensive examinations in order to formulate an appropriate treatment plan. Unfortunately, her indifferent attitude, neither resisting nor cooperating, greatly frustrated the confidence of our colleagues in Medical. Especially when the examinations finally reached the crucial data collection phase, she would mysteriously vanish like a ghost, and remain absent for a long time afterward. Out of concern for the operator's well-being, we have reached out to her supervisory personnel in hopes of gaining assistance.
—A Medical Operator

Rejected. She knows the score.
—Operator Ascalon
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】11%
伊内丝有明显的感染迹象，但她本人拒绝留下任何样本。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.21u/L
因常年在卡兹戴尔地区活动，并且有长时间的野外暴露史，伊内丝的感染情况是可以预见的。但是如同W一样，感染者的身份对她并没有造成任何的困扰。

医疗部的干员曾经多次尝试帮助伊内丝进行全面的检查，以为其制定针对性的治疗方案。但遗憾的是，伊内丝不反对也不配合的冷淡态度让医疗部的同事信心受到了极大的挫败。尤其是每当检查好不容易进行到了关键数据的采集环节，她总是如鬼魅一般突然从所有人眼前消失，并在之后很长一段时间内都不再露面。为了干员的健康考虑，我们已经申请联络她的主管人员，希望得到协助。
——某位医疗部干员

驳回，她心中有数。
——阿斯卡纶

text.en:
When Ines first came to Rhodes Island, many colleagues were intrigued by this enigmatic operator who seemed to appear and disappear at will. Most shared the same question: What kind of woman could fight alongside W for such a long time?
And so, many of them attempted to approach her, but the result was many 'expert' trackers among the Lupos returning empty-handed. They could not determine Ines's whereabouts.
As the number of failed attempts increased, the operators on the ship started taking the 'Find Ines' game more seriously. After all, not everyone would willingly admit that the Sarkaz mercenary, who spent so much time in the wilds, possessed recon and counter-recon skills surpassing our well-trained operators.
Interviews with the participants all mentioned shadowy marks deliberately left by Ines during their attempts to track her. These marks laid bare what they held dear or feared deep in their hearts. There are no secrets before her, making the operators both fearful and grave when dealing with her.
In recent days, Dr. Kal'tsit finally intervened to put an end to these games. However, a simple tracking investigation is the least effective approach. I believe my understanding of Ines far surpasses that of the others.
I reexamined the progression of the entire incident and realized that most were drawn in by Ines's outstanding abilities and overlooked two major doubts.
Doubt one: Despite her extensive experience in intelligence work, she couldn't possibly have immediately familiarized herself with the full layout of the ship upon her arrival at Rhodes Island, let alone better than the operators who had lived on board for years. I speculate that Ines must have boarded this ship a long time ago, possibly spending a significant period of time here. Considering she faked death records, I also have a bolder hypothesis.
Doubt two: While there is a wide variety of recorded Sarkaz Originium Arts, there are few accounts of mind probing or emotional interference. Moreover, such Arts are more prevalent in certain areas of Leithanien. However, Ines has been active in the Kazdel region for a long time, indicating a more direct connection.
Thus, I started my investigation with Ines's former partner, W. I cross-referenced logs and documents in the archive for major events over the past decade and, remarkably, found Ines's presence in each of them. During all these events, she has always stayed clear of the center of action, but seemed to be restrained by an inescapable force, preventing her from truly breaking free. Perhaps I need to request a higher clearance to investigate further. I feel I'm getting close to uncovering Ines's secrets.
[Classified Log]
Ines initiated contact with this overly curious desk worker, who subsequently abandoned further investigation. This record has been requested to be filed and sealed. I have reassigned him to a department where he can better utilize his talents. This is also to prevent him from causing similar issues for other operators.
—■■■
text.zh:
伊内丝小姐刚出现在罗德岛的时候，不少同事都对这名神出鬼没的干员抱有极大的兴趣，干员们大多都有同一个疑惑：究竟是什么人才能和W并肩作战这么久？
于是许多干员尝试去接触伊内丝小姐，但结果却是不少号称专精追踪的鲁珀干员都铩羽而归，他们大多无法完全掌握伊内丝小姐的行踪。
随着失败的人越来越多，舰上的干员们越来越严肃地对待“寻找伊内丝”这个游戏。毕竟不是所有人都愿意承认，这名常年混迹荒野的萨卡兹雇佣兵拥有的侦察与反侦察技巧比大多数接受过专业训练的干员更熟练。
根据我对参与者们的回访，他们均提到，在追踪伊内丝小姐的过程中发现了她刻意遗留的影子标记。这些标记清楚地展现了他们深藏内心的所爱之物或是所惧之物。在伊内丝小姐的面前，干员们藏不住任何秘密，这让他们感到畏惧，也让干员们能够更加严肃地对待伊内丝小姐。
不久前，凯尔希医生终于出面制止了这些荒唐的行为。但是单纯的追踪调查只是最低效的方式，我相信自己对伊内丝小姐的了解程度已经远超他人。
我重新回顾了整起事件的过程，发现大部分人都被伊内丝小姐自身的出色才能吸引，而完全忽视了两个重大的疑点。
疑点一：纵使伊内丝小姐有出色的情报工作经验，初到罗德岛的她也不可能立马熟悉全舰的各种路线，更不必说追踪她的干员们已经在舰上生活多年。我推测伊内丝小姐很早以前就登上过本舰，甚至在本舰生活了足够长的时间，对应其假死的记录，我隐约有了更大胆的猜测。
疑点二：虽然收录在册的萨卡兹源石技艺种类繁多，但具备心灵探查和情绪干扰的记载却少之又少，且这类源石技艺多出现在莱塔尼亚的部分地区。但是伊内丝小姐长期活动于卡兹戴尔周边，这其中理应存在一个更为直接的联系。
因此我从伊内丝小姐前队友W的履历入手，翻阅对照了档案馆内的日志和文献，我惊奇地发现在近十年的重大事件中均有她的身影出现。在所有这些事件中，伊内丝小姐都远远避开了漩涡的最中心，但是又似乎被一个无法摆脱的力量牵制，以致她无法真正抽身。也许我需要申请更多的权限来调查，我感觉已经接近伊内丝小姐的秘密了。
【权限记录】
伊内丝主动联系了这名过于好奇的文员，随后他主动放弃了后续调查。本篇记录已被要求上交封存。我将他调动到了更能发挥其才能的部门。这也是为了防止他对其他干员造成类似的困扰。
——■■■

text.en:
Unlike your run-of-the-mill wandering Sarkaz mercenaries, Ines has changed teams a few times in her lengthy career. Betrayal and animosity were common in the Scar Market, yet regardless of how her employers changed, Ines always seemed loyal to her partner—Hoederer.
Whether the word 'loyalty' accurately describes it or not, Ines has refused to reveal more about her personal relationships. Since the Victoria Incident, Rhodes Island's contact with Sarkaz forces has become more frequent. Ordinary operators were not aware of that background, but for those of us who have been with Dr. Kal'tsit and Amiya for some time, seeing an old acquaintance didn't feel nostalgic so much as heavy.
—Anonymous Sarkaz operator

Ines may be too shy to say it, but not Hoederer. I've heard the story of how they met, and they were probably just teenagers at the time. The Sarkaz don't really observe anniversaries, nor are they particularly aware of dates in battle. But I guess Ines still remembers those days.
She remembers how she, in the white birch forest, was forced to stain her hands with fresh blood, how she survived by hook and by crook. She remembers how that Sarkaz youth with a knife suddenly descended from the sky, coldly counting bodies, calculating bounties, and unexpectedly extending a hand to her... When Hoederer talks about these things, his expression doesn't change at all. He talks like he's recounting a war story. He doesn't even blush!
In any case, shortly thereafter, Ines became Hoederer's right-hand woman, even though the young Hoederer didn't have his own team at the time. According to him, after leaving the white birch forest, Ines spent each day honing her skills physically and also modifying them with Arts, all to become a true Sarkaz.
What? Invading an employee's privacy? Do you really think it's beneficial for Rhodes Island when a Sarkaz mercenary uses 'privacy' as an excuse to conceal her history and relationships? That's called due diligence!
Furthermore, they've been partners for so many years and have even worked with Ascalon and Scout. You make it sound like all that can stay under wraps... Huh? Fear of retaliation? Her Arts? Oh my... In an office shadow-stepping contest, only Ascalon can beat me. Wait, do her Arts not require contact with shadows?
—■■■

Ines has always maintained a certain distance from other mercenaries—and operators. Her Originium Arts make her uniquely skilled at knowing how to treat others with caution—especially on the battlefield. But Ines doesn't preclude herself from interpersonal interactions because of this. She understands well the benefits that come with investing 'trust' in the right people, and her Arts happen to be adept at screening for 'trust.'
Therefore, during the Kazdel civil war, Ines's skills as a spy were without equal. Her nurturing of informants and orchestration of defections were always impeccable. Perhaps Rhodes Island doesn't have need of these brutal methods right now, but I hope the Doctor recognizes her abilities as a soldier—not just an operator—and will manage to win her 'trust.' She used to be very distrustful... of who you were then.
By the way, among the 'Rhodes Island operators' that the Doctor is familiar with, Scout was among the first to earn Ines's 'trust.' As for Chernobog, Ines will one day clarify things herself. I won't speak for her.
—Ascalon

Ahaha, that night in the white birch forest, that's too good, need a copy of this. Let Kal'tsit know for me.
—Anonymous access record; even though I can guess who did it, HR gave up the investigation for security reasons.
text.zh:
与那些常见的、漂泊无根的萨卡兹雇佣兵不同，伊内丝在漫长的生涯中极少更换队伍。背叛与仇视在疤痕商场再常见不过，然而无论雇主如何更替，伊内丝似乎始终都忠诚地选择着她的搭档——赫德雷。
“忠诚”这个词是否准确姑且不提，但伊内丝拒绝就其本人的人际关系透露更多。在维多利亚事件后，罗德岛与萨卡兹相关势力的接触日益频繁，普通干员尚不清楚那段过往，但对于始终陪伴在凯尔希医生和阿米娅身边的我们来说，重见旧人，并不意味着怀念，徒有沉重罢了。
——匿名萨卡兹干员

伊内丝那是不好意思说，但是赫德雷不呀。我可是听说过他们相遇的故事——而且那时候他们估计都才十多岁吧。萨卡兹从来不兴什么纪念日，打仗的时候对日期也不那么敏感，但我猜伊内丝总是记得那些日子的。
她记得那个白桦林里的自己如何被迫手染鲜血，如何苟且偷生。更记得那个拿着刀的萨卡兹少年如何从天而降，如何冷峻地清点尸体，换算报酬，又怎么出乎意料地向她伸出了手……赫德雷讲这些话的时候完全没有表情变化，他好像真的在讲一件战场逸闻似的。他都不脸红哎！
总之，自那之后，伊内丝迅速成为赫德雷的左膀右臂，尽管那时候小屁孩赫德雷还没有自己的队伍。据男方描述，离开白桦林之后，伊内丝每天都在用物理手段打磨自己的角，还用法术修饰——为了变成一个萨卡兹。
什么？泄露干员个人隐私？你觉得一个萨卡兹雇佣兵用“隐私”作借口隐瞒履历和人际关系，真的对罗德岛有好处吗？我这叫尽职尽责！
再讲了，他们仨搭伙这么多年，又曾和阿斯卡纶和Scout是战友，说得好像这些事藏得住一样……嗯？怕我被报复？她的法术？哎呀……办公室踩影子大赛只有阿斯卡纶能赢我——等等，她的法术是不是不需要碰到影子？
——■■■

伊内丝始终与其他雇佣兵——以及干员——保持着一定的距离，她的源石技艺使得她天生懂得如何小心谨慎地对待他人——特别是在战场上。但伊内丝并没有因此而排斥人际交往。她深知正确的“信赖”能带来怎样的收益，而她的法术恰巧善于筛选“信赖”。
因此，在卡兹戴尔内战时期，伊内丝作为间谍的优秀能力毋庸置疑。她发展线人、策动叛变的任务向来完美无缺。如今的罗德岛也许不需要这些残酷的手段，但希望博士能正确认识到伊内丝作为一名士兵的能力——而不仅仅是干员——以及，希望博士能够顺利赢得她的“信赖”。她曾经非常不信任……当时的您。
对了。在博士有认知的“罗德岛干员”中，Scout是第一批赢得伊内丝的“信赖”的。关于切尔诺伯格的事，伊内丝迟早有一天会当面说清楚。我不会替她发言。
——阿斯卡纶的笔述

啊哈，白桦林的夜晚是吧，复制一份，这可是好东西。替我跟凯尔希说一声。
——匿名访问记录，尽管猜得到是谁干的，但出于安全考虑，人事部还是放弃了追查

text.en:
[Classified Log]
From the moment she pulled me out of the blaze in Auchterigg Borough, I noticed that her shadow flickered in the flames. She still tries to present herself like she was, but it doesn't work on me. You've changed her, to some extent, for sure, even though she remains unaware of the change and tries to evade the impact it's had on her.
I'm different. Working with you won't change me. So, give up trying to influence my perspective on you or on that Crown on the Shard. I'm just trying to survive in the cracks of the battlefield. Your grand ambitions don't interest me at all.
Still, I care about how you treat W. We trusted you once, and let her stay by your side, but we both know what happened. I have a responsibility to my people; it's a set of outdated rules we mercenaries have to keep to.
I've always tried to understand what it means to be Sarkaz. Thanks to Hoederer, I overthink lots of things I shouldn't, but it's only clarified my one goal—to stay alive.
W is... obtuse. She never realized the implications of her Sarkaz identity, what she bears. She dedicates too little time to reflection, blindly adopting that elusive ideal as her purpose in life.
You guided her down that path, but I don't think you've really thought through the consequences it might have on her again. Your shadow tells me you have your own plans, and you better know where she stands in them.
Hmph, I'm not asking for your word; that's not worth much to a Sarkaz. As long as she insists, I'll trust you once again, but this time, I'll be there by her side, the both of us will.
I'm just a mercenary. The most brutal price I can pay is to be broken and shattered one more time. Luckily, I'm familiar enough with the experience that it doesn't scare me anymore.
Yes, you can take that as a threat. That's exactly how I intended it.
—Words from Ines to the Doctor

She's so sweet on W? Really? No foolin'? Did W bribe her?
—Closure
text.zh:
【权限记录】
从她把我从奥克特里格区的大火中接出来的时候，我就发现她在火焰中的影子动摇了，虽然她依然试图把自己伪装成和过去一样，但这对我来说行不通。你们确实在某种程度上改变了她，尽管这种改变她毫无知觉，或者她试图逃避改变对她产生的影响。
我和她不一样，与你们合作，我不会有任何的改变。所以放弃尝试影响我对于你们，或者对于碎片大厦上那位殿下的看法。我只是一个竭力在战场夹缝中活下去的人，你们的宏图伟业我毫无兴趣。
但我在意你们对待W的方式。我们曾经信任过你们一次，同意她留在你们的身边，但最后的结果你很清楚。我必须得对自己人负责，这是一套我们雇佣兵必须要遵守的迂腐规则。
我一直尝试理解如何成为萨卡兹，虽然托赫德雷的福，我会思考很多不需要思考的东西，但这反而让我更清楚自己唯一的目的——活下去。
W太……愚钝，她从来没有认识到自己萨卡兹的身份意味着什么，需要她承担什么。她愿意思考的时间太少，以致盲目地将那个虚无缥缈的理想视作自己的人生信条。
你们引导她走上了这条路，但我怀疑你们是否考虑过这条路的终点会再次对她产生什么样的影响。你的影子告诉我，你有自己的计划，那你最好清楚她在这个计划中的位置。
哼，我没有要求你的承诺，这些东西对于萨卡兹来说脆弱无力。只要她坚持走下去，那我会再信任你们一次，但是这次我会在她身边看着，我们都会。
我只是个雇佣兵，能够付出的最惨烈的代价也无非是再粉身碎骨一次罢了。幸运的是，这种体验我已经熟悉到不会产生任何恐惧。
是的，你可以把这当做威胁，我也的确是这么想的。
——伊内丝给博士的话

她对W这么好？啊？真的假的？W是不是收买她了？
——可露希尔

text.en:
Ines always has one piece of advice for operators heading to Kazdel for the first time—don't get hung up on Kazdel's friction with Rhodes Island's values.
The longstanding conflicts in the Kazdel region have bred a thriving trade of opportunistic arms smuggling. Smugglers are eager to incite various mercenary factions through covert manipulation or direct bounties. However, these foreigners walking the paths of Kazdel have also become lucrative prey for mercenaries. Many arms smugglers from Leithanien and small contractors from Columbia have gambled everything only to be left empty-handed after a raid.
As a mercenary operating in Kazdel, Ines had her share of such operations. She once witnessed her team swiftly wipe out a convoy of Leithanian smugglers, leaving behind only a Caprinae boy. Such displaced foreign children in Kazdel are not rare; after their parents' deaths, they hold no value. Sarkaz aren't inclined to bother with them, either leaving them to fend for themselves or driving them into the harsh northern forests to experience the land's cruelty.
Sarkaz mercenaries revel in such 'entertainment.' There must be someone to exact revenge for the flames these smugglers help fan, and these bewildered young outsiders often make the best targets. As for the Caprinae boy, Ines did what a Sarkaz should. She gave him two choices—stay by his parents' corpses and perish, or be thrown into the solitude of the northern birch forests to die alone.
'Why not give the boy a chance? He's no threat.'
'Only a Sarkaz can survive in Kazdel. Before I tossed him into the forest, I gave him a file to use. His one lifeline.'
Perhaps Rhodes Island can save the unfortunate souls before us, but what about those we can't even perceive? Our abilities are ultimately limited. The chaos of Kazdel is like a vortex, drawing in all ambitious ripples, brewing greater waves, waiting to engulf everything.
'Stow the excess sympathy. At least until the day when the war ends for real.'
And for those operators doubting the authenticity of Ines's words, she'd recommend they take a trip to the northern birch forests.
'The only difference between me and that Caprinae is I walked out of the forest and survived to this day. I learned from it.'
She describes it as a place filled with not only bones and beauty, but also traces of the many who tried to survive.
'In those forests lies the secret to surviving in Kazdel.'
'It's not every time that someone comes to your rescue,' Ines concludes softly.
text.zh:
对于刚去卡兹戴尔执行任务的干员，伊内丝一直有一句忠告——不要试图用罗德岛的道德观念去掺和卡兹戴尔的争端。
卡兹戴尔地区长期以来的冲突滋生了大量投机的军火走私生意，走私商们也乐于暗中挑拨不同雇佣兵队伍或者直接发布悬赏来推波助澜。但这些行走在卡兹戴尔的外族人却也同时成了雇佣兵眼中的肥肉，不少莱塔尼亚的武器走私贩和哥伦比亚的小承包商赌上一切却最终被劫掠一空。
伊内丝作为雇佣兵在卡兹戴尔活动时参与这类行动的机会并不少，她曾经目睹一支莱塔尼亚的走私商队被自己的队伍迅速扫清，仅仅留下了一位卡普里尼少年。这类流落在卡兹戴尔的异族孩童并不罕见，他们在父母死去之后也没有任何利用价值。萨卡兹不愿意费力去处理他们，也许会将他们留在原地自生自灭，或者直接将他们赶进北部的大森林感受这片土地的残酷。
萨卡兹雇佣兵们乐于见到这种“趣事”。因为总得有人来为这些走私商助长的复仇之火偿还代价，这些惊慌失措的年少异族往往就是最好的对象。而对那位卡普里尼少年，伊内丝做了萨卡兹应该做的事。她留给了少年两个选择，留在父母的尸体身边自生自灭，或者被扔到北边的桦树林里孤独死去。
“为什么不试着放那个少年一条生路？他毫无威胁。”
“只有萨卡兹才能在卡兹戴尔生存下来。把他扔进森林之前，我扔给了他一把锉刀，那就是他的生路。”
罗德岛也许能够救下眼前那一个可怜人，可那些无法被我们视线捕捉到的呢？我们的能力终究有限。卡兹戴尔的战乱如同一个漩涡，将所有心怀野心的浪花卷入其中，然后酝酿着更大的浪潮，等待着席卷一切。
“收拾好你们泛滥的同情心。除非有一天，战争真的能够结束。”
而对那些质疑伊内丝话语真实性的干员，她会推荐他们去北边的桦树林里看看。
“我和那个卡普里尼唯一的区别是，我曾经走出了那片桦树林，靠着那片森林教会我的东西活到了今天。”
她描述那里不止有枯骨和美景，也有许多尝试活下去的人留下的痕迹。
“在那片桦树林里，藏着如何在卡兹戴尔活下去的秘密。
“不是每一次，都会有人来救你的。”伊内丝最后呢喃道。

text.en:
'How does it feel to stand here now?'
'Hmm, not great. I'm not exactly the guard type. I'm more comfortable in my old role, but it's convenient enough to do things like this for now.'
'Please don't see yourself as just a guard. Considering the situation, she's not entirely ready yet, and this is the best choice.'
'You can tell that to Ascalon. But you... you've changed a lot. Your shadow used to be full of complex emotions that were hard to decipher, but now...'
'Calm?'
'Hmm... You're still not that likable. No wonder W prefers to spend time with that Cautus.'
'How do you perceive everything before you?'
'Do you want to hear a Sarkaz answer, or my genuine thoughts?'
'...'
'One's word doesn't mean much. Sarkaz history has proven that lots of times. War will come again sooner or later. The question is, who will be the next spark? Next time, you'd better think carefully about where you want to stand.'
text.zh:
“现在站在这里的感觉如何？”
“哼，并不怎么样，护卫不是我喜欢的工作。我更习惯自己过去的身份，只是这样行事会方便许多。”
“请不要仅仅将自己视作护卫。以现在的形势来看，她还没有完全准备好，这就是最佳的选择。”
“这话你可以和阿斯卡纶去说。不过你……确实变了很多，过去你的影子里充斥着看不透的复杂情绪，但现在……”
“平静？”
“哼……你依旧没那么讨喜。难怪W平时更愿意去找那个卡特斯。”
“你如何看待眼前这一切？”
“你想听萨卡兹的回答，还是我真实的想法？”
“……”
“口头的承诺是孱弱无力的，萨卡兹的历史已经无数次证明了这个观点。战争迟早会再次爆发，问题是谁会成为下一个导火索。下一次，你最好也能想清楚，你要站在什么位置。”

value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Confirmed Infected by medical examination.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

text.en: The early career of former Sarkaz mercenary captain Hoederer is unclear. He participated in the transfer of Babel as part of the guard detail, leaving after Babel was dismantled. He was then spotted at Chernobog alongside Ines and W as a mercenary hired by Reunion, before disappearing after the Chernobog Incident. His next appearance was as a member of the Military Commission in Londinium. After obtaining certain key information, Hoederer left them and reestablished contact with Rhodes Island, once again signing a memorandum of strategic cooperation with us after discussions with Amiya.
text.zh: 前萨卡兹佣兵头目，赫德雷。早期履历不详，曾作为护卫部队的一员参与了巴别塔的转移，在巴别塔解体后离开。此后曾以整合运动所属萨卡兹雇佣兵的身份与伊内丝、W一起出现在切尔诺伯格，并在切尔诺伯格事件后消失。再次出现时，赫德雷已在伦蒂尼姆的军事委员会中任职。在取得重要情报后，赫德雷离开军事委员会，同罗德岛重新取得联系。在与阿米娅沟通后，赫德雷再次和罗德岛签订了战略合作条款。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 15%
Hoederer shows obvious symptoms of Infection, but he has declined Medical's recommendation for further examination.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.27u/L
Having spent extended periods in Kazdel and other battlefields, Hoederer's condition is serious, but he does not seem concerned about his status as Infected. Perhaps, for Sarkaz mercenaries living near Kazdel, Oripathy is as much a part of their everyday life as their weapons.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】15%
赫德雷有明显的感染迹象，但他婉拒了罗德岛医疗部门对他进行进一步检查的建议。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.27u/L
因常年在卡兹戴尔地区活动，并长时间往来于战场之间，赫德雷的感染情况比较严峻。但他似乎从未在意过自己感染者的身份。也许对于这些生活在卡兹戴尔周边的萨卡兹佣兵而言，罹患矿石病和不让武器离身一样，都是理所当然的事。

text.en:
For most young operators, a 'Sarkaz from Kazdel' usually means someone you should stay well away from. The behavior of some of our operators has undoubtedly contributed to this thinking. There is an impression that Kazdel is a place filled with people like W or Flamebringer, and even Mudrock can seem imposing in her thick and heavy armor.
Hoederer's arrival has changed some of these preconceptions. Not to say that he isn't dangerous, as his performance in battle and his sheer muscles clearly demonstrate, but there is something different about him. Mercenaries who spend their lives on the battlefield killing for a living are often rough or cold, living in the moment and indulging in pleasures like there is no tomorrow.
Hoederer, however, lives by a strictly regimented schedule while at Rhodes Island: He will show up at the training room at 5:30am every day, and do strength training for one and a half hours before having breakfast, usually boiled fowlbeast (he has also been seen asking Hibiscus to put together a healthy menu for him). He will then spend the rest of the morning reading, take a quick break around noon, and spend the entire afternoon in combat training. This is obviously very different from his lifestyle as a mercenary, but he seems to enjoy it. Perhaps he desires to feel in control of his life, compared his time on the battlefield where tomorrow is far from a given.

He's out of his mind. Is he just really insecure or something? We might all be dead by tomorrow, and the last thing he'll remember are the boiled vegetables he had for his last meal. —Anonymous Interview Log 1
Would a last meal of salted potatoes be any better? —Anonymous Interview Log 2

There is a scholar in him, but unlike any of the Victorian or Columbian academics we are familiar with. He says that his studies are not for personal growth or academic curiosity. When he visits Rhodes Island's library, he is not seeking pure knowledge, but methods. His writings and records serve a single purpose: to relieve his own pain and doubt. He is currently writing a book on the history of Sarkaz wars, and operators who've had the chance to review the draft speak highly of it, calling it 'more than just a chronicle, but a unique way of studying history from a micro perspective.'

Hoederer needs a publishing agent. Now, I want to be clear that I'm not trying to make money off of this. How much money could there possibly be in putting out a textbook? Written in Sarkaz, no less! But I'm Sarkaz too, and there are plenty of us on Rhodes Island who'd want to read our history in written form. I'll get his request for more books on economics approved immediately, as long as he lets me handle his publishing rights. —Closure
You can come talk to me about the copyright stuff. And I suggest you reject Hoederer's request for books on economics; I just wanted him to help with bookkeeping. —Message to the Procurement Department, author unknown
text.zh:
在罗德岛大部分年轻干员的印象中，“来自卡兹戴尔的萨卡兹”一般意味着，你最好绕着他们走，这无疑是拜某几位我们不是特别老实的干员所赐。在人们的口耳相传中，卡兹戴尔是一个塞满了W或者炎客那类人的地方，就连泥岩小姐，当穿着她那身厚实的盔甲出现的时候，也会散发出惊人的压迫感。
但赫德雷的到来部分改变了干员们的成见。当然，我并不是在说赫德雷不危险，看他在战场上的表现和他身上的肌肉块就能知道，赫德雷的危险程度一点都不逊于我上面提到的那几位，但他确实有一种不太一样的气质。穿梭于各个战场，以杀伐为生的雇佣兵们，通常表现得粗野或冷漠，乐于放纵与享受，这些把脑袋系在裤腰带上的人需要发泄的窗口。
但赫德雷，在他停留于舰上的时间里，每日都会在早上五点半准时出现在训练室，进行一个半小时的力量训练，之后赫德雷通常会选择一份清水煮羽兽肉作为早餐（有干员反映他甚至会拜托芙蓉为自己准备健康餐）。整个上午他一般用来阅读，在短暂的午休后，就是持续一整个下午的战斗训练，从不缺席。这无疑与他在外的雇佣兵生活大不相同，而赫德雷却出人意料地乐在其中。也许，相比朝不保夕的战场岁月，他享受的正是这种可被自己掌控的生活。

简直疯了，他是不是其实很没安全感？也许明天大家都死了，而可悲的赫德雷会想起他死前的最后一顿饭是水煮蔬菜。——匿名访问记录1
和想起最后一顿饭是盐土豆有什么区别吗？——匿名访问记录2

另一方面，赫德雷也拥有一种近似于学者的气质。但与我们所熟知的维多利亚或哥伦比亚式教授不同，赫德雷表示，他所有案头工作的目的并不是满足自己在学术上的什么好奇心与进取心。他经常光顾罗德岛的图书室，但寻求的却不仅仅是知识，更是方法。他所有的书写与记录只有一个目的：解除自己的痛苦与困惑。据悉，赫德雷现在正在撰写一本名为《萨卡兹战争史》的书籍，几名阅读过部分稿件的干员给出了相当高的评价，并表示它“并不是单纯的编年史，它承载了一种独特的，从微观出发的历史研究方式”。

我觉得赫德雷需要一个版权代理人。事先声明，我不指望从这里面赚钱，你觉得靠学术著作能赚什么钱？还是萨卡兹语写的！但我好歹也是个萨卡兹，罗德岛上也确实还有不少萨卡兹，我们很多人都想读读这些书，读读……被写下来的，我们的历史——他要是愿意让我代理以后的所有版权，我马上帮他搞定那一大堆他申请采购的经济学书籍。——可露希尔
关于版权的问题，你可以来找我谈。还有，建议驳回赫德雷那些经济学书籍的采购申请，我只是想让他负责记账而已。——隔天出现在采购部的神秘留言

text.en: Diary with yellowed pages: ...I didn't have the money. So I pulled the cart out of town and found a spot. Sobie told me everyone was buried there. There were no tombstones, but the ground was filled with Originium crystals, small ones, not the big formations that Catastrophes leave behind. Mom wasn't very tall, but it took hours to dig a hole she could lie in. The sun had risen by the time I got back. Maybe there will be crystals growing there the next time I visit. I hope I can still find it. ...... I didn't expect him to struggle. I waited for him to fall asleep. I practiced the stab so many times. I got the spot just right. Why didn't he die immediately? I still have the scratch marks he left on my wrist. It will take days for them to fade. On the whole though, it wasn't that bad. Not as scary as Madtree said. I watched him expire before my eyes. Blood everywhere. Scareye gave me a small piece of refined Pure Gold as a reward for a successful mission. Told me mercenaries don't need to ask questions. All that matters is results. Said I did well. ...... Kroche finally agreed to teach me how to drive. I still have to reach for the pedals, but I think I've got the chops. We drove on a wide open piece of the barrens. Kroche was always concerned that I'd crash the car, but there's nothing to crash into out there, and there wasn't much left of his car to crash anyway. I got tired after a while and Kroche took over. We drove aimlessly the entire day, until sundown. I thought I'd get to see a beautiful sunset, but the black smoke from Kazdel obscured everything. Kroche seems to be a decent guy, although he still won't increase my pay. Isn't he the one who said scouting was an important job? ...... Those damn angels have been after us for three days, and show no sign of being willing to let us go. I didn't even have time to change my bandages. My wound has already gone numb. Not a good sign. If you're reading this, I'm probably dead. If you're the Sankta who killed me, then abi in malam crucem. If you're just a Sarkaz passing by, pray that I return to the myriad souls. There are a few pieces of Pure Gold in my pouch. Take them, if you haven't already. (Scribbled) I have a fever. I think I'm dying. ...... I learned the name of the man who stabbed me. Cannoli. The target our squad eliminated three days ago was his father. I should thank him. The doctor who stitched up my wound gave me a quick screening. He told me I was Infected, like he was talking about the weather. I guess the burning ashes I saw that day were my Arts. What good is that? Fertilizer? I admit, I'm disappointed. I don't really care that I got Oripathy. Everyone here gets it, sooner or later. I'm one of the lucky ones. Funnel's little girl is five, and her left hand is almost entirely covered in crystals. Her sixth birthday is a few months away. Funnel's birthday present for her? A coffin. ...... Broketooth didn't want me in his group because I was too young. I'll go and find Schwab. I think he wants to form his own mercenary band. Heard that a Leithanian caravan is passing through the birch forest to the north tomorrow. They picked the worst route possible, and gave it away to boot. More than one group of bandits have them in their sights, but the mission that Scar Market gave us is to rob the bandits. Who'd make a request like that? Hope tomorrow's operation goes well. Maybe I can pick up some good Leithanian stuff. The diary ends here.
text.zh:
一本内页已经泛黄的日记：
……我拿不出那笔钱。于是，我拉着板车，在城外找了块地方，索比埃告诉我人们都埋在那里。那里没有一块墓碑，但地面上长满了源石结晶，不是天灾留下的巨型晶簇，那里的结晶都又小又细密。妈妈不算高，但我没想到挖一个她能躺下的坑还是花了好几个小时。回去的时候天已经亮了。
下次我来的时候，这里可能也会长出一小朵源石结晶，希望我还能找得到位置。
……
我没想到那个人会挣扎。
我明明等到他睡着了才动的手，要刺的位置也已经演练了好几次。我应该没有刺偏，可是为什么他没有马上死？我的手腕上还留着他抓出来的痕迹，不知道要几天才能消掉。但总体而言，不算太难，没有疯树说的那么恐怖。我看着他在我眼前断了气，血流得到处都是。
疤眼最后给了我一小块赤金，精炼过的，是这次任务的报酬。他告诉我，雇佣兵不需要问问题，只需要给出结果，我这次做得很不错。
……
克洛谢终于教我开车了，虽然脚下那几个踏板我还稍微有点够不到，但我觉得我还算有天赋。我们找了片荒野，克洛谢一直在担心我会把他的那辆车撞坏，但这里根本没什么东西可撞的，克洛谢的车本身也已经和坏了没什么区别。
我一会儿就累了，克洛谢后来就自己开车，我们漫无目的地开了好久，一直开到太阳下山。我还以为能看到漂亮的日落，结果卡兹戴尔冒出的黑烟挡住了一切。
我在想，克洛谢这人是还不错，虽然他还是不给我提高分到的酬金——他明明承认侦察也是重要的工作！
……
那帮该死的天使好像根本不打算放过我们，他们已经追了我们三天了，我根本来不及换绷带，伤口已经没有知觉了，这不是什么好兆头。
假如你捡到了这本本子，看到了这行字，大概率是我死了。如果你是那个杀了我的萨科塔，*拉特兰俚语*。
如果你是个路过的萨卡兹，请祝福我归于众魂。我的腰包里有几块零散赤金，拿去吧，虽然你大概率已经拿走了。
（潦草的字迹）我觉得我在发烧。我可能真的快死了。
……
我查到了，捅我的人叫卡诺里，三天前我们小队处理的那个任务目标是他父亲。我该感谢他，给我缝针的那个医生顺手给我做了个检测，他像谈论明天的天气一样告诉我，我已经感染了。看来，那天飘出来的那些烧着的灰，确实就是我的源石技艺。这法术能干什么用？施肥？我确实有些失望。
我不太关心自己是什么时候感染的，反正在这里每个人都会得矿石病。我的运气还算好，漏斗家的那个女孩，才五岁，左手几乎已经完全被源石结晶覆盖了。
再过几个月是她的六岁生日，漏斗给她准备的生日礼物是一口棺材。
……
缺牙嫌我太小，不愿意我加入他们的队伍。过几天我去找施瓦布，他应该对成立佣兵小队有兴趣。
听说明天北边的白桦林里会有一支莱塔尼亚的商队经过，他们选了条最差的路，还走漏了风声，有不止一伙劫掠者盯上了他们。但这次疤痕商场派来的任务是抢劫这些劫掠者，到底是谁会发这种委托？
希望明天的行动顺利，说不定也能顺便捡到点莱塔尼亚产的好东西。

之后的日记似乎没有再继续。

text.en:
The other day, I saw Hoederer chatting in the bar with an old ship-hand dating back to the Babel days. W said Hoederer was a crazy grass-eater, but he looked normal enough to me. Later, I had the chance to talk to that ship-hand about their conversation when he came to me to get some paperwork done. —■■■

Oh, that. To tell the truth, I didn't even know his name until we drank together a couple days ago. Hey, don't blame me! It's not like he remembered my name either. So many people came and went while the Chairman was still around, you hardly had the chance to remember the name of someone you might only have seen a few times. Plus, the Sarkaz mercs changed their code names so often, I don't know who has the patience to remember them all.
We didn't talk about much, just old times. I met Hoederer's band in 93. I remember that because that's the year my son died, not long before they came aboard. Times were hard at Babel back then. We were always moving, and we lost a lot of good people... never mind that. I was part of the operation to recover his squad. Only a few of them made it. I remember him and Ines mostly because they came with that nutjob, W. And the fact that they eventually left Babel... without taking her with them!
I joined Babel and worked with people like the Chairman and Kal'tsit because this was my dream. I still believe in the Chairman's path, but I also understand why so many people left. It's not just Theresis we're fighting, it's all the hatred behind him as well. But Hoederer and Ines were different from the others who left. I could tell that they didn't leave because they were afraid of Theresis, because they worried about their families in Kazdel, or because they were pessimistic about how the war would go. If you ask me, I think they looked tired and sad when they left.
When we drank together that day, Hoederer asked me which race I thought had killed the most Sarkaz. I gave a few answers, but they were all wrong. Finally, he told me it was the Sarkaz themselves. Be it Victoria, Leithanien, or any other country or faction, the best way to destroy a bunch of Sarkaz is not to waste their own precious troops, but to hire another group of Sarkaz to solve the problem. No need to pay restitution to the families of the fallen, after all, unlike their own soldiers. Hoederer said he used to think this was normal; that was the job of a merc, after all. But could they still remain sellswords for the highest bidder in the civil war between Theresa and Theresis to determine the ruler of Kazdel?
Hoederer and Ines didn't want to pick a side. They wanted to remain free. But who can truly stay above such a conflict? I don't understand him, really. He wanted to get away from it all, but in the end we ran into each other here again. Maybe there are some things you just can't get away from, just like you can't get away from eating and drinking.
Anything else? Oh, I've heard that theory too, that they left W in Babel to keep an exit route open... Whoever said that needs to use their brain. W? Keep a path open? You're lucky if she doesn't get on literally everyone's bad side... Hey, you're not going to tell her I said that, are you?
text.zh:
那天，我正巧撞见赫德雷与一位巴别塔时期就在船上工作的老员工在酒吧聊天。之前W还找我说什么赫德雷疯了，每天只吃草之类的，我看他不是挺正常的吗？后来那位老员工来找我办手续，我们就顺便说起了他和赫德雷的那次聊天。——■■■

哦，那次啊。不瞒你说，前两天喝酒我才知道他叫赫德雷。怎么是我忘性大？他也不记得我名字了！唉，议长还在的时候，来来往往的人那么多，大多数也就是打过几次照面的交情，记不得名字也正常，何况萨卡兹雇佣兵们还老是喜欢换外号，谁一个个去记？
我们也没聊什么，谈了点以前的事情。我认识赫德雷他们这帮雇佣兵是93年，我记得很清楚，我儿子就是那年死的，就在他们来船上之前不久。那段时间巴别塔的处境很不容易，总是在转移，我们也损失了很多人——算了，不说这些了。我当时参与了对赫德雷那支小队的回收，没救回来几个人，我对他和伊内丝有印象主要是因为他们是和W那疯子一起来的，还有就是……他们最终离开了巴别塔。而且还没把W一起带走！
我愿意加入巴别塔，愿意和议长、凯尔希女士他们一起共事是因为这确实是我的理想，直到现在我都毫不怀疑议长的道路。但我也理解许多退出的人，毕竟，我们要迎战的不仅有特雷西斯，还有跟在特雷西斯身后的那些仇恨。但他们，赫德雷和伊内丝的离开与其他人并不一样，我看得出来，他们离开并不是因为害怕特雷西斯的武力、担忧留在卡兹戴尔的家人或者不看好战争的走向。要我说，他们走的时候……疲惫又悲哀。
那天我们喝酒的时候，赫德雷问我，我觉得哪个种族杀的萨卡兹最多。我猜了好几个他都说不对，最后他告诉我，杀死萨卡兹最多的种族，恐怕也是萨卡兹。是啊，维多利亚、莱塔尼亚，或者随便什么国家或者势力，要是想剿灭一批萨卡兹，最好最划算的办法未必是出动自己宝贵的军队，而很有可能是雇佣另一批萨卡兹来帮他们解决问题，反正死了就死了，还不用像自家士兵一样发粮饷和抚恤。赫德雷说，以前这样的日子他觉得理所应当，毕竟雇佣兵们的工作就是这个。但在那场发生于特蕾西娅与特雷西斯之间，关乎卡兹戴尔归属的内战里，他们还能只当一群开袋即食、价高者得的雇佣兵吗？
赫德雷和伊内丝不想给自己选择立场，他们想保持自由，但这样一场纷争中，谁能纤尘不染？唉，我也真是搞不懂赫德雷，他当年就想远离这一切，结果兜兜转转，五六年过去，我们却还是在这里遇上了。也许，有的事就是逃不过的，就像没有人能不吃不喝，逃开饥渴一样。
还有什么要问的吗？哦，这说法我也听过，说什么他们俩把留在巴别塔的W当退路……谁说的？让他动动脑子，拿W当退路？她不把周围所有人都得罪光就不错了！啊，你不会把今天我们聊的这些告诉W吧？

text.en:
[Classified Log]
It's been a while, Doctor. Our brief cooperation in the Babel days is irrelevant now. I doubt you remember it, anyway.
I stood on the other side in the Chernobog Incident, and killed Scout with my own hands. I'm not going to try to justify it. I'm the direct culprit.
I also served Theresis's Military Commission for a long time, answering to Manfred. I was involved in numerous purges of the Londinium council, helping Theresis establish control and forcing Londinium to kneel.
Yes, we had a closer partnership in Victoria. We fought alongside Rhodes Island through fire and brimstone, with the tacit understanding not to bring up the past, either the good and the bad. Let me make this clear, Doctor: I'm not bringing this up now to casually apologize and seek forgiveness. On the contrary, I need you to remember that I did all that. And I can't and won't feel guilty about it any of it. I'm a mercenary, a killer, and I must face all the choices I made, as well as any consequences they bring about.
I read the terms of the agreement, of course. It's similar to the one Ines got. It's true that we'll have use of one another for a long time to come, but I'm not W, and I have no intention of chasing after Her Highness's footsteps like her. You and I both know that no matter who we have with us now, Her Highness Theresa's Babel is no more than a footnote in history.
Frankly, being part of Rhodes Island offers me many advantages, personally. Our cooperation extends beyond the realm of Oripathy and Infection. You're the experts in that field, and the Sarkaz have long been plagued by Oripathy, but it's the least of Kazdel's problems right now. It's a gentle killer, compared to war, starvation, and instigators.
I need your help because you're more complex than you let on. No need to deny it. I know what kind of people this place has. Both heroes of days gone by, and children of the future. The extraordinary pretending to be ordinary, and revolutionaries who've yet to realize who they are... Far more influence than any pharmaceutical company should wield. I claim no authority in Kazdel, and perhaps it's not even my place as a humble mercenary to worry about that city's future. In the end, though, it's our home, and we all know that Kazdel's crisis has only just begun.
I'm not an idealist like Her Highness Theresa, believing that sincerity begets selfless cooperation. But I'll leverage every bit of power I can, even if there are ulterior movies behind them. We're constantly walking on the edge of a cliff. Over the long course of history, many cities have been given the name Kazdel, but it's never changed the fact that the Sarkaz continue to wander. It's time we found an anchor for our people. We must consider how to find a true, lasting home, rather than being swept into the abyss once more by the tides of anger and ambition.
If you're no longer that destroyer, Doctor... then I need your advice.
text.zh:
【权限记录】
博士，确实好久不见了。在巴别塔时期我们之间那段短暂的合作已经不再重要，而且，你应该也想不起来了。
在切尔诺伯格事件中我曾站在你们的对立面，并亲手杀死了Scout。我不会给自己找理由，我确实是那个最终意义上的凶手。
我在特雷西斯的军事委员会里担任了很长时间的职务，向曼弗雷德负责；我参与了多场对于伦蒂尼姆议会的肃清行动，帮助特雷西斯掌控了局势，迫使伦蒂尼姆向他臣服。
是的，我们在维多利亚曾有比较紧密的合作，我们和罗德岛并肩而战，出生入死，默契地不提起往昔，不论是好的那部分，还是坏的那部分。我需要声明，博士，我这次来找你并旧事重提，不是为了轻浮地道个歉，寻求你们的原谅。正相反，我需要你牢记，这些确实是我曾经做过的事情，并且，我不会，也不能为此感到羞愧或者良心不安。说到底，我是个杀人不眨眼的雇佣兵，我必须面对所有曾做出的选择，也坦然迎接任何一种这些选择最终带来的结果。
当然，我看到了那份合作条款，和伊内丝的大差不差，我们在接下来的很长一段时间中确实也还有相互利用的必要。但我不是W，无意于像她那样只是追寻殿下的脚步。我们都清楚，无论什么原因，无论有谁参与，特蕾西娅殿下的巴别塔已经只是一个历史名词。
……说实话，博士，从我个人的角度，我很清楚获得一个罗德岛的身份是个好选择。坦诚地说，我们的合作不会仅仅围绕在矿石病和感染者的领域。你们确实是这方面的专家，萨卡兹也确实一直饱受矿石病的困扰。但对于如今的卡兹戴尔，矿石病只是一个最微不足道的问题。相比于战争、饥饿或者煽动者，矿石病杀死我们的方式称得上温和。
我需要你们的帮助，是因为你们比自身试图表现出来的更加复杂。别否认，我知道罗德岛都有些什么人。旧时代的英雄、新时代的孩子；藏头露尾的大人物、尚不自知的革命者……我很清楚，这些人带来的影响力远远超越了一家主要经营医疗与制药的企业本该拥有的。我确实不是什么卡兹戴尔的掌权者，那座城市的未来或许也轮不到我这样的雇佣兵操心，但归根结底，那是我的家。而且，我们都知道，卡兹戴尔的危机才刚刚开始。
我不像特蕾西娅殿下那么理想主义，相信真诚的交流就能换来无私的合作。但……无论如何，我会去尝试利用每一份力量，哪怕这些力量的施予者并不拥有什么“纯洁的动机”，我们也只能在悬崖边行走。历史上，无论哪座城市被冠以卡兹戴尔的名字，都无法改变萨卡兹们一直在流浪的事实。那么，是时候为我的同胞们寻找到那根锚了。我们必须得想清楚如何让家园真正存在下去，而不是被又一次愤怒与野心的浪潮冲向深渊。
若你确实不再是那个毁灭者……那么，博士，我需要你的建议。

text.en:
Hoederer received a letter of invitation from the Military Commission of Kazdel.
Following the conclusion of the war in Victoria, the nations of Terra have yet to organize an offensive against Kazdel. The return of the Lord of Fiends to Kazdel is hardly the only reason.
But the Military Commission these days... Hoederer's brow furrows just thinking about it.
He decides to spend a few more days at Rhodes Island before setting out.
text.zh:
赫德雷收到了一封卡兹戴尔军事委员会的邀请函。
维多利亚的这场战争停下之后，泰拉诸国并未急着向卡兹戴尔发动进攻，这绝不仅仅是因为“魔王”再度回到了卡兹戴尔。
但，如今的军事委员会……想到自己将要面对哪几副面孔，赫德雷狠狠地揉了揉眉头。
他决定在罗德岛上耽搁几日再出发。

text.en:
U-Official, commonly known as Streamer U, used to be an online streamer in a certain nomadic city. After being recommended by Operator Click, she signed a cooperation agreement with Rhodes Island. In addition to providing broadcasting services for our operators, she is responsible for hosting events and other work. She also serves as a consultant and provides support when Rhodes Island interfaces with media organizations.
Other than Click, who once lent her a helping hand, Streamer U has also had encounters with a few other Rhodes Island operators, though not always under pleasant circumstances and while going by a different name. Ultimately, we suspended any further background checks at her insistence.

Eureka?
––Tequila, upon passing by coincidentally

You've got the wrong person, you big fat liar!
––Streamer U, babbling incoherently
text.zh:
U-Official，通称主播U，曾在某移动城市作为网络主播活动，经干员卡达介绍与罗德岛签订合作协议，在为干员们提供直播服务的同时负责活动主持等工作，也作为顾问在罗德岛与各地传媒机构合作时提供帮助。
除了向自己伸出援手的卡达，主播U还与罗德岛上的一些干员有过一面之缘，不过那些经历似乎不甚愉快，当时主播U也并未以现在的名字行世。最终，在主播U的强烈要求之下，我们决定暂缓对她的背景调查。

尤里卡？
——偶然路过的龙舌兰

你认错人了你这个道貌岸然的大骗子！
——语无伦次的主播U

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator U-Official shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L
This operator doesn't even want to go outside.
While remaining cooped up indoors undeniably reduces the risk of Oripathy, sitting around all day definitely isn't healthy either. I wish she'd exercise more, and if that's too tough, I can at least help with some basic stretching.
––Gavial

Fantastic! I look forward to working with you, Dr. Gavial!
––Streamer U, newly arrived and hard at work building relationships

Alright! Gavial, you're in charge of helping her make her debut at Rhodes Island! Oh, but since she's a newbie, go easy on her, okay?
––Closure, who agreed to go along with Streamer U's idea for a premiere broadcast
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员U-Official没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.12u/L
该干员连门都不愿意出。
不出门对预防矿石病倒也不是完全没好处，但每天一直坐着，对身体肯定不好。还是希望这位干员能多运动一下，如果觉得困难，我可以帮忙做一些基础的拉伸。
——嘉维尔

太好了！那就麻烦嘉维尔医生了！
——初来乍到，努力想和大家打好关系的主播U

太好了！嘉维尔，她在罗德岛的首播就靠你了！啊，还有，毕竟人家刚来，你下手轻一点。
——答应帮主播U的首播出主意的可露希尔

text.en:
[Livestream Record 1]
Welcome to our special program: 'A Date With U-chan: Exclusive Interviews with Rhodes Island's Hottest Hotties'! This is everyone's favorite Streamer U, and today, I'll be introducing our guest–
Huh? Phantom vanished without a trace, Leonhardt's out on duty, and even Qanipalaat is busy? So you could only manage to get this... uhh... sunny and aggressively outgoing guy... to come to the rescue? Okay then...
Our guest today is none other than the hottest of them all, the most passionate operator at Rhodes Island: THRM-EX!
......
You say that your 'thermal shock is undefeatable,' but is that really true? Not sure I buy that.
Huh? What's that countdown for?
Some kind of special surprise? I can't wait to find out!

[Livestream Record 2]
Eight hour marathon stream challenge! As long as I don't disrupt the lives or work of any other operators, there are no breaks on this train! If yours truly manages to accomplish this feat, you'd better shower me with donos! And if I don't make it... I'll have to suffer through Round 2 of Dr. Gavial's stretching challenge tomorrow!
Hello there, what's your name?
This is the first we've met. Thanks for being a fan of the stream!
......
You'd be better believe it. Getting good footage is an absolute must...
Beeping? I don't see anything wrong on my end... Might be something with your equipment?
Huh? What's wrong? Why'd you stop talking all of a sudden? Did I say something wrong?
......
............
..................
Please, say something, Scene! Anything!

[Livestream Record 3]
Welcome to Streamer U's first mukbang since coming aboard Rhodes Island! Today's special guest is... Tada! Yan's shining star, FEater!
......
C'mon, it'll be fine! I've heard all about Shangshu's delicacies, but I can handle a little spice! Now, let's have a taste...
(Violent coughing sounds)
N-No, I don't need water! I said I'm doing a mukbang, so I have to finish the goal I set for myself!
......
I'm fine... Streaming is my job... I need to maintain... a professional attitude... See, there's only one piece of meat left on the platter... It'd be a shame to let it go to waste...
Have I ever considered doing an event organizer gig in Shangshu? Hehe. C'mon, when have I ever turned down a business offer? But, lemme finish my food first...

Footnote: Due to excessive sweating, Streamer U collapsed from dehydration after eating the last piece of meat and was rushed to Medical. Thankfully, she did not incur any serious injuries.
Addendum: FEater was moved by Streamer U's professionalism and dedication to her craft, and is currently contacting her acquaintances in the Shangshu art and literature circles to try to expand the streamer's career options.
text.zh:
【直播记录一】
欢迎来到我们今天的“小U有约：罗德岛帅哥专访”特别节目，我是大家的主播U！今天我们请到的嘉宾是——
欸？傀影先生人不见了，莱恩哈特先生要出外勤，连雪绒弟弟也在忙，所以请这位……呃……阳光开朗热情大帅哥……来临时救个场？行吧……
嘉宾是，罗德岛最热情的干员，THRM-EX先生！
……
“我的热量冲击无坚不摧”，真的吗？我不信。
欸，为什么突然开始倒计时了？
是什么惊喜吗？好期待啊！

【直播记录二】
八小时不间断直播挑战！在不打扰干员工作生活的前提下，连续八小时不冷场、不下播！如果主播赢得了挑战，请大家多多打赏！如果主播输了，明天就做嘉维尔医生的拉伸挑战第二期！
你好，请问怎么称呼？
初次见面，多谢你喜欢我的直播！
……
没错，照相器材真的非常重要……
提示音？有什么设备报错了……好像不是我的，是你的设备吗？
嗯？怎么了，怎么突然不说话了，是我说错什么了吗？
……
…………
………………
你倒是说句话呀稀音小姐！

【直播记录三】
主播U来到罗德岛以来的第一次吃播！特邀嘉宾是——锵锵，炎国大明星，食铁兽小姐！
……
没事的没事的，虽然对炎国尚蜀的美食早有耳闻，但我其实也很能吃辣的。来，让我尝一尝……
（剧烈的咳嗽声）
不，不用涮水！既然说了是吃播，我就一定要完成预定目标！
……
我没事，既然直播是工作……对待工作就要……说到做到……你看，一盘肉就剩一片了……不吃完多浪费啊……
有没有考虑去尚蜀做主持人？嘿嘿，好啊，我从来不嫌工作机会多，等我吃完这片肉……

附记：主播U在吃掉最后一片肉之后因过量出汗脱水倒地，被紧急送至医疗部，所幸并无大碍。
又及：食铁兽小姐被主播U的职业精神感动，正在替她联系尚蜀文艺界的熟人，试图为她开辟更宽阔的职业道路。
