text.en:
Friston 3 is an S-C Model four-wheeled Operation Platform, the first product of the Rhodes Island Smart Operation platform R&D Team's efforts. Closure personally led the team throughout the development process, from concept design to assembly and testing. Friston-3 is also based on PRTS, achieving a new comprehensive standard for operation platforms, from the underlying source code to the external modules. He weighs less than the other retrofitted operation platforms on Rhodes Island, while being more versatile and stable, and currently participates in operations as a Defender Operator.
[Classified Log]
The source code for Friston-3's core, compiled ideations, and other design details are temporarily unavailable to Operators, so please contact Closure directly if you have any questions.
text.zh:
S-C型四轮作业平台Friston-3，罗德岛智能作业平台研发团队正式成立后的首个成果。Friston-3由可露希尔亲自主持概念设计、落地组装与测试应用，依托于PRTS，实现了从底层代码到外部模块的全面革新。相比罗德岛上的其他改型作业平台，他更加轻便，却拥有更为全面也更为稳定的性能，现作为重装干员参与相关作战任务。
【权限记录】
有关Friston-3核心代码的来源、编写思路及更多的设计细节，暂不向各位干员开放查询权限，如有疑问可直接咨询可露希尔。

text.en:
Being Rhodes Island's very first smart operation platform developed fully in-house, Closure worked so hard on Friston-3 that she ended up 'over-designing' him——
'He should have the best combat equipment,' so Friston-3 has been equipped with the latest energy barrier generator developed by the engineering department; 'He should have deep learning and adaptive capabilities,' so Friston-3 has an Auto-updating Corpus Network, the ability to read and scan data, and a floating navigation module installed; 'He should have a rich symbolic language system not inferior to humans,' so Friston-3 has a built-in set of simple but striking emoticons that are updated quarterly; 'He should have an auto-adjusting conscious need to be entertained,' so Friston-3 has an instant camera attached onto him so he can 'snap some pics,' and requests to Procurement for films have doubled... More add-ons like these are implemented every time he undergoes maintenance, which Closure takes great joy in while Friston-3 himself is extremely opposed to these modifications.
When asked why they're no longer simply retrofitting operation platforms from Raythean Industries, Rhodes Island's Chief Engineer Closure answered as such: 'Because we should have done this a long time ago! I hate having to depend on other people's core technologies! And I always had a hunch that those Columbian companies would sneak in some backdoor plug-ins into their smart devices... And as for why we started doing this with Friston-3? It's because we've finally nailed down the skills we need in Engineering, ever since we started with Lancet-2. Also, Kal'tsit brought back Friston-3's core data from Trimounts, so it doesn't feel right to let him go through Columbian hands again for any step of the process... there's just too many complexities to consider. Alright, our chat ends here. Next up is testing his morale-raising song playback module. Where's the remote control? With me, of course.'
text.zh:
作为罗德岛首个全自研智能作业平台，可露希尔在Friston-3身上倾注了太多心血，一个具体的表现便是“过度设计”——
“他应该拥有性能最好的作战装备”，所以Friston-3配备了工程部最新研制的能量防护发生器；“他应该具备深度学习与自适应能力”，所以Friston-3应用了语料库自更新网络、阅读扫描系统与悬浮导航模块；“他应该拥有不输人类的丰富的‘副语言符号系统’”，所以Friston-3内置了一套简洁但生动的表情涂装，并以每季度一次的频率进行更新；“他应该拥有自我调节的娱乐意识”，所以Friston-3加装了一台拍立得，方便他“拍拍风景”，采购部的胶片购置需求也随之增加了一倍……且此类设计在每次定期维护检修后都会增加，可露希尔乐此不疲，Friston-3非常抗拒。
谈及为什么不再依托雷神工业的原产作业平台进行客制化，罗德岛首席工程师可露希尔小姐表示：“我们早就该这么干了！我讨厌在核心技术上受制于人的感觉！而且我总觉得那些哥伦比亚的企业会在智能设备里偷偷装一些后门插件……至于为什么从Friston-3开始自研，当然是因为我们完成了技术积累啊，工程部可是从Lancet-2时期就在筹备了。还有就是，Friston-3的核心数据是凯尔希从特里蒙带回来的，不太适合让哥伦比亚的企业再经手它的任何流程……这里面的考量就复杂了。闲聊到此结束，接下来测试Friston-3的劲歌播放组件。遥控器？遥控器当然要由我保管。”

text.en:
'THRM-EX is super passionate, while big brother Castle-3 has the wisdom of experience, and Lancet-2 is like a timid yet earnest girl who often shoots herself in the wheel... Chiave aside, we all know it's just for appearance, but Friston-3 really, really seems like a human, for real!'
——Windflit

'Lancet-2 and the others have become frequent visitors to the Lutra Workshop after Friston-3 showed up. Why? He keeps earnestly trying to teach the other robots just how advanced true AI has gotten, how to consider different prospects, what societal opinions are, and prodding them to reflect on their own existence with stuff like 'Instrumentalism' and 'what consciousness means'... he's already overloaded Lancet-2's cognitive module three times by now!'
——Mayer

'I invited Mr. Friston-3 here to act as a special consultant for the Rhodes Island Bioengineering Lab, and I did this after thinking it over carefully. He holds an astonishing amount of knowledge in biology, bioengineering, neuroscience, information science, and all that knowledge is surprisingly not in any of the databases he's connected to... His forward-looking understanding of how life and societal patterns evolve regularly leaves us mind-blown. Everything he says sounds completely plausible, but also makes you think of a parallel world, a place faintly familiar and yet completely alien to us... it does make you feel a little uneasy.
'He's not easy to talk to, though. He's pretty prejudiced, overly aggressive, a perfectionist, wants full control over his scientific research, and doubts the basic models academics currently use to verify their experimental data. And most of the time, you can't convince him otherwise. Though fortunately for us, he's equally curious about how our various technological fields are developing, so we can still manage some form of effective communication. But you know how the smarter the scientist, the harder they are to get along with... so it isn't that surprising for a scientist robot to be a little eccentric.'
——Weedy

The above are all excerpts from operators' submissions to the Rhodes Island Smart Operation Platform Service Research Survey

'They're definitely not having a friendly chat, because he's not the friendly sort to begin with. Don't worry about it though, it's par for the course with him. And it's so rare to see Kal'tsit stunned and speechless by a robot, haha... Well, it's not actually that funny. He's angry, feels humiliated, and will never run out of questions to ask her... but what can we really do? I warned Kal'tsit about this long ago.'
——Recording from the Engineering Department of Closure's response to some operators asking about Friston-3's frequent visits to Kalt'sit
text.zh:
“THRM-EX热情过头了，Castle-3大哥经历得多所以懂的也多，Lancet-2嘛，就像一个胆小又较真的小姑娘，经常自己把自己给绕进去……除了贾维，我们都知道这只是一种形容啦，但Friston-3真的很像人类，很像很像！”
——掠风

“Friston-3出现之后，Lancet-2他们就成了鲁特拉工作室的常客。为什么？Friston-3每次都会一本正经地给其他小车灌输真正的人工智能已经发展到了什么阶段，应用前景与社会舆论又是怎样的，引导他们去反思自己的存在，什么‘工具论’‘意识的定义’之类的，Lancet-2的认知模块已经过载了三次了！”
——梅尔

“我已经聘请Friston-3先生为罗德岛生物工程研究室的特别顾问，这个决定当然是慎重的。Friston-3先生在生物学、生物工程学、神经科学、信息科学等方面的知识储备令人吃惊，那些知识不被记录在他所连接的任何数据库中……他对生命演化和社会形态的理解极具前瞻性，屡次颠覆我们的认知体系，但他口中的一切又都有迹可循，你甚至能就此构想出一个并行不悖、隐隐关联却又完全陌生的遥远所在……令人有些不安。
“但他并不好说话。他过于偏执、过于强势、过于精益求精，在科学研究方面的控制欲很强，对现今学界实验数据的部分基础验证模式并不信任，而且在多数的时间无法被说服。好在他同样对于我们现在许多技术领域的发展现状感到好奇，我们的交流还是可达成的，也是有效的。再说了，越顶级的科学家越难相处……科学家机器人脾气怪一点也不难理解。”
——温蒂

——以上均摘自各位干员在《罗德岛智能作业平台服役调研表》上填写的内容

“他们的交流肯定不友好，主要是他不友好。很正常啦，别去管。看见凯尔希被一台机器怼得哑口无言可是很难得的……哈哈，也不怎么好笑。他很愤怒、很屈辱，又有太多问题要问……能怎么办呢？我早就警告过凯尔希了。”
——工程部录音，在部分干员反映Friston-3经常去找凯尔希后，可露希尔的回答

text.en:
[Classified Log]
......
'But, Kal'tsit. I'm being serious here, do you really want to go through with this? I studied the data you brought back, and even though there's only a little bit of the personality program left, it's still pretty intact. In fact, it's so intact I can't completely decipher it. At this point, I wouldn't even call him a robot more intelligent than Lancet-2, but an actual person with amnesia...'
'Do you think it's cruel, to stuff a person's soul into a machine?'
'I have to admit, I did feel a little excited at the prospect... but is this really appropriate?'
'I'm not actually sure myself.
'He did express a willingness to travel through the Terra of today in the last moments of his 'life,' but I'm not sure this counts as a new life for him. He would find himself in a shell, on a ship, in a land, all completely alien to him...
His memory will be stuck at that moment from tens of thousands of years ago, and as he looks forward to his upcoming odyssey...
'I will tell him that his journey has long ended.'
'Well, who could even bear a change this drastic? Currently, we're still testing out the core components we developed, and it's hard to tell just how well his personality program will adapt to the modules we made in-house. If his 'mood swings' fluctuate beyond what PRTS can regulate with our Engineering Department's tech, or to be more precise, with Terra's current tech...
'Simply put, I can't guarantee he won't lose control, Kal'tsit.'
'...I'll shoulder the responsibility.'
'I can't believe you'd act on something you're not even sure of...'
'We need Trevor Friston's knowledge. What he knows of humanity, of crises, of Terra, and everything beyond this great land... We need him even if this will be the second time in his life he must accept such a cruel fate. I'll convince him, he's that kind of person after all.'
'Alright, alright. If you're so set on this, I'm happy to work on it. I promise you he'll be my masterpiece!'
'...Don't let too many people disturb him.'
'Relax, I've marked down his info as 'confidential.' But since he's our very first platform developed in-house, there's still some publicity to do..'
......
——Recordings from the Engineering Team's Smart Operation platform Laboratory, marked to be destroyed
text.zh:
【权限记录】
……
“不过凯尔希，说真的，真要这么做吗？我研究过你带回来的数据，虽然只剩下极少的一部分，但人格程式是完整的，完整到无法全部解读。到时候，与其说他是比Lancet-2他们更智能的机械，不如说，他是一个失忆的人……”
“‘将一个人的灵魂塞进机器’，你觉得残忍吗？”
“我得承认我甚至有点兴奋……但是这真的合适吗？”
“我并不确定这是否合适。
“虽然他曾在‘生命’的最后，表示愿意游历如今的泰拉，但我并不确定，这对他而言，是否算得上一种新生。他会发现自己被困在完全陌生的躯壳、完全陌生的一艘船、完全陌生的大地……
“他的记忆会停留在数万年前那个离开家乡的时刻，他在期待着接下来的浩瀚征途……
“而我会告诉他，旅程早已结束。”
“唔，这换谁受得了啊……目前我们自研的核心元件还是测试版，他的人格程式与我们制造的模块的适应度有多高还很难讲，如果他的‘情绪波动’超过了PRTS所能调控的范围，以工程部掌握的技术，准确说，以这片大地现在的技术……
“说得简单点吧，我不保证他不会失控，凯尔希。”
“……我会为此负责。”
“你居然会做自己都不笃定的事情……”
“我们需要特雷弗·弗里斯顿的知识。关于人类，关于危机，关于泰拉，关于泰拉之外的一切……我们需要他，即使这是他生命中第二次接受这么残忍的命运。我会说服他，毕竟他就是那样的人。”
“行啦行啦，既然你做好了决定，我当然是一百个乐意啦。我保证，他会成为我最棒的作品！”
“……别让他被太多人打扰。”
“放心，Friston-3的资料我已经标注为‘机密’。但他作为咱们的第一款自研平台，在宣传上该出的力还是要出的。”
……
——工程部智能作业平台实验室录音，待销毁

Proficient in light and shadow-based Arts, she is skilled at fending off enemies on the battlefield. During her time aboard the landship, she will be providing us tactical and field operational support.

薇薇安娜·德罗斯特，莱塔尼亚施彤领选帝侯霍赫贝格家族后裔，前卡西米尔人气竞技骑士。经耀骑士临光举荐，在罗德岛登记为合作干员。
擅长使用光影类源石技艺，配以华丽的剑术技巧，能在战场上灵活御敌。驻留本舰期间将为罗德岛提供战术与外勤任务支援。

text.en:
A Logistics operator working at the Convalescent Garden once saw Viviana standing under the grape aisle.
She simply stood there.
Her hooded robe hid all of her actions. The operator was only able to see her antlered, snow-white silhouette from behind, not moving an inch.
'Maybe she's going through some kind of training. Best not to interrupt her.'
The operator thought, and left the grape aisle to fertilize the seedbeds further inside the greenhouse.
When the operator finished her work and was about to head back to rest, she entered the grape aisle to find Viviana still standing there. This time, she was facing her, and she noticed her hands clasped together, with her right thumb knocking the back of her left hand rhythmically. Aside from this, she wasn't moving at all. Leisurely, she simply stood there in the corridor.
Then she opened her eyes.
She pointed her finger at her antlers, and asked the operator if she could help her out.
It was only then that the operator noticed that her colleague, who had been motionless the whole time like a statue in a museum, had actually gotten her antlers caught in the grapevines and was unable to free herself.
She quickly grabbed a pair of pruning shears, and carefully cut the vines for Viviana. After the brief commotion, Viviana was freed.
......
After that, the two of them sat on a stone bench next to the grape aisle and had a short chat. Viviana was going to walk through the corridor to the flowerbeds on the other side to check on the marigolds' growth, only to find the grapevines had gotten tangled on her antlers as she was walking past. She tried to free herself at first, only to find herself getting more and more stuck as she struggled, eventually landing in that predicament.
The Logistics operator was about to ask her why she didn't seek help. After all, there were many operators in the Convalescent Garden. If she'd yelled, she wouldn't have had to suffer like that. But when she noticed Viviana describing the flora's fragrance so vividly and in such detail, as well as how she turned the automatic sprinkler's noise into a rhythm, she opted not to ask such a stupid question.
'For someone as poetic as her, perhaps a sudden, unexpected event like this was only a part of her art,' the Logistics operator thought to herself.
The chat did not go on very long. The Logistics operator had other tasks to attend to, but when they parted ways, Viviana gave her a grapevine crown, made from the same vines that were just cut. The operator had been looking at her eyes the whole time and didn't notice her making the crown at all.
Afterwards, Viviana walked through the grape aisle and disappeared among the Convalescent Garden's flowerbeds.
text.zh:
一位在疗养庭院里工作的后勤干员见到了停留在葡萄长廊下的薇薇安娜。
她就站在那里。
那件带兜帽的长袍遮掩了一切动作，这位干员只能看到一个长角的雪白背影，在那儿一动也不动。
“她大概是在进行什么修行吧，还是不要打扰比较好”。
带着这样的想法，这位干员绕开葡萄长廊，到温室深处去给苗圃施肥了。
结束工作准备去休息的时候，她走入葡萄长廊，看到薇薇安娜依然站在那里。这一次，她面对着薇薇安娜，看到她双手交叉，右手食指在左手手背上有规律地敲击着。除此以外，便没有其他动作，悠哉自得地站立在长廊中。
她睁开了眼睛。
她伸手指了指自己的角，问眼前的干员能不能想办法把自己放下来。
直到这时，这位干员才发现，眼前这个如美术馆里的雕像一样一动不动的同僚，其实只是被葡萄藤束缚住了双角，动弹不得而已。
她赶紧取来园艺剪，小心翼翼地帮薇薇安娜剪除藤蔓。一阵忙活后，薇薇安娜又自由了。
……
在那之后，她们坐在葡萄长廊旁的石椅上简单聊了一会。薇薇安娜原本只是想穿过挂满葡萄的长廊，去另一端的花田里看看金盏花近期的长势，没想到，在走过长廊时，葡萄藤趁机挂住了她的长角。她本想挣开，结果却是越缠越紧，最后就成了这副样子。
后勤干员本想问问薇薇安娜为什么不求救，疗养庭院里有很多干员，只要喊一声，大可不必遭受这样的折磨。但看着薇薇安娜在那儿生动又细致地描述草叶花香，将自动洒水机运作的杂音编成有节奏的旋律，她还是把这个蠢问题吞回了肚里。
“对于她那样诗意的人，这样的突发事件，或许只是她诗歌中的一部分吧。”后勤干员这样想着。
闲谈没有持续多久，后勤干员还有其他事要做，但在分别的时候，薇薇安娜送给了她一个葡萄藤花冠——那是用刚刚被剪落的葡萄藤做的。她一直看着薇薇安娜的眼睛，完全没看到她编织花冠的动作。
而后，薇薇安娜便轻巧地走过葡萄长廊，消失在了疗养庭院的花圃中。

text.en:
When she informed Młynar that a campaign knight swordstaff with the Nearls' crest had appeared in Kargereich, the two of them returned to Kazimierz and informed Margaret. The news undoubtedly affected the Nearls greatly. It implies that Margaret's parents and Młynar's brother and sister-in-law had left behind a tiny clue to their whereabouts. Viviana has a deep understanding of the dangers of Kargereich. Not to mention that the Nearl family does not currently have the slightest clue how to reenter that strange unreality, and with Margaret still occupied with helping the Infected of Kazimierz, it would perhaps be a long time before they could investigate...
So Viviana promised Margaret that she would provide all the help she could. At the same time, she also sought her advice regarding her future. Although she had returned to Kazimierz, that did not mean she would once again become a competition knight—she had long since tired of that status. Although her foster mother, Rossi the Grand Knight, had lunch with her on the day of her arrival and expressed her concern, she was unable to find Viviana a place to go. Returning to Leithanien was also not an option in the short term. After she pondered this over and over, Viviana was even prepared to return to Ognisko to continue her pastoral lifestyle.
However, Margaret was able to read the hint of helplessness in her words and knew that her friend would not be satisfied with simply living a quiet life. Hiding deep within her heart there was a desire to help those around her, however possible. But because of her experiences and perspective, she had yet to find her way. Margaret was naturally more than happy to help with this. As such, she recommended Rhodes Island—Not its Kazimierzian offices, but Rhodes Island itself.
Viviana had heard a few things about what they had done in Kazimierz: They led a well-trained team of operators to help the Infected and dealt with all the corporations of the General Chamber of Commerce. This rather piqued her interest, and as she listened to Margaret's descriptions, she noticed something even more special about them she found attractive: Rhodes Island could provide her the opportunity to go somewhere far away from both Leithanien and Kazimierz, where she could once again seek out poetry and stories. And when Margaret told her about the time she faced Reunion in Chernobog and mentioned the Doctor and Amiya, the smile in the corner of her mouth and her unusually resolute eyes both got Viviana very curious. The changes Margaret went through from the time she quietly left Kazimierz after winning the championship, to her return to the Grand Knight Territory and taking the crown once more—before subsequently settling down—must have all been thanks to her time with Rhodes Island. What exactly was this island like, for the Radiant Knight, as impetuous yet unadaptable as she is, to become someone able to withstand the pressure of the GCC and stay in the Grand Knight Territory? What kind of place could earn such trust and loyalty from the knight she so admires? What kind of bewitching powers does the leader known as the 'Doctor' possess? She wanted to see it all with her own eyes.
And so, a few weeks later, Viviana arrived on Rhodes Island.
text.zh:
当她将印有临光家徽章的征战骑士的剑枪曾经出现在荒域的消息告知玛恩纳后，两人同行回到了卡西米尔并将这一消息告知了玛嘉烈。这则消息对临光家的影响无疑是巨大的，这意味着失踪了十几年之久的玛嘉烈·临光的双亲，玛恩纳·临光的兄嫂留下了一星半点的线索。对于荒域的凶险，薇薇安娜深有体会，更何况，如今的他们根本不知道如何重新进入那片不属于现实的空间，玛嘉烈身上也仍负着救助卡西米尔感染者的担子，真想要随着这条线索查到什么，或许还需要很长时间……
薇薇安娜答应玛嘉烈自己会为她提供力所能及的帮助，然而，在自己未来的去处上，她也在询问玛嘉烈的建议。回到卡西米尔，不代表自己会重新成为竞技骑士——她早已厌倦了这一身份。她的养母，大骑士长罗素虽在薇薇安娜到达大骑士领的那一天就与她共进了午餐并表达了关心，可她一时间也没办法为薇薇安娜找到一个好去处。重回莱塔尼亚在短期内也不算是一种选择。思来想去，薇薇安娜准备回到奥格尼斯科，继续她那田园牧歌式的生活。
然而玛嘉烈捕捉到了薇薇安娜言语中的一丝无奈，这位朋友当然不会满足于安静地活在当下。她的内心暗含着一种渴望，想要为身边的人们做一些力所能及的事，只是碍于自身的经历与眼界，她暂时还没找到方向，而在这件事上，玛嘉烈当然很乐于帮忙。于是她向薇薇安娜推荐了罗德岛——不是罗德岛卡西米尔办事处，而是罗德岛。
罗德岛在卡西米尔做过的事薇薇安娜有所耳闻：带领一支训练有素的干员队伍、救助感染者、在商业联合会各个公司间周旋。这确实让薇薇安娜颇有兴趣，然而，在听过了玛嘉烈的描述后，她发现罗德岛还有更特别的东西吸引着她——罗德岛提供了一个机会，能够让她去往那些远离莱塔尼亚与卡西米尔的地方，重新寻找诗歌与故事。而玛嘉烈提到她在切尔诺伯格直面整合运动的时光，提到博士与阿米娅时，那嘴角勾起的微笑，异常坚定的眼神，都让薇薇安娜很好奇。从玛嘉烈上一次夺冠后黯然离开卡西米尔，到这一次重回大骑士领再次夺冠并在此安定下来，其中的转变想必都发生在罗德岛。究竟是怎样一个地方，能让锋芒毕露却不擅变通的耀骑士如今能顶住商业联合会的压力留在大骑士领，能让自己所欣赏的骑士交付那般可贵的友谊与忠诚？这位被称作“博士”的领导者，究竟有着怎样的魔力？她想要亲眼见识一下。
于是，几周后，薇薇安娜来到了罗德岛。

text.en:
There was a power outage in the library, and the room fell into darkness. Although the administrator tried to raise his voice to calm the operators reading there, he was unable to quell the circulating complaints. Naturally, Viviana was already used to this kind of darkness. She took out her sword, placed it by the table, and used her Arts to light up a candle on her sword to continue reading the epic she had borrowed. Ever since she was small child, this was how she would always read. A small candle is more than enough to completely dispel an entire swath of darkness. When she was young, she relied on the light of a candle to read her books. There was much that she was unable to do in darkness, and perhaps the only resistance she could put up was to light a candle.
......
Viviana lifted her head to find a great number of operators gathered around her. They all wanted to keep reading, but none wanted to leave the library, and so they had gathered around this lonely light source. Viviana pondered a little, and used her Arts to light up the candle on the other end of her sword. Immediately, the long table she occupied was enveloped by a warm glow. The operators around her all expressed their gratitude, and she simply nodded and continued reading. Before, in the arenas, her candlelight was much more radiant than it now was. It was able to outshine the flashes of the cameras and the spotlights of the arena. Men gushed after her like surging tides as they yelled her title. Everyone had smiles on their faces, carefully choosing the words they showered her with, yet in their hearts—and Viviana knew this better than anyone—they were all trying to extract value from her. There were flames of greed burning in the eyes of her colleagues in the Nova Knightclub, and there were flames of fervor burning in the eyes of her fans. It was the light of these flames that lit the Grand Knight Territory. Her candlelight was but a part of this light, and this light of sickness was exhausting to her. And so she extinguished her own candlelight and walked into the darkness.
......
They huddled around the tableside candlelight and continued reading for a good while. The administrator then walked in and pointed out that the power had been restored, and they had to flip the switch in the breaker box back on, but as it would be very difficult to work alone in the dark, he asked if Viviana would be willing to help guide the way. Viviana kept her sword by the tableside, and lit her own candle holder. The faint flame brought with it an enormously bright glow that lit the library up like daylight. The administrator walked ahead of her, as she followed with her candle held high. As she looked on at the silhouette that straddled between darkness and light, she couldn't help but think back on what she had endured in Kargereich. There had been no one to guide her. She could only raise the candle in her hand by herself and attempt to find something in that darkness. She walked past countless herselves, each with a candlelight that lit, only to go out. In the end, all that was left was— The administrator reached the breaker box, and he signaled to her that she may now put her candle away. Thus, she waved her hand. The flames on the candle holder and her sword all extinguished at once, and a darkness befell the space around them. Emptiness, hollowness, and the freezing cold. These were once the things she was most afraid of. But she had gotten through all of them. The ice-cold darkness of her childhood was unable to defeat her, nor the hollow darkness of Kargereich after she had grown up. Is it because she is the light that illuminates the dark, or is it because she is the darkness itself?
The lights of the library slowly lit up, and everything returned to normal. Viviana returned to her table, picked up her book, and continued reading.
text.zh:
图书室断电了，房间里一片黑暗。即使管理员大声安抚着来看书的干员，抱怨声仍在这个空间里横行。当然，薇薇安娜早已习惯了这种黑暗。她取出长剑放在桌边，用源石技艺点亮了剑上的一支蜡烛，就着烛光继续阅览着手中的传记。从小到大，她都是这么看书的。一根小小的蜡烛，就能彻底驱散一整片黑暗，年幼的她就凑在蜡烛边，借着那光芒阅读书籍上的字句。在茫茫黑暗中，有多少她力所不能及的事。她唯一的抗争，或许就只有点起烛火，仅此而已了。
……
薇薇安娜一抬头，发现周围凑过来许多干员。他们还想读一会书，却又不想离开图书室，于是纷纷聚拢到这唯一的光源边上，继续看书。薇薇安娜想了想，用源石技艺点亮了长剑上的另外一根蜡烛。霎时，她所在的整张长桌都被柔和的光芒所笼罩，围着的干员纷纷表示了感激，而薇薇安娜只是点了点头，继续看书。曾经，在赛场上，这烛火要比现在更加闪耀，盖过记者的闪光灯，以及赛场内的聚光灯。人们如潮水般向她涌来，高声呼喊着她的封号。每个人都赔着笑脸，小心谨慎地斟酌着自己的词句，然而心底里——薇薇安娜再清楚不过了——都在想方设法从自己身上榨取价值。散华骑士团的同僚眼中闪着贪婪的火，粉丝们眼中闪着狂热的火，而正是这些火带来的光，照亮了整个大骑士领。她的烛火本是那光亮的一部分，但这病态的光让她感到厌倦，于是她掐灭了自己的烛火，走入了黑暗中。
……
他们围着长桌边的烛火看了好一会儿书，管理员才姗姗来迟，电力恢复了，他得把跳了的电闸上的开关推回去，一个人在黑暗中并不好操作，于是他询问薇薇安娜是否愿意帮忙引一下路。薇薇安娜将长剑留在长桌旁，点燃了自己的烛台，微弱的火光带来了巨大的光亮，将整个图书室照得宛如白昼。管理员在前面走，薇薇安娜高举着烛台跟在后面，看着那些在黑暗与光明边缘的身影，薇薇安娜不禁想到了自己在荒域时的境遇。没有人为她引路，只有自己孤独地举着烛台，试图在那黑暗中找到些什么。无数的自己从身旁走过，一捧捧烛火亮起又熄灭，而最终留下的，却只有——管理员摸到了电闸，示意薇薇安娜能收起烛台了。于是，她一挥手，烛台与剑上的烛火一齐熄灭，黑暗席卷而来。空洞，虚无，冰冷，曾经薇薇安娜最害怕的事物。但她挺过来了，幼时冰冷的黑暗没能击败她，长大后荒域里空虚的黑暗也没能战胜她。这究竟是因为，她是点亮黑暗的光明，还是因为，她本身就是黑暗？
图书室的灯光缓缓亮起，一切恢复如常，薇薇安娜回到自己的长桌旁，重新捧起了书本，细细阅读。

text.en:
In that dream of Kargereich, Viviana saw her younger self. She saw her many mistakes and regrets. Many past events have faded as time went on, and can never again be recovered, but there are a few insignificant bits and pieces that can still be retrieved from the corners of her memory. There are still certain childish parts to her adult self. In the past, because of her constraints and to stay out of the reporters' sight, she could only keep those urges hidden deep in her heart, but now...
'Um... Er...' Nearl the Radiant Knight did not have the words to express everything going through her mind when she saw the dream-like palace built of a variety of dolls in the corner of the dormitory. On the other hand, the master of the palace welcomed her dumbfounded guest with a smile that embodied her satisfaction and joy.
It was no surprise that the knight was so flabbergasted. In that realm, there was a green patch of grass and a lake painted onto the carpet. The half-open cabinets in the corner of the wall formed a mountain range and a castle. There was a warm, gentle glow emanating from the light hanging above, with everything surrounded on all sides by dust covers.
Wild, woolen beasts of all kinds fed on the ground, paying no heed to the humans toiling nearby. The tin sentinels held their long spears tight in their hands. The silver princess ran barefoot in the field of grass.
The knight was about to say something, only for the master of this tiny realm to press a button and the castle in the cabinet began to change shape, revealing even more eccentric scenes: the Gesatzswächter trimming vines with a pair of shears in his hands, the blindfolded lady playing a foreign instrument with ease, the poet embracing his wife and lounging on a chair, and a finely-crafted model of what appeared to be a sword or a spear laid sound asleep in the wool by their feet...
Still unable to recover from her shock, the knight thought carefully about the pile of dolls. Especially the woolen one with the Nearl family crest in the corner. Aside from giving her old friend an embarrassed smile, the knight could not think of what else to do...
This sudden, minor farce did not last for long. After a simple round of teasing, the knight obtained the records she had wanted from her friend: inside were the complete sequence of events Viviana had compiled from her recollections. With all the matters she had to attend to dealt with, the two's meeting aboard Rhodes Island came to a close for the time being. Before she departed though, Margaret suddenly had a question. She had seen herself among the puppets, yet their master herself was nowhere to be seen among them.
The master did not give her an answer. She simply smiled and flipped another switch. The 'sun' slowly turned and revealed the secret hidden inside—
A young 'Master' slept curled up within, but her two antlers were already interwoven with light, illuminating the entire room.
text.zh:
在那场荒域的迷梦中，薇薇安娜看到了年幼时的自己，看到了诸多错失与遗憾。许多往事已经随时间而去，再也回不来，但还有一些，微小的一些，还能从记忆的边角中找回。成年的她依旧有童真的部分，从前碍于管束、碍于被小报记者盯上，她只能把那份冲动藏在心底里，但现在……
“啊……呃……”看着宿舍一角由各种玩偶垒起的梦幻宫殿，耀骑士临光一时间不知道自己该说什么好。而宫殿的主人，正带着满足和喜悦，微笑着看向错愕的客人。
也难怪骑士大人如此惊讶，在那一方天地里，铺设的地毯被绘上了青草与湖泊，墙角的半开放橱柜做成了山川与城堡的样子，一盏悬浮灯散发着柔和的光，四周则用防尘罩遮了个严实。
形态各异的毛绒野兽在地上吃食，丝毫不在乎近旁劳作的人类，锡制哨兵紧握着长枪，白银公主赤脚在草原上奔跑。
骑士本准备说些什么，小天地的主人摁下按钮，橱柜城堡兀自变形，更多的奇妙开始涌现：金律法卫手持剪刀修理藤蔓，蒙眼的贵妇拿着异国乐器悠然自得，诗人怀抱妻子在躺椅上入眠，在他脚下，一把如杖似剑的精巧模型也在棉绒中静静沉睡……
骑士细细琢磨着玩偶堆，仍旧没有从震惊中回过神来，特别是在看到角落里放着一个怀抱临光家家徽的毛绒玩偶后，除了向老朋友回以一个尴尬的微笑，骑士也确实做不了其他事了……
这场突如其来的小闹剧并没有持续太久，在一阵简单的调侃与交流后，骑士从朋友手中拿到了她想要的记录：里面是薇薇安娜事后根据回忆整理的事件全貌。玛嘉烈事务繁忙，两人在罗德岛上的会面也暂告结束。临行前，骑士突然想起一个问题，她在玩偶里见到了自己，但在这诸多玩偶中，并没有主人自己的身影。
主人没有回答，只是笑着摁了另外一个开关，“太阳”缓缓转动，显现出内里的奥秘——
幼小的“主人”蜷缩沉眠其间，但她的双角却已交织化作光芒，照亮整个房间。

……

value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Confirmed Infected by medical examination.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

text.en:
Carlie Lander, codename Caper, is active in areas of Bolívar where confrontations are common and accepts short-term employment from all sides to covertly stir up chaos.
While looking for new work, she proactively contacted the local Rhodes Island office and expressed interest in field operator work. After both sides got to know each other, we entered into a cooperative agreement.
text.zh:
卡莉·兰德，代号“跃跃”，活跃于玻利瓦尔境内冲突频发的地区，承接各方势力的短期雇佣，暗中给敌对势力制造混乱。
为寻求新工作主动接触了当地的罗德岛办事处，对外勤干员的工作表现出浓厚兴趣，双方彼此了解后签订了合作协议。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 5%
Operator Caper's infection is currently at an early stage; a small amount of Originium crystals are present on her body surface, primarily around her hands.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.16u/L
Operator Caper rarely comes into contact with Originium intentionally, but owing to her past lifestyle, Originium-ridden environments were unavoidable. In many areas of Bolívar, contracting Oripathy is commonplace, and the locals demonstrate an extreme lack of caution towards Originium. This has been to the benefit of local factions.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】5%
干员跃跃感染程度较浅，体表仅出现了少量源石结晶，主要分布于手部。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.16u/L
干员跃跃极少主动接触源石，但鉴于她过去的生活方式，身处受源石污染的环境是难以避免的。在玻利瓦尔的许多地区，罹患矿石病并不是什么新鲜事。当地人面对源石极度缺乏防护意识，而这更为部分当地势力省了不少麻烦。

text.en:
Not long after she came to Rhodes Island, Caper's personality triggered a dispute among operators.
Until now, she has only ever sought one thing out of life: enjoyment. In her particular parlance, 'fun.' She loves toys, jokes, and fresh, exhilarating challenges, but what she loves most is playing with others. It should be noted that 'playing with others' doesn't quite mean the same thing to Caper. It connotes something closer to 'toying with,' and in general she never asks for their consent. Because of how deceiving her appearance can be, you could very well fall into her trap if you let your guard down around her. Sadly, Lancet-2 knows this from experience. She was tricked into getting a 'system upgrade' and had THRM-EX's language module installed, leading her to loudly yell 'thermal shock' at the Medical Department. This left her depressed for several days.
A sizable number of operators have expressed discomfort regarding Caper's preferred method of recreation, and doubt her ability to show respect. Others have been more accepting of her behavior. At the very least, she has not caused any actual damage yet. Nonetheless, they remain uneasy about her behavior, as it appears she is not at all aware of the consequences of her actions.
For a child, this is definitely not a good phenomenon.
text.zh:
来到罗德岛后不久，跃跃的个性就在干员中引发了一定的争议。
跃跃在迄今为止的人生中只有一个追求——乐趣，用她的话说就是“玩”。她喜欢玩具，喜欢笑话，喜欢新鲜刺激的挑战，不过她最爱的还是和人一起玩。但请注意，跃跃的“一起玩”不是通常意义上的一起玩耍，而是她单方面的取乐，且基本不会征求参与者的同意。由于跃跃的外表极具迷惑性，和她相处时稍不留神，很可能就落入了她的陷阱之中。可怜的Lancet-2对此深有体会，她被跃跃用“系统升级”的说法哄骗，换上了THRM-EX的语言模块，导致她在医疗部里大声喊出了“热量冲击”。为此她抑郁了好几天。
对于跃跃在本舰上的娱乐行径，有相当一部分干员明确表示感到了不适，对她是否懂得尊重抱有疑问。另一部分干员则对跃跃展现了包容的态度，至少她没有造成什么实质性的破坏。但他们仍对跃跃的状态抱有些许不安，因为看起来，她似乎根本没有意识到自己的行为会带来的后果。
对于一个孩子来说，这不是个好现象。

text.en:
Her behavior during field missions is likewise disconcerting to others. This is not to say that she messes up her missions. Rather, her actions tend to be unexpected and keep others on edge. What's more, they are often accompanied by chaos.
'All she did was loosen a screw, and that heavy transport lost control on the road. The driver was flung out like a ragdoll, and the truck crashed into the target's military base head on. It started leaking fuel, which just so happened to flow right into the explosives storeroom... and you know what she did? She had some marshmallows with her all along, and started roasting them!' The operators explained how nerve-racking it was to be deployed on the same mission as Caper.
That said, it is apparent that field missions she participates are often completed with high effectiveness and efficiency. This perhaps contradicts the image that many others have of her. Caper's psychological analysis shows that she has a very keen insight, far exceeding her actual age, which enables her to identify the complex relationships between different things. On the other hand, she really sees all her behaviors as 'having fun.' In her eyes, there is no difference between being on a field mission and playing pranks on others. If she's going to have fun, then she has to go for the greatest excitement possible and get the most out of it, all while keeping herself out of trouble.
The only ones who seem completely unsurprised by Caper's behavior are the operators of the Bolívarian office. In many war-torn areas of Bolívar, the streets are ruled by orphans and young men and women with nothing to do. The chaos that can be found just about anywhere is the only source of entertainment that they have, and seeking excitement and thrills is what drives them to survive. Before they even learn to read and write, they have already picked up daggers and crossbows, and been chased as they laugh out loud. That's how they grow up, in savageness. Afterwards, the vast majority of them become 'professional hoodlums.' They find employment with the local factions and covertly run errands for the 'bigshots.' Almost all of these tasks are causing trouble for the opposing side from the behind the scenes, and Caper is thought of as showing considerable self-restraint.
'At the very least, her explosions don't get anyone hurt or killed.'
text.zh:
跃跃在外勤任务中的表现同样令人不安。这并不是意味着她会搞砸行动，而是她的行事风格总是出人意料、让人心惊胆战，且常常伴随着混乱。
“她只是松掉了一根螺丝，然后那辆重型载具就在途中失去控制，甩出司机，一头撞进了目标的军事基地中。车里的燃料漏了出来，刚好流进了爆炸物仓库中……而她竟然都准备好了用来烤的棉花糖！”干员们在讲述与跃跃一同行动的经历时总是心有余悸。
与过程形成鲜明对比的是，有跃跃参与的外勤任务往往都能高效完成，这或许会打破很多人对她的固有印象。跃跃的心理评估报告显示，她具备远超实际年龄的洞察力，能够厘清事物间的复杂关系。但另一方面，她真的以“玩”来看待自己的这些行为，在她看来，外勤行动和平时的恶作剧没什么不同。既然是玩，那就得追求最大的刺激，收获最多的乐趣，同时别惹麻烦上身。
唯独玻利瓦尔办事处的干员对跃跃的表现毫不意外。在玻利瓦尔许多被战争倾轧过的地区，其街道大多被孤儿和无所事事的年轻人占据，随处可见的混乱是他们仅有的玩乐，追求刺激是他们活下去的动力。在识字之前就拿起弩箭和匕首，边被追赶边哈哈大笑，他们就这样野蛮成长着。之后，他们中的大多数都会走上“职业混混”的道路：接受本地势力雇佣，替“大人物们”暗中行事，其中最多的就是在对手后方引发混乱。而跃跃的行为在他们当中已经算是相当克制了。
“至少她搞出的爆炸没有造成任何伤亡。”

text.en:
It's never an easy task to investigate the past of a Bolívarian. Through our countless interviews and lengthy investigations, we've uncovered a name—Carlie Lander.
Carlie Lander was born to a single-parent family in the Bolívarian slums and was raised alone by her mother, who worked as an assembler for the local munitions factory. When Carlie was old enough, she naturally started wandering the streets with the other kids from the slums. She was already showing talent in stirring up trouble. Her name is linked to many incidents, such as how a group of government soldiers who bullied the local citizens all lined up and fell into the sewers one-by-one, or how an infamous thug got hung up on some power lines in the dead of night.
According to a young man from the streets, everyone saw Carlie as a genius when it came to pranks. They thought she would one day take on the 'Redhead' that ruled the five barrios and take over as the new boss in town. They were right about the first part, at least. Carlie did indeed fearlessly challenge Redhead, and the intellectually lopsided challenge ended with Redhead getting tricked into getting on the car that took new recruits to the barracks.
But afterwards, Carlie didn't rule the streets as everyone expected. She simply announced two perpetual rules and disbanded the gang. But her two rules were more puzzling than the disbandment: No hurting anyone, and go home before 5:30. Ever since, she continued to live her best life on the street with her buddies, causing trouble everywhere, and went home right on time in the evenings, living each and every day happily.
Those peaceful days lasted until two years ago, when Carlie unexpectedly contracted Oripathy. After an intense argument with her mother, she left home and the city she lived in, never to return again.
After that, the professional hoodlum Caper was born.

[Investigation Notes]
...Young Carlie, huh? Of course I remember her. Good kid. Never caused any trouble for her family.
*sigh* The kids here are all like that... I mean, what're you supposed to do about that? Things were better when she was around though. It's gotten worse.
Gotta say. Señora Lander raised her well. Young Carlie always listened to her mother and never failed to be at home by sundown. Not like those other kids.
There's one other thing that comes to mind. It happened when Carlie was still a kid, on her birthday. She stole some fuel from home, and was going to show the kids in town what she was really capable of and make a big ruckus at a high end fashion boutique. When she had everything ready and was about to pull the trigger, she suddenly hesitated. She ran back into the store and tried to get the shopkeeper out. That was when... she saw her mother inside, buying clothes for her as a birthday present...
She was shaken, you know. She knew she almost messed up, but her mother simply grabbed her hand, bought some clothes with three months worth of wages, and went home with her.
She'd known about everything, really, and trusted her daughter not to hurt anyone and to learn her lesson...
She's a good mother.
text.zh:
调查玻利瓦尔人的过去通常不是项容易的工作。在干员长期的走访调查中，我们得到了一个名字——卡莉·兰德。
卡莉·兰德，出生于玻利瓦尔贫民窟的一个单亲家庭，从小被母亲带大，她的母亲是当地军工厂的一名装配工。卡莉到了年纪，自然就和贫民窟的其他孩子一样走上街头。此时的卡莉已经初露捣乱方面的天赋，她的名字与许多事件联系在了一起，例如欺压民众的政府军人排队掉进下水道，或是臭名昭著的恶霸半夜被挂在了电线杆上。
据一位街头少年所说，他们过去一直把卡莉当成干坏事的天才，认为卡莉总有一天会挑战那名称霸五个街区的“红毛”并取胜，成为街区里新的老大。他们猜的前半段大致没错，卡莉毫无畏惧地向“红毛”发起了挑战。这场智力上并不对等的挑战，最终以“红毛”被骗上送新兵前往军营的车而告终。
但在这之后，卡莉并没有如期望的那样称霸街头，她只是宣布了两条永久规定就解散了帮派。比起解散帮派，那两条规定更让那些混混迷惑：不许伤人，以及下午五点半前必须回家。此后她仍是每天上街和伙伴们疯玩，四处惹是生非，并在傍晚准时回家，愉快地度过每一天。
这样平静的生活一直持续到两年前，卡莉意外染上了矿石病。在和母亲激烈争吵后，她离开了家，离开了生活的城市，再也没有回来。
之后，职业混混“跃跃”出现了。

【查访笔记】
……你说小卡莉啊，我当然记得她。她是个好孩子，从不给家里惹麻烦。
唉，这里的孩子都这样……还能怎么办呢？卡莉在的时候街上还算好，现在又乱了套。
说到这个，小卡莉能那样，都是兰德女士教育得好。小卡莉听妈妈的话，一到傍晚就回家，这才没和那些孩子学坏。
我还记得一件事，那是卡莉挺小的时候，有一年生日，她偷了家里的燃料，要向那些孩子展示她的本事——在一家高级服装店里闹个大的。她什么都准备好了，正要动手的时候，却忽然犹豫了。她转而跑回店里，想要把店员都赶出去，就在这时……她看见她妈妈就在里面，正给她买衣服作礼物……
小卡莉被吓住了，知道差点就酿成大错。但兰德女士只是牵起女儿的手，拎上拿三个月工资买的衣服，一起回了家。
其实兰德女士什么都知道，她相信她女儿不会真的伤人，也确定女儿会吸取教训……
她是位好母亲。

text.en: It has been some time since Caper came to Rhodes Island, and compared to when she was fresh aboard the landship, she seems to have gotten a fair bit 'unused' to her environment. For example, many of our operators are no longer as surprised as she expects when she pulls off her carefully designed pranks. They even start laughing before she does now. This really puts a damper on her fun. Another example: she's found that there is lots of fun readily available aboard Rhodes Island: video games in the game room, operators joking around in the cafeteria, and tons of new things to see on field missions. There's no need to go looking for any. Her old lifestyle has become unnecessary. Although it is not uncommon for operators to be unaccustomed to their new environment, we nonetheless kept an eye on Caper's situation. Past cases have shown that most who've returned to normalcy after such a chaotic lifestyle had difficulties adapting to their surroundings, and the more serious of such cases have even led to self-harm. Not to mention that Caper is still a child. As such, we observed her actions and provided psychological counseling to be able to address any unexpected situations that could arise. What we've noticed is that Caper simply looked a little helpless. The frequency of her pranks has gone down, and she's been spending more time paying attention to every detail around her. Our follow-up with her also found no signs of depression or anxiety, but rather a huge sense of curiosity, 'just like a mathematician who discovered a new method of verifying their hypothesis,' as one operator put it. When we saw that, all our worries faded away. [Caper Observation Report - 23] ...When Caper kicked that can to irritate the kids in the sickroom, it really made all of us jump out of our skin. I didn't expect them to actually start playing kick the can. They chased after each other, and tired themselves out before long. I'd never seen the kids go so crazy. They all had smiles on their bright red cheeks, saying how they weren't going to lose, how Caper must've had training in kicking the can outside, how they're all sick and so it's unfair. Caper then chuckled, took her glove off, and showed them the Originium crystal on her hand. They moped a little, and kept quiet. After a while, the youngest of the children asked her if they could still play kick the can tomorrow. She immediately refused. She said, 'You dummy, there are tons of other games to play.' ...... We can more or less conclude at this point that Caper is a lot more mature than we imagined. She understands the truth behind her sharpness, and that's why she actively tests out her new environment. Most importantly, she's always understood what it is that she is looking for— She wants true happiness. Good thing that's something we can give her. [Childlike Handwriting] Mamá, I have to go now. I'm looking for somewhere different. Somewhere I don't have to be happy to cover my eyes. Somewhere I don't have to be happy to forget about all the pain and sadness. Somewhere where being happy is just that. When I find that place, I'll write you...
text.zh:
跃跃已经来到罗德岛有一段时日了。比起刚来的时候，她明显多了些“不适应”。
就比如说，现在面对她精心设计的恶作剧，许多干员不仅没有如她设想的那般惊慌，反而先于她大笑起来，这让她的乐趣大打折扣。还比如说，她发现在罗德岛上到处都是唾手可得的乐趣——游戏室里有电子游戏，食堂里总有干员在讲笑话，外勤任务中满是新鲜事，根本不用费心寻找。她过去的生活方式反而变得没必要了。
尽管面对新环境的不适应普遍存在，但我们仍对跃跃的情况提高了警惕。过往案例表明，许多从混乱中回归正常生活的人都出现了适应障碍，严重时会伤及自身，更何况跃跃只是个孩子，因此我们对她进行了行为观察和心理咨询随访，以随时应对不测。
然而我们观察到的是，跃跃仅仅是表现得有些无措。她降低了捣乱的频率，用更多的时间注意周围的一举一动。随访的结果也显示，跃跃并没有出现情绪低落和不安，反而充满了好奇心，“就像一个数学家找到了新方法验证猜想”，有干员这么形容。
直到我们观察到了这样一幕，一切顾虑都烟消云散了。
【跃跃观察报告·二十三】
……当跃跃踢起罐子，故意惹恼病房里的孩子们时，我们都捏了一把汗。
没想到他们真的开始争起罐子来，你追我赶，没两下就累到跑不动了。孩子们从没这么疯玩过，红彤彤的脸上都是笑容，嘴上却不服输，说跃跃一定在外面练过踢罐子，他们又都是病人，真不公平。
跃跃嘿嘿一笑，摘下手套，亮了亮手上的源石结晶。孩子们哀叹一声，不再言语。
过了一会儿，年龄最小的孩子问跃跃，明天还能和她一起踢罐子吗。
跃跃一口回绝。她说，傻吧，以后好玩的多的是呢。
……
基本能够下定论了，跃跃的心智远比我们想象的成熟。
她理解自己过去的尖锐真相，所以才用行为来勘验新的环境。
最重要的是，她一直明白自己追求的是什么——
她想要真正的快乐。
幸好，这是我们能够给予她的。

【稚嫩的笔迹】
妈妈，我要走了。我要去找一个地方。
一个不用开心遮住眼睛的地方。
一个不用开心忘掉痛苦和悲伤的地方。
一个开心就是开心的地方。
等我找到了，我就给你写信……

text.en:
The toy that Caper calls 'Twirly-Twirl' is undoubtedly a weapon.
Our reverse engineering tells us that over seventy percent of its parts are sourced from Bolívarian military equipment. Although they all show significant wear and tear, when put together, they nonetheless provide a weapon's basic lethality. This should never have been a child's toy.
Caper told us that her mother made it specifically for her. She wanted a unique toy, but her family was unable to afford the dolls in the shop windows, so her mother made this for her out of abandoned spare parts from the factory.
'Without this, I'd probably only have the old crossbow bolts on the street to play with. Which would've been sooo boring.'
We are aware that many operators have expressed concern about Caper freely using the 'Twirly-Twirl,' but the truth is that she has not violated any rules by using it.
So far, the most astonishing achievement of the device is that it has successfully led multiple Perro operators, namely Ceobe, to chase it back and forth on the same spot for an entire afternoon.
text.zh:
跃跃手上名为“转转”的玩具，毫无疑问，是一件武器。
逆向工程的结论是，该装备中超过七成的部件都来自于玻利瓦尔的军事装备。尽管零件老化严重，但组合起来后依然保有武器的基本杀伤力，根本不该作为孩子的玩具。
跃跃说，这就是她妈妈为她特地制作的玩具。她想要独一无二的玩具，但家里买不起橱窗里的玩偶，妈妈就拿工厂里的废旧零件做了这个。
“没有它的话，我就只能玩烂大街的弩箭了，那多没意思啊。”
我们知道许多干员对“转转”能被跃跃自由使用表示担忧，但事实是，跃跃没有用它违反任何规定。
截至目前，“转转”最显赫的战绩是：成功诱骗了以刻俄柏为首的数名佩洛干员在空地上折返跑，荒废了一整个下午。

value.en: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected by medical examination.
value.zh: 体表有源石结晶分布，参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected by medical examination.
infectionStatus.zh: 体表有源石结晶分布，参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

text.en:
Operator Valarqvin belongs to a Cyclops tribe that lives in seclusion in the Wintertooth Mountains and is said to have the ability to see into the future.
For the foreseeable future, she is proactively seeking partnerships with as many parties as possible, and has currently reached an agreement with Rhodes Island to provide assistance in matters related to Sami and its northern icefields.
text.zh:
干员凛视，隐居于萨米北部冬牙群山的独眼巨人族群的一员，据称该族群拥有能预见未来的源石技艺。
为了其预见的某种未来，正在积极主动地向各方寻求合作，现与罗德岛达成协议，为罗德岛在萨米及其北方冰原上的相关事务提供帮助。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 5%
Originium crystals are prominent on the body's surface.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.23u/L
Operator Valarqvin has a keen sense of self-preservation and the requisite knowledge to do so. However, if she follows the path she has recently laid out to Rhodes Island, then it is very likely that her BOCD will be on the high side.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】5%
干员凛视体表有明显源石结晶。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.23u/L
干员凛视有较好的自我防护意识和相关知识，只是，如果她向罗德岛陈述的近期行动轨迹属实，那么血液源石结晶密度偏高也是难免的事情。

text.en:
Historical records have always left the Sarkaz tribe of the Cyclopes shrouded in mystery. In modern times, some even believe their deeds to be nothing more than myths or legends, tall tales born from misunderstandings. With the exception of the memories passed down through the Sarkaz, the last written record of the Cyclopes in the nations of Terra appeared about a hundred and ten years ago. Afterward, they disappeared completely from the public eye. Even though Rhodes Island knew that the Cyclopes had foretold the firestorm that would engulf Londinium, none of them were witnessed appearing during the conflict itself.
Which is why when Valarqvin took the initiative to reach out to Rhodes Island and even expressed her desire to work together, the news was met with astonishment even by Sarkaz familiar with the Cyclopes. Astonishment, but also deep concern. Curiosity and joy were the furthest things from anyone's minds.
What the legends say about the Cyclopes have largely proven true—they can indeed foresee the future, and what they see are usually visions of doom.

[Classified Log]
What we witnessed in Chernobog can to some extent elucidate the true nature of the Cyclopes' visions. Either through perceptions incongruous with reality, or through collective emotions brought about by currently unfolding events, certain large-scale prophecies will course through the entire long history of the Sarkaz lineage, and sometimes cause history itself to converge around them. This has given the Cyclopes a terrible reputation even among the Sarkaz. However, the reality is that is not what a Cyclops sees.
Although their foresight does fall within the scope of Originium Arts, a more accurate description would be an 'innate sensitivity' rather than an active use of 'Arts.' It is in essence still a comprehensive deduction derived from the collective memory of the Sarkaz, but the cognitive tendencies shaped by the race's long suffering may be why the Cyclopes tend only to foresee miserable fates. However, an overwhelming majority of their visions are arbitrary, fleeting, fragmented, chaotic, and illogical. The Arts they spend a lifetime mastering are simply a means to interpret them.
Do their prophecies always come true?
Even if they have, one after another, my opinion has not changed since Chernobog.
text.zh:
独眼巨人这一萨卡兹族群在历史记录中始终笼罩着神秘的色彩，现代甚至有一些人认为他们的事迹与神话传说一样，是由误解而生的虚构故事。除了流传在萨卡兹内部的记忆，泰拉各国文字历史中最后有关独眼巨人的记录出现在大约一百一十年前，而那之后，他们完全从大众视野里销声匿迹。即使罗德岛知道伦蒂尼姆的风起云涌之中曾响起过独眼巨人的预言，也从未有人亲眼目睹这族群中的任何一人在纷争中露面。
因此，当凛视主动接触罗德岛，并表达自身的合作意向时，甚至连一些了解独眼巨人去向的萨卡兹干员都感到惊讶——只有惊讶，以及随之而来的深深忧虑。没有人表现出好奇与欣喜。
关于独眼巨人的传说大抵是真实的。他们能够预见未来，以及，他们所预见的都是厄运。

【权限记录】
罗德岛在切城的经历能够部分揭示独眼巨人远见的实质。或因谬误，或因时事激发的群体性情绪，有的宏大预言会贯穿萨卡兹整个族群的一段漫长历史，甚至促使历史向预言本身收束，因而独眼巨人即使在萨卡兹各族群之内也印象可怖。但事实上，独眼巨人通常所见的并非此种情况。
尽管确实属于源石技艺的范畴，但比起“技艺”一词，对独眼巨人远见更恰切的形容，应当是“与生俱来的感应”。其本质仍然是基于萨卡兹群体性记忆的综合推演，而萨卡兹种族遭受的漫长磨难所塑造的思维倾向，或许正是独眼巨人往往预见到命运凄惨之处的原因。绝大多数情况下，独眼巨人依靠远见所能见到的景象随机、短暂、支离破碎、混乱且毫无逻辑，而他们终其一生所磨炼的技艺，则是去理解这些景象。
远见之事是否一定会发生？
即使诸多预言一一实现，我的判断仍与在切城时相同。

text.en:
Valarqvin's purpose is extremely clear: to combat the threat looming before Sami, she is willing to cooperate with anyone who can spare concern for the country and the endless icefields.
Because her behavior is quite inconsistent with the impression given by the normally reclusive Cyclopes, Rhodes Island carefully inquired into her past experiences cooperating with others, as well as her recent actions before making contact with us. What she told us was astonishing, and her vast knowledge of the outside lands was enough to prove that it was not entirely fabricated. Over the last decade, she has been all across the wilderness. She has worked with Columbian scientific expedition teams as a guide, joined Yan's Tianshi in the icefields to exchange what information they had gleaned about the demons, and even managed to lure an Ursine army to the site of an attack out of concern for the vile contamination encroaching on their borders...
However, her narration suddenly ended there. Next, before the Rhodes Island operator could respond, she wrapped things up on her own: 'I admit, the way I have used others in the past has not always been as respectful as my current request for cooperation with Rhodes Island. Please forgive me, as fate will show no mercy.'
Needless to say, the ideals of the Cyclopes as well as their code of conduct have drawn her much criticism, but the people most at odds with her are her closest neighbors, the Elafia of Sami, who find her violation of said code most objectionable. In Sami, the Cyclopes living in seclusion in the Wintertooth Mountains are treated much like any other tribe, peacefully following their own traditions while still a part of Sami culture. However, as the rifts in opinion among the various Sami tribes have become more and more apparent in recent years, it has become increasingly difficult for people to stomach the interference of the Cyclopes. The Sami warriors have immense pride in their duty of protecting the northern front; they do not trust outsiders, nor do they believe that their duty—passed down from generation to generation—needs to be shared with anyone else. They also understand the Cyclopes, and know that what drives Valarqvin to reach out to everyone cannot be a good omen.
We should always keep in mind that this solemn and sincere messenger of fate may well be hiding something from us. Her true nature may be that of a madwoman, an opportunist, or someone harboring the resentment of the Sarkaz and seeking vengeance. But even so, she truly is trying to draw more eyes towards the northern icefields, hoping to muster enough forces to cross that chasm, and Rhodes Island happens to share her vision in that regard. That alone is sufficient basis for cooperation.
text.zh:
凛视的来意非常明确：为了萨米面临的威胁，她希望与任何愿意关心萨米及无尽冰原的人展开合作。
由于她的举止与独眼巨人隐居者给人的印象极为不符，罗德岛在初期接触时便仔细询问了她过去的合作经历和近期的行动轨迹。她列举的事例令人惊奇，而她对外界知识的掌握程度足以证明，这些经历并非她凭空捏造。近十年里，她不断在荒野上四处奔走，曾与哥伦比亚的科考队达成协作，成为他们的引路人，也曾接触炎国进入冰原的天师，交换彼此习得的有关邪魔的知识；乌萨斯的军队也曾被她引诱到袭击现场，关注到邪魔污染对他们国境线的蚕食……
她的叙述到这里戛然而止，接着，在罗德岛干员做出反应之前，她先一步为自己进行总结：“我承认，我对他人的利用，并不总是像我对罗德岛发起的合作请求一样友善。请原谅，命运并不懂得怜悯。”
很显然，独眼巨人的观念与行事准则会为她招来许多非议，但对她最为不满的，她的邻人，萨米的埃拉菲亚们，反对的却是她对独眼巨人准则的破坏。在萨米这片土地上，隐居冬牙群山的独眼巨人们就如同萨米的一个部族那样，安然地遵循自己的传统，同时融入萨米人的文明。但随着近年来萨米各部族之间的意见分歧越来越明显，一部分人也越来越难以接受独眼巨人的干涉。萨米的战士们为自己守卫北方阵线的职责而骄傲，既不信任外来者，也不认为自己代代相承的责任有必要让更多人来分担；他们也了解独眼巨人这一族群，知道凛视驱使众人所前往的，一定不是美好的前景。
我们应当时刻谨记，这位悲戚而诚挚的命运使者对我们有所隐瞒，她真正的容貌可能是疯子、野心家，或者心怀萨卡兹的怨恨而意图报复之人。但无论如何，她确实正尝试将更多人的注意力吸引到北方的那片冰原，希望聚集各方力量跨越这道天堑，而罗德岛恰好也有同样的意向。这足以成为双方合作的基础。

text.en:
The Cyclopes are a pessimistic race.
But they are not born that way. Almost every Cyclops has challenged the fate they foresaw, and tried to prevent some disaster or death only to discover in the end that their own actions contributed to it, or ushered it in sooner. As a result, it has become a tacit rule among the Cyclopes to avoid interfering with anything outside and instead focus on what they need to do internally as a people.
As for the young Cyclops Valarqvin, she was only fulfilling the duty entrusted to her by fate that day, tracking the traces left by the demons upon the frozen soil. The Cyclopes have been observing and fighting this threat for a long time: cleaning up ruins, controlling the spread of contamination, and preventing innocent people and beasts from falling prey. Those were the things within her power.
But she saw a survivor, seriously wounded by a demon and on the verge of transforming.
What she saw was not guided by fate. She had never seen that child before then, and after that moment, decided that she would not stand by and look on any longer.
She risked bringing the Sarkaz girl back to her cave. As a Cyclops who had fought against the demons for a long time, she had some skill at using necrotic Arts to absorb energy and prevent the spread of contamination, but that method was but dressing a wound, and difficult to use on a seriously injured child at death's door. If judged through the fates of the countless people seen in her complex visions, the chance to survive for a girl unfortunate enough to have caught the demons' gaze was almost zero, not to mention she was still clinging onto a contaminated weapon as if fused with it. Valarqvin simply stayed by the girl's side, taking care of her, waiting for the moment she became completely contaminated, and secretly vowing that she would not eliminate the threat before then.
She kept thinking of the child's determination despite her instinctive fear. It was as if she still wanted to fight back, unwilling to cower to any foe, even the demons.
After an unknown amount of time, fate revealed its answer, and the child woke up. Valarqvin knew that she would be unable to care for her like a parent; the girl ought to be free, and should break free from all shackles including those of her inevitable fate, just as she broke free from the demonic transfiguration. Valarqvin, alone, would remain in fate's cage. As she thought this to herself, she turned her back on the girl, and walked towards the ever-shifting icefield beyond the cave.
Although Valarqvin would later avoid making any predictions about Typhon's future, did she really see nothing at all when she decided to save her?
Indeed, she has seen a great many sights and possibilities. And she will forever remain silent about them.
text.zh:
独眼巨人是悲观的种族。
他们并非生来如此。几乎每个独眼巨人都曾挑战过自己眼中的命运，想要阻止一场灾难或一次死亡，但最后往往发现自己的行动只是在推波助澜，让厄运更早降临。于是，避免干涉外界、以族群自身的使命为重，逐渐成了独眼巨人之中默契的准则。
对于年轻的独眼巨人凛视来说，那一天她也只是履行着命运交给她的职责，在冻土上追踪邪魔留下的痕迹。独眼巨人族群对这一威胁的观测和抵抗已经持续许久。清理废墟，控制邪魔污染的扩散，避免无辜的人或野兽被波及，这就是她所能做的事情。
但是她看到了一个被邪魔重伤、正在被转化的边缘挣扎的幸存者。
这一景象无关任何命运的指引，在那一刻之前她不曾见过这个孩子，而在那一刻之后她决定再也不去注视对方。
她试着把这个萨卡兹女孩带回了洞窟。作为长期对抗邪魔的独眼巨人，她的确有一些利用凋亡法术汲取能量、遏止邪魔污染扩散的技巧，但这种应对方式显然难以用在一个重伤的、近乎奄奄一息的幼童身上。如果以她曾在纷杂的远见中所见到的无数人的命运来判断，一个被邪魔注意到的孩子，存活的几率几乎为零，遑论眼前的女孩还执着地死死抱着一把已经被污染的武器，几乎与之融为一体。凛视只是守在女孩身边，照顾着她，等待着她被彻底污染的那一刻，并暗中发誓自己不会在那之前就扼杀掉眼前的威胁。
她一直记得这个孩子在本能的恐惧中表现出的决心。似乎面对邪魔，这个孩子还想着反击，想着绝对不要畏惧任何敌人。
不知多久之后，命运揭示了答案，孩子竟然醒了过来。凛视知道自己不能如她的父母一般照料她，她应该是自由的，应该如挣脱邪魔的转化一般挣脱一切束缚，挣脱一切必然的命运。就让自己一个人留在命运的囚笼里吧。凛视这样想着，转过身去背向女孩，走向洞窟外恒久不变的冰原。
只是，尽管后来凛视始终避免对提丰的未来做出预言，但救下对方的那一刻，她真的什么都没看到吗？
她其实已经见到许多景象，许多可能。而她将永远对此保持缄默。

text.en:
[Classified Log]
The Cyclopes' northward migration was not a large-scale movement widely observed and recorded in the annals of history. However, the Sarkaz know that it began even before the Terran Era. Over the following millennia, the reclusive and solitary Cyclopes slowly moved north one by one, disappearing from everyone's sight. Only a few historical fragments can, when put together, reveal a common thread for this migration. Of course, the Sarkaz Royal Court never truly lost sight of this branch, though they also knew that Kazdel would not be built for them. The Cyclopes' attention had long since shifted away from the fate of the Sarkaz race, to instead focus on the endless icefields. Perhaps as early as thousands of years ago, they had already foreseen the doom lurking in the icefields' depths.
The Cyclopes have a code of silence not to disclose a doomsday prophecy to outsiders, even after thousands of years. So I can only speculate based on historical facts recorded in ancient texts that such prophecies are indeed possible, because the last distinctly identified Lord of the Cyclops Court was also a King of the Sarkaz who had accepted the Black Crown. And the time of her succession was close to the beginning of the Cyclopes' northward migration.
Some ancient texts claim that their departure was due to disillusionment with the other Sarkaz, a reasonable conclusion given that the Cyclops King of that era was assassinated. However, for an individual who can traverse the memories of all Sarkaz souls, how could a monarch able to foresee all manner of tragic fates fall prey to a mere assassination? And no matter how many different interpretations come from the multivarious records, they all ultimately emphasize that 'she accepted her death peacefully.'
......
The Cyclopes find the power of words to be taboo, but history must be recorded accurately.
For a fellow Sarkaz who wishes to embrace change, I would like to show my respect.
––Logos
text.zh:
【权限记录】
独眼巨人的北迁并非被广泛观察到并记入史书的大规模迁徙，但萨卡兹知道，其起始时刻早于泰拉纪年的开端。在千年之间，隐居各地的独眼巨人缓慢地逐一前往北方，离开众人的视野，仅有历史残章的只言片语，透露出这一族群为某种共同使命而迁徙的事实。当然，萨卡兹王庭从未真正与这一支系失去联系，也确切知道，卡兹戴尔将不为他们而建。独眼巨人的注意力早已从萨卡兹种族的命运上移开。他们正观测着无尽冰原，或许早在千年以前，这一族群已经预见到来自冰原深处的厄运。
以独眼巨人缄口无言的族群准则，一则末日预言即使跨越千年，他们也不会对外人声张。我仅以古籍所载的其他史实来推测，这一预言确实有存在的可能。史载中最后一位身份明确的独眼巨人王庭之主，同时也是一位接过那顶黑冠的萨卡兹魔王。她继位的时间，则与独眼巨人北迁的起始时间接近。
部分古籍也声称，独眼巨人的离去源自对其他萨卡兹的失望，因为那一代独眼巨人魔王受人刺杀而死。然而，对于一位遍历萨卡兹众魂记忆、能预见诸多悲惨命运的君主为何会死于刺杀，无论驳杂的文献进行了多少演绎，最终都会强调“她安然接受了自己的死”。
……
独眼巨人忌讳语言的力量，但对历史的精准记述有其必要性。
对于一位意图改变的萨卡兹同族，我愿示以尊重。
——Logos

text.en:
[Classified Log]
You want to know where I've seen you?
Sorry, I'm not someone who can answer your vague questions. Foresight is not omniscience, and the Cyclopes' visions are not things that can be played back.
But if you truly do not care for your past and simply want to know your future––
You will find yourself... before a 'door.' A door I have seen many times, but never have I seen it glowing so brightly.
text.zh:
【权限记录】
您想知道我在哪里见过您？
抱歉，我并不是能对您模糊的过往做出解答的人。预知并非全知，独眼巨人的远见是不能回望的。
如果您确实不在乎自己的过去，而是想探知自己的未来——
您在……一道“门”的前面。一道我见过多次，却从未见到它如此璀璨的门。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Coldshot shows no signs of Originium infection..

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.18u/L
Operator Helena frequently comes into contact with Originium in her day-to-day life. Although she demonstrates adequate safety awareness, further attention is still needed.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员冰酿没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.18u/L
干员海伦娜生活中常与源石接触，尽管防护意识到位，仍需多加注意。

text.en:
The day Helena arrived at the landship, she did not immediately report for duty as previously agreed upon. It wasn't until a number of operators reported hearing faint fowlbeast chirps on the bridge that we traced the sound to the deck and found her along with two fowlbeasts perched on the railing. Helena was enjoying her lunch with them, and imitating their chirps.
According to her, that kind of fowlbeast has a peculiar habit: They rest on land on clear, windless days, and take flight only when the storm comes, throwing themselves into the gales without looking back. With the help of the fierce winds, they can fly much greater distances than other fowlbeasts. Of course, it is also a much more dangerous journey. Few of their kind ever reach their destination.
Aside from her remarkable mimicry of animal noises, Helena also counts cooking, bartending, sewing, divination, hunting, forging, transport repair, weapon retrofitting, and more among her skill set. Yet she has never received any professional training, and every last skill she possesses is a result of the hardship she endured on the frontier. Nor does she shy away from teaching the skills she's painstakingly acquired to others. Every time she comes aboard, everyone hears her signature, passionate, and loud voice inviting all the operators to taste her cooking.
'The raisin shortbread's recipe? No problem. I'll get you a copy in a bit.
'No one ever taught me. I was on the run from someone and hid in some battlefield ruins. There I found this poor fella. His body was almost all ash, but somehow the recipes in his pocket made it through.
'Reckoned it'd be a shame to leave 'em, so I brought 'em with me.
'Not for nothing, of course. Left him a nice bottle of rum.'
text.zh:
海伦娜女士来到舰上的第一天，并没有第一时间按照约定出现，直到有多个干员报告，说在舰桥隐隐约约听到了羽兽鸣叫。我们循着声音，在甲板上找到了她，以及两只在栏杆上歇息的羽兽。海伦娜女士正与它们一起享用手中的午餐，她口中不时发出啾鸣，模仿着它们的叫声。
据她讲述，这类羽兽的习性很不寻常：在晴朗的无风天，它们落回地面歇息，直到风暴来临，它们才展开翅膀，头也不回地扎进狂风中。借助强劲的风力，它们能比其他羽兽飞得更远。当然，那也是一段更加危险的旅程，它们中能够抵达目的地的寥寥无几。
除了惟妙惟肖地模仿动物的叫声，海伦娜女士还精通烹饪、调酒、缝纫、看相、狩猎、锻造、载具修理、武器改装等技能。而她从未接受过专业培训，掌握的每一项技艺都脱胎自拓荒生活的千锤百炼。这些历经艰辛才学会的技能，她也从不吝惜分享。每次她来到舰上，大家都能听到她用那标志性的、充满热情的大嗓门邀请干员们来品尝她的厨艺。
“那份葡萄干酥饼的配方？行，一会儿给你誊一份。
“没人教我。当时我为了逃避追杀，躲进了一片战场遗迹。那里有个可怜的家伙，尸骨都快化成灰了，但口袋里的食谱居然保存了下来。
“我想一直留在那里太可惜了，所以就把它带出来了。
“不过我可没有白拿他的东西哦，我留了一瓶上好的朗姆酒呢。”

text.en:
Never get on the same transport or burdenbeast as Helena—This is common knowledge to all the operators at the frontier office. Her driving skills are unparalleled: she has the transport's speed under her control at all times, and she can accurately make decisions based on her surroundings. Be it the most precipitous terrain of the frontier or a complicated alley, she is able to keep her hand on the gear stick without a change in expression, and speed through as though driving on flat ground.
What separates her from other excellent drivers or riders is that Helena has no actual preferences for a transport or burdenbeast. In her eyes, every last one has its own temperament and personality. So as long as you understand them and drive appropriately, you can unleash speeds that tear through the wind at a moment's notice. When she's holding the reins or a steering wheel, any objective is in reach. The only thing left to pursue are 'limits.'
'Ms. Helena, did you know that some operators have described your driving as like passing through a windstorm in their mission reports?'
'Ah, yeah, I can explain that. Had a group of frontier bandits on our tail. So I had to get a little extreme to shake 'em off.'
'Extreme?'
'Drove a little faster, took a different path. Nothing special.'
'Could you be more specific?'
'See, here's what happened... After a wild chase in the city for a few miles, I drove up onto the roof of a four-story hotel. Did a couple loops up there before finding a path through the air that'd take us across the river. That's how we got the medicine to the other side.'
'What the hell, lady, what were you thinking?'
'Oh, just that it'd've been nice if we got a little rain. Or else it'd kick up a cloud of dust when we landed, and the guys out there to meet us would get a mouthful of sand.'
text.zh:
不要和海伦娜女士共乘一辆载具或者一匹驮兽——这是拓荒地办事处所有干员的共识。她驾驶技艺精湛，时刻掌控着载具的速度，精准地对四周环境做出判断。无论是陡峭颠簸的荒野还是错综复杂的街巷，她都可以面色不改地将手杆推到底，高速向前行进，如履平地。
与一些优秀驾驶员或骑手不同的是，海伦娜女士在载具或者驮兽的选择上没有固定偏好。她眼里每只驮兽、每辆载具都有着特定的脾气与性格，只要了解清楚且驾驶得当，都能在某个时刻爆发出能将空气撕裂的速度。每当她将方向盘或缰绳控制在手里，一切前方的目标都触手可及，唯一需要她追赶的，只剩“极限”。
“海伦娜女士，你知道在任务报告里有干员形容你驾驶载具好像是暴风过境吗？”
“我可以解释。当时后面有一群荒地劫匪在追，为了摆脱他们，只能用些极端的办法了。”
“极端？”
“就是开得快了些，走了些不寻常的路。”
“能再具体些吗？”
“是这样的……在城区狂奔数公里后，我把车开上了一栋四层旅馆的顶楼，在屋顶上兜过几圈，最终找准地方腾空越过一条河流，将药品送往了对岸。”
“天啊，女士你、你到底是怎么想的？”
“哦，我当时在想如果能下点小雨就好了，不然落地后扬尘飞起来，前来接应的干员就要吃一嘴沙子了。”

text.en: Anna Mitterrand, a tall Elafia woman from Nulaiteburgh. Age 18, with green eyes, pale purplish ankle-length hair, and a small mole at the corner of her mouth. On April 26, 1066, at around 11 PM, she eloped with a man from the frontier she met at the local watering hole, the McCullen Saloon, and she remains missing. She left home wearing a green dress, a pearl necklace, and priceless emerald earrings. If you're reading this, Anna, please come home as soon as you can. Your parents are worried sick, and your family is ashamed of your behavior. If anyone has seen her or has any leads, please immediately contact her father, Charlie Mitterrand, and her fiance Kendall Gould. A reward will be provided. If you can capture her and bring her back, the reward will be doubled. —Excerpt from The Nulaiteburgh Evening Post Helena F■■■■, age 23, Elafia, has a ■■■■ by her mouth, ■■■■ eyes, ■■■■ braided hair tied behind her head. Left ■■ on March 1■, 10■■ and has not returned. Took only a few items of clothing and a burdenbeast. If anyone ■■■■ her whereabouts and has any leads, please contact her lover ■■■■. —From the missing persons posters stuck to the wall of a certain pub on the frontier. Due to its age, some of the words have faded into illegibility. Madeline, Elafia, in her 30s, green eyes, purple shoulder-length hair, mole by her mouth, packs a homemade nail gun. Last month, she barged into our hideout, killed our boss, and torched the place. If you know where she is, we got money for ya. If you bring us her corpse, more money than you can count. Anyone who covers for her or helps her out is a dead man walking. —From the bounty posted by a certain frontier gang Nameless female, estimated to be in her 40s, an Elafia with a fair appearance, green eyes, short purple hair, and a mole at the corner of her mouth. Years ago, she avenged my parents by taking down a gang in the frontier, and paid for my ride to Ironforge City. I have since distinguished myself in academia and amassed a small fortune, and would like to repay this kind woman. If anyone knows her whereabouts, please contact Anna Brandt. Huge reward offered. —From The Ironforge Evening Post
text.zh:
安娜·米特朗，十八岁，埃拉菲亚，绿色眼睛，淡紫色及踝长发，嘴角边有颗小痣，身材高挑，出生于纽莱堡，1066年4月26日晚十一点左右，于当地的麦克赫伦酒吧与一名来自拓荒地的男子私奔，至今未能找到。离家出走时身穿绿色连衣裙，佩戴一串珍珠项链与一副绿宝石耳环，价值不菲。
如本人见到启事请赶紧回家，你的父母正因你的出走担心不已，你的家族也因你的妄为而蒙羞。如有人发现其下落或踪迹，请速与其父查理·米特朗或其未婚夫肯道尔·古德联系，将重金酬谢。如有人能将其抓捕带回，酬金将翻倍。
——摘自《纽莱堡晚报》

海伦娜·弗■■，二十三岁，埃拉菲亚，嘴边有■■，■■眼睛，■色头发梳作辫子盘在脑后，于10■■年3月1■日夜里从■■中离开，至今未归。
离开时只携带了几件衣物与一匹驮兽。
如有人能■■其下落与踪迹，请与其恋人■■联系。
——摘自某拓荒地酒吧墙上的寻人启事，因年份久远，部分字迹模糊不清，难以辨认

玛德琳，三十多岁，埃拉菲亚，绿眼睛，紫色及肩发，嘴边有痣，带一把自制的射钉重炮。上个月，她一个人闯入营地杀死了我们的首领，并将那里付之一炬。
如果有人能提供她的下落，我们会给你钱。
如果有人能带回她的尸体，我们会给你数不尽的钱。
如果有人胆敢将她包庇或藏匿，那等待你的只有死亡。
——摘自某荒地匪帮发布的悬赏令

无名女郎，推断年纪约在四十上下，容貌姣好，种族为埃拉菲亚，有着绿色的眼睛和紫色短发，嘴角处有一颗痣。
多年前在拓荒地，她曾帮助我向杀害家人的匪帮复仇，并为我支付去往铸铁城的车费。如今我学业有成，积蓄颇丰，想要寻找当年那位好心人报答一二。
若有人知道她的下落，请联系安娜·布兰特，必将重金酬谢。
——摘自《铸铁城晚报》

text.en:
After wandering the frontier on her own for years, Helena arrived in Davistown and accepted the final request of her old lover before his passing: to take care of the diner he left behind. Later, when Davistown went bankrupt, the platform was bought out by Blacksteel. It was only then that she and the other residents started their new lives on the frontier.
When she first arrived at Davistown, Helena wasn't planning on ending her free-roaming frontier life just yet. She only wanted to find someone dependable to take over the restaurant. However, as the years went by, she remained on the platform to run the eatery. Every time someone asked her about it, she would nonchalantly reply that it was because the residents loved her cooking. Aside from compliments and payment for their meals, her patrons never left her anything unnecessary, and moreover, none of them ever asked her to stay. This made her feel relaxed and unrestrained. From this, it's not hard to see that while Helena is warm and friendly to others, she prefers to keep a certain distance in her interpersonal relations.
In theory, dealing with a personality such as hers should be exhausting, but every operator who has been around her agrees that interacting with her is actually very pleasant. She is good at mixing drinks, and even better at listening to people vent about their troubles. However, the most important part is that she respects each and every person's personal space. Never does she cross the line and pry into anyone's innermost thoughts, even if they open up to her themselves.
When operators go to her for advice on interpersonal relationships, she only ever gives them a very simple answer:
'It ain't complicated. When you're dealing with someone, you just gotta remember that she's first and foremost herself. It's only after that she's someone else's kid, friend, partner, or parent.'
text.zh:
独自在拓荒地辗转流浪多年后，海伦娜女士来到达维镇，在那里她接受了旧日恋人去世前的委托——照料他留下的餐厅。直到后来达维镇破产，平台被黑钢买下，她才和其他镇民重新开始了在拓荒地的生活。
初来达维镇时，海伦娜女士其实并不想那么快结束在拓荒地上自由漂泊的生活，只想照顾餐馆直到找到可靠的接手人。但一年年过去，她始终没有离开，而是留在了平台上继续经营餐馆。每当有人问起，她也只淡淡回复说，因为这里的居民很喜欢自己的手艺。除了赞美与饭钱，他们从不留多余的东西，更不会有人要求她留在这里，这让她觉得轻松自在。由这点不难看出，海伦娜女士虽待人热情，在人际交往中却希望对方与自己保持恰当的距离。
按理说，与这样性格的人相处或许会感到疲惫。但所有与海伦娜女士有过交集的干员都认为，与她相处非常愉快。她擅长调酒，更擅长倾听别人的烦恼，但最为可贵的一点是，她充分尊重每个人的自我空间，永远不会越界去探究他人内心深处的隐秘感受，即使对方主动向她袒露心扉。
而对那些前来向海伦娜女士讨教人际关系处理技巧的干员，她也只是给出一段简单的回答。
“很简单，与对方相处时我们得记住，他首先是他自己，其次他才是某人的孩子、朋友、伴侣或父母。”

text.en:
You can't help but frown when you see the white liquid in your cup, but the woman opposite you seems completely unconcerned by your dissatisfaction as she goes back to cleaning wine glasses.
'Alright, enough with the face, young man.
'You can't sleep? Then don't. Drinking ain't a good habit. Keep on downing drink after drink like that, and the whole night'll be chaos. How about a warm glass of milk instead?
'At first, all you'll feel is helplessness from the darkness and loneliness, but they'll have you cornered soon enough. Then, all you'll feel is tiredness, but don't sleep. Splash some cold water on your face to keep yourself awake.
'When the lights outside the window start going out one by one in anticipation of the coming morning sun, the red glow'll stab your eyes that have adjusted to the dark. It'll sting, but bear with it. Just a reminder that you got a strange new day ahead of you.
'By then, you'll have forgotten all the troubles you had the night before, and all the pain you suffered in the past. Because right then, your fear for the future'll trump everything else.
'It'll have you anxious, for sure. But also excited. You'll find yourself trembling from it.'
text.zh:
看见杯子里的纯白液体，你不禁皱了皱眉头。可面前的女人对你的不满浑不在意，只是自顾自地擦着杯子。
“好啦，别苦着脸了，年轻人。
“睡不着呢，就干脆不要睡了。喝酒可不是什么好习惯，一杯接着一杯，一个晚上就在混沌中过去了，不如来杯热奶。
“一开始你会因为黑暗与孤独感觉到无助，但过一会儿它们就会退缩至墙角，你只觉得困倦，但千万不要睡着，用冷水拍拍脸，清醒一点。
“等看到窗外的灯一盏盏熄灭，折服于即将到来的初阳，红色的光线会刺进你已经习惯黑暗的双眼，有点痛，不过能忍受，它会提醒你陌生的一天即将来临。
“然后，你会忘记昨夜的烦恼与过往的痛苦，因为那一刻，对未来的恐惧会盖过其他一切。
“这种恐惧让你战栗，更让你兴奋，你会为此颤抖不已。”

value.en: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected by medical examination.
value.zh: 体表有源石结晶分布，参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。
