text.en: Sand Reckoner, former overseer of Menat-Ha'mait's gem trading post. He has reached a cooperative relationship with Rhodes Island after being introduced by Operator Papyrus, using his funds and contacts to support our operations in the eastern regions of Sargon.
text.zh: 衡沙，原米纳特哈玛仪宝石交易所监管人，经干员莎草介绍，与罗德岛达成合作，以自己的资金与人脉支持罗德岛在萨尔贡东部地区的活动。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Sand Reckoner shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.16u/L
Sand Reckoner has handled all sorts of gems for many years, including ones containing active Originium impurities or etched with unusual Originium circuits. Despite taking reasonable protective measures, his BOCD is still at relatively dangerous levels.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员衡沙没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.16u/L
干员衡沙长期接触各类宝石，其中部分含有活性源石杂质或印刻有特殊源石回路，尽管本人有良好的防护意识，但血液源石结晶密度仍在相对危险的水平。

text.en:
Bustling Menat-Ha'mait is Sargon's most famous center of the gem trade. Within its many, many stores, the ancient gem trading post occupies a unique position. Gems are not sold to the public here, and its overseer is no ordinary merchant. Their position is more like a decision-maker or defender of the gem trade as a whole. Almost all of the rarest jewels in the city are appraised by the overseer, every gem store in the Grand Bazaar requires their permission to open for business, and large foreign caravans often stop by the trading post. When merchants enter the building, they will respectfully place a dinar on both sides of a golden set of sales on the shop counter, signifying their honest bearing and clear conscience.
Three hundred years ago, the trading post had only just been built, and the Grand Bazaar was more known for its shoddy goods than anything it is famed for today. However, thanks to the painstaking efforts of generation after generation of overseers giving their all, Menat-Ha'mait widened its area of trade, and the influence and respect the trading post held grew alongside it. Merchants were more willing to accept the order brought about by the trading post's restrictions as the days went by.
None could say why the overseers have been so devoted to their cause for hundreds of years, keeping their distance from all in the name of fairness. This devotion and neutrality are innate to the position. When Sand Reckoner took over his ill mother's duties at the age of fifteen, none asked him about his personal affairs, or gave him any more respect than usual.
'Appraising the worth of gemstones, gathering information in the market, and serving each and every customer fairly. These are our duties, and I have learned them from my parents since a young age.
'But there is one thing we will not do. We overseers will not place our own coin on the scales. Though we maintain fairness and impartiality in the trade, we cannot say we ourselves are without sin... We cannot.'
By the time he told us all this at Rhodes Island, Sand Reckoner had left the trading post, donating his accumulated wealth to help fund Menat-Ha'mait's reconstruction efforts. As he tells it, the lord ameer may decide to personally appoint a new candidate to take over the post, or the people might figure out a way to make things work without an overseer in charge. Of course, none of that has anything to do with him or his collaboration with Rhodes Island. He is now starting his work anew in another town, and when it comes to soliciting investment, he has shown outstanding talent, alongside an unexpectedly modern streak in his thinking.
text.zh:
繁华的米纳特哈玛仪是萨尔贡著名的宝石交易之地，而在形形色色的商铺之中，古朴的宝石交易所占据着独一无二的位置。此处并不对公众出售宝石，主持交易所的监管人也不是通常的商人，而更接近于宝石贸易秩序的制定者和维护者。城中最珍稀的宝石几乎均由监管人估价，大巴扎每开设一间宝石商铺皆需监管人准许，外来商队的大宗贸易也常常选择宝石交易所作为中转站。许多商人走进这间屋子时，会满怀敬意地在柜台上的金天平两端各放入一枚第纳尔，以此表明自己将无愧于良心。
三百年前，宝石交易所刚刚建立时，以次充好的情况在大巴扎仍是常态，但随着一代又一代的监管人以一种近乎自我奉献的精神为米纳特哈玛仪扩张贸易版图，宝石交易所的影响力和公信力与日俱增，商人们也越来越愿意接受秩序的约束。
只是没有人能说清，几百年来，监管人究竟为什么愿意如此无私奉献，而为了公正不与任何人亲近，则是监管人与生俱来的义务。当十五岁的衡沙从病重的母亲那里接手交易所时，没有任何一名访客过问他的私事，或者送给他一句额外的问候。
“衡量宝石的价值，收集市场上的情报，一视同仁地招待每一位访客，按照日历执行开市与休市，我们要做的就是这些，我从很小的时候就已经开始跟着亲人学习我的职责。
“但有一件事我们不会做——监管人从不会自己将金币放上天平。我们虽然在宝石贸易上公正无私，却不能说自己是清白无辜之人……曾经不能。”
为罗德岛讲述这一切时，衡沙已经离开了宝石交易所，将积累的财富都捐献给了米纳特哈玛仪的城市重建工程。据他自己所说，王酋或许会亲自安排新的人选来接管宝石交易所，又或者，人们会想出新的方式来代替监管人的监管。当然，那一切与他无关，也与罗德岛和他的合作无关，现在的他已经在一座新的城镇重新开始自己的事业，并且在招商引资方面展现出了优秀的才能，以及出人意料地，他有着相当现代化的理念。

text.en:
In the past, there were two things helping Sand Reckoner perform his duties as overseer: his Originium Arts, and the use of clockwork fowlbeasts using techniques passed down his family.
His unique Arts allowed him to assess gems in a simpler manner compared to the methods employed by his ancestors. Menat-Ha'mait's standards for gemstones are quite different compared to other locales, especially those outside Sargon. Here, it is not size or clarity that is the most important factor, but whether or not they have been etched with Originium circuits by ancient craftsmen, or what effect said circuits entail. Sand Reckoner's Arts have an unusual tactile component. If he judges a jewel as having a circuit with a calming effect on people, he would not need to break out a magnifying glass to have a closer look. Rather, he would be able to 'touch every facet of the gem, both inside and out.'
These Arts can also be used to activate unique Originium circuits within his clockwork fowlbeasts. One told to fly dozens of meters into the distance can still be used to extend the range of his perception. However, the only things he can sense in this manner are disturbances caused by objects passing by. Most of the time, these clockwork fowlbeasts seem to be used in a similar manner to modular drones, performing tasks such as reconnaissance, transportation, or orientation. The businesspeople of the Grand Bazaar are all familiar with these azure chirpers, and will often invite one to 'witness' a trade deal, but it should not be assumed the distance one can fly is limited to the bazaar. Robberies outside the city, traces of lost lapidary workshops in the sands... Gem trade-related news from outside Menat will be brought back to the trading post, for the overseer to mention as he pleases during a discussion.
Thanks to their boundless curiosity, Engineering has dismantled several clockwork fowlbeasts supplied by Sand Reckoner. Their internal structure is incredibly complex, as expected. It can only be speculated that the core technology behind them are Originium circuit etching techniques of legendary quality. Sand Reckoner himself only knows a fixed procedure to create one, and cannot explain the theory behind the technology involved, or how to appropriate it for other uses. Despite the disappointing research results, Engineering knows this is simply yet another ancient Sargonian secret. There are many marvels of eld that still hold up to modern scrutiny. Perhaps they are still buried in the sands, lost to time, or perhaps they are hidden away behind the high walls of the mysterious City of Gold.
text.zh:
在过去的日子里，有两样东西辅助着衡沙履行监管人的职责：他自己的源石技艺，和利用家族工艺制作的发条羽兽。
比起他知道的几位祖辈，衡沙独特的源石技艺使得评估宝石的工作更加简单。米纳特哈玛仪对宝石的评价标准与其他地区，尤其是萨尔贡外的地区大不相同，这里最看重的并不是宝石的尺寸与净度，而是宝石是否带有古代工匠印刻的源石回路，以及其带有的源石回路能实现怎样的功效。而衡沙的源石技艺表现为一种特殊的触知能力，如果他判断一颗宝石的源石回路能够让人心情平静，那么他并不是靠放大镜看出来的，而是“触摸到了宝石内外每一道棱角”。
这种源石技艺也能够激活发条羽兽内部独特的源石回路，一只被衡沙放飞到数十米外的发条羽兽依然能成为他感知的延伸，只不过，他能感受到的仅限于附近有物体经过产生了扰动。更多的时候，发条羽兽看上去就像是可搭载不同功能模块的无人机，承担着摄影、运输、搜寻定位等种种职能。大巴扎内的生意人都很熟悉这些蓝色的小家伙，也往往欢迎一只发条羽兽“见证”一场交易，但发条羽兽能飞抵的距离远不止于此。城外的抢劫，被黄沙掩埋的失落宝石作坊遗迹，这些与城中宝石贸易相关的消息都会被捎回宝石交易所，继而在某一次商谈中被监管人随意抛出。
出于好奇，罗德岛工程部拆开了几只衡沙提供的发条羽兽作品。和预想的一样，这些发条羽兽的内部结构令人无比困惑，众人只能推测它的技术核心在于传说中的源石回路印刻技术，衡沙本人也只清楚固定的制作方法，无法提供原理说明或将技术挪用至他处的方式。尽管研究结果令人失望，但工程部干员也大都知道，这种技术只是古萨尔贡的无数秘密之一，而更多放到现代也不会黯然失色的发明创造，或许失落于时光与黄沙之中，又或许，只是深藏在黄金之城神秘高墙的里侧。

text.en:
When Sand Reckoner was being introduced to Rhodes Island to establish a partnership, Papyrus mentioned a rumor hounding him that she had slight concerns about: apparently, his bloodline is cursed, with each and every member of the family suffering from some unforeseen disaster. None have met a happy end. As our partnership progressed, we were able to confirm why Sand Reckoner, whose ancestors have been involved in the gem trade for generations, has such an interest in us and other international medical firms. It mostly stems from him seeing many of his relatives waste away from disease. By having more medical resources at hand, he hopes more lives can be saved.
Rhodes Island is not one to believe in curses. Medical performed a comprehensive examination of him, including a thorough check of the family medical history he provided, and ruled out the presence of a rare hereditary disease. We have seen many unknowingly infected by exposure to active Originium, and with his BOCD clearly higher than average, Medical turned their gaze towards his former living space, conducting a series of tests on the distinctive Originium-etched gems of Menat-Ha'mait. Once the tests were complete, Medical was able to tell him that under specific circumstances, gems with inlaid Originium circuits were able to influence the minute particles of Originium in everyone's bloodstream. In the trading post, where vast quantities of various etched gems were gathered, blood Originium could have been incited to grow, aggregate, or affect nerve centers. Thankfully, Sand Reckoner has already left his former domicile, and this so-called 'family curse' will likely have no further effect on him.
Surprisingly, upon hearing this news, he merely nodded and stated how happy he was that his ancestors' conjecture turned out to be correct. It's clear his family had figured out the truth a long while back. They simply never considered leaving the trading post. They held their ground until the day their mission was completed.

[Classified File]
Operator Sand Reckoner has already informed Rhodes Island of his family's true duty, in its entirety. Though he has kept a few things hidden, we can speculate that the individual his family wished to return their gems to is one of Sargon's Zhayedans, or perhaps the general that had been transformed via similar techniques, ones that spared him from age and decay. It is not our place to judge whether or not what the Sargonians see as 'eternal life' is a true continuation of life, or what state the Zhayedan soldiers are in. When it comes to Sand Reckoner and his family, perhaps the guilt that weighs heaviest on him is not in 'scattering the gems' or 'suspending the Zhayedan's life', but in being the first to tell another all this.
It can be inferred that over the last three hundred years, every member of his family abhorred the idea of spilling their secrets. They stayed silent about their heavy burden, and called few their friends. It all served to cultivate a distant, impersonal image of the overseers. Sand Reckoner is no doubt the luckiest of them. Of all the generations of overseers futilely reckoning the measure of each and every grain of sand, it was he who saw the day the gems were all returned. More importantly, however, is that he was willing to tell us everything. This means he and his family have truly found forgiveness.
text.zh:
将衡沙这一合作伙伴介绍给罗德岛时，干员莎草曾经略带担忧地提起过萦绕在他身边的一则传言：这个家族的血脉遭到了诅咒，每一位成员都会蒙受无妄之灾，不得善终。在后续合作中我们也逐渐确认，祖辈世代经营宝石生意的衡沙之所以会对罗德岛及其他国际医疗企业有兴趣，很大程度上是因为他目睹了多位亲人的病故，因此期望有充足的医疗资源来拯救更多生命。
当然，罗德岛并不接受“诅咒”这一说法。因此，医疗部为衡沙做了一套完整的体检，综合他提供的家族病史，确认他的家族并无罕见遗传病。随后，鉴于我们已经见过不少生活在活性源石环境里而不自知的感染者，而干员衡沙的血液源石结晶密度也明显高于一般市民，医疗部干员将目光投向了他过去的生活环境，对米纳特哈玛仪独特的源石回路宝石进行了一系列测试。最终，医疗部干员告诉他，特定条件下，宝石的源石回路的确有可能对人们体内普遍存在的血液源石微粒产生影响，而在各种源石回路宝石大量聚集的交易所内，血液中的源石结晶颗粒有可能在刺激下加速生长、聚集，或是影响神经中枢。好在衡沙已经离开了宝石交易所，所谓的“家族诅咒”多半不会在他身上延续了。
然而，听到这一消息的衡沙只是点了点头，表示很高兴祖辈的猜想得到了证实。很显然，他们早已意识到这一点，却从未有一刻想过离开宝石交易所，他们坚守在那里，直到完成使命的那一日。

【权限档案】
干员衡沙已经将他家族真正的责任完整地告知了罗德岛。尽管他隐去了一些信息，但我们可以推测，他的家族想要归还宝石的对象是一名萨尔贡的长生军战士，或者一位以类似技术改造的，能够长久活动而免于衰朽的将领。这种萨尔贡人眼中的“永生”是否真的能被算作一种生命的延续，被炼制为长生军的战士又以怎样的状态存在，这些并不该由我们来评判。事实上，对于衡沙的家族而言，比起“宝石失散”和“暂停长生者的生命”，或许更沉重的负罪感来自最初告密的行为。
可以想见，三百年来，每一个家族成员都绝不愿再成为任何形式的告密者，因此对自己背负的沉重过往缄口不言，甚至鲜少与人有私交，这也进一步导致了监管人的形象如此不近人情。衡沙无疑是幸运儿，在一代代人近乎徒劳地衡量过沙海的每一粒黄沙后，他等到了所有的宝石被归还的那一天；更重要的是，现在他愿意对罗德岛开口讲述这一切，这意味着，他和他的家族确实被宽恕了。

text.en:
Everyone, I know you've been making bets on Sand Reckoner lately, including but not limited to: 'whether or not placing two pet cloudbeasts in the reception room will make him come to discuss cooperative trade orders more often,' 'when he will add Rhodes Island's proprietary pet nutrient paste into his procurement list,' and 'who will be the first to run into him talking to his clockwork fowlbeasts'... I'm hoping you all, especially those of you who've been leaving your pets with him when he's alone, will curb your curiosity a little. I know his love of small animals is an open secret, and I know you don't mean any harm, but it's quite rude to keep an eye on one of our guests like this.
—An excerpt from a Logistics meeting

We've gotten the answers to those questions. First, he doesn't like having cloudbeasts in the reception room. An HR operator bringing him some files saw him use one of his clockwork fowlbeasts to patiently lure the cloudbeast out of the room beforehand, saying small animals might knock over ink pots and the like and really shouldn't be allowed into business areas. Seems he has plenty of experience with this sort of thing. But when the pet nutrient paste was mentioned, he said he didn't have any pets. He also emphasized that his Sargonian business contacts usually preferred exotic or hard-to-tame beasts, and would have little use for the nutrient pastes our operators were making.
As for whether or not he chats with his clockwork fowlbeasts, one brave operator decided to simply ask the man himself after several days of fruitless observation. This sort of abrupt questioning naturally confused him, so the operator decided to offer an analogy. 'Y'know, like one of those fairy tales where people will yell their feelings into the woods or something,' to which he replied 'I don't have much to say in the first place.'
...Going back on my word? No, I haven't. Sure, it's rude to poke your nose into a guest's breathing space like that, but don't forget he's now one of our collaborating operators. The way I see it, he's a touch too serious all the time, so it's worth an occasional reminder from us that he's not an overseer standing behind a counter for three hundred years any more. He's just a regular twenty-year-old operator, codename Sand Reckoner.
—Another excerpt from a meeting several weeks later
text.zh:
各位，我知道你们最近在围绕衡沙打赌，内容包括但不限于“在会客室里放两只宠物云兽能不能增加衡沙来罗德岛谈合作订单的频率”“衡沙什么时候会将罗德岛自研宠物营养膏加入采购清单”，以及“谁能最先撞到衡沙跟他自己的发条羽兽聊天”……我希望各位，尤其是某几位主动把自己的宠物留在独处的衡沙面前的干员，试探时稍微收敛一点。即使衡沙对小动物的喜爱已经成了一个众所周知的秘密，即使我知道大家都没有恶意，但这样观察我们的客人依然很不礼貌。
——一次后勤部干员例会的录音节选

……之前的那些问题已经有了答案。首先，他并不喜欢云兽出现在会客室里，给他拿来文件材料的人事部干员亲眼所见，他耐心地用发条羽兽把云兽吸引到了门外，然后严肃地指出小动物有可能打翻墨水瓶，不应该让其进入办公区域——就好像他在这方面有丰富的经验。不过，当提到宠物营养膏时，衡沙表示他本人并未饲养宠物。他另外强调，与他有商业往来的萨尔贡人，往往钟情于奇异的生物或难以驯服的猛兽，也用不上几名罗德岛干员自行配制的营养膏。
至于他会不会和发条羽兽聊天，某位大胆的干员观察数日无果，选择了直接询问他本人。当然，这个突如其来的问题让衡沙很困惑，所以那位干员还给他打了个比方，“就像童话故事里人们会朝树洞喊出心里话”，他的回答则是“我没有那么多话想说”。
……出尔反尔？我可没有。虽然这样试探客人会显得很不礼貌，但别忘了，衡沙已经是我们的合作干员了。我想，正因为他大多数时候都十分严肃沉稳，所以我们偶尔可以提醒一下他，他不是那个在柜台后站了三百年的监管人，只是二十岁的干员衡沙。
——数周后的另一次例会录音节选

text.en:
[Records from the gem trading post for the last several years]
Damaged item(s): clockwork fowlbeast, one
Cause of damage: getting caught by a stray cloudbeast
Notes: must upgrade the fowlbeast's perception and mobility. (This note is crossed out)
Follow-up: clockwork fowlbeast has been restored.
...
Damaged item(s): gifts of balsam, three boxes
Cause of damage: Unused since opening
Notes: Mio says they can clean themself, and will choose body washes and balsams with suitable smells of their own accord.
The storeroom is still locked, and there are no traces of damage on the walls or ventilation ducts. As Mio said, I have no means of stopping them from entering at the moment.
...
Damaged item(s): fresh seafood, twelve types
Cause of damage: Was not promptly eaten
Notes: Mio does not enjoy eating raw food. They suggested I improve my quality of life so that we can share a meal together.
Follow-up: the aforementioned seafood was eaten by a black beckbeast.
...
Damaged item(s): gemstone storage cabinets, five
Cause of damage: damaged by Woof during a test of strength
Notes: my Arts are not at the level of being able to appraise the effect of this giant gem etched with an Originium circuit. I believe it may be one of the gems we seek. Woof helped me use new materials to craft a new storage cabinet, one that does not use any of the security measures that have already been broken by thieves in the past.
Mio told me they were not actually a cloudbeast, and Woof was no beckbeast. They appear as statues around the city, on frescos and within ancient texts. They can speak, and the trading post's strictest security measures do not affect their comings and goings in the slightest. All clear proof they are no ordinary animals, but they also have means to hide these abnormalities from me. They told me the tale of the trading post and the duties of the overseer, the appearance of the vault guardian I have not yet met, as well as how more than a hundred years ago, they advised my ancestor to entrust the sole gem they found to a local collector for safekeeping. The logic was that if the gems we sought were ever gathered in one place in the future, thieves or worse were sure to take notice.
I have met with this collector and confirmed the truth of Mio's words. I then learned from Woof that there was another gem being kept at the city's museum. I now knew the whereabouts of three of the gems, including the one I happened to obtain in a trade a few days ago.
I believe Mio and Woof are symbols of fate's guiding hand, but they disagree. Mio says they're only at the trading post because they wanted a pet of their own to talk to. They chose me.
text.zh:
【宝石交易所数年前的记录】
物品异常损耗：发条羽兽一只
损耗原因：被流浪云兽捕获
备注：需改善发条羽兽的侦察能力与机动性。（此项被划去）
追录：发条羽兽已归还。
……
物品异常损耗：礼品香膏三盒
损耗原因：拆封后未使用
备注：米奥称，它会清洁自己，并自行选择气味合适的沐浴露和香膏。
库房门锁完好，墙壁及通风管道无破坏痕迹。如米奥所言，我暂时没有将它拦在门外的手段。
……
物品异常损耗：生鲜水产十二种
损耗原因：未及时食用
备注：米奥并不喜欢吃生食，它要求我提高自己的生活品质，以便它与我共同进餐。
追录：以上水产已被一只黑色循兽消耗。
……
物品异常损耗：宝石储存柜五个
损耗原因：在强度测试中被沃奥损坏
备注：这颗带有源石回路的硕大宝石，以我的源石技艺水平无法鉴定它的功效，我认为它正是我们在寻找的宝石。沃奥协助我使用新型材料打造了一个储存柜，我们摒弃了所有已经被窃贼破解的防盗方式。
米奥告诉我，实际上它不是云兽，沃奥也不是循兽。它们的形象在城市雕塑、壁画与古籍中反复出现，它们能够言语，将交易所最严密的防御设施视若无物，这些都是它们异于寻常兽类的证据，但是它们也同样有能力使我无法察觉这些异常。它们说出了交易所的故事与监管人的职责、我未曾谋面的宝库守护者的模样，以及百余年前它们如何劝说我的一位祖辈将找到的单颗宝石交给本地的收藏家保管，避免将来数颗宝石聚在一处时，再次引来歹人注意。
我会见了那位收藏家，确认米奥所言属实，从沃奥口中我进一步得知，另有一颗宝石保存于城中的博物馆。加上前几日我在交易中偶然获得的这一颗，如今我已掌握三颗宝石的下落。
我认为米奥和沃奥象征着命运的指引，不过，它们并不认同。米奥称，它住进交易所，只是因为想养一个宠物陪自己聊天，然后挑中了我。

text.en:
Marcille, the mage of Laios's party.
She claims to have unexpectedly arrived on Terra while trying to rescue her friend Falin in a dungeon. Now on Rhodes Island seeking a way home while providing medical and magic assistance.
text.zh:
玛露西尔，莱欧斯小队的魔法师。
自称在迷宫中尝试救回朋友法琳时意外来到泰拉，现于罗德岛寻找返回原本所在地的方法，并为罗德岛提供医疗、法术方面的协助。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Marcille shows no sign of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] Undisclosed
The Medical Department has agreed not to disclose the relevant data.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
玛露西尔没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】未公开
根据医疗部决议，不公开相关数据。

text.en:
Marcille is a mage from Laios's party. Terra is home to many adventurers, but we are curious about these few calling themselves 'dungeon adventurers'. She herself makes it clear that a strong physique is not a requirement: Marcille often tires herself out before the others when on long field missions, and has barely passed most of our physical exams. By contrast, the 'magic' she uses (which could be understood as a form of Originium Arts) is quite powerful, and during missions, no matter what the task requires, she will often raise her hand, saying 'I can do this! Let me do it!' before beautifully casting a suitable magic spell.
Compared to most operators who specialize only in one type of Arts, Marcille's repertoire of magic is quite diverse. Explosions or blinding light spells for offense, healing or barriers for support, summoning 'familiars', the ability to walk on water, and so on. In comparison, her lack of physical strength seems trivial.
However, we must add a strange asterisk to this: while she is well known for her poor physical fitness, operators fond of hanging out or exercising on the streets have recently reported sightings of Marcille executing difficult-to-perform maneuvers while shouting things like 'Not eating that! No way!' Aciddrop has evaluated her to 'possibly have a talent for street dancing' and has invited her to join in street events, so perhaps we will see a new side of Marcille in the near future.
text.zh:
玛露西尔是莱欧斯冒险者小队中的魔法师，泰拉大陆有众多冒险家，但会自称“迷宫冒险者”的可谓少数，我们对此很好奇。不过单从玛露西尔的经验来看，成为迷宫冒险者似乎并不需要很强健的体魄：玛露西尔常常在需要长途跋涉的外勤任务中比其他人更加容易耗尽体力，并且体能测试中很多项目都只能勉强合格。但与之相反的是，玛露西尔所使用的“魔法”（可以理解成我们所说的源石技艺）相当厉害，就像是为了证明自己一般，在出外勤任务时不论有什么需求，玛露西尔都会举着手说“我会！让我来吧！”，然后漂亮地使出相应的魔法。
与大部分只精通某一类源石技艺的干员相比，玛露西尔擅长的魔法覆盖面十分广。不论是攻击所使用的爆破、闪光魔法，还是辅助会用到的治愈和结界魔法，甚至是召唤“使魔”和能够在水上自如行走的魔法等等。拥有这样的实力，玛露西尔在体力方面的不足就显得不那么重要了。
不过奇怪的是，明明玛露西尔是出了名的身体素质差，最近一些喜欢街头活动和健身的干员们却反映，他们偶尔能看到玛露西尔做出一些非常标准的高难度动作，同时还会大喊大叫一些听起来似乎是“不吃不吃”之类的话。酸糖评价她“看起来好像有跳街舞的天赋”，并已经邀请她一起参加街头活动，说不定在不久的将来，我们就能看到玛露西尔的全新面貌了。

text.en:
The Rhodes Island library boasts a huge range of books, and operators who enjoy reading spend lots of time there, Marcille included. In just a few weeks, she seems to have already finished every theoretical work on Originium Arts, compiling a thick collection of personal notes. Operator Skyfire, who was substitute teaching a class for reserve operators, was shown her notes and commented that 'they're so easy to understand that everyone in class ought to read them too.'
Marcille only smiled at this evaluation and said: 'I did pretty good back in my magic school after all.' She also mentioned that she strove not only to advance healing magic, but has also studied the creation of harmless dungeons. Every spell she uses in the dungeon was something she studied, and it is a pity that no one in her party understands the vast knowledge required for such a feat, or realizes how powerful she actually is. Regardless, she is currently very excited at the prospect of studying a new system of magic, and is happy to share her notes on dungeon magic with our operators, hoping that everyone can learn from each other and find their own breakthroughs. Naturally, her notes were also recommended to the reserve operators as reference materials.
Soon after, the 'Marcille's drafts incident' was all everyone talked about.
A reserve operator reportedly found a page crammed with dense writing among Marcille's notes, and thought it could help her understand Arts, but after scrutinizing it she handed it to her teacher Skyfire, red-faced. Skyfire read it, then brought it to Orchid, who called over Midnight and the rest of Team A6 to discuss it until the sun rose. What exactly did Midnight do that could have informed Marcille of his past identity as the 'Devil of the Eastern Night' in Higashi, and also caused her to weave him and more than a dozen operators, including the Doctor, into a complex web of relationships, full of jealousy, hope, respect, control, exploitation, as well as love and hate?
Regardless, Marcille's desire for knowledge and her skills at both theory and practice make her a role model for all operators.
text.zh:
罗德岛图书室的藏书种类繁多，喜爱阅读的干员们会花费大把的时间泡在里面获取知识，玛露西尔也是其中的一员。不过短短几周，她已经阅览完几乎所有源石技艺相关的理论书，还整理出厚厚一本笔记，正在给预备干员代课的天火看了，评语是“非常清晰，应该给所有来上课的都看看”。
对于这一评价，玛露西尔只是笑着说：“我在魔法学校学得还不错吧？”她也说起自己不仅致力于治愈术的开发，还努力地学习如何制作无害的迷宫，在迷宫中使用的所有魔法也都是她自己在短时间内突击学会的。只可惜小队中没有人懂这其实需要相当大的知识储备才能做到，大家都不明白她有多么厉害。不过她现在很兴奋能够系统地学习一门全新的魔法，也很乐意将总结的笔记和迷宫中的魔法教给罗德岛的各位干员，希望大家能够互相学习，找到各自的突破口。于是顺理成章地，玛露西尔的笔记被推荐给预备干员作为学习的参考。
随后就发生了被大家津津乐道的“玛露西尔的草稿纸事件”。
据说一位预备干员在笔记本中偶然发现了一张写得密密麻麻的草稿纸，原本以为自己可以得到一点关于源石技艺的思路指引，但是她仔仔细细看完整张纸后，只是红着脸把它递给了自己的老师天火。天火看完后把这张纸拿去给了梓兰，梓兰当晚拉着月见夜和A6小队全员讨论了一整晚：月见夜究竟做了什么，才会让玛露西尔不仅知道了他过往在东国时的名号“东夜魔王”，还把他和本舰十数位干员牵扯在一起，编织了一张甚至包括了博士的，充斥着嫉妒、仰望、尊敬、独占欲和利用等爱恨情仇的复杂关系网。
但不管怎么说，玛露西尔的求知欲、学习能力和执行能力，是非常值得各位干员学习的。

text.en:
For some reason, Marcille has recently immersed herself in hobbies one could say are completely unrelated to returning to the dungeon.
For example, she has joined the handicraft club and learned to weave grasshoppers from straw, followed veteran operators into the wilderness to identify various fruits on Terra while gathering all kinds of berries for everyone, and learned to use a camera as she spent a whole day sitting beside Scene and capturing the sights while out on field missions, ultimately taking group shots of Laios's party along with other operators.
When an operator from HR brought her recommendation letters from Leithanian universities and Columbian research institutes, they found her on the deck carefully weaving a grasshopper from straw, next to a small plate of raspberries and a bunch of previous grasshoppers that weren't quite as good as the one in her hands. She gladly accepted HR's suggestion to rely on her 'mage' identity and her outstanding abilities to enter those institutes and receive more help on their quest to return home, and explained to the somewhat puzzled operator that her recent obsession with these unrelated hobbies was because she wanted to share what she encountered on Terra with Falin. When they finally rescue her, she intends to present them all one by one and talk about what they experienced here.
'Laios is actually more anxious than he looks. And Chilchuck won't say it, but he's already planned and optimized all our routes for the dungeon... So instead of being depressed and worried, I'm hoping to make some beautiful plans for our future too.'
Marcille checks her freshly weaved grasshopper as she speaks, and then shows the HR operator her progress. 'The first attempt was totally unrecognizable, but now it really looks like a grasshopper. I can teach Falin how to make one too, when the day comes... I can't wait to see her again!'
text.zh:
不知为何，玛露西尔最近迷上了一些与返回迷宫可以说是“毫不相关”的小爱好。
比如参加手工社团，学着做草编蚂蚱，或者是跟着几个野外经验丰富的干员辨认泰拉的各种果子，为大家采集各地的莓果，又或者是学着用照相机，跟着稀音一坐一整天，拍下外勤任务时的风景，还有莱欧斯小队几人和干员们的合照。
当人事部干员拿着莱塔尼亚的大学和哥伦比亚的研究所的推荐信去找玛露西尔时，她正在甲板上认真地用草秆编着一只小蚂蚱，手边还有一小盘木莓，以及很多编得并不那么好看的蚂蚱。她欣然接受了人事干员的提议——她可以凭借自己“魔法师”的身份和不俗的实力，进入学校或者研究所寻求帮助，以找到回去的方法——也向有些疑惑的干员解释了她近来沉迷这些小爱好的原因，即她想把在泰拉遇到的这些事物，以这种方式带回去给法琳。等到救回法琳的那一天，她会一件一件地拿出这些东西来，给法琳分享这一路他们的经历。
“莱欧斯其实比看起来要更着急。齐尔查克嘴上不说，我们在迷宫里的路线和日程的规划都是他做的，就是为了把我们在路上的时间缩到最短……所以比起苦闷焦虑，我还是希望我们都能尽量地为未来做一些美好的打算吧。”
玛露西尔说这些话的时候仔细地检查了一下自己刚编出来的蚂蚱，随后给干员展示了她一次次的“进步”：“我第一次编的时候完全看不出来是只蚂蚱，但现在已经编得很像了，到时候我就可以教法琳怎么编……我很期待我们再见的那一天的！”

text.en:
Joining the Rhodes Island Medical Department requires not only ample physiological know-how, but more importantly, a kind heart. Marcille passed this strict test and became one of the department's cooperating operators. She's also conducted comparative studies on her own healing magic and Terra's restorative Arts, to both enrich her knowledge of medical theory and help our Medic operators reach breakthroughs in curing various ailments.
This has taken quite a lot of her time.
We are extremely grateful to her for proactively participating in our tests and using the time she could have spent finding a way home instead assisting us in our research of various diseases. We are grateful to her for creating all kinds of adorable familiars to cheer up the children's ward, while paying special attention to Ceobe's condition.
We once asked her why she does all this, and she replied simply that she had already been studying diseases and trauma in her magic school and was used to developing new healing techniques. As Rhodes Island is helping them find a way home, she wants to return the favor by helping our patients.
That said, what she does for us goes far beyond 'returning the favor'.
Our guess is that, when Laios's party first met Ceobe in the wastes, perhaps Marcille was not yet aware of Oripathy and its consequences. And once she was, she chose to help us as much as she could, even making us a promise: If we could find a way for them to travel to and from Terra, she would definitely return to continue helping us study Oripathy. She wishes to see Ceobe and the other patients on Rhodes Island for as long as she can.
text.zh:
在罗德岛，加入医疗部除了需要扎实的生理知识储备，更重要的是怀有一颗善良的心。玛露西尔就是在这样严格的标准下通过测试，成了医疗部的合作人员，并对她所使用的治愈术和泰拉的恢复疗愈系法术进行比较研究，以丰富对医疗原理的认识，协助医疗干员们找到治愈各类疾病的突破口。
这花费了她相当多的时间。
我们非常感谢玛露西尔主动提出要参加测试，并利用她找回去方法的时间来协助我们进行各种疾病的研究，也很感谢她愿意造出各种各样小巧可爱的使魔逗病房中的孩子们开心以及分外关注刻俄柏的病情。
我们问过她这样做的原因，玛露西尔的回答非常简单——她在魔法学校时就从事疾病和外伤原理的研究，也负责开发新的治愈术，罗德岛帮助他们寻找回去的方式，她当然也要帮助罗德岛的病人们。
不过，玛露西尔为我们所做的事情其实已经远远超过了“报答”。
我们推测，或许莱欧斯小队在荒野上与刻俄柏相遇的时候，玛露西尔还不知道“矿石病”的存在和它会导致的后果。而在知道这一切后，她选择尽自己最大的努力帮助我们，并和我们做了约定：如果能够找到往返于他们那边和泰拉的方法，以后她还会回来，继续协助我们研究矿石病相关的问题。她想和刻俄柏还有在罗德岛治病的人们长长久久地相见。

text.en:
The fortune teller at the Sami market took Marcille's hand and said a lot of baffling things, before discovering she had no money on her and turning to the next tourist. Chilchuck scoffed at this and mocked her for being an easy mark.
Later that night, Laios's party decides to huddle up for the warmth to sleep through the freezing cold. Half-awake, Marcille seems to see a figure under the moonlight, appearing to be foolishly digging up the soil, with a filthy face, leaves stuck in their hair, and a small pile of berries picked from the Myrkwood on hand, as if right about to taste them.
Marcille was about to quickly shout a reminder not to eat unknown fruits found in the forest, only to realize that there is nothing there but her companions fast asleep, the figure from before nowhere to be found.
A gust of cold wind blows into the tree hollow and Marcille wraps her blanket tightly around her as she prepares to return to sleep. A small snowflake appears before her, carried by the wind, and it stays for a long time before melting.
She suddenly recalls something the fortune teller said, in-between their wild ramblings: if you see a snowflake in Sami that does not melt, it is the person you wanted to see the most, talking to you.
text.zh:
萨米集市中的占卜者拉着玛露西尔的手，说了一大堆听起来很玄乎的话，发现她其实没有钱之后，立马就转向了下一位游客。齐尔查克对此嗤之以鼻，嘲笑这种骗子居然会看上她。
夜晚，很冷，半梦半醒之间，玛露西尔觉得自己好像在月光下看到了一个人影。那个人傻乎乎地趴在地上挖土，挖得脸上脏脏的，头发上也沾到了树叶，手边还放了一小堆黑森林里摘来的浆果，看上去马上就准备吃掉它们尝尝味道。
玛露西尔一急，刚打算开口提醒不要乱吃，就发现眼前空空荡荡，只有睡得正香的同伴，并没有刚刚看到的人影。
一阵冷风吹进树洞，玛露西尔裹紧被子，准备再睡过去。一小片晶莹的雪花被吹到了自己面前，久久没有融化。
她突然想起在集市时那个占卜者说的一大堆乱七八糟的玄乎话里，似乎提到过，要是在萨米看到了不会融化的雪花，那就是你最想念的人在和你说话。

value.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

text.en: The leader of Laios's party, with plenty of 'dungeoneering' experience (note: We also have no idea what this so-called 'dungeon' is). While his background is uncertain, his contributions are obvious, as he is always able to offer combat support during field operations.
text.zh: 莱欧斯小队的队长，拥有丰富的“迷宫”（注：我们也不知道所谓“迷宫”到底是什么）探索经验。虽然充满谜团，但是莱欧斯的贡献毋庸置疑。在执行野外任务时，他总能为罗德岛提供不少作战帮助。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Laios shows no sign of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] Undisclosed
The Medical Department has decided not to disclose the relevant data.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
莱欧斯没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】未公开
根据医疗部决议，不公开相关数据。

text.en:
Laios claims to hail from a place called the Northern Continent. His party members also reference places like Izganda and the Eastern Continent, none of which we recognize. Our records have come up empty, so all we can do is document these names for now. Perhaps they are an incredibly skilled theater troupe touring the land with elaborately designed backstories. Or maybe these places are extremely remote, and they have been drifting across Terra until they stumbled upon Rhodes Island. They lack much common knowledge about things everyone here is familiar with, such as Arts and nomadic cities. Their amazement at our cafeteria suggests life has been very harsh for them.
Perhaps this explains why they excel in fighting and survival in the wild, even in unfamiliar environments. They have a remarkable caster, surveyor, and logistics-slash-combat specialist in their squad. Laios, their leader, seems quite average by comparison, perhaps even a bit dim-witted. Yet, given how much his team trusts him, he might possess hidden talents of his own?
text.zh:
莱欧斯自称来自北方大陆，其小队的所有成员都号称自己来自该大陆或附近的区域，包括什么伊兹甘达、东方大陆等。但是我们没人听说过这些所谓的地方，罗德岛上的文档记录里也没有，我们只能先将其记录下来。要么他们是一群演技卓绝的剧团成员，早就设计好了这样一套说辞四处巡演，要么这些地区在某些极其偏远的地方，他们四处漂泊最后来到罗德岛。小队成员们缺乏很多泰拉的一般常识，源石技艺、移动城市，很多我们习以为常的东西，他们似乎都是刚刚接触。看他们在食堂里惊讶不已的样子，过去的生活肯定很苦。
或许正因为如此，他们非常适应野外的战斗与生存，即使身处陌生的野外环境，他们也能很敏锐地发现未知的危险。莱欧斯小队里有出色的施术者、调查员和后勤兼战斗人员，而队长莱欧斯本人看上去却平平无奇甚至经常傻乎乎的，他们那么信任莱欧斯，难道他有什么独到的特长？

text.en:
During his time aboard Rhodes Island, Laios has shown considerable ability during field missions. While his basic combat skills do not match our top operators, he can quickly identify the traits and weaknesses of any wildlife. He also possesses impressive courage, often taking the first step in encounters, and quick thinking when resolving crises.
According to operators who have gone on missions with him, Laios's keen ability to analyze wildlife stems from his boundless curiosity. He is constantly observing and learning about creatures, meticulously keeping notes. When facing an unfamiliar creature, he rapidly consults his internal catalog of similar animals to pinpoint their weak points. It seems that he was already a wildlife fanatic in his hometown, although they refer to creatures as 'monsters' for some reason.
However, numerous complaints have accompanied his performance records. Laios is often distracted by unfamiliar creatures during lulls in combat, requiring other operators to keep his strange behavior in check. Many crises he resolves are in fact caused by his own curiosity. Additionally, he frequently invites operators to join his observations and experiments, causing headaches for many team captains despite their urging him to stop. Laios has also shown a deep interest in our operators themselves while aboard the landship. His curiosity about their physical features has led to chaotic incidents. Though Marcille and others managed to tie him up and issue a formal apology, many operators remain traumatized and now require regular counseling sessions.
Even Mon3tr has not escaped his observations; his daring touch earned him a vicious beating. Remarkably, when carted into Medical afterwards, he still wore a satisfied smile.
In a sense, Laios may be the most dangerous person aboard Rhodes Island.
text.zh:
在罗德岛的这段时间，莱欧斯在外勤工作中展现出了不错的能力。他的基本作战能力并不能跟优秀干员相比，不过他总能快速地发现野外生物的习性和弱点，配上他不俗的胆识，好几次挺身而出，当机立断化解了危机。
根据和他一起执行任务的干员们描述，莱欧斯能快速对野外生物下判断其实是来自他那无穷无尽的好奇心。莱欧斯每时每刻都在观察和了解生物，并将其记录整理，当遇到陌生生物时，他就能快速通过类似生物的构造特征和思维习惯快速找到其弱点。似乎在他的家乡他就是个生物（当地人称其为“魔物”）迷。
不过在我们整理莱欧斯的这些实绩记录时，我们也收到了多份投诉。莱欧斯经常在作战任务并不紧张之时被陌生生物吸引，害得干员们总需要额外照顾他，留意莱欧斯有没有做出奇怪的行为。而他解决的危机大部分都是他的好奇心所引发的。除此以外，他经常邀请干员们跟他一起进行观察和实验，干员们怎么劝都不能让他放弃，有诸多队长对此头疼不已。更有甚者，在罗德岛本舰上他还对我们的干员们产生了浓厚的兴趣，因为想要了解罗德岛众多干员的身体特征而引发了一连串的混乱。虽然玛露西尔等人成功将其捆绑禁闭，并向大家正式道了歉，但是依然有不少干员此后每每看到莱欧斯都会害怕，他们现在还需要定期去心理咨询部门接受治疗。
听说连Mon3tr都被莱欧斯好奇地观察并触摸过了，代价是被当场暴揍了一顿，听说被送进医务室时他的脸上还依然带着满足的笑容。
可能某种意义上他才是罗德岛上最危险的人。

text.en:
While Laios is clearly sharp and attentive when observing wildlife, his interpersonal skills can only be described as 'disastrous'. He is extremely poor at picking up on subtle social cues and body language, often imposing his own obsessions onto others while failing to notice their tactful rejections.
Countless incidents have occurred where operators tried to stop his 'creative ideas' involving wildlife, but all to no avail. They can only watch helplessly as he stomps into a huge nest of wild metal crabs or 'Pompeii's' lair.
Though he always seems rather regretful afterward, everyone knows it won't stop him the next time he gets a wild idea.
One memorable incident led to a unique friendship between an operator and Marcille after they gave Laios a joint dressing-down. That night, while writing up the mission report, the operator heard Marcille's perspective: though Laios isn't good with people, he is still a kind, upstanding young man who has never accepted injustice. When his sister was treated unfairly, he threw away his position as a lord's heir and left home. Out of a sense of responsibility, he has always supported his former party members financially while they were injured.
During his travels across Terra, Laios has encountered many people who survive by fair or foul means. When it comes to determining right from wrong, his heart may have long known the answer. After learning of Rhodes Island's mission and the challenges it faces, he quickly became fond of our organization and the operators striving to make our goals a reality, gladly counting himself as one of us.
text.zh:
明明观察生物时敏锐又仔细，在人际交流方面却十分地迟钝——莱欧斯察言观色的能力极差，导致他与其他人的关系容易产生裂痕。
干员们无数次想要阻止他对野生生物的“奇思妙想”，全部无功而返，他们只能眼睁睁地看着莱欧斯去惊动大型野生磐蟹的巢穴，或是“庞贝”的溶洞。
每次莱欧斯都好像很后悔的样子，但是大家知道一定还会有下一次。
一次，我们的某位外勤干员和玛露西尔小姐通过一起教训莱欧斯产生了独特的友谊。当晚整理任务报告时，该干员从玛露西尔那里听到了她对莱欧斯的看法——虽然莱欧斯待人能力如此低下，但是他依然是个善良正直的人。莱欧斯从以前起就接受不了身边的不公正——他会因为妹妹遭到了不公的待遇，就放弃自己领主之子的身份，愤而离家，也会因为责任感，一直资助以前一起冒险时受伤的队友。
在泰拉的旅行中，莱欧斯见到了这片大地上众多为了生存不择手段的人，哪些是对的，哪些是错的，他心里可能早已有了自己的答案。理解了罗德岛的目标和面对的困难后，莱欧斯很快就喜欢上了这个组织以及为此努力的干员们，爽快地融入了其中。

text.en:
Slowly, we begin to understand why Laios is the leader of his squad and why they trust him so much.
It's not due to any so-called wisdom or leadership (it would be more accurate to say he completely lacks those qualities) but rather because he always calmly considers their next moves and pulls his weight in doing his part. He understands how dangerous an unknown creature can be, so at critical moments, he remains the calmest of all.
Why have I written him such a favorable report? It seems that I, just like the rest of his party, have also seen the appeal of this 'leader' of theirs.

Addendum: Damn you, Laios! The fool noticed some rare variant of Originium slug on a mission and sneaked it into his rucksack. It managed to escape after his return to the landship, and now Logistics is in complete disarray. To whoever is reading this, know that just when you think Laios is a decent guy worth your trust, he'll do something unexpectedly maddening.
text.zh:
慢慢地，我们开始理解为什么莱欧斯能成为小队的队长，为什么他的队员们如此信任他。
不是因为所谓的睿智和领导力（不如说这些跟莱欧斯毫无关系），而是莱欧斯其实一直都会冷静地思考自己的下一步行动并承担其应尽的责任。他知道未知生物有极大的危险性，所以在关键时刻，他一定是那个最冷静的人。
我怎么会写下如此偏袒他的记录？看来我也跟莱欧斯小队的大家一样，被这位“队长”吸引了吧。

补录：该死的莱欧斯居然把出任务时发现的特异体源石虫偷偷藏在了背包里，结果在罗德岛上被它跑出来，闹得后勤部天翻地覆！看来他一辈子都得不到教训！警告，一旦你觉得莱欧斯是个值得信任的好人，他总能通过一些愚蠢的行为让你为自己的天真感到愤怒。

text.en:
Senshi is a member of Laios's party. He has ample experience in outdoor survival and a tenacious insistence on a proper diet. He serves as the group's cook.
Senshi considers it his duty to provide healthy meals for the party. The cooking pots and knives he carries are made from precious materials.
text.zh:
森西是莱欧斯小队的成员之一，具有丰富的野外生存经验，对饮食有固执的坚持，在小队中担任厨师。
森西以为小队提供健康伙食为己任，随身携带的锅具和菜刀是用珍贵材料精制的厨具。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Senshi shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] Undisclosed
The Medical Department has agreed not to disclose the relevant data.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
森西没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】未公开
根据医疗部决议，不公开相关数据。

text.en:
Senshi, who claims to be from the Eastern Continent of Izganda, is a member of Laios's party, acting as the group's cook. Although one can find complex labyrinths one might call 'dungeons' all across Terra, few would regard themselves as 'dungeon adventurers'. That said, their expertise is beyond doubt, especially for Senshi. He is strong with an astonishing physique, his long beard and rough skin being a testament to his experience and prowess. When faced with complicated and extreme environments, Senshi has proven to cope much better than most other operators. However, his particular obsession with food sometimes leaves his teammates stumped.
A truly strange fixation.
text.zh:
自称来自东方大陆伊兹甘达的森西，是莱欧斯的冒险者小队中的成员之一，在小队里担任厨师。虽然泰拉大地上遍布着错综复杂的各类迷宫，但会以“迷宫冒险者”自居的人依然是少数。我并不怀疑他们的专业程度，他们的专业性毋庸置疑，尤其是森西。森西孔武有力，体格强壮得惊人，长须和粗糙的肌肤证明了他的经验和实力。身处野外的复杂情景和极端环境时，森西能够比我们的大多数干员更好地应对。只不过有的时候，他对团队伙食独特的执着也确实让人摸不着头脑。
真是奇怪的执着。

text.en:
Senshi is indeed a master cook. During his stay on Rhodes Island, his expertise in the culinary arts quickly spread throughout the landship from Rhodes Island's kitchen. The feast he prepared on his first day here left such a deep impression on everyone that the very next day he received an invitation from the cafeteria to re-evaluate their menu together. He chose some surprising ingredients for the new menu, such as sandworm legs and cystybeast liver... but he did indeed optimize the cafeteria's offerings, and his cooking has become quite popular with the Operators.
Senshi's insistence on a proper nutritious diet has been endorsed by many from the Medical Department, especially Operator Hibiscus. She once brought some of her healthy meals to Senshi for tasting, and he offered his immediate feedback: 'It's nutritious, aye, but I cannot appreciate any dish that neglects flavor. You need both.' Since then, Hibiscus's healthy meals have subtly changed, tasting much better than before, and more operators are now willing to try them out. Judging from the strange ingredients in her new recipe, Senshi likely played a significant role in it.
text.zh:
森西在烹饪上确实有着深厚的造诣。在留驻罗德岛的这段时间里，他精湛的厨艺通过罗德岛的厨房辐射了整艘舰船。他刚来的时候准备的那顿大餐给全舰干员都留下了深刻的印象，在第二天他就受到了食堂的邀请，一同重新评估了菜单。森西为新菜单选择的食材有些比较出人意料，比如沙虫腿，瘤兽肝……但食堂的膳食结构确实得到了优化，由他烹饪的料理更是在干员们中广受欢迎。
森西对饮食营养的坚持得到了医疗部不少干员的认同，尤其是芙蓉干员。芙蓉干员曾经拿着几道健康餐去请森西品鉴，森西在品尝之后毫不讳言：“虽然很有营养，但是只关注营养而不兼顾口味的料理，恕老夫实在无法欣赏。”自那之后一小段时间里，芙蓉的健康餐食谱悄然改变，口味比从前好了不少，愿意尝试的干员也多了起来。从新食谱里那些奇奇怪怪的食材来看，森西应该也在其中发挥了不少作用吧。

text.en:
Laios and his team often baffle audiences with stories of their homeland. They never avoid the topic, and in fact seem eager to share. They like to tell us tales of strange dungeon encounters, which always reminds us that they come from a place vastly different from this land.
When speaking of the dungeon, Senshi shows markedly more familiarity and confidence than his teammates. After all, he has been adventuring for much longer than the others, to the point that some operators find it hard to believe. But he speaks so simply and sincerely that no one thinks he's bragging or lying. Whenever he describes the dungeon, he always makes it feel as though maybe the place is not just for adventure, but rather a home to him.
text.zh:
莱欧斯小队成员在同其他人讲述自己的来历时，收获的往往是对方的一头雾水。他们从未避讳谈论这些话题，甚至可以说他们对讨论这类话题充满了热情。他们常会与我们分享那个迷宫中的奇异见闻，时刻提醒着我们——他们的来处和这片大地是多么不同。
在谈及迷宫时，森西表现出了与小队的其他成员不同的熟稔和自信——毕竟森西在迷宫中冒险的时间更长，甚至令许多干员难以置信……他的语气如此淳朴和真诚，也不会让人认为他是在吹嘘或是说谎。森西描述起那个迷宫的样子总让人觉得，那里对他来说可能并非单纯是冒险的目的地，而是故乡一样的地方。

text.en:
Rhodes Island operators always carry instant food when out on missions in the wilderness. After all, completing the mission as quickly as possible is often a higher priority than filling their stomachs. However, when on missions with Senshi, he can always find the time to forage for ingredients among the surrounding flora and fauna, enthusiastically explaining what is edible or not and the basics of cooking to his teammates, before setting up his shield-like pot to cook up a hot meal. To him, cooking and eating is a ritual not to be taken lightly. He has repeatedly insisted we take only what we need to preserve the delicate ecosystem, and this respect for nature is how 'adventurers' are able to keep themselves fed and healthy out in the wilds. The ecosystem encompasses every little thing that happens on this land, and only by preserving the cycle of give and take can everything continue smoothly. Perhaps it is because of this philosophy that missions with Senshi are often smooth-sailing.
His party members have mentioned how his cooking has kept them going in that faraway dungeon. And after some time, the operators he's taken under his wing have shared similar thoughts. Being with Senshi is like working with a capable elder. Though he can sometimes be a little stubborn, the food he makes and its warm aroma always sets people at ease. Juxtaposed with the smoke and fire of his cooking pot, even the wilds of this great land seem to show a gentler side.
text.zh:
罗德岛干员们在野外行动时，会随身携带一些方便的食品，能够迅速地充饥。在大部分时候，尽快完成任务的优先级比填饱肚子要高得多。但在与森西共同行动时，他总能找到合适的时机，从周围的动物植物身上恭敬地取下足量的可食用部分，兴致勃勃地向同伴们解说起那些食材的食用禁忌、烹饪要领，然后支起他那口盾牌一样的大锅，做上一顿热气腾腾的饭菜。对森西来说，做饭、吃饭是一系列不容轻视的仪式。他不止一次说过，从自然环境中按需采集食材，是对整个生态系统微妙平衡的尊重，而“冒险者”们之所以能够用这些食材来做成填饱肚子、营养均衡的料理，也正是因为对生态系统的这份尊重。生态系统囊括了这片大地上发生的点点滴滴，只有平衡索求与给予的循环，一切才能够顺顺当当地进行下去。也许正是应了森西的理念，有他参与的任务总是一帆风顺。
莱欧斯小队的成员们都表示过，森西的料理支撑了他们在那个遥远迷宫中的冒险。一段时间后，受到过他照顾的罗德岛干员们也都产生了类似的想法。与森西在一起，就像与一位可靠的长辈一同行动。虽然这位长辈有时候会有些固执，但他做出的饭菜，散发的香味总能够让人感到亲切而安心。在那炊烟和灶台的火光边上，这片大地似乎显现出了温驯而安宁的一面。

text.en:
[Day 1]
Arrived at an unfamiliar place in the dungeon. The monsters are new, and the orcs here are fully clothed.
Fortunately, the one called Bob is quite good at cooking monsters, and we accepted his hospitality.

[Day 20? 21? Maybe 19]
A pity the records of the last few days were lost on our journey. This place is indeed much more complicated than the dungeon.

[The most filling day]
'Terra' is what the locals call this place. It's different from the dungeon, but the ingredients here can also be made into delicious and nutritious dishes.
The kids also seem fond of it.
No matter where we are, it's all good as long as we can have a good meal.
text.zh:
【第一天】
来到了迷宫里的奇怪地方，之前从来没有来过，这里的魔物也从来没见过，连兽人都穿得严严实实的。
好在那个叫鲍勃的兽人对烹饪魔物相当有一套，我们也接受了他的款待。

【第二十天？第二十一天？也许是第十九天】
前几天的记录在旅途中弄丢了，真是可惜。这个地方的情况确实比迷宫要复杂。

【吃得最饱的一天】
“泰拉”，当地人是这样叫这个地方的。虽然和迷宫不太一样，但是这里的食材也能够做出美味且营养均衡的料理。
那几个年轻人也还挺喜欢的。
不论在哪里，只要能够好好吃饭就不错。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] Undisclosed

造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%

text.en: As part of Laios's party, Chilchuck is in charge of looking for traps, lockpicking, and planning out their routes. This keeps them safe in the labyrinthine and danger-filled dungeon, and also saves them a lot of time when making their way into its depths. During Rhodes Island field missions, Chilchuck uses his sharp senses to look for hidden dangers while helping us survey the lay of the land. His picks are able to unlock all sorts of complicated mechanical locks. However, since he takes his work extremely seriously, he dislikes people interfering when he's doing specialized tasks. The love and care he shows for his lockpicks puts all of Engineering to shame. Chilchuck spends a lot of his day-to-day life helping out operators stuck in a pickle, like helping people locked out of their dorms. Though the first time he faced down Rhodes Island's security systems, he found his lockpicks were of nearly no use. Operators on scene described his expression as 'extremely adorable'. Do not let Rope near Chilchuck! We can't let her learn how to pick locks better from him!—A nervous Logistics operator
text.zh:
齐尔查克在莱欧斯小队中负责探查陷阱、开锁和规划路线，在错综复杂并充满危险的迷宫中保障小队的生命安全，并帮助小队大大缩短到达深层迷宫所需要的时间。
在罗德岛的外勤任务中，齐尔查克会利用自己敏锐的五感探查周围隐藏的危险，并协助我们完成地形探测。他手中的开锁工具能够解开各类复杂的机械锁具。不过，齐尔查克在工作中会非常严肃，并且不喜欢任何人介入他的专业领域。对于开锁工具的在意和爱护令各位工程部干员自愧弗如。
齐尔查克在日常生活中为许多干员提供了方便，比如，帮被锁在门外的干员开一下宿舍门之类的。只不过在他第一次处理罗德岛的门禁系统时，他发现自己的开锁工具几乎派不上用场，据在场干员反映，齐尔查克当时的表情“真的非常可爱”。

不许暗索再接近齐尔查克！不许她再去问怎么开锁更快、怎么开锁更简单！——某位紧张的后勤部干员

text.en:
Some additional notes on the wilderness for Rhodes Island's field missions, courtesy of Chilchuck's rather reluctant descriptions.
[Testaceous Vinecreeps]
Mostly seen in Sami. The plants it's comprised of are similar to the 'tentacles' and 'Man-eating plants' of the dungeon, which are capable of disguising themselves as normal plants. It hides among the trees of the forest and the underbrush. It's unknown why, but the local wildlife can recognize them and keep their distance, even giving sympathetic glances to men who have found themselves bound and strung upside-down by the feet. This tends to make the victims angrier than they already are.
Its fruit is aromatic and delicious, and makes a good stuffing for pies. (not recommended to approach one solely for culinary purposes.)
[Thorned Treasure Chest]
Mostly seen in the sands of Sargon. Similar to the Mimics in the dungeon. They contain random amounts of unclaimed property, which can be exchanged for goods on the black market. Opening one will trigger its counterattack. If you're careless, you'll get stabbed. Don't take them lightly without a Medic on hand. You also shouldn't poke at them if you have the sort of companion who will snidely say 'And now you know that hiding things from your buddies will just lead to suffering'.
[Chest Seaborn]
These things can transform! When they're in chest form, they'll use their tentacles to wrap around their prey and drag them inside. The suckers on their tentacles are really strong. If they latch onto your skin and you somehow manage to pull them off, the marks it leaves will last for nearly a week. Pretty embarrassing.
The part that looks like a chest is just as tasty as the rest of it, same taste and texture really. You can also use it as a serving tray.

Let us once again thank Chilchuck for these notes, and express our sympathy for his unfortunate encounters.
text.zh:
罗德岛外勤任务的野外注意事项新增以下内容，感谢齐尔查克以相当不情愿的描述作为补充。
【巨壳藤蔓】
多出现在萨米。里面的植物类似迷宫中的“触手生物”和“食人植物”，和普通植物几乎一模一样。巨壳藤蔓会掩藏在树林和草丛中，当地的动物不知为何会辨认并远离它们，甚至还会向被绑住脚、倒吊着的人投以同情的目光——令人更生气了。
果子香浓美味，可作为馅饼的馅料。（但不推荐为了吃去尝试主动接近。）
【宝刺金属箱】
多出现在萨尔贡的荒漠中。类似迷宫中的宝箱陷阱，里面有数量不等的无主财物，能在附近黑市换取物资。打开宝刺金属箱时会受到攻击，稍不注意就会被刺伤。如果没有医疗干员在一旁，不要轻易尝试；有会嘲笑你“现在你知道了，有事瞒着同伴是会吃苦头的”的同伴在一旁的话，也不要轻易尝试。
【箱形恐鱼】
这种东西会变样！箱子形态时会用触手缠住猎物，拖进箱子里吃掉。触手上吸盘的吸力非常强，被吸住后，如果想要把它硬拔下来，脸上和身上留下的红斑要将近一周才能消退，这非常丢人。
箱子模样的部分的味道和口感和其他部位一样鲜美，也可以当作盘子盛食物。

在这里再次感谢齐尔查克的补充，并对他的遭遇表示同情。

text.en:
'Does Chilchuck hate me?' This question has lingered in the minds of every operator he has worked with.
When an operator's been locked out of their room and needs help, he'll say 'good, another paycheck for me.' He will also often say 'awesome', 'sweet', etc etc, all accompanied by an inappropriate smirk...
These brief outbursts have caused confusion in many operators, and have led those in charge of field missions to suspect there might have been some sort of issue with the mission arrangements. If not, why would he use such 'subtly aggressive' language?
After carefully poring over the mission records, we noticed that Chilchuck is actually very enthusiastic about participating in missions which involve terrain data collection or trap detection. After completing one of these missions, he will spontaneously submit a report regarding trap construction and such to Engineering. He's even posted his daily schedule up on the notice board, all to make it easier for operators who need his help to find him. It's clear how much he cares for everyone!
Luckily, the operators have gradually learned that he's not actually complaining about them. He just has an unorthodox way of expressing himself. All that's left is to wonder when he'll finally admit that he actually cares a lot about his teammates and the other operators.
text.zh:
“齐尔查克先生是不是讨厌我？”这个问题一度萦绕在与他合作过的每一位干员心头。
比如，有的干员被锁在门外、向齐尔查克求助时，他会说“托你的福，我又能挣一笔了”。有时他还会不分场合地坏笑，嘴里说着“这可真厉害啊”“真不错啊”之类的话……
这些简短的评价造成了多位干员的困惑，并一度让负责外勤的干员疑惑，是否是任务的安排有问题，才会令齐尔查克言语间产生了诸多攻击性？
可在仔细查询了外勤任务记录后，我们发现只要是涉及地形侦察或是陷阱感知的任务，齐尔查克的出勤率都非常高，并且任务完成后也会给工程部提交一份关于陷阱构造之类的报告。他还整理了一个自己的日程表贴在公告板上，方便需要帮忙的干员更快地找到他——这明明是非常关心和在意大家的表现！
好在干员们都逐渐知道了齐尔查克并不是对他们有意见，只是表达的方式有那么一点点与众不同。就是不知道，他什么时候才会向他的队友和其他干员坦诚地承认，自己其实非常在意他们呢？

text.en:
Though there are many Durin operators aboard Rhodes Island, everyone still assumes Chilchuck is a child at first glance. The reason is simple: Chestnut, Durin, or even Minimalist have around twenty centimeters on him. Moreover, he has a babyface, which makes it harder to believe he is an adult.
Once they learn that he's actually twenty-nine years old, most are shocked into silence, mentally making sure to add a 'Mister' in front of his name. What's even more shocking is learning from Marcille that not only is he married, he has three daughters who are already old enough to be independent.
Lately, the operator who most commonly asks Chilchuck out for drinks is Harold. It is unknown when this development occurred. On occasion, Hellagur will be spotted joining them, and they can be heard saying things like 'It's been a while since I saw my three daughters. I should bring them a souvenir.', 'This photo of her I keep in my pocketwatch is from when she was but a child. Isn't she cute?', as well as 'You both have such loving and understanding daughters. I don't suppose you'd know a way to get mine to accept my letters?' And so on. Many operators feel hard to join their conversations, but for whatever reason, Vulcan and Enforcer have also joined their merry band.
Perhaps you need to be worrying about some little kid to take part.
text.zh:
虽然罗德岛上已经有了不少杜林干员，但大家在第一次见到齐尔查克的时候，还是会误以为他就是个小孩子。原因很简单：不论是褐果还是杜林，甚至连至简都比他高出二十厘米左右，而且，他长得也挺可爱的，再怎么看都不像一个成年人。
所以当干员们了解到他其实已经二十九岁了之后，不少人在震惊中默默地对他用上了敬称，而更让大家震惊的是齐尔查克不仅已经结了婚，还有三个女儿，甚至连女儿们也到了能够自力更生的年纪。
不知从何时起，围绕在齐尔查克身边的干员变成了经常找他喝酒的哈洛德。干员们偶尔会看到赫拉格加入他们，听到他们说起“已经很久没见我的三个女儿了，想带点什么小礼物回去送给她们”“这怀表里的照片是她小时候的，多可爱”，以及“二位的女儿真是一表人才，不知二位有什么办法能让我的女儿愿意收我的信……”等等。这种气氛令其他干员都感到无法融入，但后来不知道为什么火神和见行者也加入了他们。
可能，大家都有需要操心的小不点吧。

text.en:
Chilchuck always says he shouldn't be considered a combatant, but after a few tests, the instructors have noted his incredible accuracy in archery. The issue is that his strength is simply incapable of using a standard-issue combat bow. Maybe he can display his abilities better with a more suitable bow?
Engineering has found the challenge a rather interesting one. Out of perfectionism, R&D into a bow that must be both light and powerful while accounting for an archer who cannot use Originium Arts was put on the schedule. It seems they even added a simple Originium cannon and lockpick set to the bow's design?
Whatever it ends up as, you can look forward to the day Chilchuck uses this all-rounder bow.
text.zh:
齐尔查克一直说自己不能被算作战斗人员，不过几次测试下来教官们对他射箭的准头评价都很高，只是以他的力量根本无法使用常规战斗用的弓。或许给他一把更适合他的好弓，齐尔查克的战斗能力就能得以展现呢？
工程部的干员对此非常感兴趣，一把又轻又有威力，还要满足使用者不会源石技艺的弓的研发和制造被他们提上日程，为求尽善尽美，那把弓的设计图纸上甚至加上了简易的源石炮和开锁工具……？
不管怎样，期待齐尔查克拥有这把全能弓的那一天到来。

value.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

text.en:
Ulpianus, Ægir, former Consul of Ægir's Academy of Technology, lead researcher of the Abyssal Hunter project, and a commander of the Ægir military organization of the same name. When and where he came ashore are both unknown. He provides support when Rhodes Island is involved in ocean-related matters.

All files pertaining to Ulpianus have been moved to the high clearance database.
text.zh:
乌尔比安，阿戈尔人，阿戈尔前技术院执政官，科研项目深海猎人计划负责人，阿戈尔军事团体“深海猎人”作战指挥官之一。登陆时间地点俱不明。在罗德岛处理海洋相关事务时提供支持。

经本人与相关人员确认，乌尔比安的所有档案移入高权限资料库。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Ulpianus shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.012u/L
As self-reported, he once intentionally touched Originium for observational purposes during his time on land, but took appropriate precautions and was not infected.
His body's rather robust. It's absolutely covered in cuts and wounds, like some kind of test subject, or even an operating table itself. Frightening.
—A certain Medical Operator

Operator Ulpianus's medical records have been moved to the high clearance database. We ask that relevant Medical operators maintain strict confidentiality.
––Medical Department Internal Notice
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
乌尔比安没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.012u/L
据本人陈述，乌尔比安在陆地活动期间，曾出于考察目的有意接触过源石，但防护得当，并未感染。

他的身体很强健，上面伤口很多，就像一块被反复使用的实验体，或者手术台本身，怪吓人的。
——某医疗干员

干员乌尔比安的医疗档案已移入高权限资料库，请相关医疗干员做好保密工作。
——医疗部内部通告

text.en:
'Ulpianus... Why're you suddenly bringing up this name? Did you see him on the landship?'
'Oh, no. Is he on Rhodes Island? HR's been sorting out some operator files, and the name pops up now and then in the Abyssal Hunter mission reports. I thought I'd do some investigating...'
'You've got a real demon on your line there! You know how Skadi fights, right? How she can tear down a town on her lonesome? Columbia's engineers must love her. Well, Skadi was taught by that 'Ulpianus' guy. He can blend in with the shadows, with only his sinister eyes showing. He's also got freakish strength, able to hoist a giant four-pronged anchor, every blow a miniature explosion. He rampages through the seas, not caring if he's fighting friend or foe, a terror as famous as the Seaborn...'
'Closure, what are you talking about?'
'What I'm saying is you should stow your curiosity and get back to work.'
—Recording of a conversation between Closure and an HR Operator in a meeting room

By the time I joined the Hunters as a representative of the Legions, Ulpianus was already a veteran of five years. The lab kept his data and images from before he volunteered for the transformation. I would hesitate to call him strong. Perhaps 'somewhat feeble'? And aside from some characteristic clothing he likes to wear, the difference between then and now could not be greater. Strictly speaking, his condition was not up to the standards he himself would later establish for subjects. But at the time, the project was finally entering the clinical stage, and he chose to take that strange flesh into his body, advancing the development of the immature gene remodeling procedure... The cost? Compared to the project potentially losing its lead researcher, the many scars he gained are a negligible price. No, I do not care if he did it out of responsibility or worry. My main point is that he succeeded.
For a Hunter, his physical parameters are not particularly outstanding. In terms of only endurance or speed, he cannot compare to me or Skadi. But he chose an appropriate weapon for his fighting style, raining down brute force in exacting, methodical swings—something he often taught Skadi. That ridiculous anchor of his is nothing more than his surgeon's blade. It is not a light weapon, so every strike must give the enemy a grievous wound, one that would be hard to heal from.
...It seems his every decision is like this. Him becoming Ægir's first Abyssal Hunter, him fighting to the last, and now his departure from Ægir. This is what both his reliability and his risk stem from.
—Gladiia
text.zh:
“‘乌尔比安’……为什么突然提到这个名字？你在本舰看见他了？”
“呃，没有。这个人也来罗德岛了吗？人事部在整理干员资料，深海猎人的任务报告中，偶然出现了这个名字，所以我来确认一下……”
“那可是个大魔头！你对斯卡蒂的战斗方式有概念对吧，一个人就能拆了一座城镇，哥伦比亚的工程队应该很喜欢她。而斯卡蒂的那些手段都是这个叫‘乌尔比安’的家伙教的，他全身融入阴影，只露出一双勾魂摄魄的眼睛，天生神力，手持一柄四爪巨锚，冷兵器的每一击都能打出定点爆破的效果，他横行海洋，敌我不分，是和海嗣齐名的凶物……”
“可露希尔，你在说什么？”
“我在说……收起你的好奇心，你该回去工作了。”
——会议室录音，可露希尔与某人事干员的对话

我代表军团方面加入深海猎人计划时，乌尔比安已经战斗了五年。研究所保存着他接受改造前的数据和影像——谈不上强壮，甚至有些清瘦——除了某些着装习惯，看起来和现在区别很大。严格来说，乌尔比安的身体条件并不符合后来他自己制定的受试者征召标准。但在当时，研究终于进入临床阶段，他选择在自己身上融入那些异种的血肉，进行尚未成熟的基因改造手术……代价？与整个项目失去负责人和核心科研人员这件事相比，他身上的累累伤痕只不过是最小的代价。不，我并不在意他是出于责任心还是忧虑感，重点是他成功了。
在深海猎人里，乌尔比安的身体机能数据谈不上有多么突出，单论耐力或者速度，他比不上斯卡蒂和我。但他选择了最合适的武器与战斗方式，节制地、精准地倾泻自己的暴力——这也是他常常教育斯卡蒂的。那柄造型夸张的四爪巨锚不过是他的手术刀，用起来并不轻巧，所以每一次挥动，都必须给敌人带去创面巨大、难以恢复的撕裂伤。
……现在看来，乌尔比安做的每一个决定，都是如此。所以他成为阿戈尔第一位深海猎人，并战斗到了最后，直到现在背离阿戈尔而去。他的可靠与危险都来源于此。
——歌蕾蒂娅

text.en:
[Engineering Department Audio Log Clip 1]
'Have you finished checking through all the stuff Secunda sent us?'
'Yeah. I've looked over the experiment reports and their results a few times now. Ægir's gene editing tech is insane. They can already change individual organisms' characteristics on the fly as they grow... Oh, yeah, don't let Hypatia see those lecture tapes.'
'Doesn't Hypatia teach history? Don't tell me she's getting into bioengineering too? They're not even remotely the same!'
'No, you haven't seen how that masked Ægir in the tapes teaches. Hypatia prefers the edutainment model of teaching, so I think she'd have an aneurysm if she saw it. It's so stifling! Hardly any bilateral communication, it's just a barrage of questions.'
'What's weird about students asking questions?'
'No, it's this guy asking the STUDENTS to ask him questions.'
'...'
''The Ægir once had additional appendages, but after our ancestors moved from the rivers to the sea, they gradually atrophied...' He'd suddenly stop and be silent, then the students in the lab would ask questions one by one. Can you imagine?! Most of them, he wouldn't even answer, or just coldly say 'Wrong question. Ask another.' And they'd keep on asking... By the time you actually managed to ask a question he felt like answering, you'd already know the gist of the whole thing anyway.'
'Ægir's a country governed by scientists and engineers, so there's always going to be a few eccentrics like him. From that angle, I don't think it's so hard to understand.'
'...Really?'

[Engineering Department Audio Log Clip 2]
'So I asked Secunda about all this when I met her.'
'What'd she say?'
'That he's always been like that. Even when interviewing potential research assistants, he'd only let them ask three questions before cutting off the interview. And he's not trying to pressure people, either. He's just a bit awkward at social interaction, and not really suited to being a teacher. She does think that sort of questioning is rather normal, though. She once managed to get answers to ten questions in a row, and she thinks it's a very efficient way to communicate. It can get you to reflect on things and find your blind spots. She said we should consider it.'

[Engineering Department Audio Log Clip 3]
'There are no worthless answers. What determines their worth is the corresponding question. Only once you determine the right question can you solve it.'
text.zh:
【工程部录音片段1】
“西昆妲送来的这些东西你都看完了吗？”
“嗯。所有的实验报告和对应的工程成果我都看了好几遍。阿戈尔的基因编辑技术令人惊叹，他们已经能够在物种生长过程中自如地修改个体性状……对了，那几份授课录像，别让海帕提娅老师看到。”
“海帕提娅老师不是教历史的吗？难道她开始涉猎生物工程了？这跨度够大的啊！”
“不是，你是没看到录像里那个蒙着面的阿戈尔人是怎么给学生上课的，我怕崇尚寓教于乐的海帕提娅老师看到后会直接气到脑溢血。太压抑了！整堂课上没有平等的交流，一直在问问题。”
“学生问老师问题不是挺正常的？”
“不，是那个家伙一直在让学生问他问题。”
“……”
“‘阿戈尔人原本有附肢，但祖先从江河进入海洋后，附肢逐渐退化……’，他讲到这一句时突然停下来，沉默，然后实验室里那些学员就开始逐一向他提问。你能想象吗？！绝大多数问题他都不会回答，而是冷冷地扔回来一句‘问题错了，你重新问’，然后那些人继续提问……其实等到你问出了那个他觉得值得回答的问题，你自己也已经发现了症结所在。”
“阿戈尔本来就是一个由科学家和工程师治理的国家，这类人总有一些怪癖……从这个角度看，这种氛围好像也不是不能理解。”
“……是吗？”

【工程部录音片段2】
“后来我遇见西昆妲的时候问起了这件事……”
“她怎么说？”
“她说那个家伙一直这样。甚至在面试科研助手时，也只会让面试者问自己三个问题，便结束整个流程。他并非有意向别人施加压力，他只是在与人相处这件事情上显得有些笨拙，更不适合当一个老师……而且她觉得这样提问很正常，她曾经连续问了十个问题都得到了回答，她觉得这种沟通方式效率非常高，有利于刺激思考、锁定盲点，建议我们尝试……”

【工程部录音片段3】
“没有无效的答案，决定答案价值的是问题本身。真正发现问题所在，才能解决它。”

text.en:
Don't be fooled by the way he always lowers his voice to speak, like he's shrouding himself in mystery. He's actually a very good singer.
What's with that face? Do you think the Abyssal Hunters are only killing machines? Sure, Ægir's general education doesn't include music or dance classes, but the Little Handy module No.57 has more music than what any terrestrial music critic could hope to have. The domes are like giant pianos, converting the crashing of the waves into sweet melodies. The shifting frequency and movements of the coral by the roads is itself a form of dance... Music and dance are a part of everything we Ægir see and hear. That's how Swordfish, Shark, and I learned how to sing, play instruments, and dance. Our colleagues at the Institutes of Physical Art don't see systematic learning as necessary. They research anything and everything in the ocean and its relation to music and dance to develop a 'language' they can use to truly express themselves and communicate with the world.
The Captain's even more talented than the rest of us. He's got perfect pitch, and he's a composer too. I heard from Advisor Blandus that he got an invitation to one of those art institutes when he was young... Right, I mentioned this before: He sees music as nothing more than a tool. Each time we had a hunt in a Seaborn nest, he'd always haphazardly compose a tune, then order everyone in the his team to memorize it. Then after the battle, he'd ask us to sing it back to him and give his opinion. The dregs of the sea can't appreciate art. Memorizing the melody is enough to prove you're still you. So he'd do this before returning to the city for inspection to see who'd be executed and left to dry on the reefs, and who'd be allowed to go home.
But there's something else that left a deeper impression on me. Once, during a mission, we ran into two schools of rare fins. They cried out, their chatter all around us, disturbing most of the current. Once we got back to the city, the first thing the Captain did was to upload a score into the port's terminal. I had a listen after that. It was a duet, the cries of the fins poking out between the notes of the main melody. Ever since the Seaborn took over that patch of sea, that duet is the last record of those fins. It's hard to say it was a coincidence, knowing him. It's a beautiful song, but doesn't exactly match his icy expression.
...
No, I'm not trying to prove anything to you, nor can I prove anything to Ægir. I just wanted to say...
He can still sing. Both when the scum devoured Amaia and the sea around the Stultifera Navis fell into Silence, and when Milliarium's beacon tower fell to the seafloor... I could still hear him.
—Skadi
text.zh:
你别看他总是压低了嗓子说话，把自己搞得神神秘秘的，其实他唱歌很好听。
干嘛露出这副表情？你这人，在你眼里，深海猎人是只会杀来杀去的怪物？阿戈尔的通识教育中并没有音乐课、舞蹈课之类的东西，但是“小帮手”的第五十七号组件所存储的音乐远超陆地上任何一位乐评人的收藏；穹顶系统像是一台巨大的钢琴，会将海浪每时每刻的冲撞转化成悦耳的旋律；行道珊瑚摇曳的姿态和变化的频率本身便是舞蹈……音乐和舞蹈是阿戈尔人每时每刻都能听见看见的东西，剑鱼、鲨鱼，还有我，我们都是这么学会唱歌弹琴跳舞的。艺术研究所那些以此为职业的同胞，也不以系统性学习为前提，他们研究海洋里的每一种事物、每一个现象与音乐、舞蹈的关系，让它们真正成为表达自我、对话世界的“语言”。
在这方面，队长比我们都有天赋，他拥有绝对音准，还会作曲，我听布兰都斯顾问说他在年轻的时候就收到过艺术研究所的邀请……是的，我跟你说起过类似的事情：在他看来，音乐似乎只是一种足够好用的工具，每次我们进入海嗣巢穴前，他都会随口作一首简短的曲子，命令三队的所有人记住，在战斗结束之后，他会要求我们重复那首曲子并提些意见。海里那些恶心的杂碎不会去欣赏艺术，铭记旋律足以自证“我是谁”。在猎人们回到城市接受系统检查之前，队长习惯以这种形式来确定是该将我们处决，然后风干在礁石上，还是带我们回家。
但还有另外一件事，我的印象更深。我们曾在某次任务途中撞见两支洄游的珍稀鳞群在海渊处偶遇，它们交鸣，声音此起彼伏，搅起巨大的水流。回到我们的城市后，队长做的第一件事，是通过港口的终端上传了一份曲谱，我后来去找来听了，一首二重奏，鳞群相遇的景象仿佛随着耳边的旋律重现。后来海嗣占领了那片海域，那首二重奏确实成了对它们最后的记录，我很难说他是无意的。那首曲子很美，和队长那张冷冰冰的脸完全对不上号。
……
不，我没有必要向你证明什么，也没有办法向阿戈尔证明什么，我只是想说……
他仍会歌唱……在那只杂碎吞吃了阿玛雅、“愚人号”附近的整片海域都陷入静谧的时候，在弥利亚留姆的信标塔彻底沉入海底的时候……我绝对听到过。
——斯卡蒂

text.en:
[Classified Log]
[The image is encrypted, extracting audio]
...
I am still lucid.
There is not much time, so I will keep things as brief as possible.
These past two hundred years, the rate at which the Seaborn evolve has surpassed our understanding of them. But whether in the oceanic abyss or Iberia, Seaborn with different morphologies still share common characteristics: sleek bodies, sturdy flesh, a certain quickness. Proof of their relationship to Ishar'mla. But quite a few of the Seaborn we saw in Milliarium had divergent characteristics... Yes, this is not enough to prove that there is a new, independent bloodline within the Seaborn, but there is no doubt they have been influenced by some other, superior being. The new 'gods' of these beasts are stirring. We do not know where, or how many.
Mártus. I know this Seaborn sought you out. He revealed to you some shocking truths, some new laws of nature. Clementia locked down this information very well. I do not mean to debate you on this. We are saving ourselves, along with everything we care about. I see 'savior' and 'creator' as rather laughable titles. What I care about, though, is that he shows no fear. He believes that even with all his cards on the table, we will have no means of stopping the evolution of the Seaborn. And so I must follow him back to the heart of the sea. My assimilation was too short, my resonance with we many too shallow, and there is much I cannot yet answer. Every unusual phenomenon in the ocean, every minute warning sign, demands our attention. The seafloor volcanoes suddenly appearing these past two years, shining patches of sea that move, and that legendary 'iceberg'... I doubt it is a mere congregation of ice and snow, but rather a giant hive, an ecological system composed of chitin, daughter cells, and nutrients joined together. It does exist, and it is now 'thawing' above some patch of sea. I have already sent you the coordinates. You can try to confirm them with Gladiia.
...
I am still lucid. I will continue my work.
...
The Waterway may be connected, but do not visit the Ægir home territories unless strictly necessary.

我仍清醒。
时间不多，我会说得尽可能简短。
这两百年来，海嗣进化的速度每时每刻都在突破我们的认知。但无论是大洋深处，还是伊比利亚，那些形态各异的海嗣仍具有相当程度的共同特征——流线型的身形、强健的肉体、迅捷的速度……这与伊莎玛拉不无关系。但我们在弥利亚留姆所见的海嗣，已有相当一部分和此类特征相去甚远……是的，这并不能说明海嗣中已经存在完全独立的新集群，但它们毫无疑问受到了来自其他超级个体的影响——这帮畜生的新“神”正在松动，不知时间，不知数量。
玛利图斯，我知道那只海嗣找上了你们，他揭示了某段骇人听闻的隐情、某种规律。克莱门莎将消息封锁得很好。我也无意与你质辩，我们只是在拯救自己，以及我们所在意的一切，在我看来，“救世主”和“造物主”都是可笑的称谓。我更在意的是，他对此有恃无恐。他笃信即使开诚布公，我们仍无法干预接下来海嗣进化的过程。所以我必须随他返回大洋腹地。我融入的时间太短，我与大群的共鸣还太浅，能确认的答案有限。海洋中每一种反常的自然现象、每一个微小的征兆都值得关注：这两年凭空出现的几座海底火山、发光的移动的海域，还有那座传说中的“冰山”，我怀疑那并非冰与雪的堆积物，而是某种巨大的蜂巢，几丁质、子体细胞和营养物共同构成了庞大的生态体，它真实存在，而且正在某片海域“融化”……我已向你发送若干坐标，可以尝试与歌蕾蒂娅确认。
……
我仍清醒，我将继续行动。
……
航道已经联通，但如非必要，不要轻易前往阿戈尔本境。

Nymph is a citizen of Kazdel who joined the Field Operations Department through Rhodes Island's Kazdel office.
Her skills with mental Originium Arts and her natural gifts as a Djall have a wide range of applications.

擅长使用心灵相关的源石技艺，配合其笞心魔的天赋，可在诸多领域发挥特长。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 8%
No visible Originium crystals have been observed on the surface of Nymph's body, but continued monitoring is required.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.14u/L
Nymph is no exception to the effects of Kazdel's high-Originium environment, but medical intervention has been effective at keeping her condition under control.

造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。
