infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

text.en: Operator Figurino, real name Luchino de Montano, is the current owner of the famous Tailor de Montano shop in Siracusa. The Siracusa branch sent him to Rhodes Island on an exchange tour. During his stay on the ship, he was temporarily assigned to the Logistics Department to provide various types of support to Rhodes Island.
text.zh: 干员裁度，本名卢奇诺·德蒙塔诺，叙拉古裁缝名店德蒙塔诺现任主理人，经由叙拉古办事处推介至罗德岛交流访问，留舰期间暂时分配至后勤部，为罗德岛提供各项支持。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Figurino shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.11u/L
Operator Figurino rarely comes into contact with Originium.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员裁度没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.11u/L
干员裁度甚少接触源石。

text.en:
The name 'de Montano' might be unfamiliar to operators aboard Rhodes Island's main ship, but it's a household name in our Siracusa branch. After all, the finest tailored suits in their wardrobe all come from the Tailor de Montano shop. So when the current proprietor, Luchino, expressed interest in joining Rhodes Island, our operators at the Siracusa branch wasted no time sending his resume to the flagship.
The arrival of this young tailor didn't cause much of a stir at first—other than Orchid, who was absolutely thrilled. She had written several articles about traditional suits for her personal column, but this was her first chance to exchange ideas with the proprietor of a Siracusan tailoring shop. They penned a few articles together and created some prototype garments. Orchid rolled out some promotional slogans, like 'new looks, new trends' and 'leading a style revolution at Rhodes Island,' making it all sound quite impressive. It seems Luchino was inspired by her enthusiasm; he hadn't expected his craft to find much use at Rhodes Island.
Luckily, the uniform policy at Rhodes Island isn't particularly strict, and a wave of new fashion trends quickly took root. So if you notice operators wearing pocket squares or trading their tactical jackets for vests and tweed coats, don't be surprised. They've likely given in to Luchino and Orchid's persuasion and volunteered to be models.
That said, Luchino does seem a bit irked by the way operators refer to his creations as 'Western-style suits'. 'These clothes clearly originated in Siracusa and spread westward—so why does everyone insist on calling them 'Western-style'?' he wonders.
text.zh:
“德蒙塔诺”这个名字对于罗德岛本舰的干员来说可能有些陌生，但叙拉古办事处的干员对它可是再熟悉不过了，毕竟他们身上穿着的精品套装，其中最好的几套都是出自德蒙塔诺的制衣台。所以当这间小有名气的裁缝店的现任主理人卢奇诺向他们提出想要来到罗德岛时，办事处的干员们二话不说就将他的简历送来了本舰。
这位年轻裁缝的到来一开始并未引起什么波澜，只是令梓兰兴奋不已。她的个人专栏曾发过多篇以传统套装为主题的文章，但能与一位叙拉古裁缝店的主理人交流还是头一遭。在他们共同完成几篇文章和试做了几件样衣之后，梓兰立刻开始宣扬一些“新风貌、新时尚”“为罗德岛带来审美革新”之类的听起来很了不起的话。裁度好像也被这些话打动了，他没想到自己的一技之长在罗德岛也能派上用场。
幸好罗德岛上的制服规定并不严格，一股着装新风就此盛行起来。所以如果你发现有些干员的罗德岛制服口袋里突然多出了一块口袋巾，或者看到他们换下了复合材料制成的冲锋衣外套，穿上了格子马甲、花呢大衣，不要觉得奇怪，他们肯定是答应了裁度和梓兰的苦苦哀求，成了义务的模特。
不过裁度似乎有些介意干员们口中“西装”这一说法——“这些衣服明明是从东边的叙拉古传到西边去的，怎么大家都叫它们‘西装’呢？”

text.en:
One day, when Umberto was returning home, a giant wolf appeared on the path and stopped him. Using its claws, the wolf showed him how to mend fabric. With its teeth, it demonstrated how to cut cloth. With its tail, it taught him how to measure. The wolf wouldn't let him go until he had mastered each skill. That's how Umberto learned the art of tailoring and eventually opened the Tailor de Montano.
When Figurino was very small, he was swallowed by a giant cloth doll. The doll threatened to digest him and turn him into cotton, but he managed to find the loose thread; when he pulled on it, the doll unraveled. This convinced Umberto that Figurino was a natural-born tailor. He took him in as his apprentice, teaching him all the secrets of tailoring. He even crafted an Arts module for him using threads from the unraveled doll.
On nights when the two moons were full, a metal man would sneak into children's rooms to stretch them while they slept. Figurino, determined to avoid a visit from the metal man, painted his eyelids with eyeshadow to make it look like he was awake.
...
What kind of place is the Tailor de Montano? Orchid has explored it extensively in her column, but it's Figurino's untold stories that are truly captivating. The metal man who stretches children, the giant cloth doll, the giant wolf—these strange and fantastical figures turn the humble tailoring shop into a mystical wonderland.
Of course, Figurino has never actually seen the metal man, the giant doll, or the big bad wolf. These are all stories that Umberto used to tell him. For a long time, he couldn't understand why Umberto enjoyed tirelessly telling these fairy tales. However, when Figurino shared these stories with the children of Rhodes Island, he saw their eyes light up with curiosity. When he told the tales to young patients, he watched them drift off to sleep, comforted by the familiar words. Seeing these reactions, he finally understood why Umberto kept telling the stories.
...
'So... you don't believe in those stories anymore?'
'Of course not! I've known forever now that grown-ups made them up to trick kids!'
'Then why were you so scared when that doll that Shamare lost turned up at the foot of your bed? Your ears couldn't even stand up!'
text.zh:
老翁贝托年轻的时候被一只巨狼拦在了家门外，那只狼用爪子教他缝补，用牙齿教他裁布，用尾巴教他量尺寸，学不会就不放他回家。就这样，老翁贝托从狼那里学会了全部的裁缝手艺，开了德蒙塔诺裁缝店。
在裁度很小的时候，他曾被一个布偶巨人吃掉，巨人扬言要把他消化成棉花，结果当时裁度自己找到了线头，一扯线头，巨人就被扯散了。由此老翁贝托断定裁度是天生的裁缝，想着以后要把自己的手艺全部教给他，还把巨人的线拆了下来制成裁度的施术单元。
双月圆满的日子里，会有铁人溜进小孩子的房间，把睡着的小孩子抻长。裁度不想铁人溜进自己的房间，想让自己看起来是没睡着的样子，所以才给自己画很鲜艳的眼影。
……
德蒙塔诺究竟是一间怎样的裁缝店？在梓兰的专栏之外，裁度这些未见诸纸面的故事更加精彩。把小孩子抻长的铁人、布偶巨人、巨狼……这些神秘怪诞的形象似乎把裁缝店构建成了一个奇异的空间。
当然，裁度本人并没有真的见过所谓的铁人、布偶巨人和巨狼，这些故事其实都是源自老翁贝托的讲述。裁度曾一度不解，为什么老翁贝托愿意不厌其烦地讲述这些漏洞百出的童话。当他为罗德岛上的孩子们讲起这些故事，看到他们的眼神好奇而兴奋的时候，当他在那些年幼病患的床头，看着听完故事的他们安然入睡的时候，裁度终于能够理解，一遍遍讲述这些故事的老翁贝托的心情。
……
“所以……你现在已经不再相信那些故事了？”
“那是当然，我早就知道那些故事都是大人们编出来骗小孩子的了！”
“如果你不相信，那天巫恋弄丢的布偶娃娃出现在你床头的时候，你为什么吓得连耳朵都竖不起来了？”

text.en:
Siracusan mafia films were once a wildly popular genre in the Core countries. By the time Figurino turned twelve or thirteen, he had grown tired of Umberto's old tales and went looking for new ones in the streets ruled by gangsters. He developed a fascination with mafia novels and films. He even picked up some slick famiglia slang and learned a few Originium Arts for self-defense (no wonder he performed so well in the operator tests despite lacking actual combat experience). Umberto noticed this but rarely intervened directly. Over time, the street thugs who had befriended Figurino either left the mafia or simply ghosted him. In any case, Figurino's 'famiglia journey' was anything but smooth.
They say, 'never meet your heroes.' When Figurino finally came face-to-face with some of the famiglia 'big-shots', he realized that the glamorous Siracusan tales were nothing more than fairytales.
Still, Figurino remains an active member of Rhodes Island's mafia film fan club to this day. Many Siracusan natives scoff at those films, dismissing them as fantasies made for foreign audiences, but Figurino begs to differ.
[Post-Screening Discussion Notes]
'The male lead, Reyna, is so classy!'
'What's the point of being classy? If you ask me, the strategist, Tomassino, was much more cunning—he was the real star of the movie!'
'Figurino, what do you think?'
'Hmm... During the final showdown between the two families, at the marketplace, an unnamed member of Reyna's family gets ten seconds of screen time.'
'Oh! I remember that guy. He had the chance to take out the opposing leader with a single arrow, but he lost his nerve, ducked down a bit, and missed his shot.'
'You guys didn't see what really happened?! He ducked to shield a little girl selling oranges from a stray arrow.'
'Now that guy, that type of character, appears in plenty of other mafia films—young couples who refuse the gangsters' entreaties, old judges that uphold justice to the end of their lives. I've met people like that in real life. They may not be glamorous, but they are the real 'big shots.''
text.zh:
叙拉古黑帮传奇曾是核心圈国家风靡一时的电影题材。在裁度十二三岁的时候，老翁贝托的那些故事他已经听得厌烦，他也曾在黑帮势力横行的街头寻找新的传奇。为此他一度热衷于黑帮小说和电影，学过几句俏皮的家族黑话，还学过一些防身的源石技艺（怪不得他没有战斗经验，但做干员测试的时候却表现得那么好）。翁贝托看在眼中，但似乎极少直接干预，只不过那些和裁度交好的街头混混，要么时不时有人“洗手不干”了，要么就某一天起有人主动和他疏远了。总之，裁度的“黑帮之路”从未顺畅。
就像许多童话中天真的主角一样，当裁度真的和他仰慕的那些“大人物”面对面时，所有风光无限和优雅体面的幻想在几个日夜之内就不复存在——那些流传在街头巷尾的“大人物”传奇也只是叙拉古编织的童话罢了。
不过，裁度至今都是罗德岛上黑帮片影迷会的一员。许多叙拉古人对那些电影嗤之以鼻，认为那都是拍给外国人看的黑帮幻想，但裁度并不完全同意他们的说法。
【映后讨论记录】
“电影里的男主角雷纳，也太有风度了！”
“光有风度有什么用？要我说，还是军师托马西诺比较有谋略，他才是整部电影的高光！”
“裁度，你怎么看？”
“唔……两个家族最后在集市决战的那一段，有个连名字都没有的雷纳家族成员，有十秒的镜头。”
“啊！我记得那个人，他本来有机会一箭射死对方领袖，但他居然在这么紧张的关头突然俯下身去，那一箭就射空了。”
“你们没有发现，他俯下身去，是为了帮那个卖橘子的小女孩挡住一支乱箭？
“这样的角色其他黑帮电影里还有很多，受到黑帮利诱却不为所动的年轻情侣，秉公执法直到生命最后的老法官……这样的人我也亲眼见过，他们可能不够风光，但他们才是了不起的大人物。”

text.en:
Siracusa was going through a time of great upheaval. After Umberto's passing, many clothing companies sought to leverage Tailor de Montano's reputation to establish themselves in the new city. A few of the more prestigious ones reached out to Luchino with offers of partnership. A handful of wealthy buyers came calling, hoping he would sell his shop in exchange for a more secure financial future. He had indeed considered selling his shop, but not because people were offering gobs of cash for it. It was, in fact, because he was unsure if he, armed only with measuring tape and scissors, could manage Tailor de Montano as successfully as his predecessor had.
Though the shop's future was still up in the air, Luchino personally wrote Umberto's obituary as a sign of respect for the old man. He sent it to every customer listed in the shop's registry, assuming most wouldn't reply. To his surprise, messages of condolence poured in from all over Siracusa. Luchino knew that most of their loyal customers were ordinary Siracusans. Yet their letters were every bit as polished and respectful as those of the shop's most distinguished clients. Some even included advance payments, hoping to secure a few of their upcoming pieces.
Luchino thought of the familiar fabrics and threads in the shop, the sound of scissors slicing through cloth, and the snap of thread being cut in that tiny workspace. He recalled how those scattered fabrics and threads were transformed into elegant garments. More importantly, he thought of the old tailor who, even as his life neared its end, imbued every single stitch with the same vigor and energy. Now, in the wake of the old tailor's passing, these letters from his loyal customers seemed to tell his final story. It was as if they were reminding Luchino that even with just a measuring tape and scissors in hand, he could craft a legend of his own.
Umberto's story had come to an end, but Luchino's was only beginning. What kind of legend he would stitch together would be for him to decide. From De Montano to Rhodes Island, the boy who grew up in Siracusa was ready to start a new chapter.
text.zh:
叙拉古正处于剧变的时代，在老翁贝托去世之后，不少服装企业想要借助德蒙塔诺在新城市立足，也有许多更加有名的裁缝店向卢奇诺抛来了橄榄枝，甚至有几位出价不菲的买家已经登门拜访过，期望卢奇诺用裁缝店来交换一个更为富足的未来。卢奇诺确实也曾考虑过裁缝店的未来，但不是因为买家的出价过于慷慨，而是因为他还不确定，自己手中仅有尺和剪刀，能否把德蒙塔诺经营得和爷爷在时一样好。
虽然还没做出决定，但出于礼节，卢奇诺还是亲手写好了老翁贝托的讣告，按照店里的客人名册，发给了记录在册的每一位顾客，他以为那些老顾客不会有太多回响。出乎他意料的是，叙拉古各地顾客的慰问纷至沓来。卢奇诺知道，除了那几位名声赫赫的客人之外，德蒙塔诺的老主顾大多是最普通的叙拉古人，但他们的慰问信一样写得体面工整，甚至有人直接预付了一笔定金，希望未来也能够收到德蒙塔诺精制的衣装。
卢奇诺想起店里那些常见的布匹与丝线，想起在那小小的裁缝间里，剪刀划过布料、剪断缝线的声响，想起那些杂乱无章的布匹与丝线，是怎么变成一套套体面衣装。更重要的是，他想起了制成那一套套衣装的老裁缝，在生命走到尽头的时候，最平凡的穿针引线，也依然具有力量——在老裁缝去世之后，这一封封老主顾的来信，仍在替他讲述着最后的故事，仿佛在告诉卢奇诺，即使手中仅握着尺和剪刀，也能够裁剪出别样的传奇。
老裁缝的故事已经讲完，但卢奇诺的故事才刚刚拉开序幕，要为这故事缝制什么样的传奇，得由卢奇诺自己去裁度，从德蒙塔诺到罗德岛，生长于叙拉古的少年正要迈出自己的第一步。

text.en:
Tailor de Montano is still there, albeit temporarily closed, but the tailoring must go on. Figurino brought enough tools and materials to set up a small tailoring shop and applied for a modest workspace at Rhodes Island to use as his workshop. He continues to offer his familiar services to customers in Rhodes Island, from simple mending to complex alterations and custom orders. He remains meticulous and precise, just like the old man was.
Umberto served as a role model for so many Siracusans, especially Figurino. Though Umberto is gone, his teachings and the example he set continue to shape Figurino's growth. What exactly did the old man teach him? Figurino himself once said that Umberto taught him a craft, 'but also more than that.' There was so much more he could, and did, learn from Umberto, beyond just how to run a well-regarded tailoring shop. For now, Figurino has chosen to continue honing his skills with the tools at hand: a measuring tape, fabric, and scissors.
text.zh:
德蒙塔诺依然在，只是暂时歇业，所以裁缝的手艺不能落下。裁度是这么说的，也确实是这么做的，他带来的家当足以开起一间裁缝铺，他也在罗德岛上申请了小小的一隅空间当作自己的工作坊。从最简单的缝缝补补，到复杂的衣装修改、定制，裁度依然在用自己量体裁衣的本事为身边的人带来便利，也依然一丝不苟，就像从前的老翁贝托那样。
老翁贝托对许多叙拉古人来说都堪为典范，对于裁度更是如此。即使是离世之后，老翁贝托的言传身教也依然在呵护裁度的成长。爷爷教给他的到底是什么？他自己也说过，爷爷教给他的是一门手艺，又不只是手艺。他能从翁贝托身上学到的还有很多，不只是如何经营好一间小有名气的裁缝店而已。不过现在，裁度还是选择从手边的尺、布匹和剪刀开始继续学习。

value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Confirmed Infected by medical examination.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

text.en:
Catherine is a Victorian workers' representative. During the Londinium incident, she joined the Citizens' Self-Salvation Corps and worked in concert with Rhodes Island.
With her facilitation, several factories and workers' organizations reached agreements with us to tackle issues such as Originium cleanup, infection prevention, and medical care.
text.zh:
凯瑟琳，维多利亚工人代表。于伦蒂尼姆事件期间参与市民自救军的抵抗运动，与罗德岛协同行动。
在凯瑟琳的协调下，伦蒂尼姆的多家工厂及工人团体先后与罗德岛达成合作，在源石污染善后、矿石病预防与医疗救治等领域共同展开行动。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 9%
No visible Originium crystals have been observed on the surface of Catherine's body. However, the patient is of advanced age and became ill due to acute infection, so long-term observation is necessary.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.19u/L
Catherine was infected during the Londinium incident. She has since been treated with suppressive medications, and her disease has been effectively controlled.
While tracing the medical histories of workers from Highbury's factories, we made a discovery. During the past ten years, infection rates for workers at Catherine's shops have been relatively low. There is no secret here. Both the workers and the managers know that she will use every method at her disposal to fight for safer work environments and care for each and every one of her workers.
—Senior Operator from the Medical Department
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】9%
干员凯瑟琳体表尚未发现源石结晶分布，但患者因急性感染致病且年事较高，我们认为需要长期谨慎观察。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.19u/L
干员凯瑟琳于伦蒂尼姆事件期间感染矿石病，后续经过抑制药物注射，病情已得到有效控制。
在追溯海布里区多家工厂工人的既往病史，制定大规模救治方案的过程中，我们有了一个不大不小的发现。过去十年，凡是由凯瑟琳女士担任领班的车间，矿石病的感染率都控制在一个相对较低的水平。这背后没有什么秘密，工人们，还有工厂的管理者都很清楚，这位老工长会用自己的方式为工人们争取更加安全的生产环境，尽力照顾好每一个人。
——医疗部资深干员

text.en:
The background check on Catherine revealed nothing unusual. As reported by operators stationed in Londinium, she is an industrial worker from the Highbury district who was appointed as a representative before the age of thirty due to her outstanding productivity. She frequently mediates negotiations between workers and factory management, and has earned a considerable reputation within the Londinium worker community. The only noteworthy detail is that she was once invited—or rather, conscripted—by Parliament to serve as a senior technician to help design and manufacture the latest Steam Knight armor. However, she did not use this opportunity to climb the social ladder. Instead, she declined further studies offered by the Royal Victorian Academy of Sciences and returned to her previous position once the project concluded.
When we questioned her, she gave a brief and pragmatic response—As a worker, following a production schedule is simply a way of life, and she's well aware of the destructive power of the weapons produced on the military assembly lines. She is not some ascetic adhering to a doctrine of nonviolence. When the invaders entered the city, she rallied the workers together. Under her leadership, they produced 'the Crawler' and fought fiercely on the front lines alongside the Self-Salvation Corps. However, this does not mean she is eager to become someone who designs killing machines. She would rather devote her energy to saving lives, not taking them.
On the other hand, she has acknowledged that the events in Londinium have, to some extent, changed her perspective. The young Aslan returning from a foreign land formed a new parliament, and the workers of the Highbury district—no, all the workers of Londinium—eagerly await progress. Now, it is time for the gentlemen sitting in their cushioned chairs to win back the public's trust. One day, the workers may reconsider whether to accept the new Parliament's invitation and allow this elderly woman, still suffering from Oripathy, to live out her days in peace.
text.zh:
凯瑟琳女士的背景调查结果并没有显示出任何不同寻常之处。正如驻于伦蒂尼姆的外勤干员向本舰传回的情报所述，她是一位出身于海布里区的产业工人，不到三十岁就因为突出的生产贡献被选为代表，时常代表工人与工厂管理方进行斡旋谈判，在伦蒂尼姆本地工人社群中积累了相当的声望。唯一值得注意的是，凯瑟琳女士曾经受到议会的邀请，或者说征调，以资深技术工人的身份，参与了新式蒸汽骑士铠甲的设计制造。但她并没有利用这次机会向上攀登，反而回绝了由皇家科学院提供的进修机会，在项目告一段落后回到了原来的岗位。
针对我们的疑问，凯瑟琳女士作出了简要而务实的回答——身为一名工人，按日程从事生产便是他们的生活方式，而军工厂流水线上生产出的武器有何等杀伤力，她也十分清楚。她不是秉持某种苛刻的非暴力信条的苦修士，当入侵者踏入这座城市时，她带领工人们造出了“爬行号”，与自救军一道在前线进行了顽强的抵抗。但是，这并不意味着她会热衷于成为一个专门设计杀人工具，并且引以为傲的人，她宁愿用上全部的精气神去照看身边的人。
另一方面，凯瑟琳女士也承认，发生在伦蒂尼姆的事在某种程度上改变了她的观点。从异乡归来的年轻阿斯兰组建了新的议会，海布里区，不，整个伦蒂尼姆的工人都会与她一同拭目以待——现在，轮到坐在带软垫的靠背椅上的那些绅士来重新赢得他们的信任了。在未来的某一天，工人们也许会重新考虑是否要接受新议会的邀请，然后放她这个染上矿石病的老太太安心养老。

text.en: After the war, Rhodes Island made a temporary stop at Londinium. Catherine, who was assisting with the reconstruction effort, jumped at the opportunity to visit the landship for the first time. When submitting her request, she candidly stated that she wanted to visit her grandson, Feist, who was 'messing around' in the Engineering Department. She was also curious and wanted to see, with her own eyes, what kind of people would be so eager to wade into the murky waters of Londinium. An HR operator politely mentioned that she had already met with Rhodes Island's top management and several key squads on various battlefields across Londinium. The old worker simply raised an eyebrow and waved it off. 'If you want to befriend the workers, you can't just meet them in the beer halls while they're drinking and boasting and spitting at 'the man'. You need to go into the factories and visit their homes.' In her view, the 'professional' Rhodes Island operators aren't much different from the workers of Highbury, herself included. That's why she was particularly eager to visit the ship. When the HR operator opened the door to Engineering's workshop, she saw Closure, Stainless, Rockrock, and several other operators with their heads down, intensely focused on a single task. The drill hummed, and the argon arc welder cast an eerie white light on everyone's goggles. Catherine held up a finger to signal the HR operator to remain quiet and not disturb the group. She then picked up a spare welding mask and, rather confidently, joined in the effort. 'Wait a minute, the turret won't rotate. This motor seems unreliable, doesn't it?' 'I knew it! Lemme have a crack at it! I'm the Chief Engineer—I can fix it!' 'Feist, Closure, hold on a second. The original plan was to just make a model as a gift for Catherine, right?' 'Sure, but this is the scaled-down, movable, self-propelled version of the Crawler! Isn't it awesome?' 'But...' 'Oh, so you were planning to give this to me as a bribe, Feist?' Silence fell around the workbench as people exchanged glances through their goggles and welding masks. Stainless was digging at his ears, wondering if he was hearing things. When Catherine pushed her mask up to her forehead, the hearty laughter and exclamations finally drowned out the hum of the machinery. What followed was a family reunion, brief yet precious. As for how Catherine was welcomed by the kids over the next few days—or how her anecdotes in the factory made them laugh so hard they forgot to eat, attend class, or even sleep—that's another story.
text.zh:
在罗德岛短暂停留伦蒂尼姆，协助战后重建工作期间，凯瑟琳女士第一次造访本舰。她在提出申请时直言不讳地表示，希望借此机会探望一下在工程部“鬼混”的孙子费斯特，还要亲眼看看究竟是怎样的一帮人，非要来蹚伦蒂尼姆的浑水不可。人事部干员礼貌地指出，凯瑟琳女士实际上已经在伦蒂尼姆的各处战场上见过罗德岛的最高管理层及数支骨干行动小队了，而这位老工人只是耸了耸眉毛，波澜不惊地摆了摆手。
要和工人交朋友，就不能只在他们喝酒吹嘘，朝先生小姐吐唾沫的时候去套近乎，得到工厂里，到他们的家里去作客才行。凯瑟琳女士如是说。在她看来，把“专业人士”写在脸上的罗德岛干员与包括她在内的海布里区工人没有太大的分别。因此，她才格外希望来本舰上看一看。
当陪同的人事部干员帮她刷开工程部工作室的大门时，可露希尔、干员白铁、干员洛洛，还有其他几位工程部干员正把头埋在一块。钻头嗡嗡作响，氩弧焊机在每个人的护目镜上投下诡异的白光。凯瑟琳对人事部干员竖起食指，示意对方不要惊扰这个全神贯注的小团体。随后，她拿起一副闲置的焊接面具，从容不迫地混了进去。
“不对呀，炮塔又不能转了，这电机有点不靠谱吧？”
“我说什么来着？换我来换我来，本首席工程师亲自出手！”
“等一下，费斯特，可露希尔，我记得一开始的计划只是做个模型，当作送给凯瑟琳的礼物……”
“我知道，但这可是‘爬行号’的微缩可动自走版本！你看它现在多威风啊！”
“可是……”
“哦，费斯特，原来你打算拿这个来贿赂我？”
寂静降临在工作台的周围，人们隔着护目镜与焊接面具面面相觑。至于白铁，他使劲掏着耳朵，怀疑自己出现了幻听。当凯瑟琳把面具推到额头上时，惊呼与开怀的欢笑终于淹没了这间堆满设备的工作室。
接下来的事情无需多余笔墨描述，那是属于家人之间的团聚时刻，短暂又珍贵。至于凯瑟琳在后面的几天里是如何受孩子们的欢迎，工厂里敲铁块的轶事又是如何让他们忘了吃饭忘了上课又忘了睡觉，那就是另一个故事了。

text.en:
When I walked into Highbury, I saw an elderly manager perched on atop a ruined street corner. She watched the workers around her, shouting out orders as they moved giant piles of construction materials. Some nodded at her as they passed by. They were disheveled, and their faces weary. Many were injured. However, not a single one stopped to rest. They were too busy pushing carts filled with mortar, stacking building materials near the scaffolding, and using noisy diggers to free their streets of the wreckage left by the war.
This area was once the industrial heart of Londinium, no, of all Victoria. We need not endlessly recount the grandeur of Victoria's industrial clusters and automated assembly lines, or how the dense, efficient transportation networks delivered raw materials and intermediate products to every corner of the land. Now, the refuse often overlooked by 'gentlemen', the brave souls who only recently fought to the death with the invaders on the streets, are scraping the rust off the ironworks.
After confirming that I wasn't a thug trying to steal building materials from the construction site, the grey-haired construction supervisor—who refused to reveal her name—took me to a high platform overlooking most of Highbury. The high-rise dormitories, planned by City Hall at the edge of the plate, had been severely damaged in battle. The defense artillery had blasted a huge crater in the main building, rendering it unusable. The supervisor told me that hundreds of blue-collar families from Highbury had once lived there. Now, she sends people to patrol the area frequently to prevent young punks from sneaking into the building, which could collapse at any moment, to scavenge for scraps.
I continued chatting with the woman. I mentioned a newspaper column I had once read which denounced the dormitories, and Highbury in general, as an 'urban prison' designed to separate the dirty factories and stinky workers from the shining city of Londinium. I asked her whether the workers, who once fought valiantly for Victoria, were still willing to live behind the prison wall.
Just then, the factory whistle blew in the distance, signaling the shift change. After the sound faded, she raised a cigarette and pointed at the crater in the building, off in the distance. She told me that the building, now burned down to its frame, had once been the Auchterigg opera house. On the other side of the hole, the detached villas and large gardens of the Magna Borough still smoked amidst the rubble. While we spoke, a team of Highbury laborers was working in the factory to produce the prefabricated components needed to repair Londinium, while another had already arrived at the construction site. This city was built by the hands of the workers, and it is those hands that will eventually restore it to its rightful state.
She cynically remarked, 'Londinium's walls couldn't stop the invaders, and the Sarkaz's defenses couldn't stop the Self-Salvation Corps. Well, that prison, and its walls, won't stop anyone either.'
—A clipping from a 'Daily Salon' column; the photographer captured Catherine's silhouette.
text.zh:
走进海布里区的时候，我见到一位头发灰白的年长女工正站在街角废墟的高处，看着周围的工人们喊着号子搬运建材。一些人路过时向她点头致意。他们蓬头垢面，有很多人带着伤，面露倦色，但是没有人停下休息。在这里，人们推着填满灰浆的车，将建材堆砌在脚手架旁的空地上，用轰隆作响的挖掘机将属于他们的街道从一场战争留下的狼藉中解放出来。
这里曾经是伦蒂尼姆，乃至整个维多利亚的工业心脏。我们已不再需要连篇累牍地复述维多利亚雄伟的工业集群与自动化流水线，复述密集高效的交通网络如何输送原材料与中间制成品，在这片大地的中心创造了多么非凡的奇迹。现在，这些时常被绅士们忽视，不久前才刚刚踏上街头，与入侵者进行殊死搏斗的人们，正在为这颗蒙尘的钢铁之心除去铁锈。
在确认我不是闯进施工现场伺机盗取建材的流氓之后，那位年迈的女工长——她不愿透露姓名——领着我来到了一处可以俯瞰大半个海布里区的高台。由市议会规划建于地块边缘的高层宿舍楼在之前的战斗中遭到严重破坏，建筑主体部分被城防炮掏出了一个巨大的豁口，已完全失去了居住功能。女工长告诉我，海布里区的数百个产业工人家庭曾经就居住在这里，但现在，她不得不时常派人来附近巡逻，以免有天不怕地不怕的半大小子跑进这栋随时可能倒塌的危楼里冒险拾荒。
我与她谈起，曾有一位批评家在报纸上撰文痛斥，这几栋联排的高层宿舍楼实际上是一堵人为的隔离墙，用来将脏兮兮的工厂和臭烘烘的工人从伦蒂尼姆的城市景观中隔离出去——而海布里区的整体设计规划与一座监狱根本别无二致。我忍不住向她提问，曾经为维多利亚挺身而出的工人们，是否依旧愿意被留在这堵墙后？
这时，工厂的汽笛声在附近某处响起，午班交接的时间到了。汽笛声消失在耳畔之后，女工长举起烟，沿着城防炮掏出的大洞指向远处。她告诉我，那座被烧得只剩下骨架的建筑曾经是奥克特里格区的歌剧院；而在另一边，玛格纳区的独栋别墅和大花园还在瓦砾堆里冒着烟。就在我们交谈的同时，一班来自海布里区的工人正在工厂里生产修缮伦蒂尼姆所需要的各种预制组件，而另一班早已抵达了施工现场。这座城市在工人们的手中诞生，也会在工人们的手中被修缮至它应有的样貌。
她无不讽刺地评论道，既然伦蒂尼姆的城墙没有拦住入侵者，萨卡兹的防线没有挡住自救军，那么，这样的一道墙也不会拦住任何人。
——《每日沙龙报》专栏剪报，摄影师拍下了凯瑟琳的背影

text.en:
'Please wait, Catherine! I beg you to be patient. I assure you my request is sincere—I come on behalf of the Royal War Museum. I only wish to showcase your brave struggle to the public. I have no ulterior motives! Don't you think there's still room for discussion?'
'I'm sorry, sir, but there's nothing left to discuss. I've had people look into your background. A friend of mine told me you were unwilling to leave the museum and escape the city, and said you even opened up the warehouse, used for holding valuable artifacts, as a temporary shelter for refugees. I figured you were a man of character, someone I could trust, which is why I agreed to this meeting.'
'You honor me with your praise. In that case, may we continue?'
'No, we may not. The Crawler will not become an exhibit locked in a glass case for tourists to take photos with.'
'But... I don't understand. Haven't the Sarkaz already been driven out? We've won. Victoria has won! Shouldn't the walking war machine be moved to a museum to prove to the world that Victoria has not lost her bravery, her very soul?'
'The 'soul' of Victoria lies in the hearts of the brave warriors who sleep, every night, beneath her streets.'
'Please... hear me out, Catherine. On the day you blew that whistle, the others and I were hiding underground, too terrified to do anything. Finally, someone opened the door and told us that Londinium had been saved—the workers drove the 'walkers' right through the Sarkaz defenses. You don't know how happy I was!'
'Sigh...'
'I've worked in the museum my whole life, Catherine. I know very well that if we rely solely on words and images, people will easily forget things they should never forget. I didn't witness the Self-Salvation Corps liberating Londinium with my own eyes, but if we could display the Crawler as an exhibit, everyone would understand the heroic feats you accomplished!'
'*Sigh* You really shouldn't have sent such a nice old man to do this kind of thing, Vina.'
'Hm? What was that about the Madam Speaker?'
'It's nothing, sir. I know you mean well, but I still can't grant your request... At least, not now.'
'What do you mean?'
'We won't hand over the Crawler. However, I know a few skilled artisans who can help you create a full-scale replica of it to display in the museum.'
'But... but if it's just a replica...'
'Don't worry, sir. Even if it's just a model, every single screw will be tightened by our own hands. As long as you don't tell anyone, no one can say it's a forgery.'
text.zh:
“请等一等，凯瑟琳女士，我恳求您保持耐心。我向您保证，我的请求是真挚且诚实的——我代表皇家战争博物馆而来，我只是想要向公众展示你们勇敢的抗争，没有任何其他目的！难道您不认为这件事仍有许多商讨的余地吗？”
“很遗憾，爵士老爷，但这事儿没得谈。我找人打听过你的事，有一个朋友说你不愿抛下博物馆逃出城，还打开保存文物的仓库给人避难。我觉得差不多可以相信你的人品，才同意了这次会面。”
“能得到您的赞许是我的荣幸。那么，我们能不能再谈一谈？”
“不，不行。‘爬行号’不会变成装在玻璃柜子里，留给游客合影的展品。”
“可是……我不明白，萨卡兹难道不是已经被赶走了吗？我们胜利了，维多利亚胜利了，那台步行战车难道不应该被搬进博物馆，向世人证明维多利亚尚未失掉她勇敢的灵魂吗？”
“那些‘勇敢的灵魂’还睡在这座城市的脚底下呢。”
“请……请您听我说，凯瑟琳女士。在你们鸣响汽笛的那一天，我和其他人一直躲在地下，除了浑身打颤什么都做不了。终于，有人拉开门，告诉我们伦蒂尼姆得救了——是工人们驾驶步行战车撞开了萨卡兹的防线。您不知道我有多高兴！”
“唉……”
“我这辈子都在博物馆工作，凯瑟琳女士。我很清楚，如果只靠文字和影像，人们很容易忘掉那些他们本该永远铭记的事情。我没能亲眼目睹自救军解放伦蒂尼姆的那一刻，但如果我们能够展出‘爬行号’，每个人都会明白你们究竟实现了怎样的英雄壮举！”
“维娜，你真不该打发一个老好人来做这种事。”
“嗯？您说什么？我是不是听到了议长阁下的名字？”
“没什么，爵士。你有诚意，但我还是不能答应你的请求……至少不是现在。”
“您的意思是？”
“我们不会交出‘爬行号’。但是，我认识好些心灵手巧的家伙，他们可以帮你的博物馆做个一比一的仿制模型。”
“可，可如果只是展出复制品……”
“别担心，爵士，就算是个模型，那一颗颗螺丝也是由我们亲手拧出来的。只要你肯保守秘密，就不算弄虚作假。”

text.en:
Doctor, changing old habits is hard, especially for an old worker like me. Back in the day, my life wasn't complicated. I took care of the factory teams, looked after Feist... All the things I needed to worry about were right in front of me. It was a pretty routine life. Sometimes, I would argue with unreasonable employers on behalf of the workers. But most of the time, all I managed to bring back were some half-hearted compromises and verbal promises. The lads were still grateful, but I knew it wasn't anything to be proud of.
And now? I've suddenly become a character straight out of a spy novel. I hear rumors that 'the Catherine of Highbury,' isn't a real person, but a code name for a secret organization within the Londinium worker groups. I could almost laugh—when I first heard them, I thought it sounded a bit like something you guys would do. Ha, yeah, now I've dealt with people I'd never have had the chance to meet before. I even turned down the invitation from the Speaker you brought me. Unbelievable. But deep down, I still feel more secure carrying tools than weapons. Still, now we've come to realize that staying empty-handed just ensures that bad things will happen to you. So, I guess this old cat will have to learn some new tricks.
text.zh:
博士，改变一个人的习惯并不容易，尤其是像我这样的老工人。以前，我的生活并不复杂，带好厂里的班组，照看好费斯特，需要操心的事都摆在眼前。那是一种相当规律的生活。有时候，我会代表工人跟那些不讲理的雇主吵吵架。但大多数情况下，我只能带回一些聊胜于无的妥协和口头承诺。工人们仍然很感谢我，但我清楚，这算不上什么令人自豪的事。
现在呢？我突然成了间谍小说里的人物。我听到风传，“海布里区的凯瑟琳奶奶”并不是一个真实存在的人，而是伦蒂尼姆工人团体秘密组织机构的代号。说来好笑，我听到传言的时候倒是觉得，这样的事有那么一点像是你们的作风。呵，是啊，我现在跟很多原本一辈子也碰不见的人打过交道，还回绝了由你们请回来的议长阁下的邀请，真是不可思议。但心底里，我还是觉得把工具而不是武器揣在手里的时候，要更踏实些。只不过，我们现在算是明白了，只要两手空空，就一定会有坏事落在头上。这样一来，也只能由我这个老家伙先来改一改自己的习惯了。

text.en: Rose Salt, an herbalist who wanders Iberia. She boasts many local connections of every class and creed, and currently provides Rhodes Island with intelligence on Iberia and preliminary research.
text.zh: 瑰盐，伊比利亚地区的流浪草药医生，人脉资源丰富，涵盖当地各阶层人士，现为罗德岛提供伊比利亚相关情报及工作开展前期的调研支持。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 12%
Some Originium crystals are visible on Operator Rose Salt's left arm.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.15u/L
'I'm not sure why Rose Salt is so health-conscious at her young age. The moment she heard that new hires get a free medical examination, she requested Medical to pull out all the stops for hers. She even got a screening for hereditary diseases. She's also extremely cooperative with her Oripathy treatment. The other day, someone spotted her poring over a copy of 'A Hundred Habits of the Long-Lived.' I guess she's planning to live forever!'
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】12%
干员瑰盐左臂可见少量源石结晶。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.15u/L
“不知道为什么干员瑰盐小小年纪就能这么惜命，听说入职体检是免费的之后，她拜托医疗部给她增加了很多深层项目，连家族遗传病都筛查了一遍，矿石病的治疗配合度也极高，甚至有人看到她在仔细阅读《保障长寿的一百个习惯》。她看起来是真的想活很久！”

text.en:
Barely a day had passed before the operators coming and going from Rhodes Island were aware of a newly-arrived, sweet little girl. She would greet people with honey-glazed 'señor's and 'señora's, and if she ever spotted anyone unwell, she would approach to ask if they needed help. She would even give herself all sorts of cutesy nicknames for others to call her. Her petite build and elegant yet yellowed and old-fashioned clothing also contributed to the image of a young girl going through hard times, yet still keeping herself tidy while doing what she could to help others with her herbs (despite the full suite of medical facilities aboard Rhodes Island). She had successfully lodged herself in the hearts of the operators, making them all the fonder of this new hire.
But this situation would soon deteriorate, as her old habits reared their head and she found herself palming another operator's beautiful bracelet.
As a thief and pickpocket who had long operated in remote regions of Iberia, Rose Salt was completely unaware of 'Closure's Handmade High-Grade Security System' when she did the deed, and her crime was recorded in high definition by the surveillance cameras. To teach her a lesson, Closure had her do honest work by weaving three hundred identical bracelets and selling them. At first, Rose Salt assumed she would be paid a portion of whatever she earned, but to give her the experience of having her things taken by others, Closure put all the money towards security system maintenance.
After this harsh punishment, Rose Salt was a pitiful sight, slumped against the wall of the dormitory. Yet she never expected to be approached by the operator she stole from, carrying one of the bracelets she had made for Closure. The operator gave her her bracelet and said to the young girl: 'If you liked it that much, you could have just told me. We could have woven them together, and I'd have given one to you.'
Rose Salt's face was blank as she received it, but she quickly broke into a sincere smile. Since that day, she rarely falls back into her cloying, honeyed greetings. Perhaps she has learned there is no need for her to pretend while aboard Rhodes Island, and that if she is true to others, they will be true to her.
text.zh:
短短一天时间，罗德岛上上下下的干员们都知道新来了一个嘴非常甜的可爱小姑娘，见人就甜甜地叫哥哥姐姐，看到有人身体不舒服就主动上去询问和帮忙，还会给自己起各种可爱的小昵称。尤其她人又瘦瘦小小的，身上的衣服虽然美观大方，但也能看得出布料有些发黄老旧。于是，一个生活有些困难，但仍旧把自己收拾得干干净净，尽管知道罗德岛有着全套的医疗设备，但还是想用自己手中的那些药草卷尽量帮到你一点忙的小姑娘的形象，成功地树立在了干员们的心中，大家都挺喜欢这个新干员。
但事情很快就发生了转变，起因是瑰盐旧习难改，偷偷顺走了一个干员一串漂亮的手链。
长期在伊比利亚偏远地区小偷小摸的瑰盐，完全没有意识到什么叫做“可露希尔一手打造的高级安保系统”，她的罪行被高清摄像头清清楚楚地记录了下来。为了让瑰盐吸取教训，可露希尔决定让她照着那条手链的样子认认真真再编上三百条，随后全部拿去卖掉。瑰盐原本还以为自己最后也能分到一点辛苦钱，但结果是为了让她体会一下自己的东西被别人占有的感觉，这些收入全部被可露希尔拿去维护监控系统了。
被狠狠整治了一顿的瑰盐可怜巴巴，瘫坐在休息区，没想到那个被她偷了手链的干员拿着一条刚在可露希尔那里领到的补偿手链找到了她。干员将手链送给了她，同时还告诉这个沮丧的小姑娘：“如果你真的很喜欢我的手链，你可以直接和我说，我们可以一起编手链，我也可以把它送给你。”
拿到手链的瑰盐先是愣了一下，随后很真心地笑了起来。从那天起，瑰盐在罗德岛上就很少再假装嘴甜地叫别人哥哥姐姐了。或许她是知道了，不用伪装，人们其实也会真心地对待她。

text.en:
For a drifter, the title of 'herbalist' is a useful one. People are always ready to trust a doctor, and will not question what is inside her bag even as it bulges at the seams. While she does make use of this identity to approach her targets, it is not a false one. She really does have medical skills, and is able to treat minor scrapes and illnesses with ease. She is even famous as a wandering medic in some regions of Iberia.
According to her, her medical knowledge stems mostly from observing which herbs wild beasts would eat when poisoned or ill, or noting what herbs other doctors had used to treat her. She would then gather these herbs and dig them out of her bag the next time she ran into similar circumstances, either for herself or others. She claims the results speak for themselves, and that she's never run into any issues with this method. However, we have also asked Operator Thorns his opinion, as he has received her treatment before.
During a serious bout of motion sickness while traversing the Salt Flat, he drank an herbal soup offered by Rose Salt. As soon as it went down his throat, he found himself gripped by some indescribable force restoring his vitality, allowing him to walk the shuddering saltship like it was dry land. His limbs also felt like they had minds of their own, and it took a while before he felt in control of them again. He only later learned the cause of this: Rose Salt had given him an anti-nausea dosage appropriate for a healthy adult mangler beast. While it did cure his motion sickness for good, he does not recommend taking her prescriptions lightly.
While she does stock life-saving herbs (though given the aforementioned incident, 'life-saving' is debateable), the majority of Rose Salt's herb collection is instead for inducing dizziness. While she claims this is for self-defense, after seeing her knock out a raging tuskbeast with ease during a mission, most people no longer believe a word she says.
However, Aak has displayed a keen interest in his new coworker. After all, the censer she carries is effective in distributing all sorts of smoke and vapors. The two of them have been secretly collaborating in the development of 'miracle cures'. We can only hope that we have not found ourselves yet another laboratory explosion extraordinaire.
text.zh:
在外流浪，“草药医生”这个名头的确非常好用，人们会对一个医生抱有天然的信任，也不会去过分探究她那鼓鼓囊囊的包里放的都是什么东西，她可以借着这个身份靠近她的目标，而且瑰盐干员也不算在行骗，她是真的懂医术，一些小伤小病在她这里可以说是药到病除，甚至她在伊比利亚一些偏远的小地方是那里有名的行脚医生。
据她后来所说，她的医术来源多半是看到荒野上的野兽中毒或者生病后去吃了什么药草缓了过来，或者是别的医生用什么药草救了她，她就去采这种草，下次遇到了差不多的情况，就找出来自己吃下或者把它给其他病人——据她所说效果都非常好，从没出过什么问题——但我们也咨询了一下被她治疗过的棘刺干员。
棘刺干员曾因为在盐漠上晕船很严重就喝下了瑰盐提供的草药汤，随即彻底被一种无法言说的强劲力量刺激得精神百倍，在颠簸的盐船上来去自由如履平地，四肢也好像都有了自己的意识，他花了好一段时间才重新认识了它们。他后来也找出了原因——瑰盐给他的药是一头精壮的成年裂兽给自己治呕吐用的量，虽然这确实彻底治好了他的晕船，但他不建议任何人唐突尝试瑰盐的药方。
不过相比于治病救人（如果刚刚所说的也算是救人的话），瑰盐随身携带的，更多的还是能将人迷晕的药草。虽然她对此的解释是“自保”，但看到她在一次任务的突发情况中，轻轻松松就迷倒了一头正在发怒的牙兽后，多数人选择不再相信她嘴里的任何一句话。
不过阿似乎对这个新干员非常感兴趣——毕竟，她手中的提灯总能冒出功效各异的烟雾。他们两人似乎正在密谋研制一些“特效药”，我们十分担心实验室爆炸选手会就此增加一位。

text.en:
Before coming to Rhodes Island, Rose Salt made a living working for Iberians of every social class. She is well-acquainted with mayoral aides, the Inquisition, and the wealthy in general, but also familiar with street-level thieves and traders. Most of the time, she would act as a naive little girl, enthusiastically helping others while showing a deep interest in the lives of the rich. Once she had discreetly learned when they would not be home, she would sneak in and rob them. When not buttering someone up, she would show her true self, loitering in the marketplace and trading loot and favors until she had what she wanted.
After joining Rhodes Island, we taught her the knowledge and etiquette appropriate for her age, and how to hold a steady job like the other operators, essentially changing her lifestyle to one where she earned a fair wage. To our astonishment, she was not wholly unfamiliar with our lessons. In fact, not only was she already experienced with dining etiquette and formal speech, unlike most she even had some knowledge of subjects like formal letter writing, classical music, and painting. It seems she had received a robust education fit for nobility. But for whatever reason, she did not continue with her education, leaving her knowledge of etiquette at the level of a seven or eight year old. Now, she leans towards another extreme: in order to obtain what she wants, she will happily pretend to be a young maiden of whichever archetype she wishes, easily deceiving those who would lower their guard towards a little girl.
To live the 'good life' she envisions, Rose Salt has begrudgingly heeded our instructions and joined a classroom of seven and eight-year-olds in their lessons. However, she has repeatedly emphasized that we are not to mention she is going to class in front of the Iberians who call her Señora Pascuala, or to give her a really bad noogie!
text.zh:
来到罗德岛之前，瑰盐干员一直在为伊比利亚的各阶层的人做事挣钱，她既认识给镇长、审判庭、富贵人家工作的人，也认识那些在底层生活的小偷、商贩，在这些人面前，她多半会伪装成一个热衷于帮助他人但对有钱人非常好奇的天真小姑娘，打探他们不在家的时间再上门实施偷窃；要么就干脆露出本性，混迹在市井中间，靠利益交换到一切自己想要的东西。
入职罗德岛后，我们在向瑰盐教授那些她这个年纪本应该拥有的知识和礼仪，也教她如何像其他干员一样完成工作，挣一份不多不少的工资，换一种方式生活。不过令我们惊讶的是，瑰盐干员并不如我们一开始所想的那样完全不懂这些，实际上，她不仅懂得餐桌礼仪、称呼用语，甚至于大部分人不太接触的书信礼仪、古典音乐、绘画等她都有着一定程度的了解和认知——她似乎接受过非常良好的贵族教育。但不知为何，这份教育并没有持续下去，她所掌握的知识停滞在一个七八岁左右孩童的程度，并在之后走向了一个极端：如今的瑰盐能自如地伪装成各种形象的小姑娘，欺骗那些掉以轻心的人，获得她想要的东西。
不过，为了能过上自己心目中的“好日子”，瑰盐干员虽然嘴上有些不情愿，但也有听我们的话和一群七八岁的小病患们一起学习她应该掌握的知识，同时，她也多次向我们强调，绝对不许在伊比利亚那群会称呼她为“帕斯卡拉大人”的手下面前提她还要上课的事情，或者是揉她的脑袋！

text.en:
There is a phrase Rose Salt is fond of saying: 'I'm going to live the good life!' And true enough, she came aboard Rhodes Island one day with a large sum of money.
Apparently, it was a reward for remarkable performance during a mission. With it, she bought herself fine clothes, shiny jewelry, and all sorts of things she did not need in the slightest: a small bedside couch made with silk, a hand mirror inlaid with miniature diamonds, and a gorgeous gown with a hem trailing along the floor, etc.
Yet she still dresses in her usual clothes, having set aside such finery after only wearing it once or twice. She is simply unused to these refined luxuries. She piles the silk couch full of things she needs for her missions, the diamond-studded mirror is wedged beneath her luggage to balance it out, the gorgeous gown is draped over the bed to form a sheet, and everything else is stuffed into whatever free space there is in the small dorm we assigned to her. The glinting and glimmering coming from random corners of her room is proof enough that they exist. It seems this is the 'good life' she always dreamed of.
Moreover, the moment she has her wages for the month, she always tops up her meal card before spending the rest as soon as she can, buying all sorts of beautiful baubles she needs (or does not need), filling her dorm more and more. Rarely does she ever actually wear any of them, though. We are not sure why, but compared to others with such lavish tastes, who delight in decorating themselves, Rose Salt seems to prefer the act of spending money itself, as well as simply owning these sparkling treasures.
Many items in her collection are things she has owned for a very long time. While they no longer shine like they used to, she still takes good care of them. One time, she lost one of her baubles. She tracked it all the way to the trash storage, digging the once-beautiful object from its depths. It is as if what she cares about is not their appearance, but simply possessing them.
Yet it seems this is still not the 'good life' she longs for.
As the days passed, Rose Salt tried the life of an ordinary, rule-abiding operator, doing ordinary fieldwork and earning an ordinary wage. She has also tried returning to the life of a drifter in Iberia, assisting Rhodes Island by discreetly gathering intelligence, and occasionally earning a big wad of cash for her troubles. But after asking around, she has begun to show a keen interest in developed nations such as Columbia or Kazimierz. It is apparent that in her eyes, these two countries are lands of endless wealth. We are unsure where she picked up such notions, but she is convinced she will strike it rich there. To her, she is destined to join the upper echelons of moneyed society as a hyper-rich magnate of some sort, and finally live the true 'good life' of her dreams.
text.zh:
瑰盐干员最常挂在嘴边的话就是“我一定要过上好生活”，并且她也确实带着一大笔钱来到了罗德岛。
据说那是一次出色的任务所得到的报酬，她也用这笔钱给自己买了好看的衣服，亮闪闪的珠宝，还有各种各样她其实根本用不上的东西：用绸缎做的床边小榻、镶满碎钻的小镜，还有裙摆拖地的华丽长袍。
但她仍旧穿着平常的那身衣服，那些珠宝和华服她只是穿戴几次就放在一旁，因为她并不习惯这些繁复华丽的东西。绸缎小榻被用来堆放任务用品，碎钻小镜垫在行李下保证平衡，华丽的长袍披在床上当床单，剩下的东西全都满满当当地堆放在罗德岛分配的那间小小的宿舍里，光鲜亮丽地宣告着它们的存在。好像这样就是她想要的“好生活”。
此外，每月的工资刚一到手，除了给饭卡充上足够的钱，剩下的部分瑰盐也会很快地全花出去，换成各种她需要或者是不需要的漂亮玩意，把宿舍堆得越来越满，却又很少真正地穿戴打扮在身上。不知为何，相比于其他人买珠宝和衣服，用这些东西来装扮愉悦自己，瑰盐似乎只是享受将钱花出去，和拥有这些华美闪耀的东西的感觉。
瑰盐也有很多她很久之前收集的物品，那些东西都已经不再熠熠生辉，但她还是将它们好好地收起来。甚至在一次偶然的遗失后，瑰盐一路追到了垃圾存放站，这才把那些已经不再华丽的东西找了回来。好像她所在意的也不是这些东西的外表，而是“拥有”它们。
不过，这似乎还不是瑰盐想要拥有的“好生活”。
在后来的日子里，瑰盐干员尝试过规规矩矩地做一个普通的干员，出普通的外勤，挣工资；也尝试过回到伊比利亚四处游荡，为罗德岛打探情报，偶尔挣一笔大钱；在四处打听之后，她开始对哥伦比亚和卡西米尔这样发达的国家非常感兴趣。虽然不知道她是怎么得出的结论，但这两个地方在她心中似乎有着无尽的财富，而她的未来一定会在这些地方挣大钱，成为一个超级富豪，过上她心目中真正的“好生活”。

text.en:
When she first arrived on Rhodes Island, Rose Salt introduced herself with a bevy of cloyingly cute nicknames in order to maintain her cutesy persona. These sickly-sweet names include, but are not limited to, 'Peludita', 'Little Pascy', 'Beautiful Lil' Viper', etc. Many operators, taken in by her charm, starting actually calling her by these names, satisfying her need for cuteness. But after more time together, nearly every operator has learned her true nature, and to get back at her for lying, they started breaking out these cloying nicknames whenever she exposes her true colors, such as when she tries to assert authority over her underlings—
'Peludita~'
'Little Pascy~'
'Beau~ti~ful~ Lil'~ Vi~per~'
'GAHHH! STOP CALLING ME THAT!'
text.zh:
刚来罗德岛的时候，瑰盐干员为了装可爱，自我介绍的时候会用各种可爱的小昵称来称呼自己，这些甜腻腻的名字包括但不限于“小毛毛”“小帕”“花花蝰”等等等等，不少干员一开始也满怀怜爱地用这些可爱的小昵称来称呼她，满足她提出的各种各样的需求。相处久了，几乎每位干员都知晓了瑰盐的真面目，为了小小地报复一下当初的欺骗，干员们会突然甜腻腻地用这些名字来叫正在凶神恶煞本性毕露处理事情的瑰盐，比如，她正在和手下立威的时候——
“小毛毛~”
“小帕~”
“花~花~蝰~”
“啊！不许再这么叫我！！！！”

value.en: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected by medical examination.
value.zh: 体表有源石结晶分布，参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected by medical examination.
infectionStatus.zh: 体表有源石结晶分布，参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

text.en: Tecno is a member of Dossoles's street art community who became involved in the terrorist attack on the Galería Krysztauowa. Exposed to large amounts of Originium dust during the incident, her infection worsened and she was introduced to Rhodes Island for treatment by Operator Tequila. Once her condition stabilized, she decided to join us. After passing the relevant training courses and tests, she now resides in Dossoles as a field operator.
text.zh: 特克诺，多索雷斯街头艺术社区成员，曾卷入克里斯达尔艺术馆的恐怖袭击事件，因暴露于大量源石粉尘之中，感染加重。经干员龙舌兰介绍，特克诺来到罗德岛寻求医疗援助。病情稳定后，她主动提出加入罗德岛。现已通过相关培训和测试，作为外勤干员常驻于多索雷斯。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 7%
There are distinct, visible Originium crystals on the surface of Operator Tecno's skin.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.23u/L
Although Tecno sees her own infection as an accident, a statistical analysis of the street art community's Infected leads us to believe this is no mere 'misfortune'. There is a never-ending encroachment on their living space by the harsh, uncaring environment surrounding it, leading to a vicious cycle. Thankfully, the 'Papá' she always mentions appears to be taking our environmental safety assessment seriously, and has begun taking steps to rectify the issue.
—A Medical Operator
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】7%
干员特克诺体表可见明显源石结晶。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.23u/L
虽然特克诺将自己的感染视作意外，但统计了街头艺术社区感染者的数据后，我们认为这并非单纯的“不幸”或是“偶然”。恶劣的外部环境不断侵害社区成员的生存状态，形成恶性循环。所幸特克诺常挂在嘴边的那位“老爹”对罗德岛出具的环境安全检测报告表现出了充分的重视，现已开始着手整改。
——医疗部干员

text.en:
According to reports from many operators, spray-paint graffiti has recently been popping up all over the landship: the metal walls of the corridors, the tables in the cafeteria, the mirrors in public restrooms, etc. Nowhere seems to be safe. Inquisitive operators asked Closure to check the security tapes, hoping to find the 'artiste' behind it. While skimming the tapes, they noticed a small puppet holding a can of spray paint and toddling through a corridor. As they leaned in to see what it would do, the little rascal leaped at the camera, making even the veteran operators scream. They did not dare investigate further. Undeterred, Closure checked the rest of the tapes in her free time. According to her, the trouble-making puppet is good at playing to the camera and has a solid sense of rhythm, and she claims the video of it she put together is a cut above Wrankwood's latest horror movies.
A few days later, the warden of the sickbays, who rarely ever leaves Medical, passed by a gaggle of rubberneckers admiring one of the latest 'masterpieces'. She immediately recognized the art style, and skillfully herded the street artists headed by Tecno to the corridor in question. After the eye-catching yet unruly youths obediently cleaned up the wall, the warden gave each of them discharge papers. Ever since, the plague of graffiti has died down.
Though Tecno has given Medical a number of headaches, she also brings smiles and laughter to the other patients, especially the children. During her first stint in the ward, she drew a small cartoon on a child's plaster cast to help him sleep after his traumatic experience in a Catastrophe. Her second time around, she took apart a ward lamp and added a mechanism to make it float. Whenever the serious-faced warden made her rounds, the lamp would cast shadows resembling a pair of adorable fowlbeast wings floating behind her, distracting any children scared of needles.
Recently, a boy with the broken arm was reluctant to part with Tecno's drawing, refusing to allow us to break open the cast. During this tense situation, Tecno had a rare serious moment and told the boy about the role of destruction and reconstruction in art theory, stunning him into silence. By the time he came to his senses, the cast was already off. Before he left Rhodes Island, Tecno gave him a small sculpture she fashioned out of bits of plaster. Of course, the actual plaster cast had already been disposed of as medical waste, so her souvenir was a mock-up cast she made herself. After redrawing her cartoon, she shattered it to make the piece.
Her brash exterior may lead to misunderstandings, but I believe that when all's said and done, her sincere approach towards both art and other people lets her get along very well with pretty much anyone.
—The sickbay warden
text.zh:
据多名干员报告反馈，最近罗德岛舰船上总能见到怪异的喷绘图案——走廊的金属墙上，食堂餐桌的桌面，公共盥洗室的镜面……仿佛无处不在。好奇心旺盛的干员请求可露希尔调取监控录像，试图揪出始作俑者。屏幕中，一个拿着喷漆罐的小木偶摇摇晃晃地走过通道，正当众人等待着它的下一步举动时，小人倏地跃向屏幕，把一群老练的干员吓得吱哇乱叫，再也不敢探寻真相。可露希尔倒是利用闲暇时间看完了所有录像。据她所言，这个捣乱的小木偶颇具镜头意识和节奏感，将片段剪辑在一起的成品比近几年蓝卡坞出品的恐怖电影更胜一筹。
后来某天，鲜少离开医疗部的病房负责人路过被人围观的案发现场，她一眼认出了墙上的“杰作”，颇为熟练地拉来以特克诺为首的街头艺术家们。在这群打扮惹眼、性格乖张的年轻人乖乖打扫完墙面后，负责人送了他们一人一张出院小结，事态这才平息下来。
虽然特克诺给医疗部添了不少麻烦，但她也为其他病人，尤其是孩子们带去了不少欢笑。住院第一周，特克诺用一幅画在石膏臂上的小漫画安抚了一名在天灾中受到过度惊吓难以入眠的孩子。第二周，她拆了病房的台灯，改造成悬浮的发光装置——那位不苟言笑的负责人来查房时，装置会在她身后的墙上投映出一对可爱的羽兽翅膀，害怕打针的孩子也会变得配合一些。
前段时间，那名骨折的男孩舍不得特克诺的画，不让我们拆石膏。正犯愁时，特克诺难得严肃地对那个男孩说了一通破坏与重构之类的艺术理论，把他唬得一愣一愣的。等男孩反应过来，石膏已经清理完了。男孩离开罗德岛前，特克诺送了他一座用石膏碎片拼成的小雕像。当然，拆除的石膏已经作为医疗废弃物处理掉了，这个小纪念品是特克诺自行灌注石膏，重绘了漫画之后再砸碎制作的。
特克诺张扬的外表或许会招致一些误会，但我相信最终她能跟大部分人相处得很好，因为无论是对作品还是对人，她都十分真诚。
——病房负责人

text.en:
While sorting out information on onboarding operators, an HR operator spotted a familiar figure in a years-old Dossoles newspaper: a young girl with red hair wearing a breezy dress, looking bashfully at the camera. The article was titled 'Brilliant New Star of the Arts: Durin Beauty Leaves Home to Chase Her Dreams.' Tecno, sitting in the office at the time, snatched the newspaper clipping, shaking as she gripped it so hard her knuckles turned white, her face beet-red. After calming down, she decided to tell us about her years in Dossoles, if only to prevent HR from learning of it elsewhere and spreading rumors of her 'dark past'.
Unable to find anyone in her underground hometown who shared her aesthetic sensibilities, she left in a huff before unintentionally finding herself in Dossoles. Perhaps due to how rare Durins were there, the local TV station immediately jumped in for an interview, while also taking videos of her puppet shows. This interview was distilled into the newspaper article which made it onto the front page. 'Smooth sailing? Not really. The TV guys took out any mention of the art I was REALLY proud of. Said it was too niche, and wouldn't be good for ratings. If I listened to them, what would have been the point of leaving home?' She refused their package plan, instead devoting herself to her own art, but just as she was preparing for a solo exhibition, she was swindled out of all her savings.
Standing out in the street in her darkest hour, she was helped by a stranger. He brought her to the local art community, introducing her to the vibrant neighborhood artists. After seeing her puppetry, they joined her in mocking the TV station for being unable to recognize true talent. One after another they asked if she wanted to incorporate any other elements into her performance. Some independent artists even offered their latest works as background music.
The community Tecno found herself in lived hard lives. Homes that violated every regulation as they teetered on the brink of collapse, electric cables criss-crossing through the air, piles of garbage no-one wanted to deal with... Pretty much everything was a safety hazard of some sort. The street artists were poor, malnourished, and lacking in sleep. Many nights, Tecno would find herself drinking with her friends under an awning, shouting to high heaven how they didn't want to do art ever again. After sobering up, they would return to their ateliers, darkrooms and workshops, revising their current projects. Even in these forgotten corners of the city, they would refine the art they so loved, trying to bring out its inner shine.
However, this was Dossoles, after all. The power and profit they struggled against had always 'cared' about this plot of land no-one else did. She and her friends were doomed to be drawn into that thorny affair, and found themselves forced to take up arms in resistance.
text.zh:
整理入职干员信息时，人事部干员从多年前的一期多索雷斯报纸上看到了熟悉的身影——一名红发少女穿着轻飘飘的背带长裙，颇为腼腆地注视着镜头，报道标题为《为梦出走的杜林美少女，才华横溢的新人艺术家》。特克诺坐在办公室里，捏报纸的手指颤抖着，关节发白，面色通红。情绪稳定之后，为了避免人事部去别处求证，让这桩“黑历史”为更多人所知，她主动陈述了自己早年在多索雷斯的经历。
特克诺在地下城无法找到拥有相同艺术审美的伙伴，负气出走，误打误撞来到了多索雷斯。或许是杜林人在当地十分少见，多索雷斯电视台采访了特克诺，并拍摄了木偶表演的视频，后来采访内容还被撰成新闻报道，甚至登上了重要版面。“顺风顺水？呵，电视台的家伙们删去了我真正得意的作品，他们认为那种艺术表现方式太‘小众’，无法获得收视率。我要是会听从他们的建议，那一开始我根本就不会离开地下城。”特克诺回绝了电视台的包装企划，全情投入艺术创作，却在筹备个人艺术展时遭遇诈骗，被人卷走了所有存款。
心灰意冷的她在街头得到一名陌生人的帮助。他将特克诺带到艺术社区，向她介绍社区中形形色色的艺术创作者。在欣赏了特克诺的木偶表演后，众人一齐唾骂电视台有眼无珠，并纷纷询问特克诺是否愿意在木偶表演中加入其他元素，甚至有独立音乐人愿将自己的新作送给特克诺做背景音乐。
特克诺落脚的社区，生活条件十分糟糕。摇摇欲坠的违章建筑，混乱不堪的电网排线，无人处理的大型垃圾……到处都有安全隐患。街头艺术家们贫穷、瘦弱，总是没完没了地熬夜。许多夜晚，特克诺和这群朋友聚在遮雨棚下喝酒，大喊再也不要搞艺术了，酒醒之后又回到各自的画室、暗房、工作间里去，修改作品的细节。即使在被人遗忘的角落，他们还在打磨自己热爱的事物，试图让它们焕发光芒。
然而这里毕竟还是多索雷斯，权力和利益的斗争时刻“关心”着看似无人问津的地皮。特克诺和她的朋友们势必会卷进更麻烦的事态之中，被迫做出反抗。

text.en:
The report Operator Tequila submitted on the Galería Krysztauowa incident was rather carefully worded. The whims of a rich Kazimierzian businessman, the restless Bolívarian Coalition Government representative, and the Dossoles government watching from the sidelines. Their fight over the lot intensified, bringing disaster to the street artist community and opening ceremony audience alike. Tecno and the other artists who took part in the incident came to Rhodes Island for medical treatment afterwards. They were no hardened mercenaries, and paid a heavy price during their rescue and resistance operations. After Tecno formally became a Rhodes Island operator, the Archives Department suggested an interview, hoping they would be able to hear about the incident from her point of view. The following is an audio clip from that interview:
'Taking down those soldiers wasn't easy, not to mention the Originium explosives they had hidden in the gallery. We all wanted to give those bastards what they deserved after they put us to siege, but our bodies wouldn't listen. Even I was a bit shaky using my staff to control my puppets.
'The moment they hit the roof, everyone jumped at Mateo. He never thought a bunch of starving artists like us could be so strong. Reynell had blood all over his face, but was in high spirits when he saw that brute pinned down against the floor. That's when I realized he never planned on leaving alive. But bringing down the gallery and all those people with him... I couldn't let him do that.
'My two puppets were busted, but my friends and I had made inflatable versions of the same size to help with the choreography. Before that whole mess, we'd only wanted to protest in the plaza, so we brought the inflatables along too, with Reynell's stupid face scribbled on them. The moment the blast started rushing out the vents, Papá and I grabbed Reynell by the shoulders and jumped down. But it turns out you can't use any old inflatable as a proper landing pad.
'His little manservant dude thanked us, and I think he wanted to explain why he did something so stupid, but I kinda tuned him out when he started going on about a 'complicated family situation.' If Reynell considers himself an artist, he should be putting that resentment into his art, not getting other people to talk about it for him.
'A musician friend of mine got too caught up in the stuff happening in the gallery, didn't make it out in time to save his ears. The explosion messed up his hearing for good. I dunno, maybe if we'd had seasoned mercs to climb to the balcony instead of us, we wouldn't have taken so much damage. Maybe if Reynell had had an actual friend to give him a good hard slap, he wouldn't have done something so stupid.'
text.zh:
龙舌兰干员提交的克里斯达尔艺术馆行动报告，用词颇为谨慎。卡西米尔富商的一时兴起，玻利瓦尔联合政府代表的蠢蠢欲动，还有多索雷斯市政府的作壁上观，关于地皮的争夺愈演愈烈，殃及了街头艺术社区的居民和开幕式的观众。特克诺和其他参与行动的艺术家们在事件之后来到罗德岛治疗，他们并非训练有素的雇佣兵，在救援和对抗中付出了不小的代价。特克诺成为罗德岛正式干员后，档案部门提出面谈申请，希望特克诺能从她的视角描述事件经过。以下是该次面谈的部分语音资料。
“放倒那群军人可不是容易的事，更别提艺术馆里还藏着一堆源石爆炸物。社区被那帮混蛋围攻之后，大家多少有些力不从心，我用法杖操纵木偶时也有些发抖。
“冲上天台的时候，大家一齐扑到马特奥身上。他估计想不到，我们这群有时连饭都吃不饱的艺术家能有这么大力气。雷内尔，那家伙满头是血还兴致勃勃地看着马特奥被压制在地的样子，我从那时候就知道他根本没想活着离开。但他打算拉这么多人和艺术馆陪葬，我可不能让他如愿。
“那对木偶确实被烧毁了，不过我跟伙伴们做过两个等比例的充气模型用来确定动线。摊上这些糟心事之前，我们只是想来广场示威，就把模型带了过来，还画上了雷内尔苦兮兮的脸。爆炸的气浪冲出排气口的瞬间，我和老爹同时抓住雷内尔的肩膀跳了下去。充气人偶比起专业缓冲垫还是差了点。
“雷内尔的小跟班向我表示感谢，他似乎想为雷内尔愚蠢透顶的行为解释什么，但刚讲到雷内尔的复杂的家庭状况，我就不想听了。如果他还自认为是一名艺术家，那他的不满就应该用作品，而不是别人的嘴来表达。
“我的一名音乐家朋友因为担心馆内的情况没有及时撤离，爆炸对他的听觉产生了不可逆的影响。我不知道，如果登上阳台的不是我们而是老练的雇佣兵，社区受到的损失是不是会小一些。又或者如果雷内尔有一个能真正理解他的朋友，是否会给他一巴掌，让他清醒一点别做蠢事。”

text.en:
A few months later, our investigators revisited the artist community. Tecno would hand out medication to the Infected alongside the branch office operators, and often ran into members of the community who took protection lightly. She would then use her small puppets to step on their feet until they were able to recite her fierce warnings fluently. Everyone she met was surprised by the changes they noticed in her. Though she was as prickly and blunt as ever when talking about art, she had started to see her situation in a new light ever since the Galería Krysztauowa incident. Before, she had never cared about her physical condition, always prioritizing her creations, even sharing the unfortunately common view that her affliction made her a better, more expressive, artist. 'After I got infected, I never really treated Oripathy as anything special. All it meant was my career would be a bit shorter compared to others. But facing death in the eye isn't the same as welcoming it. I had slowly forgotten that after being infected for so long. I don't think burning your life away for your art is something to be praised for. Ever since the explosion at Galería Krysztauowa, every time I hear an Infected in our neighborhood say something that, I can't help but think of Reynell's face, wallowing in all that self-pity.'
During her treatment on Rhodes Island, Tecno learned many of the sordid details from Operator Tequila. Her forceful personality can make her hard to handle, but fortunately Ernesto has experience communicating with people like her. 'Reynell gave the gallery and the rights to the land to Papá before he left, but the military and the moneygrubbers still won't let things go. As long as the neighborhood is considered part of Dossoles, they'll still be able to meddle with it.' In the wake of the Krysztauowa incident, artists have left one after the other. But despite the manpower shortage as the community rebuilds itself, Diaz and Tecno have never tried to stop them.
'Whenever anyone leaves, they always leave behind the piece they're most satisfied with. A parting gift for the simple shelter. While we're cleaning up all this garbage and burnt walls, we moved those pieces out of the neighborhood, just temporarily. It was enough to fill two whole streets, and tourists from the business district came over to look at the pretty colors, cramming themselves into our little alleyways. Then my friends wanted to scratch their creative itch, so they picked up their spray cans and gave the business district a good makeover. Sure, they didn't make it ten minutes before security chased them away, but what's that got to do with anything? The point is, who says we can only make art on our own turf?
'Even after living in Dossoles for so long, I only recently got to know the rhythm of the city. What have I been doing this whole time? I want to go with Rhodes Island to see every corner of Terra, see the local street art. Maybe one day I'll head back to that underground city, share my experiences with the guys who voted against me back then. But if they're still going to vote a thousand to one after hearing music from all over the land, then whatever! I don't care! Okay, maybe I care a little... Guess I'm still a bit angry... Let's save that for later. I've still got a long art career ahead of me!'
text.zh:
几个月后，调查干员重访艺术社区，特克诺站在办事处干员之中为感染者们分发药物，每每碰到把防护不当回事的成员，她就会指使自己的小木偶猛踩对方的脚，直到那人把特克诺言辞激烈的叮嘱背得滚瓜烂熟为止。他们对于特克诺的改变十分意外。虽然聊起创作时，特克诺还是谁也不服、直来直去的样子，但克里斯达尔事件之后，她对于自己的处境似乎有了新的认知。过去特克诺并不在意自己的身体状况，总是将创作放在第一位，甚至像很多感染者艺术家一样，认为病痛更有利于艺术表达。“感染之后，我从未把矿石病当作一种特殊的病症，无非就是与其他艺术家相比，我的创作生涯会更短一些。不过，直面死亡不等于期待死亡，染病太久会逐渐忘记这一点。在我看来，以消磨生命为代价创作作品并非值得称道的事。尤其是克里斯达尔艺术馆爆炸之后，但凡听到社区里有感染者表达类似的想法，我就会克制不住地想起雷内尔那张自怨自艾的脸。”
在罗德岛接受治疗的这段时间，特克诺向龙舌兰干员了解了不少内情。她咄咄逼人的语气让大多数人难以招架，还好埃内斯托非常习惯此类谈话。“雷内尔走之前把这块地和艺术馆都转让给了老爹，不过军方和商人都不会善罢甘休的。只要这个社区还属于多索雷斯，他们就有插手的空间。”克里斯达尔事件后，一些艺术家陆续离开。尽管社区重建的人手严重不足，但迪亚兹老爹和特克诺并未劝阻他们。
“大家走的时候都留下了自己最满意的作品，作为献给这片简陋庇护所的礼物。为了清理建筑垃圾和烧焦的墙面，我们把这些作品暂时挪出社区，放满了两条外街。商业区的游客被鲜活的色彩吸引，拐进小巷子里。心痒的朋友重新拿起喷罐在商业区的墙上作画，虽然不出十分钟就会被保安追得四处乱窜，但那有什么关系呢？谁规定我们只能在自己的地盘上搞艺术？
“在多索雷斯待了那么久，直到最近才摸到这座城市的节律，已经是失职了。我要跟着罗德岛到泰拉各地看看，了解他们的街头艺术风格。或许有一天我会回到地下城，与当时投票表决的那群人分享自己的见闻，要是他们了解完各种音乐风格重新投票后还是投了个一千比一出来，我也不在乎啦！不……好像还是会有些生气……这些都是后话，反正我的艺术生涯还长着呢！”

text.en: 'Four rounds, no less.' 'Bet or not—it'll be settled in three. The Doctor likes cute things more than anything.' 'Really? Seems to me like the Doctor isn't that picky. Never seemed even a little interested in—Whoa! Tecno's getting pat on the head! Normally she'd hit you if you called her a kid, even as a joke!' 'What a sweet smile, befitting an idol about to make her debut.' 'Where'd you hear that from?' 'A friend in HR told me. But keep it between us, yeah?' 'What're you two chatting about? The Doctor didn't scold us for the damage we caused during the mission, and your vacation got approved too.' 'Knew you could do it, Tecno. I'll admit, I had my doubts when you first said you'd handle it.' 'Just a little trick I've used on Papá plenty of times. Picked it up real quick.' 'That fawning—err, acting was pretty much perfect.' 'Hehe~' 'But what about those rosy eartips I saw? Can you control that too?' 'Er, just a talent us Durins have.' 'But I heard from Myrtle that—' 'How about I go up to the Doctor right now and say you've decided to forfeit your leave? And also that you volunteered to model for the oil painting society in eight hours.' 'I heard nothing from nobody.' 'Good.'
text.zh:
“四个回合，不能再少了。”
“赌不赌，三回合内一定能搞定，博士最喜欢可爱的东西了。”
“真的吗？我怎么觉得博士怪不挑的，没啥特别喜欢……哇，特克诺被摸头了！平时我们开玩笑叫她一句小朋友都会被揍啊！”
“笑得好甜，不愧是差点出道的艺术偶像。”
“咦，你从哪儿听说的？”
“人事部的朋友告诉我的，别说漏嘴啊。”
“你们聊什么呢？博士没有计较这次任务造成的损失，假期也批下来了。”
“不愧是特克诺啊，一开始你说能搞定我还有些怀疑来着。”
“这招我都对老爹用了多少次了，信手拈来。”
“这撒娇——啊不，演技真是炉火纯青。”
“哼哼~”
“可是耳朵尖的颜色也能控制吗？”
“咳，这是杜林人的天赋。”
“但我之前听桃金娘说——”
“我现在就去告诉博士，你自愿放弃休假的权利，并主动要求担当油画兴趣小组的模特，八小时起步。”
“不信谣，不传谣，我什么都没听到。”
“很好。”

value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Confirmed Infected by medical examination.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

text.en: Contrail, a flying adventurer from Columbia. She travels extensively to conduct test flights, and is very knowledgeable when it comes to developing and improving flight equipment. She has come to Rhodes Island for Oripathy treatment, and provides technical support for Engineering's motorized equipment R&D projects.
text.zh: 云迹，出生于哥伦比亚的飞行冒险家，为进行飞行实验而旅居各地，对于飞行动力装备的开发与改良颇有心得，如今为治疗矿石病来到罗德岛，并为罗德岛工程部的机动装置研发项目提供技术支持。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 4%
Operator Contrail's infection is relatively mild.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.17u/L
Due to conducting test flights out in the wilds over a long period of time, Operator Contrail comes into contact with Originium rather frequently. Thankfully, she is more conscientious about protective measures than the average person, and there are currently no signs of her infection worsening. However, she still requires close observation.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】4%
干员云迹的感染状况较轻微。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.17u/L
因长期在野外进行飞行实验，干员云迹接触源石较为频繁。好在本人有较强的防护意识，目前未发现病情有进一步恶化的迹象，但仍需密切观察。

text.en: Contrail is not too good with social interaction, more used to being alone than part of a crowd. This is why when she first joined Rhodes Island, most only knew her as a new face. Few knew her name or what department she was attached to, let alone her interests or her past. The first time she managed to make a deep impression on the others was during an ordinary meeting. At the time, the landship's guide signs were being updated, and the Logistics operator in charge wanted to know if they were clear and easy to follow. Several operators were queried for their feedback, and as it happened the first operator asked was Contrail. 'All I wanted was to get the opinion of a newcomer first. I don't think she expected to be called up, and man was her face red as she stuttered and stammered. Couldn't understand a word she said, either. She just stood there... If it wasn't for someone else stepping in with their own feedback, I don't know how long that awkward moment would have gone on.' The next day, the project lead received a neatly-written document filled with detailed feedback, including many photos taken off the ship. Contrail mentioned these were all signs she saw during her travels, and included them as reference. There is another thing that gets our operators talking about Contrail. One day, an operator out on the deck for some fresh air raised their head and happened to see her flying overhead. 'At first, I thought my eyes were giving out, or I was in some crazy dream! At least, until I noticed it was Contrail. 'It's not that I think her flying skills are that crazy. It's just that the dawn light let me get a good look at her face, and, well, I've never seen her looking so comfy... I can tell she really loves flying.'
text.zh:
云迹不太擅长与人交际，比起和大家凑在一起，她更习惯独处。也正因如此，在云迹刚来罗德岛时，大家只知道来了个新面孔，极少有人知道她叫什么名字、分属于哪个部门，更遑论了解她的兴趣爱好和她的过往了。
云迹第一次给干员们留下深刻的印象是在一次例会上。那时，舰船内的引路标识牌翻新了，后勤部的相关负责人为了确认标识是否清晰好记，准备点几个干员反馈意见，可偏偏第一个点到的就是云迹。
“哎，我就是想先问问新来的干员的体验。她估计也没想到自己会被点名发言，脸瞬间涨得通红，支支吾吾的，我也没搞懂她在说什么，然后她就那么干站着——要不是旁边的人主动发言提了意见，我都不知道那窘迫的场面要持续多久。”
不过，第二天，负责人便收到了一份字迹工整、内容详实的意见书，里面附带了许多实地拍摄的照片——云迹在意见书中提及，这些都是她在各地旅行时见到的交通引导标识，仅供参考。
而有关云迹的另一件事，则成了干员们议论的热门话题。某日，一位干员跑到甲板上放风，抬头竟看到云迹正从他的头顶飞过。
“当我看到是云迹飞在半空中的时候，我还以为是我眼花了，或者我其实睡着了，只是在做一场不可思议的梦！
“我并不是觉得她的飞行技术不可思议，只是晨光照亮了她的脸庞，我从未见过她露出那样自在的神情……我能感受到，她真的在享受飞行。”

text.en:
Contrail was born in a Columbian nomadic city. Her parents were biologists by trade, and often had to travel all across Terra to observe wild animals in their natural habitat, with the young Contrail in tow. She was an extremely timid child, though. Even the footsteps of burdenbeasts were enough to make her cry. Her parents would call for her to join them in observation, but all she wanted to do was to stay in the tent by herself. She recoiled in the face of everything, and was deeply uninquisitive. Despite her parents' best efforts to provide her with an encouraging education, she remained so. But they always believed that one day, their daughter would find something she truly loves.
She eventually did, as they expected, but the experience that led to it is incredibly hard to believe.
It was a perfectly normal morning. Her parents had just finished their nighttime observation, and returned to their tent to find Contrail missing. In a panic, they searched everywhere for her, only to raise their heads and see her up in the sky. She was being held aloft in the beak of a gigantic fowlbeast, 'soaring' through the sky.
'Mom and Dad were out of their minds with worry waiting for it to set me down, but I was having the time of my life... I'd never felt that excited before.
'I remember being really scared when it picked me up, so scared I forgot to close my eyes. Then I saw those scary trees and ferocious beasts shrink until they were smaller than my finger. I saw the sun and the clouds get closer and closer. I saw where the barrens stopped being the barrens, where they turned into prairies and villages...
'Without really thinking about it, I opened up my arms and started swaying them back and forth... just like a fowlbeast.'
From that day onwards, the girl loved the sky.
text.zh:
云迹出生在哥伦比亚的一座移动城市中，父母都从事与生物研究相关的工作，他们经常要实地考察野生动物的栖息地，因此云迹从小就总是跟着父母各国各地到处跑。不过那时的云迹非常胆小，就连驮兽的踏蹄声都能把她吓哭，父母叫她一起去观察动物，她却只想独自待在帐篷里——面对对任何事情都畏缩害怕、兴味索然的云迹，即便她的父母始终采取鼓励式教育，也鲜少得到有效的回应。但他们始终相信，他们的女儿总有一天会找寻到自己真正热爱的事物。
正如他们所想，兴趣的产生总是水到渠成，只不过云迹的经历的确令人难以置信。
那是一个寻常的早晨，父母刚结束夜间监测工作，返回帐篷却发现云迹不见了。正当他们焦急地到处寻找时，抬眼却望见她在空中——云迹正被一只大型羽兽衔着，在空中“翱翔”。
“等羽兽把我送回地面，爸爸妈妈都吓坏了，但我却很兴奋……从未有过的兴奋。
“我记得刚被叼走时，我特别害怕，甚至忘记了闭上眼睛。我看到那些我害怕的丑陋树木与凶猛野兽都渐渐变得比手指还小，我看到太阳与白云离我越来越近，我看到荒野的尽头终于不再是荒野，而是村庄和草原……
“然后自然而然地，我也张开了双臂，缓缓摆动……就像羽兽一样。”
从那以后，女孩便爱上了天空。

text.en:
...
Short-range test flight No. 29:
Although the hang glider still can't handle changes in airflow during emergency situations, overall performance is as expected. This means I can start doing long-distance test flights next.
It's no surprise that Mom and Dad found out about my decision. They know how hard I worked for this day, so even the smallest breakthrough makes them happy for me.
I explained every detail of my plan to them. I'm not going to fly from rooftop to rooftop like before. This time, I'm looking to fly over a small hill.
I saw how they were worried for me, but...
I'm serious when it comes to flying. I'm pulling out all the stops.

Test flight No. 1:
I've picked the date for the test. If the weather is agreeable, I'll be flying just after sunrise.

(Below is a stretch of blank space, and the following page has been torn out.)

It's been six months since the accident, and here I am, opening this notebook again.
I've finally managed to find time to stop and think, in between the Oripathy treatments and rehab. To think about what the test flights—or rather, flying—really mean to me.
I remember lying in the mud, unable to move. The calm tone Mom used to comfort me between her sobs, telling me my legs would be fine. I also remember how Dad looked, trying everything he could to get in touch with an Oripathy specialist out in the wilds... Don't tell me all my first test flight got me was a broken body and a heartbroken family?
I have to admit, this was my first big failure. My hang glider's completely wrecked, too... But I won't forget how those broken wings saved me when I needed them the most.
Mom and Dad have occasionally been mentioning the weather to me lately, along with any new fowlbeast habitats they discovered. I know they're trying to cheer me up. They've always supported my decisions, even if they're quiet about it.
I...
I'm still thinking about soaring through the sky.

Test flight No. 2:
After 439 days, it's time to restart the test flights.
...
—Excerpt from Contrail's test flight records

At first, it was hard for us to believe that the 'flying adventurer' and the meek girl in front of us were one and the same. But upon reading these flight records, and seeing the thick stack of high-altitude photos she would have had to brave treacherous conditions to take, we couldn't deny that Contrail is an adventurer worthy of our respect.
text.zh:
……
第二十九次短距离飞行测试：
……滑翔翼虽在应对气流变化等紧急情况时仍有不足，但总体表现符合预期。这也意味着接下来我将正式开启长距离飞行实验。
爸爸妈妈得知我的决定并不意外。他们知道我为了这一天付出了怎样的心血，所以但凡我取得一丁点儿突破，他们都会为我高兴。
我向他们详细地讲解了我的规划。我不再像以前一样，只是从一个楼顶飞向另一个楼顶——这回，我的目标是飞越一座小山丘。
我看出他们在为我担忧，但……
对于飞行这件事，我一定会认真对待、全力以赴的。

第一次飞行实验：
选好了实验日期，如果届时天气状况满足飞行条件，我将于日出后起飞。

（下面是大段的空白，之后有纸页被撕去的痕迹。）

事故已经过去六个月了，我再次打开了这个笔记本。
在治疗矿石病、进行康复训练的这段日子里，我终于能够停下来好好思考——飞行实验，或者说飞行对我而言到底意味着什么。
我记得那时我落在泥地中动弹不得，妈妈急得声音都带上了哭腔，却还是强装镇定地安慰我，告诉我我的腿不会有事。我也还记得爸爸想方设法在荒郊野岭里为我联络矿石病医生时的神情……难道我的第一次飞行实验，带给我的只有身体的创伤与对家人的愧疚吗？
我必须承认这是一次重大的失败，我的滑翔翼也彻底毁坏了……但我不会忘记，这折断的羽翼在最危急的时刻，成了我的救命绳索。
最近，爸爸妈妈偶尔会跟我提起天气，也会聊他们新发现的羽兽栖息地——我知道他们也希望我振作起来，他们总是默默支持我的每一个决定。
我……
我当然还想，继续飞翔。

第二次飞行实验：
时隔439天，重启飞行实验。
……
——摘自云迹的飞行实验记录

起初，我们很难将“飞行冒险家”这个称号与面前这个总是怯生生的少女联系起来。但当我们看到这份飞行实验记录，还有那厚厚一沓显然需要亲临险境才能拍摄下来的高空风景照片时，我们不可否认，云迹的确是一位令人钦佩的冒险者。

text.en:
Autumn Year 1, we flew from western Columbia to Siesta;
Spring Year 2, we set off from Siesta, flying across Victoria to eastern Rim Billiton;
Autumn Year 2, we're ready to return, flying from Rim Billiton to Siesta;
Spring Year 3, return to Columbia, migration complete.
—In a notebook's title page, a child notes down her dreams.

Ever since their daughter showed a deep interest in flight, Contrail's parents shifted their topic of research to wild fowlbeasts. They led her on fowlbeast observations, following these free-wheeling creatures as they migrated. While she helped her parents in their observational research, she also began studying flight dynamics, continuing her studies into university. Through her own efforts, she managed to upgrade a portable flight device to be capable of short flights alongside flying fowlbeasts.
Contrail continues to perform test flights all over Terra to realize her dream of long-distance flight all the sooner, and Rhodes Island has become the platform from which she can chase her dreams. The Engineering operators are already used to the odd ideas she would occasionally propose—for example, adding colored smoke bombs to her flight device's nozzles, or making the joints of her Originium air thrusters magnetic... In short, whenever she sequesters herself in a workshop to tinker in silence, everyone knows she's figured out where she wants to fly to next.
It's true that achieving her dream will not be easy, but no matter how many times she stumbles, Contrail always picks herself back up again, facing the storm before her without a hint of fear. Perhaps one day, she will finally be able to accompany the flocks of fowlbeasts as they migrate across Terra, just like how they accompanied her when she was young.

[Clip from a wildlife documentary]
Changes to the environment caused by Catastrophes and human activity are never-ending, and we have noted that the migratory patterns of wild animals change along with them. A farflyer fowl's migration is a typical example. For the past few centuries, it was very rare to see them outside of Columbia and Siesta, but in recent years, researchers have found traces of them migrating, nesting, and breeding in places such as Victoria and Rim Billiton.
The reason we never stop observing their migratory routes is because migration is an inevitability for humanity as well. Conflicts, Catastrophes, poverty... Because of this, we can understand, even sympathize with the fowlbeasts. They may go, but they promise they will return.
text.zh:
第一年秋天，我们要从哥伦比亚西部飞到汐斯塔；
第二年春天，从汐斯塔出发，途经维多利亚，飞到雷姆必拓东部；
第二年秋天，准备返程，再从雷姆必拓飞回汐斯塔；
第三年春天，回归哥伦比亚，最终完成迁徙。
——在笔记本的扉页，一个孩子记下了自己的梦想

自从女儿对飞行产生了浓厚的兴趣，云迹的父母便将研究彻底转向野生羽兽的领域，带领着云迹观察羽兽，跟随这些自由的生灵迁徙旅居。云迹在帮助父母进行观测研究的同时，也开始学习飞行动力学相关的知识，考入大学进修，终于在自己的努力下，改良出了一款能够短时间陪伴羽兽飞行的便携飞行动力装置。
如今云迹为了能早日实现长距离飞行，仍然在各地进行着一次次飞行实验，而罗德岛也成为她继续追逐理想的平台。工程部干员们已经习惯了云迹时不时提来的怪点子——比如给飞行装置的喷桶加装一个彩色烟雾弹，或者是把她的源石动力空气炮的连接处改成磁吸式……总之，每当她把自己关在工坊里闷头鼓捣，大家就知道，她已经想好下次要去哪里飞了。
诚然，实现梦想的过程绝不可能一帆风顺，但狠狠跌过跤的云迹总会再抬起头，毫不畏惧地面对眼前的风暴。或许终有一天，她能够陪伴羽兽群完成横跨泰拉大地的长途迁徙，一如童年时，羽兽陪伴她起飞一样。

【野生动物纪录片片段】
……由天灾与人类活动导致的环境变化从未休止，我们注意到野生动物的迁徙路线也在随之改变。远羽兽的迁徙是一个较为典型的案例。在过去的数百年间，我们极少在哥伦比亚与汐斯塔以外的地区见到远羽兽的栖息地，但近几年来，一些研究者已经在维多利亚、雷姆必拓等地发现了它们迁徙、筑巢、繁衍的踪迹。
我们之所以从未停止关注野生动物的迁徙，是因为流离播越对于人类来说同样不可避免——战争，灾害，贫穷……正因如此我们才会懂得，亦能感同身受，这是一个关于归来的重要承诺。

text.en:
[Excerpts from a news tidbits section]
...This isn't the first tall building in the city this Zalak girl has conquered. We've received many eyewitness reports of her in places such as the amusement park's observation wheel and the school clock tower. We can't help but wonder, where will she take off from next? Hopefully her next flight will obey the city's traffic laws. Or better yet, I hope she doesn't catch a cold, so that her snot won't drip on my head.
—Excerpt from 'She jumps from atop the municipal building, but why?'

'That's right, we've pored over this photo, and we believe its authenticity to be up for debate.
'We know there are a lot of tall tales involving photos going around right now, and there are people trying to use blurry photos for their own ends. Some even try to pass off a log floating in a lake as a monster. So what if it's a UFO belching out steam? Call me when it starts throwing around money!'
—Excerpt from 'UFO? Expert's latest response'

'The girl flying above the forest with the fowlbeasts', 'Flying woman appears, leading fowlbeast flock' ...Many have heard similar rumors, and as much as we gasp in amazement at her fantastical feats and experiences, we should not forget that fowlbeasts flying in from foreign lands can harbor many horrific diseases. If you begin to experience any unusual symptoms, pay close attention to your health...
—Excerpt from 'Remember to stay far from these things, watch out for infectious diseases!'

We often see reports about Contrail in the news and various magazines, and most of the time, you won't know whether to laugh or sigh while reading them. We once asked her if these articles would affect her test flights. This was her response:
'Well... When I'm flying, I'm focused on what's in front of me.'
text.zh:
【花边新闻报道节选】
……这已经不是这位札拉克少女在本城征服的第一座大型建筑了。截至目前，本栏目已收到多条目击记录，地点涵盖了游乐园的摩天轮及学校的报时钟楼，我们不禁开始猜测，她的下一个起飞地点会是哪里？希望她在飞行时可以严格遵守本城的交通法规——更希望她不要感冒，免得我担心她的鼻涕会落在我头上。
——摘自《在市政大楼的楼顶纵身一跃，她是为了什么？》

“是的，我们的确有注意到这张照片，我认为它的真实性有待商榷。
“我们都知道现在很多照片经过了夸张处理，还有人刻意传播模糊不清的照片混淆视听，指着湖里的浮木说是水怪……这么想，在空中喷气的不明飞行物算什么？在空中撒钱的说不定更新鲜点！”
——摘自《不明飞行物？专家最新回应》

“和羽兽群一起飞越森林的女孩”“飞羽人现身，她为羽兽们领航”……相信很多人在坊间听过类似的传闻，在我们为她的壮举与奇幻经历惊叹之余，我们仍不应忽视，这些从其他地方飞来的羽兽，可能会携带多种可怕的病菌，一旦身体出现异常，你可能就要多加注意了……
——摘自《看到这样的场景记得远离，小心传染病！》

我们常在各种新闻、杂志上看到与云迹有关的报道，其中不乏这种令人哭笑不得的内容。我们曾问过云迹这些报道是否会对她的飞行实验造成影响，她这样回应我们的疑问——
“至少……在飞行的时候，我只会专注地看着我的前方。”

value.en: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected by medical examination.
value.zh: 体表有源石结晶分布，参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected by medical examination.
infectionStatus.zh: 体表有源石结晶分布，参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

text.en: Xanthos, former dockmaster and ferryman at the Delphi Canal in Athenius. Resigned after the relic exchange ceremony at the First Temple and was referred to Rhodes Island for Oripathy treatment by Operator Perfumer, providing services as a Guard Operator.
text.zh: 赞索斯，移动城市雅赛努斯中特尔斐运河的前任渡口管理者，河流的摆渡人。在第一神殿的文物交换仪式之后辞去了这一职务，经干员调香师介绍来到罗德岛接受矿石病的治疗，以近卫干员的身份为罗德岛提供服务。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 18%
High level of infection, clear signs of Originium infection on his forearm.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.41u/L
Infection has entered mid-stage with clear signs of spreading. Timely treatment at Rhodes Island has been able to keep his condition under control, to an extent.

Operator Varkáris's condition is serious: in addition to Oripathy, there are also numerous scars on his body and burn marks from artillery fire on his face. They are apparently the aftermath of his time fighting the Sargonians with the guerrillas. While we do not know the details, we can easily imagine how intense the battles must have been.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】18%
受感染程度较高，小臂已出现明显源石侵蚀痕迹。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.41u/L
