text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Alanna shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.13u/L
Operator Alanna demonstrates sufficient awareness of and experience in protecting herself from Originium. According to her, she has worked in high-risk industries like mining, which has made her a master of many folk remedies for Oripathy prevention and treatment. Alanna claims these methods work, but their actual clinical effectiveness remains unverified.

I doubt she worked those dangerous jobs for more than a few days before packing her bags. She seems like the sort to value her life above all.
—Warfarin
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员阿兰娜没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.13u/L
干员阿兰娜具有充分的防护意识和经验。据干员阿兰娜本人所述，她曾从事过矿工等感染风险较高的职业，也因此掌握了许多用于防治矿石病的土方子，尽管阿兰娜本人表示很有效，这些土方子的实际医学价值仍待验证。

应该是那些危险工作她都没干几天就跑路了吧。这个人看着就是那种很惜命的类型。
——华法琳

text.en:
Alanna's first job was helping her father scrub the burnt bottoms of baking trays, and her second was collecting compensation for a mining disaster on behalf of her parents and the other workers.
She did not shy away from talking about these distant memories, and even actively threw in details HR did not require. For example, that when the accident happened, she saw the carrot juice in her cup shaking while the pots and pans on the stove danced, and that she collected the compensation money on an afternoon where a sudden wind blew in a sunshower, ruining her formal suit and rendering it unwearable due to shrinkage.
For whatever reason, she suddenly paused when mentioning the clothes she threw away. She made herself a cup of hot tea before continuing on a new topic.
Following that incident, she had few choices left for survival. Once, after being kicked out of a mine by the manager for lying about her age, a passing truck driver gave her half a sandwich. During his brief break, the driver boasted about his lucrative income and even showed her a family photo from his wallet. This left Alanna determined to buy a truck.
Carrying luggage, waitering, repairing water pipes, drilling wells, attending parent-teacher meetings for children doing poorly in school... Alanna was not at all choosy about the work she did, for she knew that she was unqualified for the right to choose. She worked day and night without rest, like a glass factory furnace. Every time she got paid she would put the money in a tin biscuit box, and slept with her head on it at night, as if she could hear a truck galloping through the wilds. When the box was so full it could no longer be shut, she let out a relieved sigh, slept an entire day, and then rushed straight to a transportation company office, yelling: 'I WANNA BUY A TRUCK!'
But not everything can be bought with just hard work. Alanna paid a hefty sum for the truck's deposit and driving lessons, signing a three-month training contract with the company. As she was about to walk out the main door, she happened to turn around and saw a familiar looking driver taking a stack of cash from the banknotes she had just handed to the company.
Alanna finished her tea, and as if remembering something funny, raised her eyebrows and showed off a scar on her arm to the HR Operator. On the day she received her keys, a group of burly truck drivers were blocking the door, smoking and cracking jokes, completely oblivious that they were in her way. They even bet a few beer bottles on whether that little girl would even dare to get into the driver seat, and if she would be scared silly by barrens sandstorms.
Alanna, who had gotten to know all sorts of people in her many jobs, soon figured out the root of the problem. Thus, she made a bet with their leader on who would cry first. Alanna won when she punched the leader's nose hard, his broken sunglasses scratching her arm and leaving a scar.
It was the first time she had made a bet. She won, but did not like the feeling.
text.zh:
阿兰娜的第一份工作是帮父亲刷洗糊底的烤盘，第二份工作是替父母和其他工人讨要矿难赔偿款。
她本人并不忌讳谈及这些久远的回忆，甚至会主动补充一些其实不必告知人事部的细节，例如矿难发生的时候，她曾看见水杯里的胡萝卜汁晃个不停，灶台上的锅碗瓢盆都跳起舞来，以及她终于领到赔款的那个下午，风突然刮得很大，从远处吹来了一场太阳雨，导致她唯一的一套正装也淋湿缩水了，再也穿不上。
不知为何，说到那身报废的衣服时，阿兰娜突然顿住了。在给自己泡上一杯热茶后，她换了个话题继续往下讲。
对当年的阿兰娜来说，想要存活下去，可选的道路并不多。在她又一次因谎报年龄而被矿场管理者逐出矿井后，路过的运载车司机分了她半个三明治。运载车短暂停靠的时间里，司机向她吹嘘了自己丰厚的收入，还掏出了钱夹里的家庭合影。那之后，阿兰娜就铁了心要买一辆运载车。
扛包、端盘子、修水管、钻井、替成绩不佳的小孩出席家长会……阿兰娜从不挑活儿，她清楚自己并没有什么挑剔的资格，所以只能像玻璃工厂里的钢化炉一样昼夜不停连轴转。每次拿到钱，她就装进饼干铁盒里，夜里枕着铁盒睡觉时，她好像能听见运载车驰骋在荒野上时，呼啸而过的风声。等到饼干盒满到合不上盖子，她才松了一口气，足足睡了一整天，然后冲进运输公司，大声喊着：“我要买一辆运载车！”
但并非所有东西都是辛勤工作就能买到的。阿兰娜缴纳了高额押金与学费，和运输公司签订了三个月的培训合同，快要走出大门时，她偶然回头，看到一个脸熟的司机从她交出去的钞票里抽走了一叠。
阿兰娜喝完了那杯热茶，像是突然想起了什么好笑的事情，扬起眉毛向人事部干员炫耀起自己胳膊上的一道疤——在她领车钥匙的那天，一群壮硕的运载车司机堵在门口抽烟说笑，似乎完全没有意识到自己挡住了别人的路，他们甚至打起赌来，用几瓶啤酒押注这个小个子的女孩敢不敢爬上运载车的驾驶舱，会不会被荒野上的沙尘暴吓到哭鼻子。
阿兰娜在过往许多份或短或长的工作中认识了各种各样的人，她很快就想明白了问题所在。于是，阿兰娜也和他们中间领头的那个打了赌，赌谁会先哭出来——结果是阿兰娜赢了，她往那人鼻梁上狠狠揍了一拳，碎裂的墨镜镜片划破了她的胳膊，留下了一道疤。
那是阿兰娜和别人打的第一个赌。她赌赢了，却并不喜欢那种感觉。

text.en:
Alanna first came to Rhodes Island as Warmy's guardian, with no plans to stay long-term.
She would occasionally wander outside the Medical Department, and once accidentally found herself in Engineering's break room, where a group wielding tools were arguing incessantly over some drawings. No one minded her, so she began to stop by regularly, listening in on their shouting matches from the door. Most of the time, she failed to understand what they were even arguing about. However, one day she realized she could almost understand the jargon they used, as if they were simply fancier names for the truck components she was familiar with. So Alanna felt compelled to offer her own opinion—and started arguing with everyone else in the room. The next day, she brought in her 'thesis' to continue yesterday's debate. But this time, whenever she felt mentally stuck, someone would show up behind her and contemplate the problem together until her thoughts were sorted out. Through simultaneous learning and debating, Alanna became a regular visitor.
After that, she once walked into the room and saw a girl she didn't recognize scratching her head at a screen. She coolly walked up to the girl and began instructing her on what to do. The girl's face quickly turned from surprise to confusion. Alanna thought she failed to explain it properly, so she repeated her words patiently. To her surprise, the girl angrily stuffed the computer into Alanna's hands, saying: 'You fix it then!' Left with no choice but to slowly tinker with the computer, Alanna slowly jabbed at the keyboard with alternating fingers to enter all the commands. Before the girl left, she asked Alanna how to spell her name.

The next day, someone from HR came over saying Closure wanted to put someone called 'Alanna' on her new robot dev team, but they had to triple-check the personnel list before realizing it wasn't an operator at all! My first reaction? Of course I wanted to know who the heck Closure was! Turned out to be that girl! Didn't think she was the head of Engineering. What happened next? I signed a contract to join Rhodes Island, pretty much. I'm pretty fond of the guys in Engineering. Of course, it's also because Closure said that from now on only Engineering operators are allowed to argue in the break room.
—Alanna

She fixed it wrong—super wrong—but I saw the energy she had. She wasn't bold OR careful, but she didn't give up... I mean, what's wrong with unconventional methods? Plenty of people here in Engineering weren't hired the usual way, y'know.
—Closure
text.zh:
起初，阿兰娜只是作为温米的监护人一同来到罗德岛，并没有长期留在这里的想法。
有时她也会在医疗部以外的地方转悠。某一次，她误打误撞地走进了工程部的茶水间，那里有手拿各式工具的人对着几张图纸争论不休。没人管她，她就经常过来，靠在门框上听他们吵架，大多数时候她听到最后也没明白这群人在吵什么。不过有一次，她发现那些词她居然能听懂个七七八八，似乎只是给运载车零部件换了个更时髦的说法。于是阿兰娜忍不住出声加入讨论，提出了自己的见解——然后她就跟一屋子的人吵了起来。第二天，她拿着自己熬夜写的“论文”继续昨天的辩论。但这次，每当她思路卡住，都会有人走到她身后，和她一起钻研难点，帮她梳理思路。阿兰娜就这样一边学，一边吵，慢慢成了这个茶水间的常客。
后来某一天，阿兰娜走进茶水间时，只看到一个面生的女孩对着屏幕埋头苦算，阿兰娜大方地走到她身后开始指点。女孩脸上的表情很快从诧异变为迷惑。阿兰娜以为是自己没讲清楚，于是又耐心地重复了一遍，没想到女孩竟然气冲冲地将电脑塞进阿兰娜手里：“那你来！”阿兰娜只好用两根手指戳着键盘，慢慢地将自己的解法全输入进去。女孩临走前，仔细问清了阿兰娜的名字拼写。

第二天就有人事部的人来找我，说可露希尔要往新组建的机器人研发团队里塞一个叫“阿兰娜”的人，但他们把名册翻了个遍，才意识到这个人压根儿不是罗德岛的干员！我的第一反应？那当然是——谁是可露希尔？原来就是那个女孩！没想到她居然还是工程部的头头——后来？后来我就签了合同加入罗德岛了，我还挺喜欢工程部这些有趣的家伙的。当然，也是因为可露希尔说，以后只有工程部干员才有资格在茶水间吵架。
——阿兰娜

她的解法是错的，可以说是错得离谱，不过看得出她身上带着股冲劲儿。胆大心细谈不上，至少不会束手束脚……野路子怎么了？罗德岛工程部的这些人里，走野路子出来的难道还少吗？
——可露希尔

text.en: [Shoddy handwriting on calendar message board] Monday: Gyroscope's broken and under repairs, so don't tell it to breakdance! Also, we're collecting a codename for it this week!! Tuesday: Closure, are you illiterate? I told you not to tell it breakdance! All the wheels came off! Wednesday: Why all the fuss? I just made it do a robot dance. I put the wheels back on, and BTW, Alanna: I'm right next to you, so just turn and talk to me if you need to. Thursday: It's over if we don't figure out a codename soon! Friday: Lanns, I left you a midnight snack in the fridge, don't forget to eat it. Saturday: Potlid's stew is sooo good... why not call it Nutty, btw? Thoughts, Closure? Sunday: No comment. [Audio log] 'What did Potlid think about it?' 'Um, not a fan.' 'I saw its full name on the report. Neural Unit Terminal Driven Maintenance and Combat Assistant... Well, it's a robot car you can use on the battlefield. Listen, just call it Nutty. Short and intuitive!' 'Uh, then I better figure out how to break the news to Potlid—look at all the chili powder she sprinkled in my lunchbox! To think she'd protest against the name like this!' Potlid agreed to the name in the end. Actually, I didn't even try to convince her, she even saw the machine long ago. I only asked if she didn't like the name 'Nutty' itself, or if she didn't like me using that name on that machine. Potlid racked her brains for a long time, but still couldn't say. So I switched it up and asked, do you like it when everyone calls you 'Potlid'? And she said: 'Only you can call me that, Lanns.' Now I understood. 'Potlid' holds a unique meaning to us. Though, I want to tell her it's not just a name that ties us together. Fate's a grumpy old man. It tore us apart from our own families, and then used a huge spanner to fasten us together like screws on a board. No matter how much the truck jumped on the rocky beach, we stayed close to each other the whole way. Why did fate do that? I dunno, maybe it thought we were so alike, or maybe it thought it was better for us both this way. I've never told that to Potlid though. I'll wait. Maybe one night when she can't fall asleep, I'll make up a story for her. ...... As for how that day ended, I handed a small wrench to Potlid and invited her to join me in maintenance work on her Arts staff. She followed me and twisted the screws left and right... I smiled, and she followed suit, her face slowly returning to that perfect 100 degrees smile. —Excerpt from Operator Alanna's monthly HR interview log
text.zh:
【字迹潦草的日历留言板】
周一：陀螺仪碰坏了，正在修，别给它下跳霹雳舞的指令！另外，本周内征集代号！！
周二：可露希尔你不识字吗？都说了别让它跳霹雳舞！这下轮子全掉了！
周三：大惊小怪干什么，我让它跳的是机械舞。我已经把轮子复位了，另外，阿兰娜，我就在你旁边，有什么话可以直接转过来对我讲。
周四：再想不出来代号就要死了！
周五：兰娜姐，给你做的夜宵放进冰箱里了，记得吃哦。
周六：小锅盖做的焖饭真好吃……要不就叫它“小螺帽”吧。可露希尔，你觉得呢？
周日：我没意见。

【语音记录】
“小锅盖有意见？”
“嗯，她不同意。”
“我看看写在报告上的全名，神经单元终端驱动的维修与作战辅助……好吧，它就是个在战场上也能用的修车机器人。听我的，就叫‘小螺帽’吧，简洁又直观。”
“唉，那我可得想想，怎么去跟小锅盖讲——你看，她往我饭盒里撒了这么多辣椒粉，用这种方式跟我抗议呢！”

小锅盖最后同意了。其实我并没有试着去说服她，她早就见过那台机械装置了。我只是问她，是不喜欢“小螺帽”这个名字，还是不喜欢我用这个名字来叫它？小锅盖歪着脑袋想了很久，还是说不上来。我就又问她，那你喜欢大家叫你“小锅盖”吗？小锅盖说，兰娜姐可以这么叫。
她这么说，我才明白过来。“小锅盖”这个名字对我和她来说，有着独一无二的意义。但我想告诉她的是，真正把阿兰娜和温米联结在一起的，并不只是一个名字。
命运就是一个脾气很臭的老头子，它把我和温米从各自的家里拆下来，再用它那超级大的扳手，把我们俩像拧螺丝一样紧紧拧在一起，无论运载车驶过乱石滩时有多么颠簸，我们俩都紧紧靠在一起。命运为什么要这么做？我不知道，也许，是因为命运觉得我们很像，又或者，命运觉得这样做对我们俩都更好。
但这些话我也没对小锅盖讲过。等以后吧，在某天晚上，她睡不着的话，我再编成故事讲给她听。
……
至于那天的最后，我只是将一把小型扳手递给小锅盖，邀请她和我一起来保养那根法杖。她学着我的样子在各种螺丝上左拧拧，右拧拧……我笑了，她也笑了，脸上慢慢恢复了那道完美的100度微笑。
——摘自干员阿兰娜的月度人事访谈记录

text.en:
When I had just returned to Rhodes Island, I often got lost and missed many meetings. I know its a new nomadic plate, but there just isn't enough decent signage around here. That day I wrote a whole complaint letter to Closure, but lost my way as soon as I left the stairwell!
I almost had a panic attack until I saw a chubby robot headed my way. Silly looking thing. I tried to communicate my search for Closure, and it actually understood me! It showed me the way, and even pointed out the new signage on the walls as we went. I was so emotional the whole time—that disaster didn't break the resolve of the operators on-board, but granted them the courage to re-innovate and rebuild.
And so, by the time I finally found Closure, I tore up the letter and heaped praise on the operator who designed the robot. But for some reason, the more Closure heard, the madder she got...
—Excerpt from 'Letter of Thanks to All Engineering Operators'

According to an enthusiastic operator's report, it was discovered that Alanna, an intern from Workshop No. 3, had been using the 'Nutty' with a navigation module installed to do her volunteer work of 'showing Operators around' and pasting signage while she would hide in the lab to sleep, later exchanging her volunteer credits for a large amount of experiment materials.
Her actions have violated the spirit of the volunteer system, but Operator Alanna has realized her mistake and willingly accepted the following:
1. Operator Alanna will voluntarily deduct the respective amount of time from her clocked internship hours and postpone her evaluation for promotion;
2. Due to the outstanding reviews by various Operators of the 'Nutty' showing them around, Operator Alanna will be allowed to keep all previously exchanged experiment materials, but must use them solely on subsequent iterations of the 'Nutty' and voluntarily accept Closure's supervision.
This document is only for archival purposes and cannot be circulated. Please sign below to confirm your acknowledgment and consent on the matter.
—'■■■■ Informed Consent Form'

[Audio Log]
'Agh, got it. I stayed up a few days straight to help you draft the design, and I also had to help Potlid modify her staff. So I just wanted to catch up on my Zs.'
'I can't be bothered to reason with you...'
'Hehe, but you gotta admit my Nutty's got a pretty deceptive look, yeah? Just think about it: even our most veteran field Operators failed to detect it. How're enemies on the battlefield ever gonna guess there's miniature bombs and flamethrowers hidden inside?!'
'Wait, didn't you say it was an air pump and heat gun for repairing tires?'
'Think about it. Those aren't mutually exclusive.'
'No way! Take them out! NOW!'
text.zh:
我刚回罗德岛的时候经常迷路，也因此错过不少会议，尽管这是一个新的移动地块，但在道路引导方面确实存在不足。那天我写了一封投诉信准备交给可露希尔，但刚走出楼梯间，我就发现自己又找不着路了！
就在我的恐慌症即将发作的时候，我看到一个圆鼓鼓的机械小家伙朝我跑了过来，看起来呆头呆脑的。我试着告诉它我要去找可露希尔，结果它还真就听明白了！它一边给我带路，一边提示我去看墙上新张贴的指引标识。一路上我都在感慨，看来那场灾难没有击垮留舰干员们的意志，反而让他们拥有了创新重铸的勇气。
于是，在见到可露希尔时，我撕掉了那封投诉信，向她大力夸赞了发明制作这台“引路机器人”的干员。但不知道为什么，可露希尔好像越听越生气……
——摘自《致全体工程部干员的一封感谢信》

经热心干员举报，发现工程部第三维修工坊实习工匠阿兰娜在担任“干员回归指引志愿者”和执行张贴指引标识任务期间，违规使用了加装导航模块的“小螺帽”替其工作，自己则躲进实验室睡觉，并在事后用志愿者时长兑换了大量实验材料。
这一系列操作严重违背了设立志愿者时长兑换制度的初衷，目前干员阿兰娜也认识到了自己的错误，并自愿接受如下决定：
1.干员阿兰娜自愿在累计实习工时中扣除对应的违规时长，并推迟转正考核的时间；
2.由于“小螺帽”在指引服务上的突出表现得到了各部门干员的高度评价，干员阿兰娜可以保留之前已经兑换的实验材料，但必须将其使用于“小螺帽”的后续迭代开发中，并自愿接受可露希尔的全程监管。
此文件仅限留档存证使用，禁止外传。请在确认自己充分知情且同意后签字。
——《■■■■知情同意书》

【语音记录】
“哎呀，知道了。连着几天熬夜帮你画设计图，白天还得抽空帮小锅盖改装法杖，我这么干也只是为了补补觉嘛。”
“懒得理你……”
“嘿嘿，你也得承认，小螺帽的外表很有迷惑性吧？你想想，连我们身经百战的外勤干员都没发现，那到了战场上，敌人们想破脑袋都猜不到它里面居然还藏着微缩炸药和火焰喷射器！”
“等等，你不是说那是用来补胎的气泵和热熔枪吗？”
“你再想想，这并不冲突。”
“不行！立刻拆掉！立刻！”

text.en:
[Classified Log]
Sender: Rim Billiton Big Pillar Gotta Go Fast Transport Co. HR Dept
Recipient: Rhodes Island Rim Billiton branch c/o Alanna Engineering Department
Alanna, are you planning to return to work? Your contract is still valid, so even if you want to quit, you have to sign off and forfeit your deposit in person.
Additionally, there are some issues with the truck you returned. We found a huge hole in the right side chassis, as if it were hit by a bomb, but the outer metal layer is intact and undamaged—might you have any idea how this happened?
Best Regards!
Gotta Go Fast Transport Co.—Wheels are always faster than legs!

Sender: Rim Billiton Big Pillar Gotta Go Fast Transport Co. HR Dept
Recipient: Rhodes Island Rim Billiton branch c/o Alanna Engineering Department
Alanna, what do you mean by 'Got caught. Screw it, I quit'?
Also, 'Use the deposit to buy the boys a round of beer'—who are 'the boys' referring to? Does this include Peter from HR too, the one who always has two pairs of glasses on. You've met me, when I helped you request a LOA.
One last thing: the company has discussed the issue you raised in your last reply, and this is what they settled on: You can buy the vehicle if you wish, but you must pay the towing fee as well. After all, the wheels on it were removed long ago, and now it's in line to be scrapped for parts.
Best Regards!
Gotta Go Fast Transport Co.—Wheels are always faster than legs!

Sender: Rim Billiton Big Pillar Gotta Go Fast Transport Co. HR Dept
Recipient: Rhodes Island Rim Billiton branch c/o Alanna Engineering Department
Good news, Alanna! You can save on the towing fees! When the boys saw your proposed bet in your last reply—that no one would manage to drive that broken old thing for over three miles, they instantly installed tires on the truck, and were all ready to drive it over! I wanted to join them, but my boss didn't let me take the day off.
You previously wrote that you're allowed to take any day off you want, you get overtime pay, and your salary isn't deducted for using sick days. Is that true?
Also, does Rhodes Island have a strict work experience requirement?
Lastly, thanks for the beer!

Peter, Gotta Go Fast Transport Co. HR Dept
[Courier Delivery Receipt]
Recipient: Alanna
Shipment information: Half a cart of homemade carrot soda, half a cart of 'Big Bottletree' Beer, and the vehicle itself.
PS: Charlie the Sproglet here! Take us up quick! I finally won a bet with you!
text.zh:
【权限记录】
寄信人：雷姆必拓比格皮勒自治州跑得快运输公司人事办公室
收信人：罗德岛驻雷姆必拓办事处—转交工程部阿兰娜
阿兰娜，你还回不回来上班了？你合同还没到期呢，就算提了离职，也要本人回来签字退押金的。
另，你交还回来的车好像还有点问题，我们在车身右侧又发现一个大破洞，就跟被炮弹炸过一样，但盖在外层的铁皮却完好无损——你有什么头绪吗？
祝好！
跑得快运输公司——轮子跑永远比你用腿走要快！

寄信人：雷姆必拓比格皮勒自治州跑得快运输公司人事办公室
收信人：罗德岛驻雷姆必拓办事处—转交工程部阿兰娜
阿兰娜，你说的“被抓来打螺丝了，不干了”是什么意思？
还有“押金请他们喝啤酒”，“他们”具体指的是谁？包括人事办公室的彼得吗，就是同时戴着两副眼镜的那个，你见过的，我还帮你办过请假手续呢。
另外，你上次回信提出的问题，经过公司内部讨论，已经有了结论：你要实在想买下那辆车的话也不是不行，但是拖车费你得自己掏。毕竟那辆运载车的轮子早就卸掉了，现在它正排队等着拆零件呢。
祝好！
跑得快运输公司——轮子跑永远比你用腿走要快！

寄信人：雷姆必拓比格皮勒自治州跑得快运输公司人事办公室
收信人：罗德岛驻雷姆必拓办事处—转交工程部阿兰娜
阿兰娜，好消息！拖车费可以省下来了！那几个家伙看到你在信里发起赌约——没人能把那辆破车开出三公里，他们立马给运载车装好了轮胎，准备一路开过去！我本来也想去的，但领导不给我批假。
你之前的信里说，你在罗德岛那边可以随便请假，平时有加班费，病假还不扣薪水，是真的吗？我还想了解一下，罗德岛那边对工作经验卡得严吗？
最后，谢谢你请的啤酒！
跑得快运输公司人事办公室，彼得

【快递签收回执】
收件人：阿兰娜
货物信息：半车厢自制胡萝卜汽水，半车厢“大瓶树”牌啤酒，运货的车辆本身。
快递附言：我是小查理，快点下来接我们上去！我终于赌赢你一次了！

value.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

infectionStatus.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

text.en: Mon3tr is profoundly knowledgeable in life sciences, Oripathy treatment, history and genealogy, and many other fields. She also possesses plentiful experience in mobile combat maneuvers, and offers much-needed assistance during Rhodes Island's rebuilding. Currently serves as a special consultant for the Medical, Engineering, and Field Operations departments.
text.zh: Mon3tr，在生命科学、矿石病诊疗、历史系谱学等诸多领域具备渊博学识，拥有丰富的移动作战经验，为罗德岛重建工作提供了至关重要的帮助，现为罗德岛医疗部、工程部、外勤部特别顾问。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Mon3tr shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.00u/L
She is no longer steadfast, incisive, or relentless, nor the bearer of certain extreme traits. A reminder that our recent loss is all too real.
Mon3tr's vital signs are extremely unstable. This is not to say her new body is diseased, but rather that she is currently in a state of accelerated catalysis and morphosis—in simpler terms, this new body of hers is not yet truly complete. Thankfully, unlike Kal'tsit, who never acquiesced to a physical examination, Mon3tr is more than happy to cooperate with Medical, perhaps even too enthusiastic at times. We will continue monitoring her situation.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员Mon3tr没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.00u/L
她不再坚固、不再锐利、不再暴戾，不再是某些极端特性的载体，这都在提醒我们，刚刚经历的离别如此真实。
Mon3tr的各种体征极不稳定，这并不是说她的这具新身体出现了病变，而是说明她处于一种加速催化与形塑的常态中——换个浅显易懂的说法，她的这具新身体还没有真正完成。好在，不像凯尔希从不接受体检，Mon3tr对医疗部的工作还是配合的，甚至说，有些热情过头，我们会持续关注她的情况。

text.en:
Dr. Kal'tsit has left us, and another wearing similar clothes is now at our side, helping to rebuild Rhodes Island. This leaves many feeling somewhat bewildered. We often heard such mutterings as HQ was being rebuilt, the earliest of which even came from Medical itself.
According to the Medic operators, Mon3tr showed up to the very first meeting held after Medical was rebuilt. She stood in the corner of the room, not saying a word, electing to quietly listen to Dr. Warfarin's speech. Eventually, she was noticed. At first, Dr. Warfarin was clearly at a loss for words, but she quickly started raising her voice, drawing everyone's eyes back to her.
'I know she wants to come along. She feels like she should be there. You must have noticed it, Amiya. Kal'tsit's stethoscope, hanging around her neck... Although she got it upside down.'
'I don't think she's trying to copy Dr. Kal'tsit, nor does she hope to be her equal. She's inherited all her memories, but at the same time, she's trying to process all that pain... She needs a little... no, a lot more time, just like the rest of us.'

I have decided to officially hire Operator Mon3tr as Medical's special consultant. This decision was made after an assessment of her professional ability in basic medicine, life sciences, clinical medicine, first aid, and other such fields. Her performance during this period has also been taken into account, having helped provide aid to the wounded of her own accord and assisting in surgery (using two talons to secure the wounded while using another two to distract them—Kal'tsit never did anything like that before). This has been decided by a show of hands from all members of Medical.
—Warfarin
Your hands are so soft, Mon3tr.
—Rosmontis
See you at the training room today, Mon3tr! We're not leaving until we're all tired out!
—Blaze
She's become Blaze's ideal sparring partner, and not long after she started participating in stool racing and nut-cracking racing; she got second place in both of them.
She is Mon3tr, our new comrade-in-arms.
—Stormeye
text.zh:
凯尔希医生已经离去，而另一个衣着相似的人开始出现在我们身边，参与罗德岛重建的事务，多少让人感到有一些无措……在总部改造的这段时间，我们听到了不少诸如此类的声音，最早甚至来自医疗部。
据医疗干员所说，Mon3tr出现在了医疗部重建后的第一次会议上，她就那么站在办公室的角落，也不说话，只是安静地听华法琳医生讲话。终于，她被注意到了，华法琳医生明显地卡壳了一下，然后突然提高音量，将众人的目光拉了回来。
“我知道是她自己要来的。她觉得自己应该出现在那里嘛。阿米娅，你肯定注意到了吧，她脖子上甚至还挂着凯尔希的听诊器……虽然挂倒了。”
“我不觉得她在模仿凯尔希医生，或者希望自己能和凯尔希医生画上等号。她只是，继承了凯尔希医生的全部记忆，同时在消化那些伤痛……不止我们，她也需要一点，不，更多时间。”

我决定正式聘请Mon3tr干员作为医疗部的特别顾问。该决定基于对Mon3tr在基础医学、生命科学、临床医学与急救等领域专业能力的评估而做出，并充分考虑了该干员在这段时间的表现——主动救治伤员，辅助外科手术（指用两只爪子固定病患，用另外两只爪子分散对方注意力，凯尔希以前倒是没这个作用）。医疗部全体成员进行了举手表决。
——华法琳
你的手是软的哦，Mon3tr。
——迷迭香
Mon3tr，训练场见，今天不累不归！
——煌
她成了煌在训练场进行对抗练习的最佳对手，她参加圆凳滑行赛和开坚果竞速赛不久便拿到了双料亚军。
她是Mon3tr，我们的新战友。
——Stormeye

text.en:
[Training Room Recording]
'Wait, wait, wait, I didn't get a good look. How'd you manage to block my chainsaw? I thought it'd be a sure thing, imploding the air to force you back. No way you'd be prepared for it...'
'It was my talons.'
'You're harder to get a solid hit on than ever. Speaking of, I was wondering... Can you still do that thing with your mouth...?'
(Sound of a violent shockwave blast)
'What the ****?!?'

With Operator Blaze's enthusiastic assistance, Mon3tr has gotten accustomed to her current body in a short period of time, and has mastered several unusual combat techniques. She makes full use of the metallic constructs that float in front of her. The pair of large and small constructs are able to decompress into a pair of upper talons and lower talons respectively. The decompression process is near-instantaneous, and their shape can be freely changed to suit the current needs. For example, they can be split into fragments and adhere onto someone else, or act as an Arts unit and help her render emergency treatment. The current Mon3tr does not possess the same formidable resilience she had while at Kal'tsit's side, but there is no doubt that her highly flexible nature on the battlefield is not something to be overlooked, whether she be threatening an enemy or aiding an ally. As a new operator who has not been with Rhodes Island for very long—sorry, official procedure, gotta follow it—she has been very active, participating in over a dozen field missions. She has proven herself a great help to us.

[Classified Log]
I've ordered Medical to set up a group dedicated to monitoring Mon3tr's condition. We need to keep an eye on it.
She accompanied Dr. Kal'tsit for an incredibly long time. The end of the gemini cycle system means a painful rebirth, one full of unknowns. She hasn't been awake for long enough... Mon3tr's current appearance is merely her initial form as an independent construct—in other words, her countenance and capabilities are currently in a state of continuous flux. This process is filled with uncontrollable elements. It must be guided. Ever since we experienced that grave incident, there have been more and more disturbing developments appearing across the land. The situation is deteriorating, and that deterioration is accelerating. Rhodes Island has no time to rest. I worry... I worry that our reliance on Mon3tr will outstrip the speed at which she is adapting to these changes...
But no matter what, we will stand with her, and meet those changes together.
text.zh:
【训练场录音】
“等等，我刚刚没有看清，你是怎么挡下我的链锯的？我本来以为压爆空气，逼你后退，你一定没法防备这个杀招了……”
“是爪子哦。”
“比以前更神出鬼没了。说起来，那个，我有件事情好奇得不行——以你现在的状态，还能像以前那样从嘴里……”
（喷射冲击波的剧烈声响）
“我******！”

在煌干员热情满满的协助下，Mon3tr已在短时间之内适应了现在的躯体，并掌握了一套别样的战斗技巧。她充分利用了身前的金属构造体，大小两块金属构造体分别可以解压出两只上爪和两只下爪，解压可以在转瞬之间完成，且形态可以根据需求随时变化，比如分裂成更多碎片附着在他人身上，充当施术单元，方便她提供紧急治疗……相比曾经相伴凯尔希身侧的存在，现在的Mon3tr并不具备那样强大的对抗能力，但毫无疑问，无论是威胁敌人，还是援助队友，Mon3tr在战场上的高机动性使得她的作用不容忽视。作为加入罗德岛没多久的新干员——抱歉，从正式程序来判定，我确实需要这么说——她表现得相当活跃，已经参加了十多次外勤任务，是我们的重要助力。

【权限记录】
我已经责令医疗部成立了专门的小组，我们需要持续关注Mon3tr的身体状态。
她和凯尔希医生相伴度过了漫长的时间，双生循环系统的终结，意味着一次痛苦且充满着未知的重生，她醒来的时间还太短……Mon3tr现在的这副模样，只是她作为独立构造体的初始形态——换言之，她的形貌和能力处在持续的动态变化中。这一过程充满了种种不可控的因素，它需要被引导。而经历那场变故之后，这片大地上出现了越来越多糟糕的苗头，局势正在加速恶化，罗德岛不能有一刻停歇，我担心，我担心我们对Mon3tr的需要会超过她适应自身变化的速度……
但无论如何，我们会站在一起，迎接一切变化。

text.en:
[Classified Log]
'According to our intelligence, there has been a surge in 'academic exhanges' between the spires of Zwillingstürme lately. There is no doubt that the Golden Empress is trying to analyze the secrets plucked out from amidst the chaos. The hole in the starpod is still open, and the Columbian government is increasingly engrossed in levitation research... The nations of the Core love new opportunities, but they must understand that these opportunities indicate a brewing crisis that will affect us all, not the start of another round of disputes. We should offer Vina more support. She's able to do a lot more now... But Rhodes Island should refrain from official collaboration with Parliament.
'Just note these words down for now, Mon3tr. The Doctor and Amiya will know what they mean.'

'Laterano's Law has been on guard for a very long time now. The Holy City's futile call for peace across Terra is, in essence, a way of saving itself. We still do not know exactly what sort of disaster the Law has foreseen, but I fear that not so far in the future, all the past calamities we have seen will be but a shadow of this new one.
'If there is the opportunity, try to contact the Law, but by no means regard it as a peer. It still retains the ability that caused endless dispute in the past. It is still able to cause irreversible influence on one's personality with ease.
'But when the time is right, do not hesitate to access its system.'

'I am glad that Clementia and Gladiia listened to my proposal. The 'Land Patrol' is a good starting point. For the time being, Ægir is willing to work on dry land via more neutral powers.
'Ægir boasts of being the successor of prehistoric civilization. It is the closest to the most foundational of legacies, yet also closest to where the sea currents are cut off. If the one I least want to see shows herself, she will not overlook its existence. She will not come to them as equals of humanity, nor will she, as the philosophers of Ægir expect, reveal a million truths to them in endless communion. Even arrogant Ægir must learn how to confront a 'Creator'.
'We must deepen our bond with them, and seek out more possibilities from the ruins. Perhaps even from the Seaborn.
'Raise the priority level of founding an office in Ægir. The two consuls are a good place to start. But remember, Mon3tr. When in contact with Ægir, keep the Doctor well guarded.'

......

'War comes. It will not be one limited to her and us. It is one that affects all of Terra, and everyone on it.'

[Office Recording]
'Kal'tsit recorded this information bit by bit in my spinal cord. She probably already had an idea of how things would end, and made her final decision. Before her life faded away, she tried to leave behind as much guidance as she could for Rhodes Island.'
'You've already told the Doctor and me all of this, Mon3tr. You don't need to sit here repeating it over and over... like you're just reciting lines.'
'No, I need to understand it for myself too.'
text.zh:
【权限记录】
“根据情报，崔林特尔梅高塔间的‘学术交流’最近变得愈发频繁，毫无疑问，金色的女皇正试图解析从混沌中带出的秘密；星荚的空洞还存在，哥伦比亚官方对浮空科研项目的投入显著增多……核心圈各国都很珍视各自的新机遇，但它们同样需要知晓，这些机遇指向的是共同的危机，而非又一轮纷争。向维娜提供更多支持，如今的她能做到更多……但罗德岛应避免再从官方层面与议会达成合作。
“记下这些话就好，Mon3tr，博士和阿米娅会明白其中的含义。”

“拉特兰的‘律法’已经保持了很久的戒备状态，圣城徒劳地向泰拉发出和平的呼吁，本质上是一种自救。我们仍不知晓‘律法’预见了怎样的灾难，但我恐怕在不久的将来，所有灾难都只是同一场灾难的影子。
“若有契机，尝试与‘律法’接触，但切勿轻易将它视作同类。它仍保留着当初引发了众多争议的能力——它仍能轻易对人格造成不可逆的影响。
“但在必要的时候，不要犹豫，接入它的系统。”

“我很庆幸克莱门莎与歌蕾蒂娅听取了我的建议，‘陆巡队’是一个良好的开端——阿戈尔愿意暂时通过立场更为中立的力量在陆地上开展事务。
“阿戈尔自诩先史文明的继承者，它离最核心的遗产最近，离另一端的断流也最近。如果我最不愿见到的那个人真的现身，她不会忽视阿戈尔的存在。只不过，她不会以同为人类的平等姿态到来，更不会如阿戈尔哲人所期望的那般，与他们展开一场遍览万千真理的漫长神交。傲慢如阿戈尔，也将不得不学会面对一位‘造物主’。
“我们需要与阿戈尔建立更深入的合作关系，寻找更多可能，从遗迹，甚至从海嗣本身。
“提高建立阿戈尔办事处的优先级，克莱门莎与歌蕾蒂娅两位执政官是不错的切入口。但Mon3tr，在与阿戈尔的接触中，切记保护好博士。”

……

“战争已经来临，这不只是我们与她之间的战争，这是属于全泰拉，所有人的战争。”

【办公室录音】
“凯尔希将这些信息一条一条地刻录进了我的脊髓之中。那时候，想必她已经预感到了最后的结局，也做了最终的决定。她尝试在生命消逝之前，为罗德岛留下尽可能多的指引。”
“你已经转告过我和博士了，Mon3tr。你不用专门耐着性子坐在这里，一遍遍重复……有点像背书。”
“不，我也需要理解。”

text.en:
>TIMEDATA TT 197/19/09
>ADMIN: Oracle; PRTS
Project Codename: AMa-10
A mechanical lifeform that uses the gemini cycle system as its core. This lifeform is characterized by an impressive ability to learn and a near-indestructible structure, one that can adapt to all sorts of extreme environments. Furthermore, in theory, it will not be recognized as life by ■■■. In the original plan, this model of mechanical lifeform would have been mass-produced by the millions, helping humanity terraform planets and build new homes for us.
At the time, this was not a particularly vital project. It would not have forestalled the oncoming calamity, nor would it have served as the ark of civilization like DWDB-221E. It was more of an investment by its creators. When they were discussing AMa-10, they decided it should be designed to survive, as a way to ensure that in the future, life will still persist.
If that is to be considered the moment I was born, then this ship named Rhodes Island should be considered my birthplace. At the time, she still sailed among the stars, the two administrators aboard her cautiously watching the undulations of the dark tides as they debated concepts for the future.
But the tide fell on them faster than anybody imagined, and the AMa-10 project could not wait for the day mass production of mechanical life was feasible. And so, I was special, and alone.
Once the administrators went into hibernation, I received no further signs of life. But before the true end comes to pass, I still have some duties I must see through.

>TIMEDATA TT ???/??/??
>ADMIN: AMa-10
The administrator known as Oracle has been awakened from hibernation, and I find myself accompanying Oracle alongside the investigation of this land known as Terra. However, this is not an appropriate time for it. None of our projects have progressed as we expected. Oracle should be aware of all this. From this perspective, this awakening was not a rational action.
At journey's end, Oracle issued one last command to me.
'Find yourself.'
This command was not especially difficult to parse. What 'finding yourself' means is known to both philosophers and logicians. But I sensed a strong undercurrent of frustration in Oracle's words.
Perhaps Oracle still had other matters for me to do?
Seek out traces of life. Protect the spark of civilization. These actions may be of equal value to the hope Oracle advocated for during debates. Still, in contrast to that final instruction, they are somewhat more complicated issues.
With these doubts on my mind, I begin my own journey.

>TIMEDATA 899/03/01
>ADMIN: Kal'tsit; Mon3tr
This is the second death Kal'tsit had experienced.
The civilizations of this land are advancing, and the enemies we face are becoming more difficult to handle by the day.
Not every step of Kal'tsit's plan can go smoothly. Her defeats are not unexpected. Yet I have never seen her put her full trust in anyone before, let alone a Sarkaz woman who was once an enemy. But as her mastery of DWDB-221E shows, she is a Terran with more wisdom than most. Maybe this is why Kal'tsit likes her.
The only thing I don't understand is why she gave up her former strength, why she chose a body like an ordinary Terran. She had begun to copy the appearance of the humans of Terra a very long time ago. Imitation is a biological instinct, and the starting point for wisdom, but to Kal'tsit, this copying must have another meaning.
This is not entirely a bad thing, however. We have a clearer division of labor between us. Sometimes her conversational skills can get us out of trouble, sure, but I think using my strength's the simpler option.
I will protect her.

>TIMEDATA 1101/09/03
>ADMIN: Mon3tr
I ran into the Doctor and Amiya again.
It's strange talking to them in words, especially when talking to the Doctor. My subconscious always treats it as some sort of reunion, after ten thousand long years of waiting, and I find myself having to suppress this inappropriate joy. I believe the past me has always been able to communicate with the two quite clearly, but only now, in this current form, is the connection between us truly close. We have 'become the same kind'.
It seems I now understand the choice Kal'tsit once made.

I've been reorganizing this ten millennia of data. It feels like it all happened only yesterday, yet they also feel like ancient, faraway stories. They are the foundation my logic and personality rely on, and the treasures I share with Kal'tsit.
Protect the Doctor and Amiya. I will follow this order to the last, but not only because I was commanded to. It is also my wish.
Perhaps this will be a new beginning. I must 'find myself' once more.
text.zh:
>TIMEDATA TT 197/19/09
>ADMIN: Oracle; PRTS
项目代号：AMa-10
以双生循环系统为核心研发的机械生命，该机械生命的特点在于有强大的学习能力和近乎不会损毁的结构，足以适应各种极端环境，并且在理论设计中，不会被■■■识别为生命。按照原计划，该型号机械生命将以百万级的规模量产，帮助人类在星球范围内改造自然环境，建设新的家园。
在当时，这并不是一个非常关键的项目，无法改变即将到来的寂灭，也并不能像DWDB-221E那样成为文明的方舟。它更像是一种造物者对未来的寄托，当他们谈论AMa-10时，想到的应当是一个劫后余生，尚有生命存在的未来。
如果那算是我诞生的起源，这艘名为罗德岛的舰船应该就是我诞生的地方。那时她还在群星间穿行，舰船上的两名管理员，一边谨慎地监视着黑暗潮汐的涨落，一边对未来的构想展开辩论。
然而潮汐的余波来得比所有人想象的都更为迅捷，AMa-10项目最终没有等到机械生命量产的那一天，我成了特殊的唯一。
在管理员陷入沉睡之后，我再也没有接收到任何生命的讯号。但是在真正的终点到来之前，我还有一些需要去履行的使命。

>TIMEDATA TT ???/??/??
>ADMIN: AMa-10
名为预言家的管理员从休眠中苏醒，在我的陪同下对这片名为泰拉的大地进行了勘测。但这并不是一个合适的时机，所有项目的进展都不如预期。预言家理应对这一切有所认知，从这一点看，这次苏醒并不是理性的行为。
在旅行结束时，预言家对我下达了最后的指令。
“去找到你自己。”
这并不是难以理解的命令，“找到自己”的涵义存在于哲学与逻辑学的知识体系中。但是，我从预言家的话语中感受到了强烈的失落。
或许，预言家还有其他想让我做到的事？
寻找生命的痕迹，守护文明的火种。这些行为，或许与预言家在辩论中主张的希望有着相同的价值取向。对比那一条指令，它是稍显复杂的问题。
带着这样的疑惑，我开始了自己的旅程。

>TIMEDATA 899/03/01
>ADMIN: Kal'tsit; Mon3tr
这是凯尔希经历的第二次死亡。
这片大地上的文明的确在发展，我们面对的敌人也愈发棘手。
凯尔希的规划并不是每一项都能平稳实现，她失败过，那并不是值得意外的事。但我不曾见过她真正信任过谁，何况那名萨卡兹女性是曾经的敌人。不过从她掌握了DWDB-221E来看，她应当是有着较高智慧的泰拉生命个体，这或许是凯尔希喜欢她的理由。
我唯一不解的是，凯尔希究竟为何要放弃曾经的力量，只选择了与普通的泰拉生命没有区别的身体。而在更早之前，她就已经开始模仿泰拉人类来改变自己的样貌，模仿是生命的本能，是智慧的起点，但是对于凯尔希来说，这样的模仿理应有别的意义才对。
不过这也不完全算坏事，我们之间的分工更为明确了。有些时候凯尔希的交谈技巧的确能省去麻烦，但我认为更多时候使用我的力量更为简单。
接下来，我会保护好她。

>TIMEDATA 1101/09/03
>ADMIN: Mon3tr
我再一次遇到了博士与阿米娅。
与他们用语言交流的感觉很奇妙，尤其在面对博士时，我总是下意识地将这当作一万年后的重逢，我时常需要控制自己不要流露出不合时宜的喜悦。我认为，一直以来我的情绪总是能准确无误地传达给博士和阿米娅，但是只有以现在的模样与他们相处时，我们之间的联系才是紧密的。我们“变成了同类”。
这样看来，我似乎又能理解凯尔希过去的选择了。

我重新整理过去这一万年的资料，它们既像是昨日的回忆，又好像遥远的故事。它们是我逻辑与人格赖以成立的基准，也是我和凯尔希共同的宝物。
保护博士与阿米娅，我会将这条指令贯彻到底，但这也是我自己的意愿。
这或许是一个新的开始，我需要重新“找到自己”。

text.en: Entering underlying linked data region. Executing data integrity check. Timestamp... verified. Authorization... verified. Entering... 'Dandelion'. [Accessing work log, beginning recording] ...... Just last month, a herd of Feranmuts dragged mounts and rivers atop their bodies to the whirlpool near the Black Flow. What must be signed of these Memoranda Pertaining to Abnormal Tides has been signed, to no surprise. After all, as things stand, even the most opinionated of the Core nations must sit at the same table... In short, everything is going smoothly, though the bags under Amiya's and the Doctor's eyes are not particularly pleasant to look at. This seedship contains genetic samples of more than 134,700 native Terran species and their associated breeding platform, as well as compatible databases, backups, expert systems able to answer all possible contingencies, 'Little Handies', vast amounts of equipment... The seedship is ready, and will soon join with the main hold. Our top priority is to find the runaway objective, to try and intervene in its path and allow it to be recaptured by Terra's gravitational field... But the seedship is a brief intermission, an unspoken acknowledgment of the joint project group. We will bid it farewell once it leaves the starpod, hurtling away into the distance... Perhaps it will fade away in an instant, or perhaps it will sail the stellar sea for eternity... Or perhaps it will be seized by some star system's gravity, and these 'dandelions' will be scattered across new ground. Of course, we cannot forget the movies of Wrankwood, the music of Leithanien, the sociological research, sculptures, and literature of Ægir. Many, many things worth preserving... Perhaps, once these seeds have been baptized by the ravages of time, people will discover by happenstance that this ship is a book with said seeds trapped between its pages. The transportation technology Terra has access to has its limits, so this was in truth a compromise, but who knows, it may turn out to be a pleasant surprise. Most likely, Project Dandelion will be meaningless... Just as their every past attempt has turned out. But we cannot give up on looking for a possibility, a chance, a miracle. Like the birth of civilization on Terra. [Work log archival complete, recording confirmed] 'Ahh... Turns out, Kal'tsit, when people's heads are full of serious stuff, their tone of voice starts getting all weird. 'I'm understanding you a lot more as the days go by.'
text.zh:
底层关联数据区域接入，执行完整性验证。
时间戳验证……已通过。
权限验证……已通过。
已接入……“蒲公英”。

【工作日志读取中，开始录音】
……
就在上个月，又一批巨兽拖曳着身躯上的山川河流，抵达了黑流树海附近的涡流点；《关于潮汐异常的若干备忘录》，该签字的都签字了，其实在意料之中啦，毕竟事到如今，连那几个最有想法的核心圈国家都不得不坐在一张桌子上……总之，一切推进得还算顺利，就是阿米娅和博士的黑眼圈重得都没眼看了。
这艘播种船储存着十三万四千七百多个泰拉原生物种的基因样本和对应的培育平台，以及与之匹配的数据库、备份装置、能应对各种可能情形的“专家系统”、“小帮手”、林林总总的设备……播种船已经准备完毕，即将接入主舱室。我们的首要任务当然是找到逃逸的目标，设法干预它的轨道，好让泰拉的引力场将它重新捕获……但播种船确实是整个联合项目组都默认存在的小插曲，它会在离开星荚之后与我们道别，奔向另一个方向……或许会很快消失，或者永远在星海之间流浪……
也可能，它会被某个星系的引力捕捉，“蒲公英”就此散入新的土壤。
当然啦，我们没忘记蓝卡坞的电影，莱塔尼亚的音乐，阿戈尔的社会研究、雕塑与书籍，那值得留存的许多事物……或许，在种子经历岁月洗礼后，人们会偶然发现，这艘船本身，即是夹着种子的书页。泰拉目前的运载技术相当有限，这实在是妥协之举，但或许，也不失为一种惊喜？
“蒲公英”项目极有可能是缺乏意义的……就像他们曾经做过的种种尝试那样。但我们不能放弃期待一种可能、一次偶然、一个奇迹——一如曾经泰拉文明的诞生。
【工作日志存档完成，录音确认】

“啊……凯尔希，原来人的脑子里装满这些深重的东西时，语气真的会变得怪怪的。
“越来越理解你了。”

text.en: Sakiko Togawa is the keyboardist of Ave Mujica. She lodges aboard Rhodes Island together with the rest of the band, and actively takes on tasks of all manner aboard the ship. Her musical training and dignified manner are incontrovertible proof of her excellent upbringing.

text.en: We took in the five members of Ave Mujica at Iris's request, her wish being that we provide them temporary refuge. Given their youth and how they were stranded somewhere unfamiliar so far from home, we communicated our intent that they get some much-needed rest. However, all of them expressed that they would rather help us in exchange for their room and board, and Sakiko in particular made clear her strong desire to undertake any and all work here.
text.zh: 经过爱丽丝小姐的担保，我们接纳了包括丰川祥子在内的Ave Mujica的五名成员。爱丽丝告诉我们，希望罗德岛能为这群孩子提供暂且居住的场所。考虑到她们远离故乡且年纪不大，我们想要让Mujica的孩子们好好休息，但是她们每个人都不愿意白白留宿。特别是祥子，她很强硬地表达了希望得到一些舰上的工作的要求，无论是怎样的工作。

text.en: Sakiko is an active participant in a variety of work aboard the landship. Normally dignified and elegant, she shows no qualms about taking up simple communications assignments or manual labor tasks such as cleaning and transporting items; she carries out all her jobs without complaint. It is as though she already had a fair amount of experience with such work before coming to Rhodes Island. During work, she is always sunny and positive, while also showing care and concern for those around her. Her kind smile has left a deep impression on many operators.
text.zh: 祥子在舰上工作得十分积极。举手投足都十足优雅的她，却出乎意料地一直参与着各种基础工作。无论是简单的信息传达，还是保洁、搬运等体力劳动，她从来没有抱怨过苦和累，仿佛在来到罗德岛前她就已经习惯了这样繁重的工作。在她完成这些工作的时候，还总能带着乐观开朗的态度面对身边的人。祥子总会关心身边的干员的状况，为他人担忧，她关切的笑容给很多干员留下了深刻的印象。

text.en:
Sakiko came to Rhodes Island from the Castle of Dreams, and is almost never seen without the other members of Ave Mujica. The five of them, each thinking in different ways and pursuing different things, have been able to come together as a single band and work towards the same goal because of Sakiko.
Sakiko makes mistakes too, of course, but her strength is the ability to make decisions without fear. There would be no Ave Mujica without Sakiko's gentle strength.
text.zh:
从梦城堡来到罗德岛的祥子，总是跟Mujica的大家一同活动。她们虽是一个整体，但是每个人都有着自己的想法，追求着不同的东西。明明性格迥异，但却能紧密合作，而这都是因为祥子。
祥子当然也会失误，但是她总能勇于做出决定。祥子柔和而又坚定，正是有如此的她，才有如此的Ave Mujica。

text.en:
From the information we have, Sakiko was brought up in high society and received an excellent education from a young age, growing into a kind and affable young lady as a result. She formed her own band in emulation of a group of senior students who left a deep impression on her. Then misfortune struck; her father was forced to take the blame and resign after his company fell victim to fraud, and Sakiko was forced to quit her beloved band and work part-time odd jobs to support her broken household thereafter.
Strong-minded and refusing to give up, Sakiko would not let others see her weakness, and formed Ave Mujica in order to cut ties with her past. In spite of this, the new band was not as smooth a venture as Sakiko envisioned, and conflict arose between an inflexible Sakiko and the other band members, who would not open themselves up to her. Through all the turmoil, however, Sakiko was surely the one most mired in suffering, squarely blaming herself and proceeding to repeat her past mistakes.
All that said, Sakiko has seemed somewhat changed from that in her time aboard Rhodes Island. One wonders if she owes it to her experiences at the Castle of Dreams.
text.zh:
据我们的粗浅了解，祥子出身名门，自幼接受的教育塑造了她友爱关怀的一面。这样的祥子因为憧憬学校里的前辈而组建了自己的乐队。后来她的家中遭遇了变故，父亲因为公司遭到诈骗而引咎辞职，一蹶不振。祥子不得不退出了自己喜欢的乐队，通过一份一份的零工来维持自己破碎的家庭。
但祥子是个不愿意服输和妥协的人，她不希望在别人面前展露软弱的一面。要强的她彻底告别了过去，组建起了新的乐队Ave Mujica。然而Ave Mujica的发展也不如祥子所愿，也有大家无法打开心扉的时候。祥子的坚持引发了大家的重大争执，造成了成员的不和，但她同时也是那个最痛苦的人。她也会自责，也会迷茫，也会因为害怕而一次一次犯错。
如今在罗德岛的她似乎有了一些变化，大概是在梦城堡里经历了什么特别的事情吧。

text.en:
[Iris's Notes]
Sakiko is kind-hearted and forward-facing, cares deeply for her friends, and takes it upon herself to grapple with whatever faces her. As a result, however, she has a tendency to lose sight of what is happening around her, and in so doing, hurt her friends unawares.
Sakiko's conviction in her own decisions is firm. In her mind, she must bear the weight of the other members' lives on her shoulders, and running from this responsibility is not an option.
This is something far, far harder than she imagines it might be.
She can still be immature in places; she can still be weak and fearful, anxious that her decisions might hurt others. Moreover, she still harbors doubts that she truly can shoulder her bandmates' lives.
In the Castle of Dreams, Sakiko finally learned to believe in her own ability to fulfill her promises, but one must eventually wake up no matter how sweet the dream; she must come face to face with reality.
Sakiko will not remember what transpired here when she wakes from the dream and goes back to her old life. But I believe that a part of her experiences in the dream will stay with her and give her courage—
The courage for her to overcome all challenges, and continue to carry Ave Mujica atop her shoulders.
text.zh:
【爱丽丝记录】
祥子是一个主动，温柔，积极，很重视身边同伴的人，同时也是个总会一根筋向前，以至于不小心伤害身边同伴的人。祥子的开朗总会吸引身边的人一起跟随她，却也可能因此让她容易忽视他人感受。
祥子总是相信自己的决定。她觉得自己必须肩负身边的人的一生，她从不会逃避这样的责任。
但是做到这一点远比她想象中困难。
她也会不成熟，会害怕，害怕自己的选择会给他人带来痛苦。她也会质疑自己，是否配得上同伴们的一生。
在梦城堡的梦里，祥子最终还是相信自己可以践行自己的承诺。不管梦有多美好，她都要醒来去面对她真正的生活。
当祥子真正从梦中醒来，她不会记得这里发生的一切。但是我们丝毫不会怀疑，祥子在梦里的这些经历会留在她的潜意识里，给予她勇气——
让她勇敢面对自己、相信自己能肩负Ave Mujica走下去的勇气。

text.en: Like Sakiko Togawa, Mutsumi Wakaba comes from a well-off family. Born to famous parents, she had been the center of attention from a young age, and was childhood friends with Sakiko. Though Mutsumi often struggles to communicate her feelings, it is crystal clear how important Sakiko is to her, and how she quietly supports Sakiko.
text.zh: 若叶睦同丰川祥子一样来自名门世家。睦的父母都是当地十分有名的演员，所以睦自小就在各界的关注中成长，而她也是在那个时候成了祥子的好友。即使睦不善言辞，我们也能感受到她对祥子的重视，和她一直以来对祥子的默默支持。

text.en:
Mutsumi's struggles with communication have continued on Rhodes Island. She tends to help out with Sakiko's work where she can, seldom interacting with others on her own.
She can sometimes be found tending to fruits and vegetables on her own in the Convalescent Garden. She shows little sign of emotion when other operators talk to her, the conversation ending after a couple of short exchanges. That said, it wasn't long before people noticed that Mutsumi does not only work on her own plot; she also helps care for plants in other areas. To return the favor, the other operators help her out in kind without saying a word, working together to keep the garden beautiful.
In a later development, operators began to find paper bags at their dormitory doors, filled with produce planted by Mutsumi—in her own way, an utmost expression of her gratitude.
text.zh:
在罗德岛上，睦也不太擅长跟他人交流。睦常常在祥子工作时从旁搭把手，做一些力所能及的事，基本不会主动独自跟其他人交流。
偶尔我们会发现睦一人在疗养庭院里照料蔬果。其他负责庭院的干员想要跟她打招呼，她总是反应平淡，话也较少，没有什么情绪波动。不过干员们发现，睦不仅好好地照料了自己那一小块种植区，还帮助他人管理好了其他区域的植物。知晓这一切的干员们都会默默地帮睦照顾她的植物，大家心照不宣地一起维护着庭院。
后来，干员们留意到自己的宿舍门口总会放着睦送来的纸袋，里面装着睦种植的小小蔬果，看来她也想要努力地向大家表达感谢。

text.en:
Sakiko has asked us not to put too much pressure on Mutsumi. Mutsumi's mother is a famous actress and her father a famous comedian, leading the entertainment industry and the public to place great expectations on her, something that has troubled her all her life. Outside of her remarkable family circumstances, however, she is simply a kind-hearted girl who struggles with communication.
Sakiko tells us that she knows she cannot shelter Mutsumi all the time, but at least she wants to give Mutsumi a place where she can feel safe and comfortable.
text.zh:
祥子嘱托我们，希望罗德岛的大家不要给睦太大的压力。睦作为著名女演员和搞笑艺人的女儿，从小被整个演艺圈和大众寄予厚望，而这厚望恰恰是她最大的苦恼。明明抛开显赫的家世，睦本质上只是个不善表达、心地善良的少女。
祥子告诉我们，她知道自己并不能完全保护好睦，但是，她仍想要给睦建立一个能安心些许的地方。

text.en: Mutsumi does not talk much, but her kind heart is there for everyone to see. She always works hard to complete her missions, and other operators are impressed about how much she listens to others, as can be seen from her mission reports. As a matter of fact, Mutsumi is quite sensitive to what others say, and it is precisely her desire to live up to other people's expectations that has created pressure for her. She keeps these struggles to herself, only pushing herself harder. This personality trait has led to her suffering many times over. Sakiko, Mutsumi's childhood friend, is the only one who understands her pain. Hopefully, the support of other Rhodes Island operators will make life a little easier for Mutsumi here.
text.zh: 即使不怎么说话，大家也能知道，睦是一个内心温柔的人。睦虽然沉默寡言，但是也总会尽自己努力完成任务。大家看到任务结束后睦上交的记录就会感叹，原来这个孩子把大家的话都认真听进去了。她是如此在意身边的人的愿望，但也正是这种不想让身边的人失望的心情，成了睦最大的压力。她不擅长把这种压力带来的痛苦告诉他人，只会自己逼迫自己。这给睦带来了很多的困难，在这以前只有从小和她一起长大的朋友祥子对此有些微的了解，希望在罗德岛上，有众多干员的帮助，她能少一些这样的压力。

text.en:
[Iris's Notes]
Mutsumi has spent her entire life under the gaze of others—from her parents, from the entertainment industry, and from society at large, all wanting 'Mutsumi Wakaba' to become who they want her to be.
Under such pressure, a terrified and helpless Mutsumi played the role of a good daughter and a future star like her mother, with acting that surpassed even her mother in skill.
Mutsumi played countless 'roles' in order to protect herself. She grew more numb every time she took the stage or exited it as one of these roles, and stopped thinking about anything other than being the Mutsumi Wakaba that people wanted to see.
May Mutsumi's experiences in Terra stay with her when she wakes from the dream, giving her courage—
The courage to accept herself, the courage to accept 'Mutsumi Wakaba'.
text.zh:
【爱丽丝记录】
睦一直被身边的人注视着。那些来自母亲父亲的目光，来自演艺圈的目光，来自社会大众的目光——似乎所有人都自顾自地期待着“若叶睦”成为他们想要的样子。
恐慌无助的睦，利用她那比母亲更甚的“演技”，在各个场合里“扮演”不同的“自己”——懂事的女儿，名演员的后代。
出于自我保护，睦塑造了无数“角色”。这些“角色”一个个走上舞台，又一个个离开舞台，她已然麻木，一心只想成为别人期待的那个“若叶睦”。睦就是这样一个被这些“角色”掩埋，自我变得模糊不清的尚不成熟的少女。
当睦从故乡醒来，希望在泰拉的这些经历会留在她的潜意识里，给予她勇气——
去接纳每一个自己，不再让任何一个自己死去的勇气。

text.en: With an infectiously bright smile and excellent communication skills, Uika Misumi has fit in well at Rhodes Island. Throughout her time diligently learning the ins-and-outs of working here, Uika has earned the trust of those aboard Rhodes just like the other members of Ave Mujica.
text.zh: 三角初华在罗德岛与大家相处时，展现出了特别的亲和力。她总是对大家笑颜相向，很快，大家就喜欢上了这样的初华。初华踏实耐心地学习着罗德岛上的事务，与Ave Mujica的其他同伴一起获得了干员们的信赖。

text.en:
Though she is only in her first year of high school, Uika has already made a successful debut as a member of sumimi, an idol group from her home country. A diligent hard worker, Uika has a wonderful voice and outstanding guitar skills, and also writes her own songs and lyrics. She was scouted for Ave Mujica by Sakiko.
As guitarist-vocalist of Ave Mujica, Uika gives her everything for the band, and her deep love for it is plain for everyone to see.
text.zh:
明明还只是高一的学生，初华就已经在故乡以偶像组合sumimi成员的身份出道，并且取得了不小的成就。她有着极其美妙的歌喉、娴熟的吉他技巧，还能够自己作词作曲，在多个方面刻苦学习提高自己。后来，初华受到祥子的邀请，加入了Ave Mujica。
成为Mujica主唱的初华，无论何时都为乐队贡献着自己的全部力量，大家都能看出来，她是真的爱着这个乐队。

text.en:
Uika and Sakiko are childhood friends, which is the reason Uika joined the band. To Uika, Sakiko is more than just a friend; she is someone Uika has always aspired after.
At Rhodes Island, the pair often go up to the deck to watch the stars. Though the night sky of Terra is strange and unfamiliar, when shared with Sakiko, there could be nothing more beautiful to Uika.
text.zh:
初华与祥子自小便相识，也是得益于这一层关系，祥子才能邀请到初华加入乐队。对于初华来说，祥子不仅仅是她的好友，也是她一直以来憧憬的目标。
她们两人在罗德岛时，喜欢在夜间来到甲板上，一起看星星。泰拉的星空如此陌生，但是在这一刻的初华眼里，它也是最珍贵的美景。

text.en: We have noticed that Uika seems to put up certain subtle barriers in her interactions with us. It is not that she is not being sincere, but there is a sense that she is intentionally refraining from expressing her opinion. Compared to taking about her own thoughts, she seems to prefer to know about what Sakiko thinks. Uika's feelings toward Sakiko are more than just care or aspiration; there seem to be deeper, darker feelings within.
text.zh: 在与Ave Mujica的成员们接触的过程中，我们发现初华与他人之间总会有一种淡淡的距离感。当然这并不是指初华不是一个真诚的人，而是说，她好像不太知道要怎样展现自己的真实想法。比起说出自己所想，她总是更想要了解祥子所想。她对祥子除了关切和憧憬，似乎还有一些晦暗不明的感情。

text.en:
[Iris's Notes]
Uika has spent her life living in guilt. Though she stands by Sakiko's side, where she has always longed to be, her heart remains trapped in the past. When she feared that telling the truth would destroy the relationship they had, she found herself paralyzed in place.
When Sakiko was in pain, Uika believed that it was her and her lies who caused that pain to Sakiko, and that there was nothing Uika could do to help her. The end result was that she could not be there by Sakiko's side to support her.
One day, Uika will understand that she cannot simply hide her true feelings beneath a perfect smile. There will come a time when she must face herself.
Uika will not remember all that transpired on Terra when she wakes from the dream. But perhaps, a part of her experiences here will stay with her and give her courage—
The courage to face her own sorrow, and to move forward.
text.zh:
【爱丽丝记录】
初华一直活在内疚中。她明明已经站在了自己最向往的地方，站在了祥子的身边，但她还是无法放下过去。她害怕现状会被打破，所以她选择止步不前。
在祥子陷入痛苦时，她不敢靠近，因为她消极地认为自己的关心毫无作用。她觉得自己是骗子，是给祥子带来痛苦的元凶。
总有一天，她会明白，自己不能只是展现完美无瑕的笑容给身边的人。她是她自己，不是其他人，她不能永远隐藏起真正的自己。
当初华醒来时，她不会记得在泰拉发生的一切。但是我们希望在这里的经历能化作她潜意识里的勇气——
让她去直面自己的过去和悲伤，并且向前迈进的勇气。

text.en: Nyamu Yūtenji demonstrated great curiosity about Rhodes Island the moment she set foot on the ship. Outside of work, she can often be seen studying Rhodes Island and Terra in the archives, always declining with a smile when asked if she's in need of any help. There are still many mysteries about her.
text.zh: 来到罗德岛的若麦小姐一开始就展现出了极强的好奇心。在完成工作之余，她会在资料库里面花很多时间了解罗德岛和泰拉相关的知识。我们询问她是否需要帮助时总会被她笑着拒绝，真是神神秘秘的人啊。

text.en:
Nyamu is not just a very physically capable drummer; her bright and friendly personality has also made her many friends amongst the operators. Yet she is also highly observant, and sensitive to changes in other people's moods. By inferring what people are thinking based on their expression and body language, she is able to respond appropriately and maintain a positive atmosphere.
Everyone in the Medical Department recognizes how kind and gentle Nyamu is, though she is loath to admit it herself.
text.zh:
作为Mujica的鼓手，若麦有着较强的体能，大多数干员对若麦充满了好感。我们在跟若麦的短暂接触中发现，她随和且开朗，总能很快跟大家打成一片；她看起来十分热情亲切，却很擅长察言观色，总能很快注意到身边人的情绪变化，读出每个人真实的意愿，并做出反应，缓和气氛。
她本人不太好意思承认，但是医疗部的干员都能轻易地看出来，若麦是个善良的好孩子。

text.en:
We thought it Nyamu's talent that allowed her to perform so well, both in her band and in her work at Rhodes Island.
It was only later that we learned it was not simply about talent, but the constant hard work that she puts in on her own. She is never satisfied, always pushing herself to move forward, as though the idea she could be at a standstill angers and terrifies her.
Hopefully, she will find the opportunity to slow down and take a little time off while she is on Rhodes Island.
text.zh:
在Ave Mujica，若麦能轻松地完成极其困难的演奏，在罗德岛，她也总能得心应手地执行工作，我们本以为这都是她的天赋之才。
我们后来了解到，让她的技术炉火纯青的不仅仅是天赋，她总是一个人偷偷地进行高强度的练习，从不间断。若麦是个从来不愿意停在原地的人，她似乎一直在默默地逼迫着自己前进，像是对停滞不前的自己感到愤怒和害怕一样。
希望至少在罗德岛上，她能稍稍放缓自己的脚步，也让自己休息休息。

text.en:
Nyamu will spare no effort in pursuit of her dreams.
We have come to a hypothesis based on her actions and on excerpts of information from other Mujica members.
Nyamu is used to following the path that she believes to be most efficient, paying no heed to what other people think. Indeed, she could not even spare the time to think about whether she should give up or not.
In the presence of true genius, she found herself both awed and envious, and such emotions further fuel her fire.
text.zh:
为了实现自己的理想，若麦愿意拼尽全力不惜代价去努力。
根据若麦的行动和Mujica队员的只言片语，我们这样猜想。
若麦习惯了去选择自己觉得最快捷的道路，她不在意别人的看法，她甚至没有多余的时间去思考是否要放弃。
她嫉妒着又憧憬着身边那些真正的天才，那些不用像她一样需要付出巨大努力的人，然后将这些情绪再默默化作自己的动力。

text.en:
[Iris's Notes]
Sailing for her goal in a straight line comes naturally to Nyamu, be it in dreams or reality; it is a notion she takes for granted.
It is fortunate, then, that she could rediscover the love she once abandoned.
She will not remember what transpired here when she wakes from the dream and returns to her old life, but she will continue to pursue her ideals. May a part of this dream stay with her and give her courage—
The courage to reach out to what she loves.
text.zh:
【爱丽丝记录】
若麦觉得朝着目标直线前进是理所当然的，在她的生活中是，在梦中也是。
好在她最后还是找回了自己舍弃的爱。
当她从梦中醒来回到自己的生活，她不会记得这里发生的一切。可能她依然会鞭策着自己不惜代价地去追求既定的目标，但是至少在梦中的这些经历会留在她的潜意识里，给予她勇气——
让她去追寻自己所爱之物的勇气。

text.en:
Our first impression was that Ave Mujica was merely a student band that had stumbled upon Rhodes Island. Our thinking changed, however, as they blended into Rhodes, and began to ask how they could help.
We were surprised at how quickly Umiri Yahata absorbed new knowledge and put it into practice, and how she took the initiative in communication and working with others, supporting her team in the same way that the bass supports the rest of the band.
She is always calm, never flustered regardless of the situation—at least, so we thought.
text.zh:
我们在一开始接触Ave Mujica时，只觉得这是一支遇难的高中乐队。当她们逐渐融入罗德岛，并表示希望提供帮助时，我们对她们有了新的认识。
八幡海铃最令我们惊讶的地方在于，她快速地学习、实践，积极地沟通、协作。就像是她的贝斯之于整个乐队一样，海铃就是这样一个能支持团队的人。
她总是冷静沉稳，处变不惊，在很长一段时间里，我们都觉得她是这样的人。

text.en:
'Umiri helps out our planning work here at Rhodes. She'll draft us a whole array of plans, all of them easy to understand and execute on. She's highly reliable, and we owe more than our fair share to her.'
A very fast learner, Umiri quickly earned the trust of many teams with her thorough planning and schedule management.
She is quick to grasp the mission objective and see it through without a hitch, making her the ideal partner.
'She's a serious and brisk worker, but there's always this distance between her and us...' So operators who work with her may feel on occasion, but quickly dismiss it, assuming they're just overthinking it.
text.zh:
“海铃啊，我们确实受了她很多帮助。她帮我们分担了一部分规划工作，制定了很多简单易懂又容易执行的计划，真的很可靠……”
海铃在罗德岛上学习得很快，大家发现她总能快速地帮助各个部门清晰列出后续的规划和安排，很多小组都得到了海铃或多或少的帮助。
海铃确实是一位完美的合作伙伴，她总能够精准地理解任务的核心，并且一丝不苟地执行。
那个孩子做事很认真，但她似乎跟我们保持着微妙的距离？罗德岛的大家偶尔会产生这样的感觉，不过转念就会把它当成自己的错觉。

text.en:
It is true that Umiri has kept her distance from those around her, but it is not because she is wary of others.
She was overly eager in her first band, frequently giving instructions that she believed would help the band succeed, but ended up drawing the ire of the other band members, causing the band to fall apart.
text.zh:
我们了解到，海铃确实在刻意地保持距离。但这并不是因为她对大家有戒心。过去海铃对自己加入的第一支乐队付出了太多，为了乐队的发展做了很多工作，结果海铃的大量安排引起了乐队成员的反感，最终乐队解散，这件事导致她再也不敢对团队工作投入过多感情。她开始恰到好处地保持安全距离，并且分散情感，以此构筑起自己的心理防线。
因为害怕失去，索性让自己置身事外，海铃正是这样一个内心可爱而又笨拙的人。

text.en:
It is easy to forget that Umiri is still a young student facing challenges appropriate to her age, so outstanding are her bass skills and management ability.
She pushes herself hard with a schedule that is packed to the brim between work and practice, as well as a rigorous training regimen.
Despite her image of perfection, Umiri can find it stressful when things do not go according to plan. Binge shopping at the Rhodes Island shop is her way of blowing off steam. While the operators there are overjoyed to see her, and take photos of her with both hands full of shopping bags as commemoration, they also remind her not to go overboard with her purchases.
text.zh:
因为超强的贝斯实力和精湛的经营能力，我们甚至会偶尔忘记海铃还是个年龄尚小的高中生。
她对自己一直保持着极高的要求，她总是把自己的练习和工作安排得十分紧凑。
遇到超出计划的事情时，海铃也会积攒起压力，然后来到罗德岛商店购物消费。虽然店里的干员对此表示欢迎，还将海铃双手拎满了购物袋的照片留作收藏，但也会因为她买得实在太多而劝说她住手。

text.en:
[Iris's Notes]
On a subconscious level, Umiri is aware that the reason she cannot establish relations of trust with others is because she cannot bare her true heart to them.
She must overcome her past trauma and step out of her comfort zone, and once again reveal her heart to her friends.
When the day should come that Umiri wakes from the dream and forgets all that transpired within, may a part of what she experienced here remain with her and give her courage—
The courage to face others with her true heart.
text.zh:
【爱丽丝记录】
她将会在潜意识里面知道，自己不能得到他人信任的原因，是自己一直无法真心面对他人。
她需要克服往事带来的恐惧，走出自己为自己划定的安全区域，重新对自己看重的伙伴付出真心。
希望即使海铃从梦中醒来，忘记了这里的一切，梦里的经历仍然能化作她潜意识里的勇气——
让她能与他人真心相对的勇气。

text.en: On the subject of piety, the first person that Rhodes Island members think of is not someone from Laterano or Iberia, but Sister Nueda of the Bolívar office. She never breaks the rules, never gossips, and always appears by the side of the people who need her, asking nothing in return. Even when simply standing in a corner with her head bowed, others can sense her love and kindness, and receive strength and comfort from her presence. She follows a strict schedule every day, going to bed at 11 p.m. and waking up at 6 a.m. no matter where she is. She prays nine times during the day, then a tenth time as she mutters in her sleep. Sister Nueda's faith is highly respected, but it has also made people hesitant to approach her, other than listening to her sing in the Rhodes Island Choir. Some operators believe that, underneath the pious surface, there is a side to her that she does not let others see. [Audio Log] I had the pleasure to join Sister Nueda on a field mission. She cared for us meticulously, patted our heads after battle, and even told us bedtime stories. We're all very grateful to her... but... we're adults who can take care of ourselves. —Dobermann Sister Nueda has a wonderful voice. Even the most mundane song becomes incredibly moving when sung by her. But her love for hymns borders on obsession. Ever since she came to Rhodes Island, she has been studying the musical styles of different countries, and uses them to make new hymn arrangements. Honestly, most of them aren't bad, but I'm still trying to figure out how she came up with the idea of St. Ambrosius's Passion in Yan's xiqu style... —Czerny, Rhodes Island Choir Organist Sister Nueda? What about her? Did you assume we'd have spoken simply because we're of the same race? Does it matter whether her story about a Gallic princess traveling to Sargon in search of wisdom is true or not? Did it ever occur to you that I might provide an even more ambiguous answer? And what of it? Just because the K'uk'ulkan have millennia of knowledge in our heads doesn't mean we have to treat it as our religion. —Ho'olheyak
text.zh:
提起“虔诚”，罗德岛的每个人首先联想到的并非来自拉特兰或伊比利亚的干员，而是在玻利瓦尔办事处的努艾达修女。她从不做逾矩之事，从不讲闲言碎语，总是不计回报地出现在需要她的人身边。即便她低垂着头，静伫在角落，人们也能从她静默的姿态中感受到仁爱与慈悲，获得安慰与力量。
她每天都会严格执行既定的作息时间，无论身处何方，都会在晚上十一点准时睡下，在凌晨六点按时起身。清醒时她前前后后会进行九次祷告，而在睡梦中，她则会说着呓语，进行第十次祷告。
努艾达修女的虔诚令人尊重，也让许多人不敢轻易与她亲近，生怕打扰到她的沉思与静祷，只敢在她参加罗德岛合唱团活动时，安静坐在台下欣赏她的歌声。
不过仍有一些干员坚信，在虔诚的表象之下，努艾达修女也有着不为人知的一面。

【语音记录】
我曾经有幸和努艾达修女一起执行外勤任务，一路上，她无微不至地照料着我们，不仅全权负责小队的衣食住行，还会在战斗结束后抚摸我们的脑袋以示鼓励，甚至会在每晚入睡前，为我们讲故事。虽然很感激她，可我们明明都是有自理能力的成年人啊……
——杜宾

努艾达修女有个好嗓子，再平庸的歌曲，只要经她演绎也能变得动人无比。但她对赞美诗的偏爱实在是有些过分了，自从来到罗德岛，她就一直在尝试仿效各个国家的音乐风格，对赞美诗进行重新编曲。
我承认，它们中的大部分还不错，但是有一些就有点奇怪了，我至今也想不通，炎国戏曲风味的《圣安布罗修受难记》是怎么出现的……
——合唱团琴师车尔尼

那位努艾达修女？
啊，难道仅仅因为是同族，我们就该见上一面吗？
至于她说的故事，高卢公主远赴萨尔贡求道是真是假，有那么重要吗？
你来向我求证，就不怕我给你更加真假难辨的回答？
哦，那又如何，就算脑袋里有成千上万年的知识，也不代表“羽蛇”就要以此为信仰。
——霍尔海雅

text.en: [Post-Action Report] We were ambushed while transporting medicine, and lost contact with Sister Nueda, who had gone deep behind enemy lines while assisting us. We were making urgent plans to rescue her when she stumbled into the office with blood all over her before passing out on the floor. Fortunately, her injuries were not serious. When she woke up, she said that an armed group rescued her from the enemy camp and delivered her to the office. She left after a few days of rest to continue her journey. Later, we got news that the hostile encampment on the medicine transport route was captured by a Singas faction friendly to us, which we believed to be the group that rescued Sister Nueda. Strangely, no sooner had we sent a letter thanking them for the assistance that a letter arrived from that very group, thanking us for weakening the enemy forces and allowing them to capture the encampment with ease. If there is an unknown faction in the area that is friendly to us, we would like to request an expert scout to help us locate them, as we could use all the allies we can get... [News Excerpt] A group of guerillas consisting of deserters, farmers, and mercenaries has been active in the hills east of our position. They do not have any permanent encampments, and the identity of their leader is unknown. No one knows why they're here. While most of the soldiers believe them to be a group of disorganized rabble, our limited combat records indicate that they are quite tactically proficient. —True Bolívar Military Communique If we knew you could deal with it on your own, we wouldn't have needed to risk exposure. But I'm curious: how did you get those soldiers to turn on their own? And don't give me that crap about 'those who live by violence will die by violence'. You're responsible for the most violent situations I've seen in my life. —Letter from Sister Nueda's friend
text.zh:
【战场报告】
……药品运输途中，我们遭受了伏击，前来援助的努艾达修女因为深入敌方和我们失去了联系。就在我们紧急部署救援计划时，努艾达修女却浑身是血、跌跌撞撞地回到了办事处，随后便昏迷过去。
好在努艾达修女并无大碍，她苏醒过来后，只说是一支部队攻击敌方营地，将她救下并送回了办事处。静养数日后她便又离开了办事处，继续自己的旅程。就在她离开后，我们收到了另一则好消息——药品运输路线上敌方的驻扎地被一支同我们交好的辛嘉斯势力攻破，我们猜测或许那就是之前救下努艾达修女的部队。
但诡异的是，就在我们发去信件为对方的善行表达感激时，对方的长官却在同一时间寄来了感谢信。信中他说，正是因为我们的袭击削弱了敌方，才让他们轻而易举夺得那片营地。
如果他们并非那支部队，说明仍有未知的势力在当地活跃。希望本舰能派遣一位专业的侦察干员，帮助我们找到他们，办事处需要更多能够向我们释放善意，进而达成合作的伙伴……

【报刊节选】
近日，一支由逃兵、乡农与雇佣兵组成的游击部队被发现在我军东部山区驻地活动。他们没有固定营地，指挥者从不露面，没人知道他们出现在这里是为什么。尽管多数士兵认为他们只是一群没有组织的散兵游勇，但仅有的几次交战记录却表明他们有着成熟的战术部署……
——节选自《真正玻利瓦尔人军事特刊》

努艾达，早知道你能自己搞定，我们就没必要冒着暴露的风险赶过去了。不过我还是很好奇，你到底是怎么三言两语哄得那些士兵开始自相残杀的？
算了，猜你也只会说什么那些信奉暴力的人终究也会死于暴力，那都是鬼话。我这辈子见过的最暴力最血腥的场景，可全部是你造成的。
——摘自努艾达修女密友寄来的密信

text.en: [Interview Log] I began wandering Bolívar after my parents died. War, conflict, and dead bodies were always by my side. The heritage of the K'uk'ulkan taught me how to survive on the battlefield, but life was hard. It made me an isolated child, always keeping silent and never interacting with others. Besides, I had no need for language with the vast repository of K'uk'ulkan knowledge at my disposal. I never spoke until the age of thirteen, when I saved a gravely injured Sankta nun. We had no interaction to speak of. She was completely disfigured beneath her bandages, yet she continued to sing her hymns calmly every day, with no hint of pain in her voice. Most people in that situation would have been unable to do anything but scream. The calm and courage with which she faced her pain taught me how faith can help the soul pull through unimaginable suffering. That was when I began to dream about Laterano. I wanted to sing with her, but I was too stubborn, and only took up her melody after she had passed. By the grace of God, that was the first time words came out of my mouth. —Column 'Faith in the Fires of War', Laterano Weekly Issue 12 ...Along with a group of war orphans, Sister Nueda arrived at a Holy City that had just emerged from a nightmare. Many were still missing, and the survivors had to face the complete collapse of the foundations of their faith. Many chose to end their lives with their guns, unwilling to accept the truth. Sister Nueda was someone who had never known the beauty of the Holy City. People assumed she would turn around and leave, never speaking of faith or the Law again, but she stayed behind, walking amidst the rubble day after day, comforting all the broken souls who sought help, and guiding the lost back to the Law with the depth of her piety. As the rebuilding of the Holy City progressed, and the wounded souls of its people began to recover, her contribution caught the Lateran Curia's attention. But rather than accept the cardinals' commendation, and despite the attempts of many to persuade her otherwise, she decided to leave Laterano and return to her war-torn homeland. When I asked why she stayed and why she left, she told me that a nun had planted the seed of faith and hope in her heart, and she was simply doing the same for the Holy City. Now that faith and hope have once again taken root here, she will plant those same seeds in a soil that is even more barren. She believes that this is the revelation God had given her. —Twelve Apostles From Afar and Their Lives, Chapter 3, 'Seed of Faith'
text.zh:
【访谈记录】
在父母离世后，我便一直在玻利瓦尔流浪，自有记忆起，身边便是战乱、纷争和遍地的尸骸。
虽然从“羽蛇”传承的知识中，我找到了在战场上存活下去的方法，但生活依然很艰难，它让我变成孤僻阴郁的孩子，总是沉默，不曾与人交流。更何况，如果能够沉浸在“羽蛇”庞杂的知识中，我又有什么言语的必要。
就这样到了十三岁，我没有开口讲过哪怕一句话，直到我救下一位重伤的萨科塔修女。在与她相处的时日中，我们没有任何交流，她绷带下的肉体早已面目全非，却能每天平静地唱起赞美诗，她的歌声丝毫没有被痛苦侵染，而我以前只听过……许多哀嚎。
她经受伤痛时的坦然与坚强让我第一次感受到信仰是如何支撑一个人不被苦难所击败，就在那一刻，拉特兰令我心生憧憬，令我想要开口，为她和声。但很可惜，我那时太固执，等到她去世后，我才接过她哼的旋律。
蒙主恩典，那是我有记忆以来初次开口。
——摘自《拉特兰周报》第十二期采访专栏《战火中蒙恩的修女》

……当努艾达修女历经艰辛，带着一群经受战争之苦的孤儿来到圣城时，这里正遭受灾异，至今仍有许多同胞下落不明，而活下来的人……又不得不面对信仰的崩塌，许多难以接受的同胞用子弹结束了自己的生命。
而努艾达修女——一位从未感受过圣城美好的异乡人，在人们以为她会因此崩溃，从此远离圣城，再不谈信仰与律法时，她竟然留了下来，日复一日地行走在废墟中，安抚所有向她求助的破碎心灵，用自己的虔诚与坚定引领迷途的人重回律法的怀抱。
等到圣城的重建步入正轨，人们的心灵也逐渐治愈，努艾达修女的奉献受到了教皇厅的关注。就在枢机们决定予以表彰时，她却选择离开拉特兰，返回仍在战乱中的家乡。
许多人曾挽留她，她却一一婉拒。当我问她因何留下又因何离开，她平静地告诉我，当年一位修女在她心中留下了信仰与希望的种子，她如今只是有幸将其奉还给圣城。现在她眼看信仰与希望重又扎根在圣城，她会带着同样的期许，将律法的福音播撒到更为荒芜的土地。
她相信，这便是主在当年为她降下的启示。
——摘自《十二位远道而来的信徒及其生平》第三章《信仰的种子》

text.en:
It is public knowledge that Sister Nueda has a close friend by the name of Aurela, whom she can hardly stop talking about. She describes Aurela as a brave, polite, and approachable Sankta paladin, but no one else had ever seen this 'Aurela'.
It was only when a young man who knew about Sister Nueda's past came to find her at the office that we learned the real Aurela was almost nothing like what she had described. Aurela was an intimidating figure who frightened the children of the monastery, and took delight in dealing with soldiers and bandits who invaded the monastery in the most cruel and brutal manner.
Sister Nueda, however, turned a blind eye to Aurela's brutality, and treated the Sankta not just as a close friend, but someone whom she could entrust the monastery to. The young man sighed and said, 'I think Sister Nueda deserves better friends.'
'She doesn't need better friends. She needs the right friends. How's she supposed to protect you guys without a friend who knows how to fight?' A logistics operator patted the child's shoulder and left the room.
The operator in question had narrowly escaped death in battle half a month ago.

[Private Letter]
I've been dreaming about the time before I met you. I had to play the kind and gentle nun in front of the children, while dealing with invading soldiers out of their sight... The double life I led almost broke me.
Then you came into my life, and took the burden of cruelty from me. Finally, there was someone who could carry my violent dark side.
Stay, Aurela. You won't have to hide your true nature in front of me. Who will accept you for who you are, besides me? Your mentor? Your husband?
No, I'm the only one. The more brutal you are, the more relieved I feel. I will not project any unreasonable expectations onto you. All I need is for you to be yourself.
—Letter from Sister Nueda to Aurela written several years ago, imploring Aurela to stay at the monastery

[Confidential Record]
Aurela was a Lateran gun-knight who fell after killing a colleague, and was exiled from the Holy City. She became a mercenary in Bolívar and was responsible for numerous assassinations and attacks. It is believed that she maintains ties to Laterano, and that they had planted her there to be their... Has a close relationship with Operator Gracebearer. Her motives are currently unknown, but it is possible that she may establish formal contact with us in the future. We should continue to monitor...
—Operator Gracebearer's background report
text.zh:
办事处的干员都知道，努艾达修女有位无话不谈的好朋友，名叫奥罗拉。她总是将奥罗拉挂在嘴边，在她口中，奥罗拉是一位英勇威猛、彬彬有礼且平易近人的萨科塔游侠。可一直以来，从没人见过奥罗拉。
直到一位知晓努艾达修女过往的少年前来办事处寻找她，我们才知道奥罗拉并非努艾达修女所描述的那样。奥罗拉性格恶劣，时常恐吓修道院的孩子们，对待闯进修道院的士兵与匪徒，她的手段暴力残忍，而她本人还乐在其中。
但努艾达修女却对奥罗拉的暴行视而不见，不仅将其视作密友，甚至视作可以托付整个修道院的可靠之人。提及此事，少年叹气道：“我想，努艾达修女值得更好的朋友。”
“不，孩子，努艾达修女不需要更好的朋友，她需要适合的朋友。没有那样的狠角色陪在身侧，她要如何保护你们呢？”一位后勤干员拍了拍少年的肩膀，离开了房间。
半个月前，这位干员侥幸从战场捡回一条命。

【私人信件】
奥罗拉，最近我常常梦到那些未曾遇见你的日子，我得在孩子们面前扮演善良温柔的修女，面对前来进犯的士兵，我又要想尽办法将他们处理掉……我几乎要因为如此割裂的生活而崩溃。
幸好我遇见了你，奥罗拉，那些残忍的事可以全由你代劳，我很高兴，终于有人能承载我内心中暴力黑暗的一面。
留下来吧，奥罗拉，在我面前你再也不用掩藏自己的本性。除了我，还有谁能接受真正的你？你的老师？你的丈夫？
不，只有我。因为你越是冷酷残暴，我就越是如释重负。请你安心，在我身边，我绝不会在你身上投射无谓的美好期许，我只需要你，真正的你。
——摘自数年前努艾达修女写给奥罗拉的一封信，信中她力劝奥罗拉留在自己的修道院

【机密文件】
奥罗拉，原为拉特兰铳骑，因射杀同僚而堕天，被逐出圣城。在玻利瓦尔地区以雇佣兵身份策划多起刺杀与袭击……并非与拉特兰毫无瓜葛，暗中仍有大量联系，实则为拉特兰安插在当地的……与干员聆音私交甚密，动机未知，未来可能会与我们有正式接触，应继续关注……
——摘自聆音干员背景调查报告

text.en:
'I never meant for you to see me like this, Doctor.' Her robes are soaked with blood. Her apologetic smile does little to mitigate the terror that her appearance inspires.
'I warned you... but you came to find me anyway,' she sighs. 'How unfortunate. You're such a good person.'
She touches your cheeks with her hands, which are cold and sticky with blood. Darkness begins to fill her normally kind and compassionate eyes. You remember that her friend, Aurela, looked at you with the same cold gaze.
'Keep this a secret, won't you, Doctor? Please?' Her fingers wrap around your skull like a predatory fowlbeast's claws. You cannot help but tremble.
'Please don't look at me like that, Doctor.' She lets go and takes a couple of steps back.
She sees no fear in your eyes, only pity.
It terrifies her.
text.zh:
“我从未有意让您看见这样的我，博士。”她浑身都被鲜血浸透，嘴角的微笑带着歉意，但丝毫无法减少她此时形象的可怕程度。
“我警告过您……但您还是来找我了。”她忍不住叹息，“您是那么好的人，真是可惜。”
她捧住你的脸颊，沾满鲜血的双手让你觉得冰冷黏腻，她仁慈悲悯的眼神变得阴鸷，让你想起她的好友奥罗拉也曾用这样冷酷的目光打量着你。
“答应我，博士，为我保守秘密好吗？”她的手指像食肉羽兽的爪子一样桎梏着你的头颅，让你忍不住颤抖。
“请不要这样看我，博士。”她松开手，缓缓后退。
在你的眼中，她没有看到害怕，反而是怜悯。
这令她心生恐惧。

text.en:
1st-gen automated confessional developed by the Laterano Faith Assistive Engineering Design Bureau. It began as a stationary confessional fitted with a smart voice system, modified and fitted to a mobile chassis allowing it to move through Laterano and respond to the confession requests of citizens on the intercity net.
The classic form is the designer's taste, and gives the user an impression of simplicity and honesty.
The accuracy and response of the voice recognition system were improved, and new customization options were added, including voice types, cognition scope, and response tendencies, providing a more personalized confession experience.
The automated confessional CONFESS-47 (full serial in Curia records: LATERANO AUTOMATED CONFESSIONAL 047) joined Rhodes Island as a gift from the Lateran Curia and currently serves as an operator providing confession and other services to members of Rhodes Island.
text.zh:
由拉特兰信仰辅助器械设计所研发的第一代自律告解车。其原型为搭载了智能语音系统的固定告解室，在经过轻量化改造，并加装动力系统后，得以便捷地在拉特兰城内移动，能够及时响应拉特兰公民通过城际网络发出的告解请求。
外形上，出于设计人员的个人审美，选取了较为复古的造型，致力于给使用者留下“朴实”“诚恳”的印象。
系统上，在改进智能语音系统的识别准度与响应速度的同时，也加入了诸多自定义选项，包括语音类型、认知范畴、响应倾向性等，致力于提供私人化的告解体验。
编号为CONFESS-47（教皇厅归档的完整编号为LATERANO AUTOMATED CONFESSIONAL 047）的自律告解车作为教皇厅的礼物登上罗德岛，现以干员身份定期驻舰，为罗德岛成员提供以听取告解为主的各项服务。

text.en:
'Confession' is a concept unique to the Lateran faith, and unfamiliar to most Rhodes Island operators. People understand it in many different ways: some imagine it as a way to seek comfort by confessing one's sins and asking for forgiveness, while others see it as a way to build trust with God by dissecting one's own sins and seeking punishment. Most agreed, however, that this gift from the Lateran Curia was likely to end up as little more than an accessory in the reception room.
Surprisingly, it took only a few days before long queues started forming in front of CONFESS-47's cabin door, and most of the people lining up were not Laterans. A Lateran Messenger visiting Rhodes Island wrote a 300-page report on this remarkable phenomenon, bringing it back to Laterano to be studied by the priests.
After several months of study and discussion, the priests published a 600-page thesis arguing that confession (specifically as it pertains to confessions conducted with a confessional) is applicable to all of humanity, whether they believe in the Lateran faith or not. In the paper, they wrote:
It is human nature to give things meaning. We give any external stimulus we encounter some sort of positive or negative meaning, using it as a guide for subsequent action. The interaction between human beings is also a catalyst for the creation of such meaning. In particular, the opinions of others significantly influence the direction of such additional meaning. These additional meanings typically remain with an individual for the rest of their life, significantly shaping their views and character...Confession forms a way to eliminate additional meanings that are unnecessary.

'That's way too complicated. The truth is much simpler. Imagine that you put a grain of sand in a clam. It'll begin to secrete nacre and wrap it around the sand, until it no longer stings. But the confessional is a machine. It doesn't secrete anything; all it does is scoop the sand out for the clam and throw it away.'
'In other words, the confessional doesn't judge, whether you're bringing it joy or worry. Talk with it for a while, and you'll realize that whatever's bothering you wasn't that important after all—especially when you're trying to stifle a laugh because of a bad pun CONFESS-47 just made.'
—Exusiai, to operators whose heads were hurting after reading the aforementioned thesis
text.zh:
对于大多数罗德岛干员来说，“告解”这种独属于拉特兰信仰的行为是陌生的，人们对它的认知也五花八门。有人想象告解是“通过诉说罪孽并请求原谅的方式，求得内心的安慰”，也有人认为告解是“通过剖析自身的丑恶并求得惩罚的方式，与神明建立信任关系”。不过，大多数干员都有一个共识——教皇厅赠予罗德岛的这台“告解车”，最终大概只会成为会客室里的一件摆设。
意外的是，在来到罗德岛短短几天后，CONFESS-47的车门前就排起了长队，而长队之中多数都不是拉特兰人。之后来到罗德岛友好访问的拉特兰信使，将这种现象视作奇闻，撰写了整整三百页的报告，带回拉特兰以供修士们研究。
修士们经过数月的研讨，又写出了一篇整整六百页的论文，以证明告解（特指对告解车的告解）行为可以适用于任何现代人类，不论他是否信仰拉特兰教。根据论文所述：
为事物赋予意义乃人类之本性。人会为自身受到的任何外界刺激赋予或正面或负面的意义，以此指导自己之后的行动……人与人之间的互动亦会促进此类附加意义的产生，他人的评判会尤为显著地影响此类附加意义的导向性……通常，如此产生的附加意义会伴随人终生，并显著地改变人的观念与性格……告解作为一种用于消解不必要的附加意义的行为，理应……

“哎呀，这也太复杂啦，明明是很简单的道理。就想象一只河蚌，能产珍珠的那种。往它身体里面塞一粒沙子，它就会一遍遍地用分泌物去包裹沙粒，直到沙粒不再刺痛它。但告解车是台机器，它可不会对任何东西产生分泌物，它只会帮河蚌把沙子掏出来，然后扔掉。
“换句话说，不管你带进告解车的是喜悦还是烦恼，它都不会擅加评判。跟它多聊一会儿，就会觉得很多事其实也没那么要命——尤其是在你因为CONFESS-47的冷笑话而拼命憋笑的时候。”
——对阅读这篇论文读到头痛欲裂的干员们，能天使如是解释道
