text.en: Tippi is a Wrankwood background painter. She initiated contact with Rhodes Island in hopes of facilitating a partnership wherein we would provide medical services to Wrankwood's Infected actors and film crews. She has chosen to join Rhodes Island as a specialist operator.
text.zh: 蒂比，蓝卡坞场景喷绘师。由本人主动联系，希望推动罗德岛与蓝卡坞双方，就为蓝卡坞感染者员工和演员提供医疗服务的问题，建立相关合作关系，同时根据本人意愿，作为特种干员为罗德岛提供服务。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Tippi shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.13u/L
Operator Tippi rarely comes into contact with Originium.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员蒂比没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.13u/L
干员蒂比甚少接触源石。

text.en:
'Tippi!' An operator glared at Tippi and interrogated her. 'You made all this, didn't you? Was all that stuff real or not?'
'Tippi!' Another operator asked her with trembling hands and clenched teeth, 'Why would you do that? How did you even come up with that idea?'
Another operator punched the air silently. It took a while before he finally managed to string together a few words: 'I-I almost died of fright! I think my heart stopped!'
'Just a second, just a second!' Tippi yelled. 'C'mon, no need to overreact! I just wanted to show you guys a horror flick I worked on!'

Tippi's passion for horror films is extraordinary. Not only is she an avid viewer, she has also participated in numerous productions, and often watches them with her friends. Not just to enjoy the thrills, but also to analyze and break down the scenes and techniques.
She explains that she has a particular love for horror films because they are the most direct and simple way of studying how to build atmosphere in cinema. From backgrounds, to music, to props, to the performance itself, any weak link turns horror into comedy. She intends to learn how to keep that entire chain intact, properly conveying the atmosphere and story of the film and truly immersing the audience in fear.
Of course, the simpler reason is that she enjoys the feeling of screaming in terror with a group of friends as they huddle in a corner.
text.zh:
“蒂比。”一个干员瞪着血红的眼睛，一字一句地问眼前的人，“这都是你做的，你告诉我，刚刚那一切是不是都是真的？”
“蒂比。”又一个干员颤抖着手，咬着牙问眼前的人，“你为什么要做这样的事，你为什么会有这样的想法？”
还有一个干员沉默不语，只是抡起自己的拳头无力地捶打空气，好久才憋出来一句，“你吓死我了！你真的要吓死我了！”
“等等，等等等等！”当事人蒂比大叫起来，“各位，不要这么反应过激嘛，我只是想和你们一起看我参与制作的恐怖片而已！”

蒂比对于恐怖片的热爱非比寻常，不仅是喜欢观看，她还直接参与了不少恐怖片的制作，并拉着自己的朋友们一次又一次地热火朝天地观看它们，不仅享受被吓的乐趣，还一遍一遍地分析咂摸着里边的各种桥段、表现手法……
至于为何对恐怖片如此情有独钟，蒂比突然很认真地告诉我们：看恐怖片是一个最简单直接的研究如何塑造电影氛围的方式，因为不论是背景还是音乐，或者是道具、演员的表演，只要有一环掉链子，恐怖片就会变成搞笑片，绝对无法让人沉浸其中并真的感到害怕——如何做到每一环都正正好好，传达出电影想要传达的氛围，讲好电影想要讲的故事，这是她想从其中学习的东西。
当然，还有一个最简单的理由，那就是她的确很喜欢这种和朋友们挤在角落里，一起被吓得连声大叫的感觉。

text.en:
Despite her youth, Tippi has already accumulated quite a lot of experience in Wrankwood. Before she was a background painter, she has worked in scripts, props, lighting... name a role in a film crew, and it is more likely than not that she has done it.
As a prop technician, she watched a director combine multiple studio plates, dreaming of making the film of the century where Higashinese ninjas leap from roof to roof atop the churches of Laterano, and Lateran guns are knocked out of their wielders' hands in the bamboo forests of Yan... The final product was indeed dream-like in its wild, disconnected incoherence. She has been a makeup artist, watching the veterans transform a Forte into a Sankta using Originium Arts. She has been a VFX artist, helping create floods and earthquakes, explosions and storms for disaster movies. Tippi says that special effects are a burgeoning industry that recruits many graduates from the universities of Leithanien every year. All of that is part of everyday life on the dozens of studio plates in Wrankwood.
She has moved from job to job not because she gets bored easily, but because she wants to experience every part of the movie-making process for herself. At Rhodes Island, she has made no effort to conceal the identities of her parents and grandparents, who are all famous directors. She was also pleasantly surprised to find that Jara, who is like a grandmother to her, has ties to many of our operators. However, due to her sincere love for film, she refused to follow the path her family had planned out for her, and concealed her identity when working in Wrankwood. She wanted to try things out for herself, and make the things she loves on her own terms, be they backgrounds, props, or modifications to the script. Perhaps one day she will become a director herself, and make the movies she wants to see.
She also wants to learn more about the dark side of Wrankwood. Perhaps certain tragedies can be avoided, if there is someone there working to make things better.
text.zh:
蒂比虽然年纪不大，但在蓝卡坞已经摸爬滚打了许多年，如今的她是一名场景喷绘师，但在此之前，场记、道具、灯光……剧组中的职业，蒂比几乎已经做过大半。
比如，在蓝卡坞几十个移动拍摄地块上，曾是道具师的她见识过号称要拍一部世纪大片的导演将数个地块拼接组合，东国的忍者在拉特兰的教堂腾挪跳跃，拉特兰的铳械在大炎的竹林中被暗器击落……最终的成片仿佛一场扭曲奇特的大梦；曾是造型师的她则亲眼看着自己的前辈用源石技艺化妆，将一名丰蹄化妆成一名萨科塔；还有她曾接触过的新兴职业“实景特效师”，在灾难片中控制洪水与地裂，手搓爆炸和风雨。据蒂比说，特效片剧组现在每年都会去莱塔尼亚的大学宣讲，带回一大批刚毕业的学生。而这一切，在蓝卡坞大大小小的拍摄地块中，只是每个剧组每日都会有的日常。
不过，虽然尝试了如此多的职业，但蒂比这样做并非是三分钟热度。她告诉我们，自己是想要亲身体验电影制作的每一环，了解片场的一切。蒂比并没有像在剧组那样向我们隐瞒她祖父母与父母名导的身份，她也很惊喜地发现原来她亲爱的雅拉奶奶和我们的不少干员也关系匪浅。她之所以拒绝了家里为她安排好的，按照一个名导家族的小女儿应走的路那样在蓝卡坞发展，正是因为她对于电影有着真诚的喜爱。她想要自己去一点点尝试，用各种方法做出她自己喜欢的东西：或者是背景，或者是道具，也有可能是一段台词的修改，或许有朝一日她也会做一个导演，拍出她自己喜欢的电影。
以及，她也想多一点、再多一点地了解蓝卡坞，那些光鲜之下的灰暗面，她想能再多做一点什么，如果有人在持续不断地努力，或许，有些事情就不会发生。

text.en:
The serial murders that occurred on the set of the last film Tippi worked on were all over the newspapers of Columbia for a while. The killer, Moira—who slaughtered multiple people who were involved in the death of her sister five years ago—was a good friend of Tippi's.
Tippi was angry at her friend's deception, but also earnestly reminisced about the time they spent together. She roamed across Columbia in those days, for one more chance to see Moira. However, she only saw Moira once before her sentence was carried out. The warden told Tippi that Moira was allowed to work under supervision in her last days, making many items that were useful to the prisoners, as well as props for Wrankwood.
'We didn't approve your visits because the inmate said she didn't want visitors.
'She finished her last prop on the day the sentence was carried out. It was a sunny day, and she didn't leave any message behind except to say that she was sorry, and that she would atone for her crimes with her death.
'I'm afraid that's all we're allowed to disclose.'
That was the only thing Tippi heard from the prison. But she could imagine how Moira spent her last days. She is glad that her friend was finally free of the delusions that had plagued her, of thinking she had a sister that loved her. Moira's final days were real, and fulfilling.
She also thinks about the things she can do to prevent a tragedy like Laura's from happening again, and to prevent other people like Moira from being driven into a corner by scorn and belittlement. Perhaps it would have to start with her getting to know people on a deeper level, or by providing more direct help.
She wants to do something.
text.zh:
只要看一眼哥伦比亚的新闻和报纸就不难得知，在蒂比之前工作的片场发生了一起轰动整个蓝卡坞的连环血案，凶手似乎是为了给自己五年前去世的姐姐复仇，杀死了剧组多名与当年事件有关的人员，而那名凶手，正是和蒂比在片场关系相当不错的一位好友，莫伊拉。
蒂比那段时间在哥伦比亚四处奔走，也是为了能再次探视莫伊拉。她既愤怒于朋友当时对她的隐瞒与欺骗，也怀念她们真心相处的时光。但除了第一次会面，一直到最终行刑前，蒂比都没能再见到莫伊拉最后一面。典狱长只告诉了蒂比，莫伊拉在最后的时间里被允许在看管下前往后勤部门进行义务劳动，在那段时间，她给监狱制作了很多犯人们用得上的东西，也给蓝卡坞的剧组制作了大量的道具。
“犯人并不想接受探视，所以后来那几次都没有通过你的申请。
“行刑的那一天她在做最后一件道具，正好做完也到了时间。那天天气不错，她也没有留下什么话，只说自己很抱歉，并会用自己的死亡来表示忏悔。
“就是这些，再多的我们也不能透露了。”
蒂比说，最后她收到的就只有这样的几句话，她似乎也能想象出莫伊拉是怎样度过最后的时间的。她有些释然自己的朋友能在最后的时间里，没有仍旧像之前那样，沉浸在那不知从何处而来的虚妄与幻想之中，认为自己有一个爱自己的姐姐，而是度过了一段真实的、充实的时间。
她也时常会想，她自己能再做点什么，能让五年前那个叫作劳拉的女孩的事情不会再发生，能让以后不再会有像莫伊拉这样因为遭受轻视和排挤，最终被无处宣泄的情绪推着走上绝路的人。或许，是从她自己开始多走进每一个人的内心，或许，是直接地帮助那些人。
她很想做点什么。

text.en:
From FEater's sudden retirement to Roberta's departure, it is not hard to piece together a picture of Wrankwood from the accounts of our operators who came from there. Factory-like movie production pipelines, the flimsiness of the silver screen's facade, an ever-repetitive cycle of work and publicity, the hundreds of dream-chasers who starve to death year after year, and the concealment of this darker side beneath the bright surface.
Tippi does not deny any of this. She admits that her willingness to persevere and keep trying new things at Wrankwood was made possible by her parents' and grandparents' status as famous directors, and the love and care that Jara showed her. Even though she had walked her own path and earned everything herself, it was her family ties that taught her about Wrankwood's dark side and how to deal with it. And it is because of these same ties that she is able to laugh off any scorn or abuse she encounters on the set, allowing her to focus solely on what she wants to do. If not for that, she would be one of the thousands of people huddling in tiny rented spaces and working multiple jobs trying to make ends meet in Wrankwood.
Tippi does not deny Wrankwood's status as a 'factory of dreams', either. She has met many friends in the years she has worked there. It is not unheard of for a small-town girl to work her way to stardom, a humble stagehand to be brought to tears when they see their own name at the end of the credits, or for an abandoned plate to be repurposed as a studio plate, creating temporary jobs for the unemployed to be extras and stagehands, and giving them a reprieve as they look for the next job. In recent years, Wrankwood has even implemented policies that protect the jobs of Infected actors, provided they can afford the expensive insurance fees—a first step in a long journey for Infected rights, so to speak. Many dreams have come true in Wrankwood, and many people got their first jobs here. Even Tippi's own family, people who've been through the ins and outs of Wrankwood, have their eyes light up when they run across the town's first silent picture.
That said, she does understand why FEater and Roberta left: the exploitation and abuse is still there, and it is happening every day. For their part, FEater and Roberta also understand why Tippi has chosen to stay: she has a dream to chase, one that still has a chance of coming true—it is, after all, Wrankwood.
Yet Tippi has also told us that she wants to establish a union, not just to work with Rhodes Island to further protect the rights of Infected cast and crew, but also to help people like Laura and Moira, people struggling at the bottom rung of Wrankwood's ladder. To create a better environment for them, so that they will not have to fall by the wayside on the path of dreams.
text.zh:
食铁兽的突然息影，罗比菈塔的毅然离开，从已经加入罗德岛的几位前蓝卡坞电影从业人员的口中，我们很容易就能拼凑出一个蓝卡坞大概的模样：流水线的创造，银幕中一个个被精心打造得完美光鲜但无比虚假的假象，千篇一律的应酬和工作，空有梦想却没有资本的人一年会饿死几百个，而所有人都不约而同地将所有的腌臜掩盖在亮丽之下。
蒂比并不否认这些，她承认祖父母与父母的名导身份，和雅拉对她的宠爱与关怀都是她能在蓝卡坞坚持下去、一直大胆尝试的底气。虽然她确实不靠他们为自己铺路，一切都是自己争取来的，但没有这些因素，她也不会小小年纪就知晓蓝卡坞的阴暗面并知道该如何应对。在剧组里受了辱骂与轻视之后，她可能也无法真的像现在的自己这样一笑了之，只专注于自己最想做的事，她也很可能会是一个缩在出租屋里，一边打几份工一边贴补家用，把小小的片场当成自己全部生活的在蓝卡坞最常见的人。
不过，蒂比也并不否认，蓝卡坞确实是一个“造梦工厂”。她在蓝卡坞摸爬滚打的这几年，认识了不少来自天南地北的朋友，这里不是没有小城市来的女孩靠自身努力最终成为一代影后；也不是没有最普通的工作人员在看到自己参与制作的电影上映，影片结尾滚动着自己名字时热泪盈眶；还有原本被废弃的整个移动地块，由于被剧组看上而被买下作为拍摄地块，连带着原本失业的人们也成为临时演员和场工，有一个过渡喘息的时间寻找下一份工作……就在前几年，蓝卡坞还出台了感染者演员劳动保护条例，虽然仍旧需要缴付高昂的保险费用，但在保障感染者工作的进程上，也算是迈出了第一步。蓝卡坞让很多人在这里实现了梦想，也让很多人获得了一份工作的机会。蒂比甚至见过，自家那些已经在名利场里浸淫许久的长辈们，在偶然看到蓝卡坞第一部黑白默片的时候，眼中仍会流露出光芒。
她能理解为何食铁兽和罗比菈塔会选择离开：那些吃人不吐骨头的事情每天都在发生；食铁兽和罗比菈塔也能理解为何蒂比会选择继续留在这里：她仍有梦想在追逐，并且有朝一日或许真的能实现——蓝卡坞本身就是一个这样的地方。
不过，蒂比也相当认真地向我们提出过，她希望能成立一个工会，不仅想与罗德岛合作更进一步保障感染者员工和演员的福利，她也想为那些像劳拉或者是莫伊拉一样在蓝卡坞最底层挣扎的人们，创造一个更好的环境，不要让他们就那样轻易地夭折在追梦的路上。

text.en:
Vroom! A shadow flies across the sky, and the operators out in the Columbian wilderness start cussing out this 'crazy bastard'.
'What is he even here for? We always run into him on missions. He doesn't go when we ask him to, and jets upward as soon as we get close. Melee operators can't reach him, but there's no time to get a ranged operator. He doesn't do anything when he approaches, only fly around with his jetpack. Is he just trying to show off?'
'We had someone look into him, and apparently he was someone who quit a university job to put together weird stuff like this. And he's pretty darn good at it, to tell the truth. It took so much effort to get close enough to ask whether he was interested in working together, but he turned us down without a second thought and flew away! Seems like the kinda guy who only does what he wants to, and only talks to people he wants to.'
'Son of a gun!'
The squad leader curses as he instructs his operators to intercept the intruder. 'Good timing, Tippi! You can fly too, right? Go get him out of here and tell him not to get in the way of our mission again!'
'Roger!'
Tippi takes to the air with her own flying equipment, operating it with great proficiency—in fact, her movements and techniques are almost an exact mirror of her counterpart. When they eventually intercept one another, they look at each other with questioning glances through their helmets, before suddenly embracing each other—
Tippi: 'What are you doing here, master?!'
Jetman: 'My best student! I haven't seen you for so long!'
Operators: 'Wait, you two know each other?!'
text.zh:
咻——天空中飞过一个黑影。正在哥伦比亚荒野上作战的干员们忍不住骂骂咧咧起来：“‘喷气人’！又是这个怪家伙！又是他！”
“也不知道是来干什么的，出任务总是会遇到，让他走也不走，一接近他就飞起来！近战干员接近不了，反应过来再派远程干员去又来不及，每次过来啥也不干，就是背着他那个喷气背包飞来飞去！干什么，炫耀吗？”
“之前派人专门调查联系过他，好像是个辞了大学的职务专门折腾这些古怪装置的人，说实话技术挺厉害的。好不容易有机会询问了有没有合作意愿，他直接拒绝然后就飞走了！感觉是那种只做自己喜欢的事，只和合自己眼缘的人来往的人……”
“烦死了！”
小队长一边骂，一边指挥手下干员赶紧去拦截这个讨人厌的家伙：“蒂比，正好！你也有浮空装置，快，上去把他赶走，告诉他别再过来干扰我们执行任务了！”
“好的收到！”
咻——蒂比也飞上天空。她熟练地操作着装置在空中飞来绕去，不知为何，两人操控装置的技巧、招数，包括拦截对方飞行的方法都十分相像……终于，在天上绕来绕去的两个人撞到了一起，头盔中的两个人怀着疑惑的心情仔细瞧了瞧对方，突然抱在一起大叫起来——
蒂比：“师父？你怎么在这里？！”
“喷气人”：“哎？好徒弟！好久不见！”
干员们：“啊？你们认识？！”

text.en:
Lemuen is a citizen of Laterano entitled to the rights listed in Clauses 1 through 13 of the Laterano Constitution. She is currently a cardinal of the Lateran Curia's Seventh Tribunal.
While Lemuen claims to be visiting Rhodes Island as the family of an operator, her presence here must be treated as an official visit by a representative of Laterano. During her visit, she will provide us assistance in accordance with our agreement.
text.zh:
蕾缪安，拉特兰公民，适用于拉特兰一至十三项公民权益，现任拉特兰教皇厅第七厅枢机。
蕾缪安本人称自己来到罗德岛可以被视作干员家属来舰探亲，但她的到访在程序上仍需被认定为拉特兰代表对罗德岛的正式访问。访问期间，蕾缪安将依照协议为罗德岛提供各种形式的协助。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is confirmed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Lemuen shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L
Lemuen submitted her full patient records from Stevonus Central Hospital. We agree with their conclusion that continued rehabilitation and avoidance of secondary injury may allow her to regain the ability to walk, but it is a process that could take years or even decades. There is no guarantee that she will walk normally again in her lifetime.
Lemuen was very calm when we explained this to her, as though she had expected it. That afternoon, she brought us desserts, calling them a token of gratitude for the care we showed during the examination.
I know what she was truly thanking us for, though... It was for telling her the truth.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
蕾缪安没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.12u/L
蕾缪安提交了她在司提望区中心医院的完整病历。我们得出的结论与院方相似，如果能保持康复训练，并杜绝任何形式的二次伤害，蕾缪安仍有可能恢复行走能力，但这一过程相当漫长，可能耗费数年到数十年不等……我们确实无法保证，蕾缪安在有生之年一定还能正常行走。
我们向蕾缪安说明了上述情况，她表现得异常平静，仿佛早就清楚我们要说什么。当天下午，她若无其事地捎来了甜点，说是为了感谢我们在体检时对她的照顾。
但我知道她实际上在感谢什么……她是在感谢我们把实情告诉了她。

text.en:
After being created cardinal, Lemuen gave the Seventh Tribunal's office a complete makeover, connecting several floors and making a rest space in the atrium. Office areas were rearranged based on function and interaction, and a dedicated channel for transferring physical documents was created in order to address the inefficiency and risks of human delivery.
She also set up suggestion boxes for various areas in the atrium that cover a wide range of issues, from the Seventh Tribunal's policies to the cafeteria menu. She reads and responds to each suggestion personally.

Yes, the office building of the Seventh Tribunal has been completely rebuilt. It is now more like a computer than an office, with Cardinal Lemuen as the central processing unit. It is fortunate to have a colleague who understands the value of efficiency and has successfully implemented such a system. If only she were allowed to hold positions across multiple tribunals.
—Executor Federico, in his report after a joint project

[Report on Renovation of the Seventh Tribunal's Office Area]
...The renovation of the Seventh Tribunal's office is now complete. Expenses were within budget, and quality checks are complete. The new office area is now ready for use.
Note: A minor incident occurred during renovation, but has been properly resolved and did not result in any material impact on the project.
[Review Committee Meeting Minutes]
'This 'minor incident' she mentions was a chain explosion caused by stray fireworks from a passing procession. Numerous unauthorized personnel entered the scene and held an impromptu explosion party with the construction team, resulting in a scene of extreme chaos. How's that a 'minor incident'?'
'It occurred on the afternoon of the 23rd? But the inspection report on the morning of the 24th said 'No issues', right?'
'Cardinal Lemuen must have dealt with it on her own. Should we have a talk with her? She could have requested our assistance for accidents like these.'
'She used to report them, but all our response officers could do once they arrived was stare at the spotless scene after everything was already dealt with.'
'...Send an announcement to remind the other departments and teams. As for Cardinal Lemuen... well, I guess that's who she is.'

That's what my sister was like at home too. Not just the suggestion boxes—she always has everything figured out, from how we decide where to go on a trip, how we make up after a fight, and how we treat each other at home.
As for the trouble I used to cause when I was little... Heh, I've lost count of how many times she's smoothed things over for me.
—Exusiai
text.zh:
蕾缪安上任后，对七厅的办公楼进行了脱胎换骨的改造：几个楼层被打通，开辟出了中庭的休息空间；办公区域根据职能进行划分，依照对接的频繁程度作了空间上的合理排布；实体文件的传输设立了专门的管道系统，以杜绝人力传递可能导致的低效问题和种种意外情况……
除此之外，蕾缪安还在中庭的休息空间设置了整整一圈用途各异的意见箱，广泛接收各类意见。从对七厅工作方针的见解，到对团建餐点选择的提议……蕾缪安都会亲自回复并处理。

是的，第七厅的办公楼被完全改建了，比起常规意义上的办公楼，它现在更像是……一台计算机的机箱。至于中央处理器，就是枢机蕾缪安本人。一位能够理解并践行真正高效的工作方式的同僚……很遗憾程序上不允许她同时担任其他几厅的枢机。
——执行者费德里科，在一次对接工作后如是评价

【有关第七厅办公区域改建项目的报告】
……综上所述，第七厅的办公区域已经完成改建，项目开支与预算相符，项目结果已通过质量检验。办公区域即日起便可正式投入使用。
附：施工过程中出现的小事故已得到妥善处理，未对项目造成任何实质性影响，还请审查小组理解。
【改建项目审查小组的会议记录】
“她报告里写的‘小事故’，其实是楼下的烟花游行队不慎把烟花射进了正在通风的施工现场，引发了连环爆炸，导致附近的无关人员大规模涌入，与施工队一同举办即兴爆炸派对。整个场面极其混乱，哪里像是小事故了？”
“事故是23号下午发生的？但24号早上的视察报告，我记得是写着‘一切正常’吧？”
“那显然又是蕾缪安枢机当天自己把事情处理了。我们是不是该约谈她一次？出现这种事故本来是可以向我们申报求助的。”
“以前她不是每次都申报？但我们的对策专员到场的时候，还不是只能对着已经处理妥当、光亮整洁的现场干瞪眼？”
“……事后发个公告提醒一下其他部门和项目组吧。至于蕾缪安枢机……谁叫她是蕾缪安呢。”

老姐在家也这样。可不止意见箱哦，从出行时决定去处的方法，到吵架之后和好的方式，家里人现在的相处模式，几乎都是老姐琢磨出来的。
至于我小时候闯的祸……啊哈哈，我都数不清老姐到底帮我摆平过多少啦！
——能天使

text.en:
The first time I observed my biological father, he did not know I was watching him. The moment our eyes met, he frantically made my powdered milk and changed my diapers. For a long time, he seemed to believe that I only looked at him when I was hungry, sleepy, or needed my diaper changed.
After my grandmother died and he separated from my biological mother, something seemed to change in him. He would come to my crib every day to talk to me, telling me about his loneliness and helplessness. I understood very little of what he said at the time, but it was more interesting listening to him than staring at the ceiling. As I listened to him talk, I started to imagine strange things, picturing him shrinking until he was smaller than I was, lying on a bed, unable to move. That was how I understood the concept of 'growing old' at the time, and in my imagination I would be sitting by his bedside talking to him.
That was when I first said the word 'papà', and this light appeared above my head.

The first time I observed our parents, they didn't know I was watching them either. They stood for a long time at the door to my room, playing rubber-bullet roulette to decide what was for supper as they peeked into my room. When they left, I saw them high-five each other for opening the car door at the exact same time, like two little kids. I started imagining them taking me to a lake outside the city, with me in-between them, making footprints both shallow and deep on the shores, and walking over each other's. When the sun set, we'd look back and see that we'd only left a single row of footprints, and we'd high-five each other like three little kids.
That was when I told the Notarial Hall officer that I liked that family.

The first time I observed you, you were lying in your crib, but I had a feeling that you knew I was watching you. Do you remember how you grabbed my hair and tried to eat it? You called me 'sis' before I could react.
That was when I truly began to treat you as a sister.
Yes, I started treating you as my dear sister because I pictured us being with each other.
What exactly did I see? That's a secret. But I'm not telling you this as a riddle. I just wanted you to know that what I see in my head aren't predictions or even expectations for the future. I've never decided to get along with somebody simply because I predicted that I'd be happy with them... Besides, none of those images ever come true. I never had the chance to care for my biological father in his old age, and I doubt our parents and I will ever walk on a lake shore together.
But I feel like if you're going to be spending a lot of time with someone, you should be able to clearly imagine what that would look like. Only then can I be confident in us building that relationship.
So, those Rhodes Island operators you've been introducing me to, the ones who can use prophetic Arts... Maybe we'll become friends, but I won't ask them to predict my future. If I really could tell the future, and everything I pictured came true... That's when I would stop trying to get along with anyone.
text.zh:
我第一次认真地观察我的生父时，他并不知道我在看他。一和我对上眼神，他就手忙脚乱地给我冲奶粉、换尿布。很长一段时间里，他好像都觉得我盯着他看的原因无非是饿了、尿了，或是睡不着了。
但从我的祖母离世，我的生母与他分居的那天起，他好像突然想通了什么似的，开始每天来婴儿床前跟我说话，毫无顾忌地讲起他的孤独与无助。那时的我几乎听不懂，但听他讲话总归比每天盯着天花板有趣。他讲得多了，我也渐渐开始没来由地想象起一些奇怪的画面。我想象着他有一天缩得比当时的我还小，躺在床上一动也不能动——当时的我是这么理解“衰老”的啦——而我每天站在床边陪他说话。
就是在那时候，我第一次开口叫了“爸爸”，长出了脑袋上这顶“日光灯”。

我第一次认真地观察咱们的爸爸妈妈时，他们也不知道我在看他们。他们在我的房间门口站了很久，一边若无其事地用软胶铳弹轮盘赌决定着晚饭的菜谱，一边偷偷摸摸地往我的房间里瞥。他们走的时候，我看到他们像两个小孩一样，因为同时打开了车门而兴奋地击掌。我没来由地想象他们开车带我去城外的湖畔，一前一后把我牵在中间，在滩涂上深一脚浅一脚地走着，后面的人踩着前面人的脚印。直到太阳下山，回头看见身后只有一串脚印，就会像三个小孩一样兴奋地击掌。
就是在那时候，我第一次告诉公证所的姐姐，我其实很喜欢这个家庭。

我第一次认真地观察你的时候，你还在婴儿床里面呢。但我觉得，那时候的你一定知道我在看你。还记得吗，你扯住我的头发就要放进嘴里啃？我还没反应过来，你就开口喊了“姐姐”。
我其实也是在那时候，才第一次管你叫“妹妹”。
是哦，是因为我在那时候想象到了我们相处的一个小小的画面，才真正决定把你当最亲爱的妹妹的。
那是什么画面？保密。我今天又把这些事讲给你听，可不是为了谜底大揭秘的。我只是想让你知道，我这些没来由的想象，完全不是什么对未来的预测或期望。我可不是因为预知到未来会幸福，才决定和一个人好好相处的……况且，你看，我的想象一个都没有成真过哦。我没能真的照顾我的生父到老，和爸爸妈妈一起去湖边散步，恐怕也实现不了啦。
我只是觉得，要认真和一个人相处，我至少要能清晰地想象出我们相处的时候是什么模样才行。这样，我才有信心把这段关系变得很好很好。
所以，你好多次给我热情介绍的，罗德岛上那几位真的会预言法术的干员……我搞不好能和她们都成为朋友，但我肯定不会请她们帮我做预言哦。如果我真的能预知未来，我的那些想象也都能应验的话……我想，或许我就不会和任何人相处了。

text.en:
[Relic Inquiry Request]
To whom it may concern, Notarial Hall:
We did not find Lemuen's baby handprints and footprints among the effects of her biological parents after we adopted her.
She has expressed a strong desire for them, and we consider it very important for her mental health. We would like to ask whether they are currently in your possession, and whether it is possible to transfer them to us.
July 19, 1073

[Complaint letter, Family Suggestion Box]
Why does sis always take so long in the shower?
She's in the bathroom for like half an hour after the sound of water stops! What's she doing in there?
Can we at least make it so she's always the last to shower at night?
—El, 1085-08-02

[Audio Log, 1101/09/23]
They cut out a shot with blood in this scene, didn't they?
No, I'm not complaining, I just happened to notice.
Most people don't notice? Yes, I know. No, I'm not thirsting for more bloodshed in the movies I watch, although I guess I HAVE made you watch quite a few splatter films with me.
You're curious why I pay attention to these things?
Unlike a lot of critics, I don't think blood and gore are sacrilegious... They mean something to me.
When I was little, I took a lot time in the shower. No, I wasn't obsessed with cleanliness, but I would observe myself in the mirror after turning off the water, just like I observed everyone else.
Just as I see in others the possibility of getting along with them, I saw my own possibilities in myself. I would imagine the places this body could take me, the things we could do together. It began at a very young age, maybe as early as when my biological father bought my baby handprints and footprints... Isn't it amazing that my hands and feet could permanently leave their mark somewhere?
I imagined a lot of things. The more I imagined, the more I got along comfortably with myself. But you know what happened next.
When I was bedridden, I didn't dare look in a mirror for a long time. I knew I didn't have any scars, and I wasn't worried about being ugly... I just feared that I wouldn't be able get along with myself like I used to.
That is, until Mostima started playing movies in my ward. It was a B-movie like we used to see in theaters, one with more than its fair share of gore. But when I saw that blood on screen, instead of making me uneasy, I felt a strange sense of... comfort.
Because that's all there is to the human body, this body I'd observed for so long, isn't it? A bag of blood and meat that could fall apart at any time.
It's not really logical, but when I saw all that gore, I suddenly felt foolish for entrusting all of my possibilities to this sack of meat. And even if it no longer listens to me, perhaps I was still in charge of my own future.
I spent a few more years in the hospital, but I used that time to accomplish something quite impressive.
You want to know what it was? It's this wheelchair I'm sitting in, most of which I designed from the hospital bed.
Would you like to hear everything it can do?
text.zh:
【一份遗物查询申请】
尊敬的中庭公证所：
我们在领养蕾缪安，收领她的亲生父母为她留下的遗物时，并未在其中发现蕾缪安小时候的宝宝手足印。
蕾缪安表达了对该物品的强烈渴望。事关蕾缪安的心理健康，有劳贵方确认，该物品是否正由贵方保管？如果是，能否移交给我们？
1073年07月19日

【家庭意见箱里的一封投诉信】
我要投诉！
老姐每次洗澡都要花好久——好久，水声都停了，她还至少要在里面待半个小时才出来！她到底在里面干什么？
以后能不能让老姐每天晚上最后一个洗澡！
——乐，1085.8.2

【语音记录，1101/09/23】
博士……这里，剪辑掉了流血场面吧？
嗯？我没有什么意见哦，只是恰巧注意到了。
一般人可不会注意这个……？我知道的啦。但，我并不是真的喜欢流血场面哦。虽然拉着你看了很多血浆电影就是了。
你想知道我为什么会注意这些？
我只是不像很多批判者那样，觉得流血场面毫无底线、亵渎圣灵之类的……那些场面对我是有意义的。
小的时候，我每次洗澡都要占用浴室很久。我当然没有洁癖啦，只是关掉水之后，我会忍不住对着浴室的镜子去观察自己……就像我观察每一个人。
所以，就像我会在其他人身上看到我与他们相处的可能性，我在自己的这具身体上，也会看到我自己的可能性。我会想象这具身体能带我去到哪里，做些什么。这样的想象从很早很早的时候就开始了，或许是从我的生父给我买来宝宝手足印的时候……我的手和脚，能在印泥上永久地留下那样的痕迹，不是一件很神奇的事吗？
我想象了很久、想象了很多。这种想象越是丰富，我就越能安心地“和自己相处”。不过，后面发生了什么，你也知道啦。
卧床的时候，我很久不敢照镜子。我知道自己没有留下伤疤，我哪里都没有变得更丑陋……我只是害怕自己没法再好好地“和自己相处”。
直到莫斯提马那个家伙，没心没肺地在我的病房里放电影。那是部我们以前泡录像厅时常看的烂片，里面恰好血浆成分多了些。但，看到那些本该让我觉得不适的流血场面时，我居然意外地……感到安心。
其实，人的身体——我观察了那么久的这具身体——就只是这样，不是吗？一摊血，一堆肉，随时都可能“啪”地一声散架。
虽然没什么逻辑啦，但确实是在看到流血场面的那一刻，我突然觉得，把自己所有的可能性都寄托在一堆血肉上面，是不是有些太傻了？哪怕它们都不再听我的话了，我未来的可能性，是不是还能由我自己决定？
那之后我又在病房里待了好几年，不过，那些日子里，我做了件很了不起的事。
是什么？就是我身下的这架轮椅呀，我在病床上完成了它绝大部分功能的设计。
你想听听吗，它都能做到些什么？

text.en: Why do you see the reinstitution of mercenary guards, as exemplified by Landen, as a step back for Laterano? Whether you admit it or not, the sanctity of Laterano is fading. Can you picture the couriers of Leithanien proclaiming the revelation that the Sankta come from the same roots as the Sarkaz? Have you thought about how many times the Maylander Foundation has updated its report on the military value of the Law? A more formal organization? Do not forget that every Sankta, from the moment they obtain their patron firearm, is de facto part of a formal military organization. Laterano does not want for military strength, yet the best we can protect is this city beneath our feet, as well as an area of several hundred square kilometers around it. But the protection the Lateran faith once offered extends far beyond that, and as such we must rely on the strength of the mercenary guards beyond its borders. You have already perused the proposal on accommodating the war refugees seeking sanctuary in Laterano. Did you ever stop to consider why it was not a town or a castle that protected them from the wars of Bolívar for a decade, but a monastery built to serve our Law? It may be arrogant, but it cannot be denied that our monasteries across Terra, numbering more than a hundred, have provided sanctuary to believers who have never even once seen the white walls of Laterano—believers who may be even more devout than we are—on the strength of their sanctity alone. After our First Saint revealed the truth to all, however, this sanctity has become a curse, an excuse for those with ulterior motives to justify pillage and murder in the name of justice. Yes, it is the Seventh Tribunal's duty to protect and restore Laterano's international reputation. How do you intend to achieve that, then? Another summit? In the previous summit, we at least offered a reason and a venue for peaceful dialogue between nations. Today, we have few if any chips to bargain with. Before we can demonstrate our innocence to nonbelievers, we must first demonstrate to our believers that Laterano still offers salvation. This is the duty of the Seventh Tribunal, and of myself, Lemuen. I ask you, assembled cardinals, for your cooperation. —Lemuen, Cardinal of the Seventh Tribunal, addressing the college of cardinals
text.zh:
诸位为什么会一致认为，重新启用以兰登为首的雇佣制卫队，是拉特兰的退步？
不论诸位是否承认，拉特兰的神圣性都正在消失。诸位是否可以想象，就在此刻，远在莱塔尼亚的传令官正高声禀报，因信仰而纯洁的萨科塔，其实与萨卡兹一脉同源？诸位又是否设想过，在梅兰德的会议室，呈给基金会负责人的有关“律法”军事价值的报告，已经更新到了第几个版本？
更为正规的编制？恳请诸位不要忘记，我们之中的每一位萨科塔，从获得守护铳的那一刻起，就已经可以被视作是正规编制下的武装力量。拉特兰或许并不那么欠缺武力，但我们所能守卫的只有我们脚下的这座城市，与它周围几百平方千米的土地，仅此而已。
而拉特兰的信仰曾经所荫庇的，远不止这小小的一隅。在拉特兰之外的土地上，我们需要借助雇佣制卫队的力量。先前来到拉特兰寻求庇护的战争难民的安置方案，诸位应该已经读过。诸位是否思考过，能在玻利瓦尔的战火中护他们十年周全的，为什么不是一座村镇、一座城堡，而偏偏是一间修道院，一间为侍奉我们的律法而建的修道院？
或许有些傲慢……但我无法否认，广布泰拉大地的上百间修道院，靠着所谓的“神圣性”，庇护了诸多从未见过拉特兰的白墙，却可能在某些方面比我们更为虔诚的信徒。但在我们最初的圣徒将历史的真相公之于众的那一刻，这所谓的“神圣性”就注定会被腐化成一个恶名，一个可以让别有用心之人把烧杀抢掠矫饰为“伸张正义”的契机。
诚如诸位所言，维护甚至挽回拉特兰的国际形象是第七厅的职责，但在诸位的设想中，这一目标该如何实现？难道是倚仗又一届峰会？上一次峰会时的拉特兰姑且还能为诸国提供一个和平对话的理由和场所，如今的拉特兰，则很难拿出任何值得一提的筹码。
在我们向所有不信者证明自身的清白之前，我们应当首先给所有信徒一个清晰的讯号——拉特兰仍有救赎可言。
这是第七厅的职责，是我蕾缪安的职责。
还请诸位枢机配合。
——拉特兰教皇厅第七厅枢机蕾缪安，于枢机会议上的陈词

text.en:
The first time I saw her was on an old wall on the edge of the city, abandoned and forgotten because of plate rearrangements. Aside from my garage, there were only a few retired folks in this old district, soon to be demolished. There shouldn't have been anyone I didn't know.
It was a windy night. She sat on the wall, her legs like two dried branches, swaying stiffly in the wind. A wheelchair was parked behind her, reflecting the pale moonlight. I kept an eye on her as I searched the address book for the Notarial Hall's number, afraid that she would do something stupid if I looked away.
She did nothing, except look at me with a gaze so sharp I could not shake it even if I shed my whole skin. She raised a finger to her lips in a gesture to shush me. I put away my terminal, and by the time I looked back at her, her gaze had turned towards the night sky.
I don't know why she climbed that old wall, or how, but I was relieved that she didn't intend to take her own life.
After that, I saw her on the wall from time to time. I would wave at her, and she would wave back. I began to suspect she sat there for the same reason I wandered the old district at night. Laterano's days belonged to the noisy, happy crowds. Its nights belonged to the homeless vagabonds, to the angels whose empathy had gone awry, even to hooded Sarkaz—the ones who don't fit in, the ones who are broken.
The night before the old district was scheduled to be demolished, she appeared on the wall again, and I approached her for the first time. I told her I had a little toy in my garage that I made when I was young, a glider that fulfilled the dreams of many children before it was forgotten. Perhaps a little flight would make up for some regrets... if she wanted.
She gazed at me for a long time, before eventually declining.
'Running away has no meaning if I'm not running away on my own,' she said.
'Besides, I can fly without a glider.'
When I looked up at the wall again, she was gone. The empty wheelchair drove back down the path I had come up on its own. On the other side, she sank towards the night beneath the walls, a massive umbrella in her hands.
text.zh:
我第一次看见那个人，是在一截因区块改组而被孤零零地遗落在城市边缘的老城墙上。在很快要被拆除的老城区，除了我的载具工坊，就只剩下几个退休的老家伙，理应没有我不认识的人才是。
那天晚上风刮得厉害，她坐在墙垣上，双腿像两根干枯的树枝，僵硬地在风中摇摆。她身后停着一架轮椅，在月亮的映照下，泛着惨淡的白光。我一边在通讯录里翻找着公证所的号码，一边紧盯着她，生怕我一转头，她就做出什么傻事。
但她什么也没做，只是回看着我，用一种我不知道该怎么形容，但恐怕就算我剥掉一层皮也甩不脱的，过分锐利的目光。她把手指抬到唇边，向我比了一个噤声的手势。我试探性地收起终端，再看她时，她的目光已经飘向了不知何处的夜空。
虽然搞不明白她是为何又如何爬上了那截老城墙，但只要她没想不开，就好。
那之后，我偶尔还会在深夜，在那截城墙上瞥见她的身影。我伸手打个招呼，她也就轻轻摆摆手，聊作回应。时间久了，我想，她去那里坐着的原因，大概和我每天深夜在老城区游荡是相仿的。拉特兰的白天属于喧闹的欢乐的人们，它的夜晚属于没有身份的流民、共感失调的天使，甚至戴着兜帽的萨卡兹——那些不入流的残缺的人。
老城区要被拆除的前夜，她果然又出现在城墙上。我第一次走到她身边，对她说话。我的工坊里还放着一架年轻时的得意之作，一架在被遗忘之前，曾帮无数孩子圆过梦的滑翔机。我想，我载她飞上一程，或许可以弥补些她的缺憾……如果她愿意的话。
她长久地凝视着我，然后委婉地拒绝了。
“逃跑如果不是我一个人的逃跑，那就没有意义啦。”我记得她这样说。
“况且，哪怕不用滑翔机，我自己也可以飞的哦。”她又这样补充道。
我再回过神时，她已经从我身边消失。我看见那架无人驾驶的轮椅，自己嘀嘀响着，沿着我爬上城墙的来路向下驶去。而另一边，她撑起一把巨大的伞，沉向城墙下的夜色。

text.en:
Patrizion is a citizen of Laterano entitled to the rights listed in Clauses 1 through 13 of the Laterano Constitution, and the longest-tenured active gun-knight of Laterano. He is intimately familiar with the use of various types of firearms.
In accordance with the memorandum of cooperation between the Lateran Curia and Rhodes Island, he is currently stationed on Rhodes Island as a collaborating operator under the code name Sankta Miksaparato.
text.zh:
帕特里奇昂，拉特兰公民，拉特兰目前任职时间最长的铳骑，适用于拉特兰一至十三项公民权益，熟练掌握所有种类铳械的使用方式。
现因拉特兰教皇厅与罗德岛友好协议，以“信仰搅拌机”为代号，作为合作干员为罗德岛提供协助。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Sankta Miksaparato shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.10u/L
Operator Sankta Miksaparato has many scars on his body, but all were properly treated, and in his fitness examination he demonstrated the physical prowess befitting a gun-knight, surpassing many younger field operators.
There is irreversible damage to his left hip joint. Surgical replacement is recommended, considering his age and the associated risk of bone fracture. I am available next month to perform the operation.
—Mon3tr

'I'm a little concerned. A gun-knight's presence on Rhodes Island represents Laterano's trust in us, but... Operator Mon3tr isn't nearly as meticulous as Dr. Kal'tsit was when it comes to dealing with people.'
'Don't worry, I just saw her pushing Mr. Patrizion's wheelchair through the corridor at great speed. He was laughing heartily.'
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员信仰搅拌机没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.10u/L
虽然身上有多处伤痕，但都得到了精心医治。在几项运动测试中展现出了无愧于铳骑称号的身体素质，数据甚至超过了许多年轻的外勤干员。
左边的髋关节曾受到不可逆损伤，考虑到他年龄较大、骨质较脆，存在巨大的安全隐患，建议进行手术更换，下个月我正好有空，可以安排我来主刀。
——Mon3tr

“我有点担心，毕竟铳骑来罗德岛代表了拉特兰对我们的信任，但……Mon3tr干员在待人接物方面远没有凯尔希医生那样滴水不漏……”
“别担心，我刚刚看到Mon3tr干员推着帕特里奇昂先生的轮椅在舰桥走廊上飞速滑行，老爷子笑得很大声。”

text.en:
[A Day in Patrizion's Life]
05:00 - Wakes up and changes into full gun-knight armor. Typically takes one hour (he refused to pick a squire, insisting on wearing and removing his armor without assistance).
06:00 - Morning prayer. Typically takes one hour, though 10-15 minutes may be spent deciding which scripture ribbon to display on his armor (scriptures issued during Yvangelista XI's reign are excluded from selection).
07:00 - Arrives for duty. Patrizion leads his squad to patrol the designated district, wearing a halo amplifier (a.k.a. helmet-mounted supplemental halo light). Laterano guidebooks recommend that tourists in need of assistance seek out the brightest halo in the crowd.
13:00 - Change of shift. Patrizion climbs the walls and uses city-defense artillery loaded with special ammunition to clear obstacles in Laterano's route. Laterano is the only nomadic city that maintains its route by such means, and only the gun-knights are skilled enough to destroy large obstacles (typically overgrown Originium crystals) without compromising the terrain of the route. This is his favorite part of the day.
17:00 - Change of shift. Patrizion arrives at the firing range for practice or to train new Pontifica Cohors recruits, and demonstrates the usage of large firearms to the numerous Lateran citizens who gather to watch. Typically takes much longer than expected due to the large crowds, but he never turns down citizens seeking his advice.
19:00 - Audience with Yvangelista XI to report on Laterano's security matters, discuss the Law, and share cactus tarts (as the previous item on the schedule tends to overrun, Patrizion typically only has time to do the latter).
20:00 - End of work day. Patrizion blocks Yvangelista XI's work account, removes his personal account from the blacklist, picks out a message that includes movie tickets from the many unread messages to reply to, then turns off his terminal.
20:30 - Watches a movie with Yvangelista XI.
22:00 - Attempts to sleep (usually unsuccessful, in which case he turns on his terminal and attempts to send a message to Yvangelista XI's personal account, only to get a popup message that he has been blocked).

[Audio Log]
'Why don't you answer his messages? Weren't you the only one to realize that he disappeared when we were dragged into the dream by the Law? I thought you guys were good friends.'
'Mm... all I remembered was that there was this old man who gave me the habit of eating cactus tarts, but I couldn't remember who it was. Speaking of, you're friends with Mostima, aren't you, Fia? Why don't you answer HER messages?'
'......'
text.zh:
【帕特里奇昂的日程】
05:00 起床，花费一小时穿戴铳骑的全套盔甲（帕特里奇昂拒绝在戍卫队内挑选一位自己的侍从，并坚持自己穿脱盔甲）
06:00 晨读经文，通常会花费一个小时，但其中可能有十至五十分钟用于决定当日要在盔甲上挂哪一条经文带（选择范围不包括伊万杰利斯塔十一世在位期间颁布的经文）
07:00 到岗，佩戴光环亮度增幅器（或称头盔内置式光环补光灯），并带领所辖的戍卫队分队，在指定城区的街道上巡逻（拉特兰城的导览手册中写道：如果您遇到困难，在人群中寻找最高最亮的那顶光环，那位萨科塔会为您提供帮助）
13:00 与同僚换班，登上城墙，用填装特殊弹药的城防炮清理拉特兰城航线上的障碍物。拉特兰是唯一一座以此种方式维护航道的移动城市，而在拉特兰人之中，唯有铳骑精湛的射击技艺能够确保在震碎大体积障碍物（通常是过度增殖的源石结晶）的同时不损害航道地表的平整性（这是帕特里奇昂一天中最喜爱的工作）
17:00 与同僚换班，于靶场练习或训练戍卫队新兵，并向围观的拉特兰市民展示巨型铳械的操作方式。由于围观的市民络绎不绝，此项工作花费的时间通常会远超预期，但帕特里奇昂从不会拒绝任何一位向他求教的市民
19:00 觐见伊万杰利斯塔十一世，汇报拉特兰的防卫事宜，探讨拉特兰的律法，并与其分食仙人掌挞（由于前一项工作花费的时间远超预期，迟到的帕特里奇昂往往只会与伊万杰利斯塔十一世进行最后一项活动）
20:00 离岗，屏蔽伊万杰利斯塔十一世的工作账号，并将其私人账号拉出黑名单。从诸多未读消息中挑出附件包含电影票的一条回复，并关闭终端
20:30 与伊万杰利斯塔十一世共同观影
22:00 试图入睡（通常不能入睡，帕特里奇昂会打开终端，给伊万杰利斯塔十一世的私人账号发送消息，并收到对方的屏蔽提醒）

【语音记录】
“为什么不回他的消息？当初被律法拖进梦境的时候，不是只有你意识到他消失了吗？我以为你们关系很不错的。”
“咳……那时候我只是清楚地记得有个老家伙给我养成了吃仙人掌挞的怪癖，却怎么也想不起那是谁了，仅此而已！话又说回来，小菲啊，我看你和莫斯提马的关系也很不错，怎么你也不回她的消息呢？”
“……”

text.en: It took six months before Operator Fiammetta and Operator Sankta Miksaparato met on Rhodes Island. She promptly looked up his mission logs and found that the gun-knight, despite claiming to want to find a place outside Laterano to get some good rest, had participated in a large number of field missions, along with other even more outlandish activities: At Roberta's introduction, he starred in the Wrankwood action blockbuster Kingdom of Outlaws. He had showed up at just the right time—the filmmakers were having trouble casting someone more than two meters tall who could play a villain, wear a special suit of armor, and carry a massive weapon that sprayed fire. Conveniently, he was able to do all this without special effects or even a custom costume: all the crew had to do was spray-paint his gun-knight armor. He was extremely interested in acting, and turned out to be a natural, finishing most of his scenes in one take. The producer called him 'the last piece of the puzzle for this film to become a classic'... He also took part in a Columbian off-road rally—it took the combined efforts of Closure and Chiave's team and a full month of work to create a vehicle that could carry his weight and that of his armor, but the final result was unsatisfactory at best: though no one was foolish enough to clash with him, the machine lacked the necessary performance, and the massive rider and his massive bike were the last to cross the finish line at sunset. Though the photo album 'Gun-knights and the Art of Motorcycle Maintenance' became the subject of much discussion on the intercity net. ...... Items such as 'helping Engineering with deck repairs' and 'learning qinggong from Yanese operators' were dismissed by Fiammetta as being mundane. 'Is this your idea of rest and recuperation, Patrizion? You're even busier than you were in Laterano.' 'Did you think I'd spend my days on the deck basking in the sun?' '......' 'Sure, that sounds like what an old man on the verge of retirement might do. But I've spent my entire life as a gun-knight and nothing else. What's wrong with a chance to experience other ways of living?' 'I didn't even say anything!' 'Look, Fia, I won't interfere with your life anymore, so I hope you won't interfere with mine either... There might not be much left of it, but there are still so many possibilities.'
text.zh:
时隔半年，干员菲亚梅塔终于在罗德岛上见到了干员信仰搅拌机，随后她申请查阅了信仰搅拌机的任务记录，发现这位号称“希望能在拉特兰之外找个地方好好休息”的铳骑，短短半年内主动出了多次外勤，并在任务之余进行了多种令菲亚梅塔觉得匪夷所思的活动：
经过罗比菈塔介绍，信仰搅拌机参与了蓝卡坞动作视效大片《无法无天的国度》的拍摄。据说信仰搅拌机出现的时机刚刚好，“身形巨大、身穿特制装甲、手持喷吐火焰的巨型武器的大反派”太过难找，剧组的选角工作陷入停滞……信仰搅拌机不需要使用特效也不需要定制戏服，道具组只是在他的铳骑盔甲上喷了些彩漆，试镜时便惊艳了所有人，更何况，信仰搅拌机本人对出演电影一事十分热衷，也相当擅长，半数的戏都是一条过……按照制片人的说法，“信仰搅拌机先生的加入是令这部电影成为影史经典的最后一块拼图”……
信仰搅拌机还参与了哥伦比亚荒野的机车拉力赛，为了打造出能够承载他身躯与盔甲的专属坐骑，可露希尔、干员贾维等人鼎力相助，在工程部忙活了整整一个月。然而，信仰搅拌机在比赛中取得的成绩还是有些惨烈：虽然一路上无人敢与之争锋，但那辆车本身的性能显然还是存在问题……身形巨大的骑手推着体积巨大的机车，迎着夕阳走完了后半程，最后一个到达终点，反倒是“铳骑与机车维修艺术”系列照片在城际网络上引发了一股讨论热潮。
……
至于“参与工程部维修甲板的工作”“跟着炎国干员学习轻功”等记录，相比之下过于平平无奇，被菲亚梅塔很快地略过了。

“帕特里奇昂，这就是你说的休养？你可是比在拉特兰的时候还要忙。”
“哎呀，难道在你的想象中，我每天都躺在罗德岛的甲板上晒太阳？”
“……”
“是很符合对一个快退休的老家伙的想象啦。但干了一辈子铳骑，很难说我是经历得多还是经历得少……现在难得有时间体验体验别的生活，不是很好吗？”
“喂喂，我又没说什么！”
“小菲，我不再干涉你的人生，也希望你不要干涉我的人生……它可能剩的不多了，但还是充满了无限可能的。”

text.en:
It is difficult to define the relationship between Patrizion and Fiammetta.
They are not your average grandfather and granddaughter. He took her in when she was seven, vowing to his fallen comrade to raise her into a Lateran any parent would be proud of. Their first 'war' broke out that very day, when he attempted to comfort the young Liberi with movies when she stubbornly refused to show her sorrow. The attempt was a failure, with Patrizion being forced to defend his choice of films (though he insists it was a win because he achieved his original goal of making her forget her sorrow). The adoption documents at the Notarial Hall record their relationship as grandparent and grandchild, but they rarely call each other that. Indeed, during what little time they spend together, they are like two bickering friends, arguing over each other's fighting styles, interests, hobbies, behavior, and even diet, before going back to their own lives, satisfied.
They are also not your average mentor and pupil. Patrizion was indeed Fiammetta's mentor, and he was involved in the important moments of her life, from choice of school to choice of career. According to her, however, he only seriously exercised his role as a mentor on three occasions: accompanying her when she upgraded her grenade launcher, encouraging her to join the gun-knights, and attempting to rectify her tastes in cinema. He did not deny these claims, and simply reiterated his disapproval of her prejudice against Wrankwood movies.

[Medical Department Audio Log]
'Ah, it's nothing I can't talk about... I've always felt that my role as her mentor was to be the embodiment of Laterano for Fia. As a Liberi child who lost her parents at a young age, she had many questions growing up that 'Paradise' had to answer, questions that couldn't be answered by the papers of the Notarial Hall, or the 'faith' that every Lateran speaks of yet can't properly explain. For Fia, I was a gun-knight, someone who was in a position to interpret the Law. I was a Lateran she could talk to... Honestly, I was in the same boat. After Gia left the Holy City and Pag distanced himself from me—when I realized I'd never truly shared anything with the Liberi I lived side-by-side with—I began to have doubts about the Holy City, and needed a 'Laterano' I could talk to. That was when Fia came into my life. Who's to say who couldn't leave whose side?'
'I see. But why don't you want her to find out that you'll be hospitalized for a while because of arthritis?'
'Because I don't want her to think of me as a bedridden old man.'
text.zh:
我们很难去定义菲亚梅塔与帕特里奇昂之间的关系。
首先，他们不是常规意义上的爷孙。帕特里奇昂在菲亚梅塔七岁时将这名戍卫队遗孤领回家中，立誓要完成战友的遗愿，将菲亚梅塔培养成足以令任何父母骄傲的拉特兰人，却在当天就迎来了两人的第一场“战争”：帕特里奇昂试图用电影安慰悲伤却倔强地不肯表露的小黎博利，结果以帕特里奇昂奋力辩护自己的电影品味并失败告终（帕特里奇昂坚称这是自己的胜利，因为菲亚梅塔忘记了伤心——这才是他的本来目的）。在公证所的领养文书上，两人的关系一栏登记为“爷孙”，但几乎没人见过他们平常以爷孙相称，他们甚至很少相聚，这两人更像是损友，偶然凑在一起“贬损”对方的战斗风格、兴趣爱好、言行举止甚至饮食作息，然后满足地回归各自的生活。
再者，他们不是常规意义上的师生。依据人事部收集到的资料，帕特里奇昂先生确实是菲亚梅塔的导师，在菲亚梅塔诸多人生的重要时刻，不管是择校还是择业……都有帕特里奇昂的推荐或签字，但按照菲亚梅塔自己的说法，在她的人生中，这位导师只在三种场合认真行使他的职能：坚定不移地陪她升级榴弹发射器；坚定不移地鼓励她加入铳骑；坚定不移地试图矫正她在电影艺术上的审美……帕特里奇昂对此并不否认，同时强调菲亚梅塔对于蓝卡坞的类型电影确实存在一些偏见。

【医疗部录音】
“哎呀，这些话没有什么不能说的啦……我一直觉得，我这个‘导师’的意义，只是在于给小菲提供了一个具象化的‘拉特兰’，作为一个自幼失去父母的黎博利孩子，乐园需要回应她成长中面临的诸多疑问，这些疑问不是公证所的文件，或者每个拉特兰人都挂在嘴边却又解释不清的‘信仰’所能回答的，在小菲看来，我是铳骑，我是有资格去解释‘律法’的人，我是她真正可以对话的拉特兰……其实对我何尝不是这样呢。吉雅离开了圣城，潘也不再与我联络，当我发现自己从未与生活在一个时空的黎博利有过真正的交流，我同样对拉特兰存有疑惑，我同样需要一个，可以对话的‘拉特兰’，小菲便是在那时出现的。所以，很难说到底是小菲离不开我还是我离不开她啦……”
“我明白了。可是，帕特里奇昂先生，您的关节炎很严重，还得在医疗部住上一段时间，菲亚梅塔好不容易回来，您为什么不想让她知道这件事呢？”
“不要。我可不想在她的印象里变成一个需要躺在病床上的老家伙。”

text.en: [Postcard] Dear Grandmother, I will graduate soon. I would like to apologize for the impulsive decision I made behind your back... Perhaps you already realized that I've felt out-of-place studying theology these past four years. I still believe that my childhood dream is my destined path, and that I can do so much more as a gun-knight than as a priest. I'll be applying to become a cadet gun-knight, so I won't be coming back for the holidays. The training and approval process may take a while, but I'll be in full armor the next time I come see you. With Love, Patrizion [Notice Letter] Mr. Patrizion Pozzo, We regret to inform you that we have held the remains of your grandmother, Marion Pozzo, for the maximum period permitted. As we have been unable to contact you, we have cremated her remains in accordance with the Law. You may retrieve the ashes at your convenience. With Apologies, Ecclesia Requietum Stevonus [Permit] Patrizion Pozzo, Apostolic Knight, is hereby authorized to supervise the departure of the long-range landship Twinflower and accompanying vehicles from Laterano, for the purpose of deporting Lateran citizens afflicted with Oripathy in accordance with the Law. Patrizion Pozzo is hereby granted absolute discretion over all personnel on the ship, and is authorized to make any modifications or cancellations to the schedule as necessary. [Notification] Citizen Gia Lopez, you have been diagnosed with Oripathy, and are now scheduled to depart Laterano on the landship Twinflower in accordance with the Law. Cooperate with supervising personnel during the journey, and remain in the Infected cabins on the lower levels except when necessary. Detailed instructions are attached with this notification. Please read them prior to departure. [Recommendation] Your Holiness: I, Patrizion Pozzo, hereby recommend the cadet gun-knight Aurela, who demonstrated extraordinary performance during the assessment process. While her pride can still get in her way at times, I believe that with proper guidance she could be the most promising gun-knight of the next generation. Patrizion Pozzo [Rejection] To Patrizion Pozzo, Apostolic Knight: As the Pontiff of Laterano, I hereby reject your resignation. What happened to Aurela was not your fault—not entirely, at least—and there is still much for you to do in your current position. If you still insist on resigning and nothing will change your mind, write another resignation letter. Yvangelista XI [Unsent Letter] ...Gia. I retired today. I've been a gun-knight for fifty years... It's plenty, but at the end of it all, I still don't understand what a gun-knight is. At first, I thought becoming one would let me protect everyone. Later, I thought becoming one is what made me lose everyone around me. Recently, however, an even scarier thought occupies my mind. Maybe all the ups and downs in my life had nothing to do with becoming a gun-knight at all. That it's not that being in this position made all those choices for me, but that I was unwilling to make them myself... Was becoming a gun-knight the only choice I ever made in my life? If so, a 'gun-knight' might be no more than a symbol, an ideal, an answer for me that I'd taken for granted. But that's not what a gun-knight should be, and it's not what Laterano should be. No one should allow a symbol, an ideal, to dictate all their choices in life. Do you think I still have a chance to help the children understand this? Or maybe they've always understood it better than I have. I hope so, Gia. I really do...
text.zh:
【一张明信片】
亲爱的祖母：
我很快就要毕业。不过，很抱歉瞒着您做了个冲动的决定。理由嘛……您一定也能猜到，这四年的律法我越读越觉得无力。我还是觉得自己小时候的理想是对的，当个铳骑能做到的事，比我当个修士能做的要多太多了。
我这次假期就不回家了，直接去申报实习铳骑。训练和考核的过程可能会很长，但我到时候一定会穿着盔甲回来见您。
爱您的帕特里奇昂
【一封通知书】
尊敬的帕特里奇昂·波佐先生：
很抱歉通知您，您的祖母玛丽昂·波佐女士的遗体，已达到本教堂的最长遗体保存期限。由于一直未能联系到您，本教堂现依律法对上述遗体进行火化。您可以随时到访本教堂领取骨灰。
再次向您致以诚挚的歉意，司提望区安魂教堂

【一张许可证】
现特准帕特里奇昂·波佐以教宗骑士之名义，监督长途陆行舰“双子花”号及其附属车队离开拉特兰的行程。
该行程旨在依律法将罹患矿石病的拉特兰公民遣送出境，事关重大，帕特里奇昂·波佐有权监督舰上任何人员的任何行为，并在必要时刻取消或更改行程。
【一封告知书】
拉特兰公民吉雅·洛佩兹，现已确认您罹患矿石病，依据律法，您应在7月21日乘长途陆行舰“双子花”号离开拉特兰城。
在行程期间，您应积极配合管理，非必要不离开陆行舰下层的感染者舱室。随告知书附上具体守则文件，请您在启程前完整阅读。

【一封推荐信】
教宗敬启：
本人，帕特里奇昂·波佐，向你举荐实习铳骑奥罗拉。奥罗拉在考核过程中表现极为优异，虽性格上有自负之嫌，但我认为如果得到恰当的引导，她将会成为新生代铳骑之中最有作为的一位。
帕特里奇昂·波佐
【一封拒绝信】
教宗骑士帕特里奇昂·波佐：
我以拉特兰教宗的身份，拒绝你的辞职申请。奥罗拉的事不该完全归咎于你，而你在这个位置上还有很多能做到的事。
如果你确实无论如何都想辞职，就再写一封辞职信。
伊万杰利斯塔十一世

【一封未寄出的信】
……吉雅。
我今天正式退休了。我当了五十多年铳骑……也够了，足足够了。但很惭愧地说，我还是不明白铳骑到底是什么。
起初，我以为当上铳骑就能保护所有人。
后来，我又觉得是当了铳骑才让我失去了身边的所有人。
但近来，一个有些恐怖的想法一直困扰着我。我想，我一生中所有这些跌宕起伏，是不是都与铳骑的身份无关？
与其说是这个身份替我做出了那些选择，不如说……从最开始就是我自己不愿意去做那些选择？我这一辈子，是不是其实只做了一个选择——那就是成为铳骑？
……那我或许明白了。我眼里的铳骑，是不是就只是一个符号、一种理念，一个理所当然的答案？
但铳骑不该是这样，拉特兰不该是这样。没人该让一个符号或一种理念替自己做完人生中所有的选择。你说，我还有机会让孩子们明白这回事吗？
……又或者自始至终，他们都比我更清楚这个道理？
那样最好，吉雅，那样最好……

text.en:
It has been a long day. You were unable to get out of work until quite late, and the movie has already started by the time you arrive at the theater. You feel less guilty when you sit down and see that the seat next to you is empty; it would be rude to be half an hour late for a meeting with an old man, but not so much if the other party is late too.
The movie ends, and the old man never showed up. As you get ready to return to your office, someone pats you on the shoulder.
'You were late, Doctor.'
You turn around to see the tall figure of Patrizion, his head wrapped tight in a scarf that almost covers the top of his head. It has been a cold winter.
You express your dissatisfaction. After all, it was he who never showed up. He sighs and apologizes.
'The people behind me complained I was too tall, so I moved to the last row. Sorry, I forgot to send you a message.'
Now you are the one in the wrong. You blink.
'I usually pick the late shows, where I won't have to worry about blocking someone else's view. For some reason, though, I always have someone sitting behind me, so I always have to go sit in the last row. At my age, it gets really hard to see the screen from there...'
Patrizion keeps talking along the way, right up until you have to part. That is when he realizes it—
'Oh, look at me, I've been babbling, haven't I? It's been so long since I've watched a movie with someone, and I was just too excited.' He shakes his head abashedly and turns around to leave.
You stop him before he rounds the corner and tell him you were planning to get some ice cream. You can walk with him for a little while longer.
text.zh:
今天实在太忙，你很晚才抽出身，来到放映厅时，电影已经开始。坐下时，你发现隔壁的位置也空着，心里的愧疚减轻了些，赴一位老人家的约却迟来半个小时不是什么有礼貌的行为，但如果他也迟到，那就是另外一回事了。
直到电影结束，那位老人家也没有来，就在你打算回办事处时，有人拍了拍你的肩膀。
“你来晚了，博士。”
你转头，看到帕特里奇昂冲你打了个招呼。今年冬天真的很冷，他的围巾堆在脑袋旁，几乎连头顶也要裹起来了。
你向他表达了自己的不满，毕竟从头到尾都没出现的人是他。他叹口气，向你道歉：
“后排的人一直在抱怨我长得太高，所以我换到最后一排了。很抱歉，忘记发消息给你了。”
好吧，现在理亏的人又是你了，你眨眨眼。
“每次我都会选择最晚的场次，人少的话就不怕挡到别人的视线了。但我这破运气，每次都能碰到后面坐着人，结果就只能去最后一排坐。可你也知道，我这上了岁数的老花眼，坐在后面什么也看不清……”
帕特里奇昂就这样喋喋不休讲了一路，直到分别的路口，你都没有找到说上一句话的机会，告别的时候，老人才突然反应过来——
“唉……我这絮絮叨叨的嘴，你可不要嫌烦，我也是好久没和其他人一起来看电影了，实在是太高兴了。”他不好意思地摇摇头，转身离开。
在帕特里奇昂的背影即将消失在转角时，你叫住了他。你告诉他，你还要买一杯冰淇淋，如果顺路就再一起走一段吧。

value.en: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected by medical examination.
value.zh: 体表有源石结晶分布，参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

text.en: Elite Operator Raidian previously worked on communications support for Babel, and led the establishment of Rhodes Island's communications system, providing the necessary framework support.
text.zh: 电弧，罗德岛精英干员。曾为巴别塔提供通讯支援，主导罗德岛早期的通讯系统建设，为相关通讯工作提供了必要的框架支持。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 5%
Originium crystals can be observed on the surface of Operator Raidian's body.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.19u/L
Under normal circumstances, Operator Raidian diligently follows the Medical Department's instructions in taking her medication and using her Arts in moderation, providing a sterling example for other operators to follow... Under normal circumstances, that is.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】5%
干员电弧体表有少量源石结晶分布。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.19u/L
在通常情况下，干员电弧会稳定而可靠地遵循医疗部按时服药、适度使用源石技艺的医嘱。这种伟大的自觉和自我管理能力超过了许多干员……当然，是在通常情况下。

text.en:
[Operator Raidian's Personal Profile]
Native of Ursus, Elite Operator of Rhodes Island. Able to perceive electrical signals through Originium Arts.
Current scope of duties includes communications, intelligence processing, and field operations. Noted for her gentle and polite demeanor.
Graduated early from Marynin Girls' High School to study neuroscience at the University of Deity Grypherburg. Regularly participated in research and fieldwork during her studies.
...

[Permission verified... full profile unlocked]

[Ursus Patrol Unit Report (Fragment)]
Serafina Ivanovna Petrova is no longer in Ursus territory.
Investigation and a raid on Petrova's residence has confirmed that she is in dereliction of her duties and expresses clear sympathies for the Infected. She had ■■■■■ assisted ■■■■■.
Documents retrieved during the raid reveal that Petrova made contact with Leithanien five months ago and formalized their cooperation one and a half months ago, in exchange for a safe escape.

[Audio Log]
'Petrova? I think I remember the name...'
'Ah, yes—the girl from Ursus!'
(Rustling of clothes. The speaker seems to have shifted postures.)
'She always had a smile on her face, even when she was fleeing Ursus. (A soft sigh.) I had... some personal connections that got me work from the Kurfürst, which involved sneaking her out from right under the nose of the Patrol Unit in exchange for some sort of list she had.
'Wasn't an easy job, but it wasn't the first time either.
'Still... she was a little different. When we were at the border, she spent a long time looking back. I asked her if she missed her home, but she said she was thinking of her old workplace—weird, isn't it? Who on Terra would love their work that much?
'Never mind. I guess she was a workaholic. She did well in Leithanien. Maybe the best of anyone I've smuggled. She fit in well in Leithanien, but she didn't like the place.
'The last time I saw her, she was with a group of refugees heading to Kazdel...'
(Brief silence)
'I don't know why she gave up a nice apartment to get mixed up with a bunch of refugees. It's not exactly an easy path, and I wouldn't be there to escort her... There were rumors later that she joined some group by the name of 'Babel'. Not sure if they're true or not.
'But she never really cared where she lived. She was like that since her Ursus days.
'Strange girl, really.'

[Operator Registration Update]
Operator Raidian originally joined Babel at the invitation of Theresa while in Kazdel. She provided invaluable communications support to Babel units on Kazdelian battlefields, at great burden to herself, significantly increasing Babel's operational flexibility.
Raidian stayed at Rhodes Island after the Babel Incident, and began participating in field operations at Whitesmith's recommendation, joining the ranks of Rhodes Island's first elite operators.
text.zh:
【干员电弧个人信息】
乌萨斯人，罗德岛的精英干员，能够通过源石技艺感知电信号。
当前主要负责通讯支持、情报处理与外勤作战任务，待人亲和有礼。
少年时期于玛利内女子高等中学跳级完成学业，而后进入圣骏堡大学攻读神经科学学位。在校期间曾参与多项科研项目与社会实践。
……

【权限确认完成……已开放精英干员全信息可阅】

【乌萨斯纠察队报告书-残篇】
目标塞拉菲娜·伊万诺夫娜·彼得罗娃已不在乌萨斯境内。
根据后续调查以及房屋搜查确认，彼得罗娃罔顾审讯职责，对感染者存在明确的同情态度，曾■■■■■帮助■■■■■。
根据搜查到的书信确认，彼得罗娃于五个月前同莱塔尼亚方面取得联络，并于一个半月前与莱塔尼亚达成协作，换取潜逃机会。

【录音记录】
“塞拉菲娜？嘶，这名字……好像有点印象……
“哦，对了，是她——是那个乌萨斯女孩儿！”
（衣物摩擦声，说话人似乎换了一个姿势）
“我记得她，她总是笑眯眯的，哪怕从乌萨斯逃出来的时候也差不多是那副表情，唉……我当时有点私人关系，能从选帝侯那儿接点活儿来做，说是因为她提供了一份什么名单，作为交换莱塔尼亚得帮忙把她从纠察队眼皮子底下给偷出来。
“这活儿可不好做，但我不是第一次做了。
“不过……她的确不太一样，她在边境回头看了很久，我问她在看哪儿，是不是在想家，她说在看她工作的地方——你瞧，这不是有点毛病嘛！谁能爱工作啊！
“哈……不过也是，她估计是个工作狂吧，她后续在莱塔尼亚混得挺好的，算我送过的人里数一数二的好。她很适合莱塔尼亚。但她不喜欢莱塔尼亚。
“我最后一次见她是在难民流亡的队伍里，他们要去卡兹戴尔……”
（片刻沉默）
“我是搞不懂为什么她要放弃漂亮的高级公寓混到难民堆里去，那条路可没那么好走，而且也没我给她保驾护航……听说她后来加入了什么巴别塔，也不知道是不是真的……
“但……她从一开始就没在意过自己住的地方，在乌萨斯时就是这样。
“真是个奇怪的丫头。”

【干员登记与变动】
干员电弧于卡兹戴尔受到特蕾西娅的影响加入巴别塔，成为通讯支援人员，在身体负担极重的情况下为卡兹戴尔战场上的巴别塔队伍传递信息，大范围提高了作战机动性。
巴别塔变故后，电弧选择留在罗德岛，在Whitesmith的举荐下，她开始以核心成员的身份参与外勤作战任务，随后正式登记成为罗德岛第一批次的精英干员。

text.en: Overall, there were two causes for the incident. The first was the suspension of the stool races due to both the dangers and the toll they were taking on the work stools, resulting in a void in entertainment offerings. The second was the increase in gatherings for dining and drinking amongst the elite operators. While there is always someone or other away on a mission, these gatherings are highly valued by the operators. Sometimes bets are made over a drink, usually involving some sort of skill contest. Some are fine, some are silly, absurd and inexplicable. The latter kind always sees more participants, and it is more likely that someone will lose their heads, causing things to spiral out of control. Blaze shouted her approval when Mechanist proposed an unconventionally-powered robot arena for the third time. Misery pondered the idea quietly, shifting his eyes between a bottle and the ground, but Raidian put a hand on the three of them—at the same time—before Misery could do anything. One of the perks of having four hands, apparently. A witness recalls that she even used her fourth hand to flip the meat on the grill and put it on Mantra's plate. 'The meat's getting burnt,' she said. 'I have a better game for you, if you really want to play...' She continued, 'A competition that involves philosophy, fate, probability, and challenging yourself.' No one knew if she was drunk. She continued to wear her familiar smile, with no change in her complexion. Was she drunk? The rest exchanged glances in silence, trying to get their alcohol-addled brains spinning... Could it be? That Raidian, who always unfailingly delivers drunkards to their dorm rooms after a long night of partying, and provides them hangover patches the next day? Mechanist coughed and asked her what she had in mind. She drew back all her hands and said, dead-pan, 'Rock-paper-scissors. Loser has to write mission reports for the winner, for a week.' It was only when someone lost eight times in a row despite showing nothing but rock that people began to suspect that something was not right. Was she using her Arts? Did their bioelectrical signals betray their own thoughts? Finally, the long-awaited scissors appeared. 'Hehe...' She leaned back against her chair, her speech slightly slurred. She was undoubtedly drunk. 'I... win... yay...!'
text.zh:
事情的起因总共有二。
其一是圆凳滑行赛因为过于危险以及对工作圆凳损耗过大暂时停赛，当下缺少新的比赛用以消遣。
其二则是精英干员之间的聚餐与酒友关系正在扩散，虽然因任务分配，这种聚会从来就没凑齐过人，但是有一个算一个，有一顿算一顿，大部分人都对此接受良好。
酒桌上也偶尔有些赌局，其中大多是技能比拼，小部分荒诞而难以总结，后者的参与者永远更多，加注更激烈，也更容易让人上头……而人一旦上了头，事情就会变得难以控制。
在Mechanist第三次提出非常规能源小型机器擂台赛这个想法时，煌立刻选择了加入，Misery在一旁沉思许久，看向酒瓶然后看向地面，反复数次。在Misery动手之前，电弧伸手按住了他们三个——同时。
也许这就是有四只手的好处吧。一位涉事人回忆道，她甚至能空出来一只手给炉子上的烤肉翻面，然后夹进Mantra的盘子里。
“肉要烤煳了。”这是她说的第一句话。
“如果你们真的想玩，我有一个更好的游戏……”这是她说的第二句话，“一个关乎思想、命运、随机性与自我挑战的竞技性游戏。”
现在想来，没人知道电弧是不是已经喝醉了。她那张脸和往日一样笑眯眯的，一点不见红。
她醉了吗？众人交换眼神，片刻沉寂中，被酒精麻痹的大脑都努力转动着……不会吧？那可是电弧，不论酒局进展到几点，都能没有闪失地把醉鬼送回宿舍，并在第二天提供醒酒贴剂的电弧……
Mechanist咳嗽了一声，开口询问她那是什么比赛，她收回了所有的手。“猜拳。”她平静地说，“输了的人，帮赢家写一周的任务报告。”
一直到有人对着电弧出了八次石头，却一次都没能赌来她的剪刀时，人们才意识到问题所在。她使用了源石技艺吗？肌肉和思考的电信号是否像个漏勺一样漏光了自己的行动和思想？
那个被期待已久的剪刀终于出现在电弧手上。
“嘿嘿……”她靠着椅背，语速略显迟缓，果然已经醉了，“赢了，好耶……！”

text.en:
[Maintenance Log, Dendie and Axie]

Feb 11. Dendie submitted for inspection.
Request: The bearing on the second joint of Dendie's middle finger is not moving smoothly. There seems to be some kind of foreign object, possibly gravel or broken glass. Please be careful of sharp objects when performing maintenance.
Engineering Comment: Examination complete. Broken glass removed from joint. Did this have something to do with the beaker explosion at the lab yesterday? You didn't have to get involved... However, the auto-adjustment function of the robotic arm, designed to keep it from getting stuck, didn't seem to be working. You should bring Axie in too when you have time.

Feb 13. Axie submitted for inspection.
Request: Brought Axie as requested.
Engineering Comment: Done. Also lubricated the joints so it'll stop making that creaking noise.
Request: Come to think of it, I'm naturally right-handed... Maybe that's caused more wear and tear on Axie. Perhaps I should add another right hand to make things a little easier for it...
Engineering Comment: Four arms are not enough for you? The best you can do, IMO, is stop taking on too much missions.

Mar 20. Dendie and Axie's regular checkup.
Request: Haven't had any tough missions lately, so I haven't brought them in for a while. Thank goodness—I feel like I've been troubling you too much last month. Anyway, I'm going to make a report now and I'll just leave the gift on your desk. Happy birthday.
Engineering Comment: I'm sixteen! I'm not a little girl anymore and I don't need storybooks! Fine. Never mind. The repairs are done, and I put the stickers that Rosmontis left on it. I also applied special tempered films on the stickers so they won't peel off and are waterproof now. Even a direct hit by a bullet would only leave a small dent.

Mar 27. Feature upgrade for Dendie and Axie.
Engineering Comment: I'll come and get Dendie and Axie from you tomorrow.
Engineering Comment: You said you wanted to add a bubble spray to the medicine dispenser? I didn't have time back then, but now I have an idea...
Engineering Comment: By the way, it's not a thank-you gift for that storybook!
Request: Generally speaking, efficiency and clarity is expected in communications, but I still manage to understand what you mean.
text.zh:
【“小树”与“小轴”的维护记录】

02月11日 “小树”送检
需求记录：“小树”的中指第二关节处轴承有些卡顿，似乎是有异物卡在里面了……根据推测，有可能是碎石或是玻璃碎片，维修时请小心不要受伤。
工程干员反馈：检测完毕，碎玻璃已清理干净。我听说昨天实验室有烧杯爆炸了，其实你没必要多管闲事的。不过……理论上来说，机械臂应该有自动调节避免卡顿的功能，但似乎没有触发，把“小轴”也带来检修一下吧。

02月13日 “小轴”送检
需求记录：“小轴”我送来了，拜托你了。
工程干员反馈：完事了，顺便补了润滑油，现在运行时不会嘎嘎响了。太吵了。
需求记录：这么一想……我的确是右利手，也许是日常更习惯使用右手使得“小轴”磨损更严重，真是辛苦它了，或许我可以多补一只右手来分担……
工程干员反馈：“两只手实在是忙不过来了，要是有四只手就好了”的四手怪人，现在正在考虑升级成五手怪人吗？说实话，你少揽点任务到自己身上比什么都强……

03月20日 “小树”“小轴”日常送检
需求记录：最近都没遇到什么困难的任务，所以不怎么需要维修，真是太好了。之前有段时间总是麻烦你呢。因为今天要去做信息汇报，所以提前把它们放在你的桌子上了。还有，生日快乐。
工程干员反馈：……我现在已经不需要故事书了，我已经十六岁了，早就过了需要睡前故事的年龄了！又不是以前那个小丫头——唉，算了，懒得和你掰扯这些。维修完成了，迷迭香上次放在我这儿的贴纸我也给你贴上去了。放心吧，我专门上了层硬化镀膜，现在它不怕水也不会翘边，就算被子弹打中也最多留个小坑。

03月27日 “小树”“小轴”功能升级
工程干员反馈：我明天去你那取“小树”和“小轴”。
工程干员反馈：你之前不是想要给急救药物喷雾口添加泡泡喷射功能吗……那时候说没空，但我现在有个点子……
工程干员反馈：这不是回礼啊，别想多了！
需求记录：通常来说信息传递需要讲究效率，不过你的意思我很清楚地感受到了。

text.en:
A child once asked Raidian, 'Can you hear my thoughts through electrical signals?'
It is a question that many have asked, if not out loud. In theory, they might understand that electrical signals do not communicate the finer nuances of thought and emotion, but this question keeps popping up from the bottom of their hearts, as irrational as it may be.
'Of course not.' Raidian crouches down before the child as she examines the knee they had accidentally scraped. 'It's nothing that powerful. I'm not a mind reader, you know?'
'But you can always tell where I am, and what I need. When I'm sad, you always find me and try to make me feel better.' The child gazes at her, eyes wide open.

They used to call her 'Mind Reader' behind her back, those who feared her.
She had her own room in the interrogation department during her time in Ursus. Guards would bring her 'suspicious individuals', and they would tremble in their chair as though facing a monster. She would then close her eyes and feel the chaotic electrical signals dart through the room, flashing like a screen full of static.

Anxiety, high adrenaline levels, increased body temperature, unsteady electrical signals.
It's fear... no. Don't speculate on emotions. Analyze information. Determine truth from falsehood. Focus on facts, not feelings. That was her job. She was no 'Mind Reader', but the military's lie detector, a convenient tool.
Raidian opened her eyes and saw the old woman cowering in her chair, coughing, trying to pull at her hand. She could sense the old woman's facial muscles twitching, and tears flowing through the valleys formed by the wrinkles on her face.
'She's telling the truth,' said Raidian. 'She doesn't know where those Infected are.'

For the first time, she decided to be 'Raidian', not 'Mind Reader', not a lie detector.
'I don't need to be able to read minds for that,' said Raidian, as she wrapped the scraped knee in bandages. 'I notice what you need, how you feel, and everything else, because I care about you.'

'Come on, let's head to Medical together.' She stood up and gave the child a hand.
'But... weren't you going to check on the medicine in the mailroom?'
'There's no rush. We'll go to Medical first.'
They walked in the direction of the Medical Department. Behind them, Rhodes Island-stamped packages were stacked up in the waiting area, including personal letters, commercial goods, private documents, supplies for trading, and humanitarian donations.
They all had a destination and a recipient, be it Columbia, Kjerag, Rim Billiton, or Ursus.
text.zh:
“电信号好神奇……姐姐你通过它能听到我想的东西吗？”曾经有一个孩子这么问电弧。
这是一个不算新鲜的问题，许多人都有过这样的疑问，当然，大部分人都能从理论上了解——凭借电信号并不能完成细微感情与思维的读取。但……人们总还是会有疑问，不合时宜的、不合道理的，如同气泡一般咕嘟嘟地从心里冒出来。
“怎么会呢？”电弧蹲在孩子面前，检查他摔伤的小腿，“这又不是读心术，哪有那么厉害呀。”
“可你总是能猜到我在哪，知道我需要什么，我想哭的时候，你总能找到我，安慰我。”孩子睁着一双圆而大的眼睛看着她。

“读心术”曾经也是她的绰号。或者换句话说，有一些人心怀恐惧，便如此称呼她。
那时她还在乌萨斯，在审讯部门有一间属于她的房间，卫兵押送那些“可疑分子”来到她的面前。那些人总会坐在椅子上瑟瑟发抖，就好像她是什么可怕的怪物。她闭上眼，杂乱的电信号在审讯室中四散流窜，如同雪花屏幕一般闪烁。

紧张、肾上腺素飙升、体温升高。不稳定的电信号。
那是恐惧……不，不对。不应该猜测情绪，应该去分析，分析信息的真伪。应该注重“事实”，而非“感受”。这是她的工作，和那个可笑的外号不同，她从来都不是“读心术”，她是军方的测谎仪，一个好用的分拣道具。
电弧睁开眼，面前蜷缩在椅子上的老妇人咳嗽着，试图拉住她的手，卫兵拦住了老妇，电弧清晰地读取到老妇的面部肌肉正在抽动，有泪水蔓延在皱纹之间。
“她说的是真的。”电弧开口说，“她不知道那些感染者藏在哪里。”

那是她第一次成为“电弧”。不是“读心术”，不是测谎仪。
“这些是不需要读心术的。”电弧垂下眼睛，为孩子划伤的膝盖裹上止血绷带，“只要我一直留意着你，关心着你，我自然就会注意到你的需求，你的情绪，你的思考或其他一切。”

“来，起来吧。我带你去一趟医疗部。”她站起身，搀扶着孩子。
“啊……可是电弧姐姐，你不是要去收发室清点那些药吗？”
“不着急，先带你去医疗部。”
二人一同向医疗部的方向走去。后方一侧，罗德岛的邮递包裹盖戳转送，在停泊处一齐堆成小山。其中有个人寄送的家书、商品、私人资料，也有罗德岛用于交换的物资或者出于人道主义的馈赠。
它们都有目的地，都有收件方，也有发件人。前往哥伦比亚，前往谢拉格，前往雷姆必拓，也前往乌萨斯。

text.en:
Welcome back, Doctor.
Perhaps you'll be surprised to read this card. Perhaps your long slumber has clouded your mind, making you forget your name and where you are. There is no need to worry. Trust that this is a place you built, where you once stood, with people who stood side-by-side with you. People who share your ideals... people who miss you.
Your slippers are on the left side of the bed. Your favorite bedtime book is in the drawer on the left. If you have headaches or nightmares, there is powdered hot chocolate in the drawer under the nightstand. They always help.
I'll have someone leave this card in your room, perhaps with a flower. I know you would probably prefer a snack—like a box of cookies or some liqueur-filled chocolates. Well, I do worry about your dietary habits, but I'll leave one of those two for you.
Try to exercise self-restraint and spread it out over a number of days, rather than finish it all in one go.
Anyway, I'm glad you're back. That's all I wanted to say—welcome back, Doctor.
—Raidian

You find this card on your desk along with a dried flower, a box of liqueur-filled chocolate, a box of butter cookies, and a small jar of sugar cubes.
text.zh:
首先，博士，欢迎你回来。
也许你在读到这张贺卡的时候会很吃惊，会因为睡得太久头晕目眩，甚至会忘记自己的名字、自己身处何地，但别担心，请相信，这里是你曾经建设与站立过的地方，这里有与你并肩的人，与你理想相同的人，以及……依然在想念你的人。
另一方面，作为必要的提醒，你的拖鞋放在床位左侧，你睡前要看的书在你左手旁的抽屉里，如果你感到头疼或是做了噩梦，床头柜下面的抽屉里有热巧克力冲剂，去给自己冲一杯吧，它们总是有帮助。
贺卡我会托人放在你的房间里，也许我还会配上一朵鲜花。不过对你来说……也许一盒点心或是酒心巧克力更合心意。我确实担心你会形成不健康的饮食偏好，但我会选一样留给你的。
如果你能发挥优秀的自我管理能力，不要一口气吃光，而是每天吃一些就更好了。
总之，我很高兴你回来了，这就是这张贺卡想告诉你的——博士，欢迎回家。
——电弧

这张贺卡与一朵干花、一盒酒心巧克力、一盒黄油点心以及一小罐方糖一起摆放在你的桌子上。
